1.4.m: O noble one, I could not show my face as before. / Afflicted with intense desire, I abducted her that night while she slept.

1.4.s:
nītvā durgatamaikāṃte'kārṣamaudvāhikaṃ vidhim..
gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena tato'kārṣaṃ hṛdīpsitam.. 8.56 ..
1.4.d:
नीत्वा दुर्गतमैकांतेऽकार्षमौद्वाहिकं विधिम्..
गांधर्वेण विवाहेन ततोऽकार्षं हृदीप्सितम्.. 8.56 ..
1.4.m: Taking her to a remote, solitary place, I performed the marriage rite. / By the Gāndharva marriage, I then fulfilled my heart's desire,

1.4.s:
anicchaṃtīṃ tadā bālāṃ balātsuratasevanam..
athānupadamāgatya tatpitā prātareva mām.. 8.57 ..
1.4.d:
अनिच्छंतीं तदा बालां बलात्सुरतसेवनम्..
अथानुपदमागत्य तत्पिता प्रातरेव माम्.. 8.57 ..
1.4.m: enjoying union by force with the maiden who was unwilling. / Then, right the following morning, her father arrived on my trail.

1.4.s:
niśvasya saṃvṛto viprāstāṃ vīkṣyodvāhitāṃ sutām..
śaśāpa kupito bhadra māṃ tadānīṃ sa bhārgavaḥ.. 8.58 ..
1.4.d:
निश्वस्य संवृतो विप्रास्तां वीक्ष्योद्वाहितां सुताम्..
शशाप कुपितो भद्र मां तदानीं स भार्गवः.. 8.58 ..
1.4.m: Sighing, surrounded by brahmins, and seeing his daughter married off, / that Bhārgava, enraged, O noble one, then cursed me.

1.4.s:
..bhārgava uvāca..
niśācarasya dharmeṇa yattvayodvāhitā sutā..
tasmānniśācaraḥ pāpa bhava tvamavilaṃbitam.. 8.59 ..
1.4.d:
..भार्गव उवाच..
निशाचरस्य धर्मेण यत्त्वयोद्वाहिता सुता..
तस्मान्निशाचरः पाप भव त्वमविलंबितम्.. 8.59 ..
1.4.m: The Bhārgava said: / “Since you have married my daughter according to the way of a night-stalker, / therefore, O sinner, you shall become a night-stalker without delay!”

1.4.s:
iti śaptaḥ praṇmyainaṃ pādopagrahapūrvakam..
hāheti ca bruvangāḍhaṃ sāśrunetraṃ sagadgadam.. 8.60 ..
1.4.d:
इति शप्तः प्रण्म्यैनं पादोपग्रहपूर्वकम्..
हाहेति च ब्रुवन्गाढं साश्रुनेत्रं सगद्गदम्.. 8.60 ..
1.4.m: Being thus cursed, bowing down to him and grasping his feet, / uttering cries of “Alas! Alas!”, with tears in my eyes and a choked voice,

1.4.s:
tatohamabravaṃ kasmādadoṣaṃ māṃ bhavāniti..
śapate bhavatā dattā mama vācā purā sutā.. 8.61 ..
1.4.d:
ततोहमब्रवं कस्माददोषं मां भवानिति..
शपते भवता दत्ता मम वाचा पुरा सुता.. 8.61 ..
1.4.m: I then said: “Why do you curse me, who am blameless? / Your daughter was granted to me earlier by your own word.

1.4.s:
sodvāhitā mayā kanyā dānaṃ sakṛditi smṛtiḥ..
sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti paṇḍitāḥ.. 8.62 ..
1.4.d:
सोद्वाहिता मया कन्या दानं सकृदिति स्मृतिः..
सकृज्जल्पंति राजानः सकृज्जल्पंति पण्डिताः.. 8.62 ..
1.4.m: That maiden was wedded by me; the tradition teaches that a gift is made but once. / Kings speak but once; the learned speak but once;

1.4.s:
sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyaṃte trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt..
kiṃ ca pratiśrutārthasya nirvāhastatsatāṃ vratam.. 8.63 ..
1.4.d:
सकृत्कन्याः प्रदीयंते त्रीण्येतानि सकृत्सकृत्..
किं च प्रतिश्रुतार्थस्य निर्वाहस्तत्सतां व्रतम्.. 8.63 ..
1.4.m: maidens are given but once—these three occur only once. / Furthermore, carrying out what has been promised is the vow of the virtuous.

1.4.s:
bhavādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sādhūnāṃ tasya tyāgo vigarhitaḥ..
pratiśrutā tvayā labdhā tadā kālamiyaṃ mayā.. 8.64 ..
1.4.d:
भवादृशानां साधूनां साधूनां तस्य त्यागो विगर्हितः..
प्रतिश्रुता त्वया लब्धा तदा कालमियं मया.. 8.64 ..
1.4.m: For good men like you, abandoning it is reprehensible. / Promised by you, she was obtained by me as mine in due time.

1.4.s:
udvoḍhā cādhunā nāhamucitaḥ śāpabhājanam..
vṛthā śapanti mahyaṃ ca bhavaṃtastadvicāryatām.. 8.65 ..
1.4.d:
उद्वोढा चाधुना नाहमुचितः शापभाजनम्..
वृथा शपन्ति मह्यं च भवंतस्तद्विचार्यताम्.. 8.65 ..
1.4.m: Now that I am her wedded husband, I am not a proper recipient of a curse. / You curse me in vain; consider this matter!

1.4.s:
yo dattvā kanyakāṃ vācā paścāddharati durmatiḥ..
sa yāti narakaṃ ceti dharmaśāstreṣu niścitam.. 8.66 ..
1.4.d:
यो दत्त्वा कन्यकां वाचा पश्चाद्धरति दुर्मतिः..
स याति नरकं चेति धर्मशास्त्रेषु निश्चितम्.. 8.66 ..
1.4.m: That evil-minded man who, having given a maiden by word of mouth, takes her back later, / goes to hell: this is settled in the treatises on dharma.”

1.4.s:
tadākarṇya vyavasyāsau tathyaṃ madvacanaṃ hṛdā..
paścāttāpasamopeto munirmāmityathābravīt.. 8.67 ..
1.4.d:
तदाकर्ण्य व्यवस्यासौ तथ्यं मद्वचनं हृदा..
पश्चात्तापसमोपेतो मुनिर्मामित्यथाब्रवीत्.. 8.67 ..
1.4.m: Hearing that and resolving in his heart that my words were true, / the sage, filled with remorse, then said to me:

1.4.s:
na me syādanyathā vāṇī ulūkastvaṃ bhaviṣyati..
niśācaro hyulūko'pi procyate dvijasattama.. 8.68 ..
1.4.d:
न मे स्यादन्यथा वाणी उलूकस्त्वं भविष्यति..
निशाचरो ह्युलूकोऽपि प्रोच्यते द्विजसत्तम.. 8.68 ..
1.4.m: “My word cannot become false; you will become an owl. / An owl too is called a night-stalker, O best of the twice-born.

1.4.s:
yadeṃdradyumnavijñāne sahāyastaṃva bhaviṣyasi..
tadā tvaṃ prakṛtiṃ vipra prāpsyasītyabravītsa mām.. 8.69 ..
1.4.d:
यदेंद्रद्युम्नविज्ञाने सहायस्तंव भविष्यसि..
तदा त्वं प्रकृतिं विप्र प्राप्स्यसीत्यब्रवीत्स माम्.. 8.69 ..
1.4.m: When you become an aid in the recognition of Indradyumna, / then, O brahmin, you will regain your natural state.” Thus he spoke to me.

1.4.s:
tadvākyasamakālaṃ ca kauśikatvamidaṃ mama..
etāvaṃti dinānyāsīdaṣṭāviṃśaddinaṃ vidheḥ.. 8.70 ..
1.4.d:
तद्वाक्यसमकालं च कौशिकत्वमिदं मम..
एतावंति दिनान्यासीदष्टाविंशद्दिनं विधेः.. 8.70 ..
1.4.m: Simultaneously with his words, this state of an owl became mine. / For so many days it has lasted, up to the twenty-eighth day of Brahmā.

1.4.s:
bilvīdalauriti purā śaśiśekharasya saṃpūjanena mama dīrghataraṃ kilāyuḥ..
saṃjātamatra ca jugupsitamasya śāpātkailāsarodhasi niśācararūpamāsīt.. 8.71 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīnadīprādurbhāve bilvadalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 8 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
बिल्वीदलौरिति पुरा शशिशेखरस्य संपूजनेन मम दीर्घतरं किलायुः..
संजातमत्र च जुगुप्सितमस्य शापात्कैलासरोधसि निशाचररूपमासीत्.. 8.71 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे महीनदीप्रादुर्भावे बिल्वदलमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टमोऽध्यायः.. 8 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Because of my former worship of the Moon-Crested [Lord] with bilva leaves, / my life became extremely long; and here on the slope of Kailāsa, through his curse, I took on this despised form of a night-stalker.
Thus ends the eighth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Bilva Leaves' in the Manifestation of the Mahī River, in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
.. ulūka uvāca..
itīdamuktamakhilaṃ pūrvajanmasamudbhavam..
svarūpamāyuṣo hetuḥ kauśikatvasya ceti me.. 9.1 ..
1.4.d:
.. उलूक उवाच..
इतीदमुक्तमखिलं पूर्वजन्मसमुद्भवम्..
स्वरूपमायुषो हेतुः कौशिकत्वस्य चेति मे.. 9.1 ..
1.4.m: The owl said: / “Thus all this has been told—my past birth, / my nature, and the cause of my lifespan and my owlhood.”

1.4.s:
ityuktvā virate tasminpurūhūtasanāmani..
nāḍījaṃgho bako mitramāha taṃ duḥkhito vacaḥ.. 9.2 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा विरते तस्मिन्पुरूहूतसनामनि..
नाडीजंघो बको मित्रमाह तं दुःखितो वचः.. 9.2 ..
1.4.m: When he, whose name was Purūhūta, paused after speaking thus, / the crane Nāḍījaṅgha, sorrowful, spoke these words to his friend.

1.4.s:
..nāḍījaṃgha uvāca..
yadarthaṃ vayamāyātāstanna siddhaṃ mahāmate..
kāryaṃ tanmaraṇaṃ nūnaṃ trayāṇāmapyupāgatam.. 9.3 ..
1.4.d:
..नाडीजंघ उवाच..
यदर्थं वयमायातास्तन्न सिद्धं महामते..
कार्यं तन्मरणं नूनं त्रयाणामप्युपागतम्.. 9.3 ..
1.4.m: Nāḍījaṅgha said: / “The matter for which we came has not succeeded, O noble-minded one. / Therefore death has truly arrived for all three of us.

1.4.s:
iṃdradyumnāparijñāne bhadrako'yaṃ mumūrṣati..
tasyānu mitraṃ mārkaṃḍastaṃ cānvahamapi sphuṭam.. 9.4 ..
1.4.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नापरिज्ञाने भद्रकोऽयं मुमूर्षति..
तस्यानु मित्रं मार्कंडस्तं चान्वहमपि स्फुटम्.. 9.4 ..
1.4.m: If Indradyumna is not recognized, this Bhadraka wishes to die; / after him, his friend Mārkaṇḍa; and plainly, I too after him.

1.4.s:
mitrakārye vinirvṛtte mriyamāṇaṃ nirīkṣate..
yo mitraṃ jīvitaṃ tasya dhigasnigdhaṃ durātmanaḥ.. 9.5 ..
1.4.d:
मित्रकार्ये विनिर्वृत्ते म्रियमाणं निरीक्षते..
यो मित्रं जीवितं तस्य धिगस्निग्धं दुरात्मनः.. 9.5 ..
1.4.m: When a friend’s task is unfulfilled, he who watches his friend die /—fie upon the loveless life of that wicked soul!

1.4.s:
tadetāvanuyāsyāmi mriyamāṇāvahaṃ dvija..
āpṛcche tvāṃ namaskāra āśleṣaścāthapaścimaḥ.. 9.6 ..
1.4.d:
तदेतावनुयास्यामि म्रियमाणावहं द्विज..
आपृच्छे त्वां नमस्कार आश्लेषश्चाथपश्चिमः.. 9.6 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, O twice-born, I shall follow these two who are dying. / I take leave of you; here is my homage and this final embrace.

1.4.s:
pratijñātamaniṣpādya mitrasyābhyāgatasya ca..
kathaṃkāraṃ na lajjaṃte hatāśā jīvitepsavaḥ.. 9.7 ..
1.4.d:
प्रतिज्ञातमनिष्पाद्य मित्रस्याभ्यागतस्य च..
कथंकारं न लज्जंते हताशा जीवितेप्सवः.. 9.7 ..
1.4.m: Having failed to fulfill what was promised to a friend who has arrived, / how is it that those who are wretchedly craving life feel no shame?

1.4.s:
tasmādvahniṃ pravekṣyāmi sārdhamābhyāmasaṃśayam..
āpṛṣṭo'syadhunā snehānmama dehi jalāṃjalim.. 9.8 ..
1.4.d:
तस्माद्वह्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि सार्धमाभ्यामसंशयम्..
आपृष्टोऽस्यधुना स्नेहान्मम देहि जलांजलिम्.. 9.8 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, without doubt, I will enter the fire along with these two. / Leave has now been asked of you; out of affection, offer a handful of water for me.”

1.4.s:
ityuktavatyulūko'sau nāḍījaṃghe sagadgadam..
sāśrunetraṃ sthirībhūya prāha vācaṃ sudhāsamucam.. 9.9 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्तवत्युलूकोऽसौ नाडीजंघे सगद्गदम्..
साश्रुनेत्रं स्थिरीभूय प्राह वाचं सुधासमुचम्.. 9.9 ..
1.4.m: When Nāḍījaṅgha had spoken thus with choked voice / and tearful eyes, the owl composed himself and spoke words resembling nectar.

1.4.s:
..ulūka uvāca..
mayi jīvati mitre me bhavānmaraṇameti ca..
adyaprabhṛti kastarhi hṛdā mama labhiṣyati.. 9.10 ..
1.4.d:
..उलूक उवाच..
मयि जीवति मित्रे मे भवान्मरणमेति च..
अद्यप्रभृति कस्तर्हि हृदा मम लभिष्यति.. 9.10 ..
1.4.m: The owl said: / “While I, your friend, am alive, you would go to death? / From this day forward, then, who will find a place in my heart?

1.4.s:
astyupāyo mahānatra gandhamādanaparvate..
mattaścirāyurmitrosti gṛdhraḥ prāṇasamaḥ suhṛt.. 9.11 ..
1.4.d:
अस्त्युपायो महानत्र गन्धमादनपर्वते..
मत्तश्चिरायुर्मित्रोस्ति गृध्रः प्राणसमः सुहृत्.. 9.11 ..
1.4.m: There is a great remedy in this matter: on Mount Gandhamādana / lives a friend longer-lived than I, a vulture, a friend dear as life.

1.4.s:
sa vijñāsyati vo'bhīṣṭamiṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim..
ityuktvā puratastasthāvulūkaḥ sa ca bhūpatiḥ.. 9.12 ..
1.4.d:
स विज्ञास्यति वोऽभीष्टमिंद्रद्युम्नं महीपतिम्..
इत्युक्त्वा पुरतस्तस्थावुलूकः स च भूपतिः.. 9.12 ..
1.4.m: He will recognize King Indradyumna whom you desire.” / Having spoken thus, the owl stood before the king.

1.4.s:
mārkaṃḍeyo bakaścaiva prayayurgaṃdhamādanam..
tamāyāṃtamathālokya vayasyaṃ purataḥ sthitam.. 9.13 ..
1.4.d:
मार्कंडेयो बकश्चैव प्रययुर्गंधमादनम्..
तमायांतमथालोक्य वयस्यं पुरतः स्थितम्.. 9.13 ..
1.4.m: Mārkaṇḍeya and the crane went to the Gandhamādana mountain. / Seeing his friend coming and standing before him, 9.13

1.4.s:
svakulāyātprahṛṣṭo'sau gṛdhraḥ saṃmukhamāyayau..
kṛtasaṃvidasau pūrvaṃ svāgatāsanabhojanaiḥ.. 9.14 ..
1.4.d:
स्वकुलायात्प्रहृष्टोऽसौ गृध्रः संमुखमाययौ..
कृतसंविदसौ पूर्वं स्वागतासनभोजनैः.. 9.14 ..
1.4.m: that vulture, delighted, came forth from his nest to meet him. / Once courteous greetings had been exchanged with welcome, a seat, and food, 9.14

1.4.s:
ulūkaṃ gṛdhrarājaśca kāryaṃ papraccha taṃ tathā..
ma cācakhyāvayaṃ mitraṃ bako me'sya muniḥ kila.. 9.15 ..
1.4.d:
उलूकं गृध्रराजश्च कार्यं पप्रच्छ तं तथा..
म चाचख्यावयं मित्रं बको मेऽस्य मुनिः किल.. 9.15 ..
1.4.m: the king of vultures then asked the owl about his business. / And he said: “This crane is my friend, and a sage is his; 9.15

1.4.s:
munerapi tṛtīyo'yaṃ mitraṃ cārthoyamudyataḥ..
iṃdradyumnaparijñāne svayaṃ jīvati nānyathā.. 9.16 ..
1.4.d:
मुनेरपि तृतीयोऽयं मित्रं चार्थोयमुद्यतः..
इंद्रद्युम्नपरिज्ञाने स्वयं जीवति नान्यथा.. 9.16 ..
1.4.m: this [king] is a third friend, of the sage, and this is the purpose at hand: / if Indradyumna is recognized, he will live, not otherwise. 9.16

1.4.s:
vahniṃ pravekṣyate vyaktamayaṃ tadanu vai vayam..
mayā niṣiddho'yaṃ jñātvā tvāṃ ciraṃtanamātmanā.. 9.17 ..
1.4.d:
वह्निं प्रवेक्ष्यते व्यक्तमयं तदनु वै वयम्..
मया निषिद्धोऽयं ज्ञात्वा त्वां चिरंतनमात्मना.. 9.17 ..
1.4.m: Evidently he will enter the fire, and after him, we too. / He was restrained by me, knowing you to be ancient in age. 9.17

1.4.s:
taccejjānāsi taṃ brūhi caturṇāṃ dehi jīvitam..
saṃrakṣyāpnuhi satkīrtiṃ kṣayaṃ cākhilapāpmanaḥ.. 9.18 ..
1.4.d:
तच्चेज्जानासि तं ब्रूहि चतुर्णां देहि जीवितम्..
संरक्ष्याप्नुहि सत्कीर्तिं क्षयं चाखिलपाप्मनः.. 9.18 ..
1.4.m: If you know him, tell it, and give life to the four [of us]! / Protect us, and attain great renown and the destruction of all sins!” 9.18

1.4.s:
..gṛdhra uvāca..
ṣaṭ‌paṃcāśadvyatītā me kalpā jātasya kauśika..
na dṛṣṭo na śruto'smābhiriṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ.. 9.19 ..
1.4.d:
..गृध्र उवाच..
षट्‌पंचाशद्व्यतीता मे कल्पा जातस्य कौशिक..
न दृष्टो न श्रुतोऽस्माभिरिंद्रद्युम्नो महीपतिः.. 9.19 ..
1.4.m: The vulture said: / “Fifty-six kalpas have passed since I was born, O owl! / King Indradyumna has neither been seen nor heard of by us.” 9.19

1.4.s:
tacchrutvā vismayāviṣṭa iṃdradyumno'pi duḥkhitaḥ..
papracacha jīvite hetumatimātre vihaṃgamam.. 9.20 ..
1.4.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयाविष्ट इंद्रद्युम्नोऽपि दुःखितः..
पप्रचछ जीविते हेतुमतिमात्रे विहंगमम्.. 9.20 ..
1.4.m: Hearing this, Indradyumna was filled with astonishment and grew sorrowful. / He asked the bird the reason for his extraordinarily long life. 9.20

1.4.s:
..gṛdhra uvāca..
śrṛṇu bhadrai purā jāto markaṭo'haṃ ca cāpalaḥ..
āsaṃ kadācidabhavadvasaṃto'tha ṛtuḥ kramāt.. 9.21 ..
1.4.d:
..गृध्र उवाच..
श्रृणु भद्रै पुरा जातो मर्कटोऽहं च चापलः..
आसं कदाचिदभवद्वसंतोऽथ ऋतुः क्रमात्.. 9.21 ..
1.4.m: The vulture said: / “Listen, noble one! Long ago I was born as a restless monkey. / Once, in due course, the spring season arrived. 9.21

1.4.s:
tatrāgre devadevasya vanamadhye śivālaye..
bhavodbhavasya purato jagadyogeśvarābhidhe.. 9.22 ..
1.4.d:
तत्राग्रे देवदेवस्य वनमध्ये शिवालये..
भवोद्भवस्य पुरतो जगद्योगेश्वराभिधे.. 9.22 ..
1.4.m: There, before the God of Gods in a Śiva shrine in the midst of the forest, / before Bhavodbhava named the Lord of Yoga of the World, 9.22

1.4.s:
caturdaśīdine hastanakṣatre harṣaṇābhidhe..
yoge caitre site pakṣa āsīddamanakotsavaḥ.. 9.23 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्दशीदिने हस्तनक्षत्रे हर्षणाभिधे..
योगे चैत्रे सिते पक्ष आसीद्दमनकोत्सवः.. 9.23 ..
1.4.m: on the fourteenth day, under the constellation Hasta, at the conjunction named Harṣaṇa, / in the bright half of Caitra, there was the festival of Damanaka. 9.23

1.4.s:
atra sauvarṇyadolāyāṃ liṃga āropite janaiḥ..
niśāyāmadhirūhyā'haṃ dolāṃ tāṃ ca vyacālayam.. 9.24 ..
1.4.d:
अत्र सौवर्ण्यदोलायां लिंग आरोपिते जनैः..
निशायामधिरूह्याऽहं दोलां तां च व्यचालयम्.. 9.24 ..
1.4.m: When the liṅga was placed upon a golden swing by the people, / I climbed onto the swing at night and rocked it 9.24

1.4.s:
nisargājjaticāpalyāccirakālaṃ punaḥpunaḥ..
atha prabhāta āyātā janāḥ pūjākṛte kapim.. 9.25 ..
1.4.d:
निसर्गाज्जतिचापल्याच्चिरकालं पुनःपुनः..
अथ प्रभात आयाता जनाः पूजाकृते कपिम्.. 9.25 ..
1.4.m: again and again for a long time, out of natural monkey restlessness. / Then at dawn, the people came to perform worship; 9.25

1.4.s:
dolādhirūḍhamālokya lakuṭairmāṃ vyatāḍayan..
dolāsaṃsthita evāhaṃ pramītaḥ śivamaṃdire.. 9.26 ..
1.4.d:
दोलाधिरूढमालोक्य लकुटैर्मां व्यताडयन्..
दोलासंस्थित एवाहं प्रमीतः शिवमंदिरे.. 9.26 ..
1.4.m: seeing the monkey mounted on the swing, they beat me with clubs. / Still seated on the swing, I died right in the temple of Śiva, 9.26

1.4.s:
teṣāṃ prahāraiḥ sudṛḍhairbahubhirvajraduḥsahaiḥ..
śivāṃdolanamāhātmyājjāto'haṃ nṛpamaṃdire.. 9.27 ..
1.4.d:
तेषां प्रहारैः सुदृढैर्बहुभिर्वज्रदुःसहैः..
शिवांदोलनमाहात्म्याज्जातोऽहं नृपमंदिरे.. 9.27 ..
1.4.m: struck by their many very hard blows, unbearable as thunderbolts. / By the māhātmya of swinging Śiva, I was born in the palace of a king. 9.27

1.4.s:
kāśīśvarasya tanayaḥ pratīto'smi kuśadhvajaḥ..
jāti smarastato rājye kramātprāpyāhamaiśvaram.. 9.28 ..
1.4.d:
काशीश्वरस्य तनयः प्रतीतोऽस्मि कुशध्वजः..
जाति स्मरस्ततो राज्ये क्रमात्प्राप्याहमैश्वरम्.. 9.28 ..
1.4.m: I was known as Kuśadhvaja, the son of the king of Kāśī. / Remembering my past birth, having attained sovereign power in the kingdom in due course, 9.28

1.4.s:
kārayāmi dharāpṛṣṭhe caitre damanakotsavam..
yathā yathā dolayati śivaṃ dolāsthitaṃ naraḥ.. 9.29 ..
1.4.d:
कारयामि धरापृष्ठे चैत्रे दमनकोत्सवम्..
यथा यथा दोलयति शिवं दोलास्थितं नरः.. 9.29 ..
1.4.m: I caused the Damanaka festival to be performed on earth in Caitra. / Just as a man swings Śiva sitting on a swing, 9.29

1.4.s:
tathā tathā'śubhaṃ yāti puṇyamāyāti bhadraka..
śivadīkṣāmupāgamyākhilasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaḥ.. 9.30 ..
1.4.d:
तथा तथाऽशुभं याति पुण्यमायाति भद्रक..
शिवदीक्षामुपागम्याखिलसंस्कारसंस्कृतः.. 9.30 ..
1.4.m: so does evil depart, and merit arrives, noble one! / Having received the initiation of Śiva and being purified by all the rites of passage, 9.30

1.4.s:
śivācāryairvimukto'haṃ paśupāśaistadāgamāt..
nirvāhadīkṣāparyaṃtānsaṃskārānprāpya sarvataḥ.. 9.31 ..
1.4.d:
शिवाचार्यैर्विमुक्तोऽहं पशुपाशैस्तदागमात्..
निर्वाहदीक्षापर्यंतान्संस्कारान्प्राप्य सर्वतः.. 9.31 ..
1.4.m: I was freed from the bonds of individual souls by the Śaiva masters according to their Āgama. / Having received all rites up to the final emancipating initiation, 9.31

1.4.s:
ārādhayāmi deveśaṃ pratyakcittamumāpatim..
samastakleśavicchedakāraṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum.. 9.32 ..
1.4.d:
आराधयामि देवेशं प्रत्यक्चित्तमुमापतिम्..
समस्तक्लेशविच्छेदकारणं जगतां गुरुम्.. 9.32 ..
1.4.m: with an inward-turned mind I worshipped the Lord of the Gods, the husband of Umā, / the cause of severing all afflictions, the guru of the worlds. 9.32

1.4.s:
cittavṛttinirodhena vairāgyābhyāsayogataḥ..
japannudgītamasyārthaṃ bhāvayannaṣṭamaṃ rasam.. 9.33 ..
1.4.d:
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधेन वैराग्याभ्यासयोगतः..
जपन्नुद्गीतमस्यार्थं भावयन्नष्टमं रसम्.. 9.33 ..
1.4.m: By restraining the fluctuations of the mind through dispassion and practice, / chanting the Udgītha, meditating upon its meaning, and tasting the eighth aesthetic sentiment, 9.33

1.4.s:
tato māṃ praṇidhānenābhyāsena dṛḍhabhūminā..
antarāyānupahataṃ jñātvā tuṣṭo'bravīddharaḥ.. 9.34 ..
1.4.d:
ततो मां प्रणिधानेनाभ्यासेन दृढभूमिना..
अन्तरायानुपहतं ज्ञात्वा तुष्टोऽब्रवीद्धरः.. 9.34 ..
1.4.m: Hara, knowing that I was unaffected by obstacles through firm devotion and steadfast practice, / was pleased and said: 9.34

1.4.s:
..īśvara uvāca..
kuśadhvajāhaṃ tuṣṭodya varaṃ varaya vāṃchitam..
na hīdṛśamanuṣṭhānaṃ kasyāpyasti mahītale.. 9.35 ..
1.4.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच..
कुशध्वजाहं तुष्टोद्य वरं वरय वांछितम्..
न हीदृशमनुष्ठानं कस्याप्यस्ति महीतले.. 9.35 ..
1.4.m: Īśvara said: / ‘Kuśadhvaja, I am pleased today; choose a boon of your desire! / For there is no such practice performed by anyone else on the earth’s surface.’ 9.35

1.4.s:
śrutvetyukto mayā śambhurbhūyāsaṃ te gaṃṇo hyaham..
anenaiva śarīreṇa tathetyevāha gāṃ prabhuḥ.. 9.36 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुत्वेत्युक्तो मया शम्भुर्भूयासं ते गंणो ह्यहम्..
अनेनैव शरीरेण तथेत्येवाह गां प्रभुः.. 9.36 ..
1.4.m: Hearing this, Śambhu was addressed by me: ‘May I become your attendant / with this very body!’ The Lord said to me, ‘So be it!’ 9.36

1.4.s:
tataḥ kailāsamānīya vimānaṃ mama cādiśat..
sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaṃ divyāścaryasamāvṛtam.. 9.37 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कैलासमानीय विमानं मम चादिशत्..
सर्वरत्नमयं दिव्यं दिव्याश्चर्यसमावृतम्.. 9.37 ..
1.4.m: Then, bringing me to Kailāsa, he assigned me an aerial chariot / made entirely of jewels, divine, and filled with heavenly wonders. 9.37

1.4.s:
vicarāmi pratīto'haṃ tadārūḍho yadṛcchayā..
atha kāle kiyanmātre vyatīte'traivaṃ parvate.. 9.38 ..
1.4.d:
विचरामि प्रतीतोऽहं तदारूढो यदृच्छया..
अथ काले कियन्मात्रे व्यतीतेऽत्रैवं पर्वते.. 9.38 ..
1.4.m: Mounted on it, I roamed freely at will, renowned. / Then, when some time had passed, right on this mountain, 9.38

1.4.s:
gavākṣādhiṣṭhito'paśyaṃ vasaṃte munikanyakām..
pravāti dakṣiṇe vāyau madanāgnipradīpitaḥ.. 9.39 ..
1.4.d:
गवाक्षाधिष्ठितोऽपश्यं वसंते मुनिकन्यकाम्..
प्रवाति दक्षिणे वायौ मदनाग्निप्रदीपितः.. 9.39 ..
1.4.m: standing at the window in spring, I saw a sage’s daughter / while the southern wind blew, and I was inflamed with the fire of love: 9.39

1.4.s:
agniveśyasutāṃ bhadra vivastrāṃ jalamadhyagām..
udbhinnayauvanāṃ śyāmāṃ madhyakṣāmāṃ mṛgekṣaṇām.. 9.40 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निवेश्यसुतां भद्र विवस्त्रां जलमध्यगाम्..
उद्भिन्नयौवनां श्यामां मध्यक्षामां मृगेक्षणाम्.. 9.40 ..
1.4.m: the daughter of Agniveśya, noble one, naked in the water, / her youth blossoming, slender, thin in the waist, with eyes like a deer’s, 9.40

1.4.s:
vistīrṇajaghanābhogāṃ raṃbhoruṃ saṃhatastanīm..
tāmaṃkuritalāvaṇyāṃ jalasekā divāgrataḥ.. 9.41 ..
1.4.d:
विस्तीर्णजघनाभोगां रंभोरुं संहतस्तनीम्..
तामंकुरितलावण्यां जलसेका दिवाग्रतः.. 9.41 ..
1.4.m: with broad and expansive hips, thighs like plantain trunks, firm breasts, / her loveliness sprouting as if through sprinkling of water before me, 9.41

1.4.s:
pronnidrapaṃkajamukhīṃ varṇanīyatamākṛtim..
yathāprajñānayāthātmyādvidvidbhirapi varṇinīm.. 9.42 ..
1.4.d:
प्रोन्निद्रपंकजमुखीं वर्णनीयतमाकृतिम्..
यथाप्रज्ञानयाथात्म्याद्विद्विद्भिरपि वर्णिनीम्.. 9.42 ..
1.4.m: her face like an open lotus, of a form most worthy of description, / to be praised even by the wise according to their intelligence and reality. 9.42

1.4.s:
prodyatkaṭākṣavikṣepaiḥ śaravrātairiva smaraḥ..
svayaṃ tadaṃgamāsthāya tāḍayāmāsa māṃ dṛḍham.. 9.43 ..
1.4.d:
प्रोद्यत्कटाक्षविक्षेपैः शरव्रातैरिव स्मरः..
स्वयं तदंगमास्थाय ताडयामास मां दृढम्.. 9.43 ..
1.4.m: With rising casts of her sidelong glances, as if with showers of arrows, / Love himself, taking possession of her limbs, struck me fiercely. 9.43

1.4.s:
vayasyāsaṃvṛcāmevaṃ khelamānāṃ yadṛcchayā..
avatīryāhamaharaṃ vimānānmadanāturaḥ.. 9.44 ..
1.4.d:
वयस्यासंवृचामेवं खेलमानां यदृच्छया..
अवतीर्याहमहरं विमानान्मदनातुरः.. 9.44 ..
1.4.m: As she was playing freely, surrounded by her companions, / I descended from the aerial chariot, tormented by love, and seized her. 9.44

1.4.s:
sā gṛhītā mayā dīrghaṃ prakurvāṇā mahāsvanam..
tāteti ca vimānasthā rurodātīva bhadraka.. 9.45 ..
1.4.d:
सा गृहीता मया दीर्घं प्रकुर्वाणा महास्वनम्..
तातेति च विमानस्था रुरोदातीव भद्रक.. 9.45 ..
1.4.m: Captured by me, placed on the aerial chariot, she let out a long, loud cry / and wept bitterly, crying ‘Father!’, noble one! 9.45

1.4.s:
tato vayasyāstā dīnā munimāhuḥ pradhāvitāḥ..
vaimānikena kenāpi hriyate tava putrikā.. 9.46 ..
1.4.d:
ततो वयस्यास्ता दीना मुनिमाहुः प्रधाविताः..
वैमानिकेन केनापि ह्रियते तव पुत्रिका.. 9.46 ..
1.4.m: Then her distressed friends ran to the sage and said: / ‘Your daughter is being carried off by some celestial being! 9.46

1.4.s:
rudantīṃ bhagavannetāṃ trāhyuttiṣṭheti sarvataḥ..
tāsāṃ tadākarṇya vaco munirbhadrataponidhiḥ.. 9.47 ..
1.4.d:
रुदन्तीं भगवन्नेतां त्राह्युत्तिष्ठेति सर्वतः..
तासां तदाकर्ण्य वचो मुनिर्भद्रतपोनिधिः.. 9.47 ..
1.4.m: Arise from all sides, Lord, and protect her as she weeps!’ / Hearing their words, the sage Agniveśya, a storehouse of austerity, 9.47

1.4.s:
agniveśyo'bhyagāttasyā vyomanyupapadaṃ tvaran..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti māmuktvā saṃstabhya tapasā gatim.. 9.48 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निवेश्योऽभ्यगात्तस्या व्योमन्युपपदं त्वरन्..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति मामुक्त्वा संस्तभ्य तपसा गतिम्.. 9.48 ..
1.4.m: hastened towards her in the sky; / saying to me, ‘Halt, halt!’, he paralyzed my movement by his austerity. 9.48

1.4.s:
tataḥ prakupitaḥ prāha munimāmati duḥsaham..
..agniveśya uvāca..
yasmānmadīyā tanayā māṃsapeśīva te hṛtā.. 9.49 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रकुपितः प्राह मुनिमामति दुःसहम्..
..अग्निवेश्य उवाच..
यस्मान्मदीया तनया मांसपेशीव ते हृता.. 9.49 ..
1.4.m: Then, enraged, the sage spoke words very hard to bear: / Agniveśya said: / ‘Because my daughter has been seized by you like a piece of flesh 9.49

1.4.s:
gṛdhreṇevā'dhunā vyomni tasmādgadhro bhava drutam..
anicchaṃtī madīyeyaṃ sutā bālā tapasvinī.. 9.50 ..
1.4.d:
गृध्रेणेवाऽधुना व्योम्नि तस्माद्गध्रो भव द्रुतम्..
अनिच्छंती मदीयेयं सुता बाला तपस्विनी.. 9.50 ..
1.4.m: by a vulture just now in the sky, therefore become a vulture at once! / This daughter of mine, a young ascetic girl, was unwilling, 9.50

1.4.s:
tvayā hṛtādhunāsyaitatphalamāpnuhi durmate..
ityākarṇya bhayāviṣṭo lajjayādhomukho muneḥ.. 9.51 ..
1.4.d:
त्वया हृताधुनास्यैतत्फलमाप्नुहि दुर्मते..
इत्याकर्ण्य भयाविष्टो लज्जयाधोमुखो मुनेः.. 9.51 ..
1.4.m: yet she was carried off by you; now reap the fruit of this, evil-minded one!’ / Hearing this, seized with fear and with downcast face from shame, 9.51

1.4.s:
pādau pragṛhya nyapataṃ rudannatitarāṃ tadā..
na mayeyaṃ parijñāya hṛtā nādyāpi dharṣitā.. 9.52 ..
1.4.d:
पादौ प्रगृह्य न्यपतं रुदन्नतितरां तदा..
न मयेयं परिज्ञाय हृता नाद्यापि धर्षिता.. 9.52 ..
1.4.m: I fell down grasping the sage’s feet, weeping profusely then: / ‘I did not carry her off knowingly, nor has she been violated by me yet. 9.42

1.4.s:
prasādaṃ kuru te śāpaṃ vyāvartaya taponidhe..
praṇateṣu kṣamāvanto nisargeṇa tapodhanāḥ.. 9.53 ..
1.4.d:
प्रसादं कुरु ते शापं व्यावर्तय तपोनिधे..
प्रणतेषु क्षमावन्तो निसर्गेण तपोधनाः.. 9.53 ..
1.4.m: Be gracious, turn back your curse, O treasure of austerity! / Ascetics rich in tapas are compassionate by nature toward those who bow down; 9.53

1.4.s:
bhavaṃti saṃtastadgṛdhro mā bhaveyaṃ prasīda me..
iti prapannena mayā praṇato'sau mahāmuniḥ.. 9.54 ..
1.4.d:
भवंति संतस्तद्गृध्रो मा भवेयं प्रसीद मे..
इति प्रपन्नेन मया प्रणतोऽसौ महामुनिः.. 9.54 ..
1.4.m: good people are so; therefore, let me not become a vulture, be gracious to me!’ / When he was thus supplicated and bowed to by me who had surrendered, that great sage, 9.54

1.4.s:
prasannaḥ prāha no mithyā mama vākyaṃ bhavetkvacit..
kiṃ tviṃdradyumnabhūpālaparijñāne sahāyatām.. 9.55 ..
1.4.d:
प्रसन्नः प्राह नो मिथ्या मम वाक्यं भवेत्क्वचित्..
किं त्विंद्रद्युम्नभूपालपरिज्ञाने सहायताम्.. 9.55 ..
1.4.m: placated, said: ‘My word can never be false. / However, when you give help in recognizing King Indradyumna, 9.55

1.4.s: yadā yāsyasi śāpasya tadā muktimavāpsyasi.. 9.56 ..
1.4.d: यदा यास्यसि शापस्य तदा मुक्तिमवाप्स्यसि.. 9.56 ..
1.4.m: at that time you will attain liberation from the curse.’ 9.56

1.4.s:
ityuktvā sa muniḥ prāyādgṛhītvā nijakanyakām..
akhaṇḍaśīlāṃ svāvāsamahaṃ gṛdhro'bhavaṃ tadā.. 9.57 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिः प्रायाद्गृहीत्वा निजकन्यकाम्..
अखण्डशीलां स्वावासमहं गृध्रोऽभवं तदा.. 9.57 ..
1.4.m: Having said this, that sage departed taking his daughter, / her chastity unbroken, to his hermitage; and I then became a vulture.” 9.57

1.4.s:
evaṃ tadā damanakotsava īśvarasya āṃdolanena nṛpaveśmani me'vatāraḥ..
śambhorgaṇatvamabhavacca tathāgniveśyaśāpena gṛdhra iha bhadra tavedamuktam.. 9.58 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe mahīprādurbhāve damanakamāhātmyaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 9 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
एवं तदा दमनकोत्सव ईश्वरस्य आंदोलनेन नृपवेश्मनि मेऽवतारः..
शम्भोर्गणत्वमभवच्च तथाग्निवेश्यशापेन गृध्र इह भद्र तवेदमुक्तम्.. 9.58 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखंडे महीप्रादुर्भावे दमनकमाहात्म्यंनाम नवमोऽध्यायः.. 9 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Thus, at that time, during the damanaka festival of Īśvara, my descent took place in the royal palace through swinging, / and my status as Śambhu's attendant came to be; likewise, by the curse of Agniveśya, I became a vulture here, O noble one. This has been recounted to you.
Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Māhātmya of the Damanaka Plant' in the Manifestation of the Earth, in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
.. nārada uvāca..
gṛdhrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhavismayasaṃyutaḥ..
indradyumnastamā pṛcchaya maraṇāyopacakrame.. 10.1 ..
1.4.d:
.. नारद उवाच..
गृध्रस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा दुःखविस्मयसंयुतः..
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्तमा पृच्छय मरणायोपचक्रमे.. 10.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Having heard these words of the vulture, filled with sorrow and wonder, / Indradyumna took leave of him and prepared to die.

1.4.s:
tatastamālokya tathā mumūrṣuṃ kauśikādibhiḥ..
sa saṃhitaṃ viciṃtyāha dīrghāyuṣamathātmanaḥ.. 10.2 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तमालोक्य तथा मुमूर्षुं कौशिकादिभिः..
स संहितं विचिंत्याह दीर्घायुषमथात्मनः.. 10.2 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing him thus wishing to die, [the vulture] along with Kauśika and the others / reflected, and then spoke of someone having a longer life than himself:

1.4.s:
maivaṃ kārṣīḥ śruṇu giraṃ bhadraka tvaṃ ciraṃtanaḥ..
matto'pyasti sphuṭaṃ caiva jñāsyati tvadabhīpsitam.. 10.3 ..
1.4.d:
मैवं कार्षीः श्रुणु गिरं भद्रक त्वं चिरंतनः..
मत्तोऽप्यस्ति स्फुटं चैव ज्ञास्यति त्वदभीप्सितम्.. 10.3 ..
1.4.m: "Do not do so! Listen to [my] word, O good man! There is one older / even than me, and he will clearly know what you desire.

1.4.s:
mānase sarasi khyātaḥ kūrmomaṃtharakākhyayā..
tasya nāviditaṃ kiṃcidehi tatra vrajāmahe.. 10.4 ..
1.4.d:
मानसे सरसि ख्यातः कूर्मोमंथरकाख्यया..
तस्य नाविदितं किंचिदेहि तत्र व्रजामहे.. 10.4 ..
1.4.m: In Lake Mānasa lives a tortoise renowned by the name of Mantharaka; / nothing is unknown to him. Come, let us go there!"

1.4.s:
tataḥ pratītāste bhūpamunigṛdhrabakāstathā..
ulūkasahitā jagmuḥ sarve kūrmadidṛkṣavaḥ.. 10.5 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रतीतास्ते भूपमुनिगृध्रबकास्तथा..
उलूकसहिता जग्मुः सर्वे कूर्मदिदृक्षवः.. 10.5 ..
1.4.m: Then, trusting [his words], they—the king, the sage, the vulture, and the crane, / together with the owl—all went, wishing to see the tortoise.

1.4.s:
sarastīre sthitaḥ kūrmastānnirīkṣya vidūragān..
kāṃdiśīko viveśāsau jalaṃ śīghrataraṃ tadā.. 10.6 ..
1.4.d:
सरस्तीरे स्थितः कूर्मस्तान्निरीक्ष्य विदूरगान्..
कांदिशीको विवेशासौ जलं शीघ्रतरं तदा.. 10.6 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise, stationed on the shore of the lake, seeing them approaching from afar, / panicked and entered the water very swiftly then.

1.4.s:
kauśiko'tha tamāhedaṃ prahasya vacanaṃ svayam..
kasmātkūrma pranaṣṭodya vimukho'bhyāgateṣvapi.. 10.7 ..
1.4.d:
कौशिकोऽथ तमाहेदं प्रहस्य वचनं स्वयम्..
कस्मात्कूर्म प्रनष्टोद्य विमुखोऽभ्यागतेष्वपि.. 10.7 ..
1.4.m: Kauśika then, laughing, spoke these words himself to him: / "Why, O tortoise, have you fled today and turned away even when guests have arrived?

1.4.s:
agnirdvijānāṃ vipraśca varṇānāṃ ramaṇaḥ striyām..
guruḥ pitā ca putrāṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ.. 10.8 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निर्द्विजानां विप्रश्च वर्णानां रमणः स्त्रियाम्..
गुरुः पिता च पुत्राणां सर्वस्याभ्यागतो गुरुः.. 10.8 ..
1.4.m: Fire is the guru of the twice-born, the brahmin of the castes, the husband of women, / the father is the guru of sons, and the arrived guest is the guru of all.

1.4.s:
vihāya tamimaṃ dharmamātithyavimukhaḥ katham..
gṛhṇāsi pāpaṃ sarveṣāṃ brūhi kūrmādhunottaram.. 10.9 ..
1.4.d:
विहाय तमिमं धर्ममातिथ्यविमुखः कथम्..
गृह्णासि पापं सर्वेषां ब्रूहि कूर्माधुनोत्तरम्.. 10.9 ..
1.4.m: Abandoning this righteousness, why do you turn away from hospitality / and take upon yourself the sin of all? Speak your answer now, O tortoise!"

1.4.s:
..kūrma uvāca..
ciraṃtano hi jānāmi karttumātithyasatkriyām..
abhyāgateṣvapacitiṃ dharmaśāstreṣu niścitam.. 10.10 ..
1.4.d:
..कूर्म उवाच..
चिरंतनो हि जानामि कर्त्तुमातिथ्यसत्क्रियाम्..
अभ्यागतेष्वपचितिं धर्मशास्त्रेषु निश्चितम्.. 10.10 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise said: / "Being very old, I indeed know how to perform the respectful rites of hospitality, / and reverence towards arrived guests, as determined in the treatises on dharma.

1.4.s:
sumahatkāraṇaṃ cātra śrūyatāṃ tadvadāmi vaḥ..
nāhaṃ parāṅmukho jāta etāvaṃti dinānyapi.. 10.11 ..
1.4.d:
सुमहत्कारणं चात्र श्रूयतां तद्वदामि वः..
नाहं पराङ्मुखो जात एतावंति दिनान्यपि.. 10.11 ..
1.4.m: There is a very great reason in this matter; listen, I shall tell it to you. / I have not turned my face away [from anyone] in all these days,

1.4.s:
abhyāgatasya kasyāpi sarvasatkārasadvratī..
kiṃ tveṣa paṃcamo yo vo dṛśyate saralākṛtiḥ.. 10.12 ..
1.4.d:
अभ्यागतस्य कस्यापि सर्वसत्कारसद्व्रती..
किं त्वेष पंचमो यो वो दृश्यते सरलाकृतिः.. 10.12 ..
1.4.m: holding the good vow of all kinds of hospitality toward any guest who arrived. / But who is this fifth one among you, seen to have an upright form?

1.4.s:
iṃdradyumno mahīpālo bibhomyasmādalaṃtarām..
amunā yajamānena raucakākhye purā pure.. 10.13 ..
1.4.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नो महीपालो बिभोम्यस्मादलंतराम्..
अमुना यजमानेन रौचकाख्ये पुरा पुरे.. 10.13 ..
1.4.m: It is King Indradyumna; I fear him exceedingly! / Formerly, when he was the sacrificer in the city named Raucaka,

1.4.s:
yajñapāvakadagdhā me pṛṣṭhirnādyāpi nirvraṇā..
tanme bhayaṃ punarjātaṃ kimayaṃ punareva mām.. 10.14 ..
1.4.d:
यज्ञपावकदग्धा मे पृष्ठिर्नाद्यापि निर्व्रणा..
तन्मे भयं पुनर्जातं किमयं पुनरेव माम्.. 10.14 ..
1.4.m: my back was burnt by the sacrificial fire, and even today it is not free of scars. / Therefore, fear has arisen in me once more: will he now again

1.4.s:
āsutīvalamādhāya bhuvi dhakṣyati saṃprati..
iti vākyāvasāne tu kūrmasya kurusattama.. 10.15 ..
1.4.d:
आसुतीवलमाधाय भुवि धक्ष्यति संप्रति..
इति वाक्यावसाने तु कूर्मस्य कुरुसत्तम.. 10.15 ..
1.4.m: burn me on the earth, establishing an enclosure for the pressing of soma?" / At the conclusion of the tortoise's statement, O best of the Kurus,

1.4.s:
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ khādvimuktāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ..
sasvanurdevavādyāni kīrtyuddhāre mahīpateḥ.. 10.16 ..
1.4.d:
पपात पुष्पवृष्टिः खाद्विमुक्ताप्सरसां गणैः..
सस्वनुर्देववाद्यानि कीर्त्युद्धारे महीपतेः.. 10.16 ..
1.4.m: a shower of flowers fell from the sky, released by groups of apsarases, / and celestial instruments sounded at the restoration of the king's fame.

1.4.s:
vismitāste ca dadṛśurvimānaṃ purataḥ sthitam..
iṃdradyumnakṛte devadūtenādhiṣṭhitaṃ tadā.. 10.17 ..
1.4.d:
विस्मितास्ते च ददृशुर्विमानं पुरतः स्थितम्..
इंद्रद्युम्नकृते देवदूतेनाधिष्ठितं तदा.. 10.17 ..
1.4.m: Astonished, they saw an aerial chariot stationed before them, / occupied at that time by a messenger of the gods for the sake of Indradyumna.

1.4.s:
ayātayāmāḥ pradadurāśiṣo'smai suradvijāḥ..
sādhuvādo divi mahānāsīttasya mahīpateḥ.. 10.18 ..
1.4.d:
अयातयामाः प्रददुराशिषोऽस्मै सुरद्विजाः..
साधुवादो दिवि महानासीत्तस्य महीपतेः.. 10.18 ..
1.4.m: The gods and brahmins bestowed unwaning blessings upon him; / there was a great shout of acclaim in heaven for that king.

1.4.s:
tato vimānamālaṃbya devadūtastamuccakaiḥ..
iṃdradyumnamuvācedaṃ śrṛṇvatāṃ nākavāsinām.. 10.19 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विमानमालंब्य देवदूतस्तमुच्चकैः..
इंद्रद्युम्नमुवाचेदं श्रृण्वतां नाकवासिनाम्.. 10.19 ..
1.4.m: Then, clinging to the aerial chariot, the messenger of the gods spoke loudly / this to Indradyumna, while the dwellers of heaven listened:

1.4.s:
..devadūta uvāca..
navīkṛtādhunā kīrtistava bhūpāla nirmalā..
trilokyāmapi tacchīghraṃ vimānamidamāruha.. 10.20 ..
1.4.d:
..देवदूत उवाच..
नवीकृताधुना कीर्तिस्तव भूपाल निर्मला..
त्रिलोक्यामपि तच्छीघ्रं विमानमिदमारुह.. 10.20 ..
1.4.m: The messenger of the gods said: / "Now your stainless fame has been renewed, O protector of the earth, / even in the three worlds. Therefore, quickly mount this aerial chariot!

1.4.s:
gamyatāṃ brahmaṇo lokamākalpaṃ tapasorjitam..
preṣito'hamanenaiva tavānayanakāraṇāt.. 10.21 ..
1.4.d:
गम्यतां ब्रह्मणो लोकमाकल्पं तपसोर्जितम्..
प्रेषितोऽहमनेनैव तवानयनकारणात्.. 10.21 ..
1.4.m: Let it be gone to the world of Brahmā, which endures until the end of the kalpa, acquired by austerity! / I have been sent by him alone for the purpose of bringing you.

1.4.s:
yāvatkīrtirmanuṣyasya pṛthivyāṃ prathitā bhavet..
tāvāneva bhavetsvargī sati puṇye hyanaṃtake.. 10.22 ..
1.4.d:
यावत्कीर्तिर्मनुष्यस्य पृथिव्यां प्रथिता भवेत्..
तावानेव भवेत्स्वर्गी सति पुण्ये ह्यनंतके.. 10.22 ..
1.4.m: As long as a man's fame remains renowned on earth, / so long does he dwell in heaven, when endless merit exists.

1.4.s:
surālayasarovāpīkūpārāmādikalpanā..
etadarthaṃ hi pūrtākhyā dharmaśāstreṣu niścitā.. 10.23 ..
1.4.d:
सुरालयसरोवापीकूपारामादिकल्पना..
एतदर्थं हि पूर्ताख्या धर्मशास्त्रेषु निश्चिता.. 10.23 ..
1.4.m: The construction of temples, lakes, large wells, wells, and gardens— / indeed for this purpose is it designated as 'pūrta' in the dharma treatises."

1.4.s:
..iṃdradyumna uvāca..
amī mamaiva suhṛdo mārkaṃḍabakakauśikāḥ..
gṛdhrakūrmau prabhāvo'yamamīṣāṃ mama vṛddhaye.. 10.24 ..
1.4.d:
..इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
अमी ममैव सुहृदो मार्कंडबककौशिकाः..
गृध्रकूर्मौ प्रभावोऽयममीषां मम वृद्धये.. 10.24 ..
1.4.m: Indradyumna said: / "These are my friends: Mārkaṇḍa, the crane, and Kauśika, / and the vulture and the tortoise; this power of theirs has brought about my advancement.

1.4.s:
taccedamī mayā sākaṃ brahmalokaṃ prayāṃtyuta..
puraḥsthitāstadāyāsye brahmalokaṃ ca nānyathā.. 10.25 ..
1.4.d:
तच्चेदमी मया साकं ब्रह्मलोकं प्रयांत्युत..
पुरःस्थितास्तदायास्ये ब्रह्मलोकं च नान्यथा.. 10.25 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, if these go together with me to the world of Brahmā, / standing in front, then I shall go to the world of Brahmā, and not otherwise.

1.4.s:
pareṣāmanapekṣyaiva kṛtapratikṛtaṃ hi yaḥ..
pravartate hitāyaiva sa suhṛtprocyate budhaiḥ.. 10.26 ..
1.4.d:
परेषामनपेक्ष्यैव कृतप्रतिकृतं हि यः..
प्रवर्तते हितायैव स सुहृत्प्रोच्यते बुधैः.. 10.26 ..
1.4.m: He who acts solely for the benefit of others without expecting / any return for what was done is called a true friend by the wise.

1.4.s:
svārthodyuktadhiyo ye syuranvarthāstepyasuṃdharāḥ..
maraṇaṃ prakṛtiścaiva jīvitaṃ vikṛtiryadā.. 10.27 ..
1.4.d:
स्वार्थोद्युक्तधियो ये स्युरन्वर्थास्तेप्यसुंधराः..
मरणं प्रकृतिश्चैव जीवितं विकृतिर्यदा.. 10.27 ..
1.4.m: Those whose minds are devoted to their own self-interest, though bearing life-breaths, are useless. / When death is the natural state and life is merely an alteration,

1.4.s:
prāṇināṃ paramo lābhaḥ kevalaṃ prāṇisauhṛdam..
daridrā rāgiṇo'satyapratijñātā gurudruhaḥ.. 10.28 ..
1.4.d:
प्राणिनां परमो लाभः केवलं प्राणिसौहृदम्..
दरिद्रा रागिणोऽसत्यप्रतिज्ञाता गुरुद्रुहः.. 10.28 ..
1.4.m: the highest gain for living beings is solely friendship with living beings. / The impoverished who are passionate, those who break their promises, those who betray their elders,

1.4.s:
mitrāvasāninaḥ pāpāḥ prāyo narakamaṃḍanāḥ..
parārthanaṣṭāstadamī paṃca saṃprati sādhavaḥ.. 10.29 ..
1.4.d:
मित्रावसानिनः पापाः प्रायो नरकमंडनाः..
परार्थनष्टास्तदमी पंच संप्रति साधवः.. 10.29 ..
1.4.m: those who destroy their friends, and sinners generally adorn hell. / But these five virtuous ones have now spent themselves for the sake of another.

1.4.s:
mama kīrtisamuddhāraḥ sa prabhāvo mahātmanām..
amīṣāṃ yadi te svargaṃ prayāsyanti mayā saha..
tadāhamapi yāsyāmi devadūtānyathā na hi.. 10.30 ..
1.4.d:
मम कीर्तिसमुद्धारः स प्रभावो महात्मनाम्..
अमीषां यदि ते स्वर्गं प्रयास्यन्ति मया सह..
तदाहमपि यास्यामि देवदूतान्यथा न हि.. 10.30 ..
1.4.m: The restoration of my fame is due to the power of these great souls. / If they will go to heaven along with me, / then I too will go, O messenger of the gods, otherwise not."

1.4.s:
..devadūta uvāca..
ete haragaṇāḥ sarveśāpabhraṣṭāḥ kṣitiṃ gatāḥ.. 10.31 ..
1.4.d:
..देवदूत उवाच..
एते हरगणाः सर्वेशापभ्रष्टाः क्षितिं गताः.. 10.31 ..
1.4.m: The messenger of the gods said: / "All these are Hara's attendants who have fallen to earth due to a curse.

1.4.s:
śāpāṃte harapārśve tu yāsyaṃti pṛthivīpate..
vihāyemānato bhūpa tvamāgaccha mayā saha.. 10.32 ..
1.4.d:
शापांते हरपार्श्वे तु यास्यंति पृथिवीपते..
विहायेमानतो भूप त्वमागच्छ मया सह.. 10.32 ..
1.4.m: At the end of the curse, they will go to the side of Hara, O lord of the earth. / Therefore, leaving these behind, O king, come with me!

1.4.s:
na caiṣāṃ rocate svargo hitvā devaṃ maheśvaram..
..iṃdradyumna uvāca..
yadyevaṃ gaccha taddūta nāyāsyehaṃ triviṣṭapam.. 10.33 ..
1.4.d:
न चैषां रोचते स्वर्गो हित्वा देवं महेश्वरम्..
..इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
यद्येवं गच्छ तद्दूत नायास्येहं त्रिविष्टपम्.. 10.33 ..
1.4.m: Heaven does not please them, forsaking the god Maheśvara." / Indradyumna said: / "If it is so, then go, O messenger! I will not come to heaven.

1.4.s:
tathā tathā yati ṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi yathā gaṇaḥ..
aviśuddhikṣayādhikyadūṣaṇaireṣa niṃditaḥ.. 10.34 ..
1.4.d:
तथा तथा यति ष्यामि भविष्यामि यथा गणः..
अविशुद्धिक्षयाधिक्यदूषणैरेष निंदितः.. 10.34 ..
1.4.m: I shall strive in such a way that I too may become an attendant [of Śiva]. / It is censured by the faults of impurity, decay, and excess;

1.4.s:
svargaḥ sadānuśravikastasmādenaṃ na kāmaye..
tatrasthāsya punaḥ pāto bhayaṃ na vyeti mānasāt.. 10.35 ..
1.4.d:
स्वर्गः सदानुश्रविकस्तस्मादेनं न कामये..
तत्रस्थास्य पुनः पातो भयं न व्येति मानसात्.. 10.35 ..
1.4.m: heaven is ever dependent on Vedic tradition, therefore I do not desire it. / For one stationed there, the fear of falling again does not depart from the mind.

1.4.s:
punaḥ pāto yataḥ puṃsastasmātsvargaṃ na kāmaye..
sati puṇye svayaṃ tena pātito nijalokataḥ.. 10.36 ..
1.4.d:
पुनः पातो यतः पुंसस्तस्मात्स्वर्गं न कामये..
सति पुण्ये स्वयं तेन पातितो निजलोकतः.. 10.36 ..
1.4.m: Since there is a fall again for a person, therefore I do not desire heaven. / Even when merit still exists, I was cast down from his own world by him,

1.4.s:
caturmukhena vailakṣyaṃ gato'smi kathamemi tam..
itīdamuktvā dūtaṃ taṃ śrṛṇvato'syaiva vismayāt.. 10.37 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्मुखेन वैलक्ष्यं गतोऽस्मि कथमेमि तम्..
इतीदमुक्त्वा दूतं तं श्रृण्वतोऽस्यैव विस्मयात्.. 10.37 ..
1.4.m: and I have been humiliated by the four-faced [Brahmā]—how could I go to him?" / Having said this to that messenger, while the messenger listened in wonder,

1.4.s:
aprākṣīdbhūpatiḥ kūrmaṃ tadāyuḥkāraṇaṃ tadā..
idamāyuḥ kathaṃ jātaṃ kūrma dīrghatamaṃ tava.. 10.38 ..
1.4.d:
अप्राक्षीद्भूपतिः कूर्मं तदायुःकारणं तदा..
इदमायुः कथं जातं कूर्म दीर्घतमं तव.. 10.38 ..
1.4.m: the king then asked the tortoise the cause of his lifespan: / "How did this exceedingly long life of yours come to be, O tortoise?

1.4.s: suhṛnmitraṃ gurustvaṃ me yena kīrtirmamoddhṛtā.. 10.39 ..
1.4.d: सुहृन्मित्रं गुरुस्त्वं मे येन कीर्तिर्ममोद्धृता.. 10.39 ..
1.4.m: You are my benevolent friend, ally, and elder, by whom my fame has been restored."

1.4.s:
..kūrma uvāca..
śrṛṇu bhūpa kathāṃ divyāṃ śravaṇātpāpanāśinīm..
kathāṃ sumadhurāmetāṃ śivamāhātmyasaṃyutām.. 10.40 ..
1.4.d:
..कूर्म उवाच..
श्रृणु भूप कथां दिव्यां श्रवणात्पापनाशिनीम्..
कथां सुमधुरामेतां शिवमाहात्म्यसंयुताम्.. 10.40 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise said: / "Listen, O king, to a divine story that destroys sin upon hearing, / a very sweet story endowed with the glory of Śiva.

1.4.s:
śrṛṇvannimāmapi kathāṃ nṛpate manuṣyaḥ suśraddhayā bhavati pāpavimuktadehaḥ..
śaṃbhoḥ prasādamabhigamya yathāyurevamāsītprasādata iyaṃ mama kūrmatā ca.. 10.41 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhastrāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve daśamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 10 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
श्रृण्वन्निमामपि कथां नृपते मनुष्यः सुश्रद्धया भवति पापविमुक्तदेहः..
शंभोः प्रसादमभिगम्य यथायुरेवमासीत्प्रसादत इयं मम कूर्मता च.. 10.41 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्त्रायां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे महीप्रादुर्भावे दशमोऽध्यायः.. 10 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Hearing this story also with good faith, O king, a man has his body freed from sin. / Having attained the grace of Śambhu, as [my] life [was spared], so too through his grace this tortoise-state of mine came to be.
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled “Manifestation of the Earth,” in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..kūrma uvāca..
śāṃḍilya iti vikhyātaḥ purāhamabhavaṃ dvijaḥ..
bālabhāve mayā bhūpa krīḍamānena nirmitam.. 11.1 ..
1.4.d:
..कूर्म उवाच..
शांडिल्य इति विख्यातः पुराहमभवं द्विजः..
बालभावे मया भूप क्रीडमानेन निर्मितम्.. 11.1 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise said: / Formerly I was a brahmin renowned as Śāṇḍilya. / In childhood, O king, while playing, I built

1.4.s:
purā prāvṛṣi pāṃśūtthaṃ śivāyatanamucchritam..
jalārdravālukāprāyaṃ prāṃśuprākāraśobhitam.. 11.2 ..
1.4.d:
पुरा प्रावृषि पांशूत्थं शिवायतनमुच्छ्रितम्..
जलार्द्रवालुकाप्रायं प्रांशुप्राकारशोभितम्.. 11.2 ..
1.4.m: formerly in the rainy season a high temple of Śiva made of dust, / mostly composed of water-wet sand, adorned with high outer walls,

1.4.s:
paṃcāyatanavinyāsamanoharataraṃ nṛpa..
vināyakaśivāsūryamadhusūdanamūrtimat.. 11.3 ..
1.4.d:
पंचायतनविन्यासमनोहरतरं नृप..
विनायकशिवासूर्यमधुसूदनमूर्तिमत्.. 11.3 ..
1.4.m: very charming with a pañcāyatana layout, O king, / possessing images of Vināyaka, Śivā, Sūrya, and Madhusūdana,

1.4.s:
pītamṛtsvarṇakalaśaṃ dhvajamālāvibhūṣitam..
kāṣṭhatoraṇavinyastaṃ dolakena vibhūṣitam.. 11.4 ..
1.4.d:
पीतमृत्स्वर्णकलशं ध्वजमालाविभूषितम्..
काष्ठतोरणविन्यस्तं दोलकेन विभूषितम्.. 11.4 ..
1.4.m: with a golden jar of yellow clay, decorated with garlands of banners, / set with a wooden archway, adorned with a swing,

1.4.s:
dṛḍhaprāṃśusamudbhūtasopānaśreṇibhāsuram..
sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ vayasyaiḥ saṃvṛtena me.. 11.5 ..
1.4.d:
दृढप्रांशुसमुद्भूतसोपानश्रेणिभासुरम्..
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं दिव्यं वयस्यैः संवृतेन मे.. 11.5 ..
1.4.m: resplendent with a firm, high-rising flight of steps, / full of all wonders, divine, [built by me] surrounded by my playmates.

1.4.s:
tatra jāgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gṛtvātha viniveśitam..
bālyādupalarūpaṃ tadvarṣāvāriviśudvimat.. 11.6 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र जागेश्वरं लिंगं गृत्वाथ विनिवेशितम्..
बाल्यादुपलरूपं तद्वर्षावारिविशुद्विमत्.. 11.6 ..
1.4.m: Taking a Jāgeśvara liṅga, it was then installed there; / out of childishness [it was just] a piece of stone, cleansed by rainwater.

1.4.s:
bakapuṣpaistathānyaiśca kedārotthaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ..
komalairaparaiḥ puṣpairvṛtivallīsamudbhavaiḥ.. 11.7 ..
1.4.d:
बकपुष्पैस्तथान्यैश्च केदारोत्थैः समाहृतैः..
कोमलैरपरैः पुष्पैर्वृतिवल्लीसमुद्भवैः.. 11.7 ..
1.4.m: With baka flowers and others gathered from the fields, / with other tender blossoms grown on fence-vines,

1.4.s:
kūṣmāṃḍaiścaiva varṇādyairunmattakusumāyutaiḥ..
maṃdārairbilvapatraiśca dūrvādyaiśca navāṃkuraiḥ.. 11.8 ..
1.4.d:
कूष्मांडैश्चैव वर्णाद्यैरुन्मत्तकुसुमायुतैः..
मंदारैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च दूर्वाद्यैश्च नवांकुरैः.. 11.8 ..
1.4.m: and with ash gourds, colorful and accompanied by datura blossoms, / with mandāra flowers, bilva leaves, and fresh sprouts such as dūrvā grass,

1.4.s:
pūjā viracitā ramyā śaṃbhoriti mayā nṛpa..
tatastāṃḍavamārabdhamanapekṣitasatkriyam.. 11.9 ..
1.4.d:
पूजा विरचिता रम्या शंभोरिति मया नृप..
ततस्तांडवमारब्धमनपेक्षितसत्क्रियम्.. 11.9 ..
1.4.m: a charming worship of Śambhu was performed by me in this way, O king. / Then a tāṇḍava dance was begun, disregarding proper ritual procedure;

1.4.s:
śivasya purato bālyādgītaṃ ca svasvarjitam..
akārṣaṃ sakṛdevāhaṃ bālye śiśugaṇāvṛtaḥ.. 11.10 ..
1.4.d:
शिवस्य पुरतो बाल्याद्गीतं च स्वस्वर्जितम्..
अकार्षं सकृदेवाहं बाल्ये शिशुगणावृतः.. 11.10 ..
1.4.m: and out of childishness I sang my own song in front of Śiva. / I did this only once in childhood, surrounded by a group of children.

1.4.s:
tato mṛto'haṃ jātaśca vipro jātismaro nṛpa..
vaidiśe nagare'kārṣaṃ śivapūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ.. 11.11 ..
1.4.d:
ततो मृतोऽहं जातश्च विप्रो जातिस्मरो नृप..
वैदिशे नगरेऽकार्षं शिवपूजां विशेषतः.. 11.11 ..
1.4.m: Then I died and was born as a brahmin who remembered his past lives, O king. / In the city of Vaidiśa I performed the worship of Śiva especially.

1.4.s:
śivadīkṣāmupāgamyānugṛhītaḥ śivāgamaiḥ..
śivaprāsāda ādhāya liṃgaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ.. 11.12 ..
1.4.d:
शिवदीक्षामुपागम्यानुगृहीतः शिवागमैः..
शिवप्रासाद आधाय लिंगं श्रद्धासमन्वितः.. 11.12 ..
1.4.m: Having undergone Śaiva initiation, favored by the Śaiva scriptures, / having installed a liṅga in a temple of Śiva, endowed with faith—

1.4.s:
kalpakoṭiṃ vasetsvargeyaḥ karoti śivālayam..
yāvaṃti paramāṇūni śivasyāyatane nṛpa.. 11.13 ..
1.4.d:
कल्पकोटिं वसेत्स्वर्गेयः करोति शिवालयम्..
यावंति परमाणूनि शिवस्यायतने नृप.. 11.13 ..
1.4.m: “Whoever builds an abode of Śiva shall dwell in heaven for ten million kalpas. / As many atoms as there are in an abode of Śiva, O king,

1.4.s:
bhavaṃti tāvadvarṣāṇi karakaḥ śivasadmani..
iti paurāṇavākyāni smarañchailaṃ śivālayam.. 11.14 ..
1.4.d:
भवंति तावद्वर्षाणि करकः शिवसद्मनि..
इति पौराणवाक्यानि स्मरञ्छैलं शिवालयम्.. 11.14 ..
1.4.m: for that many years the builder remains in the home of Śiva”— / remembering these words of the Purāṇas, a stone temple of Śiva

1.4.s:
akāriṣamahaṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmavidhānataḥ..
mṛnmayaṃ kāṣṭhaniṣpannaṃ pākveṣṭaṃ śailameva vā.. 11.15 ..
1.4.d:
अकारिषमहं रम्यं विश्वकर्मविधानतः..
मृन्मयं काष्ठनिष्पन्नं पाक्वेष्टं शैलमेव वा.. 11.15 ..
1.4.m: I had made, charming, according to the rules of Viśvakarman. / “Made of clay, constructed of wood, of burnt brick, or of stone—

1.4.s:
kṛtamāyatanaṃ dadyātkramāddaśaguṇaṃ phalam..
bhasmaśāyī triṣavaṇo bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ.. 11.16 ..
1.4.d:
कृतमायतनं दद्यात्क्रमाद्दशगुणं फलम्..
भस्मशायी त्रिषवणो भिक्षान्नकृतभोजनः.. 11.16 ..
1.4.m: a temple that is built bestows tenfold fruit in succession.” / Sleeping on ashes, bathing at the three junctures of the day, eating food obtained by begging,

1.4.s:
jaṭādharastapasyaṃśca śivārādhanatatparaḥ..
itthaṃ me kurvato jātaṃ punarbhūpa pramāpaṇam.. 11.17 ..
1.4.d:
जटाधरस्तपस्यंश्च शिवाराधनतत्परः..
इत्थं मे कुर्वतो जातं पुनर्भूप प्रमापणम्.. 11.17 ..
1.4.m: wearing matted hair, practicing austerity, and intent on worshipping Śiva— / while I was doing this, O king, death came again.

1.4.s:
jāto jāti smarastatra kāritā tṛtīyehaṃ bhavāṃtare..
sārvabhaumo mahīpālaḥ pratiṣṭhāne purottame.. 11.18 ..
1.4.d:
जातो जाति स्मरस्तत्र कारिता तृतीयेहं भवांतरे..
सार्वभौमो महीपालः प्रतिष्ठाने पुरोत्तमे.. 11.18 ..
1.4.m: Born there remembering past lives, I was made in the third birth / an emperor, a ruler of the earth, in the supreme city of Pratiṣṭhāna,

1.4.s:
jayadatta iti khyātaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ..
tato mayā bahuvidhāḥ prāsādāḥ kāritā nṛpa.. 11.19 ..
1.4.d:
जयदत्त इति ख्यातः सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः..
ततो मया बहुविधाः प्रासादाः कारिता नृप.. 11.19 ..
1.4.m: known as Jayadatta, born in the solar dynasty. / Then I had many kinds of temples constructed, O king.

1.4.s:
tasminbhavāṃtare śaṃbhorārādhanapareṇa ca..
tato nirūpitā jātā bakapuṣpapurassarāḥ.. 11.20 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिन्भवांतरे शंभोराराधनपरेण च..
ततो निरूपिता जाता बकपुष्पपुरस्सराः.. 11.20 ..
1.4.m: And in that birth, intent on worshipping Śambhu, / then [offerings] were designated beginning with baka flowers,

1.4.s:
sauvarṇai rājatai ratnanirmitaiḥ kusumairnṛpa..
tathāvidhe'nnadānādi karomi nṛpasattama.. 11.21 ..
1.4.d:
सौवर्णै राजतै रत्ननिर्मितैः कुसुमैर्नृप..
तथाविधेऽन्नदानादि करोमि नृपसत्तम.. 11.21 ..
1.4.m: with flowers fashioned of gold, silver, and jewels, O king. / I performed distributions of food and the like in such manner, O best of kings.

1.4.s:
kevalaṃ śivaliṃgānāṃ pūjāṃ puṣpaiḥ karomyaham..
tato me bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ saṃtuṣṭo'tha varaṃ dadau.. 11.22 ..
1.4.d:
केवलं शिवलिंगानां पूजां पुष्पैः करोम्यहम्..
ततो मे भगवाञ्छंभुः संतुष्टोऽथ वरं ददौ.. 11.22 ..
1.4.m: I performed the worship of Śiva’s liṅgas solely with flowers. / Then the blessed Śambhu, pleased, granted me a boon:

1.4.s:
ajarāmaratāṃ rājaṃstenaiva vapuṣāvṛtaḥ..
tatastathāvidhaṃ prāpyānanyasādhāraṇaṃ varam.. 11.23 ..
1.4.d:
अजरामरतां राजंस्तेनैव वपुषावृतः..
ततस्तथाविधं प्राप्यानन्यसाधारणं वरम्.. 11.23 ..
1.4.m: freedom from old age and death, O king, while invested with that very body. / Then, having obtained such an extraordinary boon,

1.4.s:
vicarāmi mahīmetāṃ madāṃdha iva vāraṇaḥ..
śivabhaktiṃ vihāyātha nṛpo'haṃ madanāturaḥ.. 11.24 ..
1.4.d:
विचरामि महीमेतां मदांध इव वारणः..
शिवभक्तिं विहायाथ नृपोऽहं मदनातुरः.. 11.24 ..
1.4.m: I roamed this earth like an elephant blind with rut. / Abandoning devotion to Śiva, then, I as a king was afflicted by passion,

1.4.s:
pradharṣayitumārabdhaḥ striyaḥ paraparigrahāḥ..
āyuṣastapasaḥ kīrtestejaso yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ.. 11.25 ..
1.4.d:
प्रधर्षयितुमारब्धः स्त्रियः परपरिग्रहाः..
आयुषस्तपसः कीर्तेस्तेजसो यशसः श्रियः.. 11.25 ..
1.4.m: and began to violate women who were the wives of others. / The primary cause of the destruction of life, austerity, renown, splendor, fame, and fortune

1.4.s:
vināśakāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ paradārapradharṣaṇam..
sakarṇaḥ śrutihīno'sau paśyannaṃdho vadañjaḍaḥ.. 11.26 ..
1.4.d:
विनाशकारणं मुख्यं परदारप्रधर्षणम्..
सकर्णः श्रुतिहीनोऽसौ पश्यन्नंधो वदञ्जडः.. 11.26 ..
1.4.m: is the violation of another’s wife. / Though having ears, he becomes deaf; though seeing, blind; though speaking, mute;

1.4.s:
acetanaścetanāvānmūrkho vidvānapi sphuṭam..
tadā bhavati bhūpāla puruṣaḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ.. 11.27 ..
1.4.d:
अचेतनश्चेतनावान्मूर्खो विद्वानपि स्फुटम्..
तदा भवति भूपाल पुरुषः क्षणमात्रतः.. 11.27 ..
1.4.m: unconscious though conscious; a fool though learned indeed— / such a man becomes in merely a moment, O ruler of the earth,

1.4.s:
yadaiva hariṇākṣīṇāṃ gocaraṃ yāti cakṣuṣām..
mṛtasya niraye vāso jīvataśceśvarādbhayam.. 11.28 ..
1.4.d:
यदैव हरिणाक्षीणां गोचरं याति चक्षुषाम्..
मृतस्य निरये वासो जीवतश्चेश्वराद्भयम्.. 11.28 ..
1.4.m: as soon as he comes into the range of the eyes of fawn-eyed women. / For the dead, dwelling in hell; and for the living, fear of the Lord:

1.4.s:
evaṃ lokadvayaṃ haṃtrī paradārapradharṣaṇā..
jarāmaraṇahīnohamiti niścayamāsthitaḥ.. 11.29 ..
1.4.d:
एवं लोकद्वयं हंत्री परदारप्रधर्षणा..
जरामरणहीनोहमिति निश्चयमास्थितः.. 11.29 ..
1.4.m: thus violating another’s wife destroys both worlds. / Convinced with certainty, “I am free from old age and death,”

1.4.s:
aihikāmuṣmikabhayaṃ vihāyāṃha tataḥ param..
pradharṣayitumārabdhastadā bhūpa parastriyaḥ.. 11.30 ..
1.4.d:
ऐहिकामुष्मिकभयं विहायांह ततः परम्..
प्रधर्षयितुमारब्धस्तदा भूप परस्त्रियः.. 11.30 ..
1.4.m: casting aside fear of this world and the next, I, from that [moment] on, / began to violate other men’s wives, O king.

1.4.s:
atha māṃ saṃparijñāya maryādārahitaṃ yamaḥ..
varapradānādīśasya tadaṃtikasupāyayau..
vyajijñapanmadīyaṃ ca śaṃbhordharmavyatikramam.. 11.31 ..
1.4.d:
अथ मां संपरिज्ञाय मर्यादारहितं यमः..
वरप्रदानादीशस्य तदंतिकसुपाययौ..
व्यजिज्ञपन्मदीयं च शंभोर्धर्मव्यतिक्रमम्.. 11.31 ..
1.4.m: Then Yama, realizing that I had transgressed all bounds / because of the boon granted by Īśa, approached his presence; / and he reported to Śambhu my transgression of dharma:

1.4.s:
..yama uvāca..
nāhaṃ tavānubhāvena guptasyāsya vinigraham.. 11.32 ..
1.4.d:
..यम उवाच..
नाहं तवानुभावेन गुप्तस्यास्य विनिग्रहम्.. 11.32 ..
1.4.m: Yama said: / “Because he is protected by your majesty, I am not able

1.4.s:
śakromi pāpino deva manniyoge'nyamādiśa..
jagadādhārūpā hi tvayeśoktāḥ pativratāḥ.. 11.33 ..
1.4.d:
शक्रोमि पापिनो देव मन्नियोगेऽन्यमादिश..
जगदाधारूपा हि त्वयेशोक्ताः पतिव्रताः.. 11.33 ..
1.4.m: to restrain this sinner, O Lord! Appoint another in my office. / For you have declared that chaste wives are the foundation of the world, O Īśa;

1.4.s:
gāvo viprāḥ sanigamā alubdhā dānaśīlinaḥ..
satyaniṣṭhā iti svāmiṃsteṣāṃ mukhyatamā satī.. 11.34 ..
1.4.d:
गावो विप्राः सनिगमा अलुब्धा दानशीलिनः..
सत्यनिष्ठा इति स्वामिंस्तेषां मुख्यतमा सती.. 11.34 ..
1.4.m: and cows, brahmins knowledgeable in the Vedas, the ungreedy, the generous, / and those devoted to truth—among these, O Lord, a chaste wife is foremost.

1.4.s:
tāstena dharṣitā luptaṃ madīyaṃ dharmaśāsanam..
varadānapramattena tavaiva paribhūya mām.. 11.35 ..
1.4.d:
तास्तेन धर्षिता लुप्तं मदीयं धर्मशासनम्..
वरदानप्रमत्तेन तवैव परिभूय माम्.. 11.35 ..
1.4.m: They have been violated by him; my authority over dharma has been overthrown / by him, arrogant from your boon, defying me—

1.4.s:
jayadattena deveśa pratiṣṭhānādhivāsinā..
imāṃ dharmasya bhagavāngiramākarṇya kopitaḥ..
śaśāpa māṃ samānīya vepamānaṃ kṛtāṃjalim.. 11.36 ..
1.4.d:
जयदत्तेन देवेश प्रतिष्ठानाधिवासिना..
इमां धर्मस्य भगवान्गिरमाकर्ण्य कोपितः..
शशाप मां समानीय वेपमानं कृतांजलिम्.. 11.36 ..
1.4.m: by Jayadatta, O Lord of gods, who dwells in Pratiṣṭhāna!” / Hearing this speech of Dharma, the Blessed Lord was angered; / summoning me as I trembled with folded hands, he cursed me:

1.4.s:
..īśvara uvāca..
yasmādduṣṭasamācāra dharṣitāste pativratāḥ.. 11.37 ..
1.4.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच..
यस्माद्दुष्टसमाचार धर्षितास्ते पतिव्रताः.. 11.37 ..
1.4.m: Īśvara said: / “Since, O evil-doer, chaste wives were violated by you,

1.4.s:
kāmārtena mayā śaptastasmātkūrmaḥ kṣaṇādbhava..
tataḥ praṇamya vijñaptaḥ śāpatāpaharo mayā.. 11.38 ..
1.4.d:
कामार्तेन मया शप्तस्तस्मात्कूर्मः क्षणाद्भव..
ततः प्रणम्य विज्ञप्तः शापतापहरो मया.. 11.38 ..
1.4.m: afflicted by desire, therefore, cursed by me, become a tortoise instantly!” / Then, bowing down, the remover of the torment of the curse was implored by me;

1.4.s:
prāha ṣaṣṭitame kalpe viśāpo bhavitā gaṇaḥ..
madīya iti saṃprocya jagāmādarśanaṃ śivaḥ.. 11.39 ..
1.4.d:
प्राह षष्टितमे कल्पे विशापो भविता गणः..
मदीय इति संप्रोच्य जगामादर्शनं शिवः.. 11.39 ..
1.4.m: he said: “In the sixtieth kalpa you will be freed from the curse and will become a gaṇa / of mine.” Having spoken thus, Śiva vanished.

1.4.s:
ahaṃ kūrmastadā jāto daśayojanavistṛtaḥ..
samudrasalile nītastvayāhaṃ yajñasādhane.. 11.40 ..
1.4.d:
अहं कूर्मस्तदा जातो दशयोजनविस्तृतः..
समुद्रसलिले नीतस्त्वयाहं यज्ञसाधने.. 11.40 ..
1.4.m: I then became a tortoise ten yojanas in extent. / I was brought into the ocean water by you for accomplishing the sacrifice,

1.4.s:
purastādyāyajūkena smaraṃstacca bibhemi te..
dagdhastvayāhaṃ pṛṣṭhetra vraṇānyetāni paśya me.. 11.41 ..
1.4.d:
पुरस्ताद्यायजूकेन स्मरंस्तच्च बिभेमि ते..
दग्धस्त्वयाहं पृष्ठेत्र व्रणान्येतानि पश्य मे.. 11.41 ..
1.4.m: by you who were formerly a zealous sacrificer; and remembering that, I fear you. / I was burned by you upon my back; see these wounds of mine!

1.4.s:
cayanāni bahūnyatra kalpasūtravidhānataḥ..
pṛṣṭhopari kṛtānyāsanniṃdradyumna tadā tvayā.. 11.42 ..
1.4.d:
चयनानि बहून्यत्र कल्पसूत्रविधानतः..
पृष्ठोपरि कृतान्यासन्निंद्रद्युम्न तदा त्वया.. 11.42 ..
1.4.m: Many altars were built according to the rules of the Kalpasūtras / upon my back by you at that time, O Indradyumna.

1.4.s:
bhūyaḥ saṃtāpitā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī pṛthivīpate..
susrāva sarvatīrthānāṃ sāraṃ sā'bhūnmahīnadī.. 11.43 ..
1.4.d:
भूयः संतापिता यज्ञैः पृथिवी पृथिवीपते..
सुस्राव सर्वतीर्थानां सारं साऽभून्महीनदी.. 11.43 ..
1.4.m: Further, heated by the sacrifices, O lord of the earth, / the earth oozed the essence of all sacred fords; that became the river Mahī.

1.4.s:
tasyāṃ ca snānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate..
tato naimittike kasminnapi pralaya āgataḥ.. 11.44 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यां च स्नानमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते..
ततो नैमित्तिके कस्मिन्नपि प्रलय आगतः.. 11.44 ..
1.4.m: And by mere ritual ablution in it, one is freed from all sins. / Then, when a certain periodic cosmic dissolution arrived,

1.4.s:
plavamānamidaṃ rājanmānasaṃ śatayojanam..
ṣaṭ‌paṃcāśatpramāṇena kalpā mama purā nṛpa.. 11.45 ..
1.4.d:
प्लवमानमिदं राजन्मानसं शतयोजनम्..
षट्‌पंचाशत्प्रमाणेन कल्पा मम पुरा नृप.. 11.45 ..
1.4.m: this [lake] Mānasa, a hundred yojanas wide, was floating, O king. / In the measure of fifty-six cosmic ages of mine formerly, O king,

1.4.s:
vyatītā iha catvāraḥ śeṣe mokṣastataḥ param..
evamāyuridaṃ dīrghamevaṃ śāpācca kūrmatā.. 11.46 ..
1.4.d:
व्यतीता इह चत्वारः शेषे मोक्षस्ततः परम्..
एवमायुरिदं दीर्घमेवं शापाच्च कूर्मता.. 11.46 ..
1.4.m: four have elapsed here; in the remainder liberation will occur after that. / Thus this lifespan is long, and thus from a curse came the condition of a tortoise.

1.4.s:
mamābhūdīśvarasyaiva satīdharmadruho nṛpa..
brūhi kiṃ kriyatāṃ śatrorapi te gṛhagāminaḥ.. 11.47 ..
1.4.d:
ममाभूदीश्वरस्यैव सतीधर्मद्रुहो नृप..
ब्रूहि किं क्रियतां शत्रोरपि ते गृहगामिनः.. 11.47 ..
1.4.m: I was an Īśvara [himself] who injured the duty of a virtuous wife, O king. / Speak: what may be done even for you, an enemy who has come to my house?

1.4.s:
mama pṛṣṭhiściraṃ bhūpa tvayā dagdhāgninā'purā..
ahaṃ jvalaṃtīmiva tāṃ paśyāmyadyāpi satriṇā.. 11.48 ..
1.4.d:
मम पृष्ठिश्चिरं भूप त्वया दग्धाग्निनाऽपुरा..
अहं ज्वलंतीमिव तां पश्याम्यद्यापि सत्रिणा.. 11.48 ..
1.4.m: My back was burned for a long time formerly by you with fire, O king; / I see it even today as if blazing by [you] the sacrificial performer.

1.4.s:
idaṃ vimānamāyātaṃ tvayā kasmānnirākṛtam..
devadūtasamāyuktaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhogānnijārjitān.. 11.49 ..
1.4.d:
इदं विमानमायातं त्वया कस्मान्निराकृतम्..
देवदूतसमायुक्तं भुंक्ष्व भोगान्निजार्जितान्.. 11.49 ..
1.4.m: Why has this aerial chariot, having arrived together with a divine messenger, been rejected by you? / Enjoy the pleasures earned by yourself!

1.4.s:
..iṃdradyumna uvāca..
caturmukhena tenāhaṃ svargānnirvāsitaḥ svayam..
vilakṣyona prayāsyāmi pātādhikyādidūṣite.. 11.50 ..
1.4.d:
..इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
चतुर्मुखेन तेनाहं स्वर्गान्निर्वासितः स्वयम्..
विलक्ष्योन प्रयास्यामि पाताधिक्यादिदूषिते.. 11.50 ..
1.4.m: Indradyumna said: / By that four-faced [Brahmā] himself I was banished from heaven. / Being ashamed, I will not go [back] to that which is blemished by a fall [from heaven] and other [evils].

1.4.s:
tasmādvivekavairāgyamavidyāpāpanāśanam..
āliṃgyāhaṃ yatiṣyāmi prāpya bodhaṃ vimuktaye.. 11.51 ..
1.4.d:
तस्माद्विवेकवैराग्यमविद्यापापनाशनम्..
आलिंग्याहं यतिष्यामि प्राप्य बोधं विमुक्तये.. 11.51 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, having embraced discrimination and detachment, which destroy ignorance and sin, / I will strive for liberation, having attained knowledge.

1.4.s:
tanme gṛhagatasyādya yathātithyakaro bhavān..
tadādiśa yathā'pārapāradaḥ kopi me guruḥ.. 11.52 ..
1.4.d:
तन्मे गृहगतस्याद्य यथातिथ्यकरो भवान्..
तदादिश यथाऽपारपारदः कोपि मे गुरुः.. 11.52 ..
1.4.m: Since you now show hospitality to me who have come to your house, / therefore instruct me, so that some guru may take me across the shoreless [ocean].

1.4.s:
..kūrma uvāca..
lomaśonāma dīrghāyurmatto'pyasti mahāmuniḥ..
mayā kalāpagrāme sa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kvacinnṛpa.. 11.53 ..
1.4.d:
..कूर्म उवाच..
लोमशोनाम दीर्घायुर्मत्तोऽप्यस्ति महामुनिः..
मया कलापग्रामे स पूर्वं दृष्टः क्वचिन्नृप.. 11.53 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise said: / There is a great sage named Lomaśa whose lifespan is longer even than mine. / Formerly in Kalāpagrāma he was seen by me somewhere, O king.

1.4.s:
..iṃdradyumna uvāca..
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmastameva sahitāvayam..
prāhuḥ pūtatamāṃ tīrthādapi satsaṃgatiṃ budhāḥ.. 11.54 ..
1.4.d:
..इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामस्तमेव सहितावयम्..
प्राहुः पूततमां तीर्थादपि सत्संगतिं बुधाः.. 11.54 ..
1.4.m: Indradyumna said: / Therefore come, let us go together to him alone; / the wise proclaim association with the virtuous to be purer even than a sacred ford.

1.4.s:
itthaṃ niśamya nṛpatervacanaṃ tadānīṃ sarve'pi te ṣaḍatha taṃ munimukhyamāśu..
citte vidhāya muditāḥ prayayurdvijeṃdraṃ jijñāsavaḥ sucirajīvitahetumasya.. 11.55 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve kūrmākhyānaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 11 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
इत्थं निशम्य नृपतेर्वचनं तदानीं सर्वेऽपि ते षडथ तं मुनिमुख्यमाशु..
चित्ते विधाय मुदिताः प्रययुर्द्विजेंद्रं जिज्ञासवः सुचिरजीवितहेतुमस्य.. 11.55 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे महीप्रादुर्भावे कूर्माख्यानंनामैकादशोऽध्यायः.. 11 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Having thus heard the speech of the king, then all six of them, / placing that foremost of sages swiftly in mind, went joyfully to that chief of the twice-born, / desiring to know the cause of his very long life.
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, named "The Story of the Tortoise in the Manifestation of the Mahī," in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.4.s:
.. nārada uvāca..
atha te dadṛśuḥ pārtha saṃyamasthaṃ mahāmunim..
kriyāyogasamāyuktaṃ tapomūrtidharaṃ yathā.. 12.1 ..
1.4.d:
.. नारद उवाच..
अथ ते ददृशुः पार्थ संयमस्थं महामुनिम्..
क्रियायोगसमायुक्तं तपोमूर्तिधरं यथा.. 12.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Then they saw the great sage abiding in self-restraint, O Pārtha, / endowed with the yoga of action, as though holding the form of austerity,

1.4.s:
jaṭāstriṣavaṇasnānakapilāḥ śirasā tadā..
dhārayantaṃ lomaśākhyamājyasiktamivānalam.. 12.2 ..
1.4.d:
जटास्त्रिषवणस्नानकपिलाः शिरसा तदा..
धारयन्तं लोमशाख्यमाज्यसिक्तमिवानलम्.. 12.2 ..
1.4.m: bearing on his head matted locks tawny from the three daily ritual ablutions, / named Lomaśa, like a fire sprinkled with clarified butter,

1.4.s:
savyahaste tṛṇaughaṃ ca cchāyārthe viprasattamam..
dakṣiṇe cākṣamālāṃ ca bibhrataṃ maitramārgagam.. 12.3 ..
1.4.d:
सव्यहस्ते तृणौघं च च्छायार्थे विप्रसत्तमम्..
दक्षिणे चाक्षमालां च बिभ्रतं मैत्रमार्गगम्.. 12.3 ..
1.4.m: carrying a bundle of grass in his left hand for shade, the best of brahmins, / and holding a rosary in his right, walking upon the path of Maitra.

1.4.s:
ahiṃsayanduruktādyaiḥ prāṇino bhūmicāriṇaḥ..
yaḥ siddhimeti japyena sa maitro munirucyate.. 12.4 ..
1.4.d:
अहिंसयन्दुरुक्ताद्यैः प्राणिनो भूमिचारिणः..
यः सिद्धिमेति जप्येन स मैत्रो मुनिरुच्यते.. 12.4 ..
1.4.m: Not harming creatures moving on earth with harsh words and the like, / he who attains perfection through recitation is called a Maitra sage.

1.4.s:
bakabhūpadvijolūkagṛdhrakūrmā vilokya ca..
nemuḥ kalāpagrāme taṃ ciraṃtanataponidhim.. 12.5 ..
1.4.d:
बकभूपद्विजोलूकगृध्रकूर्मा विलोक्य च..
नेमुः कलापग्रामे तं चिरंतनतपोनिधिम्.. 12.5 ..
1.4.m: And seeing him in Kalāpagrāma, that crane, king, twice-born, owl, vulture, and tortoise / bowed to that ancient treasure of austerity.

1.4.s:
svāgatāsanasatkāreṇāmunā te'ti satkṛtāḥ..
yathocitaṃ pratītāstamāhuḥ kāryaṃ hṛdi sthitam.. 12.6 ..
1.4.d:
स्वागतासनसत्कारेणामुना तेऽति सत्कृताः..
यथोचितं प्रतीतास्तमाहुः कार्यं हृदि स्थितम्.. 12.6 ..
1.4.m: Having been exceedingly honored by him with welcome, a seat, and hospitality, / confident, they properly spoke to him the matter remaining in their hearts.

1.4.s:
..kūrma uvāca..
indradyumno'yamavanīpatiḥ satrijanāgraṇīḥ..
kīrtilopānnirasto'yaṃ vedhasā nākapṛṣṭhataḥ.. 12.7 ..
1.4.d:
..कूर्म उवाच..
इन्द्रद्युम्नोऽयमवनीपतिः सत्रिजनाग्रणीः..
कीर्तिलोपान्निरस्तोऽयं वेधसा नाकपृष्ठतः.. 12.7 ..
1.4.m: The tortoise said: / This Indradyumna, lord of the earth, is foremost among performers of sacrifice; / he was cast down from the surface of heaven by the Creator due to the vanishing of his fame.

1.4.s:
mārkaṃḍeyādibhiḥ prāpya kīrtyuddhāraṃca sattama..
nāyaṃ kāmayate svargaṃ punaḥpātādibhīṣaṇam.. 12.8 ..
1.4.d:
मार्कंडेयादिभिः प्राप्य कीर्त्युद्धारंच सत्तम..
नायं कामयते स्वर्गं पुनःपातादिभीषणम्.. 12.8 ..
1.4.m: And having obtained the restoration of his fame through Mārkaṇḍeya and the others, O best of beings, / he does not desire heaven, which is terrifying because of another fall and other [evils].

1.4.s:
bhavatānugṛhīto'yamihecchati mahodayam..
praṇodyastadayaṃ bhūpaḥ śiṣyaste bhagavanmayā..
tvatsakāśamihānīto brūhi sādhvasya vāṃchitam.. 12.9 ..
1.4.d:
भवतानुगृहीतोऽयमिहेच्छति महोदयम्..
प्रणोद्यस्तदयं भूपः शिष्यस्ते भगवन्मया..
त्वत्सकाशमिहानीतो ब्रूहि साध्वस्य वांछितम्.. 12.9 ..
1.4.m: Favored by you, he desires supreme welfare here. / This king, fit to be guided, is your disciple, O venerable one; / he has been brought here to your presence by me; speak rightly to his desire.

1.4.s:
paropakaraṇaṃ nāma sādhūnāṃ vratamāhitam..
viśeṣataḥ praṇodyānāṃ śiṣyavṛttimupeyuṣām.. 12.10 ..
1.4.d:
परोपकरणं नाम साधूनां व्रतमाहितम्..
विशेषतः प्रणोद्यानां शिष्यवृत्तिमुपेयुषाम्.. 12.10 ..
1.4.m: Indeed, aiding others is declared to be the vow of the virtuous, / especially toward those who are fit to be guided and have taken up the conduct of a disciple.

1.4.s:
apraṇodyeṣu pāpeṣu sādhu proktamasaṃśayam..
vidveṣaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi kurute'nyatarasya ca.. 12.11 ..
1.4.d:
अप्रणोद्येषु पापेषु साधु प्रोक्तमसंशयम्..
विद्वेषं मरणं चापि कुरुतेऽन्यतरस्य च.. 12.11 ..
1.4.m: Toward those unfit to be guided, the wicked, it is undoubtedly declared [otherwise] by the virtuous; / it produces hatred and even the death of one or the other.

1.4.s:
apramattaḥ praṇodyeṣu munireṣa prayacchati..
tadeveti bhavānevaṃ dharmaṃ vetti kuto vayam.. 12.12 ..
1.4.d:
अप्रमत्तः प्रणोद्येषु मुनिरेष प्रयच्छति..
तदेवेति भवानेवं धर्मं वेत्ति कुतो वयम्.. 12.12 ..
1.4.m: Vigilant toward those fit to be guided, this sage bestows / that very [knowledge]; thus you know dharma, whence do we?

1.4.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
kūrma yuktamidaṃ sarvaṃ tvayābhihitamadya naḥ..
dharmaśāstropanataṃ tatsmāritāḥ sma purātanam.. 12.13 ..
1.4.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
कूर्म युक्तमिदं सर्वं त्वयाभिहितमद्य नः..
धर्मशास्त्रोपनतं तत्स्मारिताः स्म पुरातनम्.. 12.13 ..
1.4.m: Lomaśa said: / O tortoise, all this spoken by you to us today is fitting; / it accords with the treatise on dharma; we are reminded of that ancient [truth].

1.4.s:
brūhi rājansuviśrabdhaṃ sandehaṃ hṛdayasthitam..
kaste kimabravīccheṣaṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ.. 12.14 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रूहि राजन्सुविश्रब्धं सन्देहं हृदयस्थितम्..
कस्ते किमब्रवीच्छेषं वक्ष्याम्यहं न संशयः.. 12.14 ..
1.4.m: Speak, O king, with full confidence, the doubt situated in your heart. / Who told you what? I will declare the remainder, of this there is no doubt.

1.4.s:
..indradyumna uvāca..
bhagavanprathamaḥ praśrastāvadeva mamocyatām..
grīṣmakāle'pi madhyasthai ravau kiṃ na tavāśramaḥ.. 12.15 ..
1.4.d:
..इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच..
भगवन्प्रथमः प्रश्रस्तावदेव ममोच्यताम्..
ग्रीष्मकालेऽपि मध्यस्थै रवौ किं न तवाश्रमः.. 12.15 ..
1.4.m: Indradyumna said: / O venerable one, let only my first question be answered: / Even in the summer season, when the sun is in the middle [of the sky], why do you have no hermitage,

1.4.s: kuṭīmātro'pi yacchāyā tṛṇaiḥ śirasi pāṇigaiḥ.. 12.16 ..
1.4.d: कुटीमात्रोऽपि यच्छाया तृणैः शिरसि पाणिगैः.. 12.16 ..
1.4.m: even the mere measure of a hut, since shade is [made] by grass held in the hands over the head?

1.4.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
martavyamastyavaśyaṃ ca kāya eṣa patiṣyati..
kasyārthe kriyate gehamanityabhavamadhyagaiḥ.. 12.17 ..
1.4.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
मर्तव्यमस्त्यवश्यं च काय एष पतिष्यति..
कस्यार्थे क्रियते गेहमनित्यभवमध्यगैः.. 12.17 ..
1.4.m: Lomaśa said: / Death is inevitable, and this body will fall; / for whose sake is a house built by those dwelling in the midst of an impermanent existence?

1.4.s:
yasya mṛtyurbhavenmitraṃ pītaṃ vā'mṛtamuttamam..
tasyaitaducitaṃ vaktumidaṃ me śvo bhaviṣyati.. 12.18 ..
1.4.d:
यस्य मृत्युर्भवेन्मित्रं पीतं वाऽमृतमुत्तमम्..
तस्यैतदुचितं वक्तुमिदं मे श्वो भविष्यति.. 12.18 ..
1.4.m: For him whose friend might be Death, or by whom the supreme nectar has been drunk, / it is fitting to say: 'This will be mine tomorrow.'

1.4.s:
idaṃ yugasahasreṣu bhaviṣyamabhaviddinam..
tadapyadyatvamāpannaṃ kā kathāmaraṇāvadheḥ.. 12.19 ..
1.4.d:
इदं युगसहस्रेषु भविष्यमभविद्दिनम्..
तदप्यद्यत्वमापन्नं का कथामरणावधेः.. 12.19 ..
1.4.m: This day, which was to be in thousands of yugas, has come to pass; / that too has reached presentness today—what talk can there be of the limit of death?

1.4.s:
kāraṇānugataṃ kāryamidaṃ śukrādabhūdvapuḥ..
kathaṃ viśuddhimāyāti kṣālitāṃgāravadvada.. 12.20 ..
1.4.d:
कारणानुगतं कार्यमिदं शुक्रादभूद्वपुः..
कथं विशुद्धिमायाति क्षालितांगारवद्वद.. 12.20 ..
1.4.m: The effect follows the cause; this body arose from semen; / how can it attain purity, like a charcoal that has been washed? Speak!

1.4.s:
tadasyāpi kṛte pāpaṃ śatruṣaḍvarganirjitāḥ..
kathaṃkāraṃ na lajjante kurvāṇā nṛpasattama.. 12.21 ..
1.4.d:
तदस्यापि कृते पापं शत्रुषड्वर्गनिर्जिताः..
कथंकारं न लज्जन्ते कुर्वाणा नृपसत्तम.. 12.21 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, even for its sake, how are those conquered by the group of six enemies / not ashamed when committing sin, O best of kings?

1.4.s:
tadbrahmaṇa ihotpannaḥ sikatādvayasambhavaḥ..
nigamoktaṃ paṭhañchṛṇvannidaṃ jīviṣyate katham.. 12.22 ..
1.4.d:
तद्ब्रह्मण इहोत्पन्नः सिकताद्वयसम्भवः..
निगमोक्तं पठञ्छृण्वन्निदं जीविष्यते कथम्.. 12.22 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, born here from Brahmā, sprung from two grains of sand, / reciting and listening to what is stated in the Veda, how shall this [person] live?

1.4.s:
tathāpi vaiṣṇavī māyā mohayatyavivekinam..
hṛdayasthaṃ na jānaṃti hyapi mṛtyu śatāyuṣaḥ.. 12.23 ..
1.4.d:
तथापि वैष्णवी माया मोहयत्यविवेकिनम्..
हृदयस्थं न जानंति ह्यपि मृत्यु शतायुषः.. 12.23 ..
1.4.m: Even so, the illusion of Viṣṇu deludes the indiscriminate person; / even those with a lifespan of a hundred years do not recognize Death seated in the heart.

1.4.s:
dantāścalāścalā lakṣmīryauvanaṃ jīvitaṃ nṛpa..
calācalamatīvedaṃ dānamevaṃ gṛhaṃ nṛṇām.. 12.24 ..
1.4.d:
दन्ताश्चलाश्चला लक्ष्मीर्यौवनं जीवितं नृप..
चलाचलमतीवेदं दानमेवं गृहं नृणाम्.. 12.24 ..
1.4.m: Teeth are unsteady, fortune is unsteady, youth and life are unsteady, O king; / giving is very unsteady, and likewise the house of human beings.

1.4.s:
iti vijñāya saṃsārasāraṃ ca calācalam..
kasyārthe kriyate rājankuṭajādi parigrahaḥ.. 12.25 ..
1.4.d:
इति विज्ञाय संसारसारं च चलाचलम्..
कस्यार्थे क्रियते राजन्कुटजादि परिग्रहः.. 12.25 ..
1.4.m: Knowing thus the essence of worldly existence to be completely transient, / for whose sake is the acquisition of a hut and other things undertaken, O king?

1.4.s:
..indradyumna uvāca..
cirāyurbhagavāneva śrūyate bhuvanatraye..
tadarthamahamāyātastatkimevaṃ vacastava.. 12.26 ..
1.4.d:
..इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच..
चिरायुर्भगवानेव श्रूयते भुवनत्रये..
तदर्थमहमायातस्तत्किमेवं वचस्तव.. 12.26 ..
1.4.m: Indradyumna said: / You alone, O venerable one, are heard of as long-lived in the three worlds; / for that purpose I have come; so why this speech of yours?

1.4.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
pratikalpaṃ maccharīrādekaromaparikṣayaḥ..
jāyate sarvanāśe ca mama bhāvi pramāpaṇam.. 12.27 ..
1.4.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
प्रतिकल्पं मच्छरीरादेकरोमपरिक्षयः..
जायते सर्वनाशे च मम भावि प्रमापणम्.. 12.27 ..
1.4.m: Lomaśa said: / In every cosmic age, the loss of one hair occurs from my body; / and when all are lost, my death will take place.

1.4.s:
paśya jānupradeśaṃ me dvyaṃgulaṃ romavarjitam..
jātaṃ vapustadbibhemi martavye sati kiṃ gṛhaiḥ.. 12.28 ..
1.4.d:
पश्य जानुप्रदेशं मे द्व्यंगुलं रोमवर्जितम्..
जातं वपुस्तद्बिभेमि मर्तव्ये सति किं गृहैः.. 12.28 ..
1.4.m: Behold, the region of my knee has become devoid of hair to the extent of two finger-breadths / on my body; therefore I am afraid: when one must die, of what use are houses?

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
itthaṃ niśamya tadvākyaṃ sa prahasyātivismitaḥ..
bhūpālastasya papraccha kāraṇaṃ tādṛśāyuṣaḥ.. 12.29 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
इत्थं निशम्य तद्वाक्यं स प्रहस्यातिविस्मितः..
भूपालस्तस्य पप्रच्छ कारणं तादृशायुषः.. 12.29 ..
1.4.m:
Nārada said:
Hearing these words of his, that king laughed, greatly astonished, / and asked him the reason for such a lifespan.

1.4.s:
..indradyumna uvāca..
pṛcchāmi tvāmahaṃ brahmanyadāyuridamīdṛśam..
tava dīrghaṃ prabhāvo'sau dānasya tapaso'thavā.. 12.30 ..
1.4.d:
..इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच..
पृच्छामि त्वामहं ब्रह्मन्यदायुरिदमीदृशम्..
तव दीर्घं प्रभावोऽसौ दानस्य तपसोऽथवा.. 12.30 ..
1.4.m:
Indradyumna said:
O brahmin, I ask you about this lifespan of yours which is such, / so long: is this the power of charity or of austerity?

1.4.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
śrṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi pūrvajanmasamudbhavām..
śivadharmayutāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm.. 12.31 ..
1.4.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
श्रृणु भूप प्रवक्ष्यामि पूर्वजन्मसमुद्भवाम्..
शिवधर्मयुतां पुण्यां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम्.. 12.31 ..
1.4.m:
Lomaśa said:
Listen, O king, I will tell the holy story arising from my previous life, / joined with the duty towards Śiva, destroying sin.

1.4.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro daridro'tīvabhūtale..
bhramāmi vasudhāpṛṣṭhe hyaśanapīḍito bhṛśam.. 12.32 ..
1.4.d:
अहमासं पुरा शूद्रो दरिद्रोऽतीवभूतले..
भ्रमामि वसुधापृष्ठे ह्यशनपीडितो भृशम्.. 12.32 ..
1.4.m: Formerly, I was a śūdra, extremely poor on the face of the earth; / I wandered upon the surface of the earth, sorely distressed by hunger.

1.4.s:
tato mayā mahalliṃgaṃ jālimadhyagataṃ tadā..
madhyāhne'sya jalādhāro dṛṣṭaścaivā vidūrataḥ.. 12.33 ..
1.4.d:
ततो मया महल्लिंगं जालिमध्यगतं तदा..
मध्याह्नेऽस्य जलाधारो दृष्टश्चैवा विदूरतः.. 12.33 ..
1.4.m: Then, at midday, I saw a great liṅga inside a thicket, / and, not far away, a reservoir of water.

1.4.s:
tataḥ praviśya tadvāri pītvā snātvā ca śāṃbhavam..
talliṃgaṃ snāpitaṃ pūjā vihitā kamalaiḥ śubhaiḥ.. 12.34 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रविश्य तद्वारि पीत्वा स्नात्वा च शांभवम्..
तल्लिंगं स्नापितं पूजा विहिता कमलैः शुभैः.. 12.34 ..
1.4.m: Then, having entered that water, having drunk, and having bathed, I bathed that liṅga / of Śambhu, and worship was performed with auspicious lotuses.

1.4.s:
atha kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭho'haṃ śrīkaṃṭhaṃ taṃ namasya ca..
punaḥ pracalito mārge pramīto nṛpasattama.. 12.35 ..
1.4.d:
अथ क्षुत्क्षामकंठोऽहं श्रीकंठं तं नमस्य च..
पुनः प्रचलितो मार्गे प्रमीतो नृपसत्तम.. 12.35 ..
1.4.m: Then, my throat parched with hunger, having bowed down to that Śrīkaṇṭha / and set out again upon the road, I died, O best of kings.

1.4.s:
tato'haṃ brāhmaṇagṛhe jāto jātismaraḥ sutaḥ..
snāpanācchivaliṃgasya sakṛtkamalapūjanāt.. 12.36 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽहं ब्राह्मणगृहे जातो जातिस्मरः सुतः..
स्नापनाच्छिवलिंगस्य सकृत्कमलपूजनात्.. 12.36 ..
1.4.m: Then I was born in the house of a brahmin as a son remembering past lives, / because of that ceremonial bath of the Śivaliṅga and the worship with lotuses performed just once.

1.4.s:
smaranvilasitaṃ mithyā satyābhāsamidaṃ jagat..
avidyāmayamityevaṃ jñātvā mūkatvamāsthitaḥ.. 12.37 ..
1.4.d:
स्मरन्विलसितं मिथ्या सत्याभासमिदं जगत्..
अविद्यामयमित्येवं ज्ञात्वा मूकत्वमास्थितः.. 12.37 ..
1.4.m: Remembering that this world is a false play of appearances, an illusory appearance of truth, / consisting of ignorance—having understood it thus, I took to muteness.

1.4.s:
tena vipreṇa vārdhakye samārādhya maheśvaram..
prāpto'hamiti me nāma īśāna iti kalpitam.. 12.38 ..
1.4.d:
तेन विप्रेण वार्धक्ये समाराध्य महेश्वरम्..
प्राप्तोऽहमिति मे नाम ईशान इति कल्पितम्.. 12.38 ..
1.4.m: Since that brahmin in old age had obtained me / by propitiating Maheśvara, my name was arranged as Īśāna.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sa vipro vātsalyādagadānsubahūnmama..
cakāra vyapaneṣyāmi mūkatvamiti niścayaḥ.. 12.39 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स विप्रो वात्सल्यादगदान्सुबहून्मम..
चकार व्यपनेष्यामि मूकत्वमिति निश्चयः.. 12.39 ..
1.4.m: Then, out of affection, that brahmin administered very many medicines to me, / resolved: “I will remove his muteness.”

1.4.s:
maṃtravādānbahūnvaidyānupāyānaparānapi..
pitrostathā mahāmāyāsaṃbaddhamanasostathā.. 12.40 ..
1.4.d:
मंत्रवादान्बहून्वैद्यानुपायानपरानपि..
पित्रोस्तथा महामायासंबद्धमनसोस्तथा.. 12.40 ..
1.4.m: [He employed] many recitations of mantras, physicians, and other means; / and seeing the folly of my parents,

1.4.s:
nirīkṣya mūḍhatāṃ hāsyamāsīnmanasi me tadā..
tathā yauvanamāsādya niśi hitvā nijaṃ gṛham.. 12.41 ..
1.4.d:
निरीक्ष्य मूढतां हास्यमासीन्मनसि मे तदा..
तथा यौवनमासाद्य निशि हित्वा निजं गृहम्.. 12.41 ..
1.4.m: whose minds were bound by the great illusion, there was laughter in my mind then. / When I attained youth in that manner, having left my home at night,

1.4.s:
saṃpūjya kamalaiḥ śaṃbhuṃ tataḥ śayanamabhyagām..
tataḥ pramīte pitari mūḍhaityahamujjhitaḥ.. 12.42 ..
1.4.d:
संपूज्य कमलैः शंभुं ततः शयनमभ्यगाम्..
ततः प्रमीते पितरि मूढैत्यहमुज्झितः.. 12.42 ..
1.4.m: and having worshipped Śambhu with lotuses, I then went to sleep. / Then, when my father died, I was abandoned as a fool

1.4.s:
saṃbaṃdhibhiḥ pratīto'tha phalāhāramavasthitaḥ..
pratītaḥ pūjayāmīśamabjairbahuvidhaistathā.. 12.43 ..
1.4.d:
संबंधिभिः प्रतीतोऽथ फलाहारमवस्थितः..
प्रतीतः पूजयामीशमब्जैर्बहुविधैस्तथा.. 12.43 ..
1.4.m: by my relatives. Recognized then as living on a diet of fruits, / recognized [thus], I worshipped the Lord likewise with many kinds of lotuses.

1.4.s:
atha varṣaśatasyāṃte varadaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ..
pratyakṣo yācito dehi jarāmaraṇasaṃkṣayam.. 12.44 ..
1.4.d:
अथ वर्षशतस्यांते वरदः शशिशेखरः..
प्रत्यक्षो याचितो देहि जरामरणसंक्षयम्.. 12.44 ..
1.4.m: Then, at the end of a hundred years, the moon-crested granter of boons / appeared visibly [and] was asked: “Grant the destruction of old age and death!”

1.4.s:
..īśvara uvāca..
ajarāmaratā nāsti nāmarūpabhṛtoyataḥ..
mamāpi dehapātaḥ syādavadhiṃ kuru jīvite.. 12.45 ..
1.4.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच..
अजरामरता नास्ति नामरूपभृतोयतः..
ममापि देहपातः स्यादवधिं कुरु जीविते.. 12.45 ..
1.4.m:
Īśvara said:
Freedom from old age and death does not exist for one who bears name and form. / Even I must undergo the fall of the body; make a limit to your life.

1.4.s:
iti śaṃbhorvacaḥ śrutvā mayā vṛtimidaṃ tadā..
kalpāṃte romapāto'stu maraṇaṃ sarvasaṃkṣaye.. 12.46 ..
1.4.d:
इति शंभोर्वचः श्रुत्वा मया वृतिमिदं तदा..
कल्पांते रोमपातोऽस्तु मरणं सर्वसंक्षये.. 12.46 ..
