1.4.m: Hearing these words of Śambhu, this was chosen by me then: / “Let there be the fall of one hair at the end of a kalpa, and death at the destruction of all [things].

1.4.s:
tatastava gaṇo bhūyāmiti me'bhīpsito varaḥ..
tathetyuktvā sa bhagavānharaścādarśanaṃ gataḥ.. 12.47 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तव गणो भूयामिति मेऽभीप्सितो वरः..
तथेत्युक्त्वा स भगवान्हरश्चादर्शनं गतः.. 12.47 ..
1.4.m: After that, let me become your attendant: this is the boon desired by me.” / Having said, “So be it,” the blessed lord Hara vanished.

1.4.s:
ahaṃ tapasiniṣṭhaśca tataḥ prabhṛti cābhavam..
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate śivapūjanāt.. 12.48 ..
1.4.d:
अहं तपसिनिष्ठश्च ततः प्रभृति चाभवम्..
ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैर्मुच्यते शिवपूजनात्.. 12.48 ..
1.4.m: And from that time on, I became devoted to austerity. / One is freed from sins such as the killing of a brahmin through the worship of Śiva

1.4.s:
bradhnābjairitarairvapi kamalairnātra saṃśayaḥ..
evaṃ kuru mahārāja tvamapyāpsyasi vāṃchitam.. 12.49 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रध्नाब्जैरितरैर्वपि कमलैर्नात्र संशयः..
एवं कुरु महाराज त्वमप्याप्स्यसि वांछितम्.. 12.49 ..
1.4.m: with sun-lotuses or other lotuses; there is no doubt in this matter. / Act in this way, O great king, and you too will attain what is desired.

1.4.s:
harabhaktasya lokasya trilokyāṃ nāsti durlabham..
bahiḥpravṛttiṃ sagṛhya jñānakarmendriyādi ca.. 12.50 ..
1.4.d:
हरभक्तस्य लोकस्य त्रिलोक्यां नास्ति दुर्लभम्..
बहिःप्रवृत्तिं सगृह्य ज्ञानकर्मेन्द्रियादि च.. 12.50 ..
1.4.m: For a person devoted to Hara, nothing is difficult to attain in the three worlds. / Having gathered inward the external activity—both the senses of knowledge and action and the rest—

1.4.s:
layaḥ sadāśive nityamataryo go'yamucyate..
duṣkaratvādvahiryogaṃ śiva eva svayaṃ jagau.. 12.51 ..
1.4.d:
लयः सदाशिवे नित्यमतर्यो गोऽयमुच्यते..
दुष्करत्वाद्वहिर्योगं शिव एव स्वयं जगौ.. 12.51 ..
1.4.m: the absorption continually in Sadāśiva is said to be the yoga of the senses. / Because of its difficulty, Śiva himself personally proclaimed the external yoga.

1.4.s:
paṃcabhiścārcanaṃ bhūtairviśiṣṭaphaladaṃ dhruvam..
kleśakarmavipākādyairāśayaiścāpya saṃyutam.. 12.52 ..
1.4.d:
पंचभिश्चार्चनं भूतैर्विशिष्टफलदं ध्रुवम्..
क्लेशकर्मविपाकाद्यैराशयैश्चाप्य संयुतम्.. 12.52 ..
1.4.m: And worship with the five elements surely bestows a distinguished fruit. / Not affected by afflictions, karmic fruition, and latencies,

1.4.s:
īśānamārādhya japanpraṇavaṃ muktipāpnuyāt..
sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā.. 12.53 ..
1.4.d:
ईशानमाराध्य जपन्प्रणवं मुक्तिपाप्नुयात्..
सर्वपापक्षये जाते शिवे भवति भावना.. 12.53 ..
1.4.m: one who worships Īśāna and chants the praṇava attains liberation. / When the destruction of all sin has occurred, contemplation arises upon Śiva.

1.4.s:
pāpopahatabuddhīnāṃ śive vārtāpi durlabhā..
durlabhaṃ bhārate janma durlabhaṃ śivapūjanam.. 12.54 ..
1.4.d:
पापोपहतबुद्धीनां शिवे वार्तापि दुर्लभा..
दुर्लभं भारते जन्म दुर्लभं शिवपूजनम्.. 12.54 ..
1.4.m: For those whose intellect is struck by sin, even talk of Śiva is difficult to attain. / Difficult to attain is birth in Bhārata; difficult to attain is the worship of Śiva;

1.4.s:
durlabhaṃ jāhnavīsnānaṃ śive bhaktiḥ sudurlabhā..
durlabhaṃ brāhmaṇe dānaṃ durlabhaṃ vahnipūjanam.. 12.55 ..
1.4.d:
दुर्लभं जाह्नवीस्नानं शिवे भक्तिः सुदुर्लभा..
दुर्लभं ब्राह्मणे दानं दुर्लभं वह्निपूजनम्.. 12.55 ..
1.4.m: difficult to attain is ritual ablution in the Jāhnavī; devotion to Śiva is very difficult to attain; / difficult to attain is giving gifts to a brahmin; difficult to attain is the worship of fire;

1.4.s: alpapuṇyaiśca duṣprāpaṃ puruṣottamapūjanam.. 12.56 ..
1.4.d: अल्पपुण्यैश्च दुष्प्रापं पुरुषोत्तमपूजनम्.. 12.56 ..
1.4.m: and by those of little merit, worship of Puruṣottama is hard to achieve.

1.4.s:
lakṣeṇa dhanuṣāṃ yogastadardhena hutāśanaḥ..
pātraṃ śatasahasreṇa revā rudraśca ṣaṣṭibhiḥ.. 12.57 ..
1.4.d:
लक्षेण धनुषां योगस्तदर्धेन हुताशनः..
पात्रं शतसहस्रेण रेवा रुद्रश्च षष्टिभिः.. 12.57 ..
1.4.m: Yoga is attained by a hundred thousand bow-lengths; Agni by half of that; / the worthy recipient by a hundred thousand; Revā and Rudra by sixty [thousand].

1.4.s:
iti damuktamakhilaṃ mayā tava mahīpate..
yathāyurabhavaddīrghaṃ samārādhya maheśvaram.. 12.58 ..
1.4.d:
इति दमुक्तमखिलं मया तव महीपते..
यथायुरभवद्दीर्घं समाराध्य महेश्वरम्.. 12.58 ..
1.4.m: Thus has this all been declared by me to you, O king, / how my lifespan became long through worshipping Maheśvara.

1.4.s:
na durlabhaṃ na duṣprāpaṃ na cāsādhyaṃ mahātmanām..
śivabhaktikṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ trilokyāmiti niścitam.. 12.59 ..
1.4.d:
न दुर्लभं न दुष्प्रापं न चासाध्यं महात्मनाम्..
शिवभक्तिकृतां पुंसां त्रिलोक्यामिति निश्चितम्.. 12.59 ..
1.4.m: Nothing is difficult to attain, nothing is hard to achieve, and nothing is impossible / for high-souled men who practice devotion to Śiva in the three worlds: this is certain.

1.4.s:
naṃdīśvarasya tenaiva vapuṣā śivapūjanāt..
siddhimālokya ko rājañchaṃkaraṃ na namasyati.. 12.60 ..
1.4.d:
नंदीश्वरस्य तेनैव वपुषा शिवपूजनात्..
सिद्धिमालोक्य को राजञ्छंकरं न नमस्यति.. 12.60 ..
1.4.m: Beholding the perfection of Nandīśvara in that very body through the worship of Śiva, / what man, O king, would not bow down to Śaṃkara?

1.4.s:
śvetasya ca mahīpasya śrīkaṃṭhaṃ ca namasyataḥ..
kālopi pralayaṃ yātaḥ kastamīśaṃ na pūjayet.. 12.61 ..
1.4.d:
श्वेतस्य च महीपस्य श्रीकंठं च नमस्यतः..
कालोपि प्रलयं यातः कस्तमीशं न पूजयेत्.. 12.61 ..
1.4.m: And when the king Śveta was bowing down to Śrīkaṇṭha, / even Time met with destruction; who would not worship that Lord?

1.4.s:
yadicchayā viśvamidaṃ jāyate vyavatiṣṭhate..
tathā saṃlīyate cāṃte kastaṃ na śaraṇaṃ vrajet.. 12.62 ..
1.4.d:
यदिच्छया विश्वमिदं जायते व्यवतिष्ठते..
तथा संलीयते चांते कस्तं न शरणं व्रजेत्.. 12.62 ..
1.4.m: By whose will this universe is born, maintained, / and dissolved at the end—who would not take refuge in him?

1.4.s:
etadrahasyamidameva nṛṇāṃ pradhānaṃ kartavyamatra śivapūjanameva bhūpa..
yasyāṃtarāyapadavīmupayāṃti lokāḥ sadyoḥ naraḥ śivanataḥ śivameva satyam.. 12.63 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve lomaśavṛttānte śivapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 12 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
एतद्रहस्यमिदमेव नृणां प्रधानं कर्तव्यमत्र शिवपूजनमेव भूप..
यस्यांतरायपदवीमुपयांति लोकाः सद्योः नरः शिवनतः शिवमेव सत्यम्.. 12.63 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे महीप्रादुर्भावे लोमशवृत्तान्ते शिवपूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः.. 12 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
This is the secret; this alone is the foremost duty for men here: the worship of Śiva alone, O king. / If people pass through the path of obstacles, instantly the man who has bowed to Śiva becomes Śiva himself, in truth.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Worship of Śiva, in the Account of Lomaśa, in the Manifestation of the Earth”, in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first Section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
iti tasya munīṃdrasya bhūpatiḥ śuśruvānvacaḥ..
prāha nāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ vihāya naraṃ kvacit.. 13.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
इति तस्य मुनींद्रस्य भूपतिः शुश्रुवान्वचः..
प्राह नाहं गमिष्यामि त्वां विहाय नरं क्वचित्.. 13.1 ..
1.4.m:
Nārada said:
Having heard these words of that lord of sages, the king said: / “Leaving you, I will not go anywhere as a [mere mortal] man.

1.4.s:
liṃgamārādhayiṣye'dya sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām..
tvayaivānugṛhīto'dya yāṃtu sarve yathāgatam.. 13.2 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगमाराधयिष्येऽद्य सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम्..
त्वयैवानुगृहीतोऽद्य यांतु सर्वे यथागतम्.. 13.2 ..
1.4.m: Today I will worship the liṅga that bestows all perfections upon men. / Blessed today by you alone, let all return whence they came.”

1.4.s:
tadbhūpativacaḥ śrutvā bako gṛdhro'tha kacchapaḥ..
ulūkaśca tathaivocuḥ praṇatā lomaśaṃ munim.. 13.3 ..
1.4.d:
तद्भूपतिवचः श्रुत्वा बको गृध्रोऽथ कच्छपः..
उलूकश्च तथैवोचुः प्रणता लोमशं मुनिम्.. 13.3 ..
1.4.m: Hearing those words of the king, the crane, the vulture, the tortoise, / and the owl likewise spoke, bowing down to the sage Lomaśa.

1.4.s:
sa ca sarvasuhṛdviprastathetyevāha tāṃstadā..
praṇodyānpraṇatānsarvānanujagrāha śiṣyavat.. 13.4 ..
1.4.d:
स च सर्वसुहृद्विप्रस्तथेत्येवाह तांस्तदा..
प्रणोद्यान्प्रणतान्सर्वाननुजग्राह शिष्यवत्.. 13.4 ..
1.4.m: And that brahmin, a friend to all, then said to them, “So be it”; / bowing down, he favored all who bowed like disciples.

1.4.s:
śivadīkṣāvidhānena liṃgapūjāṃ samādiśat..
teṣāmanugrahaparo muniḥ pramatavatsalaḥ..
tīrthādapyadhikaṃ sthāne satāṃ sādhusamāgamaḥ.. 13.5 ..
1.4.d:
शिवदीक्षाविधानेन लिंगपूजां समादिशत्..
तेषामनुग्रहपरो मुनिः प्रमतवत्सलः..
तीर्थादप्यधिकं स्थाने सतां साधुसमागमः.. 13.5 ..
1.4.m: According to the rules of initiation into Śiva's rites, he instructed them in the worship of the liṅga. / Devoted to bestowing grace upon them, the sage was fond of the zealous. / Association with the virtuous is greater even than a sacred ford;

1.4.s:
pacelimaphalaḥ sadyo duraṃtakalupāpahaḥ..
apūrvaḥ ko'pi sadgoṣṭhīsahasrakiraṇodayaḥ.. 13.6 ..
1.4.d:
पचेलिमफलः सद्यो दुरंतकलुपापहः..
अपूर्वः कोऽपि सद्गोष्ठीसहस्रकिरणोदयः.. 13.6 ..
1.4.m: it bears ripe fruit immediately and removes endless terrible sins; / the rising of the thousand-rayed sun of the company of the good is something extraordinary and matchless.

1.4.s:
ya ekāṃtatayātyaṃtamaṃtargatatamopahaḥ..
sādhugoṣṭhīsamudbhūtasukhāmṛtarasormayaḥ.. 13.7 ..
1.4.d:
य एकांततयात्यंतमंतर्गततमोपहः..
साधुगोष्ठीसमुद्भूतसुखामृतरसोर्मयः.. 13.7 ..
1.4.m: which completely dispels the darkness within through solitude. / The waves of the nectar of bliss arisen from an assembly of the virtuous,

1.4.s:
sarve varāḥ sudhākārāḥ śarkarāmadhuṣaḍrasāḥ..
tataste sādhusaṃsargaṃ saṃprāptāḥ śivaśāsanāt.. 13.8 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वे वराः सुधाकाराः शर्करामधुषड्रसाः..
ततस्ते साधुसंसर्गं संप्राप्ताः शिवशासनात्.. 13.8 ..
1.4.m: all the boons, shaped like nectar, [surpassing] sugar, honey, and the six flavors. / Then, having attained the company of the virtuous by Śiva's command,

1.4.s:
ārebhire kriyāyogaṃ mārkaṃḍanṛpapūrvakāḥ..
teṣāṃ tapasyatāmevaṃ samājagme kadācana..
tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgena lomaśālokanotsukaḥ.. 13.9 ..
1.4.d:
आरेभिरे क्रियायोगं मार्कंडनृपपूर्वकाः..
तेषां तपस्यतामेवं समाजग्मे कदाचन..
तीर्थयात्रानुषंगेन लोमशालोकनोत्सुकः.. 13.9 ..
1.4.m: the king Mārkaṇḍa and the others began the yoga of action. / As they were performing austerity in this manner, there came at one time [Nārada], / who, in connection with a pilgrimage to sacred fords, was eager to see Lomaśa.

1.4.s:
mukhyā puruṣayātrā hi tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgataḥ..
sadbhiḥ samāśrito bhūpa bhūmibhāgastathocyate.. 13.10 ..
1.4.d:
मुख्या पुरुषयात्रा हि तीर्थयात्रानुषंगतः..
सद्भिः समाश्रितो भूप भूमिभागस्तथोच्यते.. 13.10 ..
1.4.m: "Indeed, the primary pilgrimage is the pilgrimage to virtuous men, through connection with which comes the pilgrimage to sacred fords; / O king, that portion of the earth frequented by the good is spoken of in that way."

1.4.s:
kṛtārhaṇātithyavidhiṃ viśrāṃtaṃ māṃ ca phālguna..
praṇamya te'tha papracchurnāḍījaṃghapuraḥ sarāḥ.. 13.11 ..
1.4.d:
कृतार्हणातिथ्यविधिं विश्रांतं मां च फाल्गुन..
प्रणम्य तेऽथ पप्रच्छुर्नाडीजंघपुरः सराः.. 13.11 ..
1.4.m: When I had been offered hospitality and rites of welcome, and was rested, O Phālguna, / having bowed, Nāḍījaṅgha and the others asked me:

1.4.s:
..ta ucuḥ..
śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ brahmaṃścatvāro'pi svakarmaṇā..
tanmuktisādhanārthāya sthānaṃ kiṃcitsamādiśa.. 13.12 ..
1.4.d:
..त उचुः..
शापभ्रष्टा वयं ब्रह्मंश्चत्वारोऽपि स्वकर्मणा..
तन्मुक्तिसाधनार्थाय स्थानं किंचित्समादिश.. 13.12 ..
1.4.m: They said: / "O brahmin, fallen through a curse on account of our own deeds, all four of us are ruined; / point out some place to achieve liberation from it.

1.4.s: iyaṃ hi niṣphalā bhūmiḥ śapalaṃ bhārataṃ mune.. 13.13 ..
1.4.d: इयं हि निष्फला भूमिः शपलं भारतं मुने.. 13.13 ..
1.4.m: For this land is barren; the Bharata region is cursed, O sage.

1.4.s:
tatrāpi kvacidekatra sarvatīrthaphalaṃ vada..
iti pṛṣṭastvahaṃ taiśca tānabravamidaṃ tadā.. 13.14 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रापि क्वचिदेकत्र सर्वतीर्थफलं वद..
इति पृष्टस्त्वहं तैश्च तानब्रवमिदं तदा.. 13.14 ..
1.4.m: Even there, tell us of one place that grants the fruit of all sacred fords." / When questioned thus by them, I then spoke this to them:

1.4.s:
saṃvartaṃ paripṛcchadhvaṃ sa vo vakṣyati tattvataḥ..
sarvatīrthaphalāvāptikārakaṃ bhūpradeśakam.. 13.15 ..
1.4.d:
संवर्तं परिपृच्छध्वं स वो वक्ष्यति तत्त्वतः..
सर्वतीर्थफलावाप्तिकारकं भूप्रदेशकम्.. 13.15 ..
1.4.m: "Inquire of Saṃvarta; he will tell you in truth / the region of the earth that brings about the fruit of all sacred fords."

1.4.s:
..ta ucuḥ..
kutrāsau vidyate yogī nājñāsiṣma vayaṃ ca tam..
saṃvartadarśanānmuktiriti cāsmadanugrahaḥ.. 13.16 ..
1.4.d:
..त उचुः..
कुत्रासौ विद्यते योगी नाज्ञासिष्म वयं च तम्..
संवर्तदर्शनान्मुक्तिरिति चास्मदनुग्रहः.. 13.16 ..
1.4.m: They said: / "Where is this yogin to be found? We do not know him. / 'Liberation comes from the darśana of Saṃvarta'—this is your grace to us.

1.4.s:
yadi jānāsi taṃ brūhi suhṛtsaṃgo na niṣphalaḥ..
tato'hamabravaṃ tāṃśca vicāryedaṃ punaḥpunaḥ.. 13.17 ..
1.4.d:
यदि जानासि तं ब्रूहि सुहृत्संगो न निष्फलः..
ततोऽहमब्रवं तांश्च विचार्येदं पुनःपुनः.. 13.17 ..
1.4.m: If you know, tell us of him; the company of a friend is never fruitless." / Thereupon, having considered this again and again, I spoke to them:

1.4.s:
vārāṇasyāmasāvāste saṃvarto guptaliṃgabhṛt..
maladigdho vivasano bhikṣāśī kutapādanu.. 13.18 ..
1.4.d:
वाराणस्यामसावास्ते संवर्तो गुप्तलिंगभृत्..
मलदिग्धो विवसनो भिक्षाशी कुतपादनु.. 13.18 ..
1.4.m: "This Saṃvarta resides in Vārāṇasī, bearing a concealed emblem, / smeared with dirt, unclothed, eating begged food in the afternoon,

1.4.s:
karapātrakṛtāhāraḥ sarvathā niṣparigrahaḥ..
bhāvayanbrahma paramaṃ praṇavābhidhamīśvaram.. 13.19 ..
1.4.d:
करपात्रकृताहारः सर्वथा निष्परिग्रहः..
भावयन्ब्रह्म परमं प्रणवाभिधमीश्वरम्.. 13.19 ..
1.4.m: eating with his hands as a begging bowl, completely without possessions, / meditating upon the supreme Brahman, the Lord named Praṇava.

1.4.s:
bhuktvā niryāti sāyāhne vanaṃ na jñāyate janaiḥ..
yogīśvaro'sau tadrūpāḥ santyanye liṃgadhāriṇaḥ.. 13.20 ..
1.4.d:
भुक्त्वा निर्याति सायाह्ने वनं न ज्ञायते जनैः..
योगीश्वरोऽसौ तद्रूपाः सन्त्यन्ये लिंगधारिणः.. 13.20 ..
1.4.m: Having eaten, he goes out to the forest at eventide and is not recognized by people. / He is a lord of yogins, [though] there are others bearing emblems of similar form.

1.4.s:
vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ tasya jñāsyatha taṃ munim..
pratolyā rājamārge tu niśi bhūmau śavaṃ janaiḥ.. 13.21 ..
1.4.d:
वक्ष्यामि लक्षणं तस्य ज्ञास्यथ तं मुनिम्..
प्रतोल्या राजमार्गे तु निशि भूमौ शवं जनैः.. 13.21 ..
1.4.m: I will tell you his distinguishing mark, [by which] you will recognize that sage: / at night, on the royal road at the city gate, a corpse

1.4.s:
avijñātaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ stheyaṃ tadavidūrataḥ..
yastāṃ bhūmimupāgamya akasmādvinirvatate.. 13.22 ..
1.4.d:
अविज्ञातं स्थापनीयं स्थेयं तदविदूरतः..
यस्तां भूमिमुपागम्य अकस्माद्विनिर्वतते.. 13.22 ..
1.4.m: unrecognized by people should be placed on the ground, and you should stand not far from it. / Whoever approaches that place and suddenly turns back,

1.4.s:
sa saṃvarto na cākrāmatyeṣa śalyamasaṃśayam..
praṣṭavyo'bhimataṃ cāsāvupāśritya vinītavat.. 13.23 ..
1.4.d:
स संवर्तो न चाक्रामत्येष शल्यमसंशयम्..
प्रष्टव्योऽभिमतं चासावुपाश्रित्य विनीतवत्.. 13.23 ..
1.4.m: he is Saṃvarta; he will undoubtedly not step over the impurity. / Approaching him humbly, he should be asked what is desired.

1.4.s:
yadi pṛcchati kenāhamākhyāta iti māṃ tataḥ..
nivedya caitadvaktavyaṃ tvāmākhyāyāgnimāviśat.. 13.24 ..
1.4.d:
यदि पृच्छति केनाहमाख्यात इति मां ततः..
निवेद्य चैतद्वक्तव्यं त्वामाख्यायाग्निमाविशत्.. 13.24 ..
1.4.m: If he asks, 'By whom was I revealed?', then, having announced [me], / this must be said: 'Having revealed you, he entered the fire.'"

1.4.s:
tacchrutvā te tathā cakruḥ sarvepi vacanaṃ mama..
prāpya vārāṇasīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃvartaṃ te tathā vyadhuḥ.. 13.25 ..
1.4.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा ते तथा चक्रुः सर्वेपि वचनं मम..
प्राप्य वाराणसीं दृष्ट्वा संवर्तं ते तथा व्यधुः.. 13.25 ..
1.4.m: Hearing that, all of them followed my word accordingly. / Having reached Vārāṇasī and seen Saṃvarta, they acted in that manner.

1.4.s:
śavaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tairnyastaṃ saṃvarto vai nyavartata..
kṣutparīto'pi taṃ jñātvā yayustamanu śīghragam.. 13.26 ..
1.4.d:
शवं दृष्ट्वा च तैर्न्यस्तं संवर्तो वै न्यवर्तत..
क्षुत्परीतोऽपि तं ज्ञात्वा ययुस्तमनु शीघ्रगम्.. 13.26 ..
1.4.m: And seeing the corpse placed by them, Saṃvarta indeed turned back. / Though overcome by hunger, knowing who he was, they followed him as he walked swiftly.

1.4.s:
tiṣṭha brahmankṣaṇamiti jalpaṃto rājamārgagam..
yāti nirbhartsayatyeṣa nivartadhvamiti bruvan.. 13.27 ..
1.4.d:
तिष्ठ ब्रह्मन्क्षणमिति जल्पंतो राजमार्गगम्..
याति निर्भर्त्सयत्येष निवर्तध्वमिति ब्रुवन्.. 13.27 ..
1.4.m: Saying, "Wait, O brahmin, for a moment!" to him walking on the royal road, / he went on, rebuking [them] and saying, "Turn back!

1.4.s:
samayā māmare bho'dya nāgaṃtavyaṃ na vo hitam..
palāyanamasau kṛtvā gatvā dūrataraṃ saraḥ..
kupitaḥ prāha tānsarvānkenākhyāto'hamityuta.. 13.28 ..
1.4.d:
समया मामरे भोऽद्य नागंतव्यं न वो हितम्..
पलायनमसौ कृत्वा गत्वा दूरतरं सरः..
कुपितः प्राह तान्सर्वान्केनाख्यातोऽहमित्युत.. 13.28 ..
1.4.m: Do not come near me today, hey! It is not good for you!" / Taking to flight, having gone to a very distant lake, / angry, he said to all of them: "By whom, indeed, was I revealed?

1.4.s:
nivedayata śīghraṃ me yathā bhasma karomi tam..
śāpāgninātha vā yuṣmānyadi satyaṃ na vakṣyatha.. 13.29 ..
1.4.d:
निवेदयत शीघ्रं मे यथा भस्म करोमि तम्..
शापाग्निनाथ वा युष्मान्यदि सत्यं न वक्ष्यथ.. 13.29 ..
1.4.m: Disclose it to me quickly so that I may reduce him to ashes / with the fire of my curse—or else [reduce] you, if you do not speak the truth!"

1.4.s:
atha prakaṃpitāḥ prāhurnāradeneti taṃ munim..
sa tānāha punaryātaḥ piśunaḥ kva nu saṃprati.. 13.30 ..
1.4.d:
अथ प्रकंपिताः प्राहुर्नारदेनेति तं मुनिम्..
स तानाह पुनर्यातः पिशुनः क्व नु संप्रति.. 13.30 ..
1.4.m: Then, trembling, they said to that sage, "By Nārada." / He spoke to them again: "Where has that slanderer gone now,

1.4.s:
lokānāṃ yena sāpāgnau bhasmaśeṣaṃ karomi tam..
brahmabaṃdhumahaṃ prāhurbhītāste taṃ punarmunim.. 13.31 ..
1.4.d:
लोकानां येन सापाग्नौ भस्मशेषं करोमि तम्..
ब्रह्मबंधुमहं प्राहुर्भीतास्ते तं पुनर्मुनिम्.. 13.31 ..
1.4.m: of all people, so that I may reduce that wretched brahmin to ashes in the fire of my curse?" / Frightened, they spoke again to that sage:

1.4.s:
..ta ūcuḥ..
tvaṃ nivedya sa cāsmākaṃ praviṣṭo havyavāhanam..
tatkālameva vipreṃdra na vidmastatra kāraṇam.. 13.32 ..
1.4.d:
..त ऊचुः..
त्वं निवेद्य स चास्माकं प्रविष्टो हव्यवाहनम्..
तत्कालमेव विप्रेंद्र न विद्मस्तत्र कारणम्.. 13.32 ..
1.4.m: They said: / "Having told us of you, he entered the fire / at that very moment, O best of brahmins; we do not know the reason for that."

1.4.s:
..saṃvarta uvāca..
ahamapyevamevāsya kartā tena svayaṃ kṛtam..
tadbrūta kāryaṃ naivātra ciraṃ sthāsyāmi vaḥ kṛte.. 13.33 ..
1.4.d:
..संवर्त उवाच..
अहमप्येवमेवास्य कर्ता तेन स्वयं कृतम्..
तद्ब्रूत कार्यं नैवात्र चिरं स्थास्यामि वः कृते.. 13.33 ..
1.4.m: Saṃvarta said: / "I too would have done the very same to him; he did it to himself. / Therefore, state your business; I will not remain here long for your sake."

1.4.s:
..arjuna uvāca..
yadi nārada devarṣe praviṣṭo'si hutāśanam..
jīvitastatkathaṃ bhūya āścaryamiti me vada.. 13.34 ..
1.4.d:
..अर्जुन उवाच..
यदि नारद देवर्षे प्रविष्टोऽसि हुताशनम्..
जीवितस्तत्कथं भूय आश्चर्यमिति मे वद.. 13.34 ..
1.4.m: Arjuna said: / "If you entered the fire, O divine sage Nārada, / how then are you alive again? Tell me this wonder!"

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
na hutāśaḥ samudro vā vāyurvā vṛkṣaparvataḥ..
āyudhaṃ vā na me śaktā dehapātāya bhārata.. 13.35 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
न हुताशः समुद्रो वा वायुर्वा वृक्षपर्वतः..
आयुधं वा न मे शक्ता देहपाताय भारत.. 13.35 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / "Neither fire, nor the ocean, nor wind, nor a tree, nor a mountain, / nor a weapon is capable of causing the fall of my body, O Bhārata.

1.4.s:
punaretatkṛtaṃ cāpi saṃvarto manyate yathā..
ahaṃ sanmānitaśceti vahniṃ prāpyāpyagāmaham.. 13.36 ..
1.4.d:
पुनरेतत्कृतं चापि संवर्तो मन्यते यथा..
अहं सन्मानितश्चेति वह्निं प्राप्याप्यगामहम्.. 13.36 ..
1.4.m: Moreover, this was done so that Saṃvarta would consider / that I had shown him respect; and having reached the fire, I departed.

1.4.s:
yathā puṣpagṛhe kaścitpraviśatyaṃga phālguna..
tathāhamagniṃ saṃviśya yātavānuttaraṃ śrṛṇu.. 13.37 ..
1.4.d:
यथा पुष्पगृहे कश्चित्प्रविशत्यंग फाल्गुन..
तथाहमग्निं संविश्य यातवानुत्तरं श्रृणु.. 13.37 ..
1.4.m: Just as someone enters an arbor of flowers, my dear Phālguna, / so did I enter the fire and go away; hear what followed.

1.4.s:
saṃvartastānpunaḥ prāha mārkaṃḍeyamukhāniti..
viśalyaḥ paṃthāḥ kṣudhito'haṃ punaḥ purīm..
bhikṣārthaṃ paryaṭiṣyāmi praśraṃ prabrūta caiva me.. 13.38 ..
1.4.d:
संवर्तस्तान्पुनः प्राह मार्कंडेयमुखानिति..
विशल्यः पंथाः क्षुधितोऽहं पुनः पुरीम्..
भिक्षार्थं पर्यटिष्यामि प्रश्रं प्रब्रूत चैव मे.. 13.38 ..
1.4.m: Saṃvarta spoke again to them, headed by Mārkaṇḍeya, saying: / 'The path is free of obstacles; I am hungry, and again to the city / I will wander for alms; tell me your question now!'

1.4.s:
..ta ūcuḥ..
śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpsyāmastavadanugrahāt..
pratīkāraṃ tadākhyāhi praṇatānāṃ mahāmune.. 13.39 ..
1.4.d:
..त ऊचुः..
शापभ्रष्टा वयं मोक्षं प्राप्स्यामस्तवदनुग्रहात्..
प्रतीकारं तदाख्याहि प्रणतानां महामुने.. 13.39 ..
1.4.m: They said: / "Fallen through a curse, we shall attain liberation through your grace. / Therefore, tell the remedy to those who bow before you, O great sage!

1.4.s:
yatra tīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ..
tattīrthaṃ brūhi saṃvarta tiṣṭhāmo yatra vai vayam.. 13.40 ..
1.4.d:
यत्र तीर्थे सर्वतीर्थफलं प्राप्नोति मानवः..
तत्तीर्थं ब्रूहि संवर्त तिष्ठामो यत्र वै वयम्.. 13.40 ..
1.4.m: At which sacred ford does a man obtain the fruit of all sacred fords? / Tell us of that sacred ford, O Saṃvarta, where we may dwell."

1.4.s:
..saṃvarta uvāca..
namaskṛtya kumārāya durgābhyaśca narottamāḥ..
tīrthaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi mahīsāgarasaṃgamam.. 13.41 ..
1.4.d:
..संवर्त उवाच..
नमस्कृत्य कुमाराय दुर्गाभ्यश्च नरोत्तमाः..
तीर्थं च संप्रवक्ष्यामि महीसागरसंगमम्.. 13.41 ..
1.4.m: Saṃvarta said: / "Having bowed to Kumāra and to the Durgās, O best of men, / I shall tell of the sacred ford: the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean.

1.4.s:
amunā rājasiṃhena iṃdradyumnena dhīmatā..
yajanāddvyaṃgulotsedhā kṛteyaṃ vasudhāyadā.. 13.42 ..
1.4.d:
अमुना राजसिंहेन इंद्रद्युम्नेन धीमता..
यजनाद्द्व्यंगुलोत्सेधा कृतेयं वसुधायदा.. 13.42 ..
1.4.m: When, by this lion among kings, the wise Indradyumna, / this earth was made two fingers high through sacrificial worship,

1.4.s:
tadā saṃtāpyamānāyā bhuvaḥ kāṣṭhasya vai yathā..
susrāva yo jalaughaśca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ.. 13.43 ..
1.4.d:
तदा संताप्यमानाया भुवः काष्ठस्य वै यथा..
सुस्राव यो जलौघश्च सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः.. 13.43 ..
1.4.m: then, from the scorched earth, just as from wood, / there flowed a flood of water, reverenced by all the gods,

1.4.s:
mahīnāma nadī ca pṛthivyāṃ yānikānicit..
tīrthāni teṣāṃ salilasaṃbhavaṃ tajjalaṃ viduḥ.. 13.44 ..
1.4.d:
महीनाम नदी च पृथिव्यां यानिकानिचित्..
तीर्थानि तेषां सलिलसंभवं तज्जलं विदुः.. 13.44 ..
1.4.m: a river named Mahī; and whatever sacred fords there are / on the earth, they know that water to be produced from their waters.

1.4.s:
mahīnāma samutpannā deśe mālavakābhidhe..
dakṣiṇaṃ sāgaraṃ prāptā puṇyobhayataṭāśivā.. 13.45 ..
1.4.d:
महीनाम समुत्पन्ना देशे मालवकाभिधे..
दक्षिणं सागरं प्राप्ता पुण्योभयतटाशिवा.. 13.45 ..
1.4.m: Arisen under the name Mahī in the land called Mālavaka, / reaching the southern ocean, both its banks are holy and auspicious.

1.4.s:
sarvatīrthamayī pūrvaṃ mahīnāma mahānadī..
kiṃ punaryaḥ samāyogastasyāśca saritāṃ pateḥ.. 13.46 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वतीर्थमयी पूर्वं महीनाम महानदी..
किं पुनर्यः समायोगस्तस्याश्च सरितां पतेः.. 13.46 ..
1.4.m: Originally containing all sacred fords was the great river named Mahī; / how much more then its confluence with the lord of rivers [the ocean]!

1.4.s: vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ gaṃgā revā sarasvatī.. 13.47 ..
1.4.d: वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं गंगा रेवा सरस्वती.. 13.47 ..
1.4.m: Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Gaṅgā, Revā, Sarasvatī,

1.4.s:
tāpī payoṣṇī nirvidhyā candrabhāgā irāvatī..
kāverī śarayūścaiva gaṃḍakī naimiṣaṃ tathā.. 13.48 ..
1.4.d:
तापी पयोष्णी निर्विध्या चन्द्रभागा इरावती..
कावेरी शरयूश्चैव गंडकी नैमिषं तथा.. 13.48 ..
1.4.m: Tāpī, Payoṣṇī, Nirvindhyā, Candrabhāgā, Irāvatī, / Kāverī, and Sarayū, Gaṇḍakī, and Naimiṣa as well,"

1.4.s:
gayā godāvarī caiva aruṇā varuṇā tathā..
etāḥ puṇyāḥ śataśonyā yāḥ kāścitsarito bhuvi.. 13.49 ..
1.4.d:
गया गोदावरी चैव अरुणा वरुणा तथा..
एताः पुण्याः शतशोन्या याः काश्चित्सरितो भुवि.. 13.49 ..
1.4.m: Gayā, Godāvarī, Aruṇā, and Varuṇā— / these holy ones, and whatever hundreds of other rivers there are on earth,

1.4.s:
sahasraviṃśatiścaiva ṣaṭ‌śatāni tathaiva ca..
tāsāṃ sārasamudbhutaṃ mahītoyaṃ prakīrtitam.. 13.50 ..
1.4.d:
सहस्रविंशतिश्चैव षट्‌शतानि तथैव च..
तासां सारसमुद्भुतं महीतोयं प्रकीर्तितम्.. 13.50 ..
1.4.m: twenty thousand and six hundred in all— / the water of the Mahī is proclaimed as having arisen from their essence.

1.4.s:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā yatphalamāpyate..
tanmahīsāgare proktaṃ kumārasya vaco yathā.. 13.51 ..
1.4.d:
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नात्वा यत्फलमाप्यते..
तन्महीसागरे प्रोक्तं कुमारस्य वचो यथा.. 13.51 ..
1.4.m: The fruit that is obtained by bathing at all sacred fords on earth / is declared to be [gained] at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, according to Kumāra's word.

1.4.s:
ekatra sarvatīrthānāṃ yadi saṃyogamicchatha..
tadgacchatha mahāpuṇyaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgamam.. 13.52 ..
1.4.d:
एकत्र सर्वतीर्थानां यदि संयोगमिच्छथ..
तद्गच्छथ महापुण्यं महीसागरसंगमम्.. 13.52 ..
1.4.m: If you desire the union of all sacred fords in one place, / then go to the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, which yields great merit.

1.4.s:
ahaṃ cāpi ca tatraiva bahūnvarṣagaṇānpurā..
avasaṃ cāgataścātra nāradasya bhayāttathā.. 13.53 ..
1.4.d:
अहं चापि च तत्रैव बहून्वर्षगणान्पुरा..
अवसं चागतश्चात्र नारदस्य भयात्तथा.. 13.53 ..
1.4.m: And I too dwelt right there for many groups of years in the past, / and I came here out of fear of Nārada.

1.4.s:
sa hi tatra samīpasthaḥ piśunaśca viśeṣataḥ..
maruttaḥ kurute yatnaṃ tasmai brūyādidaṃ bhayam.. 13.54 ..
1.4.d:
स हि तत्र समीपस्थः पिशुनश्च विशेषतः..
मरुत्तः कुरुते यत्नं तस्मै ब्रूयादिदं भयम्.. 13.54 ..
1.4.m: For he is nearby there and is especially a talebearer. / Marutta is making an effort; [Nārada] might speak to him, hence this fear.

1.4.s:
atra digvāsasāṃ madhye bahūnāṃ tatsamastvaham..
nivasāmyatipracchanno maruttādatibhītavat.. 13.55 ..
1.4.d:
अत्र दिग्वाससां मध्ये बहूनां तत्समस्त्वहम्..
निवसाम्यतिप्रच्छन्नो मरुत्तादतिभीतवत्.. 13.55 ..
1.4.m: Here, in the midst of many who are clad in the directions, like one of them, / I dwell deeply hidden, as if terrified of Marutta.

1.4.s:
punaratrāpi māṃ nūnaṃ kathayiṣyati nāradaḥ..
tathāvidhā hi ceṣṭāsya piśunasya pradṛśyate.. 13.56 ..
1.4.d:
पुनरत्रापि मां नूनं कथयिष्यति नारदः..
तथाविधा हि चेष्टास्य पिशुनस्य प्रदृश्यते.. 13.56 ..
1.4.m: Surely Nārada will report me even here again; / for such behavior is observed in that talebearer.

1.4.s:
bhavadbhiśca na cāpyatra vaktānāṃ kasyacitkvacit..
maruttaḥ kurute yatnaṃ bhūpālo yajñasiddhaye.. 13.57 ..
1.4.d:
भवद्भिश्च न चाप्यत्र वक्तानां कस्यचित्क्वचित्..
मरुत्तः कुरुते यत्नं भूपालो यज्ञसिद्धये.. 13.57 ..
1.4.m: And you must not speak of this to anyone anywhere. / King Marutta makes an effort for the accomplishment of his sacrifice.

1.4.s:
devācāryeṇa saṃtyakto bhrātrā me kāraṇāṃ tare..
guruputraṃ ca māṃ jñātvā yajñārtvijyasya kāraṇāt.. 13.58 ..
1.4.d:
देवाचार्येण संत्यक्तो भ्रात्रा मे कारणां तरे..
गुरुपुत्रं च मां ज्ञात्वा यज्ञार्त्विज्यस्य कारणात्.. 13.58 ..
1.4.m: Having been abandoned by my brother, the teacher of the gods, for another reason, / and knowing me to be the son of his guru, [he sought me] to serve as officiating priest at his sacrifice.

1.4.s:
avidyāṃtargatairyajñakarmabhirna prayojanam..
mama hiṃsātmakairasti nigamoktairacetanaiḥ.. 13.59 ..
1.4.d:
अविद्यांतर्गतैर्यज्ञकर्मभिर्न प्रयोजनम्..
मम हिंसात्मकैरस्ति निगमोक्तैरचेतनैः.. 13.59 ..
1.4.m: I have no need for sacrificial rites wrapped in ignorance, / nor for insentient ones enjoined by the Vedas, which are violent in nature.

1.4.s:
samitpuṣpakuśaprāyaiḥ sādhanairyadyacetanaiḥ..
kriyate tattathā bhāvi kāryaṃ kāraṇavannṛṇām.. 13.60 ..
1.4.d:
समित्पुष्पकुशप्रायैः साधनैर्यद्यचेतनैः..
क्रियते तत्तथा भावि कार्यं कारणवन्नृणाम्.. 13.60 ..
1.4.m: If it is performed with insentient means consisting mainly of kindling, flowers, and kuśa grass, / then the effect that comes to be for men will correspond to its cause.

1.4.s:
tadyūyaṃ tatra gacchadhvaṃ śīghrameva nṛpānugāḥ..
asti vipraḥ svayaṃ brahmā yājñavalkyaśca tatra vai.. 13.61 ..
1.4.d:
तद्यूयं तत्र गच्छध्वं शीघ्रमेव नृपानुगाः..
अस्ति विप्रः स्वयं ब्रह्मा याज्ञवल्क्यश्च तत्र वै.. 13.61 ..
1.4.m: Therefore go there at once, attendants of the king! / There is the brahmin Yājñavalkya, who is Brahmā himself.

1.4.s:
sa hi pūrvaṃ mitheḥ puryāṃ vasannāśramamuttamam..
āgacchamānaṃ nakulaṃ dṛṣṭvā gārgīṃ vaco'bravīt.. 13.62 ..
1.4.d:
स हि पूर्वं मिथेः पुर्यां वसन्नाश्रममुत्तमम्..
आगच्छमानं नकुलं दृष्ट्वा गार्गीं वचोऽब्रवीत्.. 13.62 ..
1.4.m: For formerly, while dwelling in an excellent hermitage in the city of Mithi, / seeing a mongoose approaching, he said this word to Gārgī:

1.4.s:
gārgi rakṣa payo bhadre nakulo'yamupeti ca..
payaḥ pātuṃ kṛtimatiṃ nakulaṃ taṃ nirākuru.. 13.63 ..
1.4.d:
गार्गि रक्ष पयो भद्रे नकुलोऽयमुपेति च..
पयः पातुं कृतिमतिं नकुलं तं निराकुरु.. 13.63 ..
1.4.m: “Gārgī, protect the milk, good lady, for here comes a mongoose! / Turn away that mongoose, whose mind is set on drinking the milk.”

1.4.s:
ityukto nakulaḥ kruddhaḥ sa hi kruddhaḥ purā'bhavat..
jamadagneḥ pūrvajaiśca śaptaḥ provāca taṃ munim.. 13.64 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्तो नकुलः क्रुद्धः स हि क्रुद्धः पुराऽभवत्..
जमदग्नेः पूर्वजैश्च शप्तः प्रोवाच तं मुनिम्.. 13.64 ..
1.4.m: Addressed thus, the mongoose became enraged, for he had been enraged long ago / and cursed by the ancestors of Jamadagni; he spoke to the sage:

1.4.s:
aho vā dhigdhigityeva bhūyo dhigiti caiva hi..
nirlajjatā manuṣyāṇāṃ dṛśyate pāpakāriṇām.. 13.65 ..
1.4.d:
अहो वा धिग्धिगित्येव भूयो धिगिति चैव हि..
निर्लज्जता मनुष्याणां दृश्यते पापकारिणाम्.. 13.65 ..
1.4.m: “Ah, fie, fie, and fie yet again! / Indeed, the shamelessness of sinful humans is seen!

1.4.s:
kathaṃ te nāma pāpāni prakurvaṃti narādhamāḥ..
maraṇāṃtaritā yeṣāṃ narake tīvravedanā.. 13.66 ..
1.4.d:
कथं ते नाम पापानि प्रकुर्वंति नराधमाः..
मरणांतरिता येषां नरके तीव्रवेदना.. 13.66 ..
1.4.m: How indeed do those lowest of men commit sins, / for whom intense torment in hell is separated only by death?

1.4.s:
nimeṣo'pi na śakyeta jīvite yasya niścitam..
tanmātraparamāyuryaḥ pāpaṃ kuryātkathaṃ sa ca.. 13.67 ..
1.4.d:
निमेषोऽपि न शक्येत जीविते यस्य निश्चितम्..
तन्मात्रपरमायुर्यः पापं कुर्यात्कथं स च.. 13.67 ..
1.4.m: A person whose life cannot be guaranteed for even the blink of an eye, / whose maximum lifespan is only that long—how could he commit sin?

1.4.s:
tvaṃ mune manyase cedaṃ kulīno'smīti buddhimān..
tataḥ kṣipasi māṃ mūḍha nakulo'yamiti smayan.. 13.68 ..
1.4.d:
त्वं मुने मन्यसे चेदं कुलीनोऽस्मीति बुद्धिमान्..
ततः क्षिपसि मां मूढ नकुलोऽयमिति स्मयन्.. 13.68 ..
1.4.m: Sage, you think this: ‘I am of noble birth and wise’; / therefore you insult me, smiling: ‘This is a mongoose!’—you fool!

1.4.s:
kimadhītaṃ yājñavalkya kā yogeśvaratā tava..
niraparādhaṃ kṣipasi dhigadhītaṃ hi tattava.. 13.69 ..
1.4.d:
किमधीतं याज्ञवल्क्य का योगेश्वरता तव..
निरपराधं क्षिपसि धिगधीतं हि तत्तव.. 13.69 ..
1.4.m: What have you studied, Yājñavalkya? What is your mastery of yoga? / You insult one who is blameless; fie upon that learning of yours!

1.4.s:
kasminvedaṃ smṛtau kasyāṃ proktametadbravīhi me..
paruṣairiti vākyairmāṃ nakuleti bravīṣi yat.. 13.70 ..
1.4.d:
कस्मिन्वेदं स्मृतौ कस्यां प्रोक्तमेतद्ब्रवीहि मे..
परुषैरिति वाक्यैर्मां नकुलेति ब्रवीषि यत्.. 13.70 ..
1.4.m: Tell me, in which Veda, in which traditional law is this taught, / that you address me with harsh words, calling me ‘mongoose’?

1.4.s:
kimidaṃ naiva jānāsi yāvatyaḥ paruṣā giraḥ..
paraḥ saṃśrāvyate tāvacchaṃkavaḥ śrotrataḥ punarā.. 13.71 ..
1.4.d:
किमिदं नैव जानासि यावत्यः परुषा गिरः..
परः संश्राव्यते तावच्छंकवः श्रोत्रतः पुनरा.. 13.71 ..
1.4.m: Do you not know this: as many harsh words / as are made to be heard by another, so many spikes [are driven] through the ears?

1.4.s:
kaṃṭhe yamānugāḥ pādaṃ kṛtvā tasya sudurmateḥ..
atīva rudato lohaśaṃkūnkṣepsyaṃti karṇayoḥ.. 13.72 ..
1.4.d:
कंठे यमानुगाः पादं कृत्वा तस्य सुदुर्मतेः..
अतीव रुदतो लोहशंकून्क्षेप्स्यंति कर्णयोः.. 13.72 ..
1.4.m: The followers of Yama, placing a foot upon the throat of that evil-minded one / while he weeps aloud, will thrust iron spikes into his ears.

1.4.s:
vāvadūkāśca dhvajino muṣṇaṃti kṛpaṇāñjanān..
svayaṃ hastasahasreṇa dharmasyaivaṃ bhavadvidhāḥ.. 13.73 ..
1.4.d:
वावदूकाश्च ध्वजिनो मुष्णंति कृपणाञ्जनान्..
स्वयं हस्तसहस्रेण धर्मस्यैवं भवद्विधाः.. 13.73 ..
1.4.m: Garrulous hypocrites rob pitiable people; / people like you rob dharma itself with a thousand hands.

1.4.s:
vajrasya digdhaśastrasya kālakūṭasya cāpyuta..
samena vacasā tulyaṃ mṛtyoriti mamābhavat.. 13.74 ..
1.4.d:
वज्रस्य दिग्धशस्त्रस्य कालकूटस्य चाप्युत..
समेन वचसा तुल्यं मृत्योरिति ममाभवत्.. 13.74 ..
1.4.m: A word has become to me equal to a thunderbolt, / a poisoned weapon, kālakūṭa poison, and death itself.

1.4.s:
karṇanāsikanārācānnirharaṃti śarīrataḥ..
vākchalyastu na nirhartuṃ śakyo hṛdiśayo hi saḥ.. 13.75 ..
1.4.d:
कर्णनासिकनाराचान्निर्हरंति शरीरतः..
वाक्छल्यस्तु न निर्हर्तुं शक्यो हृदिशयो हि सः.. 13.75 ..
1.4.m: They extract iron arrows from the ear, nose, and body; / but the dart of speech cannot be extracted, for it lies within the heart.

1.4.s:
yaṃtrapīḍaiḥ samākramya varameṣa hato naraḥ..
na tu taṃ paruṣairvākyairjighāṃseta kathaṃcana.. 13.76 ..
1.4.d:
यंत्रपीडैः समाक्रम्य वरमेष हतो नरः..
न तु तं परुषैर्वाक्यैर्जिघांसेत कथंचन.. 13.76 ..
1.4.m: It is better that this man be killed, crushed in pressing-machines, / but one should never seek to harm him with harsh words.

1.4.s:
tvayā tvahaṃ yājñavalkya nityaṃ paṃḍitamāninā..
nakulosīti tīvreṇa vacasā tāḍitaḥ kutaḥ.. 13.77 ..
1.4.d:
त्वया त्वहं याज्ञवल्क्य नित्यं पंडितमानिना..
नकुलोसीति तीव्रेण वचसा ताडितः कुतः.. 13.77 ..
1.4.m: Yet why have I, Yājñavalkya, been struck by you, / who always fancy yourself a scholar, with the harsh word: ‘You are a mongoose’?”

1.4.s:
..saṃvarta uvāca..
iti śrutvā vacastasya bhṛśaṃ vismitamānasaḥ..
yājñavalkyo'bravīdetatprabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ.. 13.78 ..
1.4.d:
..संवर्त उवाच..
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य भृशं विस्मितमानसः..
याज्ञवल्क्योऽब्रवीदेतत्प्रबद्धकरसंपुटः.. 13.78 ..
1.4.m: Saṃvarta said: / Hearing his words, his mind greatly astonished, / Yājñavalkya spoke this with his hands joined in reverence:

1.4.s:
namo'dharmāya mahate na vidmo yasya vai bhavam..
paramāṇumapi vyaktaṃ kotra vidyāmadaḥ satām.. 13.79 ..
1.4.d:
नमोऽधर्माय महते न विद्मो यस्य वै भवम्..
परमाणुमपि व्यक्तं कोत्र विद्यामदः सताम्.. 13.79 ..
1.4.m: “Homage to great adharma, whose origin we do not know, / clearly even down to an atom! What pride of learning can good men have here?

1.4.s:
viraṃciviṣṇuprasamukhāḥ someṃdrapramukhāstathā..
sarvajñāste'pi muhyati gaṇanāsmādṛśaṃ ca kā.. 13.80 ..
1.4.d:
विरंचिविष्णुप्रसमुखाः सोमेंद्रप्रमुखास्तथा..
सर्वज्ञास्तेऽपि मुह्यति गणनास्मादृशं च का.. 13.80 ..
1.4.m: Virañci, Viṣṇu, Soma, Indra, and the rest— / even those omniscient ones are bewildered; what reckoning can there be of someone like me?

1.4.s:
dharmajño'smīti yo mohādātmānaṃ pratipadyate..
sa vāyuṃ muṣṭinā baddhumīhate kṛpaṇo naraḥ.. 13.81 ..
1.4.d:
धर्मज्ञोऽस्मीति यो मोहादात्मानं प्रतिपद्यते..
स वायुं मुष्टिना बद्धुमीहते कृपणो नरः.. 13.81 ..
1.4.m: The wretched man who out of delusion considers himself to be a knower of dharma / seeks to catch the wind with his fist.

1.4.s:
kecidajñānato naṣṭāḥ kecijjñānamadādapi..
jñānaṃ prāpyāpi naṣṭāśca kecidālasyato'dhamāḥ.. 13.82 ..
1.4.d:
केचिदज्ञानतो नष्टाः केचिज्ज्ञानमदादपि..
ज्ञानं प्राप्यापि नष्टाश्च केचिदालस्यतोऽधमाः.. 13.82 ..
1.4.m: Some are ruined by ignorance, others even by pride of knowledge; / and some base men, even having attained knowledge, are ruined by indolence.

1.4.s:
vedasmṛtītihāseṣu purāṇeṣu prakalpitam..
catuḥpādaṃ tathā dharmaṃ nācaratyadhamaḥ paśuḥ.. 13.83 ..
1.4.d:
वेदस्मृतीतिहासेषु पुराणेषु प्रकल्पितम्..
चतुःपादं तथा धर्मं नाचरत्यधमः पशुः.. 13.83 ..
1.4.m: The base brute does not practice the four-footed dharma / ordained in the Vedas, the smṛtis, the itihāsas, and the Purāṇas.

1.4.s:
sa purā śocate vyaktaṃ prāpya taccāṃtakaṃ gṛham..
tathāhi gṛhyakāreṇa śrutau proktamidaṃ vacaḥ.. 13.84 ..
1.4.d:
स पुरा शोचते व्यक्तं प्राप्य तच्चांतकं गृहम्..
तथाहि गृह्यकारेण श्रुतौ प्रोक्तमिदं वचः.. 13.84 ..
1.4.m: Clearly he grieves later upon reaching that house of Death. / For indeed this utterance in the Vedic text is stated by the author of the domestic rites:

1.4.s:
nakulaṃ sakulaṃ brūyānna kaṃcinmarmaṇi spṛśet..
prapaṭhannapi caivāhamidaṃ sarvaṃ tathā śukaḥ.. 13.85 ..
1.4.d:
नकुलं सकुलं ब्रूयान्न कंचिन्मर्मणि स्पृशेत्..
प्रपठन्नपि चैवाहमिदं सर्वं तथा शुकः.. 13.85 ..
1.4.m: ‘One should address a mongoose (nakula) as belonging to a family (sakula); one should not strike anyone at a vulnerable spot.’ / Even though I recite all this just like a parrot,

1.4.s: ālasyenāpyanācārādvṛthākāryekamaṃga tat.. 13.86 ..
1.4.d: आलस्येनाप्यनाचाराद्वृथाकार्येकमंग तत्.. 13.86 ..
1.4.m: out of indolence and non-observance, my friend, that solitary deed became vain.

1.4.s:
kevalaṃ pāṭha mātreṇa yaśca saṃtuṣyate naraḥ..
tathā paṃḍitamānī ca konyastasmātpaśurmataḥ.. 13.87 ..
1.4.d:
केवलं पाठ मात्रेण यश्च संतुष्यते नरः..
तथा पंडितमानी च कोन्यस्तस्मात्पशुर्मतः.. 13.87 ..
1.4.m: And the man who is satisfied merely with reciting, / and who fancies himself a scholar—what else is he considered but a beast?

1.4.s:
na cchaṃdāṃsi vṛjināttārayaṃti māyāvinaṃ māyayā''vartamānam..
nīḍaṃ śakuṃtā iva jātapakṣāśchaṃdāsyenaṃ prajahatyaṃtakāle.. 13.88 ..
1.4.d:
न च्छंदांसि वृजिनात्तारयंति मायाविनं मायया'ऽवर्तमानम्..
नीडं शकुंता इव जातपक्षाश्छंदास्येनं प्रजहत्यंतकाले.. 13.88 ..
1.4.m: The sacred meters do not deliver from sin a deceitful person acting with deceit; / just as fledglings that have grown wings abandon the nest, the meters abandon him at the time of death.

1.4.s:
svārgāya baddhakakṣo yaḥ pāṭhamātreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ..
sa bālo māturaṃkastho grahītuṃ somamicchati.. 13.89 ..
1.4.d:
स्वार्गाय बद्धकक्षो यः पाठमात्रेण ब्राह्मणः..
स बालो मातुरंकस्थो ग्रहीतुं सोममिच्छति.. 13.89 ..
1.4.m: A brahmin who girds his loins for heaven merely by recitation / is a child sitting in his mother’s lap wishing to grasp the moon.

1.4.s:
tadbhavānsarvathā mahyamanayaṃ soḍhumarhasi..
sarvaḥ ko'pi vadatyevaṃ tanmayaivamudāhṛtam.. 13.90 ..
1.4.d:
तद्भवान्सर्वथा मह्यमनयं सोढुमर्हसि..
सर्वः कोऽपि वदत्येवं तन्मयैवमुदाहृतम्.. 13.90 ..
1.4.m: Therefore you should by all means forgive my impropriety; / everyone speaks in this way, and so it was uttered by me.”

1.4.s:
..nakula uvāca..
vṛthedaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tubhyaṃ sarvalokena yatsamam..
ātmānaṃ manyase naitadvaktuṃ yogyaṃ mahātmanām.. 13.91 ..
1.4.d:
..नकुल उवाच..
वृथेदं भाषितं तुभ्यं सर्वलोकेन यत्समम्..
आत्मानं मन्यसे नैतद्वक्तुं योग्यं महात्मनाम्.. 13.91 ..
1.4.m: The mongoose said: / “In vain have you spoken this, in that you consider yourself equal / to ordinary people; it is not fitting for great souls to say this.

1.4.s:
vājivāraṇalohānāṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇavāsasām..
nārīpuruṣatoyānāmaṃtaraṃ mahadaṃtaram.. 13.92 ..
1.4.d:
वाजिवारणलोहानां काष्ठपाषाणवाससाम्..
नारीपुरुषतोयानामंतरं महदंतरम्.. 13.92 ..
1.4.m: Between horses, elephants, and irons, / between pieces of wood, stones, and garments, / and between women, men, and waters, there is a vast difference.”

1.4.s:
anye cetprākṛtā lokā bahupāpāni kurvate..
pradhānapuruṣeṇāpi kāryaṃ tatpṛṣṭhatonu kim.. 13.93 ..
1.4.d:
अन्ये चेत्प्राकृता लोका बहुपापानि कुर्वते..
प्रधानपुरुषेणापि कार्यं तत्पृष्ठतोनु किम्.. 13.93 ..
1.4.m: If other, ordinary people commit many sins, / what, should an eminent man also do the same following behind them?

1.4.s:
sarvārthaṃ nirmitaṃ śāstraṃ manobuddhī tathaiva ca..
datte vidhātrā sarveṣāṃ tathāpi yadi pāpinaḥ.. 13.94 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वार्थं निर्मितं शास्त्रं मनोबुद्धी तथैव च..
दत्ते विधात्रा सर्वेषां तथापि यदि पापिनः.. 13.94 ..
1.4.m: Scripture was fashioned for the welfare of all, and likewise mind and intellect / were granted to everyone by the Creator; yet if they still become sinners,

1.4.s:
tato vidhātuḥ ko doṣasta eva khalu durbhagāḥ..
brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa kiṃ bhāvyaṃ lokavadyataḥ.. 13.95 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विधातुः को दोषस्त एव खलु दुर्भगाः..
ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण किं भाव्यं लोकवद्यतः.. 13.95 ..
1.4.m: then what fault is it of the Creator? They alone are indeed ill-fated! / Why, in particular, should a brahmin behave like common folk?

1.4.s:
yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ..
sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate.. 13.96 ..
1.4.d:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः..
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते.. 13.96 ..
1.4.m: Whatever the superior man practices, that very thing other people do; / whatever standard he sets, the world conforms to it.

1.4.s:
tasmātsadā mahadbhiśca ātmārthaṃ ca parārthataḥ..
satāṃ dharmo na saṃtyājyo nyāyyaṃ tacchikṣaṇaṃ tava.. 13.97 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मात्सदा महद्भिश्च आत्मार्थं च परार्थतः..
सतां धर्मो न संत्याज्यो न्याय्यं तच्छिक्षणं तव.. 13.97 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, for one's own sake and for the sake of others, the duty of the virtuous / must never be abandoned by great men; it was right that you were instructed in that.

1.4.s:
yasmāttvayā pīḍito'haṃ ghoreṇa vacasā mune..
tasmācchīghraṃ tvāṃ śapsyāmi śāpayogyo hi me mataḥ.. 13.98 ..
1.4.d:
यस्मात्त्वया पीडितोऽहं घोरेण वचसा मुने..
तस्माच्छीघ्रं त्वां शप्स्यामि शापयोग्यो हि मे मतः.. 13.98 ..
1.4.m: Because I was tormented by you with harsh words, O sage, / therefore I shall quickly curse you, for I deem you fit to be cursed.

1.4.s:
nakulo'sīti māmāha bhavāṃstasmātkulādhamaḥ..
śīghramutpatsyase mohāttvameva nakulo mune.. 13.99 ..
1.4.d:
नकुलोऽसीति मामाह भवांस्तस्मात्कुलाधमः..
शीघ्रमुत्पत्स्यसे मोहात्त्वमेव नकुलो मुने.. 13.99 ..
1.4.m: You told me: 'You are a mongoose [nakula]'; therefore, lowest of your family [nakula], / you yourself, O sage, out of delusion will soon be born as a mongoose!"

1.4.s:
..saṃvarta uvāca..
iti vācaṃ samākarṇya bhāvyarthakṛtaniścayaḥ..
yājñavalkyo marau deśe viprasyājāyatātmajaḥ.. 13.100 ..
1.4.d:
..संवर्त उवाच..
इति वाचं समाकर्ण्य भाव्यर्थकृतनिश्चयः..
याज्ञवल्क्यो मरौ देशे विप्रस्याजायतात्मजः.. 13.100 ..
1.4.m: Saṃvarta said: / Having heard this speech, resigned to what was destined to happen, / Yājñavalkya was born in the Maru country as the son of a vipra.

1.4.s:
durācārasya pāpasya nighṛṇasyātivādinaḥ..
duṣkulīnasya jāto'sau tadā jātismaraḥ sutaḥ.. 13.101 ..
1.4.d:
दुराचारस्य पापस्य निघृणस्यातिवादिनः..
दुष्कुलीनस्य जातोऽसौ तदा जातिस्मरः सुतः.. 13.101 ..
1.4.m: Born to an ill-behaved, sinful, pitiless, argumentative man / of low family, he was then a son who remembered his past lives.

1.4.s:
so'tha jñānātsamālokya bhartṛyajña iti dvijaḥ..
guptakṣetraṃ samāpanno mahīsāgarasaṃgamam.. 13.102 ..
1.4.d:
सोऽथ ज्ञानात्समालोक्य भर्तृयज्ञ इति द्विजः..
गुप्तक्षेत्रं समापन्नो महीसागरसंगमम्.. 13.102 ..
1.4.m: Then, beholding through spiritual knowledge, that twice-born named Bhartṛyajña / went to the secret sacred field, the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean.

1.4.s:
tatra pāśupato bhūtvā śivārādhanatatparaḥ..
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ mahākālaṃ pūjayanvartate'dhunā.. 13.103 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र पाशुपतो भूत्वा शिवाराधनतत्परः..
स्वायंभुवं महाकालं पूजयन्वर्ततेऽधुना.. 13.103 ..
1.4.m: Becoming a Pāśupata there and intent on the worship of Śiva, / he now resides there worshiping the self-manifest Mahākāla.

1.4.s:
yo hi nityaṃ mahākālaṃ śraddhayā pūjayetpumān..
sa dauṣkulīnadoṣebhyo mucyate'hiriva tvacaḥ.. 13.104 ..
1.4.d:
यो हि नित्यं महाकालं श्रद्धया पूजयेत्पुमान्..
स दौष्कुलीनदोषेभ्यो मुच्यतेऽहिरिव त्वचः.. 13.104 ..
1.4.m: Whatever man daily worships Mahākāla with faith, / he is freed from the defects of low birth, as a snake from its slough.

1.4.s:
yathāyathā śraddhayāsau talliṃgaṃ paripaśyati..
tathātathā vimucyeta doṣairjanmaśatodbhavaiḥ.. 13.105 ..
1.4.d:
यथायथा श्रद्धयासौ तल्लिंगं परिपश्यति..
तथातथा विमुच्येत दोषैर्जन्मशतोद्भवैः.. 13.105 ..
1.4.m: Just as he beholds that liṅga with faith, / so he is freed from faults arising from hundreds of births.

1.4.s:
bhartṛyajñastu tatraiva liṃgasyārādhanātkramāt..
bījadoṣādvinirmuktastalliṃgamahimā tvasau.. 13.106 ..
1.4.d:
भर्तृयज्ञस्तु तत्रैव लिंगस्याराधनात्क्रमात्..
बीजदोषाद्विनिर्मुक्तस्तल्लिंगमहिमा त्वसौ.. 13.106 ..
1.4.m: Bhartṛyajña, through his continuous worship of the liṅga right there, / was freed from the defect of his seed; such indeed is the greatness of that liṅga!

1.4.s:
babhruṃ ca nakulaṃ prāha vimukto duṣṭajanmataḥ..
yasmāttasmādidaṃ tīrthaṃ khyātaṃ vai babhru pāvanam.. 13.107 ..
1.4.d:
बभ्रुं च नकुलं प्राह विमुक्तो दुष्टजन्मतः..
यस्मात्तस्मादिदं तीर्थं ख्यातं वै बभ्रु पावनम्.. 13.107 ..
1.4.m: Because he, freed from his wretched birth, called a brown mongoose babhru, / therefore this sacred ford is known as Babhru, the purifier.

1.4.s:
tasmādvrajadhvaṃ tatraiva mahīsāgarasaṃgamam..
paṃca tīrthāni sevanto muktimāpsyatha niścitam.. 13.108 ..
1.4.d:
तस्माद्व्रजध्वं तत्रैव महीसागरसंगमम्..
पंच तीर्थानि सेवन्तो मुक्तिमाप्स्यथ निश्चितम्.. 13.108 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, go to that very confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; / resorting to the five sacred fords, you will certainly attain liberation."

1.4.s:
ityevamuktvā saṃvarto yayāvabhimataṃ dvijaḥ..
bhartṛyajñaṃ muniṃ prāpya te ca tatra sthitābhavan.. 13.109 ..
1.4.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा संवर्तो ययावभिमतं द्विजः..
भर्तृयज्ञं मुनिं प्राप्य ते च तत्र स्थिताभवन्.. 13.109 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, the twice-born Saṃvarta departed as he wished; / and having reached the sage Bhartṛyajña, they remained there.

1.4.s:
tatastānāha sa jñātvā gaṇāñjñānena śāṃbhavān..
mahadvo vimalaṃ puṇyaṃ guptakṣetre yadatra vai.. 13.110 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तानाह स ज्ञात्वा गणाञ्ज्ञानेन शांभवान्..
महद्वो विमलं पुण्यं गुप्तक्षेत्रे यदत्र वै.. 13.110 ..
1.4.m: Then, knowing them to be attendants of Śiva through his spiritual insight, he said to them: / "Great and pure is your merit, since right here in the secret sacred field,

1.4.s:
bhavanto'bhyāgatā yatra mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ..
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ piṃḍadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ.. 13.111 ..
1.4.d:
भवन्तोऽभ्यागता यत्र महीसागरसंगमः..
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः पिंडदानं विशेषतः.. 13.111 ..
1.4.m: you have arrived where the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean is! / Ritual ablution, gift-giving, silent prayer, burnt offering, and especially offering of ancestral balls—

1.4.s:
akṣayaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ mahīsāgara saṃgame..
kṛtaṃ tathā'kṣayaṃ sarvaṃ snānadānakriyādikam.. 13.112 ..
1.4.d:
अक्षयं जायते सर्वं महीसागर संगमे..
कृतं तथाऽक्षयं सर्वं स्नानदानक्रियादिकम्.. 13.112 ..
1.4.m: all become imperishable at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; / every rite performed, such as ablution, gift-giving, and the like, becomes imperishable.

1.4.s:
yadātra stānakaṃ cakre devarṣirnāradaḥ purā..
tadā grahairvarā dattāḥ śaninā ca varastvasau.. 13.113 ..
1.4.d:
यदात्र स्तानकं चक्रे देवर्षिर्नारदः पुरा..
तदा ग्रहैर्वरा दत्ताः शनिना च वरस्त्वसौ.. 13.113 ..
1.4.m: When the divine seer Nārada formerly made a hermitage here, / then boons were granted by the planets, and this boon by Saturn:

1.4.s:
śanaiścareṇa saṃyuktā tvamāvāsyā yadā bhavet..
śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta snānadānapuraḥ saram.. 13.114 ..
1.4.d:
शनैश्चरेण संयुक्ता त्वमावास्या यदा भवेत्..
श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत स्नानदानपुरः सरम्.. 13.114 ..
1.4.m: 'When a new moon day falls joined with Saturday, / one should perform a śrāddha preceded by ritual ablution and gift-giving.

1.4.s:
yadi śrāvaṇamāsasya śanaiścaradine śubhā..
kuhūrbhavati tasyāṃ tu saṃkrāṃtiṃ kurute raviḥ.. 13.115 ..
1.4.d:
यदि श्रावणमासस्य शनैश्चरदिने शुभा..
कुहूर्भवति तस्यां तु संक्रांतिं कुरुते रविः.. 13.115 ..
1.4.m: If on a Saturday in the month of Śrāvaṇa an auspicious / new moon occurs, and the Sun makes a transit into a zodiac sign on that day,

1.4.s:
tasyāmeva tithau yogo vyatīpāto bhavedyadi..
puṣkaraṃnāma tatparva sūryaparvaśatādhikam.. 13.116 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यामेव तिथौ योगो व्यतीपातो भवेद्यदि..
पुष्करंनाम तत्पर्व सूर्यपर्वशताधिकम्.. 13.116 ..
1.4.m: and if the astronomical conjunction Vyatīpāta occurs on that very lunar day, / that festive time is named Puṣkara, greater than a hundred solar eclipses.

1.4.s:
sarvayogasamāvāpaḥ sathaṃcidapi labhyate..
tasmindine śaniṃ lohaṃ kāṃcanaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā.. 13.117 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वयोगसमावापः सथंचिदपि लभ्यते..
तस्मिन्दिने शनिं लोहं कांचनं भास्करं तथा.. 13.117 ..
1.4.m: If by any means that conjunction of all auspicious combinations is attained, / on that day one should duly worship Saturn [fashioned of] iron and the Sun [fashioned of] gold

1.4.s:
mahīsāgarasaṃsarge pūjayīta yathāvidhi..
śanimaṃtraiḥ śaniṃ dhyātvā sūryamaṃtrairdivākaram.. 13.118 ..
1.4.d:
महीसागरसंसर्गे पूजयीत यथाविधि..
शनिमंत्रैः शनिं ध्यात्वा सूर्यमंत्रैर्दिवाकरम्.. 13.118 ..
1.4.m: at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; / having meditated upon Saturn with mantras to Saturn, and upon the Sun with solar mantras,

1.4.s:
arghyaṃ dadyādbhākarasya sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye..
prayāgādidhikaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ kṣetrātkurorapi.. 13.119 ..
1.4.d:
अर्घ्यं दद्याद्भाकरस्य सर्वपापप्रशांतये..
प्रयागादिधिकं स्नानं दानं क्षेत्रात्कुरोरपि.. 13.119 ..
1.4.m: one should offer arghya to the Sun for the pacification of all sins. / Ablution here is superior to Prayāga, and gift-giving is superior even to Kurukṣetra.

1.4.s:
piṃḍadānaṃ gayākṣetrādadhikaṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana..
idaṃ saṃprāpyate parva mahadbhiḥ puṇyarāśibhiḥ.. 13.120 ..
1.4.d:
पिंडदानं गयाक्षेत्रादधिकं पांडुनंदन..
इदं संप्राप्यते पर्व महद्भिः पुण्यराशिभिः.. 13.120 ..
1.4.m: The offering of ancestral balls is superior to Gayākṣetra, O son of Pāṇḍu! / This festive conjunction is attained through heaps of great merit.

1.4.s:
pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate divi niścitam..
yathā gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ param.. 13.121 ..
1.4.d:
पितॄणामक्षया तृप्तिर्जायते दिवि निश्चितम्..
यथा गयाशिरः पुण्यं पितॄणां तृप्तिदं परम्.. 13.121 ..
1.4.m: Imperishable satisfaction of the ancestors certainly arises in heaven; / just as Gayāśiras is holy, giving supreme satisfaction to the ancestors,

1.4.s: tathā samadhikaḥ puṇyo mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ.. 13.122 ..
1.4.d: तथा समधिकः पुण्यो महीसागरसंगमः.. 13.122 ..
1.4.m: so the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean is far more holy.

1.4.s:
agniśca reto mṛḍayā ca dehe retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ..
evaṃ bruvañchraddhayā satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta mahīsamudram.. 13.123 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निश्च रेतो मृडया च देहे रेतोधा विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः..
एवं ब्रुवञ्छ्रद्धया सत्यवाक्यं ततोऽवगाहेत महीसमुद्रम्.. 13.123 ..
1.4.m: “Agni is semen, by compassion in the body Viṣṇu is the holder of semen, the navel of immortality”— / reciting this true statement with faith, one should then plunge into the ocean of the Mahī:

1.4.s:
mukhaṃ ca yaḥ sarvanadīṣu puṇyaḥ pāthodhiraṃbā pravarā mahī ca..
samastatīrthākṛtiretayośca dadāmi cārghyaṃ praṇamāmi naumi.. 13.124 ..
1.4.d:
मुखं च यः सर्वनदीषु पुण्यः पाथोधिरंबा प्रवरा मही च..
समस्ततीर्थाकृतिरेतयोश्च ददामि चार्घ्यं प्रणमामि नौमि.. 13.124 ..
1.4.m: “And [you are] the face among all rivers, the holy ocean, the mother, and the excellent Mahī; / both of you are the form of all sacred fords; I offer water-offering, I bow, I praise.

1.4.s:
tāmrā rasyāḥ payovāhāḥ pitṛprītipradāḥ śabhāḥ..
sasyamālā mahāsindhurdāturdātrī pṛthustutā..
indradyumnasya kanyā ca kṣitijanmā rāvatī.. 13.125 ..
1.4.d:
ताम्रा रस्याः पयोवाहाः पितृप्रीतिप्रदाः शभाः..
सस्यमाला महासिन्धुर्दातुर्दात्री पृथुस्तुता..
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य कन्या च क्षितिजन्मा रावती.. 13.125 ..
1.4.m: Tāmrā, Rasyā, Payovāhā, Pitṛprītipradā, Śubhā, / Sasyamālā, Mahāsindhu, Dāturdātrī, Pṛthustutā, / Indradyumnasyakanyā, Kṣitijanmā, and Rāvatī,

1.4.s:
mahīparṇā mahīśṛṃgā gaṃgā paścimavāhinī..
nadī rājanadī ceti nāmāṣṭāśamālikām.. 13.126 ..
1.4.d:
महीपर्णा महीशृंगा गंगा पश्चिमवाहिनी..
नदी राजनदी चेति नामाष्टाशमालिकाम्.. 13.126 ..
1.4.m: Mahīparṇā, Mahīśṛṅgā, the westward-flowing Gaṅgā, / Nadī, and Rājanadī: this garland of eighteen names,

1.4.s:
snānakāle ca sarvatra śrāddhakāle paṭhennaraḥ..
pṛthunoktāni nāmāni yajñamūrtipadaṃ vrajet.. 13.127 ..
1.4.d:
स्नानकाले च सर्वत्र श्राद्धकाले पठेन्नरः..
पृथुनोक्तानि नामानि यज्ञमूर्तिपदं व्रजेत्.. 13.127 ..
1.4.m: a man should recite everywhere at the time of ritual ablution and at the time of śrāddha; / [reciting] these names spoken by Pṛthu, he shall attain the state of the Embodiment of Sacrifice.

1.4.s:
mahīdohe mahānaṃdasaṃdohe viśvamohini..
jātāsi saritāṃ rājñi pāpaṃ hara mahīdrave..
..ityarghyamaṃtraḥ.. 13.128 ..
1.4.d:
महीदोहे महानंदसंदोहे विश्वमोहिनि..
जातासि सरितां राज्ञि पापं हर महीद्रवे..
..इत्यर्घ्यमंत्रः.. 13.128 ..
1.4.m: In the milking of the earth, in the abundance of great joy, O enchantress of the universe, / you were born, O queen of rivers! Remove sin, O stream of the earth!” / Thus is the water-offering mantra.

1.4.s:
kaṃkaṇaṃ rajatasyāpi yo'tra nikṣipate naraḥ..
sa jāyate mahīpṛṣṭhe dhanadhānyayute kule.. 13.129 ..
1.4.d:
कंकणं रजतस्यापि योऽत्र निक्षिपते नरः..
स जायते महीपृष्ठे धनधान्ययुते कुले.. 13.129 ..
1.4.m: Whatever man casts a silver bracelet here, / he is born on the surface of the earth in a family endowed with wealth and grain.

1.4.s:
mahīṃ ca sāgaraṃ caiva raupyakaṃkaṇa pūjayā..
pūjayāmi bhavenmā me dravyānāśo daridratā.. 13.130 ..
1.4.d:
महीं च सागरं चैव रौप्यकंकण पूजया..
पूजयामि भवेन्मा मे द्रव्यानाशो दरिद्रता.. 13.130 ..
1.4.m: “I worship the Mahī and the ocean with the worship of a silver bracelet; / may loss of wealth and poverty not befall me!”

1.4.s:
..kaṃkaṇakṣepaṇam..
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñaiśca yatphalam..
tatphalaṃ snānadānena mahīsāgarasaṃgame.. 13.131 ..
1.4.d:
..कंकणक्षेपणम्..
यत्फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञैश्च यत्फलम्..
तत्फलं स्नानदानेन महीसागरसंगमे.. 13.131 ..
1.4.m: [Thus is] the throwing of the bracelet. / Whatever fruit is [gained] in all sacred fords, and whatever fruit by all sacrifices, / that fruit is obtained by ritual ablution and gift-giving at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean.

1.4.s:
vivāde ca samutpanne aparādhī ca yo mataḥ..
jalahastaḥ sadā vācyo mahīsāgarasaṃgame.. 13.132 ..
1.4.d:
विवादे च समुत्पन्ने अपराधी च यो मतः..
जलहस्तः सदा वाच्यो महीसागरसंगमे.. 13.132 ..
1.4.m: And when a dispute has arisen, he who is deemed the guilty party / should always be made to make an oath with water in his hand at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean.

1.4.s:
saṃsnāpyāghoramaṃtreṇa sthāpya nābhipramāṇake..
jale karaṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ vācayeddrutam.. 13.133 ..
1.4.d:
संस्नाप्याघोरमंत्रेण स्थाप्य नाभिप्रमाणके..
जले करं समुद्धृत्य दक्षिणं वाचयेद्द्रुतम्.. 13.133 ..
1.4.m: Having bathed him with the Aghora mantra, and placing him in water / measuring up to his navel, holding up his right hand, one should quickly make him recite:

1.4.s:
yadi dharmo'tra satyo'sti satyaścetsaṃgamastvasau..
satyāścetkratudraṣṭāraḥ satyaṃ syānme śubhāśubham.. 13.134 ..
1.4.d:
यदि धर्मोऽत्र सत्योऽस्ति सत्यश्चेत्संगमस्त्वसौ..
सत्याश्चेत्क्रतुद्रष्टारः सत्यं स्यान्मे शुभाशुभम्.. 13.134 ..
1.4.m: “If righteousness is true here, and if this confluence is true, / and if the witnesses of sacrifice are true, may my good and bad fortune be revealed in truth!”

1.4.s:
evamuktvā karaṃ kṣipya dakṣiṇaṃ sakalaṃ tataḥ..
niḥsṛtaḥ pāpakārī cejjvareṇāpīḍyate kṣaṇāt.. 13.135 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्त्वा करं क्षिप्य दक्षिणं सकलं ततः..
निःसृतः पापकारी चेज्ज्वरेणापीड्यते क्षणात्.. 13.135 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, having plunged his entire right hand [into the water], / when he comes out, if he is a sinner, he is instantly afflicted with fever.

1.4.s:
saptāhāddṛśyate cāpi tāvannirdoṣavānmataḥ..
atra snātvā ca japtvā ca tapastaptvā tathaiva ca.. 13.136 ..
1.4.d:
सप्ताहाद्दृश्यते चापि तावन्निर्दोषवान्मतः..
अत्र स्नात्वा च जप्त्वा च तपस्तप्त्वा तथैव च.. 13.136 ..
1.4.m:
And if [nothing] is seen within seven days, he is considered faultless.
Having bathed and recited [mantras] here, and having likewise practiced austerity,

1.4.s:
rudralokaṃ subahavo gatāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā..
somavāre viśeṣeṇa snātvā yotra subhaktitaḥ.. 13.137 ..
1.4.d:
रुद्रलोकं सुबहवो गताः पुण्येन कर्मणा..
सोमवारे विशेषेण स्नात्वा योत्र सुभक्तितः.. 13.137 ..
1.4.m:
very many have gone to Rudra's world by their meritorious deed.
Whoever, having bathed here with deep devotion, especially on a Monday,

1.4.s:
paṃca tīrthāni kurute mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ..
ityādyuktaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam.. 13.138 ..
1.4.d:
पंच तीर्थानि कुरुते मुच्यते पंचपातकैः..
इत्याद्युक्तं बहुविधं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्.. 13.138 ..
1.4.m:
visits the five sacred fords, is freed from the five great sins.'
Having thus spoken the excellent, multifaceted māhātmya of the sacred ford,

1.4.s:
bhartṛyajñaḥ śivasyo ca teṣāmārādhane kramam..
śivāgamoktamādiśya pūjāyogaṃ yathāvidhi.. 13.139 ..
1.4.d:
भर्तृयज्ञः शिवस्यो च तेषामाराधने क्रमम्..
शिवागमोक्तमादिश्य पूजायोगं यथाविधि.. 13.139 ..
1.4.m:
Bhartṛyajña [explained the glory] of Śiva and the order of worshipping them;
having taught the method of worship according to the rule declared in Śiva's scriptures,

1.4.s:
śivabhaktisamudraikapūritaḥ prāha tānmuniḥ..
na śivātparamo devaḥ satyametacchivavratāḥ.. 13.140 ..
1.4.d:
शिवभक्तिसमुद्रैकपूरितः प्राह तान्मुनिः..
न शिवात्परमो देवः सत्यमेतच्छिवव्रताः.. 13.140 ..
1.4.m:
the sage, filled with the single ocean of devotion to Śiva, said to them:
'There is no deity higher than Śiva; this is the truth, O observers of vows to Śiva!

1.4.s:
śivaṃ vihāya yo hyānyadasatkiṃcidupāsate..
karasthaṃ so'mṛtaṃ tyaktvā mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ pradhāvati.. 13.141 ..
1.4.d:
शिवं विहाय यो ह्यान्यदसत्किंचिदुपासते..
करस्थं सोऽमृतं त्यक्त्वा मृगतृष्णां प्रधावति.. 13.141 ..
1.4.m:
Whoever abandons Śiva and worships something else that is unreal,
abandons the nectar in his hand and runs toward a mirage.

1.4.s:
śivaśaktimayaṃ hyetatpratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate jagat..
liṃgāṃkaṃ ca bhagāṃkaṃ ca nānyadevāṃkitaṃ kvacit.. 13.142 ..
1.4.d:
शिवशक्तिमयं ह्येतत्प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते जगत्..
लिंगांकं च भगांकं च नान्यदेवांकितं क्वचित्.. 13.142 ..
1.4.m:
For this manifest world is seen to consist of Śiva and Śakti;
it is marked by the liṅga and marked by the yoni, never marked by any other deity anywhere.

1.4.s:
yaśca taṃ pitaraṃ rudraṃ tyaktvā mātaramaṃ bikām..
vartate'sau svapitaraṃ tyaktodapitṛpiṃḍakaḥ..
yasya rudrasya māhātmyaṃ śatarudrīyamuttamam.. 13.143 ..
1.4.d:
यश्च तं पितरं रुद्रं त्यक्त्वा मातरमं बिकाम्..
वर्ततेऽसौ स्वपितरं त्यक्तोदपितृपिंडकः..
यस्य रुद्रस्य माहात्म्यं शतरुद्रीयमुत्तमम्.. 13.143 ..
1.4.m:
And he who lives having abandoned that father Rudra and mother Ambikā,
is one who has abandoned his own father, offering balls of rice and water [elsewhere].
Listen to the supreme Śatarudrīya, the māhātmya of Rudra,

1.4.s:
śrṛṇudhvaṃ yadi pāpānāmicchadhvaṃ kṣālanaṃ param..
brahmā hāṭakaliṃgaṃ ca samārādhya kapardinaḥ.. 13.144 ..
1.4.d:
श्रृणुध्वं यदि पापानामिच्छध्वं क्षालनं परम्..
ब्रह्मा हाटकलिंगं च समाराध्य कपर्दिनः.. 13.144 ..
1.4.m:
if you desire the supreme cleansing of sins.
Brahmā, having worshipped the golden liṅga of the braided-haired one,

1.4.s:
jagatpradhānamiti ca nāma japtvā virājate..
kṛṣṇamūle kṛṣṇaliṃgaṃ nāma cārjitameva ca.. 13.145 ..
1.4.d:
जगत्प्रधानमिति च नाम जप्त्वा विराजते..
कृष्णमूले कृष्णलिंगं नाम चार्जितमेव च.. 13.145 ..
1.4.m:
shines forth, reciting the name “Source of the Universe”.
At the root of the Kṛṣṇa tree, [Viṣṇu worshipped] a black liṅga, and earned the name [“the Pervader”];

1.4.s:
sanakādyaiśca talliṃgaṃ pūjyājayurjagadgatim..
darbhāṃkuramayaṃ sapta munayo viśvayonikam.. 13.146 ..
1.4.d:
सनकाद्यैश्च तल्लिंगं पूज्याजयुर्जगद्गतिम्..
दर्भांकुरमयं सप्त मुनयो विश्वयोनिकम्.. 13.146 ..
1.4.m:
and Sanaka and the others, worshipping that liṅga, attained the goal of the world.
The seven seers [worshipped a liṅga] made of sprouted Darbha grass, [reciting the name] “Womb of the Universe”;

1.4.s:
nāradastvaṃtarikṣe ca jadadbījamidaṃ gṛṇan..
vajramidro liṃgamevaṃ viśvātmānaṃ ca nāma ca.. 13.147 ..
1.4.d:
नारदस्त्वंतरिक्षे च जदद्बीजमिदं गृणन्..
वज्रमिद्रो लिंगमेवं विश्वात्मानं च नाम च.. 13.147 ..
1.4.m:
and Nārada in the sky, reciting [the name] “Seed of the World”;
Indra [worshipped] a diamond liṅga, reciting the name “Soul of the Universe”;

1.4.s:
sūryastāmraṃ tathā liṃgaṃ nāma viśvasṛjaṃ japan..
caṃdraśca mauktikaṃ liṃgaṃ japannāma jagatpatim.. 13.148 ..
1.4.d:
सूर्यस्ताम्रं तथा लिंगं नाम विश्वसृजं जपन्..
चंद्रश्च मौक्तिकं लिंगं जपन्नाम जगत्पतिम्.. 13.148 ..
1.4.m:
the Sun, a copper liṅga, reciting the name “Creator of the Universe”;
and the Moon, a pearl liṅga, reciting the name “Lord of the World”;

1.4.s:
iṃdranīlamayaṃ vahnirnāma viśveśvaraṃ japan..
puṣparāgaṃ guruliṃgaṃ viśvayoniṃ japanharam.. 13.149 ..
1.4.d:
इंद्रनीलमयं वह्निर्नाम विश्वेश्वरं जपन्..
पुष्परागं गुरुलिंगं विश्वयोनिं जपन्हरम्.. 13.149 ..
1.4.m:
Agni, a liṅga of sapphire, reciting the name “Lord of the Universe”;
Bṛhaspati, a topaz liṅga, reciting Hara's name “Womb of the Universe”;

1.4.s:
padmarāgamayaṃ śukro viśvakarmeti nāma ca..
hemaliṃgaṃ ca dhanado japannāmnā tatheśvaram.. 13.150 ..
1.4.d:
पद्मरागमयं शुक्रो विश्वकर्मेति नाम च..
हेमलिंगं च धनदो जपन्नाम्ना तथेश्वरम्.. 13.150 ..
1.4.m:
Śukra, a liṅga of ruby, and the name “All-Maker”;
and Kubera, a gold liṅga, likewise reciting the name “Īśvara”;

1.4.s:
raupyajaṃ viśvadevāśca nāmāpi jagatāṃpatim..
vāyavo rītijaṃ liṃgaṃ śaṃbhumityeva nāma ca.. 13.151 ..
1.4.d:
रौप्यजं विश्वदेवाश्च नामापि जगतांपतिम्..
वायवो रीतिजं लिंगं शंभुमित्येव नाम च.. 13.151 ..
1.4.m:
the Viśvedevas, [a liṅga] made of silver, and the name “Lord of the Worlds”;
the Vāyus, a brass liṅga, and the name “Śambhu”;

1.4.s:
kāśajaṃ vasavo liṃgaṃ svayaṃbhumiti nāma ca..
trilohaṃ mātaro liṃgaṃ nāma bhūteśameva ca.. 13.152 ..
1.4.d:
काशजं वसवो लिंगं स्वयंभुमिति नाम च..
त्रिलोहं मातरो लिंगं नाम भूतेशमेव च.. 13.152 ..
1.4.m:
the Vasus, a bronze liṅga, and the name “Svayambhu”;
the Mothers, a liṅga of three metals, and the name “Lord of Spirits”;

1.4.s:
lauhaṃ ca rakṣasāṃ nāma bhūtabhavyabhavodbhavam..
guhyakāḥ sīsajaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma yogaṃ japaṃti ca.. 13.153 ..
1.4.d:
लौहं च रक्षसां नाम भूतभव्यभवोद्भवम्..
गुह्यकाः सीसजं लिंगं नाम योगं जपंति च.. 13.153 ..
1.4.m:
and the Rākṣasas, an iron liṅga, [reciting the] name “Origin of Past, Present, and Future”;
the Guhyakas recite the name “Yoga” before a lead liṅga;

1.4.s:
jaigīṣavyo brahmarandhraṃ nāma yogeśvaraṃ japan..
nimirnayanayorliṃge japañśarveti nāma ca.. 13.154 ..
1.4.d:
जैगीषव्यो ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं नाम योगेश्वरं जपन्..
निमिर्नयनयोर्लिंगे जपञ्शर्वेति नाम च.. 13.154 ..
1.4.m:
Jaigīṣavya, reciting the name “Lord of Yoga” at the aperture of Brahmā;
Nimi, reciting the name “Śarva” upon the liṅga in his eyes;

1.4.s:
dhanvaṃtarirgomayaṃ ca sarvalokeśvareśvaram..
gaṃdharvā dārujaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvaśreṣṭheti nāma ca.. 13.155 ..
1.4.d:
धन्वंतरिर्गोमयं च सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरम्..
गंधर्वा दारुजं लिंगं सर्वश्रेष्ठेति नाम च.. 13.155 ..
1.4.m:
Dhanvantari, a cow-dung [liṅga], [reciting the name] “Lord of Lords of All the Worlds”;
the Gandharvas, a wooden liṅga, and the name “Foremost of All”;

1.4.s:
vaiḍūryaṃ rāghavo liṃgaṃ jagajjyeṣṭheti nāma ca..
bāṇo mārakataṃ liṃgaṃ vasiṣṭhamiti nāma ca.. 13.156 ..
1.4.d:
वैडूर्यं राघवो लिंगं जगज्ज्येष्ठेति नाम च..
बाणो मारकतं लिंगं वसिष्ठमिति नाम च.. 13.156 ..
1.4.m:
the scion of Raghu, a beryl liṅga, and the name “Eldest in the World”;
Bāṇa, an emerald liṅga, and the name “Most Excellent”;

1.4.s:
varuṇaḥ sphāṭikaṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā ca parameśvaram..
nāgā vidrumaliṃgaṃ ca nāma lokatrayaṃkaram.. 13.157 ..
1.4.d:
वरुणः स्फाटिकं लिंगं नाम्ना च परमेश्वरम्..
नागा विद्रुमलिंगं च नाम लोकत्रयंकरम्.. 13.157 ..
1.4.m:
Varuṇa, a crystal liṅga, and the name “Parameśvara”;
the Nāgas, a coral liṅga, and the name “Creator of the Three Worlds”;

1.4.s:
bhāratī tāraliṃgaṃ ca nāma lokatrayāśritam..
śaniśca saṃgamāvarte jagannātheti nāma ca.. 13.158 ..
1.4.d:
भारती तारलिंगं च नाम लोकत्रयाश्रितम्..
शनिश्च संगमावर्ते जगन्नाथेति नाम च.. 13.158 ..
1.4.m:
Bhāratī, a silver liṅga, and the name “Refuge of the Three Worlds”;
and Saturn, [a liṅga] at the whirlpool of the confluence, and the name “Lord of the World”;

1.4.s:
śanideśe madhyarātrau mahīsāgarasaṃgame..
jātījaṃ rāvaṇo liṃgaṃ japannāma sudurjayam.. 13.159 ..
1.4.d:
शनिदेशे मध्यरात्रौ महीसागरसंगमे..
जातीजं रावणो लिंगं जपन्नाम सुदुर्जयम्.. 13.159 ..
1.4.m:
in the land of Saturn, at midnight, at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean;
Rāvaṇa, a liṅga made of jasmine, reciting the name “Very Difficult to Conquer”;

1.4.s:
siddhāśca mānasaṃ nāma kāmamṛtyujarātigam..
uṃchajaṃ ca balirliṃgaṃ jñānātmetyasya nāma ca.. 13.160 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धाश्च मानसं नाम काममृत्युजरातिगम्..
उंछजं च बलिर्लिंगं ज्ञानात्मेत्यस्य नाम च.. 13.160 ..
1.4.m:
the Siddhas, a mental [liṅga], [reciting] the name “Transcendental to Desire, Death, and Old Age”;
and Bali, a liṅga made of gleaned grains, and his name was “Embodiment of Knowledge”;

1.4.s:
marīcipāḥ puṣpajaṃ ca jñānagamyeti nāma ca..
śakṛtāḥ śakṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ jñānajñeyeti nāma ca.. 13.161 ..
1.4.d:
मरीचिपाः पुष्पजं च ज्ञानगम्येति नाम च..
शकृताः शकृतं लिंगं ज्ञानज्ञेयेति नाम च.. 13.161 ..
1.4.m:
the drinkers of sunbeams, a flower liṅga, and the name “Attainable by Knowledge”;
those living on cow dung, a cow-dung liṅga, and the name “Knowable by Knowledge”;

1.4.s:
phenapāḥ phenajaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma cāpi sudurvidam..
kapilo vālukāliṃgaṃ varadaṃ ca japanharam.. 13.162 ..
1.4.d:
फेनपाः फेनजं लिंगं नाम चापि सुदुर्विदम्..
कपिलो वालुकालिंगं वरदं च जपन्हरम्.. 13.162 ..
1.4.m:
the foam-drinkers, a liṅga made of foam, and the name “Hard to Comprehend”;
Kapila, a sand liṅga, reciting Hara's name “Boon-Giver”;

1.4.s:
sārasvato vāciliṃgaṃ nāma vāgīśvareti ca..
gaṇā mūrtimayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma rudreti cābruvan.. 13.163 ..
1.4.d:
सारस्वतो वाचिलिंगं नाम वागीश्वरेति च..
गणा मूर्तिमयं लिंगं नाम रुद्रेति चाब्रुवन्.. 13.163 ..
1.4.m:
Sārasvata, a liṅga in speech, and the name “Lord of Speech”;
the Gaṇas [worshipped] an embodied liṅga, and uttered the name “Rudra”;

1.4.s:
jāṃbūnadamayaṃ devāḥ śitikaṇṭheti nāma ca..
śaṃkhaliṃgaṃ budho nāma kaniṣṭhamiti saṃjapan.. 13.164 ..
1.4.d:
जांबूनदमयं देवाः शितिकण्ठेति नाम च..
शंखलिंगं बुधो नाम कनिष्ठमिति संजपन्.. 13.164 ..
1.4.m:
the gods, [a liṅga] made of Jāmbūnada gold, and the name “Blue-Throated”;
Budha, a conch liṅga, reciting the name “Youngest”;

1.4.s:
aśvinau mṛnmayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā caiva suvedhasam..
vināyakaḥ piṣṭaliṃgaṃ nāmnā cāpi kapardinam.. 13.165 ..
1.4.d:
अश्विनौ मृन्मयं लिंगं नाम्ना चैव सुवेधसम्..
विनायकः पिष्टलिंगं नाम्ना चापि कपर्दिनम्.. 13.165 ..
1.4.m:
the Aśvins, a clay liṅga, and the name “Good Creator”;
Vināyaka, a flour liṅga, and the name “Kapardin”;

1.4.s:
nāvanītaṃ kujo liṃgaṃ nāma cāpi karālakam..
tārkṣya odanaliṃgaṃ ca haryakṣeti hi nāma ca.. 13.166 ..
1.4.d:
नावनीतं कुजो लिंगं नाम चापि करालकम्..
तार्क्ष्य ओदनलिंगं च हर्यक्षेति हि नाम च.. 13.166 ..
1.4.m:
Mars, a butter liṅga, and the name “Dreadful”;
Garuda, a boiled-rice liṅga, and the name “Lion-Eyed”;

1.4.s:
gauḍaṃ kāmastathā liṃgaṃ ratidaṃ ceti nāma ca..
śacī lavaṇaliṃgaṃ tu babhrukeśeti nāma ca.. 13.167 ..
1.4.d:
गौडं कामस्तथा लिंगं रतिदं चेति नाम च..
शची लवणलिंगं तु बभ्रुकेशेति नाम च.. 13.167 ..
1.4.m:
Kāma, a molasses liṅga, and the name “Giver of Pleasure”;
and Śacī, a salt liṅga, and the name “Brown-Haired”;

1.4.s:
viśvakarmā ca prāsādaliṃgaṃ yāmyeti nāma ca..
vibhīṣaṇaśca pāṃsūtthaṃ suhṛttameti nāma ca..
vaṃśāṃkurotthaṃ sagaro nāma saṃgatameva ca.. 13.168 ..
1.4.d:
विश्वकर्मा च प्रासादलिंगं याम्येति नाम च..
विभीषणश्च पांसूत्थं सुहृत्तमेति नाम च..
वंशांकुरोत्थं सगरो नाम संगतमेव च.. 13.168 ..

1.4.s:
rāhuśca rāmaṭhaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma gamyeti kīrtayan..
lepyaliṃgaṃ tathā lakṣmīrharinetreti nāma ca.. 13.169 ..
1.4.d:
राहुश्च रामठं लिंगं नाम गम्येति कीर्तयन्..
लेप्यलिंगं तथा लक्ष्मीर्हरिनेत्रेति नाम च.. 13.169 ..
1.4.m:
Rāhu, an asafoetida liṅga, proclaiming the name “Accessible”;
and Lakṣmī, an unguent liṅga, and the name “Lord of the Eyes of Hari”;

1.4.s:
yoginaḥ sarvabhūtasthaṃ sthāṇurityeva nāma ca..
nānāvidhaṃ manuṣyāśca puruṣaṃnāma nāma ca.. 13.170 ..
1.4.d:
योगिनः सर्वभूतस्थं स्थाणुरित्येव नाम च..
नानाविधं मनुष्याश्च पुरुषंनाम नाम च.. 13.170 ..
1.4.m:
yogins, [the liṅga] abiding in all beings, and the name “Sthāṇu”;
and men, of various kinds, reciting the name “Puruṣa”;

1.4.s:
tejomayaṃ ca ṛkṣāṇi bhagaṃ nāma ca bhāsvaram..
kiṃnarā dhātuliṃgaṃ ca sudīptamiti nāma ca.. 13.171 ..
1.4.d:
तेजोमयं च ऋक्षाणि भगं नाम च भास्वरम्..
किंनरा धातुलिंगं च सुदीप्तमिति नाम च.. 13.171 ..
1.4.m:
the constellations, [a liṅga] made of light, and the name “Radiant Lord”;
the Kinnaras, an ore liṅga, and the name “Brilliant”;

1.4.s:
devadeveti nāmāsti liṃgaṃ ca brahmarākṣasāḥ..
daṃtajaṃ vāraṇā liṃgaṃ nāma raṃhasameva ca.. 13.172 ..
1.4.d:
देवदेवेति नामास्ति लिंगं च ब्रह्मराक्षसाः..
दंतजं वारणा लिंगं नाम रंहसमेव च.. 13.172 ..
1.4.m:
Brahmarākṣasas [have] a liṅga, and the name is “God of Gods”;
elephants, an ivory liṅga, and the name “Swiftness”;

1.4.s:
saptalokamayaṃ sādhyā bahūrūpeti nāma ca..
dūrvāṃkuramayaṃ liṃgamṛtavaḥ sarvanāma ca.. 13.173 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तलोकमयं साध्या बहूरूपेति नाम च..
दूर्वांकुरमयं लिंगमृतवः सर्वनाम च.. 13.173 ..
1.4.m:
the Sādhyas, [a liṅga] made of seven worlds, and the name “Multiform”;
the seasons, a liṅga made of Dūrvā sprouts, and the name “All”;

1.4.s:
kauṃkumamapsaraso liṃgaṃ nāma śaṃbhoḥ priyeti ca..
siṃdūrajaṃ corvaśī ca nāma ca priyavāsanam.. 13.174 ..
1.4.d:
कौंकुममप्सरसो लिंगं नाम शंभोः प्रियेति च..
सिंदूरजं चोर्वशी च नाम च प्रियवासनम्.. 13.174 ..
1.4.m:
the apsarases, a saffron liṅga, and the name “Beloved of Śambhu”;
and Urvaśī, one made of red lead, and the name “Dwelling in What Is Dear”;

1.4.s:
brahmacāri gururliṃgaṃ nāma coṣṇīṣiṇaṃ viduḥ..
alaktakaṃ ca yoginyo nāma cāsya subabhrukam.. 13.175 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मचारि गुरुर्लिंगं नाम चोष्णीषिणं विदुः..
अलक्तकं च योगिन्यो नाम चास्य सुबभ्रुकम्.. 13.175 ..
1.4.m:
the brahmacārins, the teacher as a liṅga, and knew the name “Turbaned One”;
the Yoginīs, a red-lac liṅga, and his name “Very Tawny”;

1.4.s:
śrīkhaṃḍaṃ siddhayoginyaḥ sahasrākṣeti nāma ca..
ḍākinyo māṃsa liṃgaṃ ca nāma cāsya ca mīḍhuṣam.. 13.176 ..
1.4.d:
श्रीखंडं सिद्धयोगिन्यः सहस्राक्षेति नाम च..
डाकिन्यो मांस लिंगं च नाम चास्य च मीढुषम्.. 13.176 ..
1.4.m:
the Siddhayoginīs, sandalwood, and the name “Thousand-Eyed”;
the Ḍākinīs, a flesh liṅga, and his name “Bountiful”;

1.4.s:
apyannajaṃ ca manavo giriśeti ca nāma ca..
agastyo vrīhijaṃ vāpi suśāṃtamiti nāma ca.. 13.177 ..
1.4.d:
अप्यन्नजं च मनवो गिरिशेति च नाम च..
अगस्त्यो व्रीहिजं वापि सुशांतमिति नाम च.. 13.177 ..
1.4.m:
and the Manus, one made of food, and the name “Dwelling on the Mountain”;
Agastya, one made of rice, and the name “Very Peaceful”;

1.4.s:
yavajaṃ devalo liṃgaṃ patimityeva nāma ca..
valmīkajaṃ ca vālmīkiściravāsīti nāma ca.. 13.178 ..
1.4.d:
यवजं देवलो लिंगं पतिमित्येव नाम च..
वल्मीकजं च वाल्मीकिश्चिरवासीति नाम च.. 13.178 ..
1.4.m:
Devala, a barley liṅga, and the name “Lord”;
and Vālmīki, an anthill liṅga, and the name “Clad in Bark”.

1.4.s:
pratardano bāṇaliṃgaṃ hiraṇyabhujanāma ca..
rājikaṃ ca tathā daityā nāma ugreti kīrtitam.. 13.179 ..
1.4.d:
प्रतर्दनो बाणलिंगं हिरण्यभुजनाम च..
राजिकं च तथा दैत्या नाम उग्रेति कीर्तितम्.. 13.179 ..
1.4.m: Pratardana [worships] a bāṇaliṅga, named Hiraṇyabhuja; / and the Daityas [worship one] made of mustard seed, celebrated by the name Ugra.

1.4.s:
niṣpāvajaṃ dānavāśca liṃganāma ca dikpatim..
meghā nīramayaṃ liṃgaṃ parjanyapatināma ca.. 13.180 ..
1.4.d:
निष्पावजं दानवाश्च लिंगनाम च दिक्पतिम्..
मेघा नीरमयं लिंगं पर्जन्यपतिनाम च.. 13.180 ..
1.4.m: And the Dānavas [worship a liṅga] made of niṣpāva beans, its name Dikpati; / the clouds [worship] a liṅga made of water, with the name Parjanyapati.

1.4.s:
rājamāṣamayaṃ yakṣā nāma bhūtapatiṃ smṛtam..
tilānnajaṃ ca pitaro nāma vṛṣapatistathā.. 13.181 ..
1.4.d:
राजमाषमयं यक्षा नाम भूतपतिं स्मृतम्..
तिलान्नजं च पितरो नाम वृषपतिस्तथा.. 13.181 ..
1.4.m: The Yakṣas [worship a liṅga] made of kidney beans, remembered by the name Bhūtapati; / and the ancestors [worship one] made of sesame food, its name Vṛṣapati.

1.4.s:
gautamo gorajamayaṃ nāma gopatireva ca..
vānaprasthāḥ phalamayaṃ nāma vṛkṣāvṛteti ca.. 13.182 ..
1.4.d:
गौतमो गोरजमयं नाम गोपतिरेव च..
वानप्रस्थाः फलमयं नाम वृक्षावृतेति च.. 13.182 ..
1.4.m: Gautama [worships a liṅga] made of cattle-dust, with the name Gopati; / forest-dwellers [worship one] made of fruits, named Vṛkṣāvṛta.

1.4.s:
skaṃdaḥ pāṣāṇaliṃgaṃ ca nāma senānya eva ca..
nāgaścāśvataro dhānyaṃ madhyametyasya nāma ca.. 13.183 ..
1.4.d:
स्कंदः पाषाणलिंगं च नाम सेनान्य एव च..
नागश्चाश्वतरो धान्यं मध्यमेत्यस्य नाम च.. 13.183 ..
1.4.m: Skanda [worships] a stone liṅga, named Senānī; / and the serpent Aśvatara [worships one made of] grain, and its name is Madhyama.

1.4.s:
puroḍāśamayaṃ yajvā sruvahasteti nāma ca..
yamaḥ kālāyasamayaṃ nāma prāha ca dhanvinam.. 13.184 ..
1.4.d:
पुरोडाशमयं यज्वा स्रुवहस्तेति नाम च..
यमः कालायसमयं नाम प्राह च धन्विनम्.. 13.184 ..
1.4.m: The sacrificer [worships one] made of sacrificial cake, named Sruvahasta; / Yama [worships one] made of black iron, and he calls it Dhanvin.

1.4.s:
yavāṃkuraṃ jāmadagnyo bhargadaityeti nāma ca..
purūravāścāścānnamayaṃ bahurūpeti nāma ca.. 13.185 ..
1.4.d:
यवांकुरं जामदग्न्यो भर्गदैत्येति नाम च..
पुरूरवाश्चाश्चान्नमयं बहुरूपेति नाम च.. 13.185 ..
1.4.m: The son of Jamadagni [worships one of] barley sprouts, named Bhargadaitya; / and Purūravas [worships one] made of cooked rice, named Bahurūpa.

1.4.s:
māṃdhātā śarkarāliṃgaṃ nāma bāhuyugeti ca..
gāvaḥ payomayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma netrasahasrakam.. 13.186 ..
1.4.d:
मांधाता शर्करालिंगं नाम बाहुयुगेति च..
गावः पयोमयं लिंगं नाम नेत्रसहस्रकम्.. 13.186 ..
1.4.m: Māndhātṛ [worships] a liṅga of gravel, named Bāhuyuga; / cows [worship] a liṅga made of milk, named Netrasahasraka.

1.4.s:
sādhyā bhartṛmayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma viśvapatiḥ smṛtam..
nārāyaṇo naro mauṃjaṃ sahasraśiranāma ca.. 13.187 ..
1.4.d:
साध्या भर्तृमयं लिंगं नाम विश्वपतिः स्मृतम्..
नारायणो नरो मौंजं सहस्रशिरनाम च.. 13.187 ..
1.4.m: The Sādhyas [worship] a liṅga made of husband[-substance], remembered by the name Viśvapati; / Nara and Nārāyaṇa [worship one made] of muñja grass, named Sahasraśiras.

1.4.s:
tārkṣyaṃ pṛthustathā liṃgaṃ sahasracaraṇābhidham..
pakṣiṇo vyomaliṃgaṃ ca nāma sarvātmaketi ca.. 13.188 ..
1.4.d:
तार्क्ष्यं पृथुस्तथा लिंगं सहस्रचरणाभिधम्..
पक्षिणो व्योमलिंगं च नाम सर्वात्मकेति च.. 13.188 ..
1.4.m: Pṛthu likewise [worships] a liṅga of emerald, designated Sahasracaraṇa; / birds [worship] a sky-liṅga, named Sarvātman.

1.4.s:
pṛthivī meruliṃgaṃ ca dvitanuścāsya nāma ca..
bhasmaliṃgaṃ paśupatirnāma cāsya maheśvaraḥ.. 13.189 ..
1.4.d:
पृथिवी मेरुलिंगं च द्वितनुश्चास्य नाम च..
भस्मलिंगं पशुपतिर्नाम चास्य महेश्वरः.. 13.189 ..
1.4.m: The earth [worships] a liṅga of Mount Meru, and its name is Dvitanu; / Paśupati [worships] an ash-liṅga, and its name is Maheśvara.

1.4.s:
ṛṣayo jñānaliṃgaṃ ca cirasthāneti nāma ca..
brāhmaṇā brahmaliṃgaṃ ca nāma jyeṣṭheti taṃ viduḥ.. 13.190 ..
1.4.d:
ऋषयो ज्ञानलिंगं च चिरस्थानेति नाम च..
ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मलिंगं च नाम ज्येष्ठेति तं विदुः.. 13.190 ..
1.4.m: The ṛṣis [worship] a knowledge-liṅga, named Cirasthāna; / brahmins know a brahma-liṅga, and its name is Jyeṣṭha.

1.4.s:
gorocanamayaṃ śeṣo nāma paśupatiḥ smṛtam..
vāsukirviṣaliṃgaṃ ca nāma vai śaṃkareti ca.. 13.191 ..
1.4.d:
गोरोचनमयं शेषो नाम पशुपतिः स्मृतम्..
वासुकिर्विषलिंगं च नाम वै शंकरेति च.. 13.191 ..
1.4.m: Śeṣa [worships a liṅga] made of gorocana, remembered by the name Paśupati; / Vāsuki [worships] a poison-liṅga, named indeed Śaṃkara.

1.4.s:
takṣakaḥ kālakūṭākhyaṃ bahurūpeti nāma ca..
hālāhalaṃ ca karkoṭa ekākṣa iti nāma ca.. 13.192 ..
1.4.d:
तक्षकः कालकूटाख्यं बहुरूपेति नाम च..
हालाहलं च कर्कोट एकाक्ष इति नाम च.. 13.192 ..
1.4.m: Takṣaka [worships one] called kālakūṭa poison, named Bahurūpa; / and Karkoṭa [worships one of] hālāhala poison, with the name Ekākṣa.

1.4.s:
śrṛṃgī viṣamayaṃ padmo nāma dhūrjaṭireva ca..
putraḥ pitṛmayaṃ liṃgaṃ viśvarūpeti nāma ca.. 13.193 ..
1.4.d:
श्रृंगी विषमयं पद्मो नाम धूर्जटिरेव च..
पुत्रः पितृमयं लिंगं विश्वरूपेति नाम च.. 13.193 ..
1.4.m: Śṛṅgin [worships one] of poison, and Padma [worships one] named Dhūrjaṭi; / the son [worships] a liṅga made of the father, named Viśvarūpa.

1.4.s:
pāradaṃ ca śivā devī nāma tryambaka eva ca..
matsyādyāḥ śāstraliṃgaṃ ca nāma cāpi vṛṣākapiḥ.. 13.194 ..
1.4.d:
पारदं च शिवा देवी नाम त्र्यम्बक एव च..
मत्स्याद्याः शास्त्रलिंगं च नाम चापि वृषाकपिः.. 13.194 ..
1.4.m: And the goddess Śivā [worships one of] mercury, named Tryambaka; / fishes and the rest [worship] a liṅga of scripture, named also Vṛṣākapi.

1.4.s:
evaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena yadyatsattvaṃ vibhūtimat..
jagatyāmasti tajjātaṃ śivārādhanayogataḥ.. 13.195 ..
1.4.d:
एवं किं बहुनोक्तेन यद्यत्सत्त्वं विभूतिमत्..
जगत्यामस्ति तज्जातं शिवाराधनयोगतः.. 13.195 ..
1.4.m: Thus, what is the need of much speaking? Whatever being possesses glory / in the world, that has arisen by virtue of worshiping Śiva.

1.4.s:
bhasmano yadi vṛkṣatvaṃ jñāyate nīrasevanāt..
śivabhaktivihīnasya tato'sya phalamucyate.. 13.196 ..
1.4.d:
भस्मनो यदि वृक्षत्वं ज्ञायते नीरसेवनात्..
शिवभक्तिविहीनस्य ततोऽस्य फलमुच्यते.. 13.196 ..
1.4.m: Only if a tree could be known to grow from ashes by watering it with water, / could fruit be spoken of for one bereft of devotion to Śiva.

1.4.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yadi prāptau bhavenmatiḥ..
tato haraḥ samārādhyastrijagatyāḥ prado mataḥ.. 13.197 ..
1.4.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यदि प्राप्तौ भवेन्मतिः..
ततो हरः समाराध्यस्त्रिजगत्याः प्रदो मतः.. 13.197 ..
1.4.m: If one's mind is set on attaining duty, wealth, desire, and liberation, / then Hara is to be worshiped; he is considered the giver of the three worlds.

1.4.s:
ya idaṃ śatarudrīyaṃ prātaḥprātaḥ paṭhiṣyati..
tasya prītaḥ śivo devaḥ pradāsyatyakhilānvarān.. 13.198 ..
1.4.d:
य इदं शतरुद्रीयं प्रातःप्रातः पठिष्यति..
तस्य प्रीतः शिवो देवः प्रदास्यत्यखिलान्वरान्.. 13.198 ..
1.4.m: Whoever recites this Śatarudrīya every morning, / pleased with him, the god Śiva will grant all boons.

1.4.s:
nātaḥ paraṃ puṇyatamaṃ kiṃcidasti mahāphalam..
sarvavedarahasyaṃ ca sūryeṇoktamidaṃ mama.. 13.199 ..
1.4.d:
नातः परं पुण्यतमं किंचिदस्ति महाफलम्..
सर्ववेदरहस्यं च सूर्येणोक्तमिदं मम.. 13.199 ..
1.4.m: There is nothing more meritorious than this, yielding great fruit; / this is the secret of all the Vedas, spoken by the Sun to me.

1.4.s:
vācā ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ manasā vāpyupārjitam..
pāpaṃ tannāśamāyāti kīrtite śatarudriye.. 13.200 ..
1.4.d:
वाचा च यत्कृतं पापं मनसा वाप्युपार्जितम्..
पापं तन्नाशमायाति कीर्तिते शतरुद्रिये.. 13.200 ..
1.4.m: Whatever sin has been committed by speech or acquired by the mind, / that sin goes to destruction when the Śatarudrīya is recited.

1.4.s:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt..
bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca japedyaḥ śatarudriyam.. 13.201 ..
1.4.d:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात्..
भयान्मुच्येत भीतश्च जपेद्यः शतरुद्रियम्.. 13.201 ..
1.4.m: One afflicted with disease is freed from disease; a bound person is freed from bondage; / and a frightened person is freed from fear, if he mutters the Śatarudrīya.

1.4.s:
nāmnāṃ śatena yaḥ kumbhaiḥ puṣpaistāvadbhirīśvaram..
praṇāmānāṃ śatenāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ.. 13.202 ..
1.4.d:
नाम्नां शतेन यः कुम्भैः पुष्पैस्तावद्भिरीश्वरम्..
प्रणामानां शतेनापि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः.. 13.202 ..
1.4.m: He who [worships] Īśvara with a hundred names, with [a hundred] water jars, with as many flowers, / and with a hundred prostrations, is freed from all sins.

1.4.s:
liṃgānāṃ śatametacca śatamārādhakāstathā..
nāmāni ca śataṃ sarvadoṣasaṃnāśakaṃ smṛtam.. 13.203 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगानां शतमेतच्च शतमाराधकास्तथा..
नामानि च शतं सर्वदोषसंनाशकं स्मृतम्.. 13.203 ..
