1.4.d: बहुमानेन मे वाचं श्रृणुध्वं नाकवासिनः.. 16.46 ..
1.4.m: “Hear my words with high regard, O dwellers of heaven!

1.4.s:
bhavaṃto yajñabhoktāraḥ satāmiṣṭāśca sāttvikāḥ..
svesve pade sthitā nityaṃ jagataḥ pālane ratāḥ.. 16.47 ..
1.4.d:
भवंतो यज्ञभोक्तारः सतामिष्टाश्च सात्त्विकाः..
स्वेस्वे पदे स्थिता नित्यं जगतः पालने रताः.. 16.47 ..
1.4.m: You are the enjoyers of sacrifices, beloved of the virtuous, filled with sattva, / always established each in your own office, dedicated to the protection of the world.

1.4.s:
bhavatāṃ ca nimittena bādhaṃte dānaveśvarāḥ..
teṣāṃ samādi naivāsti daṃḍa eva vidhīyatām.. 16.48 ..
1.4.d:
भवतां च निमित्तेन बाधंते दानवेश्वराः..
तेषां समादि नैवास्ति दंड एव विधीयताम्.. 16.48 ..
1.4.m: And on account of you the lords of Dānavas harass [the world]. / For them conciliation and the rest do not apply; let punishment alone be ordained!

1.4.s:
kriyatāṃ samare buddhiḥ sainyaṃ saṃyojyatāmiti..
āvādyaṃtāṃ ca śastrāṇi pūjyaṃ tāṃ śastradevatāḥ.. 16.49 ..
1.4.d:
क्रियतां समरे बुद्धिः सैन्यं संयोज्यतामिति..
आवाद्यंतां च शस्त्राणि पूज्यं तां शस्त्रदेवताः.. 16.49 ..
1.4.m: Fix your mind on battle; let the army be assembled! / Let the weapons be sounded, and let the deities of weapons be worshipped!”

1.4.s:
ityuktāḥ samanahyaṃta devānāṃ ye pradhānataḥ..
vājināmayutenājau hemapaṭṭapariṣkṛtāḥ.. 16.50 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ताः समनह्यंत देवानां ये प्रधानतः..
वाजिनामयुतेनाजौ हेमपट्टपरिष्कृताः.. 16.50 ..
1.4.m: Thus addressed, the foremost of the gods equipped themselves, / adorned with golden headbands for battle with ten thousand horses.

1.4.s:
vāhanāni vimānāni yojayaṃtu mamāmarāḥ..
yamaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ niryāta devatāḥ.. 16.51 ..
1.4.d:
वाहनानि विमानानि योजयंतु ममामराः..
यमं सेनापतिं कृत्वा शीघ्रं निर्यात देवताः.. 16.51 ..
1.4.m: “Let my immortals yoke their mounts and aerial chariots! / Having made Yama the commander-in-chief, march out swiftly, O deities!”

1.4.s:
nānāścaryaguṇopetā durjayā devadānavaiḥ..
ratho mātalinā yukto maheṃdrasyāpyadṛśyata.. 16.52 ..
1.4.d:
नानाश्चर्यगुणोपेता दुर्जया देवदानवैः..
रथो मातलिना युक्तो महेंद्रस्याप्यदृश्यत.. 16.52 ..
1.4.m: Endowed with various wondrous qualities, invincible to gods and Dānavas, / the chariot of Mahendra, yoked by Mātali, was seen.

1.4.s:
yamo mahiṣamāsthāya senāgre samavartata..
caṃḍakiṃkiṇivṛṃdena sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ.. 16.53 ..
1.4.d:
यमो महिषमास्थाय सेनाग्रे समवर्तत..
चंडकिंकिणिवृंदेन सर्वतः परिवारितः.. 16.53 ..
1.4.m: Yama, mounted on a buffalo, took position at the front of the army, / surrounded on all sides by a multitude of fierce little bells.

1.4.s:
kalpakālojjavālāpūritāṃbaragocaraḥ..
hutāśa uraṇārūḍhaḥ śaktihasto vyavasthitaḥ.. 16.54 ..
1.4.d:
कल्पकालोज्जवालापूरितांबरगोचरः..
हुताश उरणारूढः शक्तिहस्तो व्यवस्थितः.. 16.54 ..
1.4.m: Filling the expanse of the sky with the blazing flames of the time of dissolution, / the Fire-god, mounted on a ram, spear in hand, stood in place.

1.4.s:
pavanoṃ'kuśapāṇistu vistāritamahājavaḥ..
mahāṛkṣaṃ samārūḍhaṃ senāgre samadṛśyata.. 16.55 ..
1.4.d:
पवनोंऽकुशपाणिस्तु विस्तारितमहाजवः..
महाऋक्षं समारूढं सेनाग्रे समदृश्यत.. 16.55 ..
1.4.m: Wind, an elephant-goad in his hand, his great speed spread wide, / was seen at the front of the army mounted on a great bear.

1.4.s:
bhujagendraṃ samārūḍho jaleśo bhagavānsvayam..
mahāpāśadharo vīraḥ senāyāṃ samavartata.. 16.56 ..
1.4.d:
भुजगेन्द्रं समारूढो जलेशो भगवान्स्वयम्..
महापाशधरो वीरः सेनायां समवर्तत.. 16.56 ..
1.4.m: Mounted on the lord of serpents, the blessed Lord of Waters [Varuṇa] himself, / heroic, holding a great noose, stood in the army.

1.4.s:
narayukte rathe divye dhanādhyakṣo vyacīcarat..
mahāsiṃharavo yuddhe gadāhasto vyavasthitaḥ.. 16.57 ..
1.4.d:
नरयुक्ते रथे दिव्ये धनाध्यक्षो व्यचीचरत्..
महासिंहरवो युद्धे गदाहस्तो व्यवस्थितः.. 16.57 ..
1.4.m: In a divine chariot drawn by men, the Lord of Wealth [Kubera] drove forth; / roaring like a great lion in battle, he stood with a mace in his hand.

1.4.s:
rākṣaseśo'tha nirṛtī rathe rakṣomukhairhayaiḥ..
dhanvī rakṣogaṇavṛto mahārāvo vyadṛśyata.. 16.58 ..
1.4.d:
राक्षसेशोऽथ निरृती रथे रक्षोमुखैर्हयैः..
धन्वी रक्षोगणवृतो महारावो व्यदृश्यत.. 16.58 ..
1.4.m: Then Nirṛti, the lord of rākṣasas, was seen on a chariot with horses whose faces were those of rākṣasas, / holding a bow, surrounded by troops of rākṣasas, and roaring loudly.

1.4.s:
caṃdrādityāvaśvinau ca vasavaḥ sādhyadevatāḥ..
viśvedevāśca rudrāśca sannaddhāstasthurāhave.. 16.59 ..
1.4.d:
चंद्रादित्यावश्विनौ च वसवः साध्यदेवताः..
विश्वेदेवाश्च रुद्राश्च सन्नद्धास्तस्थुराहवे.. 16.59 ..
1.4.m: The Moon and the Sun, the two Aśvins, the Vasus, the Sādhya deities, / the Viśvedevas, and the Rudras stood arrayed for battle.

1.4.s:
hemapīṭhattarāsaṃgāścitravarmāyudhadhvajāḥ..
gaṃdharvāḥ pratyadṛśyanta kṛtvā viśvāvasuṃ mukhe.. 16.60 ..
1.4.d:
हेमपीठत्तरासंगाश्चित्रवर्मायुधध्वजाः..
गंधर्वाः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त कृत्वा विश्वावसुं मुखे.. 16.60 ..
1.4.m: Wearing upper garments of golden cloth, with variegated armor, weapons, and banners, / the gandharvas appeared, placing Viśvāvasu at their head.

1.4.s:
tathā raktottarāsaṃgā nirmalāyovibhūṣaṇāḥ..
gṛdhradhvajā adṛśyaṃta rākṣasā raktamūrdhajāḥ.. 16.61 ..
1.4.d:
तथा रक्तोत्तरासंगा निर्मलायोविभूषणाः..
गृध्रध्वजा अदृश्यंत राक्षसा रक्तमूर्धजाः.. 16.61 ..
1.4.m: Likewise, rākṣasas were seen with red upper garments, flawless iron ornaments, / vulture-standards, and red hair.

1.4.s:
tathā bhīmāśanikarāḥ kṛṣṇavastrā mahārathāḥ..
yakṣāstatra vyadṛśyaṃta maṇibhadrādikoṭiśaḥ.. 16.62 ..
1.4.d:
तथा भीमाशनिकराः कृष्णवस्त्रा महारथाः..
यक्षास्तत्र व्यदृश्यंत मणिभद्रादिकोटिशः.. 16.62 ..
1.4.m: Likewise, yakṣas by the millions, led by Maṇibhadra and others, were seen there, / their hands holding terrifying thunderbolts, clad in black garments, great chariot-warriors.

1.4.s:
tāmrolūkadhvajā raudrā dvīpicarmāṃbarāstathā..
piśācāstatra rājaṃte mahāvegapuraḥsarāḥ.. 16.63 ..
1.4.d:
ताम्रोलूकध्वजा रौद्रा द्वीपिचर्मांबरास्तथा..
पिशाचास्तत्र राजंते महावेगपुरःसराः.. 16.63 ..
1.4.m: The piśācas shone there, with bronze owl-standards, fierce, / clad in leopard skins, marching ahead with great speed.

1.4.s:
tathaiva śvetavasanāḥ sitapaṭṭapatākinaḥ..
mattebhavāhanaprāyāḥ kiṃnarāstasthurāhave.. 16.64 ..
1.4.d:
तथैव श्वेतवसनाः सितपट्टपताकिनः..
मत्तेभवाहनप्रायाः किंनरास्तस्थुराहवे.. 16.64 ..
1.4.m: Likewise, the kinnaras stood in battle, dressed in white garments, / having white silk banners, mostly riding rutting elephants.

1.4.s:
muktājāla piraṣkāro haṃso hārasamaprabhaḥ..
keturjaladhināthasya saumyarūpo vyarājata.. 16.65 ..
1.4.d:
मुक्ताजाल पिरष्कारो हंसो हारसमप्रभः..
केतुर्जलधिनाथस्य सौम्यरूपो व्यराजत.. 16.65 ..
1.4.m: Adorned with nets of pearls, radiant as a pearl necklace, / a swan shone as the gentle-looking banner of the lord of the ocean.

1.4.s:
paṃcarāgamahāratnaviṭaṃko dhanadasya ca..
dhvajaḥ samutthito bhāti yātukāma ivāṃbaram.. 16.66 ..
1.4.d:
पंचरागमहारत्नविटंको धनदस्य च..
ध्वजः समुत्थितो भाति यातुकाम इवांबरम्.. 16.66 ..
1.4.m: And Dhanada's standard, with an pinnacle of five-hued great jewels, / stood erect and shone as if desiring to fly into the sky.

1.4.s:
kārṣṇalohamayo dhvāṃkṣo yamasyābhūnmahādhvajaḥ..
rākṣaseśasya vadanaṃ pretasya dhvaja ābabhau.. 16.67 ..
1.4.d:
कार्ष्णलोहमयो ध्वांक्षो यमस्याभून्महाध्वजः..
राक्षसेशस्य वदनं प्रेतस्य ध्वज आबभौ.. 16.67 ..
1.4.m: The great standard of Yama was a crow made of black iron; / the standard of the lord of rākṣasas shone with the face of a ghost.

1.4.s:
hemasiṃhadhvajau devau candrārkavamitadyuti..
kuṃbhena citravarṇena keturāśvinayorabhūt.. 16.68 ..
1.4.d:
हेमसिंहध्वजौ देवौ चन्द्रार्कवमितद्युति..
कुंभेन चित्रवर्णेन केतुराश्विनयोरभूत्.. 16.68 ..
1.4.m: The two gods whose luster flashed like the moon and sun had golden lion-standards; / the standard of the two Aśvins was [marked with] a multicolored water-pot.

1.4.s:
mātaṃgo hemaracitaścitraratnapariṣkṛtaḥ..
dhvajaḥ śatakratorāsītsitacā marasaṃsthitaḥ.. 16.69 ..
1.4.d:
मातंगो हेमरचितश्चित्ररत्नपरिष्कृतः..
ध्वजः शतक्रतोरासीत्सितचा मरसंस्थितः.. 16.69 ..
1.4.m: Śatakratu's standard was an elephant wrought of gold, adorned with variegated gems, / accompanied by white chowries.

1.4.s:
anyeṣāṃ ca dhvajāstatra nānārūpā babhū raṇe..
sanāgayakṣagaṃdharvamahoraganiśācarā.. 16.70 ..
1.4.d:
अन्येषां च ध्वजास्तत्र नानारूपा बभू रणे..
सनागयक्षगंधर्वमहोरगनिशाचरा.. 16.70 ..
1.4.m: And the banners of the others in that battle were of various forms; / along with nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, great serpents, and night-stalkers,

1.4.s:
senā sā devarājasya durjayā pratyadṛśyata..
koṭayastāstrayastriṃśannānādevakāyinām.. 16.71 ..
1.4.d:
सेना सा देवराजस्य दुर्जया प्रत्यदृश्यत..
कोटयस्तास्त्रयस्त्रिंशन्नानादेवकायिनाम्.. 16.71 ..
1.4.m: that army of the king of the gods, invincible, came into view, / consisting of thirty-three crores of diverse classes of gods.

1.4.s:
haimācalābhe sitakarṇacāmare suvarṇapadmāmalasuṃdarasraji..
kṛtābhirāmojjvalakuṃkumāṃkure kapolalītāvivimuktarāve.. 16.72 ..
1.4.d:
हैमाचलाभे सितकर्णचामरे सुवर्णपद्मामलसुंदरस्रजि..
कृताभिरामोज्ज्वलकुंकुमांकुरे कपोललीताविविमुक्तरावे.. 16.72 ..
1.4.m: Mounted upon that elephant named Airāvaṇa, resembling a mountain of gold, with white ear-chowries, wearing a lovely, spotless garland of golden lotuses, / adorned with radiant, charming saffron markings, with bees buzzing as they clung to his temples,

1.4.s:
śritastadairāvaṇanāmakuṃjare mahābalaścitraviśeṣitāṃbaraḥ..
viśālavajrāṃgavitānabhūṣitaḥ prakīrṇakeyūrabhujāgramaṃḍalaḥ.. 16.73 ..
1.4.d:
श्रितस्तदैरावणनामकुंजरे महाबलश्चित्रविशेषितांबरः..
विशालवज्रांगवितानभूषितः प्रकीर्णकेयूरभुजाग्रमंडलः.. 16.73 ..
1.4.m: the mighty [Indra] was seated, dressed in splendid, variegated garments, / adorned with a vast canopy studded with diamonds, the foreparts of his arms bedecked with armlets,

1.4.s:
sahasradṛgbaṃdisahasrasaṃstutastriviṣṭape'śobhata pākaśāsanaḥ.. 16.74 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārīkākhaṇḍe tārakāsuradevendrayuddhopakramavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 16 ..
1.4.d:
सहस्रदृग्बंदिसहस्रसंस्तुतस्त्रिविष्टपेऽशोभत पाकशासनः.. 16.74 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारीकाखण्डे तारकासुरदेवेन्द्रयुद्धोपक्रमवर्णनंनाम षोडशोऽध्यायः.. 16 ..
1.4.m:
the thousand-eyed Pākaśāsana, praised by thousands of bards, shone in the third heaven.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, entitled “Description of the Commencement of the Battle Between Tārakāsura and the Lord of the Gods,” in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tatastayoḥ samāyogaḥ senayorubhayorabhūt..
yugāṃte samanuprāpte yathā kṣubdhasamudrayoḥ.. 17.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततस्तयोः समायोगः सेनयोरुभयोरभूत्..
युगांते समनुप्राप्ते यथा क्षुब्धसमुद्रयोः.. 17.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Then the clash of those two armies occurred, / like that of two agitated oceans when the end of an eon arrives.

1.4.s:
surāsurāṇāṃ saṃmarde tasminparamadāruṇe..
tumulaṃ sumahatkrāṃte senayorubhayorapi.. 17.2 ..
1.4.d:
सुरासुराणां संमर्दे तस्मिन्परमदारुणे..
तुमुलं सुमहत्क्रांते सेनयोरुभयोरपि.. 17.2 ..
1.4.m: In that most dread encounter between the gods and asuras, / a very great, tumultuous battle broke out between both armies.

1.4.s:
garjatāṃ devadaityānāṃ śaṃkhabherīraveṇa ca..
tūryāṇāṃ caiva nirghoṣairmātaṃgānāṃ ca bṛṃhitaiḥ.. 17.3 ..
1.4.d:
गर्जतां देवदैत्यानां शंखभेरीरवेण च..
तूर्याणां चैव निर्घोषैर्मातंगानां च बृंहितैः.. 17.3 ..
1.4.m: With the roaring of gods and daityas, and the blast of conches and drums, / and with the noise of horns and the trumpeting of elephants,

1.4.s:
heṣitairhayavṛṃdānāṃ rathanemisvanena ca..
ghoṣeṇa caiva tūryāṇāṃ yugāṃta iva cābhavat.. 17.4 ..
1.4.d:
हेषितैर्हयवृंदानां रथनेमिस्वनेन च..
घोषेण चैव तूर्याणां युगांत इव चाभवत्.. 17.4 ..
1.4.m: with the neighing of troops of horses and the clatter of chariot wheels, / and with the sound of wind-instruments, it became like the end of an eon.

1.4.s:
roṣeṇābiparītāṃgāstyaktajīvitacetasaḥ..
samasajjanta tenyonyaṃ prakrameṇātilohitāḥ.. 17.5 ..
1.4.d:
रोषेणाबिपरीतांगास्त्यक्तजीवितचेतसः..
समसज्जन्त तेन्योन्यं प्रक्रमेणातिलोहिताः.. 17.5 ..
1.4.m: With limbs overcome by rage, having cast off thought of life, / they clashed with one another in turn, deeply smeared with blood.

1.4.s:
rathā rathaiḥ samāsaktā gajāścāpi mahāgajaiḥ..
pattayaḥ pattibhiścaiva hayāścāpi mahāhayaiḥ.. 17.6 ..
1.4.d:
रथा रथैः समासक्ता गजाश्चापि महागजैः..
पत्तयः पत्तिभिश्चैव हयाश्चापि महाहयैः.. 17.6 ..
1.4.m: Chariots locked with chariots, and elephants with great elephants, / foot soldiers with foot soldiers, and horses with great horses.

1.4.s:
tataḥ prāsāśanigadābhiṃḍipālaparaśvadhaiḥ..
śaktibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlairmudgaraiḥ kaṇayairguḍaiḥ.. 17.7 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रासाशनिगदाभिंडिपालपरश्वधैः..
शक्तिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैर्मुद्गरैः कणयैर्गुडैः.. 17.7 ..
1.4.m: Then with barbed darts, thunderbolts, maces, slings, and battleaxes, / with spears, flat-swords, tridents, mallets, javelins, and iron balls,

1.4.s:
cakraiśca śaktibhiścaiva tomarairaṃkuśairapi..
karṇinālīkanārācavatsadaṃtārddhacaṃdrakaiḥ.. 17.8 ..
1.4.d:
चक्रैश्च शक्तिभिश्चैव तोमरैरंकुशैरपि..
कर्णिनालीकनाराचवत्सदंतार्द्धचंद्रकैः.. 17.8 ..
1.4.m: and with discs, spears, lances, and elephant goads, / with barbed arrows, reed-arrows, iron arrows, calf-tooth arrows, and crescent-headed arrows,

1.4.s:
bhallairvetasapatraiśca śukatuṃḍaiśca nirmalaiḥ..
vṛṣṭibhiścādbhutākārairgaganaṃ samapadyata.. 17.9 ..
1.4.d:
भल्लैर्वेतसपत्रैश्च शुकतुंडैश्च निर्मलैः..
वृष्टिभिश्चाद्भुताकारैर्गगनं समपद्यत.. 17.9 ..
1.4.m: with broad-headed arrows, reed-leaf shafts, and spotless parrot-beak blades, / the sky became filled as if by showers of wondrous shapes.

1.4.s:
saṃpracchādya diśaḥ sarvāstamomayamivābhavat..
prājñāyaṃta na te'nyonyaṃ tasmiṃstamasi saṃkule.. 17.10 ..
1.4.d:
संप्रच्छाद्य दिशः सर्वास्तमोमयमिवाभवत्..
प्राज्ञायंत न तेऽन्योन्यं तस्मिंस्तमसि संकुले.. 17.10 ..
1.4.m: Covering all the directions, it became as if enveloped in darkness; / in that thick darkness they could not distinguish one another.

1.4.s:
adṛśyabhūtāstamasi nyakṛṃtaṃta parasparam..
tato bhujairdhvajaiśchatraiḥ śirobhiśca sakuṃḍalaiḥ.. 17.11 ..
1.4.d:
अदृश्यभूतास्तमसि न्यकृंतंत परस्परम्..
ततो भुजैर्ध्वजैश्छत्रैः शिरोभिश्च सकुंडलैः.. 17.11 ..
1.4.m: Becoming invisible in the darkness, they slashed at one another; / then, with arms, banners, parasols, and heads adorned with earrings,

1.4.s:
gajaisturaṃgaiḥ pādātaiḥ patadbhiḥ patitairapi..
ākāśaśiraso bhraṣṭaiḥ paṃkajairiva bhūścitā.. 17.12 ..
1.4.d:
गजैस्तुरंगैः पादातैः पतद्भिः पतितैरपि..
आकाशशिरसो भ्रष्टैः पंकजैरिव भूश्चिता.. 17.12 ..
1.4.m: with elephants, horses, and foot-soldiers falling and fallen, / the earth was strewn as if with lotuses fallen from the crest of the sky.

1.4.s:
bhagnadaṃtā bhinnakuṃbhāśchinnadīrghamahākarāḥ..
gajāḥ śailanibhāḥ peturdharaṇyāṃ rudhirasravāḥ.. 17.13 ..
1.4.d:
भग्नदंता भिन्नकुंभाश्छिन्नदीर्घमहाकराः..
गजाः शैलनिभाः पेतुर्धरण्यां रुधिरस्रवाः.. 17.13 ..
1.4.m: With broken tusks, split frontal globes, and severed long trunks, / mountain-like elephants fell upon the earth, pouring streams of blood.

1.4.s:
bhagnaiṣāśca rathāḥ peturbhagnākṣāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ..
pattayaḥ koṭiśaḥ petusturaṃgāśca sahasraśaḥ.. 17.14 ..
1.4.d:
भग्नैषाश्च रथाः पेतुर्भग्नाक्षाः शकलीकृताः..
पत्तयः कोटिशः पेतुस्तुरंगाश्च सहस्रशः.. 17.14 ..
1.4.m: Chariots fell with broken poles, broken axles, smashed to pieces; / foot-soldiers fell by the tens of millions, and horses by the thousands.

1.4.s:
tataḥ śoṇitanadyaśca harṣadāḥ piśitāśinām..
vaitālānaṃdadāyinyo vyajāyaṃta sahasraśaḥ.. 17.15 ..
1.4.d:
ततः शोणितनद्यश्च हर्षदाः पिशिताशिनाम्..
वैतालानंददायिन्यो व्यजायंत सहस्रशः.. 17.15 ..
1.4.m: Then thousands of rivers of blood arose, / giving joy to flesh-eaters and bringing delight to vetālas.

1.4.s:
tasmiṃstathāvidhe yuddhe senānīrgrasano'rihā..
bāṇavarṣeṇa mahatā devasainyamakaṃpayat.. 17.16 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिंस्तथाविधे युद्धे सेनानीर्ग्रसनोऽरिहा..
बाणवर्षेण महता देवसैन्यमकंपयत्.. 17.16 ..
1.4.m: In that sort of battle, the commander Grasana, the slayer of foes, / shook the army of the gods with a great rain of arrows.

1.4.s:
tato grasanamālokya yamaḥ krodhavimūrchitaḥ..
vavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa viśeṣādagnivarcasā.. 17.17 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ग्रसनमालोक्य यमः क्रोधविमूर्छितः..
ववर्ष शरवर्षेण विशेषादग्निवर्चसा.. 17.17 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing Grasana, Yama, overcome with fury, / rained down a shower of arrows, especially brilliant with fire.

1.4.s:
sa viddho bahubhirṣāṇairgrasano'tiparākramaḥ..
kṛtapratikṛtākāṃkṣī dhanurānamya bhairavam.. 17.18 ..
1.4.d:
स विद्धो बहुभिर्षाणैर्ग्रसनोऽतिपराक्रमः..
कृतप्रतिकृताकांक्षी धनुरानम्य भैरवम्.. 17.18 ..
1.4.m: Pierced by many arrows, Grasana, endowed with immense prowess, / wishing to return blow for blow, bent his dreadful bow,

1.4.s:
śaraiḥ sahasraiśca pañcalakṣaiścaiva vyatāḍayat..
grasanena vimuktāṃstāñcharānsopi nivārya ca.. 17.19 ..
1.4.d:
शरैः सहस्रैश्च पञ्चलक्षैश्चैव व्यताडयत्..
ग्रसनेन विमुक्तांस्ताञ्छरान्सोपि निवार्य च.. 17.19 ..
1.4.m: and struck with thousands and five hundred thousand arrows; / having warded off those arrows loosed by Grasana,

1.4.s:
bāṇavṛṣṭibhirugrābhiryamo grasanamardayat..
kṛtāṃtaśaravṛṣṭīnāṃ saṃtatīḥ pratisarpatīḥ..
ciccheda śaravarṣeṇa grasano dānaveśvaraḥ.. 17.20 ..
1.4.d:
बाणवृष्टिभिरुग्राभिर्यमो ग्रसनमर्दयत्..
कृतांतशरवृष्टीनां संततीः प्रतिसर्पतीः..
चिच्छेद शरवर्षेण ग्रसनो दानवेश्वरः.. 17.20 ..
1.4.m: Yama harassed Grasana with fierce showers of arrows; / Grasana, lord of dānavas, sliced through the continuous lines of arrows advancing from Kṛtānta with a rain of arrows.

1.4.s: viphalāṃ tāṃ samālokya yamaḥ svaśarasaṃtatim.. 17.21 ..
1.4.d: विफलां तां समालोक्य यमः स्वशरसंततिम्.. 17.21 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that line of his own arrows rendered fruitless, Yama / [turned his wrath toward him].

1.4.s:
prāhiṇonmudgaraṃ dīptaṃ grasanasya rathaṃ prati..
sa taṃ mudgaramāyāṃtamutpatya rathasattamāt.. 17.22 ..
1.4.d:
प्राहिणोन्मुद्गरं दीप्तं ग्रसनस्य रथं प्रति..
स तं मुद्गरमायांतमुत्पत्य रथसत्तमात्.. 17.22 ..
1.4.m: He hurled a blazing mallet toward Grasana's chariot; / seeing that mallet arriving, leaping up from his excellent chariot,

1.4.s:
jagrāha vāmahastena līlayā grasano'rihā..
tenaiva mudgareṇātha yamasya mahiṣaṃ ruṣā.. 17.23 ..
1.4.d:
जग्राह वामहस्तेन लीलया ग्रसनोऽरिहा..
तेनैव मुद्गरेणाथ यमस्य महिषं रुषा.. 17.23 ..
1.4.m: Grasana, the slayer of enemies, caught it playfully with his left hand; / then, with that very mallet, in anger, at Yama's buffalo

1.4.s:
tāḍayāmāsa vegena sa papāta mahītale..
utpatyātha yamastasmānmahiṣānnipatiṣyataḥ.. 17.24 ..
1.4.d:
ताडयामास वेगेन स पपात महीतले..
उत्पत्याथ यमस्तस्मान्महिषान्निपतिष्यतः.. 17.24 ..
1.4.m: he struck with force, and it fell to the surface of the earth; / then Yama, springing up from that buffalo about to fall,

1.4.s:
prāsena tāḍayāmāsa grasanaṃ vadane dṛḍham..
sa tu prāptaprahāreṇa mūrchito nyapatadbhuvi.. 17.25 ..
1.4.d:
प्रासेन ताडयामास ग्रसनं वदने दृढम्..
स तु प्राप्तप्रहारेण मूर्छितो न्यपतद्भुवि.. 17.25 ..
1.4.m: struck Grasana firmly in the face with a barbed dart; / he, struck by that blow, fell unconscious upon the ground.

1.4.s:
grasanaṃ patita dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho bhīmaparākramaḥ..
yamasya bhiṃḍipālena prahāramakaroddhṛdi .. 17.26 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रसनं पतित दृष्ट्वा जंभो भीमपराक्रमः..
यमस्य भिंडिपालेन प्रहारमकरोद्धृदि .. 17.26 ..
1.4.m: Seeing Grasana fallen, Jambha of terrifying prowess / dealt a blow to Yama's chest with a sling.

1.4.s:
yamastena prahāreṇa susrāva rudhiraṃ mukhāt..
atigāḍha prahārārttaḥ kṛtāṃtomūrchito'bhavat.. 17.27 ..
1.4.d:
यमस्तेन प्रहारेण सुस्राव रुधिरं मुखात्..
अतिगाढ प्रहारार्त्तः कृतांतोमूर्छितोऽभवत्.. 17.27 ..
1.4.m: From that blow, Yama discharged blood from his mouth; / afflicted by the exceedingly deep strike, Kṛtānta fell unconscious.

1.4.s:
kṛtāṃtamarditaṃ dṛṣṭvā gadāpāṇirdhanādipaḥ..
vṛto yakṣāyutagaṇairjaṃbhaṃ pratyudyayau ruṣaā.. 17.28 ..
1.4.d:
कृतांतमर्दितं दृष्ट्वा गदापाणिर्धनादिपः..
वृतो यक्षायुतगणैर्जंभं प्रत्युद्ययौ रुषआ.. 17.28 ..
1.4.m: Seeing Kṛtānta tormented, the Lord of Wealth, mace in hand, / surrounded by tens of thousands of Yakṣas, advanced against Jambha in wrath.

1.4.s:
jaṃbho ruṣā tamāyāṃtaṃ dānavā nīkasaṃvṛtaḥ..
jagrāha vākyaṃ rājñastu yatā snigdhena bhāṣitam.. 17.29 ..
1.4.d:
जंभो रुषा तमायांतं दानवा नीकसंवृतः..
जग्राह वाक्यं राज्ञस्तु यता स्निग्धेन भाषितम्.. 17.29 ..
1.4.m: Jambha, surrounded by his host of Dānavas, as he came in wrath, / grasped the words that were spoken affectionately by the king.

1.4.s:
grasano labdhasaṃjño'tha yamasya prāhiṇodgadām..
maṇihemapariṣkārāṃ gurvī parighamardinīm.. 17.30 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रसनो लब्धसंज्ञोऽथ यमस्य प्राहिणोद्गदाम्..
मणिहेमपरिष्कारां गुर्वी परिघमर्दिनीम्.. 17.30 ..
1.4.m: Then Grasana, having regained consciousness, hurled a mace at Yama, / adorned with jewels and gold, heavy, and crushing iron bars.

1.4.s:
tāmāpataṃtīṃ saṃprekṣya gadāṃ mahiṣavāhanaḥ..
gadāyāḥ pratighātārthaṃ jagajjvalanabhairavam.. 17.31 ..
1.4.d:
तामापतंतीं संप्रेक्ष्य गदां महिषवाहनः..
गदायाः प्रतिघातार्थं जगज्ज्वलनभैरवम्.. 17.31 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that mace hurtling toward him, he whose mount is the buffalo, / to thwart the mace, [loosed a rod] terrible as the fire of the universe,

1.4.s:
daṃḍaṃ mumoca kopena jvālāmālāsamākulam..
sa gadāṃ viyati prāpya rarāsāṃbudharoddhatam.. 17.32 ..
1.4.d:
दंडं मुमोच कोपेन ज्वालामालासमाकुलम्..
स गदां वियति प्राप्य ररासांबुधरोद्धतम्.. 17.32 ..
1.4.m: In anger he loosed his rod, blazing with garlands of flames; / reaching the mace in the sky, it roared like a swollen cloud.

1.4.s:
saṃvaṭṭaścābhavattābhyāṃ śailābhyāmiva duḥsahaḥ..
tābhyāṃ niṣpeṣanirhrāda jaḍīkṛtadigaṃtaram.. 17.33 ..
1.4.d:
संवट्टश्चाभवत्ताभ्यां शैलाभ्यामिव दुःसहः..
ताभ्यां निष्पेषनिर्ह्राद जडीकृतदिगंतरम्.. 17.33 ..
1.4.m: A collision occurred between the two, unbearable as that of two mountains; / with the crash of their impact, it stunned the quarters of the horizon.

1.4.s:
jagadvyākulatāṃ yātaṃ pralayāgamaśaṃkayā..
kṣaṇātpraśāṃtanirhrādaṃ jvaladulkāsamācitam.. 17.34 ..
1.4.d:
जगद्व्याकुलतां यातं प्रलयागमशंकया..
क्षणात्प्रशांतनिर्ह्रादं ज्वलदुल्कासमाचितम्.. 17.34 ..
1.4.m: The world fell into agitation out of fear of the arrival of dissolution; / in an instant the noise died down, [yet] filled with blazing meteors,

1.4.s:
niṣpeṣaṇaṃ tayorbhīmama bhūdganagocaram..
nihatyātha gadāṃ daṇḍastato grasanamūrdhani.. 17.35 ..
1.4.d:
निष्पेषणं तयोर्भीमम भूद्गनगोचरम्..
निहत्याथ गदां दण्डस्ततो ग्रसनमूर्धनि.. 17.35 ..
1.4.m: The terrible collision of the two took place in the sky. / Then, having struck down the mace, the rod [fell] onto Grasana's head;

1.4.s:
papāta pauruṣaṃ hatvā yathā daivaṃ purārjitam..
satu tena prahāreṇa dṛṣṭvā satimirādiśaḥ.. 17.36 ..
1.4.d:
पपात पौरुषं हत्वा यथा दैवं पुरार्जितम्..
सतु तेन प्रहारेण दृष्ट्वा सतिमिरादिशः.. 17.36 ..
1.4.m: It fell, striking down his human effort, just as previously earned destiny [strikes a man]. / From that blow, seeing the directions enveloped in darkness,

1.4.s:
papāta bhūmau niḥsaṃjño bhūmireṇuvibhūṣitaḥ..
tato hāhāravo ghoraḥ senayorubhayorabhūt.. 17.37 ..
1.4.d:
पपात भूमौ निःसंज्ञो भूमिरेणुविभूषितः..
ततो हाहारवो घोरः सेनयोरुभयोरभूत्.. 17.37 ..
1.4.m: He fell to the ground unconscious, covered with the dust of the earth. / Then a dreadful cry of "Alas, alas!" arose from both armies.

1.4.s:
tato mahūrtamātreṇa grasanaḥ prāpya cetanām..
apaśyatsvāṃ tanuṃ dhvastāṃ vilolābharaṇāṃbarām.. 17.38 ..
1.4.d:
ततो महूर्तमात्रेण ग्रसनः प्राप्य चेतनाम्..
अपश्यत्स्वां तनुं ध्वस्तां विलोलाभरणांबराम्.. 17.38 ..
1.4.m: Then in just a moment, Grasana regained consciousness / and saw his body shattered, his ornaments and garments disheveled.

1.4.s:
sa cāpi ciṃtayāmāsa kṛtapratikṛtakriyām..
dhigastu pauruṣaṃ mahyaṃ prabhoragresaraḥ katham.. 17.39 ..
1.4.d:
स चापि चिंतयामास कृतप्रतिकृतक्रियाम्..
धिगस्तु पौरुषं मह्यं प्रभोरग्रेसरः कथम्.. 17.39 ..
1.4.m: He too reflected upon retaliation for the deed done: / "Fie on my prowess! How can I be the leader of my lord?

1.4.s:
mayyāśritāni sainyāni jite mayi jitāni ca..
asaṃbhāvitarūpo hi sajjano modate sukham.. 17.40 ..
1.4.d:
मय्याश्रितानि सैन्यानि जिते मयि जितानि च..
असंभावितरूपो हि सज्जनो मोदते सुखम्.. 17.40 ..
1.4.m: The troops depend on me; if I am defeated, they too are defeated. / A good man unburdened by expectations indeed rejoices in comfort;

1.4.s:
saṃbhāvitastvaśaktaścettasya nāyaṃ paro'pi vā..
evaṃ saṃciṃtya vegena samuttasthau mahābalaḥ.. 17.41 ..
1.4.d:
संभावितस्त्वशक्तश्चेत्तस्य नायं परोऽपि वा..
एवं संचिंत्य वेगेन समुत्तस्थौ महाबलः.. 17.41 ..
1.4.m: But if an esteemed man proves incapable, neither this world nor the next belongs to him." / Thinking thus, the mighty warrior rose up with swiftness.

1.4.s:
mudgaraṃ kāladaṇḍābhaṃ gṛhītvā girisaṃnibham..
grasano ghorasaṃkalpaḥ saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭacchadaḥ.. 17.42 ..
1.4.d:
मुद्गरं कालदण्डाभं गृहीत्वा गिरिसंनिभम्..
ग्रसनो घोरसंकल्पः संदष्टौष्ठपुटच्छदः.. 17.42 ..
1.4.m: Taking up a club resembling a mountain, like the staff of Death, / Grasana, dreadful in his resolve, bit his lips.

1.4.s:
rathena tvarito'gacchadāsasādāṃtakaṃ raṇe..
samāsādya yamaṃ yuddhe grasano bhrāmya mudgaram.. 17.43 ..
1.4.d:
रथेन त्वरितोऽगच्छदाससादांतकं रणे..
समासाद्य यमं युद्धे ग्रसनो भ्राम्य मुद्गरम्.. 17.43 ..
1.4.m: Quickly mounted on his chariot, he went and approached Antaka in battle; / having approached Yama in battle, Grasana swung his club

1.4.s:
vegena mahatā raudraṃ cikṣepa yamamūrdhani..
vilokya mudgaraṃ dīptaṃ yamaḥ saṃbhrāṃtalocanaḥ.. 17.44 ..
1.4.d:
वेगेन महता रौद्रं चिक्षेप यममूर्धनि..
विलोक्य मुद्गरं दीप्तं यमः संभ्रांतलोचनः.. 17.44 ..
1.4.m: And hurled the fierce [weapon] with great force at Yama's head. / Seeing the blazing club, Yama, his eyes wide in agitation,

1.4.s:
vaṃcayāmāsa durddharṣaṃ mudgaraṃ taṃ mahābalaḥ..
tasminnapasṛte dūraṃ caṃḍānāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām.. 17.45 ..
1.4.d:
वंचयामास दुर्द्धर्षं मुद्गरं तं महाबलः..
तस्मिन्नपसृते दूरं चंडानां भीमकर्मणाम्.. 17.45 ..
1.4.m: That mighty one dodged the irresistible club. / When it had flown far away, it crushed ten thousand

1.4.s:
yāmyānāṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ ca ayutaṃ niṣpipeṣa ha..
tatastadayutaṃ dṛṣṭvā hataṃ kiṃkaravāhinī.. 17.46 ..
1.4.d:
याम्यानां किंकराणां च अयुतं निष्पिपेष ह..
ततस्तदयुतं दृष्ट्वा हतं किंकरवाहिनी.. 17.46 ..
1.4.m: Of Yama's attendants, who were fierce and performed terrible deeds. / Then, seeing that ten thousand slain, the army of attendants,

1.4.s:
daśārbudamitā kruddhā grasanāyānvadhāvata..
grasanastu samālokya tāṃ kiṃkaramayāṃ śubhām.. 17.47 ..
1.4.d:
दशार्बुदमिता क्रुद्धा ग्रसनायान्वधावत..
ग्रसनस्तु समालोक्य तां किंकरमयां शुभाम्.. 17.47 ..
1.4.m: Numbering a billion, ran furiously against Grasana. / But Grasana, beholding that splendid host of attendants,

1.4.s:
mene yamasahasrāṇi tādṛgrūpabalā hi sā..
vigāhya grasanaṃ senā vavarṣa śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ.. 17.48 ..
1.4.d:
मेने यमसहस्राणि तादृग्रूपबला हि सा..
विगाह्य ग्रसनं सेना ववर्ष शरवृष्टिभिः.. 17.48 ..
1.4.m: Thought them to be thousands of Yamas, for they were identical in form and strength. / Plunging toward Grasana, the army showered rains of arrows.

1.4.s:
kalpāṃtaghorasaṃkāśo babhūva sa mahāraṇaḥ..
kecicchailena bibhiduḥ kecidbāṇairajihyagaiḥ.. 17.49 ..
1.4.d:
कल्पांतघोरसंकाशो बभूव स महारणः..
केचिच्छैलेन बिभिदुः केचिद्बाणैरजिह्यगैः.. 17.49 ..
1.4.m: That great battle became dreadful, like the end of a cosmic cycle: / some tore [him] with rocks, some with straight-flying arrows,

1.4.s:
pipiṣurgadayā kecitkocinmudgaravṛṣṭibhiḥ..
kecitprāsaprahāraiśca tāḍayāmāsuruddhatāḥ.. 17.50 ..
1.4.d:
पिपिषुर्गदया केचित्कोचिन्मुद्गरवृष्टिभिः..
केचित्प्रासप्रहारैश्च ताडयामासुरुद्धताः.. 17.50 ..
1.4.m: Some crushed [him] with maces, some with showers of clubs, / and some haughtily struck him with thrusts of javelins.

1.4.s:
apare kiṃkarāstasya lalaṃburbāhumaṃḍale..
śilābhirapare jaghnurdrumairanye mahocchrayaiḥ.. 17.51 ..
1.4.d:
अपरे किंकरास्तस्य ललंबुर्बाहुमंडले..
शिलाभिरपरे जघ्नुर्द्रुमैरन्ये महोच्छ्रयैः.. 17.51 ..
1.4.m: Other attendants clung to his arms; / others struck him with stones, and others with lofty trees.

1.4.s:
tasyāpare ca gātreṣu daśanāṃścanyapātayan..
apare muṣṭibhiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kiṃkarāstāḍayaṃti ca .. 17.52 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यापरे च गात्रेषु दशनांश्चन्यपातयन्..
अपरे मुष्टिभिः पृष्ठं किंकरास्ताडयंति च .. 17.52 ..
1.4.m: And others sank their teeth into his limbs; / other attendants pounded his back with their fists.

1.4.s:
evaṃ cābhidrutastaiḥ sa grasanaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ..
utsādya gātraṃ bhūpṛṣṭhe niṣpipeṣa sahasraśaḥ.. 17.53 ..
1.4.d:
एवं चाभिद्रुतस्तैः स ग्रसनः क्रोधमूर्छितः..
उत्साद्य गात्रं भूपृष्ठे निष्पिपेष सहस्रशः.. 17.53 ..
1.4.m: Thus attacked by them, Grasana, frantic with rage, / shook his body and crushed thousands onto the surface of the earth.

1.4.s:
kāṃścidutthāya jaghne'sau muṣṭibhiḥ kiṃkarānraṇe..
kāṃścitpādaprahāreṇa dhāvannanyānacūrṇayat.. 17.54 ..
1.4.d:
कांश्चिदुत्थाय जघ्नेऽसौ मुष्टिभिः किंकरान्रणे..
कांश्चित्पादप्रहारेण धावन्नन्यानचूर्णयत्.. 17.54 ..
1.4.m: Rising up, he struck some attendants in battle with fists; / he pounded some with kicks of his feet, and running, pulverized others.

1.4.s:
kṣaṇaikena sa tānninye yamalokāyabhārata..
sa ca kiṃkarayuddhena vavṛdhe'gnirivaidhasā.. 17.55 ..
1.4.d:
क्षणैकेन स तान्निन्ये यमलोकायभारत..
स च किंकरयुद्धेन ववृधेऽग्निरिवैधसा.. 17.55 ..
1.4.m: In a single moment he dispatched them to the realm of Yama, O Bhārata; / and by the fight with the attendants, he grew like fire with fuel.

1.4.s:
tamālokya yamo'śrāṃtaṃ śrāṃtaṃstāṃśca hatānsvakān..
ājagāma samudyamya daṃḍaṃ mahiṣavāhanaḥ.. 17.56 ..
1.4.d:
तमालोक्य यमोऽश्रांतं श्रांतंस्तांश्च हतान्स्वकान्..
आजगाम समुद्यम्य दंडं महिषवाहनः.. 17.56 ..
1.4.m: Seeing him unwearied and his own men weary and slain, / Yama, whose mount is the buffalo, came forward, raising his rod.

1.4.s:
grasanastu tamāyāṃtamājaghne gadayorasi..
aciṃtayitvā tatkarma grasanasyāṃtako'rihā.. 17.57 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रसनस्तु तमायांतमाजघ्ने गदयोरसि..
अचिंतयित्वा तत्कर्म ग्रसनस्यांतकोऽरिहा.. 17.57 ..
1.4.m: Grasana struck him upon the chest with a mace as he approached; / Antaka, the slayer of foes, paid no heed to that deed of Grasana,

1.4.s:
vyāghrāndaṃḍena saṃjaghne sa rathānnya patadbhuvi..
tataḥ kṣaṇena cotthāya saṃciṃtyātmānamuddhataḥ.. 17.58 ..
1.4.d:
व्याघ्रान्दंडेन संजघ्ने स रथान्न्य पतद्भुवि..
ततः क्षणेन चोत्थाय संचिंत्यात्मानमुद्धतः.. 17.58 ..
1.4.m: And struck down his tigers with his rod; [Grasana] fell from the chariot to the earth. / Then, rising in an instant and considering his dignity, proud,

1.4.s:
vāyuvegena sahasā yayau yamarathaṃ prati..
padātiḥ sa rathaṃ taṃ ca samāruhya yamaṃ tadā.. 17.59 ..
1.4.d:
वायुवेगेन सहसा ययौ यमरथं प्रति..
पदातिः स रथं तं च समारुह्य यमं तदा.. 17.59 ..
1.4.m: He rushed suddenly with the speed of wind toward Yama's chariot; / on foot, mounting that chariot, he then

1.4.s:
yodhayāmāsa bāhubhyāmākṛṣya balināṃ varaḥ..
yamo'pi śastrāṇyutsṛjca bāhuyuddhe pravartate.. 17.60 ..
1.4.d:
योधयामास बाहुभ्यामाकृष्य बलिनां वरः..
यमोऽपि शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्च बाहुयुद्धे प्रवर्तते.. 17.60 ..
1.4.m: Engaged Yama, pulling him with both arms, he the best of the strong; / Yama too, casting aside his weapons, engaged in arm-to-arm combat.

1.4.s:
grasanaṃ kaṭivastre tu yamaṃ gṛhya balotkaṭaḥ..
bhrāmayāmāsa vegena saṃbhramāviṣṭacetasam.. 17.61 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रसनं कटिवस्त्रे तु यमं गृह्य बलोत्कटः..
भ्रामयामास वेगेन संभ्रमाविष्टचेतसम्.. 17.61 ..
1.4.m: Seizing Grasana by the waistcloth, Yama, vehement in strength, / whirled him around with speed as his mind became bewildered.

1.4.s:
vimocyātha yamaḥ kaṣṭātkaṃṭhe'vaṣṭabhya cāsuram..
bāhubhyāṃ bhrāmayāmāsa so'pyātmānamamocayat.. 17.62 ..
1.4.d:
विमोच्याथ यमः कष्टात्कंठेऽवष्टभ्य चासुरम्..
बाहुभ्यां भ्रामयामास सोऽप्यात्मानममोचयत्.. 17.62 ..
1.4.m: Then, freeing himself with difficulty, Yama gripped the Asura by the neck / and whirled him with both arms; he too freed himself.

1.4.s:
tato jaghnaturanyonyaṃ muṣṭibhirnirdayau ca tau..
daityeṃdrasyātivīryatvātpariśrāṃtataro yamaḥ.. 17.63 ..
1.4.d:
ततो जघ्नतुरन्योन्यं मुष्टिभिर्निर्दयौ च तौ..
दैत्येंद्रस्यातिवीर्यत्वात्परिश्रांततरो यमः.. 17.63 ..
1.4.m: Then the two mercilessly struck each other with fists; / because the Daitya lord possessed excessive strength, Yama became utterly exhausted.

1.4.s:
skaṃdhe nidhāya daityasya mukhaṃ viśrāṃtimaicchata..
tamā lakṣya tato daityaḥ śrāṃtamutpāṭya caujasā.. 17.64 ..
1.4.d:
स्कंधे निधाय दैत्यस्य मुखं विश्रांतिमैच्छत..
तमा लक्ष्य ततो दैत्यः श्रांतमुत्पाट्य चौजसा.. 17.64 ..
1.4.m: Placing his face on the shoulder of the Daitya, he sought rest. / Perceiving him exhausted, the Daitya then ripped him up with his might

1.4.s:
niṣpipeṣa mahīpṛṣṭhe vinighnanpārṣṇipāṇibhiḥ..
tato yamasya vadanātsusrāva rudhiraṃ bahu.. 17.65 ..
1.4.d:
निष्पिपेष महीपृष्ठे विनिघ्नन्पार्ष्णिपाणिभिः..
ततो यमस्य वदनात्सुस्राव रुधिरं बहु.. 17.65 ..
1.4.m: And crushed him upon the surface of the earth, striking him with heels and fists; / then copious blood flowed from Yama's mouth.

1.4.s:
nirjīvamiti taṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ saṃtyajya dānavaḥ..
jayaṃ prāpyoddhataṃ nādaṃ muktvā saṃtrāsya devatāḥ.. 17.66 ..
1.4.d:
निर्जीवमिति तं दृष्ट्वा ततः संत्यज्य दानवः..
जयं प्राप्योद्धतं नादं मुक्त्वा संत्रास्य देवताः.. 17.66 ..
1.4.m: Seeing him lifeless, the Dānava then released him; / having attained victory, he let out a fierce roar, terrifying the deities,

1.4.s: svakaṃ sainyaṃ samāsādya tasthau giririvācalaḥ.. 17.67 ..
1.4.d: स्वकं सैन्यं समासाद्य तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः.. 17.67 ..
1.4.m: And having returned to his own army, he stood immovable like a mountain.

1.4.s:
nādena tasya grasanasya saṃkhye mahāyudhaiścārditasarvagātrāḥ..
gate kṛthāṃte vasudhāṃ ca niṣprabhe cakaṃpire kāṃdiśikāḥ surāste.. 17.68 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe tārakasainyadevasainyayormadhye yamagrasanayoryuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 17 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
नादेन तस्य ग्रसनस्य संख्ये महायुधैश्चार्दितसर्वगात्राः..
गते कृथांते वसुधां च निष्प्रभे चकंपिरे कांदिशिकाः सुरास्ते.. 17.68 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्त्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे तारकसैन्यदेवसैन्ययोर्मध्ये यमग्रसनयोर्युद्धवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः.. 17 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
At that roar of Grasana in the battle, all their limbs tormented by mighty weapons, / when Kṛtānta had fallen to the earth and lost his luster, those gods fled in all directions, trembling.
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Battle between Yama and Grasana in the Midst of the Armies of Tāraka and the Gods', in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
dhanādhipasya jaṃbhena sāyakairmarmabhedibhiḥ..
diśoparuddhāḥ kruddhena sainyaṃ cābhyarditaṃ bhṛśam.. 18.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
धनाधिपस्य जंभेन सायकैर्मर्मभेदिभिः..
दिशोपरुद्धाः क्रुद्धेन सैन्यं चाभ्यर्दितं भृशम्.. 18.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / The directions were blocked and the army was severely afflicted / by the enraged Jambha with arrows piercing the vitals of the Lord of Wealth.

1.4.s:
taddṛṣṭvā karma daityasya dhanādhyakṣaḥ pratāpavān..
ākarṇākṛṣṭacāpastu jaṃbhamājau mahābalam.. 18.2 ..
1.4.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा कर्म दैत्यस्य धनाध्यक्षः प्रतापवान्..
आकर्णाकृष्टचापस्तु जंभमाजौ महाबलम्.. 18.2 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that deed of the Daitya, the glorious overseer of wealth, / drawing his bow up to his ear, [shot] at the mighty Jambha in battle.

1.4.s:
hṛdi vivyādha bāṇānāṃ sahasreṇāgnivarcasām..
sa prahasya tato vīro bāṇānāmayutatrayam.. 18.3 ..
1.4.d:
हृदि विव्याध बाणानां सहस्रेणाग्निवर्चसाम्..
स प्रहस्य ततो वीरो बाणानामयुतत्रयम्.. 18.3 ..
1.4.m: He pierced him in the heart with a thousand arrows having the brilliance of fire. / Then that hero laughed aloud, and in an instant hurled / thirty thousand arrows,

1.4.s:
niyutaṃ ca tathā koṭimarbudaṃ cākṣipatkṣaṇāt..
tasya tallāghravaṃ dṛṣaṭvā kruddho gṛhya mahāgadām.. 18.4 ..
1.4.d:
नियुतं च तथा कोटिमर्बुदं चाक्षिपत्क्षणात्..
तस्य तल्लाघ्रवं दृषट्वा क्रुद्धो गृह्य महागदाम्.. 18.4 ..
1.4.m: and likewise a hundred thousand, ten million, and a hundred million arrows. / Seeing his lightness of hand, the enraged [Lord of Wealth] took up a great mace,

1.4.s:
dhanādhyakṣaḥ pracikṣepa svargepsuḥ svadhanaṃ yathā..
muktāyāṃ vai nādo'bhūtpralaye yathā.. 18.5 ..
1.4.d:
धनाध्यक्षः प्रचिक्षेप स्वर्गेप्सुः स्वधनं यथा..
मुक्तायां वै नादोऽभूत्प्रलये यथा.. 18.5 ..
1.4.m: and the overseer of wealth hurled it, just as one desiring heaven gives away his wealth. / When it was released, a roar arose like that at the dissolution of the world.

1.4.s:
bhūtānāṃ bahudhā rāvā jajñire khe mahābhayāḥ..
vāyuśca sumahāñjajñe khamāyānmeghasaṃkulam.. 18.6 ..
1.4.d:
भूतानां बहुधा रावा जज्ञिरे खे महाभयाः..
वायुश्च सुमहाञ्जज्ञे खमायान्मेघसंकुलम्.. 18.6 ..
1.4.m: Terrifying roars of creatures arose in many ways in the sky; / a tremendous wind arose, and the sky became filled with clouds.

1.4.s:
sā hi vaiśravaṇasyāste trailokyābhyarcitā gadā..
āyāṃtīṃ tāṃ samālokya taḍitsaṃghātadurddaśām.. 18.7 ..
1.4.d:
सा हि वैश्रवणस्यास्ते त्रैलोक्याभ्यर्चिता गदा..
आयांतीं तां समालोक्य तडित्संघातदुर्द्दशाम्.. 18.7 ..
1.4.m: For that mace of Vaiśravaṇa was worshipped throughout the three worlds. / Seeing it approaching, terrible to behold like a cluster of lightning flashes,

1.4.s:
daityo gadāvighātārthaṃ śastravṛṣṭiṃ mumoca ha..
cakrāṇi kuṇapānprāsāñchataghnīḥ paṭṭiśāṃstathā.. 18.8 ..
1.4.d:
दैत्यो गदाविघातार्थं शस्त्रवृष्टिं मुमोच ह..
चक्राणि कुणपान्प्रासाञ्छतघ्नीः पट्टिशांस्तथा.. 18.8 ..
1.4.m: the Daitya released a shower of weapons to thwart the mace: / discs, clubs, darts, centuple-killers, and cleavers,

1.4.s:
parighānmuśalānvṛkṣāngirīṃścātulavikramaḥ..
kadarthīkṛtya śastrāṇi tāni sarvāṇi sā gadā.. 18.9 ..
1.4.d:
परिघान्मुशलान्वृक्षान्गिरींश्चातुलविक्रमः..
कदर्थीकृत्य शस्त्राणि तानि सर्वाणि सा गदा.. 18.9 ..
1.4.m: iron bars, pestles, trees, and mountains, being of matchless prowess. / Frustrating all those weapons, that mace,

1.4.s:
kalpāṃtabhāskaro yadvannyapataddaityavakṣasi..
sa tayā gāḍhabhinnaḥ sansaphenarudhiraṃ vaman.. 18.10 ..
1.4.d:
कल्पांतभास्करो यद्वन्न्यपतद्दैत्यवक्षसि..
स तया गाढभिन्नः सन्सफेनरुधिरं वमन्.. 18.10 ..
1.4.m: like the sun at the end of an aeon, struck down upon the Daitya's chest. / Deeply pierced by it, vomiting frothy blood,

1.4.s:
niḥpapāta rathājjaṃbho vasudhāṃ gatacetanaḥ..
jaṃbhaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kujaṃbho ghoraniścayaḥ.. 18.11 ..
1.4.d:
निःपपात रथाज्जंभो वसुधां गतचेतनः..
जंभं निपतितं दृष्ट्वा कुजंभो घोरनिश्चयः.. 18.11 ..
1.4.m: Jambha fell unconscious from his chariot onto the ground. / Seeing Jambha fallen, Kujambha of terrible resolve,

1.4.s:
dhanādhipasya saṃkruddho nādenāpūrayandiśaḥ..
cakre bāṇamayaṃ jālaṃ śakuṃtasyeva paṃjaram.. 18.12 ..
1.4.d:
धनाधिपस्य संक्रुद्धो नादेनापूरयन्दिशः..
चक्रे बाणमयं जालं शकुंतस्येव पंजरम्.. 18.12 ..
1.4.m: furious at the Lord of Wealth, filling the directions with his roar, / created a cage of arrows like a cage around a bird.

1.4.s:
vicchidya bāṇajālaṃ ca māyājālamivotkaṭam..
mumoca bāṇānaparāṃstasya yakṣādhipo balī.. 18.13 ..
1.4.d:
विच्छिद्य बाणजालं च मायाजालमिवोत्कटम्..
मुमोच बाणानपरांस्तस्य यक्षाधिपो बली.. 18.13 ..
1.4.m: Shattering that snare of arrows, which was fierce like a snare of illusions, / the mighty lord of the yakṣas released other arrows at him.

1.4.s:
ciccheda līlayā tāṃśca daityaḥ krodhīva sadvacaḥ..
niṣphalāṃstāṃstato dṛṣṭvā bāṇānkruddho dhanādhipaḥ.. 18.14 ..
1.4.d:
चिच्छेद लीलया तांश्च दैत्यः क्रोधीव सद्वचः..
निष्फलांस्तांस्ततो दृष्ट्वा बाणान्क्रुद्धो धनाधिपः.. 18.14 ..
1.4.m: The Daitya casually cut them down, as an angry man rejects good counsel. / Seeing those arrows rendered futile, the enraged Lord of Wealth

1.4.s:
śaktiṃ jagrāha durdharṣāṃ śataghaṃṭāmahāsvanām..
preṣitā sā tadā śaktirdārayāmāsa taṃ hṛti.. 18.15 ..
1.4.d:
शक्तिं जग्राह दुर्धर्षां शतघंटामहास्वनाम्..
प्रेषिता सा तदा शक्तिर्दारयामास तं हृति.. 18.15 ..
1.4.m: seized an irresistible spear resounding loudly with a hundred bells. / Flung at that time, that spear pierced him in the chest,

1.4.s:
yathālpabodhaṃ puruṣaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārasaṃbhavam..
tathāsya hṛdayaṃ bhittvā jagāma dharaṇītalam.. 18.16 ..
1.4.d:
यथाल्पबोधं पुरुषं दुःखं संसारसंभवम्..
तथास्य हृदयं भित्त्वा जगाम धरणीतलम्.. 18.16 ..
1.4.m: just as sorrow arising from worldly existence pierces a man of little understanding; / thus having pierced his heart, it went into the earth's surface.

1.4.s:
nimeṣātsobhisaṃstambhya dānavo dāruṇākṛtiḥ..
jagrāha paṭṭiśaṃ daityo girīṇāmapi bhedanam.. 18.17 ..
1.4.d:
निमेषात्सोभिसंस्तम्भ्य दानवो दारुणाकृतिः..
जग्राह पट्टिशं दैत्यो गिरीणामपि भेदनम्.. 18.17 ..
1.4.m: Composing himself in a moment, that fierce-looking Dānava, / that Daitya, seized a cleaver capable of splitting even mountains.

1.4.s:
sa tena paṭṭisenājau dhanadasya stanāṃtaram..
vākyena tīkṣṇarūpeṇa marmākṣaravisarpiṇā.. 18.18 ..
1.4.d:
स तेन पट्टिसेनाजौ धनदस्य स्तनांतरम्..
वाक्येन तीक्ष्णरूपेण मर्माक्षरविसर्पिणा.. 18.18 ..
1.4.m: With that cleaver in battle, between Dhanada's breasts, / just as a wicked man pierces the heart of a noble person / with harsh speech that spreads words striking the vitals,

1.4.s:
nirbibhedābhijātasya hṛdayaṃ durjano yathā..
tena paṭṭiśa ghātena dhaneśaḥ. parimūrchitaḥ.. 18.19 ..
1.4.d:
निर्बिभेदाभिजातस्य हृदयं दुर्जनो यथा..
तेन पट्टिश घातेन धनेशः. परिमूर्छितः.. 18.19 ..
1.4.m: he pierced him. / Deeply swooning from that blow of the cleaver,

1.4.s:
niṣasāda rathopasthe durvācā sujano yathā..
tathāgataṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhaneśaṃ vai mṛtaṃ yathā.. 18.20 ..
1.4.d:
निषसाद रथोपस्थे दुर्वाचा सुजनो यथा..
तथागतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा धनेशं वै मृतं यथा.. 18.20 ..
1.4.m: the Lord of Wealth sank down onto the floor of his chariot, like a good man [crushed] by malicious words. / Seeing the Lord of Wealth reduced to such a state, as if dead,

1.4.s:
rākṣaso nirṛtirdevo niśācarabalānugaḥ..
abhidudrāva vegena kujaṃbhaṃ bhīmavikramam.. 18.21 ..
1.4.d:
राक्षसो निरृतिर्देवो निशाचरबलानुगः..
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुजंभं भीमविक्रमम्.. 18.21 ..
1.4.m: the rākṣasa lord Nirṛti, followed by a force of night-wanderers, / charged swiftly against Kujambha of terrible prowess.

1.4.s:
atha dṛṣṭvātidurdharṣaṃ kujaṃbho rākṣaseśvaram..
nodayāmāsa daityānsa rākṣaseśarathaṃ prati.. 18.22 ..
1.4.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वातिदुर्धर्षं कुजंभो राक्षसेश्वरम्..
नोदयामास दैत्यान्स राक्षसेशरथं प्रति.. 18.22 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing the exceedingly unassailable lord of the rākṣasas, / Kujambha urged his Daityas toward the chariot of the rākṣasa lord.

1.4.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā noditāṃ senāṃ prabalāstrāṃ subhīṣaṇām..
rathādāplutya vegena nirṛtī rākṣaseśvaram.. 18.23 ..
1.4.d:
स दृष्ट्वा नोदितां सेनां प्रबलास्त्रां सुभीषणाम्..
रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन निरृती राक्षसेश्वरम्.. 18.23 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that dreadful army with mighty weapons urged against him, / leaping down swiftly from his chariot, Nirṛti, the lord of the rākṣasas,

1.4.s:
khaḍgena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa carmapāṇiradhāvata..
praviśya dānavānīkaṃ gajaḥ padmasaro yathā.. 18.24 ..
1.4.d:
खड्गेन तीक्ष्णधारेण चर्मपाणिरधावत..
प्रविश्य दानवानीकं गजः पद्मसरो यथा.. 18.24 ..
1.4.m: ran with a shield in his hand and a sharp-edged sword. / Entering the Dānava host like an elephant into a lotus lake,

1.4.s:
loḍayāmāsa bahudhā viniṣkṛtya sahasraśaḥ..
ciccheda kāṃścicchataśo bibhedānyānvarāsinā.. 18.25 ..
1.4.d:
लोडयामास बहुधा विनिष्कृत्य सहस्रशः..
चिच्छेद कांश्चिच्छतशो बिभेदान्यान्वरासिना.. 18.25 ..
1.4.m: he threw it into turmoil in many ways, tearing [them] apart by the thousands. / He cut down some by the hundreds and pierced others with his excellent sword.

1.4.s:
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhamukhaiḥ pṛthvīṃ daityānāṃ so'bhyapūrayat..
tato niḥśeṣitaprāyāṃ vilokya svāṃ camūṃ tadā.. 18.26 ..
1.4.d:
संदष्टौष्ठमुखैः पृथ्वीं दैत्यानां सोऽभ्यपूरयत्..
ततो निःशेषितप्रायां विलोक्य स्वां चमूं तदा.. 18.26 ..
1.4.m: He covered the earth with the faces of Daityas whose lips were bitten [in anger]. / Then, seeing his army practically annihilated at that time,

1.4.s:
muktvā dhanapatiṃ daityaḥ kujaṃbho nirṛtiṃ yayau..
labdhasaṃjñastu jaṃbho'pi dhanādhyakṣapadānugān.. 18.27 ..
1.4.d:
मुक्त्वा धनपतिं दैत्यः कुजंभो निरृतिं ययौ..
लब्धसंज्ञस्तु जंभोऽपि धनाध्यक्षपदानुगान्.. 18.27 ..
1.4.m: the Daitya Kujambha left the Lord of Wealth and went against Nirṛti. / Having regained consciousness, Jambha also captured alive

1.4.s:
jīvagrāhaṃ sa jagrāha baddhā pāśaiḥ sahasradhā..
mūrtimaṃti ca ratnani padmādīṃśca nidhīṃstathā.. 18.28 ..
1.4.d:
जीवग्राहं स जग्राह बद्धा पाशैः सहस्रधा..
मूर्तिमंति च रत्ननि पद्मादींश्च निधींस्तथा.. 18.28 ..
1.4.m: the followers of the overseer of wealth, binding them a thousandfold with nooses, / along with jewels personified, treasures like the Padma,

1.4.s:
vāhanāni ca divyāni vimānāni ca sarvaśaḥ..
dhaneśo labdhasaṃjñastu tāmavasthāṃ vilokya saḥ.. 18.29 ..
1.4.d:
वाहनानि च दिव्यानि विमानानि च सर्वशः..
धनेशो लब्धसंज्ञस्तु तामवस्थां विलोक्य सः.. 18.29 ..
1.4.m: and all the divine vehicles and aerial chariots. / The Lord of Wealth, having regained consciousness and seeing that state of affairs,

1.4.s:
niḥśvasandīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca roṣāttāmravilocanaḥ..
dhyātvāstraṃ gāruḍaṃ divyaṃ bāṇaṃ saṃdhāya kārmuke.. 18.30 ..
1.4.d:
निःश्वसन्दीर्घमुष्णं च रोषात्ताम्रविलोचनः..
ध्यात्वास्त्रं गारुडं दिव्यं बाणं संधाय कार्मुके.. 18.30 ..
1.4.m: sighing long and hot, with eyes copper-red from anger, / meditated on the divine Gāruḍa weapon and, fitting an arrow to his bow,

1.4.s:
mumoca dānavānīke taṃ bāṇaṃ śatrudāraṇam..
prathamaṃ kārmukaṃ tasya vahnijvālamadṛśyata.. 18.31 ..
1.4.d:
मुमोच दानवानीके तं बाणं शत्रुदारणम्..
प्रथमं कार्मुकं तस्य वह्निज्वालमदृश्यत.. 18.31 ..
1.4.m: discharged that arrow tearing foes into the Dānava army. / First, his bow appeared as a flame of fire,

1.4.s:
niścerurvisphuliṃgānāṃ koṭayo dhanuṣastathā..
tato jvālākulaṃ vyoma cakre cāstraṃ samaṃtataḥ.. 18.32 ..
1.4.d:
निश्चेरुर्विस्फुलिंगानां कोटयो धनुषस्तथा..
ततो ज्वालाकुलं व्योम चक्रे चास्त्रं समंततः.. 18.32 ..
1.4.m: and tens of millions of sparks flew out from the bow; / then the weapon filled the sky all around with flames.

1.4.s:
tadastraṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho bhīmaparākramaḥ..
saṃvartaṃ mumuce tena praśāṃtaṃ gāruḍaṃ tadā.. 18.33 ..
1.4.d:
तदस्त्रं सहसा दृष्ट्वा जंभो भीमपराक्रमः..
संवर्तं मुमुचे तेन प्रशांतं गारुडं तदा.. 18.33 ..
1.4.m: Suddenly seeing that weapon, Jambha of terrible prowess / released the Saṃvarta weapon; by it the Gāruḍa [weapon] was quenched.

1.4.s:
tatastaṃ dānavo dṛṣṭvā kuberaṃ roṣavihvalaḥ..
abhidudrāva vegena padātirdhanadaṃ nadan.. 18.34 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तं दानवो दृष्ट्वा कुबेरं रोषविह्वलः..
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन पदातिर्धनदं नदन्.. 18.34 ..
1.4.m: Then the Dānava, seeing Kubera, agitated with rage, / rushed swiftly on foot toward Dhanada, roaring loudly.

1.4.s:
athābhimukhamāyāṃtaṃ daityaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanādhipaḥ..
babhūva saṃbhramāviṣṭaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ.. 18.35 ..
1.4.d:
अथाभिमुखमायांतं दैत्यं दृष्ट्वा धनाधिपः..
बभूव संभ्रमाविष्टः पलायनपरायणः.. 18.35 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing the Daitya coming face-to-face, the Lord of Wealth / was seized by panic and became intent on flight.

1.4.s:
tataḥ palāyatastasya mukuṭo ratnamaṃḍitaḥ..
papāta bhūtale dīpto ravibiṃbamivāṃbarāt.. 18.36 ..
1.4.d:
ततः पलायतस्तस्य मुकुटो रत्नमंडितः..
पपात भूतले दीप्तो रविबिंबमिवांबरात्.. 18.36 ..
1.4.m: Then, as he was fleeing, his gem-studded diadem, / brilliant like the disc of the sun, fell to the earth from the sky.

1.4.s:
yakṣaṇāmabhijātānāṃ bhagnaṃ pravavṛte raṇāt..
martuṃ saṃgrāma śirasi yuktaṃ no bhūṣaṇāya tat.. 18.37 ..
1.4.d:
यक्षणामभिजातानां भग्नं प्रववृते रणात्..
मर्तुं संग्राम शिरसि युक्तं नो भूषणाय तत्.. 18.37 ..
1.4.m: The noble yakṣas suffered a rout from the battle, / [thinking]: 'It is fitting to die at the vanguard of battle, not for [mere] adornment.'

1.4.s:
iti vyavasya durdharṣā nānāśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ..
yuyutsavastathā yakṣā mukuṭaṃ parivārya te.. 18.38 ..
1.4.d:
इति व्यवस्य दुर्धर्षा नानाशस्त्रास्त्रपाणयः..
युयुत्सवस्तथा यक्षा मुकुटं परिवार्य ते.. 18.38 ..
1.4.m: Having thus resolved, those irresistible yakṣas, weapons and missiles in hand, / wishing to fight, surrounding the diadem—

1.4.s:
abhimāna dhanā vīrā dhanasya padānugāḥ..
tānamarṣācca saṃprekṣya dānavaścaṃḍapauruṣaḥ.. 18.39 ..
1.4.d:
अभिमान धना वीरा धनस्य पदानुगाः..
तानमर्षाच्च संप्रेक्ष्य दानवश्चंडपौरुषः.. 18.39 ..
1.4.m: those heroes whose wealth was their honor, the followers of Dhanada— / seeing them with anger, the Dānava of fierce prowess,

1.4.s:
bhuśuṇḍīṃ bhīṣaṇākārāṃ gṛhītvā śailagauravām..
rakṣiṇo mukuṭasyātha niṣpipeṣa niśācarān.. 18.40 ..
1.4.d:
भुशुण्डीं भीषणाकारां गृहीत्वा शैलगौरवाम्..
रक्षिणो मुकुटस्याथ निष्पिपेष निशाचरान्.. 18.40 ..
1.4.m: taking up a dreadful bhuśuṇḍī with the weight of a mountain, / crushed those night-wanderers who were guarding the diadem.

1.4.s:
tānpramathyātha niyutaṃ mukuṭaṃ taṃ svake rathe..
samāropyāmararipurjitvā dhanadamāhave.. 18.41 ..
1.4.d:
तान्प्रमथ्याथ नियुतं मुकुटं तं स्वके रथे..
समारोप्यामररिपुर्जित्वा धनदमाहवे.. 18.41 ..
1.4.m: Having crushed a hundred thousand of them, placing that diadem on his chariot, / the enemy of the immortals, having conquered Dhanada in battle,

1.4.s:
dhanāni ca nidhīngṛhya svasainyena samāvṛtaḥ..
nādena mahatā devāndrāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ.. 18.42 ..
1.4.d:
धनानि च निधीन्गृह्य स्वसैन्येन समावृतः..
नादेन महता देवान्द्रावयामास सर्वशः.. 18.42 ..
1.4.m: and having seized the wealth and treasures, surrounded by his army, / put the gods to flight on all sides with a tremendous roar.

1.4.s:
dhanado'pi dhanaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhīto muktamūrdhajaḥ..
padātirekaḥ santrastaḥ prāpyaivaṃ dīnavatsthitaḥ.. 18.43 ..
1.4.d:
धनदोऽपि धनं सर्वं गृहीतो मुक्तमूर्धजः..
पदातिरेकः सन्त्रस्तः प्राप्यैवं दीनवत्स्थितः.. 18.43 ..
1.4.m: And Dhanada, all his wealth seized, his hair disheveled, / terrified, alone on foot, stood in this condition like a wretched beggar.

1.4.s:
kujaṃbhenātha saṃsakto rajanīcaranaṃdanaḥ..
māyāmamoghāmāśritya tāmasīṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ.. 18.44 ..
1.4.d:
कुजंभेनाथ संसक्तो रजनीचरनंदनः..
मायाममोघामाश्रित्य तामसीं राक्षसेश्वरः.. 18.44 ..
1.4.m: Then, having clashed with Kujambha, the delight of the night-wanderers, / the lord of the rākṣasas, having resorted to an unerring, dark illusion...

1.4.s:
mohayāmāsa daityendro jagatkṛtvā tamomayam..
tato viphalanetrāṇi dānavānāṃ balāni ca.. 18.45 ..
1.4.d:
मोहयामास दैत्येन्द्रो जगत्कृत्वा तमोमयम्..
ततो विफलनेत्राणि दानवानां बलानि च.. 18.45 ..
1.4.m: The lord of the Daityas bewildered [them], turning the world into darkness; / and then the eyes of the Dānavas' forces became useless. 18.45

1.4.s:
na śekuścalituṃ tatra padādapi padaṃ tadā..
tato nānāstravarṣeṇa dānavānāṃ mahācamūḥ.. 18.46 ..
1.4.d:
न शेकुश्चलितुं तत्र पदादपि पदं तदा..
ततो नानास्त्रवर्षेण दानवानां महाचमूः.. 18.46 ..
1.4.m: They were unable then to move even a step from that spot. / Then, with a shower of various missiles, the great army of the Dānavas, 18.46

1.4.s:
jaghāna nirṛtirdevastamasā saṃvṛtā bhṛśam..
hanyamāneṣu daityeṣu kujaṃbhe mūḍhacetasi.. 18.47 ..
1.4.d:
जघान निरृतिर्देवस्तमसा संवृता भृशम्..
हन्यमानेषु दैत्येषु कुजंभे मूढचेतसि.. 18.47 ..
1.4.m: completely enveloped in darkness, was slain by god Nirṛti. / As the Daityas were being slain and Kujambha was bewildered in mind, 18.47

1.4.s:
mahiṣo dānavendrastu kalpāṃtāṃ bhodasannibhaḥ..
astraṃ cakāra sāvitramulkāsaṃghātamaṃḍitam.. 18.48 ..
1.4.d:
महिषो दानवेन्द्रस्तु कल्पांतां भोदसन्निभः..
अस्त्रं चकार सावित्रमुल्कासंघातमंडितम्.. 18.48 ..
1.4.m: Mahiṣa, the lord of the Dānavas, resembling a cloud at the end of the kalpa, / discharged the Sāvitra missile adorned with a mass of meteors. 18.48

1.4.s:
vijṛṃbhatyatha sāvitre paramāstre prātapini..
praṇāsamagamattīvraṃ tamo ghoramanaṃtaram.. 18.49 ..
1.4.d:
विजृंभत्यथ सावित्रे परमास्त्रे प्रातपिनि..
प्रणासमगमत्तीव्रं तमो घोरमनंतरम्.. 18.49 ..
1.4.m: As the supreme Sāvitra missile expanded in blazing heat, / the intense, terrible darkness immediately went to destruction. 18.49

1.4.s:
tato'stravisphuliṃgāṃkaṃ tamaḥ śuklaṃ vyajāyata..
protphullāruṇapadmaughaṃ śaradīvāmalaṃ saraḥ.. 18.50 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽस्त्रविस्फुलिंगांकं तमः शुक्लं व्यजायत..
प्रोत्फुल्लारुणपद्मौघं शरदीवामलं सरः.. 18.50 ..
1.4.m: Then, marked by sparks from the missile, the darkness became bright, / like a clear lake in autumn with a mass of blooming red lotuses. 18.50

1.4.s:
tatastamasi saṃśāṃte daityendrāḥ prāptacakṣuṣaḥ..
cakruḥ krureṇa tamasā devānīkaṃ mahādbhutam.. 18.51 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तमसि संशांते दैत्येन्द्राः प्राप्तचक्षुषः..
चक्रुः क्रुरेण तमसा देवानीकं महाद्भुतम्.. 18.51 ..
1.4.m: Then, when the darkness was quieted and the lords of the Daityas regained their sight, / they made a great wonder against the army of the gods with cruel gloom. 18.51

1.4.s:
athādāya dhanurghoramiṣuṃ cāśīviṣopamam..
kujaṃbho'dhāvata kṣipraṃ rakṣodevabalaṃ prati.. 18.52 ..
1.4.d:
अथादाय धनुर्घोरमिषुं चाशीविषोपमम्..
कुजंभोऽधावत क्षिप्रं रक्षोदेवबलं प्रति.. 18.52 ..
1.4.m: Then, taking up a terrible bow and an arrow like a venomous serpent, / Kujambha quickly ran toward the army of the Rākṣasas and gods. 18.52

1.4.s:
rākṣasendrastathāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣaṭvā taṃ sa padānugaḥ..
vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiḥ kālāśanisamasvanaiḥ.. 18.53 ..
1.4.d:
राक्षसेन्द्रस्तथायांतं दृषट्वा तं स पदानुगः..
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः कालाशनिसमस्वनैः.. 18.53 ..
1.4.m: Seeing him approaching thus on foot, the lord of the Rākṣasas / pierced him with sharp arrows that sounded like the thunderbolt of Time. 18.53

1.4.s:
nādānaṃ na ca sandhānaṃ na mokṣo vāsya lakṣyate..
cicchedograiḥ śaravrātaistāñcharānatilāghavāt.. 18.54 ..
1.4.d:
नादानं न च सन्धानं न मोक्षो वास्य लक्ष्यते..
चिच्छेदोग्रैः शरव्रातैस्ताञ्छरानतिलाघवात्.. 18.54 ..
1.4.m: Neither his taking [an arrow], nor aiming, nor releasing could be perceived; / with very great dexterity, he cut off those arrows with masses of fierce arrows. 18.54

1.4.s:
dhvajaṃ śareṇa tīkṣṇena nicakartāmaradviṣaḥ..
sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapāharat.. 18.55 ..
1.4.d:
ध्वजं शरेण तीक्ष्णेन निचकर्तामरद्विषः..
सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपाहरत्.. 18.55 ..
1.4.m: With a sharp arrow he cut down the enemy of the immortals' flag, / and with a broad-headed arrow he knocked his charioteer from the chariot's seat. 18.55

1.4.s:
kālakalpena bāṇena taṃ ca vakṣasyātāḍayat..
sa tu tena prahāreṇa cakampe pīḍito bhṛśam.. 19.56 ..
1.4.d:
कालकल्पेन बाणेन तं च वक्षस्याताडयत्..
स तु तेन प्रहारेण चकम्पे पीडितो भृशम्.. 19.56 ..
1.4.m: And with an arrow equal to Death he struck him on the chest; / and he, afflicted exceedingly by that blow, trembled, 18.56

1.4.s:
daityeṃdro rākṣasendreṇa kṣitikaṃpenago yathā..
sa suhūrtātsamāśvāsya matvā taṃ durjayaṃ raṇe.. 18.57 ..
1.4.d:
दैत्येंद्रो राक्षसेन्द्रेण क्षितिकंपेनगो यथा..
स सुहूर्तात्समाश्वास्य मत्वा तं दुर्जयं रणे.. 18.57 ..
1.4.m: the lord of the Daityas [shaken] by the lord of the Rākṣasas like a mountain by an earthquake. / Having recovered after a moment and considering him hard to conquer in battle, 18.57

1.4.s:
padātirāsādya rathaṃ rakṣo vāmakareṇa ca..
keśeṣu nirṛtiṃ gṛhya jānunākramya ca sthitaḥ.. 18.58 ..
1.4.d:
पदातिरासाद्य रथं रक्षो वामकरेण च..
केशेषु निरृतिं गृह्य जानुनाक्रम्य च स्थितः.. 18.58 ..
1.4.m: the Rākṣasa, going on foot and approaching the chariot, / seized Nirṛti by the hair with his left hand and pinned him down with his knee. 18.58

1.4.s:
tataḥ khaḍgena ca śiraśchettumaicchadamarṣaṇaḥ..
tataḥ kalakalo jajñe devānāṃ sumahāṃstadā..
kujaṃbhasya vaśaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirṛtimāhave.. 18.59 ..
1.4.d:
ततः खड्गेन च शिरश्छेत्तुमैच्छदमर्षणः..
ततः कलकलो जज्ञे देवानां सुमहांस्तदा..
कुजंभस्य वशं प्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा निरृतिमाहवे.. 18.59 ..
1.4.m: Then, intolerant, he wished to cut off his head with a sword. / Then a very great uproar arose among the gods, / seeing Nirṛti fallen into the power of Kujambha in battle. 18.59

1.4.s:
etasminnantare devo varuṇaḥ pāśabhṛddhṛtaḥ..
pāśena dānaveṃdrasya babandhāśu bhujadvayam.. 18.60 ..
1.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवो वरुणः पाशभृद्धृतः..
पाशेन दानवेंद्रस्य बबन्धाशु भुजद्वयम्.. 18.60 ..
1.4.m: In the meantime, the god Varuṇa, the noose-bearer, held fast / and quickly bound the two arms of the Dānava lord with a noose. 18.60

1.4.s:
tato baddhabhujaṃ daityaṃ viphalīkṛtapauruṣam..
tāḍayāmāsa gadayā dayāmutsṛjya pāśabhṛt.. 18.61 ..
1.4.d:
ततो बद्धभुजं दैत्यं विफलीकृतपौरुषम्..
ताडयामास गदया दयामुत्सृज्य पाशभृत्.. 18.61 ..
1.4.m: Then the noose-bearer, abandoning mercy, struck with a mace / the Daitya whose arms were bound and whose prowess was rendered futile. 18.61

1.4.s:
sa tu tena prahāreṇa srotobhiḥ kṣatajaṃ sravan..
dadhāra kālameghasya rūpaṃ vidyullatābhṛtam.. 18.62 ..
1.4.d:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण स्रोतोभिः क्षतजं स्रवन्..
दधार कालमेघस्य रूपं विद्युल्लताभृतम्.. 18.62 ..
1.4.m: Streaming blood in torrents from that blow, / he assumed the appearance of a dark cloud bearing streaks of lightning. 18.62

1.4.s:
tadavasthāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā kujaṃbhaṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ..
vyāvṛttavadanārāvo bhoktumaicchatsurāvubhau.. 18.63 ..
1.4.d:
तदवस्थागतं दृष्ट्वा कुजंभं महिषासुरः..
व्यावृत्तवदनारावो भोक्तुमैच्छत्सुरावुभौ.. 18.63 ..
1.4.m: Seeing Kujambha brought to that state, Mahiṣāsura, / roaring with a gaping mouth, wished to devour both gods, 18.63

1.4.s:
nirṛti varuṇaṃ caiva tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrotkaṭānanaḥ..
tāvabhiprāyamā lokya tasya daityasya dūṣitam.. 18.64 ..
1.4.d:
निरृति वरुणं चैव तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रोत्कटाननः..
तावभिप्रायमा लोक्य तस्य दैत्यस्य दूषितम्.. 18.64 ..
1.4.m: Nirṛti and Varuṇa, his face fierce with sharp fangs. / Perceiving that Daitya's wicked intention, 18.64

1.4.s:
tyaktvā rathāvubhau bhītau padātī pradrutau drutam..
jagmaturmahiṣādbhītau śaraṇaṃ pākaśāsanam.. 18.65 ..
1.4.d:
त्यक्त्वा रथावुभौ भीतौ पदाती प्रद्रुतौ द्रुतम्..
जग्मतुर्महिषाद्भीतौ शरणं पाकशासनम्.. 18.65 ..
1.4.m: both of them, frightened, abandoned their chariots and quickly fled on foot; / terrified of Mahiṣa, they went to Pākaśāsana for refuge. 18.65

1.4.s:
kruddho'tha mahiṣo daityo varuṇaṃ samupādravat..
tamaṃtakamukhāsannamālokya himadīdhitiḥ.. 18.66 ..
1.4.d:
क्रुद्धोऽथ महिषो दैत्यो वरुणं समुपाद्रवत्..
तमंतकमुखासन्नमालोक्य हिमदीधितिः.. 18.66 ..
1.4.m: Then the enraged Daitya Mahiṣa ran toward Varuṇa. / Seeing him near the mouth of Death, the moon, cool-rayed, 18.66

1.4.s:
cakre śastraṃ visṛṣṭaṃ hi himasaṃghātamulbaṇam..
vāyavyaṃ cāstra matulaṃ caṃdraścakre dvitīyakam.. 18.67 ..
1.4.d:
चक्रे शस्त्रं विसृष्टं हि हिमसंघातमुल्बणम्..
वायव्यं चास्त्र मतुलं चंद्रश्चक्रे द्वितीयकम्.. 18.67 ..
1.4.m: discharged indeed a terrifying weapon consisting of a mass of snow, / and the Moon discharged a second incomparable missile, the Vāyavya. 18.67

1.4.s:
vāyunā tena caṃḍaṃna saṃśuṣkeṇa himena ca..
mahāhimanipātena śastraiścaṃdrapraṇoditaiḥ.. 18.68 ..
1.4.d:
वायुना तेन चंडंन संशुष्केण हिमेन च..
महाहिमनिपातेन शस्त्रैश्चंद्रप्रणोदितैः.. 18.68 ..
1.4.m: By that fierce wind, by the dry frost, / by the great fall of snow, and by weapons impelled by the Moon, 18.68

1.4.s:
gātrāṇyasurasainyānāmadahyaṃta samaṃtataḥ..
vyathitā dānavāḥ sarve sītacchāditapauruṣāḥ.. 18.69 ..
1.4.d:
गात्राण्यसुरसैन्यानामदह्यंत समंततः..
व्यथिता दानवाः सर्वे सीतच्छादितपौरुषाः.. 18.69 ..
1.4.m: the limbs of the Asura armies were burned on all sides. / All the Dānavas were distressed, their prowess enveloped by the cold. 18.69

1.4.s:
na śekuścaliṃtuṃ tatra nāstrāṇyādātumeva ca..
mahiṣo niṣprayatnaśca śītenākaṃpitānanaḥ.. 18.70 ..
1.4.d:
न शेकुश्चलिंतुं तत्र नास्त्राण्यादातुमेव च..
महिषो निष्प्रयत्नश्च शीतेनाकंपिताननः.. 18.70 ..
1.4.m: They were unable to move there, nor could they take up weapons. / And Mahiṣa became motionless, his face trembling from the cold. 18.70

1.4.s:
aṃsamāliṃgya pāṇibhyāmupaviṣṭo hyadhomukhaḥ..
sarve te niṣpratīkārā daityāścaṃdramasā jitāḥ.. 18.71 ..
1.4.d:
अंसमालिंग्य पाणिभ्यामुपविष्टो ह्यधोमुखः..
सर्वे ते निष्प्रतीकारा दैत्याश्चंद्रमसा जिताः.. 18.71 ..
1.4.m: Embracing his shoulder with both hands, he sat down with his face downward. / All those Daityas, helpless, were defeated by the Moon. 18.71

1.4.s:
raṇecchāṃ dūratastyaktvā tasthuste jīvitārthinaḥ..
tatrābravītkālanemirdaityānkrodhavidīpitaḥ.. 18.72 ..
1.4.d:
रणेच्छां दूरतस्त्यक्त्वा तस्थुस्ते जीवितार्थिनः..
तत्राब्रवीत्कालनेमिर्दैत्यान्क्रोधविदीपितः.. 18.72 ..
1.4.m: Having cast far away the desire for battle, they stood there seeking life. / There Kālanemi, inflamed with wrath, spoke to the Daityas: 18.72

1.4.s:
bhobhoḥ śrṛṃgāriṇaḥ krūrāḥ sarvaśastrāstrapāragāḥ..
ekaiko'pi jagatkṛsnaṃ śaktastulayituṃ bhujaiḥ.. 18.73 ..
1.4.d:
भोभोः श्रृंगारिणः क्रूराः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगाः..
एकैकोऽपि जगत्कृस्नं शक्तस्तुलयितुं भुजैः.. 18.73 ..
1.4.m: ‘O fierce proud warriors, masters of all weapons and missiles! / Each one of you alone is capable of lifting the entire world with his arms! 18.73

1.4.s:
ekaiko'pi kṣamo grastuṃ jagatsarvaṃ carācaram..
ekaikasyāpi paryāptā na sarve'pi divaukasaḥ.. 18.74 ..
1.4.d:
एकैकोऽपि क्षमो ग्रस्तुं जगत्सर्वं चराचरम्..
एकैकस्यापि पर्याप्ता न सर्वेऽपि दिवौकसः.. 18.74 ..
1.4.m: Each one alone is capable of swallowing the entire world, moving and unmoving! / Not even all the sky-dwellers combined are a match for each one alone! 18.74

1.4.s:
kiṃ trastanayanāścaiva samare parinirjitāḥ..
na yuktametacchūrāṇāṃ viśeṣāddaityajanmanām.. 18.75 ..
1.4.d:
किं त्रस्तनयनाश्चैव समरे परिनिर्जिताः..
न युक्तमेतच्छूराणां विशेषाद्दैत्यजन्मनाम्.. 18.75 ..
1.4.m: Why then are your eyes terrified and you completely defeated in battle? / This is not fitting for heroes, especially for those born as Daityas! 18.75

1.4.s:
rājñaśca tārakasyāpi darśayiṣyatha kiṃ mukham..
viratānāṃ raṇāccāsau kruddhaḥ prāṇānhariṣyati.. 18.76 ..
1.4.d:
राज्ञश्च तारकस्यापि दर्शयिष्यथ किं मुखम्..
विरतानां रणाच्चासौ क्रुद्धः प्राणान्हरिष्यति.. 18.76 ..
1.4.m: And what face will you show to King Tāraka? / For, enraged, he will take the lives of those who have ceased from battle!’ 18.76

1.4.s:
iti te procyamānāpi nocuḥ kiṃcinmahāsurāḥ..
śītena naṣṭaśrutayo bhraṣṭavākyāśca te tathā.. 18.77 ..
1.4.d:
इति ते प्रोच्यमानापि नोचुः किंचिन्महासुराः..
शीतेन नष्टश्रुतयो भ्रष्टवाक्याश्च ते तथा.. 18.77 ..
1.4.m: Even when spoken to thus, the great Asuras said nothing; / their hearing was lost from the cold, and their speech was likewise gone. 18.77

1.4.s:
mūkāstathābhavandaityā mṛtakalpā mahāraṇe..
tāndṛṣṭvā naṣṭacetaskāndaityāñchītena pīḍitān.. 18.78 ..
1.4.d:
मूकास्तथाभवन्दैत्या मृतकल्पा महारणे..
तान्दृष्ट्वा नष्टचेतस्कान्दैत्याञ्छीतेन पीडितान्.. 18.78 ..
1.4.m: Thus the Daityas became dumb, like dead men in the great battle. / Seeing those Daityas deprived of their senses and afflicted by the cold, 18.78

1.4.s:
matvā kālakṣamaṃ kāryaṃ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ..
āśritya mānavīṃ māyāṃ vitatya ca mahāvapuḥ.. 18.79 ..
1.4.d:
मत्वा कालक्षमं कार्यं कालनेमिर्महासुरः..
आश्रित्य मानवीं मायां वितत्य च महावपुः.. 18.79 ..
1.4.m: the great Asura Kālanemi, considering the action suited to the moment, / resorted to the Mānavī illusion, and expanding his vast form, 18.79

1.4.s:
pūrayāmāsa gaganaṃ vidiśa eva ca..
nirmame dānavendro'sau śarīrebhāskarāyutam.. 18.80 ..
1.4.d:
पूरयामास गगनं विदिश एव च..
निर्ममे दानवेन्द्रोऽसौ शरीरेभास्करायुतम्.. 18.80 ..
1.4.m: filled the sky and the intermediate quarters too. / That lord of the Dānavas created ten thousand suns in his body. 18.80

1.4.s:
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva pūrayāmāsa pāvakaiḥ..
tato jvālākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyamabhavatkṣaṇāt.. 18.81 ..
1.4.d:
दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव पूरयामास पावकैः..
ततो ज्वालाकुलं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमभवत्क्षणात्.. 18.81 ..
1.4.m: He filled the directions and intermediate quarters with fires. / Then in a moment the entire three worlds became filled with flames. 18.81

1.4.s:
tena jvālāsamūhena himāṃ śuragamaddrutam..
tataḥ krameṇa vibhraṣṭaṃ śītadurdinamābabhau.. 18.82 ..
1.4.d:
तेन ज्वालासमूहेन हिमां शुरगमद्द्रुतम्..
ततः क्रमेण विभ्रष्टं शीतदुर्दिनमाबभौ.. 18.82 ..
1.4.m: Before that mass of flames, the moon quickly fled. / Then by degrees the day of foul cold weather vanished, and there shone 18.82

1.4.s:
tadbalaṃ dānaveṃdrāṇāṃ māyayā kālaneminaḥ..
taddṛṣṭvā dānavānīkaṃ labdhasaṃjñaṃ divākaraḥ..
uvācāruṇamatyarthaṃ koparaktāṃtalocanaḥ.. 18.83 ..
1.4.d:
तद्बलं दानवेंद्राणां मायया कालनेमिनः..
तद्दृष्ट्वा दानवानीकं लब्धसंज्ञं दिवाकरः..
उवाचारुणमत्यर्थं कोपरक्तांतलोचनः.. 18.83 ..
1.4.m: that army of the Dānava lords by Kālanemi's illusion. / Seeing that Dānava host having regained consciousness, the sun, / the corners of his eyes extremely red with anger, spoke to Aruṇa: 18.83

1.4.s:
..divākara uvāca..
nayāruṇa rathaṃ śīghraṃ kālanemiratho yataḥ.. 18.84 ..
1.4.d:
..दिवाकर उवाच..
नयारुण रथं शीघ्रं कालनेमिरथो यतः.. 18.84 ..
1.4.m: The Sun said: / ‘Drive the chariot quickly, Aruṇa, to where Kālanemi is. 18.84

1.4.s:
vimarde tatra viṣame bhavitā bhūtasaṃkṣayaḥ..
jita eṣaśaśāṃko'tha vayaṃ yadbalamāśritāḥ.. 18.85 ..
1.4.d:
विमर्दे तत्र विषमे भविता भूतसंक्षयः..
जित एषशशांकोऽथ वयं यद्बलमाश्रिताः.. 18.85 ..
1.4.m: In that dreadful clash, the destruction of living beings will occur. / This moon, whose power we relied upon, has now been conquered.’ 18.85

1.4.s:
ityuktaścodayāmāsa rathaṃ garuḍapūrvajaḥ..
rathe sthito'pi tairaśvaiḥ sitacāmaradhāribhiḥ.. 18.86 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्तश्चोदयामास रथं गरुडपूर्वजः..
रथे स्थितोऽपि तैरश्वैः सितचामरधारिभिः.. 18.86 ..
1.4.m: Thus addressed, the elder brother of Garuḍa urged on the chariot; / and standing on the chariot with those horses bearing white chowries, 18.86

1.4.s:
jagaddīpo'tha bhagavāñjagrāha vitataṃ dhanuḥ..
śaraugho vai pāṃḍuputra kṣipramāsīdviṣadyutiḥ.. 18.87 ..
1.4.d:
जगद्दीपोऽथ भगवाञ्जग्राह विततं धनुः..
शरौघो वै पांडुपुत्र क्षिप्रमासीद्विषद्युतिः.. 18.87 ..
1.4.m: the blessed light of the world took up his drawn bow. / A flood of arrows indeed, O son of Pāṇḍu, quickly became blazing like poison. 18.87

1.4.s:
śaṃbarāstreṇa saṃdhāya bāṇamekaṃ sasarja ha..
dvitīyaṃ cendrajālenāyojitaṃ pramumoca ha.. 18.88 ..
1.4.d:
शंबरास्त्रेण संधाय बाणमेकं ससर्ज ह..
द्वितीयं चेन्द्रजालेनायोजितं प्रमुमोच ह.. 18.88 ..
1.4.m: Fastening one arrow with the Śambara missile, he released it; / and he discharged a second combined with the missile of Indra’s net. 18.88

1.4.s:
śaṃbarāstraṃ kṣaṇāccakre teṣāṃrūpaviparyayam..
devānāṃ dānavaṃ rūpaṃ dānavānāṃ ca daivikam.. 18.89 ..
1.4.d:
शंबरास्त्रं क्षणाच्चक्रे तेषांरूपविपर्ययम्..
देवानां दानवं रूपं दानवानां च दैविकम्.. 18.89 ..
1.4.m: In an instant, the weapon of Śambara reversed their appearances: / [it gave] the gods the form of Dānavas, and the Dānavas the divine form.

1.4.s:
matvā surānsvakāneva jaghne ghorāstralāghavāt..
kālanemī ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kṛtāṃta iva saṃkṣaye.. 18.90 ..
1.4.d:
मत्वा सुरान्स्वकानेव जघ्ने घोरास्त्रलाघवात्..
कालनेमी रुषाविष्टः कृतांत इव संक्षये.. 18.90 ..
1.4.m: Believing [them] to be gods, Kālanemi, overcome with rage, / slaughtered his own people with the swiftness of his dreadful weapons, like the End-Maker at the cosmic destruction.

1.4.s:
kāṃścitkhaḍgena tīkṣṇena kāṃścinnārācavṛṣṭibhiḥ..
kāṃścidgadābhirghorābhiḥ kāṃściddhoraiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ.. 18.91 ..
1.4.d:
कांश्चित्खड्गेन तीक्ष्णेन कांश्चिन्नाराचवृष्टिभिः..
कांश्चिद्गदाभिर्घोराभिः कांश्चिद्धोरैः परश्वधैः.. 18.91 ..
1.4.m: [He killed] some with a sharp sword, some with showers of iron arrows, / some with dreadful maces, and some with terrifying battle-axes.

1.4.s:
śirāṃsi keṣācidapātayadrathādbhujāṃstathā sārathīṃscogravegān..
kāṃścitpipeṣātharathasya vegātkāṃścittathātyadbhutamuṣṭipātaiḥ.. 18.92 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikā khaṇḍe tārakasainyadevasainyayoryuddhavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 18 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
शिरांसि केषाचिदपातयद्रथाद्भुजांस्तथा सारथींस्चोग्रवेगान्..
कांश्चित्पिपेषाथरथस्य वेगात्कांश्चित्तथात्यद्भुतमुष्टिपातैः.. 18.92 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिका खण्डे तारकसैन्यदेवसैन्ययोर्युद्धवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः.. 18 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
From their chariots he felled the heads of some, the arms [of others], and swift charioteers; / some he crushed with the speed of his chariot, and others with exceedingly marvelous blows of his fists.
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, titled "Description of the Battle Between the Army of Tāraka and the Army of the Gods," in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
kālanemī ruṣāviṣṭasteṣāṃ rūpaṃ na buddhavān..
tato nimiṃ ca daityendraṃ matvā devaṃ mahājavaḥ.. 19.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
कालनेमी रुषाविष्टस्तेषां रूपं न बुद्धवान्..
ततो निमिं च दैत्येन्द्रं मत्वा देवं महाजवः.. 19.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Overcome with rage, Kālanemi did not perceive their true appearance. / Then, believing Nimi, the king of the Daityas, to be a god, the immensely swift one

1.4.s:
keśeṣu gṛhya taṃ vīraṃ cakarṣa ca nanāda ca..
tato nimiruvācedaṃ kālanemiṃ mahābalam.. 19.2 ..
1.4.d:
केशेषु गृह्य तं वीरं चकर्ष च ननाद च..
ततो निमिरुवाचेदं कालनेमिं महाबलम्.. 19.2 ..
1.4.m: seized that warrior by the hair, dragged him, and roared. / Thereupon Nimi spoke these words to the exceedingly mighty Kālanemi:

1.4.s:
ahaṃ nimiḥ kālaneme sutaṃ matvā vadhasva mā..
bhavatā mohitenājau devānmatvāsurāḥ svakāḥ.. 19.3 ..
1.4.d:
अहं निमिः कालनेमे सुतं मत्वा वधस्व मा..
भवता मोहितेनाजौ देवान्मत्वासुराः स्वकाः.. 19.3 ..
1.4.m: "I am Nimi, O Kālanemi; knowing me to be your son, do not strike me! / Deluded in battle, taking your own Asuras for gods,

1.4.s:
suraiḥ sudurjayāḥ koṭyo nihatādaśa viddhi tat..
sarvāstravāraṇaṃ muṃca brahmamastraṃ tvarānvitaḥ.. 19.4 ..
1.4.d:
सुरैः सुदुर्जयाः कोट्यो निहतादश विद्धि तत्..
सर्वास्त्रवारणं मुंच ब्रह्ममस्त्रं त्वरान्वितः.. 19.4 ..
1.4.m: you have slain ten crores [of them], who were exceedingly difficult for the gods to vanquish—know this! / Swiftly release the Brahmā weapon, which wards off all weapons."

1.4.s:
sa tena bodhito daityo muktvā taṃ saṃbhramākulaḥ..
bāṇaṃ brahmāstravihitaṃ mumoca tvarayānvitaḥ.. 19.5 ..
1.4.d:
स तेन बोधितो दैत्यो मुक्त्वा तं संभ्रमाकुलः..
बाणं ब्रह्मास्त्रविहितं मुमोच त्वरयान्वितः.. 19.5 ..
1.4.m: Awakened by him, the Daitya released him, bewildered with agitation, / and in great haste discharged an arrow empowered by the Brahmā weapon.

1.4.s:
brahmāstraṃ tatprajajvāla tataḥ khe sumahādbhutam..
devānāṃ cābhavatsainyaṃ sarvameva bhayākulam.. 19.6 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मास्त्रं तत्प्रजज्वाल ततः खे सुमहाद्भुतम्..
देवानां चाभवत्सैन्यं सर्वमेव भयाकुलम्.. 19.6 ..
1.4.m: That Brahmā weapon then blazed up in the sky, exceedingly wondrous; / and the entire army of the gods became confounded with fear.

1.4.s:
śaṃbarāstraṃ tataḥ śāṃtaṃ brāhmapratihataṃ tadā..
tasminpratihate hyastre bhāskaraḥ prabhuḥ.. 19.7 ..
1.4.d:
शंबरास्त्रं ततः शांतं ब्राह्मप्रतिहतं तदा..
तस्मिन्प्रतिहते ह्यस्त्रे भास्करः प्रभुः.. 19.7 ..
1.4.m: Then the weapon of Śambara, neutralized by the Brahmā weapon, was pacified. / Indeed, when that weapon was countered, the lord Bhāskara (the Sun),

1.4.s:
maheṃdrajālamāstāya cakre bhīṣaṇāṃ tanum..
visphūrjatkarasaṃghātasamākrāṃtajagattrayaḥ.. 19.8 ..
1.4.d:
महेंद्रजालमास्ताय चक्रे भीषणां तनुम्..
विस्फूर्जत्करसंघातसमाक्रांतजगत्त्रयः.. 19.8 ..
1.4.m: resorting to the great illusion of Indra, assumed a terrifying form; / having pervaded the three worlds with a dense mass of flashing rays,

1.4.s:
tatāpa dānavānīkaṃ galanmajjāṅghriśoṇitam..
cakṣūṃṣi dānavendrāṇāṃ cakārāṃdhāni sa prabhuḥ.. 19.9 ..
1.4.d:
तताप दानवानीकं गलन्मज्जाङ्घ्रिशोणितम्..
चक्षूंषि दानवेन्द्राणां चकारांधानि स प्रभुः.. 19.9 ..
1.4.m: he scorched the Dānava host so that their marrow, legs, and blood melted away. / That lord blinded the eyes of the kings of the Dānavas.

1.4.s:
gajānāmagalanmedaḥ petuścāpi rathā bhuvi..
turaṃgamāḥ śvasaṃtaśca gharmārtā rathinopi ca.. 19.10 ..
1.4.d:
गजानामगलन्मेदः पेतुश्चापि रथा भुवि..
तुरंगमाः श्वसंतश्च घर्मार्ता रथिनोपि च.. 19.10 ..
1.4.m: The fat of the elephants melted, and chariots collapsed upon the ground; / horses panted, and charioteers were tormented by the heat.

1.4.s:
itaścetaśca salilaṃ prārthayaṃtastṛṣāturāḥ..
giridroṇīśca pādāṃśca giriṇāṃ gahanāni ca.. 19.11 ..
1.4.d:
इतश्चेतश्च सलिलं प्रार्थयंतस्तृषातुराः..
गिरिद्रोणीश्च पादांश्च गिरिणां गहनानि च.. 19.11 ..
1.4.m: Afflicted with thirst, seeking water here and there, / [they sought] mountain gorges, the foothills of mountains, and thickets.

1.4.s:
teṣāṃ prārthayatāṃ śīghramanyonyaṃ ca visarpiṇām..
dāvāgnirajvalattīvro ghoro nardagdhapādapaḥ.. 19.12 ..
1.4.d:
तेषां प्रार्थयतां शीघ्रमन्योन्यं च विसर्पिणाम्..
दावाग्निरज्वलत्तीव्रो घोरो नर्दग्धपादपः.. 19.12 ..
1.4.m: As they sought [water] quickly, dispersing among one another, / an intense forest fire blazed up, dreadful, burning the trees with a roar.

1.4.s:
toyārthinaḥ puro dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ kallo lamālitam..
puraḥsthitamapi prāptuṃ na śekurupasāditum.. 19.13 ..
1.4.d:
तोयार्थिनः पुरो दृष्ट्वा तोयं कल्लो लमालितम्..
पुरःस्थितमपि प्राप्तुं न शेकुरुपसादितुम्.. 19.13 ..
1.4.m: Craving water, seeing water before them wreathed in waves, / though it stood right before them, they were unable to reach it or approach it.

1.4.s:
aprāpya salilaṃ bhūmāvabhyāśe drutameva te..
tatratatra vyadṛśyanta mṛtā daityeśvarābhuvi.. 19.14 ..
1.4.d:
अप्राप्य सलिलं भूमावभ्याशे द्रुतमेव ते..
तत्रतत्र व्यदृश्यन्त मृता दैत्येश्वराभुवि.. 19.14 ..
1.4.m: Failing to obtain water on the earth in their vicinity, / those lords of the Daityas were seen dying swiftly here and there upon the ground.

1.4.s:
rathā gajāśca patitāsturaṃgāśca śramānvitāḥ..
sthitā vamaṃto dhāvaṃto galaddrutavasāsrajaḥ.. 19.15 ..
1.4.d:
रथा गजाश्च पतितास्तुरंगाश्च श्रमान्विताः..
स्थिता वमंतो धावंतो गलद्द्रुतवसास्रजः.. 19.15 ..
1.4.m: Chariots and elephants fell, and horses, overcome with exhaustion, / stood vomiting, running about, their melted fat and blood pouring forth.

1.4.s:
dānavānāṃ koṭikoṭi vyadṛśyatamṛtaṃ tadā..
evaṃ kṣayo jānavānāṃ tasminmahati vartite.. 19.16 ..
1.4.d:
दानवानां कोटिकोटि व्यदृश्यतमृतं तदा..
एवं क्षयो जानवानां तस्मिन्महति वर्तिते.. 19.16 ..
1.4.m: Crores upon crores of Dānavas were then seen lying dead. / While this great destruction of the Dānavas was thus taking place,

1.4.s:
prakopodbhūtatāmrākṣaḥ kālanemī ruṣāturaḥ..
babhūva kālamedhābhaḥ sphuradromaśatahradaḥ.. 19.17 ..
1.4.d:
प्रकोपोद्भूतताम्राक्षः कालनेमी रुषातुरः..
बभूव कालमेधाभः स्फुरद्रोमशतह्रदः.. 19.17 ..
1.4.m: Kālanemi, his eyes copper-red with intense wrath and afflicted with fury, / came to resemble a dark death-cloud, his flashing hair like a hundred lightning bolts.

1.4.s:
gaṃbhīrāsphoṭanirhrādajagaddhṛdayakaṃpanaḥ..
pracchādya gaganaṃ sūryaprabhāṃ sarvāṃ vyanāśayat.. 19.18 ..
1.4.d:
गंभीरास्फोटनिर्ह्रादजगद्धृदयकंपनः..
प्रच्छाद्य गगनं सूर्यप्रभां सर्वां व्यनाशयत्.. 19.18 ..
1.4.m: Making the heart of the world tremble with the roar of his deep clapping, / he covered the sky and destroyed all the light of the sun.

1.4.s:
vavarṣa śītaṃ ca jalaṃ dānavendrabalaṃ prati..
daityāstāṃ vṛṣṭimāsādya samāśvastāstataḥ kramāt.. 19.19 ..
1.4.d:
ववर्ष शीतं च जलं दानवेन्द्रबलं प्रति..
दैत्यास्तां वृष्टिमासाद्य समाश्वस्तास्ततः क्रमात्.. 19.19 ..
1.4.m: He rained down cold water upon the army of the lords of the Dānavas; / having received that rain, the Daityas gradually regained their strength,

1.4.s:
bījāṃkurā iva mlānāḥ prāpya vṛṣṭiṃ dharātale..
tataḥ sa megharūpeṇa kālanemirmahāsurāḥ.. 19.20 ..
1.4.d:
बीजांकुरा इव म्लानाः प्राप्य वृष्टिं धरातले..
ततः स मेघरूपेण कालनेमिर्महासुराः.. 19.20 ..
1.4.m: like withered seed-sprouts upon the earth receiving rain. / Then, in the form of a cloud, that invincible great Asura Kālanemi

1.4.s:
śastravṛṣṭiṃ vavarṣogrāṃ devanīkeṣu durjayaḥ..
tayā vṛṣṭyā pīḍyamānā daityairanyaiśca devatāḥ.. 19.21 ..
1.4.d:
शस्त्रवृष्टिं ववर्षोग्रां देवनीकेषु दुर्जयः..
तया वृष्ट्या पीड्यमाना दैत्यैरन्यैश्च देवताः.. 19.21 ..
1.4.m: rained down a fierce shower of weapons upon the armies of the gods. / Tormented by that shower and by the other Daityas, the gods

1.4.s:
gatiṃ kāṃcinna paśyanti gāvaḥ śītārditā iva..
parasparaṃ vyalīyaṃta gajeṣu turageṣu ca..
ratheṣu ca bhayatrastāstatratatra nililyire.. 19.22 ..
1.4.d:
गतिं कांचिन्न पश्यन्ति गावः शीतार्दिता इव..
परस्परं व्यलीयंत गजेषु तुरगेषु च..
रथेषु च भयत्रस्तास्तत्रतत्र निलिल्यिरे.. 19.22 ..
1.4.m: saw no way out, like cattle afflicted with cold; / they crowded together among the elephants, horses, / and chariots, and hid themselves here and there, terrified with fear.

1.4.s:
evaṃ te līyamānāśca nihatāḥ kālane minā..
dṛśyaṃte patitā devāḥ śastrabhinnaṃgasaṃdhayaḥ.. 19.23 ..
1.4.d:
एवं ते लीयमानाश्च निहताः कालने मिना..
दृश्यंते पतिता देवाः शस्त्रभिन्नंगसंधयः.. 19.23 ..
1.4.m: As they thus hid, the gods, slain by Kālanemi, / were seen falling, the joints of their limbs shattered by weapons,

1.4.s:
vibhinnā bhinnamūrdhānastathā bhinnorujānavaḥ..
viparyastaṃ rathāṃgaiśca patitaṃ dhvajaśaktibhiḥ.. 19.24 ..
1.4.d:
विभिन्ना भिन्नमूर्धानस्तथा भिन्नोरुजानवः..
विपर्यस्तं रथांगैश्च पतितं ध्वजशक्तिभिः.. 19.24 ..
1.4.m: severed, their heads cleft, and their thighs and knees broken, / overturned by chariot-wheels, and struck down by standards and javelins.

1.4.s:
turaṃgāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gajānāmayutāni ca..
raktena teṣāṃ ghoreṇa dustarā cābhavanmahī.. 19.25 ..
1.4.d:
तुरंगाणां सहस्राणि गजानामयुतानि च..
रक्तेन तेषां घोरेण दुस्तरा चाभवन्मही.. 19.25 ..
1.4.m: With thousands of horses and tens of thousands of elephants, / the earth became impassable on account of their dreadful blood.

1.4.s:
evamājau mahādaityaḥ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ..
jaghne muhurtamātreṇa gaṃdharvāṇāṃ daśāyutam.. 19.26 ..
1.4.d:
एवमाजौ महादैत्यः कालनेमिर्महासुरः..
जघ्ने मुहुर्तमात्रेण गंधर्वाणां दशायुतम्.. 19.26 ..
1.4.m: Thus in battle, the great Daitya, the great Asura Kālanemi, / slew a hundred thousand Gandharvas in merely a muhūrta.

1.4.s:
yakṣāṇāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi kiṃnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca..
jaghne piśācamukhyānāṃ saptalakṣāṇi nirbhayaḥ.. 19.27 ..
1.4.d:
यक्षाणां पंचलक्षाणि किंनराणां तथैव च..
जघ्ने पिशाचमुख्यानां सप्तलक्षाणि निर्भयः.. 19.27 ..
1.4.m: Fearless, he slew five hundred thousand Yakṣas, as many Kinnaras, / and seven hundred thousand chiefs of Piśācas.

1.4.s:
itareṣāṃ na saṃkhyāsti surajātinikāyinām..
jaghne sa koṭiśaḥ kraddhaḥ kālanemirmadotkaṭaḥ.. 19.28 ..
1.4.d:
इतरेषां न संख्यास्ति सुरजातिनिकायिनाम्..
जघ्ने स कोटिशः क्रद्धः कालनेमिर्मदोत्कटः.. 19.28 ..
1.4.m: There was no counting the other groups of the classes of deities; / enraged and puffed up with arrogance, Kālanemi slew them by the crores.

1.4.s:
evaṃ pratibhaye bhīme tadāmara mahākṣaye..
saṃkruddhāvaśvinau vīrau citrāstrakavacojjavalau.. 19.29 ..
1.4.d:
एवं प्रतिभये भीमे तदामर महाक्षये..
संक्रुद्धावश्विनौ वीरौ चित्रास्त्रकवचोज्जवलौ.. 19.29 ..
1.4.m: While such a terrifying, dreadful, great destruction of the immortals was taking place, / the heroic Aśvins, furious, radiant with wondrous weapons and armor,

1.4.s:
jaghnatustau raṇe daityamekaikaṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ śaraiḥ..
nirbhidya te mahādaityaṃ sapuṃkhā viviśurmahīm.. 19.30 ..
1.4.d:
जघ्नतुस्तौ रणे दैत्यमेकैकं षष्टिभिः शरैः..
निर्भिद्य ते महादैत्यं सपुंखा विविशुर्महीम्.. 19.30 ..
1.4.m: both struck that Daitya in battle, each with sixty arrows. / Piercing the great Daitya, [the arrows], feathers and all, entered the earth.

1.4.s:
tābhyāṃ bāṇaprahāraistu kiṃcitso'vāptacetanaḥ..
jagrāha cakraṃ lakṣāraṃ tailadhautaṃ raṇe'dhikam.. 19.31 ..
1.4.d:
ताभ्यां बाणप्रहारैस्तु किंचित्सोऽवाप्तचेतनः..
जग्राह चक्रं लक्षारं तैलधौतं रणेऽधिकम्.. 19.31 ..
1.4.m: Somewhat recovering his consciousness from the blows of the arrows shot by the two, / he seized in battle an exceptional discus of a hundred thousand spokes, cleaned with oil.

1.4.s:
tena cakreṇa sośvibhyāṃ ciccheda rathakūbaram..
jagrāhātha dhanurdaityaḥ śarāṃścāśīviṣopamān.. 19.32 ..
1.4.d:
तेन चक्रेण सोश्विभ्यां चिच्छेद रथकूबरम्..
जग्राहाथ धनुर्दैत्यः शरांश्चाशीविषोपमान्.. 19.32 ..
1.4.m: With that discus, he severed the yoke-pole of the chariot of the two Aśvins. / Then the Daitya seized a bow and arrows resembling venomous serpents;

1.4.s:
vavarṣa bhiṣajormūrdhni saṃchādyākāśagocaram..
tāvapyastraiḥ smṛtaiḥ sarvāśchedaturdaityasāyakān.. 19.33 ..
1.4.d:
ववर्ष भिषजोर्मूर्ध्नि संछाद्याकाशगोचरम्..
तावप्यस्त्रैः स्मृतैः सर्वाश्छेदतुर्दैत्यसायकान्.. 19.33 ..
1.4.m: shrouding the sky, he rained them down upon the heads of the two physicians. / They too, by means of recalled weapons, cut down all the Daitya's arrows.

1.4.s:
tacca karama tayordṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ kopamāviśat..
jagrāha mudgaraṃ bhīma kāladaṃḍavibhīṣaṇam.. 19.34 ..
1.4.d:
तच्च करम तयोर्दृष्ट्वा विस्मितः कोपमाविशत्..
जग्राह मुद्गरं भीम कालदंडविभीषणम्.. 19.34 ..
