1.4.m: Seeing that feat of the two, he was filled with wonder and gave way to rage; / he seized a fierce club, terrifying as the rod of death.

1.4.s:
sa tadamudbhrāmya vegena cikṣepāsya rathaṃ prati..
taṃ tu mudgaramāyāṃtamālokyāṃbaragocare.. 19.35 ..
1.4.d:
स तदमुद्भ्राम्य वेगेन चिक्षेपास्य रथं प्रति..
तं तु मुद्गरमायांतमालोक्यांबरगोचरे.. 19.35 ..
1.4.m: Swirling it with great force, he hurled it toward their chariot. / Seeing that club coming through the sky,

1.4.s:
muktvā rathāvubhau vegādāplutau tarasāśvinau..
tau rathau sa tu niṣpiṣya mudgaro'calasaṃnibhaḥ.. 19.36 ..
1.4.d:
मुक्त्वा रथावुभौ वेगादाप्लुतौ तरसाश्विनौ..
तौ रथौ स तु निष्पिष्य मुद्गरोऽचलसंनिभः.. 19.36 ..
1.4.m: both Aśvins abandoned their chariots and leaped away with speed. / Crushing those two chariots, that club, which resembled a mountain

1.4.s:
dārayāmāsa dharaṇīṃ hemajālapariṣkṛtaḥ..
tasya karmātha taddṛṣṭvā bhiṣajau citrayodhinau.. 19.37 ..
1.4.d:
दारयामास धरणीं हेमजालपरिष्कृतः..
तस्य कर्माथ तद्दृष्ट्वा भिषजौ चित्रयोधिनौ.. 19.37 ..
1.4.m: and was adorned with a golden network, tore open the earth. / Seeing that deed of his, the two physicians, wondrous fighters,

1.4.s:
vajrāstraṃ ca prakurvāṇau dānaveṃdramayudhyatām..
ghoravajraprahāraistu dānavaḥ sa parikṣataḥ.. 19.38 ..
1.4.d:
वज्रास्त्रं च प्रकुर्वाणौ दानवेंद्रमयुध्यताम्..
घोरवज्रप्रहारैस्तु दानवः स परिक्षतः.. 19.38 ..
1.4.m: Employing the thunderbolt missile, the two fought the lord of Dānavas. / Pierced by the strikes of that terrible thunderbolt, the Dānava,

1.4.s:
ratho dhvajo dhanuścaiva chatraṃ ca kavacaṃ tathā..
kṣaṇena śatadhā bhūtaṃ sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ.. 19.39 ..
1.4.d:
रथो ध्वजो धनुश्चैव छत्रं च कवचं तथा..
क्षणेन शतधा भूतं सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः.. 19.39 ..
1.4.m: his chariot, flag, bow, umbrella, and armor / were in an instant shattered into a hundred pieces before the eyes of the entire army.

1.4.s:
taddṛṣṭvā dukaraṃ karma so'śvibhyāṃ bhīmavikramaḥ..
nārāyaṇāstraṃ balavānmumoca raṇamūrdhani.. 19.40 ..
1.4.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा दुकरं कर्म सोऽश्विभ्यां भीमविक्रमः..
नारायणास्त्रं बलवान्मुमोच रणमूर्धनि.. 19.40 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that difficult deed done by the two Aśvins, he of terrible prowess, / mighty [Kālanemi], discharged the Nārāyaṇa missile at the vanguard of battle.

1.4.s:
tataḥ śaśāma vajrāstraṃ kālanemistato ruṣā..
jīvagrāhaṃ grāhayitumaśvinau tau pracakrame.. 19.41 ..
1.4.d:
ततः शशाम वज्रास्त्रं कालनेमिस्ततो रुषा..
जीवग्राहं ग्राहयितुमश्विनौ तौ प्रचक्रमे.. 19.41 ..
1.4.m: Then the thunderbolt missile was quelled; thereupon Kālanemi, in anger, / set out to capture the two Aśvins alive.

1.4.s:
tāvabhiprāyamālakṣya saṃtyajya samarāṃgaṇam..
padātī vepamānāṃgau pradrutau vāsavoyataḥ.. 19.42 ..
1.4.d:
तावभिप्रायमालक्ष्य संत्यज्य समरांगणम्..
पदाती वेपमानांगौ प्रद्रुतौ वासवोयतः.. 19.42 ..
1.4.m: Perceiving his intention, abandoning the battlefield, / the two fled on foot, limbs trembling, to where Indra was.

1.4.s:
tayoranugato daityaḥ kālanemirnadanmuhuḥ..
prāpyeṃdrasya balaṃ krūro daityānīkapadānugaḥ.. 19.43 ..
1.4.d:
तयोरनुगतो दैत्यः कालनेमिर्नदन्मुहुः..
प्राप्येंद्रस्य बलं क्रूरो दैत्यानीकपदानुगः.. 19.43 ..
1.4.m: The Daitya Kālanemi pursued the two, roaring again and again; / the cruel one, followed by the Daitya army, reached Indra's force.

1.4.s:
sa kāla iva kalpāṃte yadā vāsavamādrutaḥ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūtāni viviśurvihvalāni tu.. 19.44 ..
1.4.d:
स काल इव कल्पांते यदा वासवमाद्रुतः..
तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वभूतानि विविशुर्विह्वलानि तु.. 19.44 ..
1.4.m: When he rushed against Indra like Death at the end of an eon, / all beings, beholding him, became agitated and bewildered.

1.4.s:
hāhārāvaṃ prakurvāṇāstadā devāśca menire..
parājayaṃ maheṃdrasya sarvalokakṣayāvaham.. 19.45 ..
1.4.d:
हाहारावं प्रकुर्वाणास्तदा देवाश्च मेनिरे..
पराजयं महेंद्रस्य सर्वलोकक्षयावहम्.. 19.45 ..
1.4.m: Crying aloud in distress, the gods then considered / the defeat of Mahendra, which would bring ruin to all worlds, [inevitable].

1.4.s:
celuḥ śikhariṇo mukhyāḥ peturulkā nabhastalāt..
jagarjurjaladā dikṣu saṃbhūtaśca mahāravaḥ.. 19.46 ..
1.4.d:
चेलुः शिखरिणो मुख्याः पेतुरुल्का नभस्तलात्..
जगर्जुर्जलदा दिक्षु संभूतश्च महारवः.. 19.46 ..
1.4.m: Foremost mountain peaks shook; meteors fell from the vault of heaven; / clouds thundered in all directions, and a tremendous uproar arose.

1.4.s:
tāṃ bhūtāvikṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ seṃdrā bhayāvahāḥ..
manasā śaraṇaṃ jagmurvāsudevaṃ jagatpatim.. 19.47 ..
1.4.d:
तां भूताविकृतिं दृष्ट्वा देवाः सेंद्रा भयावहाः..
मनसा शरणं जग्मुर्वासुदेवं जगत्पतिम्.. 19.47 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that unnatural portent of beings, the terrified gods, together with Indra, / sought refuge in their minds with Vāsudeva, Lord of the universe:

1.4.s:
namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca..
jagaddhitāya kṛṣṇāya goviṃdāya namonamaḥ.. 19.48 ..
1.4.d:
नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय गोब्राह्मणहिताय च..
जगद्धिताय कृष्णाय गोविंदाय नमोनमः.. 19.48 ..
1.4.m: “Salutations to the deity devoted to brahmins, to the benefactor of cows and brahmins, / to Kṛṣṇa, the benefactor of the universe; salutations, salutations to Govinda!

1.4.s:
sa no rakṣatu goviṃdo bhayārtāste jaguḥ surāḥ..
surāṇāṃ ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā bhagavāngaruḍadhvajaḥ.. 19.49 ..
1.4.d:
स नो रक्षतु गोविंदो भयार्तास्ते जगुः सुराः..
सुराणां चिंतितं ज्ञात्वा भगवान्गरुडध्वजः.. 19.49 ..
1.4.m: May that Govinda protect us!” Thus the gods, tormented by fear, chanted. / Knowing the thoughts of the gods, the blessed Lord who bears Garuḍa on his banner,

1.4.s:
vibudhyaiva ca paryaṃkādyoganidrāṃ vihāya saḥ..
lakṣmīkarayugāṃbhojalālitāṃghrisaroruhaḥ.. 19.50 ..
1.4.d:
विबुध्यैव च पर्यंकाद्योगनिद्रां विहाय सः..
लक्ष्मीकरयुगांभोजलालितांघ्रिसरोरुहः.. 19.50 ..
1.4.m: awoke from his couch, relinquishing his yogic sleep— / he whose lotus-feet are caressed by the lotus-pair of Lakṣmī's hands,

1.4.s:
śāradaṃbaranīrābjakāṃtidehacchaviḥ prabhuḥ..
kaustubhodbhāsihṛdayaḥ kāṃtakeyūrabhāskaraḥ.. 19.51 ..
1.4.d:
शारदंबरनीराब्जकांतिदेहच्छविः प्रभुः..
कौस्तुभोद्भासिहृदयः कांतकेयूरभास्करः.. 19.51 ..
1.4.m: the Lord whose body radiates the luster of a blue lotus under an autumn sky, / whose chest is illumined by the Kaustubha gem, blazing with beautiful armlets—

1.4.s:
vimṛśya surasaṃkṣobhaṃ vainateyamātāhvayat..
āhūte'visthitetasmingaruḍe duḥkhite bhṛśam.. 19.52 ..
1.4.d:
विमृश्य सुरसंक्षोभं वैनतेयमाताह्वयत्..
आहूतेऽविस्थितेतस्मिन्गरुडे दुःखिते भृशम्.. 19.52 ..
1.4.m: reflecting upon the agitation of the gods, he summoned the son of Vinatā. / When Garuḍa was summoned and arrived, greatly sorrowed,

1.4.s:
divyanānāstratīkṣṇārcirāruhyāgātsurāhavam..
tatrāpaśyata deveṃdraṃ bhayabhītamabhidrutam.. 19.53 ..
1.4.d:
दिव्यनानास्त्रतीक्ष्णार्चिरारुह्यागात्सुराहवम्..
तत्रापश्यत देवेंद्रं भयभीतमभिद्रुतम्.. 19.53 ..
1.4.m: the Lord, blazing with sharp rays of diverse divine weapons, mounted him and went to the battle of the gods. / There he saw the King of gods, terrified and pursued

1.4.s:
dānaveṃdrairnavāṃbhodasacchāyaiḥ sarvathotkaṭaiḥ..
yathā hi puruṣaṃ ghorairabhāgyairarthakāṃkṣibhiḥ.. 19.54 ..
1.4.d:
दानवेंद्रैर्नवांभोदसच्छायैः सर्वथोत्कटैः..
यथा हि पुरुषं घोरैरभाग्यैरर्थकांक्षिभिः.. 19.54 ..
1.4.m: by Dānava chiefs resembling fresh rain-clouds, arrogant in every way, / just as a man is pursued by terrible misfortunes seeking his wealth.

1.4.s:
tattrāṇāyāvrajadviṣṇuḥ stūyamāno muhuḥ suraiḥ..
abhāgyebhyaḥ paritrātuṃ sukṛtaṃ nirmalaṃ yathā.. 19.55 ..
1.4.d:
तत्त्राणायाव्रजद्विष्णुः स्तूयमानो मुहुः सुरैः..
अभाग्येभ्यः परित्रातुं सुकृतं निर्मलं यथा.. 19.55 ..
1.4.m: To protect him, Viṣṇu advanced, praised repeatedly by the gods, / just as pure good merit arrives to rescue [a man] from misfortunes.

1.4.s:
athāpaśyata daityeṃdro viyati dyutimaṃḍalam..
sphuraṃtamudayācchīghraṃ kāṃtaṃ sūryaśataṃ yathā.. 19.56 ..
1.4.d:
अथापश्यत दैत्येंद्रो वियति द्युतिमंडलम्..
स्फुरंतमुदयाच्छीघ्रं कांतं सूर्यशतं यथा.. 19.56 ..
1.4.m: Then the Daitya chief saw an orb of light in the sky / flashing swiftly from the mountain of sunrise, lovely as a hundred suns.

1.4.s:
prabhavaṃ jñātumicchaṃto dānavāstasya tejasaḥ..
garuḍaṃ tamathā paśyankalpāṃtānalabhairavam.. 19.57 ..
1.4.d:
प्रभवं ज्ञातुमिच्छंतो दानवास्तस्य तेजसः..
गरुडं तमथा पश्यन्कल्पांतानलभैरवम्.. 19.57 ..
1.4.m: Wishing to know the source of that fiery energy, the Dānavas then / saw Garuḍa, fearsome as the fire at the end of an eon,

1.4.s:
tatra sthitaṃ caturbāhuṃ hariṃ cānupamadyutim..
tamālokyāsureṃdrāstu harṣasaṃpūrṇamānasāḥ.. 19.58 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र स्थितं चतुर्बाहुं हरिं चानुपमद्युतिम्..
तमालोक्यासुरेंद्रास्तु हर्षसंपूर्णमानसाः.. 19.58 ..
1.4.m: and mounted upon him the four-armed Hari of matchless splendor. / Seeing him, the chiefs of Asuras, their minds filled with joy, [cried]:

1.4.s:
ayaṃ sa devaḥ sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ keśavo'rihā..
asmiñjite jitāḥ sarvā devatā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 19.59 ..
1.4.d:
अयं स देवः सर्वेषां शरणं केशवोऽरिहा..
अस्मिञ्जिते जिताः सर्वा देवता नात्र संशयः.. 19.59 ..
1.4.m: “This is that god, the refuge of all, Keśava, the slayer of foes! / Once he is conquered, all the deities are conquered—there is no doubt of this!

1.4.s:
enamāśritya lokeśā yajñabhāgabhujo'marāḥ..
ityuktvā te samāgamya sarva eva tatastataḥ.. 19.60 ..
1.4.d:
एनमाश्रित्य लोकेशा यज्ञभागभुजोऽमराः..
इत्युक्त्वा ते समागम्य सर्व एव ततस्ततः.. 19.60 ..
1.4.m: Relying on him, the lords of the worlds, the immortals, enjoy their shares of sacrifice!” / Saying this, gathering together from all sides,

1.4.s:
taṃ jaghnurvividhaiḥ śastraiḥ parivārya samaṃtataḥ..
kālanemiprabhṛtayo daśa daityamahārathāḥ.. 19.61 ..
1.4.d:
तं जघ्नुर्विविधैः शस्त्रैः परिवार्य समंततः..
कालनेमिप्रभृतयो दश दैत्यमहारथाः.. 19.61 ..
1.4.m: they struck him with various weapons, surrounding him on every side— / Kālanemi and the other ten great Daitya car-warriors.

1.4.s:
ṣaṣṭyā vivyādhabāṇānāṃ kālanemirjanārdanam..
nimiḥ śatena bāṇānāṃ mathano'śītibhiḥ śaraiḥ.. 19.62 ..
1.4.d:
षष्ट्या विव्याधबाणानां कालनेमिर्जनार्दनम्..
निमिः शतेन बाणानां मथनोऽशीतिभिः शरैः.. 19.62 ..
1.4.m: Kālanemi pierced Janārdana with sixty arrows, / Nimi with a hundred arrows, Mathana with eighty shafts,

1.4.s:
jaṃbhakaścaiva saptatyā śuṃbho daśabhireva ca..
śeṣā daitye śvarāḥ sava viṣṇumekaikaśaḥ śaraiḥ.. 19.63 ..
1.4.d:
जंभकश्चैव सप्तत्या शुंभो दशभिरेव च..
शेषा दैत्ये श्वराः सव विष्णुमेकैकशः शरैः.. 19.63 ..
1.4.m: Jambhaka with seventy, and Śumbha with ten. / The remaining Daitya lords all struck Viṣṇu individually with arrows—

1.4.s:
daśabhirdaśabhiḥ śalyairjaghnuḥ sagaruḍaṃ raṇe..
teṣāmamṛṣyattatkarma viṣṇurdānavasūdanaḥ.. 19.64 ..
1.4.d:
दशभिर्दशभिः शल्यैर्जघ्नुः सगरुडं रणे..
तेषाममृष्यत्तत्कर्म विष्णुर्दानवसूदनः.. 19.64 ..
1.4.m: with ten darts each they struck him together with Garuḍa in battle. / Viṣṇu, slayer of Dānavas, could not tolerate that deed of theirs;

1.4.s:
ekaikaṃ dānavaṃ jaghne ṣaḍbhiḥ paḍbhirajihnagaiḥ..
ākarṇakṛṣṭairbhūyaśca kālanemistribhiḥ śaraiḥ.. 19.65 ..
1.4.d:
एकैकं दानवं जघ्ने षड्भिः पड्भिरजिह्नगैः..
आकर्णकृष्टैर्भूयश्च कालनेमिस्त्रिभिः शरैः.. 19.65 ..
1.4.m: he struck each Dānava with six straight-flying arrows. / Again, with three arrows drawn to his ear, Kālanemi

1.4.s:
viṣṇuṃ vivyādha hṛdaye roṣādraktavilocanaḥ..
tasyāśobhaṃta te bāṇā hṛdaye taptakāṃcanāḥ.. 19.66 ..
1.4.d:
विष्णुं विव्याध हृदये रोषाद्रक्तविलोचनः..
तस्याशोभंत ते बाणा हृदये तप्तकांचनाः.. 19.66 ..
1.4.m: pierced Viṣṇu in the chest, his eyes red with rage. / Those arrows of molten gold shone on his chest

1.4.s:
mayūkhā iva saṃdīptāḥ kaustubhasya sphurattviṣaḥ..
tairbāṇaiḥ kiṃcidāyasto harirjagrāha mudgaram.. 19.67 ..
1.4.d:
मयूखा इव संदीप्ताः कौस्तुभस्य स्फुरत्त्विषः..
तैर्बाणैः किंचिदायस्तो हरिर्जग्राह मुद्गरम्.. 19.67 ..
1.4.m: like blazing rays flashing from the Kaustubha gem. / Somewhat distressed by those arrows, Hari seized a club.

1.4.s:
sa tamudgrāhya vegena dānavāya mumoca vai..
dānavendrastamaprāptaṃ viyatyeva śataiḥ śaraiḥ.. 19.68 ..
1.4.d:
स तमुद्ग्राह्य वेगेन दानवाय मुमोच वै..
दानवेन्द्रस्तमप्राप्तं वियत्येव शतैः शरैः.. 19.68 ..
1.4.m: Lifting it with force, he hurled it at the Dānava. / Before it reached him, the Dānava chief, while it was still in the air, with hundreds of arrows

1.4.s:
ciccheda tilaśaḥ kruddho darśayanpāṇilāghavam..
tato viṣṇuḥ prakupitaḥ prāsaṃ jagrāha bhairavam.. 19.69 ..
1.4.d:
चिच्छेद तिलशः क्रुद्धो दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्..
ततो विष्णुः प्रकुपितः प्रासं जग्राह भैरवम्.. 19.69 ..
1.4.m: furiously sliced it into sesame-sized pieces, displaying the lightness of his hand. / Then Viṣṇu, enraged, seized a fearsome spear;

1.4.s:
tena daityasya hṛdayaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ..
kṣaṇena labdhasaṃjñastu kālanemirmahāsuraḥ.. 19.70 ..
1.4.d:
तेन दैत्यस्य हृदयं ताडयामास वेगतः..
क्षणेन लब्धसंज्ञस्तु कालनेमिर्महासुरः.. 19.70 ..
1.4.m: with it, he violently struck the Daitya's chest. / Regaining consciousness in a moment, the great Asura Kālanemi

1.4.s:
śaktiṃ jagrāha tīkṣṇāgrāṃ hemaghaṃṭāṭṭahāsinīm..
tayā vāmaṃ bhujaṃ viṣṇorbibheda ditinaṃdanaḥ.. 19.71 ..
1.4.d:
शक्तिं जग्राह तीक्ष्णाग्रां हेमघंटाट्टहासिनीम्..
तया वामं भुजं विष्णोर्बिभेद दितिनंदनः.. 19.71 ..
1.4.m: grasped a sharp-pointed spear ringing with golden bells. / With it, that son of Diti pierced the left arm of Viṣṇu.

1.4.s:
bhinnaṃ śaktyā bhujaṃ tasya srutaśoṇitamābabhau..
nīle balā hake vidyudvidyotaṃtī yathā muhuḥ.. 19.72 ..
1.4.d:
भिन्नं शक्त्या भुजं तस्य स्रुतशोणितमाबभौ..
नीले बला हके विद्युद्विद्योतंती यथा मुहुः.. 19.72 ..
1.4.m: Pierced by the spear, his arm dripping blood shone / like lightning repeatedly flashing in a dark cloud.

1.4.s:
tato viṣṇuḥ prakupito jagrāha vipulaṃ dhanuḥ..
saptadaśa ca nārācāṃstīkṣṇāgrānmarmabhedinaḥ.. 19.73 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विष्णुः प्रकुपितो जग्राह विपुलं धनुः..
सप्तदश च नाराचांस्तीक्ष्णाग्रान्मर्मभेदिनः.. 19.73 ..
1.4.m: Then Viṣṇu, enraged, took up his mighty bow / and seventeen sharp-pointed iron arrows capable of piercing vital spots.

1.4.s:
daityasya hṛdayaṃ ṣaḍbhirvivyādha ca śaraistribhiḥ..
caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā.. 19.74 ..
1.4.d:
दैत्यस्य हृदयं षड्भिर्विव्याध च शरैस्त्रिभिः..
चतुर्भिः सारथिं चास्य ध्वजं चैकेन पत्रिणा.. 19.74 ..
1.4.m: With six, and then three arrows, he pierced the Daitya's chest, / with four his charioteer, and with one feathered shaft his banner;

1.4.s:
dvābhyāṃ dhanurjyādhanuṣī bhujaṃ caikena patriṇā..
sa viddho hṛdaye gāḍhaṃ doṣairmūḍho yathā naraḥ.. 19.75 ..
1.4.d:
द्वाभ्यां धनुर्ज्याधनुषी भुजं चैकेन पत्रिणा..
स विद्धो हृदये गाढं दोषैर्मूढो यथा नरः.. 19.75 ..
1.4.m: with two his bow and bowstring, and with one feathered shaft his arm. / Deeply pierced in the chest, like a man bewildered by vices,

1.4.s:
srutaraktāruṇaḥ prāṃśuḥ pīḍācalitamānasaḥ..
cakaṃpe māruteneva coditaḥ kiṃśukadrumaḥ.. 19.76 ..
1.4.d:
स्रुतरक्तारुणः प्रांशुः पीडाचलितमानसः..
चकंपे मारुतेनेव चोदितः किंशुकद्रुमः.. 19.76 ..
1.4.m: the tall [demon], crimson with flowing blood, his mind shaken with pain, / trembled like a kiṃśuka tree stirred by the wind.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kaṃpitamālakṣya gadāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ..
tāṃ ca vegena cikṣepa kālanemivadhaṃ prati.. 19.77 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कंपितमालक्ष्य गदां जग्राह केशवः..
तां च वेगेन चिक्षेप कालनेमिवधं प्रति.. 19.77 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing him trembling, Keśava seized his mace, / and hurled it with force to slay Kālanemi.

1.4.s:
sā papāta śirasyugrā sahasā kālaneminaḥ..
saṃcūrṇitottamāṃ gastu niṣpiṣṭamukuṭosuraḥ.. 19.78 ..
1.4.d:
सा पपात शिरस्युग्रा सहसा कालनेमिनः..
संचूर्णितोत्तमां गस्तु निष्पिष्टमुकुटोसुरः.. 19.78 ..
1.4.m: That fierce [mace] fell swiftly upon Kālanemi's head; / with his head crushed and his crown smashed to pieces, the Asura,

1.4.s:
srutaraktaugharaṃdhraśca srutadhāturivācalaḥ..
papāta sve rathe bhagno visaṃjñaḥ śiṣṭajīvanaḥ.. 19.79 ..
1.4.d:
स्रुतरक्तौघरंध्रश्च स्रुतधातुरिवाचलः..
पपात स्वे रथे भग्नो विसंज्ञः शिष्टजीवनः.. 19.79 ..
1.4.m: his cavities gushing streams of blood like a mountain discharging mineral ores, / fell broken in his chariot, unconscious, with only a remnant of life.

1.4.s:
patitasya rathopasthe dānavasyācyuto'rihā..
smitapūrvamuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ cakrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ.. 19.80 ..
1.4.d:
पतितस्य रथोपस्थे दानवस्याच्युतोऽरिहा..
स्मितपूर्वमुवाचेदं वाक्यं चक्रायुधः प्रभुः.. 19.80 ..
1.4.m: To the Dānava fallen on the floor of the chariot, the Lord Acyuta, slayer of foes, / armed with the discus, spoke these words with a smile:

1.4.s:
gacchāsura vimukto'si sāṃprataṃ jīva nirvṛtaḥ..
tataḥ svalpena kālena ahameva tavāṃtakaḥ.. 19.81 ..
1.4.d:
गच्छासुर विमुक्तोऽसि सांप्रतं जीव निर्वृतः..
ततः स्वल्पेन कालेन अहमेव तवांतकः.. 19.81 ..
1.4.m: “Go, Asura, you are released; live at ease for now. / Then, after a short time, I myself shall be your ender.”

1.4.s:
evaṃ vacastasya niśamya viṣṇoḥ sarveśvarasyātha rathaṃ nimeṣāt..
nināya dūraṃ kila kālanemino bhītastadā sārathirlokanāthāt.. 19.82 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe devāsurāsaṃgrāme kālanemikṛtayuddhasaṃmarde viṣṇunā saha kālanemiyuddhavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 19 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
एवं वचस्तस्य निशम्य विष्णोः सर्वेश्वरस्याथ रथं निमेषात्..
निनाय दूरं किल कालनेमिनो भीतस्तदा सारथिर्लोकनाथात्.. 19.82 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे देवासुरासंग्रामे कालनेमिकृतयुद्धसंमर्दे विष्णुना सह कालनेमियुद्धवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशोऽध्यायः.. 19 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Hearing these words of Viṣṇu, the Lord of All, Kālanemi’s charioteer, terrified of the Lord of the World, instantly drove the chariot far away.
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Battle of Kālanemi with Viṣṇu, in the Tumult of the Battle between Gods and Asuras," in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavāḥ sarve kruddhāḥ svaiḥsvairbalairvṛtāḥ..
saraghā iva mākṣikaṃ rurudhuḥ sarvatastataḥ.. 20.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
तं दृष्ट्वा दानवाः सर्वे क्रुद्धाः स्वैःस्वैर्बलैर्वृताः..
सरघा इव माक्षिकं रुरुधुः सर्वतस्ततः.. 20.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Seeing him, all the Dānavas, enraged and surrounded by their respective forces, / hemmed him in on all sides, like bees around honey.

1.4.s:
parvatābhe gaje bhīme madasrāviṇi durdame..
sitacitrapatāke tu prabhinnakaraṭāmukhe.. 20.2 ..
1.4.d:
पर्वताभे गजे भीमे मदस्राविणि दुर्दमे..
सितचित्रपताके तु प्रभिन्नकरटामुखे.. 20.2 ..
1.4.m: Upon a fearsome elephant resembling a mountain, streaming with rut, untameable, / bearing white variegated banners, its temple-cheeks split [with mada],

1.4.s:
svarṇavarṇāṃcite yadvannage dāvāgnisaṃvṛte..
āruhyajau nimirdaityo hariṃ pratyudyayau balī.. 20.3 ..
1.4.d:
स्वर्णवर्णांचिते यद्वन्नगे दावाग्निसंवृते..
आरुह्यजौ निमिर्दैत्यो हरिं प्रत्युद्ययौ बली.. 20.3 ..
1.4.m: which was adorned with golden color like a mountain enveloped by forest fire, / the mighty Daitya Nimi mounted and advanced against Hari in battle.

1.4.s:
tasyāsandānavā raudrā gajasya parirakṣiṇaḥ..
saptaviṃśatikoṭyaśca kirīṭakavacojjavalāḥ.. 20.4 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यासन्दानवा रौद्रा गजस्य परिरक्षिणः..
सप्तविंशतिकोट्यश्च किरीटकवचोज्जवलाः.. 20.4 ..
1.4.m: The terrifying Dānavas who guarded that elephant / numbered twenty-seven crores, radiant with diadems and armor.

1.4.s:
aśvamāruhya śailābhaṃ harimādravat..
paṃcayojanapragrīvamuṣṭramāsthāya jaṃbhakaḥ.. 20.5 ..
1.4.d:
अश्वमारुह्य शैलाभं हरिमाद्रवत्..
पंचयोजनप्रग्रीवमुष्ट्रमास्थाय जंभकः.. 20.5 ..
1.4.m: [One] rushed against Hari having mounted a horse resembling a mountain; / Jambhaka, having mounted a camel with a neck five yojanas long;

1.4.s:
śumbho meṣaṃ samāruhyāvrajaddvādaśayojanam..
apare dānavendrāśca yattā nānāstrāpāṇayaḥ.. 20.6 ..
1.4.d:
शुम्भो मेषं समारुह्याव्रजद्द्वादशयोजनम्..
अपरे दानवेन्द्राश्च यत्ता नानास्त्रापाणयः.. 20.6 ..
1.4.m: Śumbha advanced mounted upon a ram twelve yojanas long; / and other Dānava lords, prepared and with various weapons in hand,

1.4.s:
ājagmuḥ samare kruddhā viṣṇumakliṣṭakāriṇam..
paragheṇa nimirdaityo mathano mudgareṇa ca.. 20.7 ..
1.4.d:
आजग्मुः समरे क्रुद्धा विष्णुमक्लिष्टकारिणम्..
परघेण निमिर्दैत्यो मथनो मुद्गरेण च.. 20.7 ..
1.4.m: enraged, advanced in battle against Viṣṇu of effortless deeds: / the Daitya Nimi with an iron bar, and Mathana with a club;

1.4.s:
śumbhaḥ śūlena tīkṣṇena prāsena grasanastathā..
cakreṇa krathanaḥ kruddho jaṃbhaḥ śaktyā mahāraṇe.. 20.8 ..
1.4.d:
शुम्भः शूलेन तीक्ष्णेन प्रासेन ग्रसनस्तथा..
चक्रेण क्रथनः क्रुद्धो जंभः शक्त्या महारणे.. 20.8 ..
1.4.m: Śumbha with a sharp trident, and Grasana likewise with a dart; / the enraged Krathana with a discus, and Jambha with a spear in the great battle.

1.4.s:
jaghnurnārāyaṇaṃ śeṣā viśikhairmarmabhedibhiḥ..
tānyastrāṇi prayuktāni viviśuḥ puruṣottamam.. 20.9 ..
1.4.d:
जघ्नुर्नारायणं शेषा विशिखैर्मर्मभेदिभिः..
तान्यस्त्राणि प्रयुक्तानि विविशुः पुरुषोत्तमम्.. 20.9 ..
1.4.m: The rest struck Nārāyaṇa with arrows that pierce the vitals. / Those weapons discharged entered the Supreme Person,

1.4.s:
upadeśā guroryadvatsacchiṣyaṃ bahudheritāḥ..
tataḥ kruddho harirgṛhya dhanurbāṇāṃśca puṣkalān.. 20.10 ..
1.4.d:
उपदेशा गुरोर्यद्वत्सच्छिष्यं बहुधेरिताः..
ततः क्रुद्धो हरिर्गृह्य धनुर्बाणांश्च पुष्कलान्.. 20.10 ..
1.4.m: like the manifold instructions of a guru entering a good pupil. / Then enraged Hari, taking up his bow and copious arrows,

1.4.s:
mamarda daityasenāṃ taddharmamarthavaco yathā..
nimiṃ vivyādha viṃśatyā vāṇairanalavarcasaiḥ.. 20.11 ..
1.4.d:
ममर्द दैत्यसेनां तद्धर्ममर्थवचो यथा..
निमिं विव्याध विंशत्या वाणैरनलवर्चसैः.. 20.11 ..
1.4.m: crushed the Daitya army, just as discourse on wealth [crushes] righteousness. / He pierced Nimi with twenty arrows brilliant as fire;

1.4.s:
mathanaṃ daśabhiścaiva śumbhaṃ paṃcabhireva ca..
śatena mahiṣaṃ kruddho vivyādhorasi mādhavaḥ.. 20.12 ..
1.4.d:
मथनं दशभिश्चैव शुम्भं पंचभिरेव च..
शतेन महिषं क्रुद्धो विव्याधोरसि माधवः.. 20.12 ..
1.4.m: enraged Mādhava pierced Mathana with ten, Śumbha with five, / and Mahiṣa on his chest with a hundred;

1.4.s:
jaṃbhaṃ dvādaśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvāṃścaikaika śo'ṣṭabhiḥ..
tasya tallāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ.. 20.13 ..
1.4.d:
जंभं द्वादशभिस्तीक्ष्णैः सर्वांश्चैकैक शोऽष्टभिः..
तस्य तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा दानवाः क्रोधमूर्छिताः.. 20.13 ..
1.4.m: and Jambha with twelve sharp [arrows], and each one of the rest with eight. / Seeing his lightness of hand, the Dānavas, faint with rage,

1.4.s:
cakrurgāḍhataraṃ yatnamāvṛṇvānā hariṃ śaraiḥ..
cicchedātha dhanurjyāṃ ca nimirbhallena dānavaḥ.. 20.14 ..
1.4.d:
चक्रुर्गाढतरं यत्नमावृण्वाना हरिं शरैः..
चिच्छेदाथ धनुर्ज्यां च निमिर्भल्लेन दानवः.. 20.14 ..
1.4.m: made a still greater effort, covering Hari with arrows. / Then the Dānava Nimi severed the bowstring with a broad-headed arrow,

1.4.s:
hastāccāpaṃ ca saṃraṃbhācciccheda mahiṣāsuraḥ..
ṣīḍayāmāsā garuḍaṃ jaṃbho bāṇāyutaistribhiḥ.. 20.15 ..
1.4.d:
हस्ताच्चापं च संरंभाच्चिच्छेद महिषासुरः..
षीडयामासा गरुडं जंभो बाणायुतैस्त्रिभिः.. 20.15 ..
1.4.m: and Mahiṣāsura passionately sliced the bow from his hand. / Jambha afflicted Garuḍa with thirty thousand arrows,

1.4.s:
bhujāvasya ca vivyādha śaṃbho bāṇāyutena vai..
tato vismitacittastu gadāṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ.. 20.16 ..
1.4.d:
भुजावस्य च विव्याध शंभो बाणायुतेन वै..
ततो विस्मितचित्तस्तु गदां जग्राह माधवः.. 20.16 ..
1.4.m: and Śambha pierced his two arms with ten thousand arrows. / Then, with an astonished mind, Mādhava seized his mace.

1.4.s:
tāṃ prāhiṇotsa vegena mathanāya mahāhave..
tāmāprāptāṃ nimirbāṇairmuśalābhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ.. 20.17 ..
1.4.d:
तां प्राहिणोत्स वेगेन मथनाय महाहवे..
तामाप्राप्तां निमिर्बाणैर्मुशलाभैः सहस्रशः.. 20.17 ..
1.4.m: He hurled it with speed at Mathana in the great combat. / Before it reached him, Nimi struck it with thousands of arrows resembling pestles,

1.4.s:
āhatya pātayāmāsa vinadankālameghavat..
tatoṃ'tarikṣe hāheti bhūtānāṃ jajñire kathāḥ.. 20.18 ..
1.4.d:
आहत्य पातयामास विनदन्कालमेघवत्..
ततोंऽतरिक्षे हाहेति भूतानां जज्ञिरे कथाः.. 20.18 ..
1.4.m: and knocked it down, roaring like a storm cloud at the end of time. / Then in the sky arose the cries of beings, saying "Alas! Alas!"

1.4.s:
naitadasti balaṃ vyaktaṃ yatrāśīryata sā gadā..
tāṃ hariḥ patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā asthāne prārthanāmiva.. 20.19 ..
1.4.d:
नैतदस्ति बलं व्यक्तं यत्राशीर्यत सा गदा..
तां हरिः पतितां दृष्ट्वा अस्थाने प्रार्थनामिव.. 20.19 ..
1.4.m: There was clearly no strength here [equal to] where that mace was shattered. / Hari, seeing it fallen like a plea made in the wrong place,

1.4.s:
jagrāha mudgaraṃ ghoraṃ divyaratnapariṣkṛtam..
taṃ mumocātivegena nimimuddiśya dānavam.. 20.20 ..
1.4.d:
जग्राह मुद्गरं घोरं दिव्यरत्नपरिष्कृतम्..
तं मुमोचातिवेगेन निमिमुद्दिश्य दानवम्.. 20.20 ..
1.4.m: seized a terrible club adorned with divine gems. / He hurled it with exceeding speed, aiming at the Dānava Nimi.

1.4.s:
tamāyāṃtaṃ viyatyeva trayo daityā hyavārayan..
gadayā daṃbhadaityastu grasanaḥ paṭṭiśena tu.. 20.21 ..
1.4.d:
तमायांतं वियत्येव त्रयो दैत्या ह्यवारयन्..
गदया दंभदैत्यस्तु ग्रसनः पट्टिशेन तु.. 20.21 ..
1.4.m: As it came flying through the sky, three Daityas intercepted it: / the Daitya Dambha with a mace, Grasana with a sharp-edged spear,

1.4.s:
śaktyā ca mahiṣo daityo vinadaṃto mahāraravam..
nirākṛtaṃ tamālokya durjanaiḥ sujanaṃ yathā.. 20.22 ..
1.4.d:
शक्त्या च महिषो दैत्यो विनदंतो महाररवम्..
निराकृतं तमालोक्य दुर्जनैः सुजनं यथा.. 20.22 ..
1.4.m: and the Daitya Mahiṣa with a lance, roaring with a tremendous cry. / Seeing it repelled, as a virtuous man is by the wicked,

1.4.s:
jagrāha śaktimugrogrāṃ śataghaṃṭāmahāsvanām..
jaṃbhāya tāṃ samuddiśya prāhiṇodbhīṣaṇeraṇe.. 20.23 ..
1.4.d:
जग्राह शक्तिमुग्रोग्रां शतघंटामहास्वनाम्..
जंभाय तां समुद्दिश्य प्राहिणोद्भीषणेरणे.. 20.23 ..
1.4.m: he seized a spear exceedingly fierce, with the great resonance of a hundred bells. / Aiming it at Jambha, he hurled it in that terrifying battle.

1.4.s:
tāmāyāntīmathālokya jaṃbho'nyasya rathāttvarāt..
āplutya līlayā gṛhṇankāminīṃ kāmuko yathā.. 20.24 ..
1.4.d:
तामायान्तीमथालोक्य जंभोऽन्यस्य रथात्त्वरात्..
आप्लुत्य लीलया गृह्णन्कामिनीं कामुको यथा.. 20.24 ..
1.4.m: Seeing it arriving, Jambha quickly leapt down from another's chariot / and caught it playfully, like an impassioned man seizing a lovely woman;

1.4.s:
tayaiva garuḍaṃ mūrdhni jaghne sa prahasanbalī..
tato bhūyo rathaṃ prāpya ghanurgṛhyabhyayojayat.. 20.25 ..
1.4.d:
तयैव गरुडं मूर्ध्नि जघ्ने स प्रहसन्बली..
ततो भूयो रथं प्राप्य घनुर्गृह्यभ्ययोजयत्.. 20.25 ..
1.4.m: and laughing, the mighty one struck Garuḍa on the head with that very [spear]. / Then, having mounted his chariot again, he seized his bow and strung it.

1.4.s:
vicetāścābhavadyuddhe garuḍaḥ śaktipīḍitaḥ..
tataḥ prahasya taṃ viṣṇuḥ sādhusādhviti bhārata.. 20.26 ..
1.4.d:
विचेताश्चाभवद्युद्धे गरुडः शक्तिपीडितः..
ततः प्रहस्य तं विष्णुः साधुसाध्विति भारत.. 20.26 ..
1.4.m: Garuḍa became unconscious in battle, afflicted by the spear. / Then Viṣṇu, smiling, said to him: "Well done! Well done!", O Bhārata,

1.4.s:
karasparśena kṛtavānvimohaṃ vinatātmajam..
samāśvāsya ca taṃ vāgbhiḥ śaktiṃ dṛṣṭvā ca niṣphalām.. 20.27 ..
1.4.d:
करस्पर्शेन कृतवान्विमोहं विनतात्मजम्..
समाश्वास्य च तं वाग्भिः शक्तिं दृष्ट्वा च निष्फलाम्.. 20.27 ..
1.4.m: and dispelled the delusion of Vinatā's son with the touch of his hand. / Comforting him with words and seeing that the spear had proved futile,

1.4.s:
kubhāryasya yathā puṃsaḥ sarvaṃsyācciṃtitaṃ vṛthā..
dṛṭhasāramahāmaurvīmanyāṃ saṃyojayattataḥ.. 20.28 ..
1.4.d:
कुभार्यस्य यथा पुंसः सर्वंस्याच्चिंतितं वृथा..
दृठसारमहामौर्वीमन्यां संयोजयत्ततः.. 20.28 ..
1.4.m: just as all the designs of a man with a bad wife come to nothing, / he then fixed another bowstring of firm and mighty strength.

1.4.s:
kṛtvā ca talanirghoṣaṃ raudramastraṃ mumoca saḥ..
tato'stratejasā sarvamākāśaṃ naiva dṛśyate.. 20.29 ..
1.4.d:
कृत्वा च तलनिर्घोषं रौद्रमस्त्रं मुमोच सः..
ततोऽस्त्रतेजसा सर्वमाकाशं नैव दृश्यते.. 20.29 ..
1.4.m: Having produced a clapping sound with his palm, he discharged the Raudra weapon. / Then, by the radiance of the weapon, the whole sky could not be seen at all;

1.4.s:
bhūmirdiśaśca vidiśo bāmajālamayā bubhuḥ..
dṛṣṭvā tadastramāhātmyaṃ senānīrgrasano'suraḥ.. 20.30 ..
1.4.d:
भूमिर्दिशश्च विदिशो बामजालमया बुभुः..
दृष्ट्वा तदस्त्रमाहात्म्यं सेनानीर्ग्रसनोऽसुरः.. 20.30 ..
1.4.m: the earth, the cardinal points, and the intermediate points became filled with a net of arrows. / Seeing the greatness of that weapon, the Asura commander Grasana

1.4.s:
brāhmamastraṃ cakārāśu sarvāstravinivāraṇam..
tena tatpraśamaṃ yātaṃ raudrāstraṃ lokabhīṣaṇam.. 20.31 ..
1.4.d:
ब्राह्ममस्त्रं चकाराशु सर्वास्त्रविनिवारणम्..
तेन तत्प्रशमं यातं रौद्रास्त्रं लोकभीषणम्.. 20.31 ..
1.4.m: swiftly discharged the Brāhma weapon, which repels all weapons. / By that, the Raudra weapon, terrifying to the world, was brought to rest.

1.4.s:
astre pratihate tasminviṣṇurdānavasūdanaḥ..
kāladaṃḍāstramakarotsarvalokabhayaṃkaram.. 20.32 ..
1.4.d:
अस्त्रे प्रतिहते तस्मिन्विष्णुर्दानवसूदनः..
कालदंडास्त्रमकरोत्सर्वलोकभयंकरम्.. 20.32 ..
1.4.m: When that weapon was neutralized, Viṣṇu, the slayer of Dānavas, / invoked the Kāladaṇḍa weapon, terrifying to all the worlds.

1.4.s:
saṃdhīyamānestre tasminmārutaḥ paruṣo vavau..
cakaṃpe ca mahī devī bhinnāścāṃbudhayo'bhavan.. 20.33 ..
1.4.d:
संधीयमानेस्त्रे तस्मिन्मारुतः परुषो ववौ..
चकंपे च मही देवी भिन्नाश्चांबुधयोऽभवन्.. 20.33 ..
1.4.m: While that weapon was being aimed, a harsh wind blew, / the earth goddess trembled, and the oceans split apart.

1.4.s:
tadastramugraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ..
cakrurastrāṇi divyāni nānārūpāṇi saṃyuge.. 20.34 ..
1.4.d:
तदस्त्रमुग्रं दृष्ट्वा तु दानवा युद्धदुर्मदाः..
चक्रुरस्त्राणि दिव्यानि नानारूपाणि संयुगे.. 20.34 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that fierce weapon, the Dānavas, arrogant in battle, / invoked divine weapons of various forms in the combat.

1.4.s:
nārāyaṇāṃstraṃ grasanastu cakre tvāṣṭraṃ nimiścāstravaraṃ mumoca..
aiṣīkamastraṃ ca cakāra jaṃbho yuddhasya daṇḍāstra nivāraṇāya.. 20.35 ..
1.4.d:
नारायणांस्त्रं ग्रसनस्तु चक्रे त्वाष्ट्रं निमिश्चास्त्रवरं मुमोच..
ऐषीकमस्त्रं च चकार जंभो युद्धस्य दण्डास्त्र निवारणाय.. 20.35 ..
1.4.m: Grasana invoked the Nārāyaṇa weapon, Nimi discharged the excellent Tvāṣṭra weapon, / and Jambha discharged the Aiṣīka weapon to ward off the Daṇḍa weapon of the battle.

1.4.s:
yāvacca saṃdhānavaśaṃ prayāṃti nārāyaṇādīni nivāraṇāya..
tāvatkṣaṇenaiva jaghāna koṭīṃdaityeśvarāṇāṃ kila kāladaṃḍaḥ.. 20.36 ..
1.4.d:
यावच्च संधानवशं प्रयांति नारायणादीनि निवारणाय..
तावत्क्षणेनैव जघान कोटींदैत्येश्वराणां किल कालदंडः.. 20.36 ..
1.4.m: Even as the Nārāyaṇa and other weapons were being aimed for its neutralization, / the Kāladaṇḍa slew a crore of Daitya lords in a mere instant.

1.4.s:
anaṃtaraṃ śāṃtabhayaṃ tadastraṃ daityāstrayogena ca kāladaṇḍam..
śāṃtaṃ tadālokya hariḥ svamastraṃ kopena kālānalatulyamūrtiḥ.. 20.37 ..
1.4.d:
अनंतरं शांतभयं तदस्त्रं दैत्यास्त्रयोगेन च कालदण्डम्..
शांतं तदालोक्य हरिः स्वमस्त्रं कोपेन कालानलतुल्यमूर्तिः.. 20.37 ..
1.4.m: Thereafter, seeing that weapon, the Kāladaṇḍa, calmed and its terror ceased by the counteraction of the Daityas' weapons, / Hari, whose form became like the fire of dissolution in anger,

1.4.s:
jagrāha cakraṃ tapanā yutaprabhamugrāramātmānamiva dvitīyam..
cikṣepa senāpataye jvalaṃtaṃ caturbhūjaḥ saṃyati saṃpragṛhya.. 20.38 ..
1.4.d:
जग्राह चक्रं तपना युतप्रभमुग्रारमात्मानमिव द्वितीयम्..
चिक्षेप सेनापतये ज्वलंतं चतुर्भूजः संयति संप्रगृह्य.. 20.38 ..
1.4.m: seized the discus, brilliant as ten thousand suns, with fierce spokes, like a second self. / Grasping it firmly in combat, the four-armed one hurled it blazing at the general.

1.4.s:
tadāvrajaccakramatho vilokya sarvātmanā daityavarāḥ svavīryāt..
nāśaknunvārayituṃ pracaṃḍaṃ daivaṃ yathā pūrvamivopapannam.. 20.39 ..
1.4.d:
तदाव्रजच्चक्रमथो विलोक्य सर्वात्मना दैत्यवराः स्ववीर्यात्..
नाशक्नुन्वारयितुं प्रचंडं दैवं यथा पूर्वमिवोपपन्नम्.. 20.39 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing that furious discus advancing, the foremost Daityas, with all their soul and their own valor, / were unable to ward it off, just like fate arrived from [deeds] done before.

1.4.s:
tadapratarkyaṃ navahetitulyaṃ cakraṃ papāta grasanasya kaṇṭhe..
tadraktadhārā ruṇaghoranābhi jagāma bhūyopi karaṃ murāreḥ.. 20.40 ..
1.4.d:
तदप्रतर्क्यं नवहेतितुल्यं चक्रं पपात ग्रसनस्य कण्ठे..
तद्रक्तधारा रुणघोरनाभि जगाम भूयोपि करं मुरारेः.. 20.40 ..
1.4.m: That unfathomable discus, like a newly forged weapon, fell upon Grasana's neck. / Its dreadful nave turned crimson with the stream of his blood, it returned once more to the hand of Murāri.

1.4.s:
cakrāhataḥ saṃyati dānavaśca papāta bhūmau pramamāra cāpi..
daityāśca śeṣā bhṛśaśaukamāpuḥ krodhaṃ ca kecitpipiṣurbhujāṃśca.. 20.41 ..
1.4.d:
चक्राहतः संयति दानवश्च पपात भूमौ प्रममार चापि..
दैत्याश्च शेषा भृशशौकमापुः क्रोधं च केचित्पिपिषुर्भुजांश्च.. 20.41 ..
1.4.m: Struck by the discus in the battle, the Dānava fell to the ground and died; / and the remaining Daityas experienced immense sorrow, while some ground their arms in rage.

1.4.s:
tato vinihate daitye grasane balanāyake..
nirmaryādamayudhyaṃta hariṇā saha dānavāḥ.. 20.42 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विनिहते दैत्ये ग्रसने बलनायके..
निर्मर्यादमयुध्यंत हरिणा सह दानवाः.. 20.42 ..
1.4.m: Then, after the Daitya Grasana, the commander of the army, was slain, / the Dānavas fought unrestrainedly with Hari,

1.4.s:
paṭṭiśairmuśalaiḥ prāsaigni dābhiḥ kaṇapairapi..
tīkṣṇānanaiśca nārācaiścakraiḥ śaktibhireva ca.. 20.43 ..
1.4.d:
पट्टिशैर्मुशलैः प्रासैग्नि दाभिः कणपैरपि..
तीक्ष्णाननैश्च नाराचैश्चक्रैः शक्तिभिरेव च.. 20.43 ..
1.4.m: with flat-faced iron spears, maces, lances, knifes, and iron bludgeons, / and with sharp-faced iron arrows, discuses, and spears.

1.4.s:
tadastrajālaṃ tairmuktaṃ labdhalakṣo janārdanaḥ..
ekaikaṃ śatadhā cakre bāṇairagni śikhopamaiḥ.. 20.44 ..
1.4.d:
तदस्त्रजालं तैर्मुक्तं लब्धलक्षो जनार्दनः..
एकैकं शतधा चक्रे बाणैरग्नि शिखोपमैः.. 20.44 ..
1.4.m: Having found his mark, Janārdana split into a hundred pieces each one / of that mass of missiles loosed by them, using arrows resembling tongues of fire.

1.4.s:
jaghāna teṣāṃ saṃkruddhaḥ koṭikoṭiṃ janārdanaḥ..
tataste sahasā bhūtvā nyapatankeśavopari.. 20.45 ..
1.4.d:
जघान तेषां संक्रुद्धः कोटिकोटिं जनार्दनः..
ततस्ते सहसा भूत्वा न्यपतन्केशवोपरि.. 20.45 ..
1.4.m: Enraged, Janārdana struck down tens of millions of them; / then, coming together all at once, they fell upon Keśava.

1.4.s:
garuḍaṃ jagṛhuḥ kecitpādayoḥ śataśo'surāḥ..
lalaṃbire ca pakṣābhyāṃ mukhe cānye lalaṃbire.. 20.46 ..
1.4.d:
गरुडं जगृहुः केचित्पादयोः शतशोऽसुराः..
ललंबिरे च पक्षाभ्यां मुखे चान्ये ललंबिरे.. 20.46 ..
1.4.m: Some Asuras seized Garuḍa by the feet in their hundreds; / they clung to his two wings, and others clung to his face.

1.4.s:
keśavasyāpi dhanuṣi bhujayoḥ śīrṣa eva ca..
lalaṃbire mahādaityā ninadaṃto muhurmuhuḥ.. 20.47 ..
1.4.d:
केशवस्यापि धनुषि भुजयोः शीर्ष एव च..
ललंबिरे महादैत्या निनदंतो मुहुर्मुहुः.. 20.47 ..
1.4.m: Unto Keśava's bow as well, and upon his two arms and head, / the great Daityas clung, roaring again and again.

1.4.s:
tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā siddhacāraṇavārtikāḥ..
hāheti mumucurnādasaṃbare cāstuvanharim.. 20.48 ..
1.4.d:
तदद्भुतं महद्दृष्ट्वा सिद्धचारणवार्तिकाः..
हाहेति मुमुचुर्नादसंबरे चास्तुवन्हरिम्.. 20.48 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that great marvel, the Siddhas, Cāraṇas, and travelers / let out cries of "Alas, alas!" and praised Hari in the sky.

1.4.s:
tato harirvinirdhūya pātayāmāsa tānbhuvi..
yathā prabuddhaḥ puruṣo doṣānsaṃsārasaṃbhavān.. 20.49 ..
1.4.d:
ततो हरिर्विनिर्धूय पातयामास तान्भुवि..
यथा प्रबुद्धः पुरुषो दोषान्संसारसंभवान्.. 20.49 ..
1.4.m: Then Hari, shaking them off violently, cast them down upon the earth, / just as an enlightened person casts off the faults born of worldly existence.

1.4.s:
vikośaṃ ca tataḥ naṃdakaṃ khaḍgamuttamam..
carma cāpyamalaṃ viṣṇuḥ padātistānadhāvata.. 20.50 ..
1.4.d:
विकोशं च ततः नंदकं खड्गमुत्तमम्..
चर्म चाप्यमलं विष्णुः पदातिस्तानधावत.. 20.50 ..
1.4.m: Then, unsheathing his excellent sword Nandaka / and taking up his spotless shield, Viṣṇu ran at them on foot.

1.4.s:
tato muhūrtamātreṇa padmāni daśa keśavaḥ..
cakartta mārge bahubhirvicarandaityasattamān.. 20.51 ..
1.4.d:
ततो मुहूर्तमात्रेण पद्मानि दश केशवः..
चकर्त्त मार्गे बहुभिर्विचरन्दैत्यसत्तमान्.. 20.51 ..
1.4.m: Then, in merely a moment, wandering along the way, / Keśava with his many [blows] cut down ten lotus-units of the foremost Daityas.

1.4.s:
tato nimiprabhṛtayo vinadyāsurasattamāḥ..
adhāvaṃta maheṣvāsāḥ keśavaṃ pādacāriṇam.. 20.52 ..
1.4.d:
ततो निमिप्रभृतयो विनद्यासुरसत्तमाः..
अधावंत महेष्वासाः केशवं पादचारिणम्.. 20.52 ..
1.4.m: Then the foremost Asuras headed by Nimi, mighty archers, / roaring loudly, ran toward Keśava as he traversed on foot.

1.4.s:
garutmāṃścābhyayāttūrṇamāruroha ca taṃ hariḥ..
uvāca ca garutmaṃtaṃ tasmiṃśca tumule raṇe.. 20.53 ..
1.4.d:
गरुत्मांश्चाभ्ययात्तूर्णमारुरोह च तं हरिः..
उवाच च गरुत्मंतं तस्मिंश्च तुमुले रणे.. 20.53 ..
1.4.m: And Garuḍa swiftly approached, and Hari mounted him, / and he spoke to Garuḍa in that tumultuous battle:

1.4.s:
aśrāṃto yadi tārkṣyāsi mathanaṃ prati tadvraja..
śrāṃtaścecca muhūrtaṃ tvaṃ raṇādapasṛto bhava.. 20.54 ..
1.4.d:
अश्रांतो यदि तार्क्ष्यासि मथनं प्रति तद्व्रज..
श्रांतश्चेच्च मुहूर्तं त्वं रणादपसृतो भव.. 20.54 ..
1.4.m: "If you are not weary, O Tārkṣya, then advance toward Mathana; / but if you are weary, withdraw for a moment from the battle."

1.4.s:
..tārkṣya uvāca..
na me śramo'sti lokeśa kiṃcitsaṃsmarataśca me..
yanme sutānvāhanatve kalpayāmāsa tārakaḥ.. 20.55 ..
1.4.d:
..तार्क्ष्य उवाच..
न मे श्रमोऽस्ति लोकेश किंचित्संस्मरतश्च मे..
यन्मे सुतान्वाहनत्वे कल्पयामास तारकः.. 20.55 ..
1.4.m: Tārkṣya said: / "I have no weariness, O Lord of the World, even a bit, when I remember / that Tāraka appointed my sons to serve as mounts."

1.4.s:
iti bravanraṇe daityaṃ mathanaṃ prati so'gamat..
daityastavabhimukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhacakragadādharam.. 20.56 ..
1.4.d:
इति ब्रवन्रणे दैत्यं मथनं प्रति सोऽगमत्..
दैत्यस्तवभिमुखं दृष्ट्वा शंखचक्रगदाधरम्.. 20.56 ..
1.4.m: Speaking thus, he went toward the Daitya Mathana in battle. / The Daitya, seeing him approaching, bearing the conch, discus, and mace,

1.4.s:
jaghāna bhiṃḍipālena śitadhāreṇa vakṣasi..
taṃ prahāramaciṃtyaiva viṣṇustasminmahāhave.. 20.57 ..
1.4.d:
जघान भिंडिपालेन शितधारेण वक्षसि..
तं प्रहारमचिंत्यैव विष्णुस्तस्मिन्महाहवे.. 20.57 ..
1.4.m: struck him on the chest with a sharp-edged javelin. / Without giving any thought to that blow in that great fight, Viṣṇu

1.4.s:
jaghāna paṃcabhirbāṇairgirīṃdrasyāpi bhedakaiḥ..
ākarṇakṛṣṭairdaśabhiḥ punarviddhaḥ stanāṃtare.. 20.58 ..
1.4.d:
जघान पंचभिर्बाणैर्गिरींद्रस्यापि भेदकैः..
आकर्णकृष्टैर्दशभिः पुनर्विद्धः स्तनांतरे.. 20.58 ..
1.4.m: struck him with five arrows capable of cleaving even a sovereign mountain; / and again, pierced between his breasts by ten [shafts] drawn to the ear,

1.4.s:
vicetano muhūrtātsa saṃstabhya mathanaḥ punaḥ..
gṛhītvā parighaṃ mūrdhni janārdanamatāḍayat.. 20.59 ..
1.4.d:
विचेतनो मुहूर्तात्स संस्तभ्य मथनः पुनः..
गृहीत्वा परिघं मूर्ध्नि जनार्दनमताडयत्.. 20.59 ..
1.4.m: senseless for a moment, Mathana composed himself once more, / and taking an iron club, struck Janārdana on the head.

1.4.s:
viṣṇustena prahāreṇa kiṃcidāghūrṇito'bhavat..
tataḥ kopavivṛttākṣo gadāṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ.. 20.60 ..
1.4.d:
विष्णुस्तेन प्रहारेण किंचिदाघूर्णितोऽभवत्..
ततः कोपविवृत्ताक्षो गदां जग्राह माधवः.. 20.60 ..
1.4.m: Viṣṇu was slightly staggered by that blow; / then, his eyes rolling in rage, Mādhava seized his mace.

1.4.s:
tayā saṃtāḍayāmāsa mathanaṃ hṛdaye dṛḍham..
sa papāta tathā bhūmau cūrṇitāṃgo mamāra ca.. 20.61 ..
1.4.d:
तया संताडयामास मथनं हृदये दृढम्..
स पपात तथा भूमौ चूर्णितांगो ममार च.. 20.61 ..
1.4.m: With it he struck Mathana forcefully on the heart; / he fell thus upon the ground with shattered limbs and died.

1.4.s:
tasminnipatite bhūmau mathane mathite bhṛśam..
avasādaṃ yuyurdaityāḥ sarve te yuddhamaṇḍale.. 20.62 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ मथने मथिते भृशम्..
अवसादं युयुर्दैत्याः सर्वे ते युद्धमण्डले.. 20.62 ..
1.4.m: When that Mathana was crushed and had fallen to the ground, / all those Daityas were seized with despair on the battlefield.

1.4.s:
tatasteṣu viṣaṇṇeṣu dānaveṣvatimāniṣu..
cukopa raktanayano mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ.. 20.63 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तेषु विषण्णेषु दानवेष्वतिमानिषु..
चुकोप रक्तनयनो महिषो दानवेश्वरः.. 20.63 ..
1.4.m: Then, as those excessively proud Dānavas grew despondent, / Mahiṣa, the lord of the Dānavas, flew into a rage, his eyes red.

1.4.s:
pratyudyayau hariṃ raudraḥ svabāhubalamāśritaḥ..
rīkṣṇadhāreṇa śūlena mahiṣo harimardayan.. 20.64 ..
1.4.d:
प्रत्युद्ययौ हरिं रौद्रः स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः..
रीक्ष्णधारेण शूलेन महिषो हरिमर्दयन्.. 20.64 ..
1.4.m: Relying on the strength of his own arms, the terrible Mahiṣa marched out against Hari, / tormenting Hari with a sharp-edged trident;

1.4.s:
śaktyā ca garuḍaṃ vīro hṛdaye'bhyahanaddṛḍham..
tato vivṛtya vadanaṃ mahāmalaguhānibham.. 20.65 ..
1.4.d:
शक्त्या च गरुडं वीरो हृदयेऽभ्यहनद्दृढम्..
ततो विवृत्य वदनं महामलगुहानिभम्.. 20.65 ..
1.4.m: and the heroic [demon] struck Garuḍa firmly in the chest with a spear. / Then, opening his mouth, which resembled a huge dark cavern,

1.4.s:
grastumaicchadraṇe daityaḥ sagarutmaṃtamacyutam..
athāc‌yuto'pi vijñāya dānavasya cikīrṣitam.. 20.66 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रस्तुमैच्छद्रणे दैत्यः सगरुत्मंतमच्युतम्..
अथाच्‌युतोऽपि विज्ञाय दानवस्य चिकीर्षितम्.. 20.66 ..
1.4.m: the Daitya wished to swallow Acyuta along with Garuḍa in the battle. / Then Acyuta of great might, knowing what the Dānava intended to do,

1.4.s:
vadanaṃ pūrayāmāsa divyaistrairmahābalaḥ..
sa tairbāṇairabhihato mahiṣo'calasaṃnibhaḥ.. 20.67 ..
1.4.d:
वदनं पूरयामास दिव्यैस्त्रैर्महाबलः..
स तैर्बाणैरभिहतो महिषोऽचलसंनिभः.. 20.67 ..
1.4.m: filled his mouth with divine missiles. / Struck by those arrows, Mahiṣa, who resembled a mountain,

1.4.s:
parivartitakāyārdhaḥ papātātha mamāra ca..
mahiṣaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvayitvā punarhariḥ.. 20.68 ..
1.4.d:
परिवर्तितकायार्धः पपाताथ ममार च..
महिषं पतितं दृष्ट्वा जीवयित्वा पुनर्हरिः.. 20.68 ..
1.4.m: with half his body overturned, fell down and died. / Seeing Mahiṣa fallen, Hari brought him back to life and then

1.4.s:
mahiṣaṃ prāha mattastvaṃ vadhaṃ nārhasi dānava..
yoṣidvadhyaḥ puroktastvaṃ sākṣātkamalayoninā.. 20.69 ..
1.4.d:
महिषं प्राह मत्तस्त्वं वधं नार्हसि दानव..
योषिद्वध्यः पुरोक्तस्त्वं साक्षात्कमलयोनिना.. 20.69 ..
1.4.m: said to Mahiṣa: "O Dānava, you do not deserve death at my hands; / formerly it was declared by the Lotus-born [Brahmā] himself that you are to be killed by a woman.

1.4.s:
uttiṣṭha gaccha manmukto drutamasmānmahāraṇāt..
ityukto hariṇā tasmāddeśādapagato'suraḥ.. 20.70 ..
1.4.d:
उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ मन्मुक्तो द्रुतमस्मान्महारणात्..
इत्युक्तो हरिणा तस्माद्देशादपगतोऽसुरः.. 20.70 ..
1.4.m: Arise, go, released by me, swiftly away from this great battle." / Addressed thus by Hari, the Asura departed from that place.

1.4.s:
tasminparāṅmukhe daitye mahiṣe śuṃbhadānavaḥ..
saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāṭopo bhṛkuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ.. 20.71 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिन्पराङ्मुखे दैत्ये महिषे शुंभदानवः..
संदष्टौष्ठपुटाटोपो भृकुटीकुटिलाननः.. 20.71 ..
1.4.m: When that Daitya Mahiṣa had turned away, the Dānava Śumbha, / with the swell of his lips bitten and his face furrowed with frowns,

1.4.s:
nirmadhya pāṇinā pāṇiṃ dhanurādāya bhairavam..
sajjīkṛtya mahāghorānmumoca śataśaḥ śarān.. 20.72 ..
1.4.d:
निर्मध्य पाणिना पाणिं धनुरादाय भैरवम्..
सज्जीकृत्य महाघोरान्मुमोच शतशः शरान्.. 20.72 ..
1.4.m: rubbing hand against hand and taking up a terrible bow, / strung it and loosed hundreds of exceedingly dreadful arrows.

1.4.s:
sa citrayodhī dṛḍhamuṣṭipātastataśva viṣṇuṃ ca daityaḥ..
bāṇairjvaladvahniśikhānikāśaiḥ kṣiptairasaṃkhyaiḥ pratighāhīnaiḥ.. 20.73 ..
1.4.d:
स चित्रयोधी दृढमुष्टिपातस्ततश्व विष्णुं च दैत्यः..
बाणैर्ज्वलद्वह्निशिखानिकाशैः क्षिप्तैरसंख्यैः प्रतिघाहीनैः.. 20.73 ..
1.4.m: That Daitya, who fought with wondrous skill and struck with a firm grip, then [attacked] Viṣṇu / with innumerable, unhindered arrows discharged, resembling blazing tongues of fire.

1.4.s:
viṣṇuśca daityeṃdraśarārdito bhṛśaṃ bhuśuṃḍimādāya kṛtāṃtatulyām..
tayā mukhaṃ cāsya pipeṣa saṃkhye śuṃbhasya jatruṃ ca dharādharābham.. 20.74 ..
1.4.d:
विष्णुश्च दैत्येंद्रशरार्दितो भृशं भुशुंडिमादाय कृतांततुल्याम्..
तया मुखं चास्य पिपेष संख्ये शुंभस्य जत्रुं च धराधराभम्.. 20.74 ..
1.4.m: And Viṣṇu, deeply tormented by the arrows of the lord of the Daityas, seized an iron club like Death; / with it in the fight he crushed his face and Śumbha's collarbone, which was like a mountain.

1.4.s:
tatastribhiḥ śaṃbhubhujaṃ dviṣaṣṭyā sūtasya śīrṣaṃ daśakṣiśca ketum..
viṣṇurvikṛṣṭaiḥ śravaṇāvasānaṃ daityasya bāṇairjvalanārkavarṇaiḥ.. 20.75 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्त्रिभिः शंभुभुजं द्विषष्ट्या सूतस्य शीर्षं दशक्षिश्च केतुम्..
विष्णुर्विकृष्टैः श्रवणावसानं दैत्यस्य बाणैर्ज्वलनार्कवर्णैः.. 20.75 ..
1.4.m: Then, with three arrows drawn up to the ear, having the color of fire and sun, Viṣṇu [pierced] Śumbha's arm, / with sixty-two his charioteer's head, and with ten the Daitya's banner.

1.4.s:
sa taiśca viddho vyathito babhūva daityeśvaro visrutaśoṇitāktaḥ..
tato'sya kiṃciccalitasya dhairyāduvāca śaṃkhāṃbujasārṅgapāṇiḥ.. 20.76 ..
1.4.d:
स तैश्च विद्धो व्यथितो बभूव दैत्येश्वरो विस्रुतशोणिताक्तः..
ततोऽस्य किंचिच्चलितस्य धैर्यादुवाच शंखांबुजसार्ङ्गपाणिः.. 20.76 ..
1.4.m: Pierced by them and afflicted, the lord of the Daityas became smeared with flowing blood. / Then, as he wavered slightly in his steadfastness, he whose hand holds the conch, lotus, and bow of horn said:

1.4.s:
yoṣitsuvadhyo'si raṇaṃ vibhuṃca śuṃbhā'śubha svalpatarairahobhiḥ..
mattorhasi tvaṃ na vṛthaiva mūḍha tato'payātaḥ sa ca śaṃbhadānavaḥ.. 20.77 ..
1.4.d:
योषित्सुवध्योऽसि रणं विभुंच शुंभाऽशुभ स्वल्पतरैरहोभिः..
मत्तोर्हसि त्वं न वृथैव मूढ ततोऽपयातः स च शंभदानवः.. 20.77 ..
1.4.m: "You are easily slain by a woman; leave the battle, O inauspicious Śumbha, in a very few days! / You do not deserve [death] at my hands in vain, O fool." Thereupon that Dānava Śumbha retreated.

1.4.s:
jambho'tha tadviṣṇumukhānniśamya jagarja coccaiḥ kṛtasiṃhanādaḥ..
provāca vākyaṃ ca salīlamājau mahāṭṭahāsena jagadvikaṃpya.. 20.78 ..
1.4.d:
जम्भोऽथ तद्विष्णुमुखान्निशम्य जगर्ज चोच्चैः कृतसिंहनादः..
प्रोवाच वाक्यं च सलीलमाजौ महाट्टहासेन जगद्विकंप्य.. 20.78 ..
1.4.m: Then Jambha, hearing that from Viṣṇu's mouth, roared loudly, uttering a lion's roar, / and playfully spoke these words in the battle, making the world tremble with his loud burst of laughter:

1.4.s:
kimebhiste jalāvāsa daityairhīnaparākramaiḥ..
māmāsādaya yuddhe'sminyadi te pauruṣaṃ kvacit.. 20.79 ..
1.4.d:
किमेभिस्ते जलावास दैत्यैर्हीनपराक्रमैः..
मामासादय युद्धेऽस्मिन्यदि ते पौरुषं क्वचित्.. 20.79 ..
1.4.m: "O you whose dwelling is in the waters, what use have you for these Daityas who lack prowess? / Face me in this battle if you have any manly vigor anywhere!

1.4.s:
yatte pūrvaṃ hatā daityā hiraṇyākṣamukhāḥ kila..
jaṃbhastadābhavannaiva paśya māmadya saṃsthitam.. 20.80 ..
1.4.d:
यत्ते पूर्वं हता दैत्या हिरण्याक्षमुखाः किल..
जंभस्तदाभवन्नैव पश्य मामद्य संस्थितम्.. 20.80 ..
1.4.m: When formerly those Daityas led by Hiraṇyākṣa were slain by you, / Jambha was truly not there; behold me standing here today!"

1.4.s:
paśya tālapratī kāśau bhujāvetau hare mama..
vakṣo vā vajrakaṭhinaṃ mayi prahara tatsukham.. 20.81 ..
1.4.d:
पश्य तालप्रती काशौ भुजावेतौ हरे मम..
वक्षो वा वज्रकठिनं मयि प्रहर तत्सुखम्.. 20.81 ..
1.4.m: "Look at these two arms of mine, Hari, like palm trees! / Or [look at my] chest, hard as a thunderbolt! Strike me, and take your pleasure!"

1.4.s:
ityuktaḥ keśavastena sṛkkiṇī saṃlihanruṣā..
mumoca parighaṃghoraṃ virīṇāmapi dāraṇam.. 20.82 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्तः केशवस्तेन सृक्किणी संलिहन्रुषा..
मुमोच परिघंघोरं विरीणामपि दारणम्.. 20.82 ..
1.4.m: Addressed thus by him, Keśava, licking the corners of his mouth in fury, / hurled a terrible iron mace, one that could split even rocks.

1.4.s:
tatastasyāpyanupadaṃ kālāyasamayaṃ dṛḍham..
mumoca mudgaraṃ viṣṇurdvitīyaṃ parvataṃ yathā.. 20.83 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तस्याप्यनुपदं कालायसमयं दृढम्..
मुमोच मुद्गरं विष्णुर्द्वितीयं पर्वतं यथा.. 20.83 ..
1.4.m: Then, close behind it, Viṣṇu hurled a solid club / made of dark iron, like a second mountain.

1.4.s:
tadāyudhadvayaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho nyasya rathe dhanuḥ..
āplutya parighaṃ gṛhya garuḍaṃ tena jaghnivān.. 20.84 ..
1.4.d:
तदायुधद्वयं दृष्ट्वा जंभो न्यस्य रथे धनुः..
आप्लुत्य परिघं गृह्य गरुडं तेन जघ्निवान्.. 20.84 ..
1.4.m: Seeing those two weapons, Jambha set down his bow upon his chariot, / leaped forward, seized the iron mace, and struck Garuḍa with it.

1.4.s:
dvitīyaṃ mudgaraṃ cānu gṛhītvā vinadanraṇe..
sarvaprāṇena goviṃdaṃ tena mūrdhni jaghāna saḥ.. 20.85 ..
1.4.d:
द्वितीयं मुद्गरं चानु गृहीत्वा विनदन्रणे..
सर्वप्राणेन गोविंदं तेन मूर्ध्नि जघान सः.. 20.85 ..
1.4.m: Then seizing the second weapon, the club, roaring in battle, / he struck Govinda on the head with all his might.

1.4.s:
tābhyāṃ cātiprahārābhyāmubhau garuḍakeśavau..
mohāviṣṭau vicetaskau mṛtakalpāvivāsatām.. 20.86 ..
1.4.d:
ताभ्यां चातिप्रहाराभ्यामुभौ गरुडकेशवौ..
मोहाविष्टौ विचेतस्कौ मृतकल्पाविवासताम्.. 20.86 ..
1.4.m: From those exceedingly powerful blows, both Garuḍa and Keśava, / enveloped in stupor and senseless, lay as though dead.

1.4.s:
tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā jagarjurdaityasattamāḥ..
naitānharṣamadoddhūtānidaṃ sehe jagattadā.. 20.87 ..
1.4.d:
तदद्भुतं महद्दृष्ट्वा जगर्जुर्दैत्यसत्तमाः..
नैतान्हर्षमदोद्धूतानिदं सेहे जगत्तदा.. 20.87 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that great wonder, the foremost Daityas roared; / the universe could not endure them, shaken by the arrogance of their joy.

1.4.s:
siṃhanādaistalonnāhairdhanurnādaiśca bāṇajaiḥ..
jaṃbhaṃ te harṣayāmāsurvāsāṃsyādudhuvuśca te.. 20.88 ..
1.4.d:
सिंहनादैस्तलोन्नाहैर्धनुर्नादैश्च बाणजैः..
जंभं ते हर्षयामासुर्वासांस्यादुधुवुश्च ते.. 20.88 ..
1.4.m: With lion-roars, clappings of palms, and the twangs of bowstrings born of arrows, / they cheered Jambha and waved their garments.

1.4.s: śaṃkhāṃśca pūrayāmāsuścikṣipurdevatā bhṛśam.. 20.89 ..
1.4.d: शंखांश्च पूरयामासुश्चिक्षिपुर्देवता भृशम्.. 20.89 ..
1.4.m: They blew their conches and fiercely harassed the deities.

1.4.s:
saṃjñāmavāpyātha mahāraṇe hariḥ savainateyaḥ parirabhya jaṃbham..
parāṅmukhaḥ saṃyugādapradhṛṣyātpalāyanaṃ vegaparaścakāra.. 20.90 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe daityaiḥ saha viṣṇoryuddhavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 20 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
संज्ञामवाप्याथ महारणे हरिः सवैनतेयः परिरभ्य जंभम्..
पराङ्मुखः संयुगादप्रधृष्यात्पलायनं वेगपरश्चकार.. 20.90 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखंडे दैत्यैः सह विष्णोर्युद्धवर्णनंनाम विंशोऽध्यायः.. 20 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Then Hari, regaining consciousness in the great battle, along with the son of Vinatā, grappling with Jambha, / turned his back upon the invincible combat and fled swiftly.
Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "Description of the Battle of Viṣṇu with the Daityas," in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tamālokya palāyaṃtaṃ vidhvastadhvajakārmukam..
daityāṃśca muditāniṃdraḥ kartavyaṃ nādhyagacchata.. 21.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
तमालोक्य पलायंतं विध्वस्तध्वजकार्मुकम्..
दैत्यांश्च मुदितानिंद्रः कर्तव्यं नाध्यगच्छत.. 21.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Seeing him fleeing, with his banner and bow broken, / and the Daityas rejoicing, Indra did not know what to do.

1.4.s:
athāyānnikaṭaṃ viṣṇoḥ sureśastvarayānvitaḥ..
uvāca cainaṃ madhuramutsāhaparibṛṃhitam.. 21.2 ..
1.4.d:
अथायान्निकटं विष्णोः सुरेशस्त्वरयान्वितः..
उवाच चैनं मधुरमुत्साहपरिबृंहितम्.. 21.2 ..
1.4.m: Then the lord of the gods quickly approached Viṣṇu / and spoke sweet words to him, filled with encouragement:

1.4.s:
kimebhiḥ krīḍase deva dānavairduṣṭamānasaiḥ..
durjanairlabdharaṃdhrasya puruṣasya kutaḥ kriyāḥ.. 21.3 ..
1.4.d:
किमेभिः क्रीडसे देव दानवैर्दुष्टमानसैः..
दुर्जनैर्लब्धरंध्रस्य पुरुषस्य कुतः क्रियाः.. 21.3 ..
1.4.m: "Why do you sport, O Lord, with these wicked-minded Dānavas? / How can an individual whose vulnerable spot is seized by vile men perform his duties?

1.4.s:
śaktenopekṣito nīco manyate balamātmanaḥ..
tasmānna nīcaṃ matimānuṣekṣeta kathaṃcana.. 21.4 ..
1.4.d:
शक्तेनोपेक्षितो नीचो मन्यते बलमात्मनः..
तस्मान्न नीचं मतिमानुषेक्षेत कथंचन.. 21.4 ..
1.4.m: When disregarded by the capable, a base man believes in his own strength; / therefore, a wise man should never disregard a base man.

1.4.s:
athāgresarasaṃpattyā rathino jayamāyayuḥ..
kaste sakhābhavatpūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣavadhe vibho.. 21.5 ..
1.4.d:
अथाग्रेसरसंपत्त्या रथिनो जयमाययुः..
कस्ते सखाभवत्पूर्वं हिरण्याक्षवधे विभो.. 21.5 ..
1.4.m: Moreover, charioteers attained victory through the excellence of their vanguards. / Who was your companion previously, O Lord, in slaying Hiraṇyākṣa?

1.4.s:
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo vīryaśālī madoddhataḥ..
prāpya tvāṃ tṛmavannaṣṭastatra ko'gresarastava.. 21.6 ..
1.4.d:
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो वीर्यशाली मदोद्धतः..
प्राप्य त्वां तृमवन्नष्टस्तत्र कोऽग्रेसरस्तव.. 21.6 ..
1.4.m: The Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was mighty and arrogant with pride; / meeting you, he perished like straw. Who was your vanguard there?

1.4.s:
pūrvaṃ pratibalā daityā madhukaiṭabhasannibhāḥ..
niviṣṭāstvāṃ tu saṃprāpya śalabhā iva pāvakam.. 21.7 ..
1.4.d:
पूर्वं प्रतिबला दैत्या मधुकैटभसन्निभाः..
निविष्टास्त्वां तु संप्राप्य शलभा इव पावकम्.. 21.7 ..
1.4.m: Previously, rival Daityas like Madhu and Kaiṭabha, / having approached you, were consumed like moths in a flame.

1.4.s:
yugeyuge ca daityānāṃ tvatto nāśo'bhavaddhare..
tathaivādyeha bhītānāṃ tvaṃ hi viṣṇo surāśrayaḥ.. 21.8 ..
1.4.d:
युगेयुगे च दैत्यानां त्वत्तो नाशोऽभवद्धरे..
तथैवाद्येह भीतानां त्वं हि विष्णो सुराश्रयः.. 21.8 ..
1.4.m: In every age, O Hari, the destruction of the Daityas has come from you. / So too today, O Viṣṇu, you are the refuge of the terrified gods in this world!"

1.4.s:
evaṃ saṃnodito viṣṇurvyavardhata mahābhujaḥ..
balena tejasā ṛddhyā sarvabhūtāśrayo'rihā.. 21.9 ..
1.4.d:
एवं संनोदितो विष्णुर्व्यवर्धत महाभुजः..
बलेन तेजसा ऋद्ध्या सर्वभूताश्रयोऽरिहा.. 21.9 ..
1.4.m: Thus urged, Viṣṇu, mighty-armed, the slayer of foes and refuge of all beings, / expanded in strength, splendor, and prosperity.

1.4.s:
athovāca sahasrākṣaṃ keśavaḥ prahasanniva..
evametadyathā prāha bhavānasmadgataṃ vacaḥ.. 21.10 ..
1.4.d:
अथोवाच सहस्राक्षं केशवः प्रहसन्निव..
एवमेतद्यथा प्राह भवानस्मद्गतं वचः.. 21.10 ..
1.4.m: Then Keśava, as if smiling, spoke to the thousand-eyed [Indra]: / "It is so, exactly as you have spoken concerning me.

1.4.s:
trailokyadānavānsarvāndagdhuṃ śaktaḥ kṣaṇādaham..
durjastārakaḥ kiṃ tu muktvā saptadinaṃ śiśum.. 21.11 ..
1.4.d:
त्रैलोक्यदानवान्सर्वान्दग्धुं शक्तः क्षणादहम्..
दुर्जस्तारकः किं तु मुक्त्वा सप्तदिनं शिशुम्.. 21.11 ..
1.4.m: I am able in an instant to burn all the Dānavas of the three worlds. / But Tāraka is difficult to conquer, except by an infant seven days old.

1.4.s:
mahiṣaścaiva śuṃbhaśca ubhau vadhyau ca yoṣitā..
jaṃbho durvāsasā śaptaḥ śakravadhyo bhavāniti..
tasmāttvaṃ divyavīryeṇa jahi jaṃbhaṃ madotkaṭam.. 21.12 ..
1.4.d:
महिषश्चैव शुंभश्च उभौ वध्यौ च योषिता..
जंभो दुर्वाससा शप्तः शक्रवध्यो भवानिति..
तस्मात्त्वं दिव्यवीर्येण जहि जंभं मदोत्कटम्.. 21.12 ..
1.4.m: And Mahiṣa and Śumbha are both to be slain by a woman. / Jambha was cursed by Durvāsas: 'You shall be slain by Śakra!' / Therefore, with divine valor, slay Jambha, swollen with pride!

1.4.s: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāmṛte sa tu dānavaḥ.. 21.13 ..
1.4.d: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां त्वामृते स तु दानवः.. 21.13 ..
1.4.m: That Dānava cannot be slain by all living beings, except by you.

1.4.s:
mayā gupto raṇe jaṃbho jagatkaṃṭakamuddhara..
tadvaikuṃṭhavacaḥ śrutvā sahasrākṣomarārihā.. 21.14 ..
1.4.d:
मया गुप्तो रणे जंभो जगत्कंटकमुद्धर..
तद्वैकुंठवचः श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षोमरारिहा.. 21.14 ..
1.4.m: Protected by me in battle, remove Jambha, the thorn of the world!" / Hearing that speech of Vaikuṇṭha, the thousand-eyed [Indra], slayer of the foes of the immortals,

1.4.s:
samādiśatsurādhyakṣānsainyasya racanāṃ prati..
tataścābhyarthito devairviṣṇuḥ sainyamakalpayat.. 21.15 ..
1.4.d:
समादिशत्सुराध्यक्षान्सैन्यस्य रचनां प्रति..
ततश्चाभ्यर्थितो देवैर्विष्णुः सैन्यमकल्पयत्.. 21.15 ..
1.4.m: commanded the lords of the gods regarding the array of the army. / Then, requested by the gods, Viṣṇu arranged the army.

1.4.s:
yatsāraṃ sarvalokasya vīryasya tapaso'pi ca..
tadaikādaśa rudrāṃśca cakārāgresarānhariḥ.. 21.16 ..
1.4.d:
यत्सारं सर्वलोकस्य वीर्यस्य तपसोऽपि च..
तदैकादश रुद्रांश्च चकाराग्रेसरान्हरिः.. 21.16 ..
1.4.m: What was the essence of all the world, and of valor and austerity— / that Hari made into the eleven Rudras at the vanguard.

1.4.s:
vyālīḍhāṃgā mahādevā balino nīlakaṃdharāḥ..
caṃdrakhaṃḍatripuṃḍrāśca piṃgākṣāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ.. 21.17 ..
1.4.d:
व्यालीढांगा महादेवा बलिनो नीलकंधराः..
चंद्रखंडत्रिपुंड्राश्च पिंगाक्षाः शूलपाणयः.. 21.17 ..
1.4.m: The great gods, their limbs entwined by serpents, mighty, blue-throated, / with the crescent moon and the three lines of ash, yellow-eyed, bearing tridents in their hands,

1.4.s:
piṃgottuṃgajaṭājūṭāḥ siṃhacarmāvasāyinaḥ..
bhasmoddhūlitagātrāśca bhujamaṃḍalabhairavāḥ.. 21.18 ..
1.4.d:
पिंगोत्तुंगजटाजूटाः सिंहचर्मावसायिनः..
भस्मोद्धूलितगात्राश्च भुजमंडलभैरवाः.. 21.18 ..
1.4.m: with tall, tawny matted hair, wearing lion skins, / their limbs smeared with sacred ash, fearsome with circles of arms,

1.4.s:
kapālīśādayo rudrā vidrāvitamahā'surāḥ..
kapālī piṃgalo bhīmo virupākṣo vilohitaḥ.. 21.19 ..
1.4.d:
कपालीशादयो रुद्रा विद्रावितमहाऽसुराः..
कपाली पिंगलो भीमो विरुपाक्षो विलोहितः.. 21.19 ..
1.4.m: the Rudras, Kapālīśa and the others, put the great Asuras to flight: / Kapālī, Piṅgala, Bhīma, Virūpākṣa, Vilohita,

1.4.s:
ajakaḥ śāsanaḥ śāstā śaṃbhuścaṃdro bhavastathā..
eta ekādaśanaṃtabalā rudrāḥ prabhāvinaḥ.. 21.20 ..
1.4.d:
अजकः शासनः शास्ता शंभुश्चंद्रो भवस्तथा..
एत एकादशनंतबला रुद्राः प्रभाविनः.. 21.20 ..
1.4.m: Ajaka, Śāsana, Śāstā, Śambhu, Candra, and Bhava— / these eleven Rudras were of endless strength and glorious power.

1.4.s:
apālayaṃta tridaśānvigarjaṃta ivāṃbudāḥ..
himācalābhe mahati kāṃcanāṃburuhasrahi.. 21.21 ..
1.4.d:
अपालयंत त्रिदशान्विगर्जंत इवांबुदाः..
हिमाचलाभे महति कांचनांबुरुहस्रहि.. 21.21 ..
1.4.m: They protected the gods, roaring like clouds. / Mounted on Airāvata, who was like the Himālaya, wearing a garland of golden lotuses,

1.4.s:
pracaṃcalamahāhemaghaṃṭāsaṃhatimaṃḍite..
airāvate caturdaṃte mattamātaṃga āsthitaḥ.. 21.22 ..
1.4.d:
प्रचंचलमहाहेमघंटासंहतिमंडिते..
ऐरावते चतुर्दंते मत्तमातंग आस्थितः.. 21.22 ..
1.4.m: adorned with a host of swinging large golden bells, / four-tusked, an elephant in rut,

1.4.s:
mahāmadajalasrāve kāmarūpe śatakratuḥ..
tasthau himagireḥ śrṛṃge bhānumāniva dīptimān..
tasyārakṣatpadaṃ savyaṃ māruto'mitavikramaḥ.. 21.23 ..
1.4.d:
महामदजलस्रावे कामरूपे शतक्रतुः..
तस्थौ हिमगिरेः श्रृंगे भानुमानिव दीप्तिमान्..
तस्यारक्षत्पदं सव्यं मारुतोऽमितविक्रमः.. 21.23 ..
1.4.m: shedding copious rut-fluid, able to change form at will, Śatakratu [Indra] stood / like the radiant sun upon a peak of the snowy mountain. / The wind god of boundless valor protected his left flank;

1.4.s:
jugopāparamagniśca jvālāpūritadiṅmukhaḥ..
pṛṣṭharakṣo'bhava dviṣṇuḥ samareśaḥ śatakratoḥ.. 21.24 ..
1.4.d:
जुगोपापरमग्निश्च ज्वालापूरितदिङ्मुखः..
पृष्ठरक्षोऽभव द्विष्णुः समरेशः शतक्रतोः.. 21.24 ..
1.4.m: Agni, filling the quarters of the sky with flames, guarded the other; / and Viṣṇu, the lord of the battle, protected the rear of Śatakratu.

1.4.s:
ādityā vasavo viśve marutaścāśvināvapi..
gaṃdharvā rākṣasā yakṣāḥ sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ.. 21.25 ..
1.4.d:
आदित्या वसवो विश्वे मरुतश्चाश्विनावपि..
गंधर्वा राक्षसा यक्षाः सकिंनरमहोरगाः.. 21.25 ..
1.4.m: The Ādityas, Vasus, Viśvedevas, Maruts, and the two Aśvins, / the Gandharvas, Rākṣasas, Yakṣas, along with Kinnaras and great serpents,

1.4.s:
koṭiśaḥkoṭiśaḥ gṛtvā vṛṃdaṃ cihnopalakṣitam..
viśrāvayaṃtaḥ svāṃ kīrtiṃ baṃdivṛndaiḥ puraḥ saraiḥ.. 21.26 ..
1.4.d:
कोटिशःकोटिशः गृत्वा वृंदं चिह्नोपलक्षितम्..
विश्रावयंतः स्वां कीर्तिं बंदिवृन्दैः पुरः सरैः.. 21.26 ..
1.4.m: forming troops by the tens of millions, distinguished by banners, / proclaiming their own fame with hosts of bards marching before them,

1.4.s: celurdaityavadhe dṛptā nānāvarṇāyudhadhvajāḥ.. 21.27 ..
1.4.d: चेलुर्दैत्यवधे दृप्ता नानावर्णायुधध्वजाः.. 21.27 ..
1.4.m: haughty in slaying Daityas, with multicolored weapons and banners, marched forth.

1.4.s:
śatakratoramaranikāyapālitā patākinī yānaninādanāditā..
sitonnatadhvajapaṭakoṭimaṃḍitā babhūva sā ditisutokavardhinī.. 21.28 ..
1.4.d:
शतक्रतोरमरनिकायपालिता पताकिनी याननिनादनादिता..
सितोन्नतध्वजपटकोटिमंडिता बभूव सा दितिसुतोकवर्धिनी.. 21.28 ..
1.4.m: Guarded by the host of immortals, that army of Śatakratu, resplendent with the sound of vehicles / and adorned with tens of millions of elevated white flag-cloths, brought joy to the sons of Diti.

1.4.s:
āyāṃtīṃ tāṃ vilokyātha surasenāṃ gajāsuraḥ..
gajarūpī mahāṃścaiva saṃhārāṃbhodhivikramaḥ.. 21.29 ..
1.4.d:
आयांतीं तां विलोक्याथ सुरसेनां गजासुरः..
गजरूपी महांश्चैव संहारांभोधिविक्रमः.. 21.29 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that army of the gods approaching, Gajāsura, / having the form of an elephant, immense, with the prowess of the ocean of destruction,

1.4.s:
paraśvadhāyudho daityo daśanauṣṭhakasaṃpuṭaḥ..
mamarda caraṇe devāṃścikṣepānyānkareṇa ca.. 21.30 ..
1.4.d:
परश्वधायुधो दैत्यो दशनौष्ठकसंपुटः..
ममर्द चरणे देवांश्चिक्षेपान्यान्करेण च.. 21.30 ..
1.4.m: a Daitya armed with a battle-axe, with his lips clenched over his tusks, / crushed gods with his feet and hurled others with his trunk.

1.4.s:
parānparaśunā jaghne daityeṃdro raudravikramaḥ..
tasyaivaṃ nighnataḥ kruddhā devagandharvakiṃnarāḥ.. 21.31 ..
1.4.d:
परान्परशुना जघ्ने दैत्येंद्रो रौद्रविक्रमः..
तस्यैवं निघ्नतः क्रुद्धा देवगन्धर्वकिंनराः.. 21.31 ..
1.4.m: The lord of the Daityas, of terrible prowess, struck down others with his axe. / As he was thus striking, the gods, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras, enraged,

1.4.s:
mumucuḥ saṃhatāḥ sarve citraśastrāstrasaṃhatim..
paraśvadhāṃśca cakrāṇi bhiṇḍipālānsamudgarān.. 21.32 ..
1.4.d:
मुमुचुः संहताः सर्वे चित्रशस्त्रास्त्रसंहतिम्..
परश्वधांश्च चक्राणि भिण्डिपालान्समुद्गरान्.. 21.32 ..
1.4.m: banded together and all unleashed a multitude of diverse weapons and missiles: / battle-axes, discuses, javelins, and clubs.

1.4.s:
kuntānprāsāñcharāṃstīkṣṇānmudgarāṃścāpi duḥsahān..
tānsarvānsograsaddaityo yūthapaḥ kavalāniva.. 21.33 ..
1.4.d:
कुन्तान्प्रासाञ्छरांस्तीक्ष्णान्मुद्गरांश्चापि दुःसहान्..
तान्सर्वान्सोग्रसद्दैत्यो यूथपः कवलानिव.. 21.33 ..
1.4.m: Spears, darts, sharp arrows, and intolerable clubs— / that leader of the troop, the Daitya, swallowed them all like mouthfuls [of food].

1.4.s:
kopasphuritadaṃṣṭrāgraḥ karasphoṭena nādayan..
surānnaghnaṃścarārājau duṣprekṣyaḥ so'tha dānavaḥ.. 21.34 ..
1.4.d:
कोपस्फुरितदंष्ट्राग्रः करस्फोटेन नादयन्..
सुरान्नघ्नंश्चराराजौ दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः सोऽथ दानवः.. 21.34 ..
1.4.m: With the tips of his tusks quivering in rage, resounding with the clapping of his hands, / that Dānava, dreadful to look upon, roamed about in the battle, striking down the gods.

1.4.s:
yasminyasminnipatati sura vṛṃde gajāsuraḥ..
tasmistīsminmahāśabdo hāhākāro vyajāyata.. 21.35 ..
1.4.d:
यस्मिन्यस्मिन्निपतति सुर वृंदे गजासुरः..
तस्मिस्तीस्मिन्महाशब्दो हाहाकारो व्यजायत.. 21.35 ..
1.4.m: Wherever Gajāsura fell upon the host of gods, / in that very place arose a great cry of "Alas! Alas!"

1.4.s:
atha vidravamānaṃ tablaṃ prekṣva samaṃtataḥ..
rudrāḥ parasparaṃ procurahaṃkārotthitārciṣaḥ.. 21.36 ..
1.4.d:
अथ विद्रवमानं तब्लं प्रेक्ष्व समंततः..
रुद्राः परस्परं प्रोचुरहंकारोत्थितार्चिषः.. 21.36 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing that army fleeing in all directions, / the Rudras, from whom rays of egoism arose, spoke to one another:

1.4.s:
bhobho gṛhṇata daityeṃdraṃ bhiṃdatainaṃ mahābalāḥ..
karṣatainaṃ śitaiḥ śūlairbhañjatainaṃ hi marmasu.. 21.37 ..
1.4.d:
भोभो गृह्णत दैत्येंद्रं भिंदतैनं महाबलाः..
कर्षतैनं शितैः शूलैर्भञ्जतैनं हि मर्मसु.. 21.37 ..
1.4.m: "Ho, ho! Seize the lord of Daityas! Pierce him, O mighty ones! / Drag him with sharp tridents! Crush him in his vital parts!"

1.4.s:
kapālī vākyamākarṇya śūlaṃ sitaśitaṃmukhe..
saṃmārjya vāmahastena saṃraṃbhādvivṛtekṣaṇaḥ.. 21.38 ..
1.4.d:
कपाली वाक्यमाकर्ण्य शूलं सितशितंमुखे..
संमार्ज्य वामहस्तेन संरंभाद्विवृतेक्षणः.. 21.38 ..
1.4.m: Kapālin, hearing the words, wiped the trident, / which was exceedingly sharp at the tip, with his left hand, his eyes wide open with fury.

1.4.s:
protphullāruṇanīlābjasaṃhatiḥ sarvato diśaḥ..
athāgādbhukuṭīvakro daityeṃdrābhimukho raṇe.. 21.39 ..
1.4.d:
प्रोत्फुल्लारुणनीलाब्जसंहतिः सर्वतो दिशः..
अथागाद्भुकुटीवक्रो दैत्येंद्राभिमुखो रणे.. 21.39 ..
1.4.m: The multitude of blossomed red and blue lotuses [resembled his eyes gazing in] all directions; / then, his brow curved with a frown, he advanced facing the Daitya lord in battle.

1.4.s:
dṛḍhena muṣṭibandhena śūlaṃ viṣṛbhya nirmalaḥ..
jaghāna kumbhadeśe tu kapālī gajadānavam.. 21.40 ..
1.4.d:
दृढेन मुष्टिबन्धेन शूलं विषृभ्य निर्मलः..
जघान कुम्भदेशे तु कपाली गजदानवम्.. 21.40 ..
1.4.m: Bracing his trident with a firm grip of his fist, the pure / Kapālin struck the elephant-Dānava on the frontal globe of his head.

1.4.s:
tato daśāpi te rudrā nirmalāyomayai raṇe..
jaghnuḥ śūlaistu daityeṃdraṃ śailavarṣmāṇamāhave.. 21.41 ..
1.4.d:
ततो दशापि ते रुद्रा निर्मलायोमयै रणे..
जघ्नुः शूलैस्तु दैत्येंद्रं शैलवर्ष्माणमाहवे.. 21.41 ..
1.4.m: Then those ten Rudras too struck the lord of Daityas, / who possessed the bulk of a mountain, with tridents made of pure iron in the fight.

1.4.s:
susrāva śoṇitaṃ paścātsarvasrotassu tasya vai..
śūlaraktena rudrasya śuśubhe gajadānavaḥ.. 21.42 ..
1.4.d:
सुस्राव शोणितं पश्चात्सर्वस्रोतस्सु तस्य वै..
शूलरक्तेन रुद्रस्य शुशुभे गजदानवः.. 21.42 ..
1.4.m: Then blood flowed through all his channels; / smeared with the blood from the trident of Rudra, the elephant-Dānava shone

1.4.s:
protphullāmalanīlābjaṃ śaradīvāmalaṃ saraḥ..
bhasmaśubhratanucchāyai rudra rhaṃsairivāvṛtam.. 21.43 ..
1.4.d:
प्रोत्फुल्लामलनीलाब्जं शरदीवामलं सरः..
भस्मशुभ्रतनुच्छायै रुद्र र्हंसैरिवावृतम्.. 21.43 ..
1.4.m: like a clear lake in autumn with blossoming pure blue lotuses, / surrounded by swans resembling Rudra with bodies bright with ashes.

1.4.s:
kruddhaṃ kapālinaṃ daityaḥ pracalatkarṇapallavaḥ..
bhavaṃ ca dantairbibhide nābhideśe jagāsuraḥ.. 21.44 ..
1.4.d:
क्रुद्धं कपालिनं दैत्यः प्रचलत्कर्णपल्लवः..
भवं च दन्तैर्बिभिदे नाभिदेशे जगासुरः.. 21.44 ..
1.4.m: With the leaf-like tips of his ears flapping, Gajāsura, enraged, / pierced the furious Kapālin and Bhava at the region of the navel with his tusks.

1.4.s:
dṛṣṭvānuraktaṃ rudrābhyāṃ navarudrāstato drutam..
vivyadhurviśikhaiḥ śūlaiḥ śarīramamaradviṣaḥ.. 21.45 ..
1.4.d:
दृष्ट्वानुरक्तं रुद्राभ्यां नवरुद्रास्ततो द्रुतम्..
विव्यधुर्विशिखैः शूलैः शरीरममरद्विषः.. 21.45 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that he was engaged with the two Rudras, the nine Rudras then swiftly / pierced the body of the enemy of the immortals with arrows and tridents.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kapālinaṃ tyaktvā bhavaṃ cāsurapuṃgavaḥ..
vegena kupito daityo nava rudrānupādravat..
mamarda caraṇāghātairdantaiścāpi kareṇa ca.. 21.46 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कपालिनं त्यक्त्वा भवं चासुरपुंगवः..
वेगेन कुपितो दैत्यो नव रुद्रानुपाद्रवत्..
ममर्द चरणाघातैर्दन्तैश्चापि करेण च.. 21.46 ..
1.4.m: Then, abandoning Kapālin and Bhava, that bull among asuras, / the Daitya, enraged, charged with speed at the nine Rudras; / he trampled them with blows of his feet, and also with his tusks and his trunk.

1.4.s:
tato'sau śūlayuddhena śramamāsādito yadā..
tadā kapālī jagrāha karamasyāmaradviṣaḥ.. 21.47 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽसौ शूलयुद्धेन श्रममासादितो यदा..
तदा कपाली जग्राह करमस्यामरद्विषः.. 21.47 ..
1.4.m: Then, when he had attained exhaustion from the duel of tridents, / Kapālin seized the trunk of this enemy of the immortals.

1.4.s:
bhrāmayāmāsa cātīva vegena ca gajāsuram..
dṛṣṭvāśramāturaṃ daityaṃ kiṃciccyāvitajīvitam.. 21.48 ..
1.4.d:
भ्रामयामास चातीव वेगेन च गजासुरम्..
दृष्ट्वाश्रमातुरं दैत्यं किंचिच्च्यावितजीवितम्.. 21.48 ..
1.4.m: And with great speed he whirled Gajāsura around; / seeing the Daitya afflicted with fatigue, his life almost departing,

1.4.s:
nirutsāhaṃ raṇe tasmingatayuddhotsavo'bhavat..
tato bhramata evāsya carma utkṛttya bhairavam.. 21.49 ..
1.4.d:
निरुत्साहं रणे तस्मिन्गतयुद्धोत्सवोऽभवत्..
ततो भ्रमत एवास्य चर्म उत्कृत्त्य भैरवम्.. 21.49 ..
1.4.m: deprived of zeal, his eagerness for battle gone in that fight— / then, tearing off his dreadful skin while he was still spinning,

1.4.s:
sravatsarvāṃgara ktaughaṃ cakārāṃbaramātmanaḥ..
tuṣṭuvustaṃ tadā devā bahudhā bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ.. 21.50 ..
1.4.d:
स्रवत्सर्वांगर क्तौघं चकारांबरमात्मनः..
तुष्टुवुस्तं तदा देवा बहुधा बहुभिः स्तवैः.. 21.50 ..
1.4.m: which was flowing with a stream of blood from all its limbs, he made it his garment. / Then the gods praised him in many ways with numerous hymns of praise,

1.4.s:
ūcuścainaṃ cayo hanyātsa mriyeta tatastvasau..
dṛṣṭvā kapālino rūpaṃ gajacarmāṃbarāvṛtam.. 21.51 ..
1.4.d:
ऊचुश्चैनं चयो हन्यात्स म्रियेत ततस्त्वसौ..
दृष्ट्वा कपालिनो रूपं गजचर्मांबरावृतम्.. 21.51 ..
1.4.m: and they said to him: "Whoever would strike this one would die." Then he, / seeing the form of Kapālin clad in the garment of elephant hide,

1.4.s:
vitresurdudruvurjaghnurnipetuśca sahasraśaḥ..
evaṃ vilulite tasmindānavendre mahābale.. 21.52 ..
1.4.d:
वित्रेसुर्दुद्रुवुर्जघ्नुर्निपेतुश्च सहस्रशः..
एवं विलुलिते तस्मिन्दानवेन्द्रे महाबले.. 21.52 ..
1.4.m: [the Dānavas] were terrified, fled, struck [at random], and fell down by the thousands. / When that mighty lord of Dānavas was thus destroyed,

1.4.s:
gajaṃ mattamathāruhya śatadundubhināditam..
nimirabhyapatattūrṇaṃ surasainyāni loḍayan.. 21.53 ..
1.4.d:
गजं मत्तमथारुह्य शतदुन्दुभिनादितम्..
निमिरभ्यपतत्तूर्णं सुरसैन्यानि लोडयन्.. 21.53 ..
1.4.m: having mounted a rutting elephant that resounded with a hundred kettledrums, / Nimi rushed forward swiftly, throwing the armies of the gods into disorder.

1.4.s:
yāṃyāṃ nimigajo yāti diśaṃ tāṃtāṃ savāhanāḥ..
dudruvuścukruśurdevā bhayenākaṃpitā muhuḥ.. 21.54 ..
1.4.d:
यांयां निमिगजो याति दिशं तांतां सवाहनाः..
दुद्रुवुश्चुक्रुशुर्देवा भयेनाकंपिता मुहुः.. 21.54 ..
1.4.m: Whichever quarter Nimi's elephant approached, / in that direction the gods fled along with their mounts and wailed, trembling repeatedly with fear.

1.4.s:
gandhena suramātaṃgā dudruvustasya hastinaḥ..
palāyiteṣu sainyeṣu surāṇāṃ pākaśāsanaḥ.. 21.55 ..
1.4.d:
गन्धेन सुरमातंगा दुद्रुवुस्तस्य हस्तिनः..
पलायितेषु सैन्येषु सुराणां पाकशासनः.. 21.55 ..
1.4.m: At the scent of his elephant, the elephants of the gods fled. / When the armies of the gods had fled, Pākaśāsana

1.4.s:
tasthau dikpālakaiḥ sārdhamaṣṭabhiḥ keśavena ca..
saṃprāptastasya mātaṃgo yāvacchakragajaṃ prati.. 21.56 ..
1.4.d:
तस्थौ दिक्पालकैः सार्धमष्टभिः केशवेन च..
संप्राप्तस्तस्य मातंगो यावच्छक्रगजं प्रति.. 21.56 ..
1.4.m: stood firm together with the eight guardians of the quarters and Keśava. / As soon as his elephant reached Śakra's elephant,

1.4.s:
tāvacchakragajo bhīto muktvā nādaṃ subhairavam..
dhriyamāṇo'pi yatnena cakora iva tiṣṭhati.. 21.57 ..
1.4.d:
तावच्छक्रगजो भीतो मुक्त्वा नादं सुभैरवम्..
ध्रियमाणोऽपि यत्नेन चकोर इव तिष्ठति.. 21.57 ..
1.4.m: Śakra's elephant, terrified, uttered a dreadful cry, / and although held with effort, stood trembling like a cakora bird.

1.4.s:
palāyati gaje tasminnārūḍhaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ..
viparītamukhaṃ yuddhaṃ dānavendreṇa so'karot.. 21.58 ..
1.4.d:
पलायति गजे तस्मिन्नारूढः पाकशासनः..
विपरीतमुखं युद्धं दानवेन्द्रेण सोऽकरोत्.. 21.58 ..
1.4.m: While that elephant was fleeing, Pākaśāsana, mounted upon it, / fought facing backwards with the lord of Dānavas.

1.4.s:
śatakra tustu śūlena nimiṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat..
gadayā daṃtinaṃ tasya galladeśehanadbhṛśam.. 21.59 ..
1.4.d:
शतक्र तुस्तु शूलेन निमिं वक्षस्यताडयत्..
गदया दंतिनं तस्य गल्लदेशेहनद्भृशम्.. 21.59 ..
1.4.m: Śatakratu struck Nimi on the chest with a trident, / and with a mace he struck his elephant violently on the cheek.

1.4.s:
taṃ prahāraciṃtyaiva nimirnirbhayapauruṣaḥ..
airāvataṃ kaṭīdeśe mudgareṇābhyatāḍayat.. 21.60 ..
1.4.d:
तं प्रहारचिंत्यैव निमिर्निर्भयपौरुषः..
ऐरावतं कटीदेशे मुद्गरेणाभ्यताडयत्.. 21.60 ..
1.4.m: Disregarding that blow, Nimi of fearless prowess / struck Airāvata on the hip with a club.

1.4.s:
sa hato mudgareṇātha śakrakuñjara āhave..
jagāma paścātpadbhyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ bhūdharākṛtiḥ.. 21.61 ..
1.4.d:
स हतो मुद्गरेणाथ शक्रकुञ्जर आहवे..
जगाम पश्चात्पद्भ्यां च पृथिवीं भूधराकृतिः.. 21.61 ..
1.4.m: Struck then by the club in battle, Śakra's elephant, / resembling a mountain, sank back onto the earth upon its hind legs.

1.4.s:
lāghavātkṣipramutthāya tato'maramahāgajaḥ..
raṇādapasasarpātha bhīṣito nimihastinā.. 21.62 ..
1.4.d:
लाघवात्क्षिप्रमुत्थाय ततोऽमरमहागजः..
रणादपससर्पाथ भीषितो निमिहस्तिना.. 21.62 ..
1.4.m: Rising quickly with agility, the great elephant of the immortals / then retreated from the battle, terrified by Nimi's elephant.

1.4.s:
tato vāyurvavau rūkṣo bahuśarkarapāṃśulaḥ..
sammukho nimimātaṃgo'kaṃpano'calakaṃpanaḥ..
srutarakto babhau śailo ghanadhātuhrado yatā.. 21.63 ..
1.4.d:
ततो वायुर्ववौ रूक्षो बहुशर्करपांशुलः..
सम्मुखो निमिमातंगोऽकंपनोऽचलकंपनः..
स्रुतरक्तो बभौ शैलो घनधातुह्रदो यता.. 21.63 ..
1.4.m: Then blew a harsh wind, full of dust and many pebbles. / Facing [them], Nimi's elephant, unshakeable, shook the mountains; / flowing with blood, it shone like a mountain with a dense pool of red mineral ores.

1.4.s:
dhaneśo'pi gadāṃ gurvī tasya dānavahastinaḥ..
mumoca vegānnyapatatsā gadā tasya mūrdhani.. 21.64 ..
1.4.d:
धनेशोऽपि गदां गुर्वी तस्य दानवहस्तिनः..
मुमोच वेगान्न्यपतत्सा गदा तस्य मूर्धनि.. 21.64 ..
1.4.m: The lord of wealth too hurled a heavy mace with speed / at that elephant of the Dānava; that mace fell upon its head.

1.4.s:
gajo gadānipātena sa tena parimūrchitaḥ..
daṃtairbhitvā dharāṃ vegātpapātācalasannibhaḥ.. 21.65 ..
1.4.d:
गजो गदानिपातेन स तेन परिमूर्छितः..
दंतैर्भित्वा धरां वेगात्पपाताचलसन्निभः.. 21.65 ..
1.4.m: Fainting from the fall of that mace, / the elephant, having pierced the earth with its tusks, fell with speed like a mountain.

1.4.s:
patite ca gaje tasminsiṃhanādo mahānabhūt..
sarvataḥ surasainyānāṃ gajabṛṃhitabṛṃhitaḥ.. 21.66 ..
1.4.d:
पतिते च गजे तस्मिन्सिंहनादो महानभूत्..
सर्वतः सुरसैन्यानां गजबृंहितबृंहितः.. 21.66 ..
1.4.m: When that elephant fell, a great lion's roar arose / from the armies of the gods on all sides, augmented by the trumpeting of elephants,

1.4.s:
heṣāraveṇa cāśvānāṃ rāṇāsphoṭaiśca dhanvinām..
gajaṃ taṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā nimiṃ cāpi parāṅmukham.. 21.67 ..
1.4.d:
हेषारवेण चाश्वानां राणास्फोटैश्च धन्विनाम्..
गजं तं निहतं दृष्ट्वा निमिं चापि पराङ्मुखम्.. 21.67 ..
1.4.m: by the neighing of horses, and by the twanging of the bows of archers. / Seeing that elephant slain and Nimi turning away,

1.4.s:
surāṇāṃ siṃhanādaṃ ca sannāditadigaṃtaram..
jaṃbho jajvāla kopena saṃdīpta iva pāvakaḥ.. 21.68 ..
1.4.d:
सुराणां सिंहनादं च सन्नादितदिगंतरम्..
जंभो जज्वाल कोपेन संदीप्त इव पावकः.. 21.68 ..
1.4.m: and the lion's roar of the gods that resounded through the quarters, / Jambha blazed with anger like an inflamed fire.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sa koparaktākṣo dhnuṣyāropya sāyakam..
tiṣṭheti cābravīttāraṃ sārathiṃ cāpyanaṃdayat.. 21.69 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स कोपरक्ताक्षो ध्नुष्यारोप्य सायकम्..
तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्तारं सारथिं चाप्यनंदयत्.. 21.69 ..
1.4.m: Then, his eyes red with rage, fixing an arrow on his bow, / he shouted loudly, "Halt!", and cheered his charioteer.

1.4.s:
tamāyāṃtamabhiprekṣya dhanuṣyāhitasā yakam..
śatakraturadīnātmā dṛḍhamādatta kārmukam.. 21.70 ..
1.4.d:
तमायांतमभिप्रेक्ष्य धनुष्याहितसा यकम्..
शतक्रतुरदीनात्मा दृढमादत्त कार्मुकम्.. 21.70 ..
1.4.m: Seeing him approaching with an arrow placed on the bow, / Śatakratu, undaunted in spirit, firmly took up his bow

1.4.s: bāṇaṃ ca tailadhautāgramardhacaṃdramajihmagam.. 21.71 ..
1.4.d: बाणं च तैलधौताग्रमर्धचंद्रमजिह्मगम्.. 21.71 ..
1.4.m: and a crescent-headed arrow whose tip was cleaned with oil, flying straight.

1.4.s:
tenāsyaṭa saśaraṃ cāpaṃ ciccheda balavṛtrahā..
apāsya taddhanuśchinnaṃ jaṃbho dānavanaṃdanaḥ.. 21.72 ..
1.4.d:
तेनास्यट सशरं चापं चिच्छेद बलवृत्रहा..
अपास्य तद्धनुश्छिन्नं जंभो दानवनंदनः.. 21.72 ..
1.4.m: With it the slayer of Bala and Vṛtra sliced through his bow along with the arrow. / Casting aside that severed bow, Jambha, the delight of the Dānavas,

1.4.s:
anyatkārmukādāya vegavadbhārasādhanam..
śarāṃścāśīviṣākārāṃstailadhautājihmagān.. 21.73 ..
1.4.d:
अन्यत्कार्मुकादाय वेगवद्भारसाधनम्..
शरांश्चाशीविषाकारांस्तैलधौताजिह्मगान्.. 21.73 ..
1.4.m: took another bow, swift and capable of bearing heavy strain, / and arrows resembling venomous serpents, cleaned with oil and flying straight.

1.4.s:
śakraṃ vivyādha daśabhirjatrudeśe ca patribiḥ..
hṛdaye ca tribhiścaiva dvābhyāṃ ca skandhayordvayoḥ.. 21.74 ..
1.4.d:
शक्रं विव्याध दशभिर्जत्रुदेशे च पत्रिबिः..
हृदये च त्रिभिश्चैव द्वाभ्यां च स्कन्धयोर्द्वयोः.. 21.74 ..
1.4.m: He pierced Śakra with ten winged arrows in the clavicle region, / with three in the chest, and with two in his two shoulders.

1.4.s:
śakropi dānavendrāya bāṇajālama bhīrayan..
aprāptāndānavendrastu śarāśchakrabhujeritān.. 21.75 ..
1.4.d:
शक्रोपि दानवेन्द्राय बाणजालम भीरयन्..
अप्राप्तान्दानवेन्द्रस्तु शराश्छक्रभुजेरितान्.. 21.75 ..
1.4.m: Śakra too dispatched a volley of arrows at the lord of Dānavas; / but the lord of Dānavas, before they reached him, [sliced] the arrows shot by Śakra's arms,

1.4.s:
ciccheda śatadhā''kāśe śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ..
tataśca śarajālena devendro dānaveśvaram.. 21.76 ..
1.4.d:
चिच्छेद शतधा'ऽकाशे शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः..
ततश्च शरजालेन देवेन्द्रो दानवेश्वरम्.. 21.76 ..
1.4.m: he cut them into a hundred pieces in the sky with arrows resembling tongues of fire. / And then, with a net of arrows, the lord of gods [assailed] the lord of Dānavas—

1.4.s:
ācchādayata yatnena varṣāsviva ghanairnabhaḥ..
daityo'pi bāṇajālena vivyādha sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ.. 21.77 ..
1.4.d:
आच्छादयत यत्नेन वर्षास्विव घनैर्नभः..
दैत्योऽपि बाणजालेन विव्याध सायकैः शितैः.. 21.77 ..
1.4.m: covered [him] with effort, just as clouds cover the sky in the rainy season. / The Daitya, too, pierced [him] with a net of sharp arrows,

1.4.s:
yathā vāyurghanāṭopaṃ yadavāryaṃ diśāṃ mukhe..
śakro'tha krodhasaṃraṃbhānna viśeṣayate yadā.. 21.78 ..
1.4.d:
यथा वायुर्घनाटोपं यदवार्यं दिशां मुखे..
शक्रोऽथ क्रोधसंरंभान्न विशेषयते यदा.. 21.78 ..
1.4.m: just as the wind [scatters] a mass of clouds that is irresistible in the face of the quarters. / Then, when Śakra, furious with rage, could gain no advantage

1.4.s:
dānavendraṃ tadā cakre gaṃdharvāstraṃ mahādbhutam..
tato'sya tejasā vyāptamabhūdganagocaram.. 21.79 ..
1.4.d:
दानवेन्द्रं तदा चक्रे गंधर्वास्त्रं महाद्भुतम्..
ततोऽस्य तेजसा व्याप्तमभूद्गनगोचरम्.. 21.79 ..
1.4.m: over the lord of the Dānavas, he discharged the most wondrous Gandharva missile. / Then, pervaded by its brilliance, the domain of the sky became filled

1.4.s:
gandharvanagaraiścāpi nānāprākāratoraṇaiḥ..
muṃcadbhiradbhutākārairastravṛṣṭiṃ samaṃtataḥ.. 21.80 ..
1.4.d:
गन्धर्वनगरैश्चापि नानाप्राकारतोरणैः..
मुंचद्भिरद्भुताकारैरस्त्रवृष्टिं समंततः.. 21.80 ..
1.4.m: with cities of the Gandharvas, possessing various ramparts and archways, / discharging a rain of weapons of wondrous form on all sides.

1.4.s:
tayāstravṛṣṭyā daityānāṃ hanyamānā mahācamūḥ..
jaṃbhaṃ śaraṇamāgacchattrāhitrāhīti bhārata.. 21.81 ..
1.4.d:
तयास्त्रवृष्ट्या दैत्यानां हन्यमाना महाचमूः..
जंभं शरणमागच्छत्त्राहित्राहीति भारत.. 21.81 ..
1.4.m: Smitten by that rain of weapons, the great army of the Daityas / went to Jambha for refuge, crying, “Save us! Save us!”, O Bhārata.

1.4.s:
tato jaṃbho mahāvīryo vinadya prahasanmuhuḥ..
smaransādhusamācāraṃ daityānāmabhayaṃ dadau.. 21.82 ..
1.4.d:
ततो जंभो महावीर्यो विनद्य प्रहसन्मुहुः..
स्मरन्साधुसमाचारं दैत्यानामभयं ददौ.. 21.82 ..
1.4.m: Then the mighty Jambha, roaring and laughing again and again, / remembering the conduct of the virtuous, granted fearlessness to the Daityas.

1.4.s:
tato'straṃ mauśalaṃnāma mumoca sumahābhayam..
athogramusalaiḥ sarvamabhavatpūritaṃ jagat.. 21.83 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽस्त्रं मौशलंनाम मुमोच सुमहाभयम्..
अथोग्रमुसलैः सर्वमभवत्पूरितं जगत्.. 21.83 ..
1.4.m: Then he discharged a terrible missile named the Mauśala. / Thereupon, the entire universe was filled with ferocious clubs.

1.4.s:
taiśca bhagnāni sarvāṇi gaṃdharvanagarāṇi ca..
athograika prahāreṇa rathamaśvaṃ gajaṃ suram.. 21.84 ..
1.4.d:
तैश्च भग्नानि सर्वाणि गंधर्वनगराणि च..
