तत्प्रतीक्षस्व तं कालं पश्चादस्मत्सखीसमम्.. 25.33 ..
1.4.m: In only five muhūrtas her observance will be completed. / Therefore, wait for that time; afterwards, together with our companion,

1.4.s:
nānāvidā dharmavārtāḥ prakariṣyasi brāhmaṇa..
ityuktvā vijayādyāstā devīcaritavarṇanaiḥ.. 25.34 ..
1.4.d:
नानाविदा धर्मवार्ताः प्रकरिष्यसि ब्राह्मण..
इत्युक्त्वा विजयाद्यास्ता देवीचरितवर्णनैः.. 25.34 ..
1.4.m: you will engage in various discourses on dharma, O brahmin.' / Having spoken thus, Vijayā and the others, their faces wet with tears, / spent that time before the twice-born with descriptions of the Goddess's life.

1.4.s:
aśrumukhyo dvijasyāgre ninyuḥ kālaṃ ca taṃ tadā..
tataḥ kāle kiṃcidūne brahmacārī mahāmatiḥ.. 25.35 ..
1.4.d:
अश्रुमुख्यो द्विजस्याग्रे निन्युः कालं च तं तदा..
ततः काले किंचिदूने ब्रह्मचारी महामतिः.. 25.35 ..
1.4.m: Then, when the time was slightly short [of complete], the wise celibate student,

1.4.s:
vilokanamiṣeṇāgādāśramopasthitaṃ hradam..
nipapāta ca tatrāsau cukrośātitarāṃ tataḥ.. 25.36 ..
1.4.d:
विलोकनमिषेणागादाश्रमोपस्थितं ह्रदम्..
निपपात च तत्रासौ चुक्रोशातितरां ततः.. 25.36 ..
1.4.m: on the pretext of sightseeing, went to the pool situated near the hermitage, / and there he fell in, and then cried out loudly:

1.4.s:
ahamatra nimajjāmi ko'pi māmuddhareta bhoḥ..
iti tāreṇa krośaṃtaṃ śrutvā taṃ vijayādikāḥ.. 25.37 ..
1.4.d:
अहमत्र निमज्जामि कोऽपि मामुद्धरेत भोः..
इति तारेण क्रोशंतं श्रुत्वा तं विजयादिकाः.. 25.37 ..
1.4.m: 'I am drowning here! Let someone rescue me, alas!' / Hearing him calling out loudly in this way, Vijayā and the others

1.4.s:
ājagmustvarayā yuktā dadustasmai karaṃ ca tāḥ..
sa cukrośa tato gāḍhaṃ dūredūre punaḥpunaḥ.. 25.38 ..
1.4.d:
आजग्मुस्त्वरया युक्ता ददुस्तस्मै करं च ताः..
स चुक्रोश ततो गाढं दूरेदूरे पुनःपुनः.. 25.38 ..
1.4.m: came in haste and offered him their hands. / Then he cried out fiercely, [moving] further and further away again and again:

1.4.s:
nāhaṃ spṛśāmyasaṃsiddhāṃ mriye vā nānṛtaṃ tvidam..
tataḥ samāptaniyamā pārvatī svayamāyayau.. 25.39 ..
1.4.d:
नाहं स्पृशाम्यसंसिद्धां म्रिये वा नानृतं त्विदम्..
ततः समाप्तनियमा पार्वती स्वयमाययौ.. 25.39 ..
1.4.m: 'I will not touch an unperfected woman; let me die, but this is not false!' / Then Pārvatī, having completed her observance, came in person.

1.4.s:
savyaṃ karaṃ dadāvasya taṃ cāsau nābhyanandata..
bhadre yacchuci naiva syādyaccaivāvajñayā kṛtam.. 25.40 ..
1.4.d:
सव्यं करं ददावस्य तं चासौ नाभ्यनन्दत..
भद्रे यच्छुचि नैव स्याद्यच्चैवावज्ञया कृतम्.. 25.40 ..
1.4.m: She offered him her left hand, but he did not welcome it: / 'O auspicious lady, that which is not pure and that which is done with contempt,

1.4.s:
sadoṣeṇa kṛtaṃ yacca tadādadyānna karhicit..
savyaṃ cāśuci te hastaṃ nāvalaṃbāmi karhicit.. 25.41 ..
1.4.d:
सदोषेण कृतं यच्च तदादद्यान्न कर्हिचित्..
सव्यं चाशुचि ते हस्तं नावलंबामि कर्हिचित्.. 25.41 ..
1.4.m: and that which is done with a defect, one should never accept. / And your left hand is impure; I will never take hold of it.'

1.4.s:
ityuktā pārvatī prāha nāhaṃ dattaṃ ca dakṣiṇam..
dadāmi kasyacidvipra devadevāya kalpitam.. 25.42 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ता पार्वती प्राह नाहं दत्तं च दक्षिणम्..
ददामि कस्यचिद्विप्र देवदेवाय कल्पितम्.. 25.42 ..
1.4.m: Thus addressed, Pārvatī said: 'I do not give my right hand / to anyone, O brahmin; it is intended for the God of gods.

1.4.s:
dakṣiṇaṃ me karaṃ devo grahītā bhava eva ca..
śīryate cogratapasā satyametanmayoditam.. 25.43 ..
1.4.d:
दक्षिणं मे करं देवो ग्रहीता भव एव च..
शीर्यते चोग्रतपसा सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम्.. 25.43 ..
1.4.m: The god Bhava alone shall take my right hand. / It is withering by severe austerity; this which I have spoken is true.'

1.4.s:
..vipra uvāca..
yadyevamavalepaste gamanaṃ kena vāryate..
yathā tava pratijñeyaṃ mamāpīyaṃ tathācalā.. 25.44 ..
1.4.d:
..विप्र उवाच..
यद्येवमवलेपस्ते गमनं केन वार्यते..
यथा तव प्रतिज्ञेयं ममापीयं तथाचला.. 25.44 ..
1.4.m: The brahmin said: / 'If you have such pride, who is preventing your departure? / Just as this vow is yours, so too is this [resolution] of mine unshakeable.

1.4.s:
rudrasyāpi vayaṃ mānyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ te tapo vada..
viṣamasthaṃ yatra vipraṃ mriyamāṇamupekṣasi.. 25.45 ..
1.4.d:
रुद्रस्यापि वयं मान्याः कीदृशं ते तपो वद..
विषमस्थं यत्र विप्रं म्रियमाणमुपेक्षसि.. 25.45 ..
1.4.m: We are worthy of honour even to Rudra! Tell me, what kind of austerity is yours, / wherein you neglect a brahmin who is in peril and dying?'

1.4.s:
avajā nāsi viprāṃstvaṃ tacchīghraṃ vraja darśanāt..
yadi vā manyase pūjyāṃstato'bhyuddhara nānyathā.. 25.46 ..
1.4.d:
अवजा नासि विप्रांस्त्वं तच्छीघ्रं व्रज दर्शनात्..
यदि वा मन्यसे पूज्यांस्ततोऽभ्युद्धर नान्यथा.. 25.46 ..
1.4.m: You despise brahmins; therefore go quickly from my sight! / Or if you consider [them] worthy of worship, then rescue me, not otherwise."

1.4.s:
tato vicārya bahudhā iti ceti ca sā śubhā..
viprasyoddharaṇaṃ sarvadharmebhyo'manyatādhikam.. 25.47 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विचार्य बहुधा इति चेति च सा शुभा..
विप्रस्योद्धरणं सर्वधर्मेभ्योऽमन्यताधिकम्.. 25.47 ..
1.4.m: Then, having reflected much, "Shall I do this or that?", the auspicious lady / considered rescuing a brahmin to be superior to all other duties.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sā dakṣiṇaṃ dattvā karaṃ taṃ projjahāra ca..
naraṃ nārī proddharati sajjantaṃ bhavavāridhau..
etatsandarśanārthāya tathā cakre bhavodbhavaḥ.. 25.48 ..
1.4.d:
ततः सा दक्षिणं दत्त्वा करं तं प्रोज्जहार च..
नरं नारी प्रोद्धरति सज्जन्तं भववारिधौ..
एतत्सन्दर्शनार्थाय तथा चक्रे भवोद्भवः.. 25.48 ..
1.4.m: Then she offered her right hand and pulled him out. / A woman pulls out a man who is sinking in the ocean of worldly existence— / to show this, Śiva, the source of becoming, acted in such a manner.

1.4.s: proddhṛtya ca tataḥ snātvā baddhva yogāsanaṃ sthitā.. 25.49 ..
1.4.d: प्रोद्धृत्य च ततः स्नात्वा बद्ध्व योगासनं स्थिता.. 25.49 ..
1.4.m: Having pulled him out and then bathed, she sat fixing herself in a yoga posture.

1.4.s:
brahmacārī tataḥ prāha prahasankimidaṃ śubhe..
kartukāmāsi tanvaṃgi dṛḍhayogāsanasthitā.. 25.50 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मचारी ततः प्राह प्रहसन्किमिदं शुभे..
कर्तुकामासि तन्वंगि दृढयोगासनस्थिता.. 25.50 ..
1.4.m: Then the brahmacārin said, laughing: "What is this, auspicious lady? / What do you wish to do, slender-limbed one, seated firmly in a yoga posture?"

1.4.s:
devī prāha jvālayiṣye śarīraṃ yogavahninā..
mahādevakṛtamatirucchiṣṭāhaṃ yato'bhavam.. 25.51 ..
1.4.d:
देवी प्राह ज्वालयिष्ये शरीरं योगवह्निना..
महादेवकृतमतिरुच्छिष्टाहं यतोऽभवम्.. 25.51 ..
1.4.m: The goddess said: "I will burn this body with the fire of yoga, / for I, having dedicated my mind to Mahādeva, have become defiled [by touching another]."

1.4.s:
brahmacārī tataḥ prāha kāścidbrāhmaṇakāmyayā..
kṛtvā vārtāstataḥ svīyamabhīṣṭaṃ kuru pārvati.. 25.52 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मचारी ततः प्राह काश्चिद्ब्राह्मणकाम्यया..
कृत्वा वार्तास्ततः स्वीयमभीष्टं कुरु पार्वति.. 25.52 ..
1.4.m: Then the brahmacārin said: "Out of regard for a brahmin's wish, / converse for a moment, and then do what you desire, O Pārvatī.

1.4.s:
nopahanyāṃ kadācidvi sādhubhirviprakāmanā..
dharmamenaṃ manyase cenmuhūrtaṃ brūhi pārvati.. 25.53 ..
1.4.d:
नोपहन्यां कदाचिद्वि साधुभिर्विप्रकामना..
धर्ममेनं मन्यसे चेन्मुहूर्तं ब्रूहि पार्वति.. 25.53 ..
1.4.m: A wish of a brahmin should never be thwarted by the virtuous. / If you consider this to be righteousness, speak with me for a moment, O Pārvatī."

1.4.s:
devī prāha brūhi vipra muhūrtaṃ saṃsthitā tvaham..
tataḥ svayaṃ vratī prāha devīṃ tāṃ svasakhīyutām.. 25.54 ..
1.4.d:
देवी प्राह ब्रूहि विप्र मुहूर्तं संस्थिता त्वहम्..
ततः स्वयं व्रती प्राह देवीं तां स्वसखीयुताम्.. 25.54 ..
1.4.m: The goddess said: "Speak, brahmin; I will stay for a moment." / Then the celibate student himself addressed that goddess who was accompanied by her friends:

1.4.s:
kimarthamiti rambhoru nave vayasi duścaram..
tapastvayā samārabdhaṃ nānurūpaṃ vibhāti me.. 25.55 ..
1.4.d:
किमर्थमिति रम्भोरु नवे वयसि दुश्चरम्..
तपस्त्वया समारब्धं नानुरूपं विभाति मे.. 25.55 ..
1.4.m: "Why, O woman of lovely thighs, at this young age, has this austerity, / so difficult to perform, been undertaken by you? It does not seem fitting to me.

1.4.s:
durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ girirājagṛhe'dhunā..
bhogāṃśca durlabhāndevi tyaktvā kiṃ kliśyate vapuḥ.. 25.56 ..
1.4.d:
दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं गिरिराजगृहेऽधुना..
भोगांश्च दुर्लभान्देवि त्यक्त्वा किं क्लिश्यते वपुः.. 25.56 ..
1.4.m: Having obtained a rare human birth in the palace of the king of mountains, / and having abandoned hard-to-obtain pleasures, O goddess, why is your body tormented?

1.4.s:
atīva dūye vīkṣya tvāṃ sukumāratarākṛtim..
atyugratapasā kliṣṭā padminīva himarditā.. 25.57 ..
1.4.d:
अतीव दूये वीक्ष्य त्वां सुकुमारतराकृतिम्..
अत्युग्रतपसा क्लिष्टा पद्मिनीव हिमर्दिता.. 25.57 ..
1.4.m: I am exceedingly grieved seeing you, who have such a delicate form, / distressed by severe austerity like a lotus afflicted by frost.

1.4.s:
idaṃ cānyattva śubhe śiraso rogadaṃ mama..
yaddehaṃ tyaktukāmā tvaṃ prabuddhā nāsi bālike.. 25.58 ..
1.4.d:
इदं चान्यत्त्व शुभे शिरसो रोगदं मम..
यद्देहं त्यक्तुकामा त्वं प्रबुद्धा नासि बालिके.. 25.58 ..
1.4.m: And here is another thing, O auspicious one, that gives a headache to my head: / that you wish to abandon your body! Are you not awake to reason, young girl?

1.4.s:
vāmaḥ kāmo manuṣyeṣu satyametadvaco yataḥ..
spṛhaṇīyāsi sarveṣāmevaṃ pīḍayase vapuḥ.. 25.59 ..
1.4.d:
वामः कामो मनुष्येषु सत्यमेतद्वचो यतः..
स्पृहणीयासि सर्वेषामेवं पीडयसे वपुः.. 25.59 ..
1.4.m: Adverse indeed is desire among humans; for true is this saying, / since you, who are longed for by all, thus torment your body.

1.4.s:
avijñātānvayo nagnaḥ śūlī bhūtagaṇādhipaḥ..
śmaśānanilayo bhasmoddhūlano vṛṣavāhanaḥ.. 25.60 ..
1.4.d:
अविज्ञातान्वयो नग्नः शूली भूतगणाधिपः..
श्मशाननिलयो भस्मोद्धूलनो वृषवाहनः.. 25.60 ..
1.4.m: He has an unknown lineage, is naked, bears a trident, is lord of the spirit-hordes, / has his abode in cremation grounds, is smeared with ashes, and rides a bull.

1.4.s:
gajājino dvijihvādyalaṃkṛtāṃgo jaṭādharaḥ..
virūpākṣaḥ kathaṃkāraṃ nirguṇaḥ syāttavocitaḥ.. 25.61 ..
1.4.d:
गजाजिनो द्विजिह्वाद्यलंकृतांगो जटाधरः..
विरूपाक्षः कथंकारं निर्गुणः स्यात्तवोचितः.. 25.61 ..
1.4.m: He wears an elephant skin, has limbs adorned with snakes and the like, wears matted locks, / has deformed eyes, and is without qualities; how could he be suitable for you?

1.4.s:
guṇā ye kulaśīlādya varāṇāmuditā budhaiḥ..
teṣāmeko'pi naivāsti tasmiṃstannocitaḥ sa te.. 25.62 ..
1.4.d:
गुणा ये कुलशीलाद्य वराणामुदिता बुधैः..
तेषामेकोऽपि नैवास्ति तस्मिंस्तन्नोचितः स ते.. 25.62 ..
1.4.m: Whatever virtues such as noble birth and good conduct are declared by the wise for bridegrooms— / not even one of them exists in him; therefore, he is not suitable for you.

1.4.s:
śocanīyatamā pūrvamāsītpārvati kaumudī..
tvaṃ saṃvṛttā dvitīyāsi tasyāstatsaṃgamāśayā.. 25.63 ..
1.4.d:
शोचनीयतमा पूर्वमासीत्पार्वति कौमुदी..
त्वं संवृत्ता द्वितीयासि तस्यास्तत्संगमाशया.. 25.63 ..
1.4.m: Formerly, moonlight was most pitiable [for choosing him], O Pārvatī; / you have become the second, on account of your hope for union with him.

1.4.s:
tapodhanāḥ sarvasamā vayaṃ yadyapi pārvati..
dunotyeva tavāraṃbhaḥ śūlāyāṃ yūpasatkriyā.. 25.64 ..
1.4.d:
तपोधनाः सर्वसमा वयं यद्यपि पार्वति..
दुनोत्येव तवारंभः शूलायां यूपसत्क्रिया.. 25.64 ..
1.4.m: Although we whose wealth is austerity view all equally, O Pārvatī, / your undertaking indeed pains me, like offering honor to a sacrificial post upon a stake of impalement.

1.4.s:
vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ vāsaḥ śmaśāne pāṇisaṃgrahaḥ..
savyālapāṇinā kṣaumagajatvagbaṃdhanaḥ katham.. 25.65 ..
1.4.d:
वृषभारोहणं वासः श्मशाने पाणिसंग्रहः..
सव्यालपाणिना क्षौमगजत्वग्बंधनः कथम्.. 25.65 ..
1.4.m: Riding a bull, living in a cremation ground, the taking of your hand / by a hand encircled with serpents, the knotting of a silken garment with an elephant skin—how [can that be]?

1.4.s:
janahāsyakaraṃ sarvaṃ tvayārabdhamasāṃpratam..
strībhāvādbhūtisaṃparkkaḥ kathaṃ cābhimatastava.. 25.66 ..
1.4.d:
जनहास्यकरं सर्वं त्वयारब्धमसांप्रतम्..
स्त्रीभावाद्भूतिसंपर्क्कः कथं चाभिमतस्तव.. 25.66 ..
1.4.m: All that you have begun is improper, causing laughter among people. / And how is contact with ashes pleasing to you, being of a woman's nature?

1.4.s:
nivartaya manastasmādasmātsarvavirodhinaḥ..
mṛgākṣi madanārātermarkaṭākṣasya prārthanāt.. 25.67 ..
1.4.d:
निवर्तय मनस्तस्मादस्मात्सर्वविरोधिनः..
मृगाक्षि मदनारातेर्मर्कटाक्षस्य प्रार्थनात्.. 25.67 ..
1.4.m: Turn your mind away from that opponent of all, / from praying for the foe of Madana who has monkey-like eyes, O deer-eyed lady!"

1.4.s:
viruddhavādinaṃ caivaṃ brahmacāriṇamīśvaram..
niśamya kupitā devī prāha vācā sagadgadam.. 25.68 ..
1.4.d:
विरुद्धवादिनं चैवं ब्रह्मचारिणमीश्वरम्..
निशम्य कुपिता देवी प्राह वाचा सगद्गदम्.. 25.68 ..
1.4.m: Hearing the brahmacārin, who was Īśvara, speaking such contrary words, / the goddess was enraged and said in a voice choked with emotion:

1.4.s:
mā mā brāhmaṇa bhāṣiṣṭhā viruddhamiti śaṃkare..
mahattamo yāti pumāndevadevasya niṃdayā.. 25.69 ..
1.4.d:
मा मा ब्राह्मण भाषिष्ठा विरुद्धमिति शंकरे..
महत्तमो याति पुमान्देवदेवस्य निंदया.. 25.69 ..
1.4.m: "Do not, do not, O brahmin, speak such contrary things about Śaṃkara! / A man enters the deepest darkness by reviling the God of gods.

1.4.s:
na samyagabhijānāsi tasya devasya ceṣṭitam..
śrṛṇu brāhmaṇa tvaṃ pāpādyathāsmātparimucyase.. 25.70 ..
1.4.d:
न सम्यगभिजानासि तस्य देवस्य चेष्टितम्..
श्रृणु ब्राह्मण त्वं पापाद्यथास्मात्परिमुच्यसे.. 25.70 ..
1.4.m: You do not properly understand the deeds of that God. / Listen, O brahmin, so that you may be freed from this sin.

1.4.s:
sa ādiḥ sarvajagatāṃ kosya vedānvayaṃ tataḥ..
sarvaṃ jagadyasya rūpaṃ digvāsāḥ kīrtyate tataḥ.. 25.71 ..
1.4.d:
स आदिः सर्वजगतां कोस्य वेदान्वयं ततः..
सर्वं जगद्यस्य रूपं दिग्वासाः कीर्त्यते ततः.. 25.71 ..
1.4.m: He is the beginning of all the worlds; who, then, knows his lineage? / He whose form is the entire universe is therefore called naked (clothed in space).

1.4.s:
guṇatrayamayaṃ śūlaṃ śūlī yasmādbibhārte saḥ..
abaddhāḥ sarvato muktā bhūtā eva ca tatpatiḥ.. 25.72 ..
1.4.d:
गुणत्रयमयं शूलं शूली यस्माद्बिभार्ते सः..
अबद्धाः सर्वतो मुक्ता भूता एव च तत्पतिः.. 25.72 ..
1.4.m: Because he bears the trident made of the three guṇas, he is the trident-bearer. / The beings (bhūtas) are unattached and free on all sides, and he is their lord.

1.4.s:
śmaśānaṃ cāpi saṃsārastadvāsī kṛpayārthinām..
bhūtayaḥ kathitā bhūtistāṃ bibharti sa bhūtibhṛt.. 25.73 ..
1.4.d:
श्मशानं चापि संसारस्तद्वासी कृपयार्थिनाम्..
भूतयः कथिता भूतिस्तां बिभर्ति स भूतिभृत्.. 25.73 ..
1.4.m: The cremation ground is the realm of transmigration; he dwells there out of compassion for supplicants. / Prosperity (bhūti) is proclaimed as [his] splendour (bhūti); he bears it, [hence] he is the bearer of ashes/prosperity.

1.4.s:
vṛṣo dharma iti proktastamārūḍhastato vṛṣī..
sarpāśca doṣāḥ krodhādyāstānbibharti jaganmayaḥ.. 25.74 ..
1.4.d:
वृषो धर्म इति प्रोक्तस्तमारूढस्ततो वृषी..
सर्पाश्च दोषाः क्रोधाद्यास्तान्बिभर्ति जगन्मयः.. 25.74 ..
1.4.m: The bull is declared to be righteousness (dharma); he has mounted it, so he is the rider of the bull. / And the serpents are defects such as wrath and the like; he who is made of the universe bears them.

1.4.s:
nānāvidhāḥ karmayogā jaṭārūpā bibharti saḥ..
vedatrayī trinetrāṇi tripuraṃ triguṇaṃ vapuḥ.. 25.75 ..
1.4.d:
नानाविधाः कर्मयोगा जटारूपा बिभर्ति सः..
वेदत्रयी त्रिनेत्राणि त्रिपुरं त्रिगुणं वपुः.. 25.75 ..
1.4.m: He bears the various yogas of action in the form of matted locks. / The triad of Vedas are his three eyes; the three worlds (Tripura) are his body composed of the three guṇas.

1.4.s:
bhasmīkaroti taddevastripuradhnastataḥ smṛtaḥ..
evaṃvidha mahādevaṃ vidurye sūkṣmadarśinaḥ.. 25.76 ..
1.4.d:
भस्मीकरोति तद्देवस्त्रिपुरध्नस्ततः स्मृतः..
एवंविध महादेवं विदुर्ये सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः.. 25.76 ..
1.4.m: The God reduces it to ashes, hence he is remembered as the destroyer of Tripura. / Those who see subtler realities know Mahādeva to be such.

1.4.s:
kathaṃkāraṃ hi te nāma bhajaṃte naiva taṃ haram..
atha vā bhītasaṃsārāḥ sarve vipra yato janāḥ.. 25.77 ..
1.4.d:
कथंकारं हि ते नाम भजंते नैव तं हरम्..
अथ वा भीतसंसाराः सर्वे विप्र यतो जनाः.. 25.77 ..
1.4.m: How indeed would they not worship that Hara? / Furthermore, O brahmin, since all people are fearful of transmigration,

1.4.s:
vimṛśya kurvate sarvaṃ vimṛśyaitanmayā kṛtam..
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāstu tvamapyenaṃ prapūjaya.. 25.78 ..
1.4.d:
विमृश्य कुर्वते सर्वं विमृश्यैतन्मया कृतम्..
शुभं वाप्यशुभं वास्तु त्वमप्येनं प्रपूजय.. 25.78 ..
1.4.m: they do everything after deliberate reflection; after deliberate reflection this was done by me. / Whether it brings good fortune or misfortune, you too should worship him!"

1.4.s:
iti bruvaṃtyāṃ tasyāṃ tu kiṃcitprasphuritādharam..
vijñāya tāṃ sakhīmāha kimapyeṣa vivakṣukaḥ.. 25.79 ..
1.4.d:
इति ब्रुवंत्यां तस्यां तु किंचित्प्रस्फुरिताधरम्..
विज्ञाय तां सखीमाह किमप्येष विवक्षुकः.. 25.79 ..
1.4.m: While she was speaking thus, noticing that his lower lip trembled slightly, / she said to her friend: "He wishes to say something else.

1.4.s:
vāryatāmiti vipro'yaṃ mahaddūṣaṇabāṣakaḥ..
na kevalaṃ pāpabhāgī śrotā vai syānna saṃśayaḥ.. 25.80 ..
1.4.d:
वार्यतामिति विप्रोऽयं महद्दूषणबाषकः..
न केवलं पापभागी श्रोता वै स्यान्न संशयः.. 25.80 ..
1.4.m: Let this brahmin, who speaks such great censures, be restrained! / Not only the speaker, but the listener too indeed becomes a sharer in sin, without a doubt.

1.4.s:
atha vā kiṃ ca naḥ kāryaṃ vādena saha brāhmaṇaiḥ..
karṇau pidhāya yāsyāmo yathā yaḥ syāttatāstu saḥ.. 25.81 ..
1.4.d:
अथ वा किं च नः कार्यं वादेन सह ब्राह्मणैः..
कर्णौ पिधाय यास्यामो यथा यः स्यात्ततास्तु सः.. 25.81 ..
1.4.m: Or rather, what business do we have with a debate with brahmins? / Covering our ears, let us depart; let him be as he is."

1.4.s:
ityuktvotthāya gacchaṃtyāṃ pidhāya śravaṇāvubhau..
svarūpaṃ samupāśritya jagṛhe vasanaṃ haraḥ.. 25.82 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय गच्छंत्यां पिधाय श्रवणावुभौ..
स्वरूपं समुपाश्रित्य जगृहे वसनं हरः.. 25.82 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, as she arose and walked away covering both ears, / Hara, assuming his own form, seized her garment.

1.4.s:
tato nirīkṣya taṃ devaṃ saṃbhrāṃtā parameśvarī..
praṇipatya maheśānaṃ tuṣṭāvāvanatā umā.. 25.83 ..
1.4.d:
ततो निरीक्ष्य तं देवं संभ्रांता परमेश्वरी..
प्रणिपत्य महेशानं तुष्टावावनता उमा.. 25.83 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing that God, the supreme goddess was bewildered; / bowing low, Umā prostrated before the Great Lord and praised him.

1.4.s:
prāha tāṃ ca mahādevo dāso'smi tava śobhane..
tapodravyeṇa krītaśca samādiśa yathepsitam.. 25.84 ..
1.4.d:
प्राह तां च महादेवो दासोऽस्मि तव शोभने..
तपोद्रव्येण क्रीतश्च समादिश यथेप्सितम्.. 25.84 ..
1.4.m: And Mahādeva said to her: "I am your servant, O beautiful lady, / purchased by the wealth of your austerity; command me as you desire."

1.4.s:
..devyuvāca..
manasastvaṃ prabhuḥ śaṃbho dattaṃ tacca mayā tava..
vapuṣaḥ pitarāvīśau tau sammānayitumarhasi.. 25.85 ..
1.4.d:
..देव्युवाच..
मनसस्त्वं प्रभुः शंभो दत्तं तच्च मया तव..
वपुषः पितरावीशौ तौ सम्मानयितुमर्हसि.. 25.85 ..
1.4.m: The goddess said: / "You are the master of my mind, O Śambhu, and that has been given by me to you. / My parents are masters of my body; it is fitting that you honour them."

1.4.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
pitrā hi te parijñātaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ rūpaśālinīm..
bālāṃ svayaṃvaraṃ putrī mahaṃ dāsyāmi nānyathā.. 25.86 ..
1.4.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
पित्रा हि ते परिज्ञातं दृष्ट्वा त्वां रूपशालिनीम्..
बालां स्वयंवरं पुत्री महं दास्यामि नान्यथा.. 25.86 ..
1.4.m: Mahādeva said: / "Seeing you endowed with beauty while still a young girl, your father decided: / 'I shall give my daughter in a svayaṃvara, not otherwise.'

1.4.s:
tattasya sarvamevāstu vacanaṃ tvaṃ himācalam..
svayaṃvarārthaṃ suśroṇi preraya tvāṃ vṛṇe tataḥ.. 25.87 ..
1.4.d:
तत्तस्य सर्वमेवास्तु वचनं त्वं हिमाचलम्..
स्वयंवरार्थं सुश्रोणि प्रेरय त्वां वृणे ततः.. 25.87 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, let all his words be fulfilled. O fair-hipped lady, / urge Himācala toward a svayaṃvara; then I shall choose you."

1.4.s:
ityuktvā tāṃ mahādevaḥ śuciḥ śuciṣado vibhuḥ..
jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ svapuraṃ prayayau ca sā.. 25.88 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तां महादेवः शुचिः शुचिषदो विभुः..
जगामेष्टं तदा देशं स्वपुरं प्रययौ च सा.. 25.88 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus to her, Mahādeva, pure, dwelling in purity, the all-pervading lord, / went to his desired abode, and she returned to her own city.

1.4.s: dṛṣṭvā devīṃ tadā hṛṣṭo menayā sahito'calaḥ.. 25.89 ..
1.4.d: दृष्ट्वा देवीं तदा हृष्टो मेनया सहितोऽचलः.. 25.89 ..
1.4.m: Seeing the goddess then, the mountain [Himavat], together with Menā, was filled with joy.

1.4.s:
āliṃgyāghrāya papraccha sarvaṃ sā ca nyavedayat..
duhiturdevadevena ājñaptaṃ tu himācalaḥ.. 25.90 ..
1.4.d:
आलिंग्याघ्राय पप्रच्छ सर्वं सा च न्यवेदयत्..
दुहितुर्देवदेवेन आज्ञप्तं तु हिमाचलः.. 25.90 ..
1.4.m: Embracing and smelling [her head], he questioned her, and she reported everything / which the God of Gods had commanded concerning his daughter. Then the Himālaya,

1.4.s:
svayaṃvaraṃ pramuditaḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat..
aśvino dvādaśādityā gandharvaruḍoragāḥ.. 25.91 ..
1.4.d:
स्वयंवरं प्रमुदितः सर्वलोकेष्वघोषयत्..
अश्विनो द्वादशादित्या गन्धर्वरुडोरगाः.. 25.91 ..
1.4.m: greatly delighted, proclaimed a svayaṃvara throughout all the worlds. / The two Aśvins, the twelve Ādityas, the Gandharvas, the Garuḍas, and the Uragas,

1.4.s:
yakṣāḥ siddhāstathā sādhyā daityāḥ kiṃpuruṣā nagāḥ..
samudrādyāśca ye kecittrailokyapravarāsca ye.. 25.92 ..
1.4.d:
यक्षाः सिद्धास्तथा साध्या दैत्याः किंपुरुषा नगाः..
समुद्राद्याश्च ये केचित्त्रैलोक्यप्रवरास्च ये.. 25.92 ..
1.4.m: the Yakṣas, the Siddhas, likewise the Sādhyas, the Daityas, the Kiṃpuruṣas, the mountains, / the oceans and others, whoever were the foremost in the three worlds,

1.4.s:
trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatāni ca..
trayastriṃśacca ye devāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ.. 25.93 ..
1.4.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि त्रयस्त्रिंशच्छतानि च..
त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च ये देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च कोटयः.. 25.93 ..
1.4.m: the thirty-three thousand, the thirty-three hundred, / the thirty-three gods, and the thirty-three crores,

1.4.s:
jagmurgirīndraputryāstu svayaṃvaramanuttamam..
āmaṃtritastathā viṣṇurmerumāha hasanniva.. 25.94 ..
1.4.d:
जग्मुर्गिरीन्द्रपुत्र्यास्तु स्वयंवरमनुत्तमम्..
आमंत्रितस्तथा विष्णुर्मेरुमाह हसन्निव.. 25.94 ..
1.4.m: went to the matchless svayaṃvara of the daughter of the king of mountains. / Likewise invited, Viṣṇu spoke to Meru as if smiling:

1.4.s:
tātāsmākaṃ ca sā devī mero gaccha namāmi tām..
atha śailasutā devī haimamāruhya śobhanam.. 25.95 ..
1.4.d:
तातास्माकं च सा देवी मेरो गच्छ नमामि ताम्..
अथ शैलसुता देवी हैममारुह्य शोभनम्.. 25.95 ..
1.4.m: “O father, that goddess is our mother too. O Meru, go; I bow to her.” / Then the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, having mounted a splendid,

1.4.s:
vimānaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam..
apsarobhiḥ pranṛtyadbhiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā.. 25.96 ..
1.4.d:
विमानं सर्वतोभद्रं सर्वरत्नैरलंकृतम्..
अप्सरोभिः प्रनृत्यद्भिः सर्वाभरणभूषिता.. 25.96 ..
1.4.m: golden vimāna, auspicious on all sides and adorned with all kinds of jewels, / while apsarases danced, decorated with every ornament,

1.4.s:
gaṃdharvasaṃghairvividhaiḥ kiṃnaraiśca suśobhanaiḥ..
baṃdibhiḥ stūyamānā ca vīrakāṃsyadharā sthitā.. 25.97 ..
1.4.d:
गंधर्वसंघैर्विविधैः किंनरैश्च सुशोभनैः..
बंदिभिः स्तूयमाना च वीरकांस्यधरा स्थिता.. 25.97 ..
1.4.m: being praised by various hosts of Gandharvas, by highly radiant Kiṃnaras, / and by bards, remained standing, holding a heroic gong.

1.4.s:
sitātapatraratnāṃśumiśritaṃ cāvahattadā..
śālinī nāma pārvatyāḥ saṃdhyāpūrṇedumaṃḍalā.. 25.98 ..
1.4.d:
सितातपत्ररत्नांशुमिश्रितं चावहत्तदा..
शालिनी नाम पार्वत्याः संध्यापूर्णेदुमंडला.. 25.98 ..
1.4.m: Then [an attendant] named Śālinī held for Pārvatī [an umbrella] / blended with the rays of jewels on a white parasol, resembling the full moon’s disc at twilight.

1.4.s:
cāmarāsaktahastābhirdivyastrībhiśca saṃvṛtā..
mālāṃ pragṛhya sā tasthau suradrumasamudbhavām.. 25.99 ..
1.4.d:
चामरासक्तहस्ताभिर्दिव्यस्त्रीभिश्च संवृता..
मालां प्रगृह्य सा तस्थौ सुरद्रुमसमुद्भवाम्.. 25.99 ..
1.4.m: Surrounded by celestial women whose hands were busy with chowries, / holding a garland born of a celestial tree, she stood.

1.4.s:
evaṃ tasyāṃ sthitāyāṃ tu sthite lokatraye tadā..
śiśurbhūtvā mahādevaḥ krīḍārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ.. 25.100 ..
1.4.d:
एवं तस्यां स्थितायां तु स्थिते लोकत्रये तदा..
शिशुर्भूत्वा महादेवः क्रीडार्थं वृषभध्वजः.. 25.100 ..
1.4.m: When she was standing thus, and the three worlds were standing [assembled] then, / Mahādeva, whose emblem is the bull, having become a child for sport,

1.4.s:
utsaṃgatalasaṃgupto babhūva bhagavānbhavaḥ..
jayeti yatpadaṃ khyātaṃ tasya satyārthamīśvaram.. 25.101 ..
1.4.d:
उत्संगतलसंगुप्तो बभूव भगवान्भवः..
जयेति यत्पदं ख्यातं तस्य सत्यार्थमीश्वरम्.. 25.101 ..
1.4.m: the blessed Bhava hid himself upon the lap [of the goddess]. / In order to make true the word “Victory” famous as his title, Īśvara [did so].

1.4.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā śiśuṃ devāstasya utsaṃgavartinaḥ..
koyamatreti saṃmaṃtrya cukruśurbhṛśaroṣitāḥ.. 25.102 ..
1.4.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा शिशुं देवास्तस्य उत्संगवर्तिनः..
कोयमत्रेति संमंत्र्य चुक्रुशुर्भृशरोषिताः.. 25.102 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing the child resting upon her lap, / the gods deliberated, “Who is this here?”, and shouted, exceedingly enraged.

1.4.s:
vajramāhārayattasya bāhumudyamya vṛtrahā..
sa bāhurudyatastasya tathaiva samatiṣṭhata.. 25.103 ..
1.4.d:
वज्रमाहारयत्तस्य बाहुमुद्यम्य वृत्रहा..
स बाहुरुद्यतस्तस्य तथैव समतिष्ठत.. 25.103 ..
1.4.m: Raising his arm, the slayer of Vṛtra brought forth his thunderbolt against him. / His arm, once raised, remained frozen just as it was.

1.4.s:
staṃbhitaḥ śiśurūpeṇa devadevena līlayā..
vajraṃ kṣeptuṃ na śaknoti bāhuṃ cālayituṃ tadā.. 25.104 ..
1.4.d:
स्तंभितः शिशुरूपेण देवदेवेन लीलया..
वज्रं क्षेप्तुं न शक्नोति बाहुं चालयितुं तदा.. 25.104 ..
1.4.m: Paralysed in sport by the God of Gods in the form of a child, / he was unable then to cast the thunderbolt or to move his arm.

1.4.s:
vahniḥ śaktiṃ tadā kṣeptuṃ na śaśāka tathotthitaḥ..
yamo'pi daṃḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca nirṛtistaṃ śiśuṃ prati.. 25.105 ..
1.4.d:
वह्निः शक्तिं तदा क्षेप्तुं न शशाक तथोत्थितः..
यमोऽपि दंडं खड्गं च निरृतिस्तं शिशुं प्रति.. 25.105 ..
1.4.m: Fire, having thus arisen, was unable then to throw his spear; / Yama too [was unable to wield] his staff, and Nirṛti his sword, against that child.

1.4.s:
pāśaṃ ca varuṇo rājā dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samīraṇaḥ..
somo guḍaṃ dhaneśaśca gadāṃ sumahatīṃ dṛḍhām.. 25.106 ..
1.4.d:
पाशं च वरुणो राजा ध्वजयष्टिं समीरणः..
सोमो गुडं धनेशश्च गदां सुमहतीं दृढाम्.. 25.106 ..
1.4.m: King Varuṇa his noose, the Wind his flag-staff, / Soma his club, and the Lord of Wealth his massive and sturdy mace;

1.4.s:
nānāyudhāni cādityā musalaṃ vasavastathā..
mahāghorāṇi śastrāṇi tārakādyāśca dānavāḥ.. 25.107 ..
1.4.d:
नानायुधानि चादित्या मुसलं वसवस्तथा..
महाघोराणि शस्त्राणि तारकाद्याश्च दानवाः.. 25.107 ..
1.4.m: the Ādityas their various weapons, and the Vasus their pestle, / and the Dānavas led by Tāraka their extremely dreadful missiles,

1.4.s:
staṃbhitā devadevena tathānye bhuvaneṣu ye..
pūṣā daṃtāndaśandaṃrbālamaikṣata mohitaḥ.. 25.108 ..
1.4.d:
स्तंभिता देवदेवेन तथान्ये भुवनेषु ये..
पूषा दंतान्दशन्दंर्बालमैक्षत मोहितः.. 25.108 ..
1.4.m: as well as the others who were in the worlds, were paralysed by the God of Gods. / Pūṣan, biting his teeth and bewildered, stared with malice at the boy;

1.4.s:
tasyāpi daśanāḥ peturdṛṣṭamātrasya śaṃbhunā..
bhagaśca netre vikṛte cakāra sphuṭite ca te.. 25.109 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यापि दशनाः पेतुर्दृष्टमात्रस्य शंभुना..
भगश्च नेत्रे विकृते चकार स्फुटिते च ते.. 25.109 ..
1.4.m: his teeth also fell out the moment he was looked at by Śambhu. / And Bhaga contorted his eyes, and they burst open.

1.4.s:
balaṃ tejaśca yogāṃśca sarveṣāṃ jagṛhe prabhuḥ..
atha teṣu sthiteṣveva manyumatsu sureṣvapi.. 25.110 ..
1.4.d:
बलं तेजश्च योगांश्च सर्वेषां जगृहे प्रभुः..
अथ तेषु स्थितेष्वेव मन्युमत्सु सुरेष्वपि.. 25.110 ..
1.4.m: The Lord took away the strength, the fiery splendour, and the powers of them all. / Then, while those wrathful gods remained standing thus,

1.4.s:
brahmā dhyānamupāśritya bubodha haraceṣṭitam..
so'bhigamya mahādevaṃ tuṣṭāva prayato vidhiḥ.. 25.111 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मा ध्यानमुपाश्रित्य बुबोध हरचेष्टितम्..
सोऽभिगम्य महादेवं तुष्टाव प्रयतो विधिः.. 25.111 ..
1.4.m: Brahmā, resorting to meditation, understood the act of Hara. / Approaching Mahādeva, Brahmā, devoutly restrained, praised him

1.4.s:
paurāṇaiḥ sāmasaṃgītairvedikairguhyanāmabhiḥ..
namastubhyaṃ mahādeva mahādevyai namonamaḥ.. 25.112 ..
1.4.d:
पौराणैः सामसंगीतैर्वेदिकैर्गुह्यनामभिः..
नमस्तुभ्यं महादेव महादेव्यै नमोनमः.. 25.112 ..
1.4.m: with secret names sung in Sāmans, from the Purāṇas, and Vedic: / “Salutation to you, Mahādeva! Salutation, salutation to the Great Goddess!

1.4.s:
prasādāttava buddhyādirjagadetatpravartate..
mūḍhāśca devatāḥ sarvā nainaṃ budhyata śaṃkaram.. 25.113 ..
1.4.d:
प्रसादात्तव बुद्ध्यादिर्जगदेतत्प्रवर्तते..
मूढाश्च देवताः सर्वा नैनं बुध्यत शंकरम्.. 25.113 ..
1.4.m: Through your grace this world, beginning with intellect, proceeds. / And all the deities are bewildered; they did not recognise this Śaṃkara,

1.4.s:
mahādevamihāyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam..
gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ yadi jīvitumicchata.. 25.114 ..
1.4.d:
महादेवमिहायातं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्..
गच्छध्वं शरणं शीघ्रं यदि जीवितुमिच्छत.. 25.114 ..
1.4.m: Mahādeva, who has arrived here, worshipped by all the gods! / Quickly go for refuge, if you wish to live!”

1.4.s:
tataḥ saṃbhrama saṃpannāstuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥ..
namonamo mahādeva pāhipāhi jagatpate.. 25.115 ..
1.4.d:
ततः संभ्रम संपन्नास्तुष्टुवुः प्रणताः सुराः..
नमोनमो महादेव पाहिपाहि जगत्पते.. 25.115 ..
1.4.m: Then, filled with agitation, bowing down, the gods praised [him]: / “Salutation, salutation, Mahādeva! Protect us, protect us, Lord of the Universe!

1.4.s:
durācārānbhavānasmānātmadrohaparāyaṇān..
aho paśyata no mauḍhyaṃ jānaṃtastava bhāvinīm.. 25.116 ..
1.4.d:
दुराचारान्भवानस्मानात्मद्रोहपरायणान्..
अहो पश्यत नो मौढ्यं जानंतस्तव भाविनीम्.. 25.116 ..
1.4.m: Forgive us who are wicked in conduct and devoted to hostility against our own self! / Ah, behold our foolishness! Although knowing your future

1.4.s:
bhāryāmumāṃ mahādevīṃ tathāpyatra samāgatāḥ..
yuktametadyadasmākaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhyeta cāsuraiḥ.. 25.117 ..
1.4.d:
भार्यामुमां महादेवीं तथाप्यत्र समागताः..
युक्तमेतद्यदस्माकं राज्यं गृह्येत चासुरैः.. 25.117 ..
1.4.m: wife to be Umā, the Great Goddess, nevertheless we assembled here! / It is proper that our kingdom should be seized by the asuras,

1.4.s:
yeṣāmevaṃvidhābuddhirasmābhiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvidam..
atha vā no na doṣo'sti paśavo hi vayaṃ yataḥ.. 25.118 ..
1.4.d:
येषामेवंविधाबुद्धिरस्माभिः किं कृतं त्विदम्..
अथ वा नो न दोषोऽस्ति पशवो हि वयं यतः.. 25.118 ..
1.4.m: we whose intellect is of such a kind! But what is this that was done by us? / Or rather, there is no fault in us, for we are beasts,

1.4.s:
tvayaiva patinā sarve preritāḥ kurmahe vibho..
īśvaraḥ sarva bhūtānāṃ patistvaṃ parameśvaraḥ.. 25.119 ..
1.4.d:
त्वयैव पतिना सर्वे प्रेरिताः कुर्महे विभो..
ईश्वरः सर्व भूतानां पतिस्त्वं परमेश्वरः.. 25.119 ..
1.4.m: and impelled by you alone as our master, O all-pervading Lord, we act. / You are the Īśvara of all beings, the master, the Parameśvara.

1.4.s:
bhrāmayasyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ yantrārūḍhaṃ svamāyayā..
yena vibhrāmitā mūḍhāḥ samāyātāḥ svayaṃvaram.. 25.120 ..
1.4.d:
भ्रामयस्यखिलं विश्वं यन्त्रारूढं स्वमायया..
येन विभ्रामिता मूढाः समायाताः स्वयंवरम्.. 25.120 ..
1.4.m: Mounted on a mechanical device, you cause the entire universe to revolve through your māyā; / bewildered by which, these fools arrived at the svayaṃvara.

1.4.s:
tasmai paśunāṃ pataye namastubhyaṃ prasīda naḥ..
atha teṣāṃ prasanna'bhūddevadevāstriyaṃbakaḥ.. 25.121 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मै पशुनां पतये नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद नः..
अथ तेषां प्रसन्नऽभूद्देवदेवास्त्रियंबकः.. 25.121 ..
1.4.m: Salutation to you, that Lord of beasts! Be gracious to us!” / Then the three-eyed God of Gods was pleased with them.

1.4.s:
yathāpūrvaṃ cakāraitānsaṃstavādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ..
tārakapramukhā daityāḥ saṃkruddhāstatra procire.. 25.122 ..
1.4.d:
यथापूर्वं चकारैतान्संस्तवाद्ब्रह्मणः प्रभुः..
तारकप्रमुखा दैत्याः संक्रुद्धास्तत्र प्रोचिरे.. 25.122 ..
1.4.m: Due to the eulogy of Brahmā, the Lord restored them as before. / The Daityas headed by Tāraka, enraged, said there:

1.4.s:
koyamaṃga mahādevo na manyāmo vayaṃ ca tam..
tataḥ prahasya bālo'sau huṃkāraṃ līlayā vyadhāt.. 25.123 ..
1.4.d:
कोयमंग महादेवो न मन्यामो वयं च तम्..
ततः प्रहस्य बालोऽसौ हुंकारं लीलया व्यधात्.. 25.123 ..
1.4.m: “O dear ones, who is this Mahādeva? We do not acknowledge him!” / Then, laughing aloud, that boy uttered the sound ‘huṃ’ in sport.

1.4.s:
huṃkāreṇaiva te daityāḥ svameva nagaraṃ gatāḥ..
vismṛtaṃ sakalaṃ teṣāṃ svayaṃvaramukhaṃ ca tat.. 25.124 ..
1.4.d:
हुंकारेणैव ते दैत्याः स्वमेव नगरं गताः..
विस्मृतं सकलं तेषां स्वयंवरमुखं च तत्.. 25.124 ..
1.4.m: Merely by that sound ‘huṃ’, those Daityas went to their own city; / all of that, beginning with the svayaṃvara, was forgotten by them

1.4.s:
mahādevaprabhāvena daityānāṃ ghorakarmaṇām..
evaṃ yasya prabhāvo hi devadaityeṣu phālguna.. 25.125 ..
1.4.d:
महादेवप्रभावेन दैत्यानां घोरकर्मणाम्..
एवं यस्य प्रभावो हि देवदैत्येषु फाल्गुन.. 25.125 ..
1.4.m: through the majesty of Mahādeva, [forgotten] by the Daityas of terrible deeds. / Such indeed is his majesty among gods and Daityas, O Phālguna!

1.4.s:
kathamīśvaravākyārthastasmādanyatra mucyate..
asaṃśayaṃ vimuḍhāste paścāttāpaḥ purā mahān.. 25.126 ..
1.4.d:
कथमीश्वरवाक्यार्थस्तस्मादन्यत्र मुच्यते..
असंशयं विमुढास्ते पश्चात्तापः पुरा महान्.. 25.126 ..
1.4.m: How can the meaning of Īśvara's word be released anywhere other than from him? / Undoubtedly bewildered are they; great will be their remorse hereafter,

1.4.s:
īśvaraṃ bhuvanasyāsya ye bhajaṃte na tryaṃbakam..
tataḥ saṃstūyamānaḥ sa suraiḥ padmabhuvādibhiḥ.. 25.127 ..
1.4.d:
ईश्वरं भुवनस्यास्य ये भजंते न त्र्यंबकम्..
ततः संस्तूयमानः स सुरैः पद्मभुवादिभिः.. 25.127 ..
1.4.m: who do not worship the three-eyed Īśvara of this world! / Then, being praised by the gods headed by the lotus-born [Brahmā],

1.4.s:
vapuścakāra deveśastryaṃbakaḥ paramādbhutam..
tejasā tasya devāste seṃdracaṃdradivākarāḥ.. 25.128 ..
1.4.d:
वपुश्चकार देवेशस्त्र्यंबकः परमाद्भुतम्..
तेजसा तस्य देवास्ते सेंद्रचंद्रदिवाकराः.. 25.128 ..
1.4.m: the three-eyed Lord of Gods assumed a supremely wondrous form. / Because of his fiery splendour, those gods along with Indra, the moon, and the sun,

1.4.s:
sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāśca vasurviśve ca devatāḥ..
sayamāśca sarudrāśca cakṣuraprārthayanprabhum.. 25.129 ..
1.4.d:
सब्रह्मकाः ससाध्याश्च वसुर्विश्वे च देवताः..
सयमाश्च सरुद्राश्च चक्षुरप्रार्थयन्प्रभुम्.. 25.129 ..
1.4.m: accompanied by Brahmā, accompanied by the Sādhyas, the Vasus, the Viśvedevas, / accompanied by Yama, and accompanied by the Rudras, begged the Lord for eye[sight].

1.4.s:
tebhyaḥ paratamaṃ cakṣuḥ svavapurdraṣṭumuttamam..
dadāvambāpatiḥ śarvo bhavānyāścālasya ca.. 25.130 ..
1.4.d:
तेभ्यः परतमं चक्षुः स्ववपुर्द्रष्टुमुत्तमम्..
ददावम्बापतिः शर्वो भवान्याश्चालस्य च.. 25.130 ..
1.4.m: To them, to Bhavānī, and to the Mountain, Śarva, the husband of the Mother, / granted the supreme, excellent eye to see his own form.

1.4.s:
labdhvā rudraprasādena divyaṃ cakṣuranuttamam..
sabrahyakāstadā devāstamapaśyanmaheśvaram.. 25.131 ..
1.4.d:
लब्ध्वा रुद्रप्रसादेन दिव्यं चक्षुरनुत्तमम्..
सब्रह्यकास्तदा देवास्तमपश्यन्महेश्वरम्.. 25.131 ..
1.4.m: Having obtained through Rudra’s grace the matchless divine eye, / the gods along with Brahmā then beheld that Maheśvara.

1.4.s:
tato jaguśca munayaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca khecarāḥ..
mumucuśca tadā nedurdevaduṃdubhayo bhṛśam.. 25.132 ..
1.4.d:
ततो जगुश्च मुनयः पुष्पवृष्टिं च खेचराः..
मुमुचुश्च तदा नेदुर्देवदुंदुभयो भृशम्.. 25.132 ..
1.4.m: Then the munis sang, and the sky-goers released / a shower of flowers; then the celestial drums resounded loudly.

1.4.s:
jagugadharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ..
mumudurgaṇapāḥ sarve mumodāṃbā ca pārvatī.. 25.133 ..
1.4.d:
जगुगधर्वमुख्याश्च ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः..
मुमुदुर्गणपाः सर्वे मुमोदांबा च पार्वती.. 25.133 ..
1.4.m: The chief Gandharvas sang, and hosts of apsarases danced. / All the leaders of the gaṇas rejoiced, and Mother Pārvatī rejoiced.

1.4.s:
brahmādyā menire pūrṇāṃ bhavānīṃ ca girīśvaram..
tasya devī tato hṛṣṭā samakṣaṃ tridivaukasām.. 25.134 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्माद्या मेनिरे पूर्णां भवानीं च गिरीश्वरम्..
तस्य देवी ततो हृष्टा समक्षं त्रिदिवौकसाम्.. 25.134 ..
1.4.m: Brahmā and the others considered Bhavānī and the lord of the mountain fulfilled. / Then the goddess, joyful in the presence of the dwellers of heaven,

1.4.s:
pādayoḥ sthāpayāmāsa mālāṃ divyāṃ sugaṃdhinīm..
sādusādhviti saṃprocya tayā taṃ tatra carcitam.. 25.135 ..
1.4.d:
पादयोः स्थापयामास मालां दिव्यां सुगंधिनीम्..
सादुसाध्विति संप्रोच्य तया तं तत्र चर्चितम्.. 25.135 ..
1.4.m: placed at his feet a divine, fragrant garland. / Saying 'Well done! Well done!', honoured there by her,

1.4.s:
saha devyā namaścakruḥ śirobhirbhūtalāśritaiḥ..
sarve sabrahmakā devā jayeti ca mudā jaguḥ.. 25.136 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye śrīmahādevavaivāhikotsāvarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 25 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
सह देव्या नमश्चक्रुः शिरोभिर्भूतलाश्रितैः..
सर्वे सब्रह्मका देवा जयेति च मुदा जगुः.. 25.136 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्ये श्रीमहादेववैवाहिकोत्सावर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः.. 25 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
all the gods together with Brahmā bowed down with their heads touching the ground to him along with the goddess, / and sang with joy: 'Victory!'
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Wedding Festival of Lord Mahādeva', in the Kumāreśvaramāhātmya of the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa, in the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
atha brahmā mahādevamabhivādya kṛtāṃjaliḥ..
udvāhaḥ kriyatāṃ deva ityuvāca maheśvaram.. 26.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
अथ ब्रह्मा महादेवमभिवाद्य कृतांजलिः..
उद्वाहः क्रियतां देव इत्युवाच महेश्वरम्.. 26.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Then Brahmā, having saluted Mahādeva with joined palms, / spoke to Maheśvara: 'O god, let the marriage be performed.'

1.4.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prāhedaṃ bhagavānharaḥ..
parādhīnā vayaṃ brahmanhimādrestava cāpi yat.. 26.2 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्राहेदं भगवान्हरः..
पराधीना वयं ब्रह्मन्हिमाद्रेस्तव चापि यत्.. 26.2 ..
1.4.m: Hearing his words, the blessed lord Hara said: / 'O Brahmā, we are dependent on others, on Himādri and on you;

1.4.s:
yadyuktaṃ kriyatāṃ taddhi vayaṃ yuṣmadvaśe'dhunā..
tato brahmā svayaṃ divyaṃ puraṃ ratnamayaṃ śubham.. 26.3 ..
1.4.d:
यद्युक्तं क्रियतां तद्धि वयं युष्मद्वशेऽधुना..
ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयं दिव्यं पुरं रत्नमयं शुभम्.. 26.3 ..
1.4.m: so let whatever is fitting be done, for we are now under your control.' / Then Brahmā himself immediately prepared a divine, auspicious city,

1.4.s:
udvāhārthaṃ maheśasya tatkṣaṇātsamakalpayat..
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ prāsādaśataśobhitam.. 26.4 ..
1.4.d:
उद्वाहार्थं महेशस्य तत्क्षणात्समकल्पयत्..
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं प्रासादशतशोभितम्.. 26.4 ..
1.4.m: made of jewels, for the marriage of Maheśa, / a hundred yojanas wide and adorned with hundreds of palaces.

1.4.s:
puretasminmahādevaḥ svayameva vyatiṣṭhata..
tataḥ saptamunīndevaściṃtitābyāgatānpuraḥ.. 26.5 ..
1.4.d:
पुरेतस्मिन्महादेवः स्वयमेव व्यतिष्ठत..
ततः सप्तमुनीन्देवश्चिंतिताब्यागतान्पुरः.. 26.5 ..
1.4.m: Mahādeva himself resided in that city. / Then the god sent the seven sages, who had arrived before him upon being thought of,

1.4.s:
prāhiṇodaṃbikāyāśca sthirapatrārthamīśvaraḥ..
sāruṃdhatīkāste tatra hlādayaṃto himācalam.. 26.6 ..
1.4.d:
प्राहिणोदंबिकायाश्च स्थिरपत्रार्थमीश्वरः..
सारुंधतीकास्ते तत्र ह्लादयंतो हिमाचलम्.. 26.6 ..
1.4.m: for the sake of the betrothal letter for Ambikā, the lord / [sent] them along with Arundhatī, delighting Himācala there;

1.4.s:
sabhāryāmīśvaraguṇaiḥ sthirapatrāṇi cādadhuḥ..
tataḥ saṃpūjitāstena punarāgamya te'calāt.. 26.7 ..
1.4.d:
सभार्यामीश्वरगुणैः स्थिरपत्राणि चादधुः..
ततः संपूजितास्तेन पुनरागम्य तेऽचलात्.. 26.7 ..
1.4.m: and with the virtues of the lord, they delivered the betrothal letters to [Himācala] and his wife. / Then, honoured by him, they returned from that mountain

1.4.s:
nyavedayaṃsryaṃbakāya sa ca tānabhyanaṃdata..
udvāhārthaṃ tato devo viśvaṃ sarvaṃ nyamaṃtrayat.. 26.8 ..
1.4.d:
न्यवेदयंस्र्यंबकाय स च तानभ्यनंदत..
उद्वाहार्थं ततो देवो विश्वं सर्वं न्यमंत्रयत्.. 26.8 ..
1.4.m: and reported to Tryambaka, and he rejoiced with them. / Then the god invited the entire universe for the marriage;

1.4.s:
samāgataṃ ca tatsava vinā daityairdurātmabhiḥ..
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yacca viśvaṃ viṣṇupurogamam.. 26.9 ..
1.4.d:
समागतं च तत्सव विना दैत्यैर्दुरात्मभिः..
स्थावरं जंगमं यच्च विश्वं विष्णुपुरोगमम्.. 26.9 ..
1.4.m: and all that [universe] arrived, except for the wicked Daityas— / whatever was stationary and moving, headed by Viṣṇu.

1.4.s:
sabrahyakaṃ purārātermahimānamavardhayat..
tatastaṃ vidhirāhedaṃ gandhamādanaparvate.. 26.10 ..
1.4.d:
सब्रह्यकं पुरारातेर्महिमानमवर्धयत्..
ततस्तं विधिराहेदं गन्धमादनपर्वते.. 26.10 ..
1.4.m: Together with Brahmā, it enhanced the glory of the enemy of Tripura. / Then Brahmā spoke these words to him on Mount Gandhamādana,

1.4.s:
pure sthitaṃ vivāhasya deva kālaḥ pravartate..
tatastasya jaṭājūṭe caṃdrakhaṃḍaṃ pitāmahaḥ.. 26.11 ..
1.4.d:
पुरे स्थितं विवाहस्य देव कालः प्रवर्तते..
ततस्तस्य जटाजूटे चंद्रखंडं पितामहः.. 26.11 ..
1.4.m: stationed in the city: 'O god, the time of the wedding has arrived.' / Then the Grandfather, his eyes wide open with generous affection,

1.4.s:
babaṃdha praṇayodāravisphāritavilocanaḥ..
kaparddaṃ śobhanaṃ viṣṇuḥ svaya cakre'sya harṣataḥ.. 26.12 ..
1.4.d:
बबंध प्रणयोदारविस्फारितविलोचनः..
कपर्द्दं शोभनं विष्णुः स्वय चक्रेऽस्य हर्षतः.. 26.12 ..
1.4.m: tied the crescent moon in his matted hair. / Viṣṇu himself out of joy fashioned his beautiful braid of hair;

1.4.s:
kapālamālāṃ vipulāṃ cāmuṇḍā mūrdhnyabaṃdhata..
uvāca cāpi giriśaṃ putraṃ janaya śaṃkara.. 26.13 ..
1.4.d:
कपालमालां विपुलां चामुण्डा मूर्ध्न्यबंधत..
उवाच चापि गिरिशं पुत्रं जनय शंकर.. 26.13 ..
1.4.m: Cāmuṇḍā fastened a large garland of skulls upon his head / and said to Giriśa: 'O Śaṃkara, beget a son

1.4.s:
yo daityeṃdrakulaṃ hatvā māṃ raktaistarpayiṣyati..
sūryo jvalacchikhāraktaṃ bhābāsitajagattrayam.. 26.14 ..
1.4.d:
यो दैत्येंद्रकुलं हत्वा मां रक्तैस्तर्पयिष्यति..
सूर्यो ज्वलच्छिखारक्तं भाबासितजगत्त्रयम्.. 26.14 ..
1.4.m: who, having slain the family of the Daitya chiefs, will gratify me with their blood.' / The Sun, having illumined the three worlds with his radiance, out of great joy

1.4.s:
babaṃdha devadevasyaca svayameva pramodataḥ..
śeṣavāsukimukhyāśca jvalaṃtastejasā śubhāḥ.. 26.15 ..
1.4.d:
बबंध देवदेवस्यच स्वयमेव प्रमोदतः..
शेषवासुकिमुख्याश्च ज्वलंतस्तेजसा शुभाः.. 26.15 ..
1.4.m: himself tied [a garland] red with blazing flames for the god of gods. / And the auspicious [serpents], foremost of whom were Śeṣa and Vāsuki, glowing with splendour,

1.4.s:
ātmānaṃ bhūṣaṇasthāne svayaṃ te cakrurīśvare ..
vāyavaśca tatastīkṣṇaśrṛṃgaṃ himagiriprabham.. 26.16 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मानं भूषणस्थाने स्वयं ते चक्रुरीश्वरे ..
वायवश्च ततस्तीक्ष्णश्रृंगं हिमगिरिप्रभम्.. 26.16 ..
1.4.m: themselves served as ornaments upon the lord. / Then the Winds adorned the bull, which had sharp horns

1.4.s:
vṛṣaṃ vibhūṣayāmāsurnānāratnopapattibhiḥ..
śakro gajajinaṃ gṛhya svayamagre vyavasthitaḥ.. 26.17 ..
1.4.d:
वृषं विभूषयामासुर्नानारत्नोपपत्तिभिः..
शक्रो गजजिनं गृह्य स्वयमग्रे व्यवस्थितः.. 26.17 ..
1.4.m: and the radiance of the snowy mountain, with various precious gems. / Śakra, holding an elephant hide, stood in front himself.

1.4.s:
vinā bhasma samādhāya kapāle rajataprabham..
manujāsthimayīṃ mālāṃ pretanāthaśca vandanam.. 26.18 ..
1.4.d:
विना भस्म समाधाय कपाले रजतप्रभम्..
मनुजास्थिमयीं मालां प्रेतनाथश्च वन्दनम्.. 26.18 ..
1.4.m: Leaving aside the ashes, and having placed on a skull [a garland] radiant as silver, / a garland of human bones, and sandalwood paste, the lord of departed spirits,

1.4.s:
vahnistejomayaṃ divyamajinaṃ pradadau sthitaḥ..
evaṃ vibhūṣitaḥ sarvairbhṛtyairīśo babhau bhṛśam.. 26.19 ..
1.4.d:
वह्निस्तेजोमयं दिव्यमजिनं प्रददौ स्थितः..
एवं विभूषितः सर्वैर्भृत्यैरीशो बभौ भृशम्.. 26.19 ..
1.4.m: and Fire, standing by, gave a divine hide made of radiance. / Thus adorned by all his attendants, the lord shone brightly.

1.4.s:
tato himādreḥ puruṣā vīrakaṃ procire vacaḥ..
mā bhūtkālātyayaḥ śīghraṃ bhavasyaitannivedyatām.. 26.20 ..
1.4.d:
ततो हिमाद्रेः पुरुषा वीरकं प्रोचिरे वचः..
मा भूत्कालात्ययः शीघ्रं भवस्यैतन्निवेद्यताम्.. 26.20 ..
1.4.m: Then the men of Himādri spoke words to Vīraka: / 'Let not the time pass; let this be reported quickly to Bhava.'

1.4.s:
tato devaṃ praṇamyāha vīrakaḥ karasaṃpuṭī..
tvarayaṃti maheśānaṃ himādreḥ puruṣāstvamī.. 26.21 ..
1.4.d:
ततो देवं प्रणम्याह वीरकः करसंपुटी..
त्वरयंति महेशानं हिमाद्रेः पुरुषास्त्वमी.. 26.21 ..
1.4.m: Then Vīraka, bowing to the god with cupped hands, said: / 'These men of Himādri are urging Maheśāna to hasten.'

1.4.s:
iti śrutvā vaco devaḥ śīghramityeva cābravīt..
sapta vāridhayastasya cakrurdarpaṇadarśanam.. 26.22 ..
1.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो देवः शीघ्रमित्येव चाब्रवीत्..
सप्त वारिधयस्तस्य चक्रुर्दर्पणदर्शनम्.. 26.22 ..
1.4.m: Hearing this speech, the god said, 'At once!' / The seven oceans provided him with mirrors;

1.4.s:
tatraikṣata mahādevaḥ svarūpaṃ sa jaganmayam..
tato baddhāṃjalirdhīmānsthāṇuṃ provāca keśavaḥ.. 26.23 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रैक्षत महादेवः स्वरूपं स जगन्मयम्..
ततो बद्धांजलिर्धीमान्स्थाणुं प्रोवाच केशवः.. 26.23 ..
1.4.m: in them Mahādeva beheld his own form, which comprises the universe. / Then wise Keśava, with joined palms, spoke to Sthāṇu:

1.4.s:
devadeva mahādeva tripurāṃtaka śaṃkara..
śobhase'nena rūpeṇa jagadānaṃdadāyinā.. 26.24 ..
1.4.d:
देवदेव महादेव त्रिपुरांतक शंकर..
शोभसेऽनेन रूपेण जगदानंददायिना.. 26.24 ..
1.4.m: 'O god of gods, Mahādeva, destroyer of Tripura, Śaṃkara, / you shine with this form that gives joy to the world,

1.4.s:
maheśvara yathā sākṣādaparastvaṃ maheśvaraḥ..
tataḥ smayanmahādevo jayeti bhuvane śrutaḥ.. 26.25 ..
1.4.d:
महेश्वर यथा साक्षादपरस्त्वं महेश्वरः..
ततः स्मयन्महादेवो जयेति भुवने श्रुतः.. 26.25 ..
1.4.m: O Maheśvara, like another Maheśvara in visible presence.' / Then Mahādeva, smiling, while [shouts of] 'Victory!' were heard throughout the world,

1.4.s:
karamālaṃbya viṣṇośca vṛṣabhaṃ ruruheśanaiḥ..
tataśca vasavo devāḥ śūlaṃ tasya nyavedayan.. 26.26 ..
1.4.d:
करमालंब्य विष्णोश्च वृषभं रुरुहेशनैः..
ततश्च वसवो देवाः शूलं तस्य न्यवेदयन्.. 26.26 ..
1.4.m: clasped the hand of Viṣṇu and slowly mounted the bull. / Then the Vasu gods offered him his trident;

1.4.s:
dhanado nidibhiryuktaḥ samīpasthastato'bhavat..
sa śūlapāṇirviśvātmā saṃcacāla tato haraḥ.. 26.27 ..
1.4.d:
धनदो निदिभिर्युक्तः समीपस्थस्ततोऽभवत्..
स शूलपाणिर्विश्वात्मा संचचाल ततो हरः.. 26.27 ..
1.4.m: then the Bestower of Wealth, accompanied by his treasures, stood nearby. / Then Hara, holding the trident in his hand, the Soul of the Universe, set out,

1.4.s:
devaduṃdubhinādaiśca puṣpāsāraiśca gītakaiḥ..
nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca jayeti ca mahāsvanaiḥ.. 26.28 ..
1.4.d:
देवदुंदुभिनादैश्च पुष्पासारैश्च गीतकैः..
नृत्यद्भिरप्सरोभिश्च जयेति च महास्वनैः.. 26.28 ..
1.4.m: accompanied by the sounds of divine drums, showers of flowers, songs, / dancing apsarases, and loud shouts of 'Victory!'

1.4.s:
savyadakṣiṇasaṃsthānau brahmaviṣṇūtu jagmatuḥ..
haṃsaṃ ca garuḍaṃ caiva samāruhya mahāprabhau.. 26.29 ..
1.4.d:
सव्यदक्षिणसंस्थानौ ब्रह्मविष्णूतु जग्मतुः..
हंसं च गरुडं चैव समारुह्य महाप्रभौ.. 26.29 ..
1.4.m: The two great lords, Brahmā and Viṣṇu, mounted on the swan and Garuḍa respectively, / rode on his left and right sides.

1.4.s:
athāditirditiḥ sā ca danuḥ kadrūḥ suparṇajā..
paulomī surasā caiva siṃhikā surabhirmuniḥ.. 26.30 ..
1.4.d:
अथादितिर्दितिः सा च दनुः कद्रूः सुपर्णजा..
पौलोमी सुरसा चैव सिंहिका सुरभिर्मुनिः.. 26.30 ..
1.4.m: Then Aditi, Diti, and Danu, Kadrū, the daughter of Suparṇa, / Paulomī, Surasā, Siṃhikā, Surabhi, Muni,

1.4.s:
siddhirmāyā kṣamā durgā devī svāhā svadhā sudhā..
sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī lakṣmīḥ sā dakṣiṇā dyutiḥ.. 26.31 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धिर्माया क्षमा दुर्गा देवी स्वाहा स्वधा सुधा..
सावित्री चैव गायत्री लक्ष्मीः सा दक्षिणा द्युतिः.. 26.31 ..
1.4.m: Siddhi, Māyā, Kṣamā, the goddess Durgā, Svāhā, Svadhā, Sudhā, / Sāvitrī, Gāyatrī, Lakṣmī, Dakṣiṇā, Dyuti,

1.4.s:
spṛhāmatirdhṛtirbuddhirmaṃthirṛddhiḥ sarasvatī..
rākā kuhūḥ sinīvālī devī bhānumatī tathā.. 26.32 ..
1.4.d:
स्पृहामतिर्धृतिर्बुद्धिर्मंथिरृद्धिः सरस्वती..
राका कुहूः सिनीवाली देवी भानुमती तथा.. 26.32 ..
1.4.m: Spṛhā, Mati, Dhṛti, Buddhi, Manthi, Ṛddhi, Sarasvatī, / Rākā, Kuhū, Sinīvālī, and the goddess Bhānumatī,

1.4.s:
dharaṇī dhāraṇī velā rājñī cāpi ca rohiṇī..
ityetāścānyadevānāṃ mātaraḥ patnayastathā.. 26.33 ..
1.4.d:
धरणी धारणी वेला राज्ञी चापि च रोहिणी..
इत्येताश्चान्यदेवानां मातरः पत्नयस्तथा.. 26.33 ..
1.4.m: Dharaṇī, Dhāraṇī, Velā, Rājñī, and Rohiṇī— / these and the other mothers and wives of the gods

1.4.s:
udvāhaṃ devadevasya jagmuḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ..
uragā garuḍā yakṣā gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnarā narāḥ.. 26.34 ..
1.4.d:
उद्वाहं देवदेवस्य जग्मुः सर्वा मुदान्विताः..
उरगा गरुडा यक्षा गंधर्वाः किंनरा नराः.. 26.34 ..
1.4.m: all went with joy to the wedding of the god of gods. / Serpents, Garuḍas, yakṣas, gandharvas, kiṃnaras, humans,

1.4.s:
sāgarā girayo meghā māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā..
vedā maṃtrāstathā yajñāḥ śrautā dharmāśca sarvaśaḥ.. 26.35 ..
1.4.d:
सागरा गिरयो मेघा मासाः संवत्सरास्तथा..
वेदा मंत्रास्तथा यज्ञाः श्रौता धर्माश्च सर्वशः.. 26.35 ..
1.4.m: oceans, mountains, clouds, months, years, / the Vedas, mantras, sacrifices, and all the Śrauta dharmas,

1.4.s:
huṃkārāḥ praṇavāścaiva itihāsāḥ sahasraśaḥ..
koṭiśaśca tathā devā maheṃdrādyāḥ savāhanāḥ.. 26.36 ..
1.4.d:
हुंकाराः प्रणवाश्चैव इतिहासाः सहस्रशः..
कोटिशश्च तथा देवा महेंद्राद्याः सवाहनाः.. 26.36 ..
1.4.m: huṃkāras, praṇavas, and thousands of itihāsas, / and tens of millions of gods, Mahendra and others, with their mounts,

1.4.s:
anujagmurmahādevaṃ koṭiśo'rbudaśaśca hi..
gaṇāśca pṛṣṭhato jagmuḥ śaṃkhavarṇāśca koṭiśaḥ.. 26.37 ..
1.4.d:
अनुजग्मुर्महादेवं कोटिशोऽर्बुदशश्च हि..
गणाश्च पृष्ठतो जग्मुः शंखवर्णाश्च कोटिशः.. 26.37 ..
1.4.m: followed Mahādeva by tens of millions and hundreds of millions. / And behind him went the gaṇas, conch-coloured by the tens of millions:

1.4.s:
daśabhiḥ kekarākhyāśca vidyuto'ṣṭābhireva ca..
catuḥṣaṣṭyā viśākhāśca navabhiḥ pāriyātrikāḥ.. 26.38 ..
1.4.d:
दशभिः केकराख्याश्च विद्युतोऽष्टाभिरेव च..
चतुःषष्ट्या विशाखाश्च नवभिः पारियात्रिकाः.. 26.38 ..
1.4.m: those named Kekara by ten [crores], and Vidyuts by eight; / the Viśākhas by sixty-four, and the Pāriyātrikas by nine;

1.4.s:
ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāṃtakaḥ śrīmāṃstathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ..
jvālākeśo dvādaśabhiḥ koṭibhiḥ saṃvṛto yayau.. 26.39 ..
1.4.d:
षड्भिः सर्वांतकः श्रीमांस्तथैव विकृताननः..
ज्वालाकेशो द्वादशभिः कोटिभिः संवृतो ययौ.. 26.39 ..
1.4.m: the glorious Sarvāntaka by six, and likewise Vikṛtānana; / and Jvālākeśa went surrounded by twelve crores.

1.4.s:
saptabhiḥ samadaḥ śrīmānduṃdubhoṣṭhābhireva ca..
paṃcabhiśca kapālīśaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃhrādakaḥ śubhaḥ.. 26.40 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तभिः समदः श्रीमान्दुंदुभोष्ठाभिरेव च..
पंचभिश्च कपालीशः षड्भिः संह्रादकः शुभः.. 26.40 ..
1.4.m: The glorious Samada went with seven [crores], and Dundubha with eight; / Kapālīśa with five, and auspicious Saṃhrādaka with six.

1.4.s:
koṭikoṭibhirevaikaḥ kuṃḍakaḥ kuṃbhakastathā..
viṣṭaṃbho'ṣṭābhireveha gaṇapaḥ sarvasattamaḥ.. 26.41 ..
1.4.d:
कोटिकोटिभिरेवैकः कुंडकः कुंभकस्तथा..
विष्टंभोऽष्टाभिरेवेह गणपः सर्वसत्तमः.. 26.41 ..
1.4.m: Kuṇḍaka alone went with crores of crores, and likewise Kumbhaka; / Viṣṭambha, the leader of gaṇas, best of all beings, with eight.

1.4.s:
pippalaśca sahasreṇa sannādaśca tathā balī..
āveśanastathāṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiścaṃdratāpanaḥ.. 26.42 ..
1.4.d:
पिप्पलश्च सहस्रेण सन्नादश्च तथा बली..
आवेशनस्तथाष्टाभिः सप्तभिश्चंद्रतापनः.. 26.42 ..
1.4.m: And Pippala with a thousand, and likewise mighty Sannāda; / and Āveśana with eight, and Candratāpana with seven.

1.4.s:
mahākeśaḥ sahasreṇa naṃdirdvādaśabhistathā..
nagaḥ kālaḥ karālaśca mahākālaḥ śatena ca.. 26.43 ..
1.4.d:
महाकेशः सहस्रेण नंदिर्द्वादशभिस्तथा..
नगः कालः करालश्च महाकालः शतेन च.. 26.43 ..
1.4.m: Mahākeśa went with a thousand, and Nandin likewise with twelve; / Naga, Kāla, and Karāla, and Mahākāla with a hundred.

1.4.s:
agnikaḥ śatakoṭyā vai koṭyāgnimukha eva ca..
ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca koṭyā caiva dhanāvahaḥ.. 26.44 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निकः शतकोट्या वै कोट्याग्निमुख एव च..
आदित्यमूर्धा कोट्या च कोट्या चैव धनावहः.. 26.44 ..
1.4.m: Agnika went indeed with a hundred crores, and Agnimukha with a crore; / Ādityamūrdhan with a crore, and Dhanāvaha also with a crore.

1.4.s:
sannāgaśca śatenaiva kumudaḥ koṭibhistribhiḥ..
amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā sumaṃtrakaḥ.. 26.45 ..
1.4.d:
सन्नागश्च शतेनैव कुमुदः कोटिभिस्त्रिभिः..
अमोघः कोकिलश्चैव कोटिकोट्या सुमंत्रकः.. 26.45 ..
1.4.m: And Sannāga with a hundred, Kumuda with three crores; / Amogha and Kokila, and Sumantraka with a crore of crores.

1.4.s:
kākapādastatā ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā saṃtānako gaṇaḥ..
mahābalaśca navabhirmadhupiṃgaśca piṃgalaḥ.. 26.46 ..
1.4.d:
काकपादस्तता षष्ट्या षष्ट्या संतानको गणः..
महाबलश्च नवभिर्मधुपिंगश्च पिंगलः.. 26.46 ..
1.4.m: Kākapāda went with sixty, and the gaṇa Saṃtānaka with sixty; / and Mahābala with nine, and Madhupiṅga and Piṅgala.

1.4.s:
nīlo navatyā saptatyā caturvaktraśca pūrvapāt..
vīrabhadraścaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā karaṇo bālakastathā.. 26.47 ..
1.4.d:
नीलो नवत्या सप्तत्या चतुर्वक्त्रश्च पूर्वपात्..
वीरभद्रश्चश्चतुःषष्ट्या करणो बालकस्तथा.. 26.47 ..
1.4.m: Nīla with ninety, Caturvaktra and Pūrvapāt with seventy; / and Vīrabhadra with sixty-four, and Karaṇa and Bālaka.

1.4.s:
paṃcākṣaḥ śatamanyuśca meghamanyuśca viṃśatiḥ..
kāṣṭhakoṭiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukośo vṛṣabhastathā.. 26.48 ..
1.4.d:
पंचाक्षः शतमन्युश्च मेघमन्युश्च विंशतिः..
काष्ठकोटिश्चतुःषष्ट्या सुकोशो वृषभस्तथा.. 26.48 ..
1.4.m: Pañcākṣa and Śatamanyu, and Meghamanyu with twenty; / Kāṣṭhakoṭi with sixty-four, and Sukośa and Vṛṣabha.

1.4.s:
viśvarūpastālaketuḥ paṃcāśacca sitānanaḥ..
īśāno vṛddhadevaśca dīptātmā mṛtyuhā tathā.. 26.49 ..
1.4.d:
विश्वरूपस्तालकेतुः पंचाशच्च सिताननः..
ईशानो वृद्धदेवश्च दीप्तात्मा मृत्युहा तथा.. 26.49 ..
1.4.m: Viśvarūpa, Tālaketu, and Sitānana with fifty; / Īśāna, Vṛddhadeva, Dīptātman, and Mṛtyuhan.

1.4.s:
viṣādo yamahā caiva gaṇo bhṛṃgariṭistathā..
aśanī hāsakaścaiva catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahasrapāt.. 26.50 ..
1.4.d:
विषादो यमहा चैव गणो भृंगरिटिस्तथा..
अशनी हासकश्चैव चतुःषष्ट्या सहस्रपात्.. 26.50 ..
1.4.m: Viṣāda, Yamahan, and the gaṇa Bhṛṅgiriṭin; / Aśani and Hāsaka, and Sahasrapāt with sixty-four.

1.4.s:
ete cānye ca gaṇapā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ..
sarve sahasrahastāśca jaṭāmukuṭadhārīṇaḥ.. 26.51 ..
1.4.d:
एते चान्ये च गणपा असंख्याता महाबलाः..
सर्वे सहस्रहस्ताश्च जटामुकुटधारीणः.. 26.51 ..
1.4.m: These and other commanders of the gaṇas, innumerably many and very powerful, / all having a thousand arms and wearing crowns of matted hair,

1.4.s:
caṃdralekhāvataṃsāśca nīlakaṃṭhāstrilocanāḥ..
hārakuṃḍalakeyūramukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtāḥ.. 26.52 ..
1.4.d:
चंद्रलेखावतंसाश्च नीलकंठास्त्रिलोचनाः..
हारकुंडलकेयूरमुकुटाद्यैरलंकृताः.. 26.52 ..
1.4.m: having the crescent moon as an ornament, blue-necked, three-eyed, / adorned with necklaces, earrings, armlets, diadems, and other jewels,

1.4.s:
aṇimādiguṇairyuktāḥ śaktāḥ śāpaprasādayoḥ..
sūryakoṭipratīkāśāstatrājagmurgaṇeśvarāḥ.. 26.53 ..
1.4.d:
अणिमादिगुणैर्युक्ताः शक्ताः शापप्रसादयोः..
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशास्तत्राजग्मुर्गणेश्वराः.. 26.53 ..
1.4.m: endowed with supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, capable of cursing and bestowing favor, / resembling ten million suns—those lords of gaṇas came there,

1.4.s:
pātālāṃbarabhūmisthāḥ sarvalokanivāsinaḥ..
tuṃbururnārado hāhā hūhūścaiva tu sāmagāḥ.. 26.54 ..
1.4.d:
पातालांबरभूमिस्थाः सर्वलोकनिवासिनः..
तुंबुरुर्नारदो हाहा हूहूश्चैव तु सामगाः.. 26.54 ..
1.4.m: abiding in Pātāla, the sky, and the earth, dwelling in all the worlds. / Tumburu, Nārada, Hāhā, and Hūhū, singers of the Sāmaveda,

1.4.s:
taṃtrīmādāya vādyāṃścā'vādayañchaṃkarotsave..
ṛṣayaḥ kṛtsnaśaścaiva vedagītāṃstapodhanāḥ.. 26.55 ..
1.4.d:
तंत्रीमादाय वाद्यांश्चाऽवादयञ्छंकरोत्सवे..
ऋषयः कृत्स्नशश्चैव वेदगीतांस्तपोधनाः.. 26.55 ..
1.4.m: taking lutes and musical instruments, played at the celebration of Śaṃkara; / and all the sages, rich in austerities, chanting Vedic songs,

1.4.s:
puṇyānvaivāhikānmaṃtrāñjeṣuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ..
evaṃ pratasthegiriśo vījyamānaśca gaṃgayā.. 26.56 ..
1.4.d:
पुण्यान्वैवाहिकान्मंत्राञ्जेषुः संहृष्टमानसाः..
एवं प्रतस्थेगिरिशो वीज्यमानश्च गंगया.. 26.56 ..
1.4.m: chanted sacred wedding mantras, their minds filled with joy. / Thus set forth the Lord of the Mountain, fanned with chowries by Gaṅgā,

1.4.s:
tathā yamunayā cāpāṃpatinā dhṛtacchatrayā..
strībhirnānāvidhālāpailājābhiścānumoditaḥ.. 26.57 ..
1.4.d:
तथा यमुनया चापांपतिना धृतच्छत्रया..
स्त्रीभिर्नानाविधालापैलाजाभिश्चानुमोदितः.. 26.57 ..
1.4.m: and by Yamunā, with an umbrella held by the Lord of the Waters, / acclaimed by women with diverse discourses and parched grain.

1.4.s:
mahotsavena deveśo giristhānaṃ viveśa saḥ..
prabhāsatsvarṇakalaśaṃ toraṇānāṃ śatairyutam.. 26.58 ..
1.4.d:
महोत्सवेन देवेशो गिरिस्थानं विवेश सः..
प्रभासत्स्वर्णकलशं तोरणानां शतैर्युतम्.. 26.58 ..
1.4.m: With great festivity, that Lord of Gods entered the mountain abode, / shining with golden vessels and furnished with hundreds of arched gateways,

1.4.s:
vaiḍūryabaddhabhūmisthaṃ ratnajaiśca gṛhairyutam..
tatpraviśya stūyamāno dvāramabhyāsasāda ha.. 26.59 ..
1.4.d:
वैडूर्यबद्धभूमिस्थं रत्नजैश्च गृहैर्युतम्..
तत्प्रविश्य स्तूयमानो द्वारमभ्याससाद ह.. 26.59 ..
1.4.m: situated on ground laid with lapis lazuli and furnished with jewel-wrought mansions. / Entering there while being praised, he approached the doorway.

1.4.s:
tato himācalastatra dṛśyate vyākulākulaḥ..
ādiśadātmabhṛtyānāṃ mahādeva upasthite.. 26.60 ..
1.4.d:
ततो हिमाचलस्तत्र दृश्यते व्याकुलाकुलः..
आदिशदात्मभृत्यानां महादेव उपस्थिते.. 26.60 ..
1.4.m: Then the snowy mountain was seen there, overwhelmed with agitation; / he gave orders to his servants when Mahādeva arrived.

1.4.s:
tato brahmāṇamacalo gurutve prārthayattadā..
kṛtyānāṃ sarvabhāreṣu vāsudevaṃ ca buddhimān.. 26.61 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्माणमचलो गुरुत्वे प्रार्थयत्तदा..
कृत्यानां सर्वभारेषु वासुदेवं च बुद्धिमान्.. 26.61 ..
1.4.m: Then the mountain petitioned Brahmā to be the preceptor, / and the wise mountain petitioned Vāsudeva with regard to all burdens of the rites.

1.4.s:
pratyāha ca vivāha'sminkumārībhrātaraṃ vinā..
bhaviṣyati kathaṃ viṣṇo lājahomādikarmasu.. 26.62 ..
1.4.d:
प्रत्याह च विवाहऽस्मिन्कुमारीभ्रातरं विना..
भविष्यति कथं विष्णो लाजहोमादिकर्मसु.. 26.62 ..
1.4.m: And he said: “In this marriage, without a brother of the maiden, / O Viṣṇu, how will rites such as the offering of parched grain take place?

1.4.s:
suto hi mama mainākaḥ sa praviṣṭo'rṇave sthitaḥ..
iti ciṃtāviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ viṣṇurāhamahāmatiḥ.. 26.63 ..
1.4.d:
सुतो हि मम मैनाकः स प्रविष्टोऽर्णवे स्थितः..
इति चिंताविषण्णं तं विष्णुराहमहामतिः.. 26.63 ..
1.4.m: For Maināka is my son, and he has entered and remains in the ocean.” / To him who was thus downcast with worry, high-minded Viṣṇu said:

1.4.s:
atra ciṃtā na kartavyā girirāja kathaṃcana..
ahaṃ bhrātā jaganmāturetade vaṃ ca nānyathā.. 26.64 ..
1.4.d:
अत्र चिंता न कर्तव्या गिरिराज कथंचन..
अहं भ्राता जगन्मातुरेतदे वं च नान्यथा.. 26.64 ..
1.4.m: “No anxiety should be had in this matter in any way, O king of mountains! / I am the brother of the mother of the universe; this is truly so and not otherwise.”

1.4.s:
tataḥ pramuditaḥ śailaḥ pārvatīṃ ca svalaṃkṛtām..
sakhībhiḥ koṭisaṃkhyābhirvṛtāṃ praveśayatsadaḥ.. 26.65 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रमुदितः शैलः पार्वतीं च स्वलंकृताम्..
सखीभिः कोटिसंख्याभिर्वृतां प्रवेशयत्सदः.. 26.65 ..
1.4.m: Then, delighted, the mountain had Pārvatī, exquisitely adorned / and surrounded by millions of female companions, enter the assembly.

1.4.s:
tato nīlamayastaṃbhaṃ jvalatkāṃcanakuṭṭimam..
muktājālapariṣkāraṃ jvalitau ṣadhidīpitam.. 26.66 ..
1.4.d:
ततो नीलमयस्तंभं ज्वलत्कांचनकुट्टिमम्..
मुक्ताजालपरिष्कारं ज्वलितौ षधिदीपितम्.. 26.66 ..
1.4.m: Then Śarva, surrounded by his attendants, entered the marriage pavilion, / which had pillars made of sapphire, a glittering golden floor,

1.4.s:
ratnāsanasahasrāḍhyaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam..
vivāhamaṃḍapaṃ śarvo viveśānucarāvṛtaḥ.. 26.67 ..
1.4.d:
रत्नासनसहस्राढ्यं शतयोजनविस्तृतम्..
विवाहमंडपं शर्वो विवेशानुचरावृतः.. 26.67 ..
1.4.m: was decorated with strings of pearls, illuminated by blazing medicinal herbs, / rich with a thousand jeweled seats, and a hundred yojanas wide.

1.4.s:
tataḥ śailaḥ sapatnīkaḥ pādau prakṣālya harṣitaḥ..
bhavasya tena toyena siṣice svaṃ jagattathā.. 26.68 ..
1.4.d:
ततः शैलः सपत्नीकः पादौ प्रक्षाल्य हर्षितः..
भवस्य तेन तोयेन सिषिचे स्वं जगत्तथा.. 26.68 ..
1.4.m: Then the joyful mountain, accompanied by his wife, washed the feet / of Bhava, and with that water sprinkled himself and the world.

1.4.s:
pādyamācamanaṃ dattvā madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tathā..
pradānasya prayogaṃ ca saṃciṃtayaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ.. 26.69 ..
1.4.d:
पाद्यमाचमनं दत्त्वा मधुपर्कं च गां तथा..
प्रदानस्य प्रयोगं च संचिंतयंति ब्राह्मणाः.. 26.69 ..
1.4.m: Having offered water for the feet, water for sipping, madhuparka, and a cow, / the brahmins contemplated the ritual procedure for the giving away [of the bride].

1.4.s:
dauhitrīṃ kavyavāhānāṃ dadmi putrīṃ svakāmaham..
ityuktvā tasthivāñchailo na jānāti harasya saḥ.. 26.70 ..
1.4.d:
दौहित्रीं कव्यवाहानां दद्मि पुत्रीं स्वकामहम्..
इत्युक्त्वा तस्थिवाञ्छैलो न जानाति हरस्य सः.. 26.70 ..
1.4.m: “I give my own daughter, the granddaughter of the Kavyavāha pitṛs…” / having spoken thus, the mountain paused; he did not know Hara's lineage.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sarvānapṛcchatsa kulaṃ ko'pi na veda tat..
tato viṣṇuridaṃ prāha pṛchyaṃte'nye kimarthataḥ.. 26.71 ..
1.4.d:
ततः सर्वानपृच्छत्स कुलं कोऽपि न वेद तत्..
ततो विष्णुरिदं प्राह पृछ्यंतेऽन्ये किमर्थतः.. 26.71 ..
1.4.m: Then he asked everyone, but no one knew that lineage. / Then Viṣṇu spoke these words: “Why are others being asked?

1.4.s:
ajñātakulatāṃ tasya pṛchyatāmayameva ca..
ahireva aheḥ pādānvetti nānyo himācala.. 26.72 ..
1.4.d:
अज्ञातकुलतां तस्य पृछ्यतामयमेव च..
अहिरेव अहेः पादान्वेत्ति नान्यो हिमाचल.. 26.72 ..
1.4.m: Let this one himself be asked about the fact that his lineage is unknown. / Only a snake knows the feet of a snake, no one else, O snowy mountain!

1.4.s:
svagotraṃ yadi na brūte na deyā bhaginī mama..
tato hāsastadā jajñe sarveṣāṃ sumahāsvanaḥ.. 26.73 ..
1.4.d:
स्वगोत्रं यदि न ब्रूते न देया भगिनी मम..
ततो हासस्तदा जज्ञे सर्वेषां सुमहास्वनः.. 26.73 ..
1.4.m: If he does not state his own clan, my sister is not to be given.” / Then there arose a very great sound of laughter from everyone.

1.4.s:
nivṛttaśca kṣaṇādbhūyaḥ kiṃ vakṣyati harastviti..
tato vimṛśya bahudhā kiṃcidbhītānano yatā.. 26.74 ..
1.4.d:
निवृत्तश्च क्षणाद्भूयः किं वक्ष्यति हरस्त्विति..
ततो विमृश्य बहुधा किंचिद्भीताननो यता.. 26.74 ..
1.4.m: And in an instant it ceased again, [wondering] what Hara would say. / Then, reflecting in many ways, with a somewhat frightened face, restrained,

1.4.s:
lajjājaḍaḥ smitaṃ cakre tataḥ pārtha sa vai haraḥ..
tato viśiṣṭā bruvati śīghraṃ kālo'tivartate.. 26.75 ..
1.4.d:
लज्जाजडः स्मितं चक्रे ततः पार्थ स वै हरः..
ततो विशिष्टा ब्रुवति शीघ्रं कालोऽतिवर्तते.. 26.75 ..
1.4.m: numb with embarrassment, that Hara smiled, O Pārtha. / Then eminent sages said: “Quickly, the auspicious time is passing!”

1.4.s:
hariḥ prāha maheśānaṃ bibhyadāvedmayahaṃ tava..
mātāmahaṃ ca pitaraṃ prayogaṃ śrṛṇu bhūdhara.. 26.76 ..
1.4.d:
हरिः प्राह महेशानं बिभ्यदावेद्मयहं तव..
मातामहं च पितरं प्रयोगं श्रृणु भूधर.. 26.76 ..
1.4.m: Hari said to Maheśāna: “Afraid, I shall proclaim your / maternal grandfather and father; listen to the ritual statement, O mountain!

1.4.s:
ātmaputrāya te śaṃbho ātmadauhitrakāya te..
ityukte viṣṇunā sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ.. 26.77 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मपुत्राय ते शंभो आत्मदौहित्रकाय ते..
इत्युक्ते विष्णुना सर्वे साधुसाध्विति ते जगुः.. 26.77 ..
1.4.m: ‘To you, O Śambhu, who are your own son; to you, who are your own grandson!’” / When this was spoken by Viṣṇu, they all chanted, “Excellent, excellent!”

1.4.s:
devo'pyudāharedvuddhiṃ sarvebhyo'pyadhikāṃ varām..
tataḥ śailastathā coktvā dattvā devīṃ ca sodakam.. 26.78 ..
1.4.d:
देवोऽप्युदाहरेद्वुद्धिं सर्वेभ्योऽप्यधिकां वराम्..
ततः शैलस्तथा चोक्त्वा दत्त्वा देवीं च सोदकम्.. 26.78 ..
1.4.m: The god [Viṣṇu] showed a display of intelligence superior to all others and best. / Then the mountain, speaking likewise and giving away the goddess with water,

1.4.s:
ātmānaṃ cāpi devāya pradadau sodakaṃ nagaḥ..
tataḥ sarve tuṣṭuvustaṃ vivāhaṃ vismayānvitāḥ.. 26.79 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मानं चापि देवाय प्रददौ सोदकं नगः..
ततः सर्वे तुष्टुवुस्तं विवाहं विस्मयान्विताः.. 26.79 ..
1.4.m: the mountain gave even himself to the god with water. / Then, filled with wonder, they all praised that wedding:

1.4.s:
dātā mahībhṛtāṃ nātho hotā devaścaturmukhaḥ..
varaḥ paśupatiḥ sākṣātkanyā viśvaraṇistathā.. 26.80 ..
1.4.d:
दाता महीभृतां नाथो होता देवश्चतुर्मुखः..
वरः पशुपतिः साक्षात्कन्या विश्वरणिस्तथा.. 26.80 ..
1.4.m: “The giver is the lord of mountains; the hotṛ priest is the four-faced god [Brahmā]; / the groom is Paśupati in person; and the bride is the mother of the universe!”

1.4.s:
tataḥ stuvatsu muniṣu puṣpavarṣe mahatyapi..
nadatsu devatūryeṣu karaṃ jagrāha tryambakaḥ.. 26.81 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स्तुवत्सु मुनिषु पुष्पवर्षे महत्यपि..
नदत्सु देवतूर्येषु करं जग्राह त्र्यम्बकः.. 26.81 ..
1.4.m: Then, while the sages were praising, a great rain of flowers was falling, / and the drums of the gods were sounding, Tryambaka took her hand.

1.4.s:
devo devīṃ samālokya salajjāṃ himaśailajām..
na tṛpyati na cāhlādatsā ca devāṃ vṛṣadhvajam.. 26.82 ..
1.4.d:
देवो देवीं समालोक्य सलज्जां हिमशैलजाम्..
न तृप्यति न चाह्लादत्सा च देवां वृषध्वजम्.. 26.82 ..
1.4.m: Looking upon the modest goddess born of the snowy mountain, the god / was not satiated; nor was she with delight looking upon the god whose banner is the bull.

1.4.s:
tatra brahmādimunayo devīmadbhutarūpiṇīm..
paśyaṃtaḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmurmanasā parameśvaram.. 26.83 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मादिमुनयो देवीमद्भुतरूपिणीम्..
पश्यंतः शरणं जग्मुर्मनसा परमेश्वरम्.. 26.83 ..
1.4.m: There the sages, Brahmā and others, looking upon the goddess of wondrous form, / mentally sought refuge in the Supreme Lord:

1.4.s:
mā muhyāma pārvatīṃ ca yathā nāradaparvatau..
tatastathaiva taccakre sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ vacaḥ.. 26.84 ..
1.4.d:
मा मुह्याम पार्वतीं च यथा नारदपर्वतौ..
ततस्तथैव तच्चक्रे सर्वेषामीप्सितं वचः.. 26.84 ..
1.4.m: “May we not be infatuated with Pārvatī as were Nārada and Parvata!” / Then he fulfilled that desired prayer of them all accordingly.

1.4.s:
tato devaiśca munibhiḥ saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ..
praviveśa śubhāṃ vedīṃ mūrtimajjvalanāśritām.. 26.85 ..
1.4.d:
ततो देवैश्च मुनिभिः संस्तुतः परमेश्वरः..
प्रविवेश शुभां वेदीं मूर्तिमज्ज्वलनाश्रिताम्.. 26.85 ..
1.4.m:
Then, praised by the gods and sages, the Supreme Lord
entered the auspicious altar, which was attended by the embodied fire.

1.4.s:
vedhāḥ śrutīritairmaṃ trairmūrtimadbhirupasthitaiḥ..
mūrtamagniṃ juhāva triḥ parikramya ca taṃ haraḥ.. 26.86 ..
1.4.d:
वेधाः श्रुतीरितैर्मं त्रैर्मूर्तिमद्भिरुपस्थितैः..
मूर्तमग्निं जुहाव त्रिः परिक्रम्य च तं हरः.. 26.86 ..
1.4.m:
With the embodied Vedic hymns recited and present, Brahmā made offerings to the embodied fire;
and Hara circumambulated it three times.

1.4.s:
lājāhoma umābhrātā prāha taṃ sasmitaṃ hariḥ..
bahavo militāḥ saṃti lokāḥ saṃmarda īśvara.. 26.87 ..
1.4.d:
लाजाहोम उमाभ्राता प्राह तं सस्मितं हरिः..
बहवो मिलिताः संति लोकाः संमर्द ईश्वर.. 26.87 ..
1.4.m:
At the offering of fried grains, Hari, Umā's brother, smilingly said to him:
"O Lord, many people have gathered together; there is a great crowd.

1.4.s:
sāvadhānena rakṣyāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tvayā hara..
tato haraśca taṃ prāha svajane mā'tigopaya.. 26.88 ..
1.4.d:
सावधानेन रक्ष्याणि भूषणानि त्वया हर..
ततो हरश्च तं प्राह स्वजने माऽतिगोपय.. 26.88 ..
1.4.m:
O Hara, your ornaments must be guarded attentively."
Then Hara said to him: "Do not conceal too much from one's own people.

1.4.s:
kiṃcitprārthaya dāsyāmi prāha viṣṇustato varam..
tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā me'stu sa ca taddurlabhaṃ dadau.. 26.89 ..
1.4.d:
किंचित्प्रार्थय दास्यामि प्राह विष्णुस्ततो वरम्..
त्वयि भक्तिर्दृढा मेऽस्तु स च तद्दुर्लभं ददौ.. 26.89 ..
1.4.m:
Ask for something, and I will grant it." Then Viṣṇu spoke his boon:
"May I have firm devotion to you." And he granted that rare gift.

1.4.s:
dadatuḥ sṛṣṭisaṃrakṣāṃ brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāmubhau..
agnaye yajñabhāgāṃśca prītau harajanārdanau.. 26.90 ..
1.4.d:
ददतुः सृष्टिसंरक्षां ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणामुभौ..
अग्नये यज्ञभागांश्च प्रीतौ हरजनार्दनौ.. 26.90 ..
1.4.m:
Both [Hara and Umā] gave Brahmā the preservation of creation as a priestly fee,
and portions of the sacrifice to Agni, both Hara and Janārdana being delighted.

1.4.s:
bhṛgvādīnāṃ tato dattvā śrutirakṣaṇadakṣiṇām..
tato gītaiśca nṛtyaiśca bhojanaiśca yathepsitaiḥ.. 26.91 ..
1.4.d:
भृग्वादीनां ततो दत्त्वा श्रुतिरक्षणदक्षिणाम्..
ततो गीतैश्च नृत्यैश्च भोजनैश्च यथेप्सितैः.. 26.91 ..
1.4.m:
Then, having given the priestly fee for preserving the Vedas to Bhṛgu and the others,
with songs, dances, and desired feasts,

1.4.s:
mahotsavairanekaiśca vismayaṃ samapadyata..
visṛjya lokaṃ taṃ sarvaṃ kimicchādānakairbhavaḥ.. 26.92 ..
1.4.d:
महोत्सवैरनेकैश्च विस्मयं समपद्यत..
विसृज्य लोकं तं सर्वं किमिच्छादानकैर्भवः.. 26.92 ..
1.4.m:
and with many great festivals, astonishment was produced.
Dismissing all those people with gifts given according to their desires, Bhava,

1.4.s:
sarasvatyā ca pitarau devyāścā''śvāsya duḥkhitau..
āmaṃtrya himaśaileṃdraṃ brahmaṇaṃ ca sakeśavam.. 26.93 ..
1.4.d:
सरस्वत्या च पितरौ देव्याश्चा'ऽश्वास्य दुःखितौ..
आमंत्र्य हिमशैलेंद्रं ब्रह्मणं च सकेशवम्.. 26.93 ..
1.4.m:
having consoled with Sarasvatī the grieving parents of the goddess,
and bidding farewell to the lord of the snowy mountain, to Brahmā, and to Keśava,

1.4.s: jagāma maṃdaragiriṃ giriṇā yānugorcitaḥ.. 26.94 ..
1.4.d: जगाम मंदरगिरिं गिरिणा यानुगोर्चितः.. 26.94 ..
1.4.m: went to Mount Mandara, honored by the mountain who followed him.

1.4.s:
tato gate bhagavati nīlalohite sahomayā girimamalaṃ hi bhūdharaḥ..
sabāṃdhavo ruditi hi kasya no mano visaṃṣṭham̐laṃ jagati hi kanyakāpituḥ.. 26.95 ..
1.4.d:
ततो गते भगवति नीललोहिते सहोमया गिरिममलं हि भूधरः..
सबांधवो रुदिति हि कस्य नो मनो विसंष्ठम्̐लं जगति हि कन्यकापितुः.. 26.95 ..
1.4.m:
Then, when the holy Nīlalohita had departed for the stainless mountain along with Umā, the mountain [Himālaya] wept with his kinsmen;
for whose mind is not unhinged in this world when he is the father of a bride?

1.4.s:
imaṃ vivāhaṃ girirājaputryāḥ śrṛṇoti cādhyeti ca yo naraḥ śuciḥ..
viśeṣataścāpi vivāhamaṃgale sa maṃgalaṃ vṛddhimavāpnute ciram.. 26.96 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāma ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumāreśamāhātmye haragaurīvivāhavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍiṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 26 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
इमं विवाहं गिरिराजपुत्र्याः श्रृणोति चाध्येति च यो नरः शुचिः..
विशेषतश्चापि विवाहमंगले स मंगलं वृद्धिमवाप्नुते चिरम्.. 26.96 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराम एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारेशमाहात्म्ये हरगौरीविवाहवर्णनंनाम षडिंशोऽध्यायः.. 26 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Whatever pure man hears or recites this marriage of the daughter of the king of mountains,
especially during an auspicious wedding ceremony, he attains auspiciousness and long-lasting prosperity.
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Marriage of Hara and Gaurī', in the Kaumāreśamāhātmya of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tato nirupamaṃ divyaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ śubham..
īśānanirmitaṃ sākṣātsaha devyāviśadgṛham.. 27.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततो निरुपमं दिव्यं सर्वरत्नमयं शुभम्..
ईशाननिर्मितं साक्षात्सह देव्याविशद्गृहम्.. 27.1 ..
1.4.m:
Nārada said:
Then, together with the goddess, he entered an incomparable, divine, and auspicious house
made entirely of jewels, fashioned by Īśāna himself.

1.4.s:
tatrāsau maṃdaragirau saha devyā bhagākṣahā..
prāsāde tatra codyāne reme saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ.. 27.2 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रासौ मंदरगिरौ सह देव्या भगाक्षहा..
प्रासादे तत्र चोद्याने रेमे संहृष्टमानसः.. 27.2 ..
1.4.m:
There on Mount Mandara, the slayer of the eyes of Bhaga,
his mind filled with joy, took his pleasure with the goddess in that palace and garden.

1.4.s:
etasminnaṃtare devāstārakeṇātipīḍitāḥ..
protsāhitena cātyarthaṃ mayā kalicikīrṣuṇā.. 27.3 ..
1.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवास्तारकेणातिपीडिताः..
प्रोत्साहितेन चात्यर्थं मया कलिचिकीर्षुणा.. 27.3 ..
1.4.m:
Meanwhile, the gods, severely afflicted by Tāraka
and exceedingly incited by me, who wished to cause conflict,

1.4.s:
āsādya te bhavaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭuburbahudhā stavaiḥ..
etasminnaṃtare devī prodvartayata gātrakam.. 27.4 ..
1.4.d:
आसाद्य ते भवं देवं तुष्टुबुर्बहुधा स्तवैः..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी प्रोद्वर्तयत गात्रकम्.. 27.4 ..
1.4.m:
approached the god Bhava and praised him with many hymns.
In the meantime, the goddess was rubbing unguents upon her body.

1.4.s:
udvartanamalenātha naraṃ cakre gajānanam..
devānāṃ saṃstavaiḥ puṇyaiḥ kṛpayābhipariplutā.. 27.5 ..
1.4.d:
उद्वर्तनमलेनाथ नरं चक्रे गजाननम्..
देवानां संस्तवैः पुण्यैः कृपयाभिपरिप्लुता.. 27.5 ..
1.4.m:
Then, out of the dirt from the unguents, she fashioned an elephant-faced person,
overwhelmed with compassion by the holy praises of the gods.

1.4.s:
putretyuvāca taṃ devī tataḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasā..
etasminnaṃtare śarvastatrāgatya vaco'bravīt.. 27.6 ..
1.4.d:
पुत्रेत्युवाच तं देवी ततः संहृष्टमानसा..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शर्वस्तत्रागत्य वचोऽब्रवीत्.. 27.6 ..
1.4.m:
With a delighted mind, the goddess said to him, "My son!"
In the meantime, Śarva arrived there and spoke these words:

1.4.s:
putrastavāyaṃ girije śrṛṇu yādṛgbhaviṣyati..
vikrameṇa ca vīryeṇa kṛpayā sadṛśo mayā.. 27.7 ..
1.4.d:
पुत्रस्तवायं गिरिजे श्रृणु यादृग्भविष्यति..
विक्रमेण च वीर्येण कृपया सदृशो मया.. 27.7 ..
1.4.m:
"Hear, O daughter of the mountain, what kind of person this son of yours will be:
He will be like me in prowess, vigor, and compassion.

1.4.s:
yathāhaṃ tādṛśaścāsau putraste bhavitā guṇaiḥ..
ye ca pāpā durācārā vedāndharmaṃ dviṣaṃti ca.. 27.8 ..
1.4.d:
यथाहं तादृशश्चासौ पुत्रस्ते भविता गुणैः..
ये च पापा दुराचारा वेदान्धर्मं द्विषंति च.. 27.8 ..
1.4.m:
Such as I am, so shall this son of yours be in virtues.
And those who are sinful, ill-behaved, and hate the Vedas and dharma—

1.4.s:
teṣāmāmaraṇāṃtāni vighnānyeṣa kariṣyati..
ye ca māṃ naiva manyaṃte viṣṇuṃ vāpi jagadgurum.. 27.9 ..
1.4.d:
तेषामामरणांतानि विघ्नान्येष करिष्यति..
ये च मां नैव मन्यंते विष्णुं वापि जगद्गुरुम्.. 27.9 ..
1.4.m:
he will create obstacles for them until their death.
And those who do not respect me, or Viṣṇu, the teacher of the universe,

1.4.s:
vighnitā vighnarājena te yāsyaṃti mahattamaḥ..
teṣāṃ gṛheṣu kalahaḥ sadā naivopasāmyati.. 27.10 ..
1.4.d:
विघ्निता विघ्नराजेन ते यास्यंति महत्तमः..
तेषां गृहेषु कलहः सदा नैवोपसाम्यति.. 27.10 ..
1.4.m:
obstructed by the Lord of Obstacles, they shall go to great darkness.
Quarrels in their homes will never cease;

1.4.s:
putrasya tava vighnena samūlaṃ tasya naśyati..
yeṣāṃ na pūjyāḥ pūjyaṃte krodhāsatyaparāśca ye.. 27.11 ..
1.4.d:
पुत्रस्य तव विघ्नेन समूलं तस्य नश्यति..
येषां न पूज्याः पूज्यंते क्रोधासत्यपराश्च ये.. 27.11 ..
1.4.m:
by the obstacle [caused by] your son, they will be utterly destroyed.
For those who do not honor those worthy of honor, who are given to anger and falsehood,

1.4.s:
raudrasāhasikā ye ca teṣāṃ vighnaṃ kariṣyati..
śrutidharmāñjñātidharmānpālayaṃti gurūṃśca ye.. 27.12 ..
1.4.d:
रौद्रसाहसिका ये च तेषां विघ्नं करिष्यति..
श्रुतिधर्माञ्ज्ञातिधर्मान्पालयंति गुरूंश्च ये.. 27.12 ..
1.4.m:
and who are ferocious and rash, he will create obstacles.
For those who maintain the duties of the Vedas, familial duties, and their teachers,

1.4.s:
kṛpālavo gatakrodhāsteṣāṃ vighnaṃ hariṣyati..
sarve dharmāśca karmāṇi tathā nānāvidhāni ca.. 27.13 ..
1.4.d:
कृपालवो गतक्रोधास्तेषां विघ्नं हरिष्यति..
सर्वे धर्माश्च कर्माणि तथा नानाविधानि च.. 27.13 ..
1.4.m:
who are compassionate and free from anger, he will remove obstacles.
All religious duties and rites of various kinds

1.4.s:
savighnāni bhivaṣyaṃti pūjayāsya vinā śubhe..
evaṃ śrutvā umā prāha evamastviti śaṃkaram.. 27.14 ..
1.4.d:
सविघ्नानि भिवष्यंति पूजयास्य विना शुभे..
एवं श्रुत्वा उमा प्राह एवमस्त्विति शंकरम्.. 27.14 ..
1.4.m:
will be beset with obstacles without worship offered to him, O auspicious lady."
Having heard this, Umā said to Śaṃkara, "So be it."

1.4.s:
tato bṛhattanuḥ so'bhūttejasā dyotayandiśaḥ..
tato gaṇaiḥ samaṃ śarvaḥ surāṇāṃ pradadau ca tam..
yāvattāra kahaṃtā vo bhavettāvadayaṃ prabhuḥ.. 27.15 ..
1.4.d:
ततो बृहत्तनुः सोऽभूत्तेजसा द्योतयन्दिशः..
ततो गणैः समं शर्वः सुराणां प्रददौ च तम्..
यावत्तार कहंता वो भवेत्तावदयं प्रभुः.. 27.15 ..
1.4.m:
Then he became huge-bodied, illuminating the directions with his brilliance.
Then Śarva gave him, along with his attendants, to the gods, [saying]:
"He shall be your lord until the slayer of Tāraka is born."

1.4.s:
tato vighnapatirdevaiḥ saṃstutaḥ pramatārtihā..
cakāra teṣāṃ kṛtyāni vighnāni ditijanmanām.. 27.16 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विघ्नपतिर्देवैः संस्तुतः प्रमतार्तिहा..
चकार तेषां कृत्यानि विघ्नानि दितिजन्मनाम्.. 27.16 ..
1.4.m:
Then, praised by the gods, the Lord of Obstacles, the destroyer of the distress of the Pramathas,
executed their tasks and placed obstacles before the descendants of Diti.

1.4.s:
pārvatī ca punardevī putratve parikalpya ca..
aśokasyāṃkuraṃ vārbhiravarddhayata svādṛtaiḥ.. 27.17 ..
1.4.d:
पार्वती च पुनर्देवी पुत्रत्वे परिकल्प्य च..
अशोकस्यांकुरं वार्भिरवर्द्धयत स्वादृतैः.. 27.17 ..
1.4.m:
Then the goddess Pārvatī again, treating a sprout of an aśoka tree as a son,
nurtured it with lovingly fetched waters.

1.4.s:
saptarṣīnatha cāhūya saṃskāramaṃgalaṃ taroḥ..
kārayāmāsa tanvaṃgī tatastāṃ munayo'bruvan.. 27.18 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तर्षीनथ चाहूय संस्कारमंगलं तरोः..
कारयामास तन्वंगी ततस्तां मुनयोऽब्रुवन्.. 27.18 ..
1.4.m:
Having summoned the seven seers, the slender-limbed lady
had the auspicious rite of the tree performed; then the sages said to her:

1.4.s:
tvayaiva darśite mārge maryādāṃ kartumarhasi..
kiṃ phalaṃ bhavitā devi kalpitaistaruputrakaiḥ.. 27.19 ..
1.4.d:
त्वयैव दर्शिते मार्गे मर्यादां कर्तुमर्हसि..
किं फलं भविता देवि कल्पितैस्तरुपुत्रकैः.. 27.19 ..
1.4.m:
"You yourself ought to establish the standard along the path you have shown.
What will be the fruit, O goddess, produced from trees adopted as sons?"

1.4.s:
..devyuvāca..
yo vai nirudake grāme kūpaṃ kārayate budhaḥ..
yāvattoyaṃ bhavetkūpe tāvatsvarge sa modate.. 27.20 ..
1.4.d:
..देव्युवाच..
यो वै निरुदके ग्रामे कूपं कारयते बुधः..
यावत्तोयं भवेत्कूपे तावत्स्वर्गे स मोदते.. 27.20 ..
1.4.m:
The goddess said:
"A wise man who constructs a well in a waterless village
rejoices in heaven as long as there is water in the well.

1.4.s:
daśakūpasamāvāpī daśavāpī samaṃ saraḥ..
daśasaraḥsamā kanyā daśakanyāsamaḥ kratuḥ.. 27.21 ..
1.4.d:
दशकूपसमावापी दशवापी समं सरः..
दशसरःसमा कन्या दशकन्यासमः क्रतुः.. 27.21 ..
1.4.m:
A step-well is equal to ten wells; a reservoir is equal to ten step-wells;
a daughter is equal to ten reservoirs; a sacrifice is equal to ten daughters;

1.4.s: daśakratusamaḥ putro daśaputrasamo drumaḥ.. 27.22 ..
1.4.d: दशक्रतुसमः पुत्रो दशपुत्रसमो द्रुमः.. 27.22 ..
1.4.m: a son is equal to ten sacrifices; a tree is equal to ten sons.

1.4.s:
eṣaiva mama maryādā niyatā lokabhāvinī..
jīrṇoddhāre kṛte vāpi phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ matam.. 27.23 ..
1.4.d:
एषैव मम मर्यादा नियता लोकभाविनी..
जीर्णोद्धारे कृते वापि फलं तद्द्विगुणं मतम्.. 27.23 ..
1.4.m:
This is my established rule, ordained for the welfare of the world.
And if restoration of the decayed is done, the fruit is considered double."

1.4.s:
..iti gaṇeśotpattiḥ..
tataḥ kadācidbhagavānumayā saha maṃdare..
maṃdire harṣajanane kaladhautamaye śubhe.. 27.24 ..
1.4.d:
..इति गणेशोत्पत्तिः..
ततः कदाचिद्भगवानुमया सह मंदरे..
