1.4.m: He beheld Kumāra, who had one neck and one body, / an unformed mass on the first day, attaining distinct form on the second,

1.4.s:
dṛtīyāyāṃ śiśurjātaścaturthyāṃ pūrṇa evaca..
paṃcamyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ so'bhūtpāvakaṃ cāpyapaśyata.. 29.151 ..
1.4.d:
दृतीयायां शिशुर्जातश्चतुर्थ्यां पूर्ण एवच..
पंचम्यां संस्कृतः सोऽभूत्पावकं चाप्यपश्यत.. 29.151 ..
1.4.m: become an infant on the third, fully formed on the fourth, / consecrated on the fifth, and who also looked upon the fire.

1.4.s:
tatastaṃ pāvakaḥ pārtha āliliṃga cucuṃba ca..
putreti coktvā tasmai sa śaktyastrama dadātsvayam.. 29.152 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तं पावकः पार्थ आलिलिंग चुचुंब च..
पुत्रेति चोक्त्वा तस्मै स शक्त्यस्त्रम ददात्स्वयम्.. 29.152 ..
1.4.m: Then, O Pārtha, Pāvaka embraced and kissed him, / and saying, “O son,” he himself gave him the spear weapon.

1.4.s:
sa ca śaktiṃ samādāya namaskṛtya ca pāvakam..
śvetaśrṛṃgaṃ samārūḍho mukhaiḥ paśyandiśo daśa.. 29.153 ..
1.4.d:
स च शक्तिं समादाय नमस्कृत्य च पावकम्..
श्वेतश्रृंगं समारूढो मुखैः पश्यन्दिशो दश.. 29.153 ..
1.4.m: Taking the spear and bowing to Pāvaka, / he ascended the White Peak, gazing at the ten directions with his faces.

1.4.s:
vyanadadbhairavaṃ nādaṃ trāsa yansāsuraṃ jagat..
tataḥ śvetagireḥ śrṛṃgaṃ rakṣaḥ padmadaśāvṛtam.. 29.154 ..
1.4.d:
व्यनदद्भैरवं नादं त्रास यन्सासुरं जगत्..
ततः श्वेतगिरेः श्रृंगं रक्षः पद्मदशावृतम्.. 29.154 ..
1.4.m: He uttered a terrifying roar, terrifying the world together with the asuras. / Then the peak of the White Mountain, inhabited by a hundred thousand rākṣasas,

1.4.s:
bibheda tarasā śaktyā śatayojanavistṛtam..
tadekena prahāreṇa khaṃḍaśaḥ patitaṃ bhuvi.. 29.155 ..
1.4.d:
बिभेद तरसा शक्त्या शतयोजनविस्तृतम्..
तदेकेन प्रहारेण खंडशः पतितं भुवि.. 29.155 ..
1.4.m: extending a hundred yojanas, he split swiftly with his spear. / With that single blow, it fell to the earth in pieces.

1.4.s:
cūrṇīkṛtā rākṣasāste satataṃ dharmaśatravaḥ..
tataḥ pravyathitā bhūmirvyaśīryata samaṃtataḥ.. 29.156 ..
1.4.d:
चूर्णीकृता राक्षसास्ते सततं धर्मशत्रवः..
ततः प्रव्यथिता भूमिर्व्यशीर्यत समंततः.. 29.156 ..
1.4.m: Those rākṣasas, the perpetual enemies of dharma, were crushed to dust. / Then the earth, deeply agitated, broke apart on all sides.

1.4.s:
bhītāśca parvatāḥ sarve cukruśuḥ pralayādyathā..
bhūtāni tatra subhṛśaṃ trāhitrāhīti cojjaguḥ.. 29.157 ..
1.4.d:
भीताश्च पर्वताः सर्वे चुक्रुशुः प्रलयाद्यथा..
भूतानि तत्र सुभृशं त्राहित्राहीति चोज्जगुः.. 29.157 ..
1.4.m: And all the frightened mountains wailed as if at the dissolution of the world. / There the creatures shrieked intensely: “Save us! Save us!”

1.4.s:
evaṃ śrutvā tato devā vāsavaṃ saha te'bruvan..
yenaikena prahāreṇa trailokyaṃ vyākulī kṛtam.. 29.158 ..
1.4.d:
एवं श्रुत्वा ततो देवा वासवं सह तेऽब्रुवन्..
येनैकेन प्रहारेण त्रैलोक्यं व्याकुली कृतम्.. 29.158 ..
1.4.m: Hearing this, the gods together said to Vāsava: / “By whom with a single blow the three worlds have been thrown into confusion,

1.4.s:
sa saṃkruddhaḥ kṣaṇādviśvaṃ saṃhariṣyati vāsava..
vayaṃ ca pālanārthāya sṛṣṭā devena vedhasā.. 29.159 ..
1.4.d:
स संक्रुद्धः क्षणाद्विश्वं संहरिष्यति वासव..
वयं च पालनार्थाय सृष्टा देवेन वेधसा.. 29.159 ..
1.4.m: that enraged one, O Vāsava, will destroy the universe in an instant. / And we were created by the god Vedhas for the purpose of protection.

1.4.s:
tacca trāṇaṃ sadā kāryaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi..
asmākaṃ paśyatāmevaṃ yadi saṃkṣobhyate jagat.. 29.160 ..
1.4.d:
तच्च त्राणं सदा कार्यं प्राणैः कंठगतैरपि..
अस्माकं पश्यतामेवं यदि संक्षोभ्यते जगत्.. 29.160 ..
1.4.m: And that protection must always be carried out, even with our lives in our throats. / If the world is perturbed in this way before our very eyes,

1.4.s:
dhiktato janma vīrāṇāṃ ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ kṣaṇāt..
tadasmābhiḥ sahainaṃ tvaṃ kṣatumarhasi vāsava.. 29.161 ..
1.4.d:
धिक्ततो जन्म वीराणां श्लाघ्यं हि मरणं क्षणात्..
तदस्माभिः सहैनं त्वं क्षतुमर्हसि वासव.. 29.161 ..
1.4.m: then cursed is the birth of heroes; praised indeed is death in a moment! / Therefore, you must slay him together with us, O Vāsava.”

1.4.s:
evamuktastathetyuktvā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tamabhyayāt..
vidhitsustasya vīryaṃ sa śakrastūrṇataraṃ tadā.. 29.162 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा देवैः सार्धं तमभ्ययात्..
विधित्सुस्तस्य वीर्यं स शक्रस्तूर्णतरं तदा.. 29.162 ..
1.4.m: Thus addressed, saying “So be it,” Śakra went against him together with the gods, / desiring then to test his valor very swiftly.

1.4.s:
ugraṃ tacca mahāvegaṃ devānīkaṃ durāsadam..
nardamānaṃ guhaṛ prekṣya nanāda jaladhiryathā.. 29.163 ..
1.4.d:
उग्रं तच्च महावेगं देवानीकं दुरासदम्..
नर्दमानं गुहऋ प्रेक्ष्य ननाद जलधिर्यथा.. 29.163 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that fierce, swift, invincible army of the gods / roaring, Guha roared like the ocean.

1.4.s:
tasya nādena mahatā samuddhūtodadhiprabham..
babhrāma tatratatraiva deva sainyamacetanam.. 29.164 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य नादेन महता समुद्धूतोदधिप्रभम्..
बभ्राम तत्रतत्रैव देव सैन्यमचेतनम्.. 29.164 ..
1.4.m: Because of his great roar, appearing like an agitated ocean, / the army of the gods wandered here and there, senseless.

1.4.s:
jighāṃsūnupasaṃprāptāndevāndṛṣṭvā sa pāvakiḥ..
visasarjja mukhāttatra pravṛddhāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ.. 29.165 ..
1.4.d:
जिघांसूनुपसंप्राप्तान्देवान्दृष्ट्वा स पावकिः..
विससर्ज्ज मुखात्तत्र प्रवृद्धाः पावकार्चिषः.. 29.165 ..
1.4.m: Seeing the gods arrived with a desire to kill him, that son of Pāvaka / discharged from his mouth vast flames of fire.

1.4.s:
adahaddevasainyāni ceṣṭa mānāni bhūtale..
te pradīptaśirodehāḥ pradīptāyudhavāhanāḥ.. 29.166 ..
1.4.d:
अदहद्देवसैन्यानि चेष्ट मानानि भूतले..
ते प्रदीप्तशिरोदेहाः प्रदीप्तायुधवाहनाः.. 29.166 ..
1.4.m: He scorched the divine armies writhing upon the ground. / Their heads and bodies blazing, their weapons and mounts blazing,

1.4.s:
pracyutāḥ sahasā bhāṃti divastārāgaṇā iva..
dahyamānāḥ prapannāste śaraṇaṃ pāvakātmajam.. 29.167 ..
1.4.d:
प्रच्युताः सहसा भांति दिवस्तारागणा इव..
दह्यमानाः प्रपन्नास्ते शरणं पावकात्मजम्.. 29.167 ..
1.4.m: falling suddenly, they shone like hosts of stars from heaven. / Being burned, they fled for refuge to the son of Pāvaka.

1.4.s:
devā vajradharaṃ procustyaja vajraṃ śatakrato..
ukto devaistadā śakraḥ skaṃde vajravāsṛjat.. 29.168 ..
1.4.d:
देवा वज्रधरं प्रोचुस्त्यज वज्रं शतक्रतो..
उक्तो देवैस्तदा शक्रः स्कंदे वज्रवासृजत्.. 29.168 ..
1.4.m: The gods said to the wielder of the thunderbolt: “Drop the thunderbolt, O Śatakratu!” / Addressed by the gods, Śakra then hurled the thunderbolt at Skanda.

1.4.s:
tadvisṛṣṭaṃ jaghānāśu pārśva skaṃdasya dakṣiṇam..
bibheda ca kuruśreṣṭha tadā tasya mahātmanaḥ.. 29.169 ..
1.4.d:
तद्विसृष्टं जघानाशु पार्श्व स्कंदस्य दक्षिणम्..
बिभेद च कुरुश्रेष्ठ तदा तस्य महात्मनः.. 29.169 ..
1.4.m: Hurled, it struck the right flank of Skanda swiftly / and pierced it, O best of the Kurus, of that great-souled one.

1.4.s:
vajraprahārātskaṃdasya saṃjātaḥ puruṣo'paraḥ..
yuvā kāṃcanasannāhaḥ śaktidhṛgdivya kuṃḍalaḥ.. 29.170 ..
1.4.d:
वज्रप्रहारात्स्कंदस्य संजातः पुरुषोऽपरः..
युवा कांचनसन्नाहः शक्तिधृग्दिव्य कुंडलः.. 29.170 ..
1.4.m: From the blow of the thunderbolt, another person arose from Skanda, / a youth clad in golden armor, holding a spear, with divine earrings,

1.4.s:
śākha ityabhivikhyātaḥ sopi vyanadadadbhutam..
tataśceṃdraḥ punaḥ kruddho hṛdi skaṃdaṃ vyadārayat.. 29.171 ..
1.4.d:
शाख इत्यभिविख्यातः सोपि व्यनददद्भुतम्..
ततश्चेंद्रः पुनः क्रुद्धो हृदि स्कंदं व्यदारयत्.. 29.171 ..
1.4.m: renowned as Śākha; he too roared wondrously. / Then Indra, enraged again, cleaved Skanda in the chest.

1.4.s:
tatrāpi tādṛśo jajñe naigameya iti śrutaḥ..
tato vinadya skaṃdādyāścatvārastaṃ tadābhyayuḥ.. 29.172 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रापि तादृशो जज्ञे नैगमेय इति श्रुतः..
ततो विनद्य स्कंदाद्याश्चत्वारस्तं तदाभ्ययुः.. 29.172 ..
1.4.m: There too another like him was born, known as Naigameya. / Then, roaring, Skanda and the others, four [in all], charged against him at that time.

1.4.s:
tadeṃdro vajramutsṛjya prāṃjaliḥ śaraṇaṃ yayau..
tasyābhayaṃ dadau skaṃdaḥ sahasainyasya sattamaḥ.. 29.173 ..
1.4.d:
तदेंद्रो वज्रमुत्सृज्य प्रांजलिः शरणं ययौ..
तस्याभयं ददौ स्कंदः सहसैन्यस्य सत्तमः.. 29.173 ..
1.4.m: Then Indra, abandoning his thunderbolt, went for refuge with folded palms. / Skanda, the best of beings, granted safety to him along with his army.

1.4.s:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭāstrabhidaśā vāditrāṇyabhyavādayan..
vajraprahārātkanyāśca jajñire'sya mahābalāḥ.. 29.174 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रहृष्टास्त्रभिदशा वादित्राण्यभ्यवादयन्..
वज्रप्रहारात्कन्याश्च जज्ञिरेऽस्य महाबलाः.. 29.174 ..
1.4.m: Then the delighted gods sounded musical instruments. / And from his thunderbolt blow, maidens of great strength were born,

1.4.s:
yā haraṃ ti śiśūñjātāngarbhasthāṃścaiva dāruṇāḥ..
kākī ca hilimā caiva rudrā ca vṛṣabhā tathā.. 29.175 ..
1.4.d:
या हरं ति शिशूञ्जातान्गर्भस्थांश्चैव दारुणाः..
काकी च हिलिमा चैव रुद्रा च वृषभा तथा.. 29.175 ..
1.4.m: dreadful ones, who seize children that are born and those remaining in the womb: / Kākī, Hilimā, Rudrā, and likewise Vṛṣabhā,

1.4.s:
āyā palālā mitrā ca saptaitāḥ śiśumātaraḥ..
etāsāṃvīryasaṃpannaḥ śiśuścābhūtsudāruṇaḥ.. 29.176 ..
1.4.d:
आया पलाला मित्रा च सप्तैताः शिशुमातरः..
एतासांवीर्यसंपन्नः शिशुश्चाभूत्सुदारुणः.. 29.176 ..
1.4.m: Āyā, Palālā, and Mitrā—these are the seven Mothers of Children. / And from these was born a child endowed with valor, very dreadful,

1.4.s:
skaṃdaprasādajaḥ putro lohitākṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ..
eṣa vīrāṣṭakaḥ proktaḥ skaṃdamātṛgaṇo'dbhutaḥ.. 29.177 ..
1.4.d:
स्कंदप्रसादजः पुत्रो लोहिताक्षो भयंकरः..
एष वीराष्टकः प्रोक्तः स्कंदमातृगणोऽद्भुतः.. 29.177 ..
1.4.m: a terrifying, red-eyed son born from the grace of Skanda. / This is declared as the wondrous group of eight heroic mothers of Skanda,

1.4.s:
pūjanīyaḥ sadā bhaktyā sarvāpasmāraśāṃtidaḥ..
upātiṣṭhattataḥ skaṃdaṃ hiraṇyakavacasrajam.. 29.178 ..
1.4.d:
पूजनीयः सदा भक्त्या सर्वापस्मारशांतिदः..
उपातिष्ठत्ततः स्कंदं हिरण्यकवचस्रजम्.. 29.178 ..
1.4.m: always to be worshipped with devotion, granting relief from all forms of epilepsy. / Then Śrī approached Skanda, who had a golden armor and garland,

1.4.s:
lohitāṃbarasaṃvītaṃ trailokyasyāpi suprabham..
yuvānaṃ śrīḥ svayaṃ bheje taṃ praṇamya śarīriṇī.. 29.179 ..
1.4.d:
लोहितांबरसंवीतं त्रैलोक्यस्यापि सुप्रभम्..
युवानं श्रीः स्वयं भेजे तं प्रणम्य शरीरिणी.. 29.179 ..
1.4.m: covered in red cloth, radiant even to the three worlds, / a youth; Śrī herself, incarnate, attended upon him, bowing down.

1.4.s:
śriyā juṣṭaṃ ca taṃ prāhuḥ sarve devāḥ praṇamya vai..
hiraṇyavarṇṇa bhadraṃ te lokānāṃ śaṃkaro bhava.. 29.180 ..
1.4.d:
श्रिया जुष्टं च तं प्राहुः सर्वे देवाः प्रणम्य वै..
हिरण्यवर्ण्ण भद्रं ते लोकानां शंकरो भव.. 29.180 ..
1.4.m: And to him who was attended by Śrī, all the gods indeed said, bowing: / “O golden-hued one, auspiciousness to you! Be a bringer of welfare to the worlds!

1.4.s: bhavāniṃdro'stu no nātha trailokyasya hitāya vai.. 29.181 ..
1.4.d: भवानिंद्रोऽस्तु नो नाथ त्रैलोक्यस्य हिताय वै.. 29.181 ..
1.4.m: May you be Indra, our lord, for the benefit of the three worlds!”

1.4.s:
..skaṃda uvāca..
kimiṃdraḥ sarvalokānāṃ karotīha surottamāḥ..
kathaṃ devagaṇāṃścaiva pāti nityaṃ sureśvaraḥ.. 29.182 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कंद उवाच..
किमिंद्रः सर्वलोकानां करोतीह सुरोत्तमाः..
कथं देवगणांश्चैव पाति नित्यं सुरेश्वरः.. 29.182 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / “What does Indra do for all the worlds here, O best of gods? / And how does the Lord of Gods always protect the hosts of deities?”

1.4.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
iṃdro diśati bhūtānāṃ balaṃ tejaḥ prajāḥ sukham..
prajñāṃ prayacchati tathā sarvāndāyānsureśvaraḥ.. 29.183 ..
1.4.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
इंद्रो दिशति भूतानां बलं तेजः प्रजाः सुखम्..
प्रज्ञां प्रयच्छति तथा सर्वान्दायान्सुरेश्वरः.. 29.183 ..
1.4.m: The gods said: / “Indra assigns strength, splendor, offspring, and happiness to living beings; / and the Lord of Gods bestows wisdom and all inheritances.

1.4.s:
durvṛttānāṃ sa harati vṛttasthānāṃ prayacchati..
anuśāsti ca bhūtāni kāryeṣu balavattaraḥ.. 29.184 ..
1.4.d:
दुर्वृत्तानां स हरति वृत्तस्थानां प्रयच्छति..
अनुशास्ति च भूतानि कार्येषु बलवत्तरः.. 29.184 ..
1.4.m: He takes away from the ill-behaved; he bestows upon those established in good conduct. / And, most mighty, he commands creatures in their duties.

1.4.s:
asūrye ca bhavetsūryastathā'caṃdre ca caṃdramāḥ..
bhavatyagniśca vāyuśca pṛthivyāṃ jīvakāraṇam.. 29.185 ..
1.4.d:
असूर्ये च भवेत्सूर्यस्तथाऽचंद्रे च चंद्रमाः..
भवत्यग्निश्च वायुश्च पृथिव्यां जीवकारणम्.. 29.185 ..
1.4.m: Where there is no sun, he becomes the sun; likewise, where there is no moon, the moon. / He becomes fire and wind, the cause of life on earth.

1.4.s:
etadiṃdreṇa kartavyamiṃdro hi vipulaṃ balam..
tvaṃ ceṃdro bhava no vīra tārakaṃ jahi te namaḥ.. 29.186 ..
1.4.d:
एतदिंद्रेण कर्तव्यमिंद्रो हि विपुलं बलम्..
त्वं चेंद्रो भव नो वीर तारकं जहि ते नमः.. 29.186 ..
1.4.m: This is to be done by Indra, for Indra is vast strength. / And become our Indra, O hero! Slay Tāraka! Homage to you!”

1.4.s:
..iṃdra uvāca..
tvaṃ bhaveṃdro mahābāho sarveṣāṃ naḥ sukhāvahaḥ..
praṇamya prārthaye skaṃda tārakaṃ jahi rakṣa naḥ.. 29.187 ..
1.4.d:
..इंद्र उवाच..
त्वं भवेंद्रो महाबाहो सर्वेषां नः सुखावहः..
प्रणम्य प्रार्थये स्कंद तारकं जहि रक्ष नः.. 29.187 ..
1.4.m: Indra said: / “You become Indra, O mighty-armed one, bringing happiness to all of us. / Bowing, I pray, O Skanda: slay Tāraka, protect us!”

1.4.s:
..skaṃda uvāca..
śādhi tvameva trailokyaṃ bhavāniṃdrostu sarvadā..
kariṣye ceṃdrakarmāṇi na mameṃdratvamīpsitam.. 29.188 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कंद उवाच..
शाधि त्वमेव त्रैलोक्यं भवानिंद्रोस्तु सर्वदा..
करिष्ये चेंद्रकर्माणि न ममेंद्रत्वमीप्सितम्.. 29.188 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / “Rule the three worlds yourself; may you always be Indra. / I will perform the deeds of Indra; the rank of Indra is not desired by me.

1.4.s:
tvameva rājā bhadraṃ te trailokyasya mamaiva ca..
karomi kiṃ ca te śakraśāsanaṃ brūhi tanmama.. 29.189 ..
1.4.d:
त्वमेव राजा भद्रं ते त्रैलोक्यस्य ममैव च..
करोमि किं च ते शक्रशासनं ब्रूहि तन्मम.. 29.189 ..
1.4.m: You alone are king—auspiciousness to you—of the three worlds and of myself. / And what command of yours shall I carry out, O Śakra? Tell that to me.”

1.4.s:
..iṃdra uvāca..
yadi satyamidaṃ vākyaṃ niścayādbhāṣitaṃ tvayā..
abhiṣicchasva devānāṃ saināpatye mahābala..
ahamiṃdro bhaviṣyāmi tava vākyādyaśo'stu te.. 29.190 ..
1.4.d:
..इंद्र उवाच..
यदि सत्यमिदं वाक्यं निश्चयाद्भाषितं त्वया..
अभिषिच्छस्व देवानां सैनापत्ये महाबल..
अहमिंद्रो भविष्यामि तव वाक्याद्यशोऽस्तु ते.. 29.190 ..
1.4.m: Indra said: / “If these words have been spoken by you with firm resolve, / be consecrated in the generalship of the gods, O one of great strength! / I will be Indra by your word; may glory be yours!”

1.4.s:
..skaṃda uvāca..
dānavānāṃ vināśāya devānāmarthasiddhaye..
gobrāhmaṇasya cārthāya evamastu vacastava.. 29.191 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कंद उवाच..
दानवानां विनाशाय देवानामर्थसिद्धये..
गोब्राह्मणस्य चार्थाय एवमस्तु वचस्तव.. 29.191 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / “For the destruction of the Dānavas, for the success of the purpose of the gods, / and for the sake of cows and brahmins, so let your word be!”

1.4.s:
ityukte sumahānādaḥ surāṇāmabhyajāyata..
bhūtānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ trailokyāṃkapakārakaḥ.. 29.192 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ते सुमहानादः सुराणामभ्यजायत..
भूतानां चापि सर्वेषां त्रैलोक्यांकपकारकः.. 29.192 ..
1.4.m: When this was said, a very great roar arose from the gods, / and from all living beings, filling the lap of the three worlds.

1.4.s:
jayeti tuṣṭuvuścainaṃ vāditrāṇyabhyavādayan..
nanṛstaṣṭuvuścaivaṃ karāghātāṃśca cakrire.. 29.193 ..
1.4.d:
जयेति तुष्टुवुश्चैनं वादित्राण्यभ्यवादयन्..
ननृस्तष्टुवुश्चैवं कराघातांश्च चक्रिरे.. 29.193 ..
1.4.m: They praised him, crying 'Victory!', and sounded musical instruments; / they danced, sang praises, and clapped their hands.

1.4.s:
tena śabdena mahatā vismitā naganaṃdinī..
śaṃkaraṃ prāha ko deva nādo'yamativartate.. 29.194 ..
1.4.d:
तेन शब्देन महता विस्मिता नगनंदिनी..
शंकरं प्राह को देव नादोऽयमतिवर्तते.. 29.194 ..
1.4.m: Amazed by that great noise, the daughter of the mountain / said to Śaṃkara: 'O Lord, what is this resounding noise?'

1.4.s:
..rudra uvāca..
adya nunaṃ prahṛṣṭānāṃ surāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ..
śrūyaṃte ca tathā devī yathā jātaḥ sutastava.. 29.195 ..
1.4.d:
..रुद्र उवाच..
अद्य नुनं प्रहृष्टानां सुराणां विविधा गिरः..
श्रूयंते च तथा देवी यथा जातः सुतस्तव.. 29.195 ..
1.4.m: Rudra said: / 'Today indeed, O goddess, the manifold voices of the rejoiced gods are heard, / since your son has been born.

1.4.s:
gavāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca divaukasām..
mārjayiṣyati cāśrūṇi putraste puṇyavatyapi.. 29.196 ..
1.4.d:
गवां च ब्राह्मणानां च साध्वीनां च दिवौकसाम्..
मार्जयिष्यति चाश्रूणि पुत्रस्ते पुण्यवत्यपि.. 29.196 ..
1.4.m: For cows, for brahmins, and for virtuous wives among the celestials, / your son shall wipe away tears, O blessed one.'

1.4.s:
evaṃ vadati sā devī draṣṭuṃ tamutsukā'bhavat..
śaṃkaraśca mahātejāḥ putrasnehādhiko yataḥ.. 29.197 ..
1.4.d:
एवं वदति सा देवी द्रष्टुं तमुत्सुकाऽभवत्..
शंकरश्च महातेजाः पुत्रस्नेहाधिको यतः.. 29.197 ..
1.4.m: As he spoke thus, the goddess became eager to see him, / as did Śaṃkara of great splendor, being full of deep affection for his son.

1.4.s:
vṛṣabhaṃ tata āruhya devyā saha samutsukaḥ..
sagaṇo bhava āgacchatputra darśanalālasaḥ.. 29.198 ..
1.4.d:
वृषभं तत आरुह्य देव्या सह समुत्सुकः..
सगणो भव आगच्छत्पुत्र दर्शनलालसः.. 29.198 ..
1.4.m: Then, having mounted the bull together with the goddess, eager, / accompanied by his attendants, Bhava went forth, yearning for the sight of his son.

1.4.s:
tato brahmā mahāsenaṃ prajāpatirathābravīt..
abhigaccha mahādevaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ prabho.. 29.199 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा महासेनं प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत्..
अभिगच्छ महादेवं पितरं मातरं प्रभो.. 29.199 ..
1.4.m: Then Brahmā, the lord of creatures, spoke to Mahāsena: / 'Go to Mahādeva, your father, and to your mother, O lord.

1.4.s:
anayorvīryasaṃyogāttavotpattistu prāthamī..
evamastviti cāpyuktvā mahāseno maheśvaram.. 29.200 ..
1.4.d:
अनयोर्वीर्यसंयोगात्तवोत्पत्तिस्तु प्राथमी..
एवमस्त्विति चाप्युक्त्वा महासेनो महेश्वरम्.. 29.200 ..
1.4.m: For your primal origin was from the union of their seed.' / Having replied, 'So be it,' Mahāsena went to Maheśvara.

1.4.s:
apūjayadameyātmā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tām..
tatastamāliṃgya sutaṃ ciraṃ saṃyojya cāśiṣaḥ.. 29.201 ..
1.4.d:
अपूजयदमेयात्मा पितरं मातरं च ताम्..
ततस्तमालिंग्य सुतं चिरं संयोज्य चाशिषः.. 29.201 ..
1.4.m: The immeasurable-souled one worshiped the father and that mother. / Then, embracing their son for a long time and bestowing blessings,

1.4.s:
ciraṃ jahṛṣatuścobhau pārvatīparameśvarau..
siddhasārasya tattvaṃ ca dadau tuṣṭo'sya śaṃkaraḥ.. 29.202 ..
1.4.d:
चिरं जहृषतुश्चोभौ पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ..
सिद्धसारस्य तत्त्वं च ददौ तुष्टोऽस्य शंकरः.. 29.202 ..
1.4.m: both Pārvatī and Parameśvara rejoiced for a long time. / Pleased, Śaṃkara gave him the essence of the supreme perfection,

1.4.s:
devī prakṛtimokṣaṃ ca tuṣṭā harṣapariplutā..
etasminneva kāle tu ṣaḍdevyastaṃ samāgaman.. 29.203 ..
1.4.d:
देवी प्रकृतिमोक्षं च तुष्टा हर्षपरिप्लुता..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु षड्देव्यस्तं समागमन्.. 29.203 ..
1.4.m: and the goddess, delighted and overflowing with joy, [gave him] release from material nature. / Just at that time, the six goddesses arrived before him.

1.4.s:
ṛṣibhistāḥ parityaktāstaṃ putreti jagustadā..
pārvatī ca tataḥ prāha mama putro na vastvayam.. 29.204 ..
1.4.d:
ऋषिभिस्ताः परित्यक्तास्तं पुत्रेति जगुस्तदा..
पार्वती च ततः प्राह मम पुत्रो न वस्त्वयम्.. 29.204 ..
1.4.m: They who had been abandoned by the seers then cried out to him, 'O son!' / And then Pārvatī said: 'He is my son, not yours.'

1.4.s:
svāhā mameti ca prāha pāvakaśca mameti ca..
rudro mameti ca prāha mama devanadīti ca.. 29.205 ..
1.4.d:
स्वाहा ममेति च प्राह पावकश्च ममेति च..
रुद्रो ममेति च प्राह मम देवनदीति च.. 29.205 ..
1.4.m: Svāhā said, 'He is mine,' and the Fire said, 'He is mine.' / Rudra said, 'He is mine,' and the celestial river said, 'He is mine.'

1.4.s:
cakruste kalahaṃ ghoraṃ vivadaṃtaḥ parasparam..
putrasneho hi balavānpārtha kiṃkiṃ na kārayet.. 29.206 ..
1.4.d:
चक्रुस्ते कलहं घोरं विवदंतः परस्परम्..
पुत्रस्नेहो हि बलवान्पार्थ किंकिं न कारयेत्.. 29.206 ..
1.4.m: They raised a fierce quarrel, disputing among one another. / Affection for a son is indeed powerful, O Pārtha; what would it not make one do?

1.4.s:
tatastānprahasannāha vivādo yujyate na ca..
sarveṣāṃ vo guhaḥ putro matto vai vriyatāṃ varaḥ.. 29.207 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तान्प्रहसन्नाह विवादो युज्यते न च..
सर्वेषां वो गुहः पुत्रो मत्तो वै व्रियतां वरः.. 29.207 ..
1.4.m: Then, laughing, he said to them: 'Dispute is not proper. / Guha is the son of you all; let a boon be chosen from me!'

1.4.s:
tataḥ prāhuśca ṣaḍdevyaḥ svargo no hyakṣayo bhavet..
tatheti tā guhaḥ prāha śakrastatrāṃtare'bravīt.. 29.208 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्राहुश्च षड्देव्यः स्वर्गो नो ह्यक्षयो भवेत्..
तथेति ता गुहः प्राह शक्रस्तत्रांतरेऽब्रवीत्.. 29.208 ..
1.4.m: Then the six goddesses said: 'May heaven be imperishable for us.' / Guha said to them, 'So be it.' In the meantime, Śakra said:

1.4.s:
rohiṇyāścānujā skaṃda spardhamānābhijitkhalā..
icchaṃtī jyeṣṭhatāṃ devī pṛthaktvaṃ ca taporatā.. 29.209 .. tu. lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā 2.32.14
1.4.d:
रोहिण्याश्चानुजा स्कंद स्पर्धमानाभिजित्खला..
इच्छंती ज्येष्ठतां देवी पृथक्त्वं च तपोरता.. 29.209 .. तु. लक्ष्मीनारायणसंहिता 2.32.14
1.4.m: 'O Skanda, the wicked Abhijit, a younger sister of Rohiṇī, in rivalry / and desiring superiority and separateness, is engaged in austerity.

1.4.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti mūḍho'smi tatsthāne sthāpaya prabho..
tatastatheti ca prokte kṛttikāstā divaṃ gatāḥ.. 29.210 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रभृति मूढोऽस्मि तत्स्थाने स्थापय प्रभो..
ततस्तथेति च प्रोक्ते कृत्तिकास्ता दिवं गताः.. 29.210 ..
1.4.m: Ever since, I have been confused; establish [them] in her place, O lord.' / Then, upon his saying, 'So be it,' the Kṛttikās went to heaven.

1.4.s:
nakṣatraṃ saptaśīrṣābhaṃ bhāti tadvahnidaivatam..
athainamabravītsvāhā priyā nāhaṃ mahārciṣaḥ..
tadagneḥ priyatāṃ dehi sahavāsaṃ sadaiva ca.. 29.211 ..
1.4.d:
नक्षत्रं सप्तशीर्षाभं भाति तद्वह्निदैवतम्..
अथैनमब्रवीत्स्वाहा प्रिया नाहं महार्चिषः..
तदग्नेः प्रियतां देहि सहवासं सदैव च.. 29.211 ..
1.4.m: That constellation, having the appearance of seven heads, shines with Fire as its deity. / Then Svāhā said to him: 'I am not beloved to the great-flamed one; / therefore grant me love from Fire, and ever cohabitation [with him].'

1.4.s:
..skaṃda uvāca..
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yatkiṃciddvijā hoṣyaṃti pāvake.. 29.212 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कंद उवाच..
हव्यं कव्यं च यत्किंचिद्द्विजा होष्यंति पावके.. 29.212 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / 'Whatever oblations to gods and ancestors the twice-born shall offer into the purifier,

1.4.s:
tatte nāmnā pradāsyaṃti vāsaḥ sārdhaṃ bhavettava..
pāvakaḥ prārthayāmāsa yajñabhāgānpunaḥ sutān.. 29.213 ..
1.4.d:
तत्ते नाम्ना प्रदास्यंति वासः सार्धं भवेत्तव..
पावकः प्रार्थयामास यज्ञभागान्पुनः सुतान्.. 29.213 ..
1.4.m: they shall offer by your name, and your residence shall be together [with him].' / Fire again begged: 'May the sons have a share in the sacrifices.'

1.4.s:
sa cāpyāhādyaprabhṛti yajñabhāgānavāpnuhi..
itare prārthayāmāsuḥ khyāto nastvaṃ suto bhava.. 29.214 ..
1.4.d:
स चाप्याहाद्यप्रभृति यज्ञभागानवाप्नुहि..
इतरे प्रार्थयामासुः ख्यातो नस्त्वं सुतो भव.. 29.214 ..
1.4.m: And he said: 'From this day forth, obtain shares in the sacrifices.' / The others begged: 'Be known as our son.'

1.4.s:
evameveti tānāha skaṃdastaddhi sudurlabham..
tatastaṃ yoginaḥ sarve saṃbhūya sanakādayaḥ..
abhyaṣiṃcangirau tasminyogināmādipatyake.. 29.215 ..
1.4.d:
एवमेवेति तानाह स्कंदस्तद्धि सुदुर्लभम्..
ततस्तं योगिनः सर्वे संभूय सनकादयः..
अभ्यषिंचन्गिरौ तस्मिन्योगिनामादिपत्यके.. 29.215 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said to them, 'Even so,' for that is very hard to obtain. / Then all the yogins, Sanaka and the others, assembled / and consecrated him on that mountain in the sovereignty over yogins.

1.4.s:
yogīśvaramiti prāhustatastaṃ yoginastathā..
jahṛpurdevatāścaiva nānāvādyanyavādayan.. 29.216 ..
1.4.d:
योगीश्वरमिति प्राहुस्ततस्तं योगिनस्तथा..
जहृपुर्देवताश्चैव नानावाद्यन्यवादयन्.. 29.216 ..
1.4.m: The yogins then addressed him as Yogīśvara; / and the deities rejoiced and sounded various musical instruments.

1.4.s:
abhiṣiktena tenāsau śuśubhe śvetaparvataḥ..
ādityenevāṃśumatā suramya udayācalaḥ.. 29.217 ..
1.4.d:
अभिषिक्तेन तेनासौ शुशुभे श्वेतपर्वतः..
आदित्येनेवांशुमता सुरम्य उदयाचलः.. 29.217 ..
1.4.m: With him consecrated, the white mountain shone, / just as the delightful mountain of dawn does with the radiant sun.

1.4.s:
tato devāḥ sagandharvā nṛtyaṃtyapsarasastathā..
hṛṣṭānāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrūyate ninado mahān.. 29.218 ..
1.4.d:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा नृत्यंत्यप्सरसस्तथा..
हृष्टानां सर्वभूतानां श्रूयते निनदो महान्.. 29.218 ..
1.4.m: Then the gods with the gandharvas, and likewise the apsarases, danced; / a great sound of all the rejoiced beings was heard.

1.4.s:
evaṃ sendraṃ jagatsarvaṃ śvetaparvatasaṃsthitam..
prahṛṣṭaṃ prekṣya taṃ skandaṃ na ca tṛpyati darśanāt.. 29.219 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye skandakumārasya sarvadevasainādhipatyabhiṣekotsavavarmanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 29 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
एवं सेन्द्रं जगत्सर्वं श्वेतपर्वतसंस्थितम्..
प्रहृष्टं प्रेक्ष्य तं स्कन्दं न च तृप्यति दर्शनात्.. 29.219 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्ये स्कन्दकुमारस्य सर्वदेवसैनाधिपत्यभिषेकोत्सववर्मनंनामैकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 29 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Thus the entire world, along with Indra, stationed on the white mountain, / rejoiced at seeing Skanda and was not satiated by the sight.
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Consecration Festival of Skanda-Kumāra to the Supreme Command of All the Gods' Army', in the Kumāreśvaramāhātmya within the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tataḥ skandaḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ śvetaparvata mastakāt..
uttīrya tārakaṃ hantuṃ dakṣiṇāṃ sa diśaṃ yayau.. 30.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततः स्कन्दः सुरैः सार्धं श्वेतपर्वत मस्तकात्..
उत्तीर्य तारकं हन्तुं दक्षिणां स दिशं ययौ.. 30.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Then Skanda, accompanied by the gods, / having descended from the crest of the white mountain, set out toward the southern direction to slay Tāraka.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sarasvatītīre yāni bhūtāni nārada..
grahāścopagrahāścaiva vetālāḥ śākinī gaṇāḥ.. 30.2 ..
1.4.d:
ततः सरस्वतीतीरे यानि भूतानि नारद..
ग्रहाश्चोपग्रहाश्चैव वेतालाः शाकिनी गणाः.. 30.2 ..
1.4.m: Then, on the bank of the Sarasvatī, whatever beings there were, O Nārada— / planetary spirits and secondary planetary spirits, vetālas, and hosts of śākinīs,

1.4.s:
unmādā ye hyapasmārāḥ palādāśca piśācakāḥ..
devaisteṣāmādhipatye so'bhyaṣicyata pāvakiḥ.. 30.3 ..
1.4.d:
उन्मादा ये ह्यपस्माराः पलादाश्च पिशाचकाः..
देवैस्तेषामाधिपत्ये सोऽभ्यषिच्यत पावकिः.. 30.3 ..
1.4.m: insanities, falling sicknesses, flesh-eaters, and piśācas— / over their lordship, the son of the Fire was consecrated by the gods,

1.4.s:
yathā te naiva maryādāṃ saṃtyajaṃti durāśayāḥ..
etaistasmātsamākrāṃtaḥ śaraṇyaṃ pāvakiṃ vrajet.. 30.4 ..
1.4.d:
यथा ते नैव मर्यादां संत्यजंति दुराशयाः..
एतैस्तस्मात्समाक्रांतः शरण्यं पावकिं व्रजेत्.. 30.4 ..
1.4.m: so that those wicked-minded ones would not transgress proper bounds. / Therefore, one afflicted by them should seek refuge in the son of the Fire.

1.4.s:
aprakīrṇendriyaṃ dāṃtaṃ śuciṃ nityamataṃdritam..
āstikaṃ skandabhaktaṃ ca varjayaṃti grahādikāḥ.. 30.5 ..
1.4.d:
अप्रकीर्णेन्द्रियं दांतं शुचिं नित्यमतंद्रितम्..
आस्तिकं स्कन्दभक्तं च वर्जयंति ग्रहादिकाः.. 30.5 ..
1.4.m: The planetary spirits and others avoid one whose senses are not scattered, who is self-controlled, / pure, ever unwearied, faithful, and a devotee of Skanda.

1.4.s:
maheśvaraṃ ca ye bhaktā bhaktā nārāyaṇaṃ ca ye..
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa naśyaṃte te vidūrataḥ.. 30.6 ..
1.4.d:
महेश्वरं च ये भक्ता भक्ता नारायणं च ये..
तेषां दर्शनमात्रेण नश्यंते ते विदूरतः.. 30.6 ..
1.4.m: And those who are devoted to Maheśvara, and those who are devoted to Nārāyaṇa— / at their mere sight, they perish from afar.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sarvaiḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ mahītīraṃ yayau guhaḥ..
tatra devaiḥ prakathitaṃ mahīmāhātmyamuttamam.. 30.7 ..
1.4.d:
ततः सर्वैः सुरैः सार्धं महीतीरं ययौ गुहः..
तत्र देवैः प्रकथितं महीमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्.. 30.7 ..
1.4.m: Then Guha, along with all the gods, went to the bank of the Mahī; / there, the supreme māhātmya of the Mahī was recounted by the gods.

1.4.s:
śrṛṇvanvisiṣmiye skandaḥ praṇanāma ca tāṃ nadīm..
tato mahīdakṣiṇatastīramāśritya dhiṣṭhitam.. 30.8 ..
1.4.d:
श्रृण्वन्विसिष्मिये स्कन्दः प्रणनाम च तां नदीम्..
ततो महीदक्षिणतस्तीरमाश्रित्य धिष्ठितम्.. 30.8 ..
1.4.m: Hearing it, Skanda was astonished and bowed down to that river. / Then, to the south of the Mahī, to him who remained established on the bank,

1.4.s:
praṇamya śakrapramukhā guhaṃ vacanamabruvan..
abhiṣiktaṃ vinā skanda senāpatimakalmaṣam.. 30.9 ..
1.4.d:
प्रणम्य शक्रप्रमुखा गुहं वचनमब्रुवन्..
अभिषिक्तं विना स्कन्द सेनापतिमकल्मषम्.. 30.9 ..
1.4.m: having bowed down, [the gods] headed by Śakra spoke these words: / 'Without a consecrated, stainless commander of the army, O Skanda,

1.4.s:
na śarma labhate senā tasmāttvamabhiṣecaya..
mahīsāgarasaṃbhūtaiḥ puṇyaiścāpi śivairjalaiḥ.. 30.10 ..
1.4.d:
न शर्म लभते सेना तस्मात्त्वमभिषेचय..
महीसागरसंभूतैः पुण्यैश्चापि शिवैर्जलैः.. 30.10 ..
1.4.m: the army obtains no security; therefore, consecrate yourself. / With the holy and auspicious waters born from the union of the Mahī and the ocean,

1.4.s:
abhiṣekṣyāmahe tvāṃ ca tatra no draṣṭumarhasi..
yathā hastipade sarvapadāṃtarbhāva iṣyate.. 30.11 ..
1.4.d:
अभिषेक्ष्यामहे त्वां च तत्र नो द्रष्टुमर्हसि..
यथा हस्तिपदे सर्वपदांतर्भाव इष्यते.. 30.11 ..
1.4.m: we shall consecrate you, and you ought to look upon us there. / Just as the inclusion of all footprints is held to be in an elephant's footprint,

1.4.s:
sarvatīrthāntarasthānaṃ tathārṇavamahījale..
sarvabhūtamayo yadvatryaṃbakaḥ parikīrtyate.. 30.12 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वतीर्थान्तरस्थानं तथार्णवमहीजले..
सर्वभूतमयो यद्वत्र्यंबकः परिकीर्त्यते.. 30.12 ..
1.4.m: so is the residence of all other sacred fords in the water of the ocean and the Mahī. / Just as Tryambaka is proclaimed to consist of all beings,

1.4.s:
sarvatīrthamayastadvanmahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ..
ardhanārīśvaraṃ rūpaṃ yathā rudrasya sarvadam.. 30.13 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वतीर्थमयस्तद्वन्महीसागरसंगमः..
अर्धनारीश्वरं रूपं यथा रुद्रस्य सर्वदम्.. 30.13 ..
1.4.m: Likewise, the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean consists of all sacred fords, / just as the Ardhanārīśvara form of Rudra grants everything.

1.4.s:
tathā mahīsamudrasya snānaṃ sarvaphalapradam..
yenātra pitaraḥ skanda tarpitā bhaktibhāvataḥ.. 30.14 ..
1.4.d:
तथा महीसमुद्रस्य स्नानं सर्वफलप्रदम्..
येनात्र पितरः स्कन्द तर्पिता भक्तिभावतः.. 30.14 ..
1.4.m: So too, a ritual ablution in the Mahī ocean bestows all fruits. / He by whom the ancestors have been gratified here through devotion, O Skanda,

1.4.s:
tena sarveṣu tīrtheṣu tarpitā nātra saṃśayaḥ..
na caitaddhṛdi maṃtavyaṃ kṣārametajjalaṃ hi yat.. 30.15 ..
1.4.d:
तेन सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु तर्पिता नात्र संशयः..
न चैतद्धृदि मंतव्यं क्षारमेतज्जलं हि यत्.. 30.15 ..
1.4.m: by him they have been gratified in all sacred fords; of this there is no doubt. / Nor should it be thought in one's heart that this water is merely salty;

1.4.s:
yathā hi kaṭutiktādi gavā grastaṃ hi kṣīradam..
evametattvidaṃ toyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛpti dāyakam.. 30.16 ..
1.4.d:
यथा हि कटुतिक्तादि गवा ग्रस्तं हि क्षीरदम्..
एवमेतत्त्विदं तोयं पितॄणां तृप्ति दायकम्.. 30.16 ..
1.4.m: for just as bitter and pungent things eaten by a cow produce milk, / even so this water gives gratification to the ancestors."

1.4.s:
evaṃ bruvatsu deveṣu kapilo'pi munirjagau..
satyametadumāputra sarvatīrthamayī mahī.. 30.17 ..
1.4.d:
एवं ब्रुवत्सु देवेषु कपिलोऽपि मुनिर्जगौ..
सत्यमेतदुमापुत्र सर्वतीर्थमयी मही.. 30.17 ..
1.4.m: While the gods were speaking thus, the sage Kapila also said: / "This is true, O son of Umā; the Mahī contains all sacred fords.

1.4.s:
kardamo yastvahamapi jñātvā tīrthamahā guṇān..
sarvāṃ bhuvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā hyaśramamāstitaḥ.. 30.18 ..
1.4.d:
कर्दमो यस्त्वहमपि ज्ञात्वा तीर्थमहा गुणान्..
सर्वां भुवं परित्यज्य कृत्वा ह्यश्रममास्तितः.. 30.18 ..
1.4.m: And I, Kardama's son, having known the great virtues of the sacred ford, / abandoned the entire earth and established an hermitage here."

1.4.s:
tato maheśvaraḥ prāha satyametatsuroditam..
brahmādyāstaṃ tathā prāhuratra bhūyo'pyatho guruḥ.. 30.19 ..
1.4.d:
ततो महेश्वरः प्राह सत्यमेतत्सुरोदितम्..
ब्रह्माद्यास्तं तथा प्राहुरत्र भूयोऽप्यथो गुरुः.. 30.19 ..
1.4.m: Then Maheśvara said: "What the gods have spoken is true." / Brahmā and the others said the same to him; then, once more, the preceptor said here:

1.4.s:
atrābhiṣekaṃ te vīra kariṣyāmaḥ samādiśa..
tataḥ suvismitastatra snātvā skando mahāmanāḥ.. 30.20 ..
1.4.d:
अत्राभिषेकं ते वीर करिष्यामः समादिश..
ततः सुविस्मितस्तत्र स्नात्वा स्कन्दो महामनाः.. 30.20 ..
1.4.m: "We shall perform your consecration here, O hero; give the command." / Thereupon, deeply amazed, the magnanimous Skanda, having bathed there,

1.4.s:
abhiṣiñcantu māṃ devā iti tānabravīdvacaḥ..
tato'bhiṣekasaṃbhārānsarvānsaṃbhṛtya śāstrataḥ.. 30.21 ..
1.4.d:
अभिषिञ्चन्तु मां देवा इति तानब्रवीद्वचः..
ततोऽभिषेकसंभारान्सर्वान्संभृत्य शास्त्रतः.. 30.21 ..
1.4.m: spoke this word to them: "Let the gods consecrate me." / Then, gathering all the materials for consecration according to the scriptures,

1.4.s:
juhuvurmaṃtrapūte'gnau catvāro mukhyaṛtvijaḥ..
brahmā ca kapilo jīvo viśvāmitraścaturthakaḥ.. 30.22 ..
1.4.d:
जुहुवुर्मंत्रपूतेऽग्नौ चत्वारो मुख्यऋत्विजः..
ब्रह्मा च कपिलो जीवो विश्वामित्रश्चतुर्थकः.. 30.22 ..
1.4.m: four principal officiating priests made offerings in the fire purified with mantras: / Brahmā, Kapila, Bṛhaspati, and Viśvāmitra as the fourth,

1.4.s:
anye ca śataśastatra munayo vedapāragāḥ..
tatrādbhutaṃ mahādevo darśayāmāsa bhārata.. 30.23 ..
1.4.d:
अन्ये च शतशस्तत्र मुनयो वेदपारगाः..
तत्राद्भुतं महादेवो दर्शयामास भारत.. 30.23 ..
1.4.m: and hundreds of other sages there who were masters of the Vedas. / There Mahādeva showed a wonder, O Bhārata,

1.4.s:
yadagnikuṇḍamadhyastho liṃgamūrtirvyadṛśyata..
ahamevāgnimadhyastho havirgṛhṇāmi nityaśaḥ.. 30.24 ..
1.4.d:
यदग्निकुण्डमध्यस्थो लिंगमूर्तिर्व्यदृश्यत..
अहमेवाग्निमध्यस्थो हविर्गृह्णामि नित्यशः.. 30.24 ..
1.4.m: for he appeared in the form of a liṅga seated within the fire pit: / "Abiding in the midst of the fire, I myself constantly receive the oblation."

1.4.s:
etatsaṃdarśanārthāya liṃgamūrtirabhūdvibhuḥ..
talliṃgamatulaṃ devā namaścakrurmudānvitāḥ.. 30.25 ..
1.4.d:
एतत्संदर्शनार्थाय लिंगमूर्तिरभूद्विभुः..
तल्लिंगमतुलं देवा नमश्चक्रुर्मुदान्विताः.. 30.25 ..
1.4.m: In order to demonstrate this, the Lord assumed the form of a liṅga. / Filled with joy, the gods bowed to that peerless liṅga,

1.4.s:
sarvapāpāpahaṃ pārtha sarvakāmaphalapradam..
tatra homāvasāne ca datte himavatā śubhe.. 30.26 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वपापापहं पार्थ सर्वकामफलप्रदम्..
तत्र होमावसाने च दत्ते हिमवता शुभे.. 30.26 ..
1.4.m: which removes all sins, O son of Pṛthā, and bestows the fruits of all desires. / Then, at the conclusion of the fire offering, when the auspicious [seat] was offered by Himavat,

1.4.s:
divyaratnānvite skando niṣaṇṇaḥ paramāsane..
sarvamaṃgalasaṃbhārairvidhimaṃtrapuraskṛtam.. 30.27 ..
1.4.d:
दिव्यरत्नान्विते स्कन्दो निषण्णः परमासने..
सर्वमंगलसंभारैर्विधिमंत्रपुरस्कृतम्.. 30.27 ..
1.4.m: Skanda was seated upon the supreme seat endowed with divine gems. / With all the auspicious materials, preceded by rites and mantras,

1.4.s:
abhyaṣiṃcaṃstato devāḥ kumāraṃ śaṃkarātmajam..
iṃdro viṣṇurmahāvīryo brahmarudrau ca phālguna.. 30.28 ..
1.4.d:
अभ्यषिंचंस्ततो देवाः कुमारं शंकरात्मजम्..
इंद्रो विष्णुर्महावीर्यो ब्रह्मरुद्रौ च फाल्गुन.. 30.28 ..
1.4.m: the gods then consecrated Kumāra, the son of Śaṃkara: / Indra, Viṣṇu of great prowess, and Brahmā and Rudra, O Phālguna;

1.4.s:
ādityādya grahāḥ sarve tathobhāvanilānalau..
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāścaivāśvināvubhau.. 30.29 ..
1.4.d:
आदित्याद्य ग्रहाः सर्वे तथोभावनिलानलौ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याश्चैवाश्विनावुभौ.. 30.29 ..
1.4.m: all the planets beginning with the sun, as well as both wind and fire; / the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sādhyas, and both Aśvins;

1.4.s:
viśvedevāśca maruto gaṃdharvāpsarasastathā..
devabrahmarṣayaścaiva vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ.. 30.30 ..
1.4.d:
विश्वेदेवाश्च मरुतो गंधर्वाप्सरसस्तथा..
देवब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः.. 30.30 ..
1.4.m: the Viśvedevas, the Maruts, the gandharvas and apsarases; / the divine and brahmin seers, the Vālakhilyas, and the Marīcipas;

1.4.s:
vidyādharā yogasiddhāḥ pulastyapulahādayaḥ..
pitaraḥ kaśyapo'triśca marīcirbhṛguraṃgirāḥ.. 30.31 ..
1.4.d:
विद्याधरा योगसिद्धाः पुलस्त्यपुलहादयः..
पितरः कश्यपोऽत्रिश्च मरीचिर्भृगुरंगिराः.. 30.31 ..
1.4.m: the vidyādharas, the perfected masters of yoga, Pulastya, Pulaha, and others; / the ancestors, Kaśyapa, Atri, Marīci, Bhṛgu, and Aṅgiras;

1.4.s:
dakṣo'tha manavo ye ca jyotīṃṣi ṛtavastathā..
mūrtimatyaśca sarito mahīprabhṛtikāstathā.. 30.32 ..
1.4.d:
दक्षोऽथ मनवो ये च ज्योतींषि ऋतवस्तथा..
मूर्तिमत्यश्च सरितो महीप्रभृतिकास्तथा.. 30.32 ..
1.4.m: Dakṣa, and the Manus, the heavenly bodies, and the seasons; / the rivers in embodied form, beginning with the Mahī;

1.4.s:
lavaṇādyāḥ samudrāśca prabhāsādyāśca tīrthakāḥ..
pṛthivī dyaurdiśaścaiva pādapāḥ pārvatāstathā.. 30.33 ..
1.4.d:
लवणाद्याः समुद्राश्च प्रभासाद्याश्च तीर्थकाः..
पृथिवी द्यौर्दिशश्चैव पादपाः पार्वतास्तथा.. 30.33 ..
1.4.m: the oceans beginning with the salt sea, and the sacred fords beginning with Prabhāsa; / the earth, heaven, the cardinal directions, trees, and mountains;

1.4.s:
ādityādyā mātaraśca kurvaṃtyo guhamaṃgalam..
vāsukipramukhā nāgāsthathobhau garuḍāruṇau.. 30.34 ..
1.4.d:
आदित्याद्या मातरश्च कुर्वंत्यो गुहमंगलम्..
वासुकिप्रमुखा नागास्थथोभौ गरुडारुणौ.. 30.34 ..
1.4.m: and the Mothers beginning with the solar deities, performing auspicious rites for Guha; / the nāgas led by Vāsuki, as well as both Garuḍa and Aruṇa;

1.4.s:
varuṇo dhanadaścaiva yamaḥ sānucarastathā..
rākṣaso nirṛtiścaiva bhūtāni ca palāśanāḥ.. 30.35 ..
1.4.d:
वरुणो धनदश्चैव यमः सानुचरस्तथा..
राक्षसो निरृतिश्चैव भूतानि च पलाशनाः.. 30.35 ..
1.4.m: Varuṇa, the giver of wealth [Kubera], and Yama accompanied by his attendants; / the rākṣasa Nirṛti, and the spirits that eat flesh;

1.4.s:
dharmo bṛhaspatiścaiva kapilo gādhinaṃdanaḥ..
bahulatvācca ye noktā vividhā devatāgaṇāḥ.. 30.36 ..
1.4.d:
धर्मो बृहस्पतिश्चैव कपिलो गाधिनंदनः..
बहुलत्वाच्च ये नोक्ता विविधा देवतागणाः.. 30.36 ..
1.4.m: Dharma, Bṛhaspati, Kapila, and the son of Gādhin [Viśvāmitra]; / and the various hosts of deities that were not mentioned because of their great number—

1.4.s:
te ca sarve mahīkūle hyabhyaṣiṃcanmudā guham..
tato mahāsvanāmugrāṃ devadaityādidarpahām.. 30.37 ..
1.4.d:
ते च सर्वे महीकूले ह्यभ्यषिंचन्मुदा गुहम्..
ततो महास्वनामुग्रां देवदैत्यादिदर्पहाम्.. 30.37 ..
1.4.m: all of them joyfully consecrated Guha on the bank of the Mahī. / Then Paśupati gave him a fierce, loud-roaring army of all beings,

1.4.s:
dadau paśupatistasmai sarvabhūtamahācamūm..
viṣṇurdadau vaijayaṃtīṃ mālāṃ balavivardhinīm.. 30.38 ..
1.4.d:
ददौ पशुपतिस्तस्मै सर्वभूतमहाचमूम्..
विष्णुर्ददौ वैजयंतीं मालां बलविवर्धिनीम्.. 30.38 ..
1.4.m: which crushed the pride of gods, Daityas, and others. / Viṣṇu gave the garland Vaijayantī, which increases strength;

1.4.s:
umā dadau cārajasī vāsasī sūryasaprabhā..
gaṃgā kamaṃḍaluṃ divyamamṛtodbhavamuttamam.. 30.39 ..
1.4.d:
उमा ददौ चारजसी वाससी सूर्यसप्रभा..
गंगा कमंडलुं दिव्यममृतोद्भवमुत्तमम्.. 30.39 ..
1.4.m: Umā gave two dustless garments radiant like the sun; / Gaṅgā, an excellent divine water pot sprung from nectar;

1.4.s:
mahī mahānadī tasya cākṣamālāṃ sasāgarā..
dadau mudā kumārāya daṃḍaṃ caiva bṛhaspatiḥ.. 30.40 ..
1.4.d:
मही महानदी तस्य चाक्षमालां ससागरा..
ददौ मुदा कुमाराय दंडं चैव बृहस्पतिः.. 30.40 ..
1.4.m: the great river Mahī, together with the ocean, gave him a rosary; / and Bṛhaspati joyfully gave Kumāra a staff;

1.4.s:
garuḍo dayitaṃ putraṃ mayūraṃ citrabarhiṇam..
aruṇastāmracūḍaṃ ca pradadau caraṇāyudham.. 30.41 ..
1.4.d:
गरुडो दयितं पुत्रं मयूरं चित्रबर्हिणम्..
अरुणस्ताम्रचूडं च प्रददौ चरणायुधम्.. 30.41 ..
1.4.m: Garuḍa [gave] his beloved son, a peacock with colorful tail feathers; / Aruṇa bestowed a red-crested cock, whose feet are weapons;

1.4.s:
chāgaṃ ca varuṇo rājā balavīryasamanvitam..
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā brahmā brahmaṇyāya dadau jayam.. 30.42 ..
1.4.d:
छागं च वरुणो राजा बलवीर्यसमन्वितम्..
कृष्णाजिनं तथा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मण्याय ददौ जयम्.. 30.42 ..
1.4.m: King Varuṇa gave a goat endowed with power and vigor; / and Brahmā gave victory and a black antelope skin to the friend of brahmins;

1.4.s:
caturo'nucarāṃścaiva mahāvīryānbalotkaṭān..
naṃdisenaṃ lohitākṣaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ ca mānasān.. 30.43 ..
1.4.d:
चतुरोऽनुचरांश्चैव महावीर्यान्बलोत्कटान्..
नंदिसेनं लोहिताक्षं घण्टाकर्णं च मानसान्.. 30.43 ..
1.4.m: and [he gave] four mind-born attendants of great prowess and mighty strength: / Nandisena, Lohitākṣa, Ghaṇṭākarṇa,

1.4.s:
caturthaṃ cāpyatibalaṃ khyātaṃ kusumamālinam..
tataḥ sthāṇurdadau devo mahāpāriṣadaṃ kratum.. 30.44 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्थं चाप्यतिबलं ख्यातं कुसुममालिनम्..
ततः स्थाणुर्ददौ देवो महापारिषदं क्रतुम्.. 30.44 ..
1.4.m: and the fourth, known as Kusumamālin, exceedingly strong. / Then god Sthāṇu gave the great attendant Kratu,

1.4.s:
sa hi devāsure yuddhe daityānāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām..
jaghāna dorbhyāṃ saṃkruddhaḥ prayutāni caturdaśa.. 30.45 ..
1.4.d:
स हि देवासुरे युद्धे दैत्यानां भीमकर्मणाम्..
जघान दोर्भ्यां संक्रुद्धः प्रयुतानि चतुर्दश.. 30.45 ..
1.4.m: who, enraged in the battle between the gods and asuras, / slew with his two arms one million four hundred thousand Daityas of terrible deeds.

1.4.s:
yamaḥ prādādanucarau yamakālopamau tadā..
unmāthaṃ ca pramāthaṃ ca mahāvīryau mahādyutī.. 30.46 ..
1.4.d:
यमः प्रादादनुचरौ यमकालोपमौ तदा..
उन्माथं च प्रमाथं च महावीर्यौ महाद्युती.. 30.46 ..
1.4.m: Then Yama gave two attendants resembling Yama and death: / Unmātha and Pramātha, of great prowess and great splendor;

1.4.s:
subhrājau bhāskarasyaiva yau sadā cānuyāyinau..
tau sūryaḥ kārtikeyāya dadau pārtha mudānvitaḥ.. 30.47 ..
1.4.d:
सुभ्राजौ भास्करस्यैव यौ सदा चानुयायिनौ..
तौ सूर्यः कार्तिकेयाय ददौ पार्थ मुदान्वितः.. 30.47 ..
1.4.m: the Sun, filled with joy, O son of Pṛthā, gave to Kārttikeya / the very radiant pair who ever follow the sun;

1.4.s:
kailāsaśrṛṅgasaṃkāśau śvetamālyānulepanau..
somo'pyanucarau prādānmaṇiṃ sumaṇimeva ca.. 30.48 ..
1.4.d:
कैलासश्रृङ्गसंकाशौ श्वेतमाल्यानुलेपनौ..
सोमोऽप्यनुचरौ प्रादान्मणिं सुमणिमेव च.. 30.48 ..
1.4.m: resembling the peaks of Kailāsa, with white garlands and ointments, / Soma too gave two attendants: Maṇi and Sumaṇi;

1.4.s:
jvālajihvaṃ jyotiṣaṃ ca dadāvagnirmahābalau..
parighaṃ ca balaṃ caiva bhīmaṃ ca sumahābalam.. 30.49 ..
1.4.d:
ज्वालजिह्वं ज्योतिषं च ददावग्निर्महाबलौ..
परिघं च बलं चैव भीमं च सुमहाबलम्.. 30.49 ..
1.4.m: Agni gave the two of great strength: Jvālājihva and Jyotiṣa; / and Viṣṇu of wide strides gave three attendants to Skanda:

1.4.s:
skaṃdāya trīnanucarāndadau viṣṇururukramaḥ..
utkrośaṃ paṃcajaṃ caiva vajradaṇḍadharāvubhau.. 30.50 ..
1.4.d:
स्कंदाय त्रीननुचरान्ददौ विष्णुरुरुक्रमः..
उत्क्रोशं पंचजं चैव वज्रदण्डधरावुभौ.. 30.50 ..
1.4.m: Parigha, Bala, and the exceedingly strong Bhīma; / the slayer of enemy heroes, Indra, gave to the son of Maheśa

1.4.s:
dadau maheśaputrāya vāsavaḥ paravīrahā..
tau hi śatrūnmahendrasya jaghnatuḥ samare bahūn.. 30.51 ..
1.4.d:
ददौ महेशपुत्राय वासवः परवीरहा..
तौ हि शत्रून्महेन्द्रस्य जघ्नतुः समरे बहून्.. 30.51 ..
1.4.m: Utkrośa and Pañcaja, both bearing thunderbolts and staffs; / for those two had slain many enemies of the great Indra in battle;

1.4.s:
vardhanaṃ baṃdhanaṃ caiva āyurvedaviśāradau..
skandāya dadatuḥ prītāvaśvinau bharatarṣabha.. 30.52 ..
1.4.d:
वर्धनं बंधनं चैव आयुर्वेदविशारदौ..
स्कन्दाय ददतुः प्रीतावश्विनौ भरतर्षभ.. 30.52 ..
1.4.m: pleased, the two Aśvins, skilled in the science of medicine, / gave Vardhana and Bandhana to Skanda, O bull of the Bharatas;

1.4.s:
balaṃ cātibalaṃ caiva mahāvaktrau mahābalau..
pradadau kārtikeyāya vāyuścānucarāvubhau.. 30.53 ..
1.4.d:
बलं चातिबलं चैव महावक्त्रौ महाबलौ..
प्रददौ कार्तिकेयाय वायुश्चानुचरावुभौ.. 30.53 ..
1.4.m: Vāyu bestowed on Kārttikeya two attendants: / Bala and Atibala, large-mouthed and of great strength;

1.4.s:
ghasaṃ cātighasaṃ vīrau varuṇaśca dadau prabhuḥ..
suvarcasaṃ mahātmānaṃ tathaivāpyativarcasam.. 30.54 ..
1.4.d:
घसं चातिघसं वीरौ वरुणश्च ददौ प्रभुः..
सुवर्चसं महात्मानं तथैवाप्यतिवर्चसम्.. 30.54 ..
1.4.m: Lord Varuṇa gave two heroes: Ghasa and Atighasa; / Himavat bestowed, O son of Pṛthā, manifestly on his grandson

1.4.s:
himavānpradadau pārtha sākṣāddauhitrakāya vai..
kāṃcanaṃ ca dadau merurmeghamālinameva ca.. 30.55 ..
1.4.d:
हिमवान्प्रददौ पार्थ साक्षाद्दौहित्रकाय वै..
कांचनं च ददौ मेरुर्मेघमालिनमेव च.. 30.55 ..
1.4.m: the magnanimous Suvarcas and likewise Ativarcas; / Meru gave Kāñcana and Meghamālin;

1.4.s:
ucchritaṃ cātiśṛṃgaṃ ca mahāpāṣāṇayodhinau..
svāheyāya dadau prītaḥ sa viṃdhyaḥ pārṣadau śubhau.. 30.56 ..
1.4.d:
उच्छ्रितं चातिशृंगं च महापाषाणयोधिनौ..
स्वाहेयाय ददौ प्रीतः स विंध्यः पार्षदौ शुभौ.. 30.56 ..
1.4.m: and, pleased, the Vindhya gave two auspicious attendants who fight with great boulders / to the son of Svāhā: Ucchrita and Atiśṛṅga.

1.4.s:
saṃgrahaṃ vigrahaṃ caiva samudro'pi gadhādharau..
pradadau pārṣadau virau mahīnadyā samanvitaḥ.. 30.57 ..
1.4.d:
संग्रहं विग्रहं चैव समुद्रोऽपि गधाधरौ..
प्रददौ पार्षदौ विरौ महीनद्या समन्वितः.. 30.57 ..
1.4.m: The ocean too, accompanied by the river Mahī, gave two heroic attendants, / Saṃgraha and Vigraha, both wielding maces.

1.4.s:
unmādaṃ puṣpadaṃtaṃ ca śaṃkukarṇaṃ tathaiva ca..
pradadāvagniputrāya pārvatī śubhadarśanā.. 30.58 ..
1.4.d:
उन्मादं पुष्पदंतं च शंकुकर्णं तथैव च..
प्रददावग्निपुत्राय पार्वती शुभदर्शना.. 30.58 ..
1.4.m: Pārvatī of auspicious appearance gave Unmāda, Puṣpadanta, / and likewise Śaṅkukarṇa to the son of Agni.

1.4.s:
jayaṃ mahājayaṃ caiva nāgau jvalanasūnave..
pradadurbalināṃ śreṣṭhau suparṇaḥ pārṣadāvubhau.. 30.59 ..
1.4.d:
जयं महाजयं चैव नागौ ज्वलनसूनवे..
प्रददुर्बलिनां श्रेष्ठौ सुपर्णः पार्षदावुभौ.. 30.59 ..
1.4.m: The two serpents Jaya and Mahājaya, best among the strong, / [and] Suparṇa both gave two attendants to the fire-born son.

1.4.s:
evaṃ sādhyāśca rudrāśca vasavaḥ pitarastathā..
sarve jagati ye mukhyā daduḥ skaṃdāya pārṣadān.. 30.60 ..
1.4.d:
एवं साध्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवः पितरस्तथा..
सर्वे जगति ये मुख्या ददुः स्कंदाय पार्षदान्.. 30.60 ..
1.4.m: Thus the Sādhyas, the Rudras, the Vasus, and the ancestors, / indeed all who are foremost in the world, gave attendants to Skanda.

1.4.s:
nānāvīryānmahāvīryānnānāyudhavibhūṣaṇān..
bahulatvānna śakyaṃte saṃkhyātuṃ te ca phālguna.. 30.61 ..
1.4.d:
नानावीर्यान्महावीर्यान्नानायुधविभूषणान्..
बहुलत्वान्न शक्यंते संख्यातुं ते च फाल्गुन.. 30.61 ..
1.4.m: Possessed of various prowess, of great heroism, adorned with diverse weapons— / because of their vast number, O Phālguna, they cannot be counted.

1.4.s:
mātaśca dadustasmai tadā mātṛgaṇānprabho..
yābhirvyāptāstrayo lokāḥ kalyāṇībhiścarācarāḥ.. 30.62 ..
1.4.d:
मातश्च ददुस्तस्मै तदा मातृगणान्प्रभो..
याभिर्व्याप्तास्त्रयो लोकाः कल्याणीभिश्चराचराः.. 30.62 ..
1.4.m: And the mothers then gave him hosts of mothers, O lord, / auspicious ones by whom the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings are pervaded:

1.4.s:
prabhāvatī viśālākṣī gopālā gonasā tathā..
apsujātā bṛhaddaṃḍī kālikā bahuputrakā.. 30.63 ..
1.4.d:
प्रभावती विशालाक्षी गोपाला गोनसा तथा..
अप्सुजाता बृहद्दंडी कालिका बहुपुत्रका.. 30.63 ..
1.4.m: Prabhāvatī, Viśālākṣī, Gopālā, Gonadā likewise, / Apsujātā, Bṛhaddaṇḍī, Kālikā, Bahuputrakā,

1.4.s:
bhayaṃkarī ca cakrāṃgī tīrthanemiśca mādhavī..
gītapriyā alātākṣī caṭulā śalabhāmukhī.. 30.64 ..
1.4.d:
भयंकरी च चक्रांगी तीर्थनेमिश्च माधवी..
गीतप्रिया अलाताक्षी चटुला शलभामुखी.. 30.64 ..
1.4.m: Bhayaṃkarī and Cakrāṅgī, Tīrthanemi, and Mādhavī, / Gītapriyā, Alātākṣī, Caṭulā, Śalabhāmukhī,

1.4.s:
vidyujjihvā rudrakālī śatolūkhalamekhalā..
śataghaṃṭākiṃkiṇikā cakrākṣī catvarālayā.. 30.65 ..
1.4.d:
विद्युज्जिह्वा रुद्रकाली शतोलूखलमेखला..
शतघंटाकिंकिणिका चक्राक्षी चत्वरालया.. 30.65 ..
1.4.m: Vidyujjihvā, Rudrakālī, Śatolūkhalamekhalā, / Śataghaṇṭākiṅkiṇikā, Cakrākṣī, Catvarālayā,

1.4.s:
pūtanā rodanā tvāmā koṭarā meghavāhinī..
ūrdhvaveṇīdharā caiva jarāyurjarjarānanā.. 30.66 ..
1.4.d:
पूतना रोदना त्वामा कोटरा मेघवाहिनी..
ऊर्ध्ववेणीधरा चैव जरायुर्जर्जरानना.. 30.66 ..
1.4.m: Pūtanā, Rodanā, Āmā, Koṭarā, Meghavāhinī, / Ūrdhvaveṇīdharā, and Jarāyu, Jarjarānanā,

1.4.s:
khaṭakheṭī dahadahā tathā dhamadhamā jayā..
bahuveṇī bahuśīrā bahupādā bahustanī.. 30.67 ..
1.4.d:
खटखेटी दहदहा तथा धमधमा जया..
बहुवेणी बहुशीरा बहुपादा बहुस्तनी.. 30.67 ..
1.4.m: Khaṭakheṭī, Dahadahā, likewise Dhamadhamā, Jayā, / Bahuveṇī, Bahuśīrā, Bahupādā, Bahustanī,

1.4.s:
śatolūkamukhī kṛṣṇā karṇaprāvaraṇā tathā..
śūnyālayā dhānyavāsā paśudā dhānyadā sadā.. 30.68 ..
1.4.d:
शतोलूकमुखी कृष्णा कर्णप्रावरणा तथा..
शून्यालया धान्यवासा पशुदा धान्यदा सदा.. 30.68 ..
1.4.m: Śatolūkamukhī, Kṛṣṇā, Karṇaprāvaraṇā likewise, / Śūnyālayā, Dhānyavāsā, Paśudā, and constantly Dhānyadā.

1.4.s:
etāścānyāśca bahvyaśca mātaro bharatarṣabha..
bahulatvādahaṃ tāsāṃ na saṃkhyātumihotsahe.. 30.69 ..
1.4.d:
एताश्चान्याश्च बह्व्यश्च मातरो भरतर्षभ..
बहुलत्वादहं तासां न संख्यातुमिहोत्सहे.. 30.69 ..
1.4.m: These and many other mothers, O bull of the Bharatas— / because of their great number, I do not venture to count them here.

1.4.s:
vṛkṣacatvaravāsinyaścatuṣpathaniveśanāḥ..
guhāsmaśānavāsinyaḥ śailaprasravaṇālayāḥ.. 30.70 ..
1.4.d:
वृक्षचत्वरवासिन्यश्चतुष्पथनिवेशनाः..
गुहास्मशानवासिन्यः शैलप्रस्रवणालयाः.. 30.70 ..
1.4.m: Dwelling in trees and courtyards, having their homes at crossroads, / dwelling in caves and cremation grounds, having mountain cascades for their abode,

1.4.s:
nānābharaṇaveṣāstā nānāmūrtidharāstathā..
nānābhāṣāyudhadharāḥ parivavrustadā guham.. 30.71 ..
1.4.d:
नानाभरणवेषास्ता नानामूर्तिधरास्तथा..
नानाभाषायुधधराः परिवव्रुस्तदा गुहम्.. 30.71 ..
1.4.m: bearing diverse ornaments and attire, displaying diverse forms, / speaking diverse languages and bearing diverse weapons, they then surrounded Guha.

1.4.s:
tataḥ sa śuśubhe śrīmānguho guha ivāparaḥ..
saināpatye cābhiṣikto devairnānāmunīśvaraiḥ.. 30.72 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स शुशुभे श्रीमान्गुहो गुह इवापरः..
सैनापत्ये चाभिषिक्तो देवैर्नानामुनीश्वरैः.. 30.72 ..
1.4.m: Then glorious Guha shone like another Guha, / consecrated to the commandership of the army by the gods and various lords of sages.

1.4.s:
tataḥ praṇamya sarvāṃstā nekaikatvena pāvakiḥ..
vriyatāṃ vara ityāha bhavabrahmapurogamān.. 30.73 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kārtikeyasya senānītve'bhiṣekavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 30 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रणम्य सर्वांस्ता नेकैकत्वेन पावकिः..
व्रियतां वर इत्याह भवब्रह्मपुरोगमान्.. 30.73 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कार्तिकेयस्य सेनानीत्वेऽभिषेकवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 30 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Then, having bowed to all of them one by one, the son of the Fire-god / said to those led by Bhava and Brahmā: “Let a boon be chosen!”
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, titled “Description of Kārttikeya's Consecration to the Commandership of the Army,” in the Kumāreśvaramāhātmya of the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa, in the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
te cainaṃ yojya cāśīrbhirayācaṃta varaṃ guham..
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yatpāpaṃ tārakaṃ jahi.. 31.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ते चैनं योज्य चाशीर्भिरयाचंत वरं गुहम्..
एष एव वरोऽस्माकं यत्पापं तारकं जहि.. 31.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / And having joined him with blessings, they asked a boon of Guha: / “This alone is our boon: slay the wicked Tāraka!”

1.4.s:
evamastviti tānuktvā yogoyoga iti bruvan..
tārakārimahātejā mayūraṃ cādhyarohata.. 31.2 ..
1.4.d:
एवमस्त्विति तानुक्त्वा योगोयोग इति ब्रुवन्..
तारकारिमहातेजा मयूरं चाध्यरोहत.. 31.2 ..
1.4.m: Having said to them, “So be it,” and declaring “Preparation! Preparation!”, / the enemy of Tāraka, possessed of great splendor, mounted the peacock.

1.4.s:
śaktihasto vinadyātha guho devāṃstadābravīt..
yadyadya tārakaṃ pāpaṃ nāhaṃ hanmi surottamāḥ.. 31.3 ..
1.4.d:
शक्तिहस्तो विनद्याथ गुहो देवांस्तदाब्रवीत्..
यद्यद्य तारकं पापं नाहं हन्मि सुरोत्तमाः.. 31.3 ..
1.4.m: Spear in hand, having roared, Guha then addressed the gods: / “If today I do not slay the wicked Tāraka, O best of the gods,

1.4.s:
gobrāhmaṇāvamantṝṇāṃ tato yāmi gatiṃ sphuṭam..
evaṃ tena pratijñāte śabdo'tisumahānabhūt.. 31.4 ..
1.4.d:
गोब्राह्मणावमन्तॄणां ततो यामि गतिं स्फुटम्..
एवं तेन प्रतिज्ञाते शब्दोऽतिसुमहानभूत्.. 31.4 ..
1.4.m: then clearly I shall go to the destination of those who insult cows and brahmins!” / When this vow was made by him, an exceedingly great roar arose.

1.4.s:
yogoyoga iti prāhurājñayā śarajanmanaḥ..
arajo vāsasī rakte vasānaḥ pārvatīsutaḥ.. 31.5 ..
1.4.d:
योगोयोग इति प्राहुराज्ञया शरजन्मनः..
अरजो वाससी रक्ते वसानः पार्वतीसुतः.. 31.5 ..
1.4.m: “Preparation! Preparation!” they shouted at the command of the reed-born god. / Clothed in two dustless red garments, the son of Pārvatī,

1.4.s:
athāgre sarvadevānāṃ sthito vīro yayau mudā..
tasya keturalaṃ bhāti caraṇāyudhaśobhitaḥ.. 31.6 ..
1.4.d:
अथाग्रे सर्वदेवानां स्थितो वीरो ययौ मुदा..
तस्य केतुरलं भाति चरणायुधशोभितः.. 31.6 ..
1.4.m: standing at the head of all the gods, the hero went forth with joy. / His banner shone brightly, adorned with a rooster.

1.4.s:
caraṇābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ girīñchakto yo vidārayituṃ raṇe..
yā ceṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhā śāṃtirbalaṃ yathā.. 31.7 ..
1.4.d:
चरणाभ्यां चरणाभ्यां गिरीञ्छक्तो यो विदारयितुं रणे..
या चेष्टा सर्वभूतानां प्रभा शांतिर्बलं यथा.. 31.7 ..
1.4.m: He who was capable of splitting mountains with both feet in battle— / whatever activity, radiance, tranquil strength all living beings have,

1.4.s:
tanmayā guhaśaktiḥ sā bhṛśaṃ haste vyarocata..
yaddārḍhyaṃ sarvalokeṣu tanmayaṃ kavacaṃ tathā.. 31.8 ..
1.4.d:
तन्मया गुहशक्तिः सा भृशं हस्ते व्यरोचत..
यद्दार्ढ्यं सर्वलोकेषु तन्मयं कवचं तथा.. 31.8 ..
1.4.m: composed of that, that spear of Guha shone intensely in his hand. / Whatever firmness exists in all the worlds, an armor composed of that

1.4.s:
yotsyamānasya vīrasya deheprādurabhūtsvayam..
dharmaḥ satyamasaṃmohastejaḥ kāṃtatvamakṣatiḥ.. 31.9 ..
1.4.d:
योत्स्यमानस्य वीरस्य देहेप्रादुरभूत्स्वयम्..
धर्मः सत्यमसंमोहस्तेजः कांतत्वमक्षतिः.. 31.9 ..
1.4.m: manifested of its own accord upon the body of the hero about to fight. / Righteousness, truth, freedom from delusion, splendor, charm, invulnerability,

1.4.s:
balamojaḥ kṛpā cava baddhā karayugaṃ tathā..
ādeśakārīṇyagre'sya svayaṃ tasthurmahātmanaḥ.. 31.10 ..
1.4.d:
बलमोजः कृपा चव बद्धा करयुगं तथा..
आदेशकारीण्यग्रेऽस्य स्वयं तस्थुर्महात्मनः.. 31.10 ..
1.4.m: might, vigor, and compassion, with folded hands, / carrying out his orders, stood of their own accord before that great-souled one.

1.4.s:
tamagre cāpi gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhatonuyayau haraḥ..
rathenādityavarṇena pārvatyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ.. 31.11 ..
1.4.d:
तमग्रे चापि गच्छंतं पृष्ठतोनुययौ हरः..
रथेनादित्यवर्णेन पार्वत्या सहितः प्रभुः.. 31.11 ..
1.4.m: And as he went ahead, Hara followed behind him, / the lord along with Pārvatī on a sun-colored chariot

1.4.s:
nirmitena hareṇaiva svayamīśena līlayā..
sahasraṃ tasya siṃhānāṃ tasminyuktaṃ rathottame.. 31.12 ..
1.4.d:
निर्मितेन हरेणैव स्वयमीशेन लीलया..
सहस्रं तस्य सिंहानां तस्मिन्युक्तं रथोत्तमे.. 31.12 ..
1.4.m: fashioned in play by Hara himself, the sovereign Lord. / A thousand lions were yoked to that supreme chariot.

1.4.s:
abhīṣūnpuruṣavyāghra brahmā ca jagṛhe svayam..
te pibaṃta ivākāśaṃ trāsayaṃtaścarācaram.. 31.13 ..
1.4.d:
अभीषून्पुरुषव्याघ्र ब्रह्मा च जगृहे स्वयम्..
ते पिबंत इवाकाशं त्रासयंतश्चराचरम्.. 31.13 ..
1.4.m: Brahmā himself, O tiger among men, held the reins. / As if drinking the sky, terrifying moving and unmoving beings,

1.4.s:
siṃhā rathasya gacchaṃto nadaṃtaścārukesarāḥ..
tasminrathe paśupatiḥ sthito bhātyumayā saha.. 31.14 ..
1.4.d:
सिंहा रथस्य गच्छंतो नदंतश्चारुकेसराः..
तस्मिन्रथे पशुपतिः स्थितो भात्युमया सह.. 31.14 ..
1.4.m: the lions of the chariot advanced, roaring, with beautiful manes. / Paśupati, standing upon that chariot together with Umā, shone

1.4.s:
vidyutā meḍitaḥ sūryaḥ seṃdracāpaghano yathā..
agratastasya bhagavāndhaneśo guhyakaiḥ saha.. 31.15 ..
1.4.d:
विद्युता मेडितः सूर्यः सेंद्रचापघनो यथा..
अग्रतस्तस्य भगवान्धनेशो गुह्यकैः सह.. 31.15 ..
1.4.m: like the sun enveloped by lightning, like a cloud with a rainbow. / In front of him, the blessed lord of wealth, along with the Guhyakas,

1.4.s:
āsthāya ruciraṃ yāti puṣpakaṃ naravāhanaḥ..
airāvaṇaṃ samāstāya śakraścāpi suraiḥ saha.. 31.16 ..
1.4.d:
आस्थाय रुचिरं याति पुष्पकं नरवाहनः..
ऐरावणं समास्ताय शक्रश्चापि सुरैः सह.. 31.16 ..
1.4.m: having mounted the splendid Puṣpaka, rode, borne by a man. / Śakra too, having mounted Airāvaṇa, together with the gods,

1.4.s:
pṛṣṭhatonuyayau yāṃtaṃ varadaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam..
tasya dakṣiṇato devā marutaścitrayodhinaḥ.. 31.17 ..
1.4.d:
पृष्ठतोनुययौ यांतं वरदं वृषभध्वजम्..
तस्य दक्षिणतो देवा मरुतश्चित्रयोधिनः.. 31.17 ..
1.4.m: followed behind the boon-granting bull-bannered god as he went. / To his right, the Maruts, gods of wondrous warfare,

1.4.s:
gacchaṃti vasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiśca saha saṃgatāḥ..
yamaśca mṛtyunā sārdhaṃ sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ.. 31.18 ..
1.4.d:
गच्छंति वसुभिः सार्धं रुद्रैश्च सह संगताः..
यमश्च मृत्युना सार्धं सर्वतः परिवारितः.. 31.18 ..
1.4.m: advanced along with the Vasus, united with the Rudras. / And Yama, accompanied by Death, surrounded on all sides

1.4.s:
ghorairvyādhiśataiścāpi savyato yāti kopitaḥ..
yamasya pṛṣṭhataścāpi ghorastriśikharaḥ sitaḥ.. 31.19 ..
1.4.d:
घोरैर्व्याधिशतैश्चापि सव्यतो याति कोपितः..
यमस्य पृष्ठतश्चापि घोरस्त्रिशिखरः सितः.. 31.19 ..
1.4.m: by hundreds of terrible diseases, proceeded on the left in wrath. / And behind Yama went the trident called Vijaya,

1.4.s:
vijayonāma rudrasya yāti śūlaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ..
tamugrapāśo bhagavanvaruṇaḥ salileśvaraḥ.. 31.20 ..
1.4.d:
विजयोनाम रुद्रस्य याति शूलः स्वयं कृतः..
तमुग्रपाशो भगवन्वरुणः सलिलेश्वरः.. 31.20 ..
1.4.m: fashioned by Rudra himself, terrible, three-pronged, and white. / Surrounding it by hundreds, the blessed Varuṇa, lord of waters, bearing a dreadful noose,

1.4.s:
parivārya śataiyāti yādobhirvividhairvṛtaḥ..
pṛṣṭhato vijayasyāpi yāti rudrasya paṭṭiśaḥ.. 31.21 ..
1.4.d:
परिवार्य शतैयाति यादोभिर्विविधैर्वृतः..
पृष्ठतो विजयस्यापि याति रुद्रस्य पट्टिशः.. 31.21 ..
1.4.m: went forth, surrounded by diverse aquatic creatures. / And behind Vijaya went Rudra's paṭṭiśa,

1.4.s:
gadāmuśalaśaktyādyairvarapraharaṇairvṛtaḥ..
paṭṭiśaṃ cānvagātpārtha astraṃ pāśupataṃ mahat.. 31.22 ..
1.4.d:
गदामुशलशक्त्याद्यैर्वरप्रहरणैर्वृतः..
पट्टिशं चान्वगात्पार्थ अस्त्रं पाशुपतं महत्.. 31.22 ..
1.4.m: surrounded by excellent weapons: maces, clubs, spears, and others. / And the great Pāśupata weapon, O Pārtha, followed the paṭṭiśa:

1.4.s:
bahuśīrṣaṃ mahāghoramekapādaṃ bahūdaram..
kamaṃḍaluścāsya paścānmaharṣigaṇasevitaḥ.. 31.23 ..
1.4.d:
बहुशीर्षं महाघोरमेकपादं बहूदरम्..
कमंडलुश्चास्य पश्चान्महर्षिगणसेवितः.. 31.23 ..
1.4.m: many-headed, exceedingly terrible, single-footed, and multi-bellied. / And behind it was his water-pot, attended by hosts of great seers.

1.4.s:
tasya dakṣiṇato bhāti daṇḍo gacchañchriyā vṛtaḥ..
bhṛgvaṃgirobhiḥ sahito devairapya bhipūjitaḥ.. 31.24 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य दक्षिणतो भाति दण्डो गच्छञ्छ्रिया वृतः..
भृग्वंगिरोभिः सहितो देवैरप्य भिपूजितः.. 31.24 ..
1.4.m: To its right shone the staff, proceeding surrounded with majesty, / accompanied by the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases, revered even by the gods.

1.4.s:
rākṣasāścānyadevāśca gandharvā bhujagāstathā..
nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca munayo'psarasāṃ gaṇāḥ.. 31.25 ..
1.4.d:
राक्षसाश्चान्यदेवाश्च गन्धर्वा भुजगास्तथा..
नद्यो नदाः समुद्राश्च मुनयोऽप्सरसां गणाः.. 31.25 ..
1.4.m: Rākṣasas and other gods, gandharvas, serpents likewise, / rivers, streams, and oceans, sages, and troops of apsarases,

1.4.s:
nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva jaṃgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā..
mātaraśca mahādevamanujagmuḥ kṣudhānvitāḥ.. 31.26 ..
1.4.d:
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव जंगमं स्थावरं तथा..
मातरश्च महादेवमनुजग्मुः क्षुधान्विताः.. 31.26 ..
1.4.m: lunar mansions and planets, the moving and the unmoving, / and the mothers, gripped by hunger, followed Mahādeva.

1.4.s:
sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhataścāsīttārkṣyastho buddhimānhariḥ..
pālayanpṛtanāṃ sarvāṃ svaparīvārasaṃvṛtaḥ.. 31.27 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वेषां पृष्ठतश्चासीत्तार्क्ष्यस्थो बुद्धिमान्हरिः..
पालयन्पृतनां सर्वां स्वपरीवारसंवृतः.. 31.27 ..
1.4.m: And behind everyone came wise Hari, mounted on Tārkṣya, / protecting the entire army, surrounded by his own retinue.

1.4.s:
evaṃ sainyasamopeta uttaraṃ taṭamāgataḥ..
tāmraprākāramāśritya tasthau tryaṃbakanaṃdanaḥ.. 31.28 ..
1.4.d:
एवं सैन्यसमोपेत उत्तरं तटमागतः..
ताम्रप्राकारमाश्रित्य तस्थौ त्र्यंबकनंदनः.. 31.28 ..
1.4.m: Thus accompanied by the army, having arrived at the northern bank, / the son of Tryambaka halted, taking his position by the copper rampart.

1.4.s:
sa tārakapurasyāpi paśyanṛddhi manuttamām..
visiṣmiye mahāsenaḥ praśaśaṃsa tapo'sya ca.. 31.29 ..
1.4.d:
स तारकपुरस्यापि पश्यनृद्धि मनुत्तमाम्..
विसिष्मिये महासेनः प्रशशंस तपोऽस्य च.. 31.29 ..
1.4.m: Beholding the incomparable prosperity of Tāraka's city, / Mahāsena was astonished, and he praised his austerity.

1.4.s:
sthitaḥ paśyansa śuśubhe mayūrastho guhastadā..
chatreṇa dhriyamāṇena svayaṃ somasamastviṣā.. 31.30 ..
1.4.d:
स्थितः पश्यन्स शुशुभे मयूरस्थो गुहस्तदा..
छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन स्वयं सोमसमस्त्विषा.. 31.30 ..
1.4.m: Stationed upon his peacock, Guha shone then as he gazed, / under a parasol held above him, himself resembling the moon in brilliance,

1.4.s:
vījyamānaścāmarābhyāṃ vāyvagribhyāṃ mahādyutiḥ..
mātṛbhiśca surairdattaiḥ svairgaṇairapi saṃvṛtaḥ.. 31.31 ..
1.4.d:
वीज्यमानश्चामराभ्यां वाय्वग्रिभ्यां महाद्युतिः..
मातृभिश्च सुरैर्दत्तैः स्वैर्गणैरपि संवृतः.. 31.31 ..
1.4.m: fanned with two chowries by Vāyu and Agni, possessing great splendor, / surrounded by the Mothers, by [gods] given by the gods, and by his own attendants.

1.4.s:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ śakro deva madhye vaco'bravīt..
paśyapaśya mahāsena daityānāṃ balaśālinām.. 31.32 ..
1.4.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तं शक्रो देव मध्ये वचोऽब्रवीत्..
पश्यपश्य महासेन दैत्यानां बलशालिनाम्.. 31.32 ..
1.4.m: Then Śakra, bowing down to him amidst the gods, said these words: / 'Behold, behold, O Mahāsena, [the city] of the mighty Daityas,

1.4.s:
ye tvāṃ kālaṃ na jānaṃti martyā gṛharatā iva..
eteṣāṃ ca gṛhe dūto yastvāṃ śaṃsatu tārakam.. 31.33 ..
1.4.d:
ये त्वां कालं न जानंति मर्त्या गृहरता इव..
एतेषां च गृहे दूतो यस्त्वां शंसतु तारकम्.. 31.33 ..
1.4.m: who do not recognize you as Death, like mortals attached to their homes! / Let a messenger go to their home who may proclaim you to Tāraka.

1.4.s:
vīrāṇāmucitaṃ tvetatkīrtidaṃ ca mahājane..
anujñayā tataḥ skandabhaktaṃ śakro dhanaṃjaya.. 31.34 ..
1.4.d:
वीराणामुचितं त्वेतत्कीर्तिदं च महाजने..
अनुज्ञया ततः स्कन्दभक्तं शक्रो धनंजय.. 31.34 ..
1.4.m: For this is fitting for heroes, and it brings renown among the great.' / Thereupon, with [Skanda's] permission, Śakra, O Dhanañjaya, [spoke to me,] Skanda's devotee;

1.4.s:
māmādiśyāsurendrāya prāhiṇoddautyayogyakam..
ahaṃ svayaṃ gantukāmaḥ śakreṇāpi ca preṣitaḥ.. 31.35 ..
1.4.d:
मामादिश्यासुरेन्द्राय प्राहिणोद्दौत्ययोग्यकम्..
अहं स्वयं गन्तुकामः शक्रेणापि च प्रेषितः.. 31.35 ..
1.4.m: instructing me, fit for an embassy, he dispatched me to the king of the Asuras. / Desiring to go myself, and also sent by Śakra,

1.4.s:
prāsāde strīsahasrāṇāṃ prāvocaṃ madhyato'pyaham..
asurādhamadurbuddhe śakrastvāmāha tacchṛṇu.. 31.36 ..
1.4.d:
प्रासादे स्त्रीसहस्राणां प्रावोचं मध्यतोऽप्यहम्..
असुराधमदुर्बुद्धे शक्रस्त्वामाह तच्छृणु.. 31.36 ..
1.4.m: in the palace, even in the midst of thousands of women, I spoke: / 'O lowest of Asuras, evil-minded one, Śakra speaks to you; listen to this!

1.4.s:
yajjagaddalanādāptaṃ kilbiṣaṃ dānava tvayā..
tasyāhaṃ nāśakaste'dya puruṣaścedbhaviṣyasi.. 31.37 ..
1.4.d:
यज्जगद्दलनादाप्तं किल्बिषं दानव त्वया..
तस्याहं नाशकस्तेऽद्य पुरुषश्चेद्भविष्यसि.. 31.37 ..
1.4.m: The guilt that was incurred by you, O Dānava, from crushing the world— / I am the destroyer of that for you today, if you will act like a man!

1.4.s:
śīghraṃ niḥsara pāpiṣṭha niḥsariṣyasi cenna hi..
kṣaṇāttava puraṃ kṣepsye pāvitryāyaiva sāgare.. 31.38 ..
1.4.d:
शीघ्रं निःसर पापिष्ठ निःसरिष्यसि चेन्न हि..
क्षणात्तव पुरं क्षेप्स्ये पावित्र्यायैव सागरे.. 31.38 ..
1.4.m: Come out quickly, most wicked one! If you do not come out, / in a moment I will cast your city into the ocean for its purification!'

1.4.s:
iti śrutvā rūkṣavācaṃ kruddhaḥ strīgaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ..
muṣṭimudyamyamā'dhāvadbhītaścāhaṃ palāyitaḥ.. 31.39 ..
1.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा रूक्षवाचं क्रुद्धः स्त्रीगणसंवृतः..
मुष्टिमुद्यम्यमाऽधावद्भीतश्चाहं पलायितः.. 31.39 ..
1.4.m: Hearing these harsh words, enraged, surrounded by a host of women, / he ran at me with raised fist, and I fled in fear.

1.4.s:
vyākulastatra vṛttāṃtaṃ kumārāya nyavedayam..
mayi cāpyāgate daityaściṃtayāmāsa cetasi.. 31.40 ..
1.4.d:
व्याकुलस्तत्र वृत्तांतं कुमाराय न्यवेदयम्..
मयि चाप्यागते दैत्यश्चिंतयामास चेतसि.. 31.40 ..
1.4.m: Agitated, I reported the incident there to Kumāra; / and when I had gone, the Daitya reflected in his mind:

1.4.s:
nālabdha saṃśrayaḥ śakro vaktumetadihārhati..
nimittāni ca ghorāṇi saṃtrāsaṃ janayaṃti me.. 31.41 ..
1.4.d:
नालब्ध संश्रयः शक्रो वक्तुमेतदिहार्हति..
निमित्तानि च घोराणि संत्रासं जनयंति मे.. 31.41 ..
1.4.m: 'Without having found a refuge, Śakra would not be fit to say this here; / and terrible omens produce terror in me.'

1.4.s:
evaṃ viciṃtya cotthāya gavākṣaṃ sodhyarohata..
sahasrabhaumikāvāsaśrṛṅgavātāyanasthitaḥ.. 31.42 ..
1.4.d:
एवं विचिंत्य चोत्थाय गवाक्षं सोध्यरोहत..
सहस्रभौमिकावासश्रृङ्गवातायनस्थितः.. 31.42 ..
1.4.m: Having reflected thus and arisen, he climbed up to an oriel window; / stationed at the window on the summit of his thousand-storied dwelling,

1.4.s:
apaśyaddevasainyaṃ sa divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca saṃvṛtam..
ratairgajairhayaiścāpi nāditāśca diśo daśa.. 31.43 ..
1.4.d:
अपश्यद्देवसैन्यं स दिवं भूमिं च संवृतम्..
रतैर्गजैर्हयैश्चापि नादिताश्च दिशो दश.. 31.43 ..
1.4.m: he beheld the army of the gods covering heaven and earth, / and the ten directions resounding with chariots, elephants, and horses,

1.4.s:
vimānaiścādbhutākāraiḥ kiṃnarodgītanāditaiḥ..
dundubhibhirgoviṣāṇaistālaiḥ śaṃkhaiśca nāditaiḥ.. 31.44 ..
1.4.d:
विमानैश्चाद्भुताकारैः किंनरोद्गीतनादितैः..
दुन्दुभिभिर्गोविषाणैस्तालैः शंखैश्च नादितैः.. 31.44 ..
1.4.m: with aerial chariots of wondrous forms resplendent with the song of Kinnaras, / and noisy with kettle-drums, cow-horns, cymbals, and conches.

1.4.s:
akṣobhyāmiva tāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā so'ciṃtayattadā..
ete mayā jitāḥ pūrvaṃ kasmādbhūyaḥ samāgatāḥ.. 31.45 ..
1.4.d:
अक्षोभ्यामिव तां सेनां दृष्ट्वा सोऽचिंतयत्तदा..
एते मया जिताः पूर्वं कस्माद्भूयः समागताः.. 31.45 ..
1.4.m: Seeing that army, unshakeable as it were, he then thought: / 'These were conquered by me before; why have they come together again?'

1.4.s:
iti ciṃtāparo daityaḥ śuśrāva kaṭukākṣaram..
devabaṃdibhirudvuṣṭaṃ ghoraṃ hṛdayadāraṇam.. 31.46 ..
1.4.d:
इति चिंतापरो दैत्यः शुश्राव कटुकाक्षरम्..
देवबंदिभिरुद्वुष्टं घोरं हृदयदारणम्.. 31.46 ..
1.4.m: While the Daitya was thus absorbed in thought, he heard bitter words / chanted by the bards of the gods, dread and heart-rending:

1.4.s: jayātu laśaktidīdhitipiṃjararucāruṇamaṃḍalabhujodbhāsitadevasainya puravanakumudakānanavikāsaneṃdo kumāranātha jaya ditikulamahodadhivaḍavānala madhuraravamayūraravāsuramukuṭakūṭakuṭṭitacaraṇanakhāṃkura mahāsena tārakavaṃśaśuṣkatṛmadāvānala yogīśvarayaॉ yogijanahṛdayagaganavitataciṃtāsaṃtānasaṃtamasanodanakharakiraṇakalpanakhanikaravirājitacaraṇakamala skanda jaya bāla saptavāsara bhuvanāvaliśokasaṃdahana.. 31.47 ..
1.4.d: जयातु लशक्तिदीधितिपिंजररुचारुणमंडलभुजोद्भासितदेवसैन्य पुरवनकुमुदकाननविकासनेंदो कुमारनाथ जय दितिकुलमहोदधिवडवानल मधुररवमयूररवासुरमुकुटकूटकुट्टितचरणनखांकुर महासेन तारकवंशशुष्कतृमदावानल योगीश्वरयॉ योगिजनहृदयगगनविततचिंतासंतानसंतमसनोदनखरकिरणकल्पनखनिकरविराजितचरणकमल स्कन्द जय बाल सप्तवासर भुवनावलिशोकसंदहन.. 31.47 ..
1.4.m: 'Victory to the commander of the Kumāras, who illuminates the army of the gods with the red disc of his arms shining with the luster of the flashes of his peerless spear, the moon making bloom the groves of white water-lilies of the city's gardens! Victory, O submarine fire to the great ocean of Diti's race, whose foot-sprouts of nails are crushed against the tops of the diadems of the Asuras roaring like sweet-sounding peacocks, Mahāsena, forest fire to the dry grass of the line of Tāraka, lord of yogins, whose lotus feet are adorned with a cluster of nails that act like sharp rays driving away the deep darkness of the chain of anxious thoughts spread across the sky of the hearts of yogins, Skanda! Victory, O child of seven days, consumer of the grief of the worlds!'

1.4.s:
namo namastestu manoramāya namostu te sādhubhayāpahāya..
namostu te bālakṛtācalāya namonamo nāśaya devaśatrūn.. 31.48 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kumārasya tārakāsunaranagaraṃ prati gamanavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 31 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
नमो नमस्तेस्तु मनोरमाय नमोस्तु ते साधुभयापहाय..
नमोस्तु ते बालकृताचलाय नमोनमो नाशय देवशत्रून्.. 31.48 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कुमारस्य तारकासुनरनगरं प्रति गमनवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 31 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
'Homage, homage be to you, the delightful one! Homage be to you, the remover of fear for the virtuous! / Homage be to you, who made mountains firm while a boy! Homage, homage! Destroy the enemies of the gods!'
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, titled 'Description of Kumāra's March to the City of the Asura Tāraka,' in the Kumāreśvaramāhātmya of the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa, in the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
śrutvaitaṃ saṃstavaṃ daityaḥ saṃghuṣṭaṃ devabaṃdibhiḥ..
sasmāra brahmaṇo vākyaṃ vadhaṃ bālādupasthitam.. 32.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
श्रुत्वैतं संस्तवं दैत्यः संघुष्टं देवबंदिभिः..
सस्मार ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं वधं बालादुपस्थितम्.. 32.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Hearing this hymn of praise proclaimed by the bards of the gods, / the Daitya remembered Brahmā's statement that his death would come from a child.

1.4.s:
śrutvā sa klinnasarvāṃgo dvāḥsthaṃ rājā vaco'bravīt..
amātyāndraṣṭumicchāmi śīghramānaya mā ciram.. 32.2 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुत्वा स क्लिन्नसर्वांगो द्वाःस्थं राजा वचोऽब्रवीत्..
अमात्यान्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि शीघ्रमानय मा चिरम्.. 32.2 ..
1.4.m: Upon hearing it, his whole body drenched [in sweat], the king spoke to the door-keeper: / 'I wish to see my ministers; bring them quickly, do not delay!'

1.4.s:
tataste rājavacanātkālanemi mukhāgatāḥ..
prāha tāṃstārako daityaḥ kimidaṃ vo viceṣṭitam.. 32.3 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्ते राजवचनात्कालनेमि मुखागताः..
प्राह तांस्तारको दैत्यः किमिदं वो विचेष्टितम्.. 32.3 ..
1.4.m: Then, at the king's word, they arrived, headed by Kālanemi. / The Daitya Tāraka said to them: 'What is this conduct of yours?

1.4.s:
yaiḥ śatrusaṃbhavā vārtā kāpi na śrīvitastvaham..
madirākāmamattānāṃ maṃtritvaṃ vo na yujyate..
hitaṃ mantrayate rājñastena maṃtrī nigadyate.. 32.4 ..
1.4.d:
यैः शत्रुसंभवा वार्ता कापि न श्रीवितस्त्वहम्..
मदिराकाममत्तानां मंत्रित्वं वो न युज्यते..
हितं मन्त्रयते राज्ञस्तेन मंत्री निगद्यते.. 32.4 ..
1.4.m: By you no news whatsoever of the enemy's uprising was made known to me! / Counselorship is not proper for you who are intoxicated with wine and lust! / He who counsels the king's benefit is called a minister.'

1.4.s:
..amātyā ūcuḥ..
ko jānāti surāndīnāndaityānāmiti no matiḥ.. 32.5 ..
1.4.d:
..अमात्या ऊचुः..
को जानाति सुरान्दीनान्दैत्यानामिति नो मतिः.. 32.5 ..
1.4.m: The ministers said: / 'Who pays heed to the wretched gods? Such has been our view regarding the Daityas.

1.4.s:
mā viṣīda mahārāja vayaṃ jeṣyāmahe surān..
bālādapi bhayaṃ kiṃ vā lajjāyai ciṃtitaṃ tvidam.. 32.6 ..
1.4.d:
मा विषीद महाराज वयं जेष्यामहे सुरान्..
बालादपि भयं किं वा लज्जायै चिंतितं त्विदम्.. 32.6 ..
1.4.m: Do not despair, great king; we will conquer the gods! / What fear is there from a mere boy? Yet this worry is cause for shame!

1.4.s:
sarvametatsusādhyaṃ ca bherī saṃtāḍyatāṃ dṛḍham..
tato daityendravacanātsaṃnāhajananī tadā.. 32.7 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वमेतत्सुसाध्यं च भेरी संताड्यतां दृढम्..
ततो दैत्येन्द्रवचनात्संनाहजननी तदा.. 32.7 ..
1.4.m: All this is easily accomplished; let the war drum be struck forcefully!' / Then, by order of the king of the Daityas, generating martial readiness,

1.4.s:
bhṛśaṃ saṃtāḍitā bherī kaṃpayāmāsa sā jagat..
smaraṇāddaityarājasya parvatebhyo mahāsurāḥ.. 32.8 ..
1.4.d:
भृशं संताडिता भेरी कंपयामास सा जगत्..
स्मरणाद्दैत्यराजस्य पर्वतेभ्यो महासुराः.. 32.8 ..
1.4.m: the war drum, struck vehemently, made the universe tremble. / At the call of the Daitya king, the great Asuras from the mountains,

1.4.s:
nimnagābhyaḥ samudrebhyaḥ pātālebhyoṃ'barādapi..
sahasā samanuprāptā yugāṃtānalasaprabhāḥ.. 32.9 ..
1.4.d:
निम्नगाभ्यः समुद्रेभ्यः पातालेभ्योंऽबरादपि..
सहसा समनुप्राप्ता युगांतानलसप्रभाः.. 32.9 ..
1.4.m: from the rivers, from the oceans, from the Pātālas, and from the sky, / arrived all at once, blazing like the fire at the end of the world-age.

1.4.s:
koṭikoṭisahasraistu parārdhairdaśabhiḥ śataiḥ..
senāpatiḥ kālanemiḥ śīghraṃ devānupāyayau.. 32.10 ..
1.4.d:
कोटिकोटिसहस्रैस्तु परार्धैर्दशभिः शतैः..
सेनापतिः कालनेमिः शीघ्रं देवानुपाययौ.. 32.10 ..
1.4.m: With crores of thousands of crores and ten thousand parārdhas, / the general Kālanemi marched quickly against the gods.

1.4.s:
caturyojanavistīrṇe nānāścaryasamanvite..
rathe sthito manāgdīnastārakaḥ samadṛśyata.. 32.11 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्योजनविस्तीर्णे नानाश्चर्यसमन्विते..
रथे स्थितो मनाग्दीनस्तारकः समदृश्यत.. 32.11 ..
1.4.m: Stationed in a chariot four yojanas wide, filled with various wonders, / Tāraka was seen looking somewhat dejected.

1.4.s:
etasminnaṃtare pārtha kruddhaiḥ skandasya pārṣadaiḥ..
prākāraḥ pātitaḥ sarvo bhagnānyupavanāni ca.. 32.12 ..
1.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे पार्थ क्रुद्धैः स्कन्दस्य पार्षदैः..
प्राकारः पातितः सर्वो भग्नान्युपवनानि च.. 32.12 ..
1.4.m: In the meantime, O Pārtha, by the enraged attendants of Skanda, / the entire rampart was cast down and the pleasure-gardens broken to pieces.

1.4.s:
tataścacāla vasudhā devī savanakānanā..
jajvāla khaṃ sanakṣatraṃ pramūḍhaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhṛśam.. 32.13 ..
1.4.d:
ततश्चचाल वसुधा देवी सवनकानना..
जज्वाल खं सनक्षत्रं प्रमूढं भुवनं भृशम्.. 32.13 ..
1.4.m: Then the goddess Earth, with her woods and forests, shook; / the sky blazed with its stars, and the world was utterly bewildered.

1.4.s:
tamobhūtaṃ jagaccasīdgṛdhrairvyāptaṃ nabho'bhavat..
tato nānāpraharaṇaṃ pralayāṃbudasannibham.. 32.14 ..
1.4.d:
तमोभूतं जगच्चसीद्गृध्रैर्व्याप्तं नभोऽभवत्..
ततो नानाप्रहरणं प्रलयांबुदसन्निभम्.. 32.14 ..
1.4.m: The world was shrouded in darkness, and the sky was filled with vultures. / Then, equipped with various weapons, resembling the clouds of dissolution,

1.4.s:
kālanemimukhaṃ pārtha adṛśyata mahadbalam..
taddhi ghoramasaṃkhyeyaṃ jagarja vividhā giraḥ.. 32.15 ..
1.4.d:
कालनेमिमुखं पार्थ अदृश्यत महद्बलम्..
तद्धि घोरमसंख्येयं जगर्ज विविधा गिरः.. 32.15 ..
1.4.m: the great army led by Kālanemi appeared, O Pārtha! / Dreadful and countless, it roared out various cries,

1.4.s:
abhyadravadraṇe devānbhagavaṃtaṃ ca śaṃkaram..
vinadadbhistato daityaindevānīkaṃ mahāyudhaiḥ.. 32.16 ..
1.4.d:
अभ्यद्रवद्रणे देवान्भगवंतं च शंकरम्..
विनदद्भिस्ततो दैत्यैन्देवानीकं महायुधैः.. 32.16 ..
1.4.m: and rushed in battle against the gods and the venerable Śaṃkara. / Then, as the Daityas with great weapons roared, [they attacked] the divine army.

1.4.s:
parvataiśca śataghnībhirāyasaiḥ paridhairapi..
kṣaṇena drāvitaṃ sarvaṃ vimukhaṃ cāpyadṛśyata.. 32.17 ..
1.4.d:
पर्वतैश्च शतघ्नीभिरायसैः परिधैरपि..
क्षणेन द्रावितं सर्वं विमुखं चाप्यदृश्यत.. 32.17 ..
1.4.m: With boulders, śataghnīs, and iron bludgeons, / in an instant the whole [host] was routed and seen turning back.

1.4.s:
asurairvadhyamāne tu pāvakairiva kānanam..
apataddāvabhūmiṣṭha mahādrumavanaṃ yathā.. 32.18 ..
1.4.d:
असुरैर्वध्यमाने तु पावकैरिव काननम्..
अपतद्दावभूमिष्ठ महाद्रुमवनं यथा.. 32.18 ..
1.4.m: As they were slaughtered by the asuras like a forest by fires, / they fell like a grove of great trees caught in a forest fire.

1.4.s:
te bhinnāsthiśi rodehāḥ prādravaṃta divaukasaḥ..
na nāthamadhyagacchaṃta vadhyamānā mahāsuraiḥ.. 32.19 ..
1.4.d:
ते भिन्नास्थिशि रोदेहाः प्राद्रवंत दिवौकसः..
न नाथमध्यगच्छंत वध्यमाना महासुरैः.. 32.19 ..
1.4.m: With their bones and heads shattered, the gods fled, / finding no protector as they were slain by the great asuras.

1.4.s:
atha tadvidrutaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvāḥ puraṃdaraḥ..
āśvāsayannuvācedaṃ balavaddānavārditam.. 32.20 ..
1.4.d:
अथ तद्विद्रुतं सैन्यं दृष्ट्वाः पुरंदरः..
आश्वासयन्नुवाचेदं बलवद्दानवार्दितम्.. 32.20 ..
1.4.m: Then, seeing that army routed and grievously afflicted by the dānavas, / Puraṃdara spoke, reassuring them:

1.4.s:
bhayaṃ tyajata bhadraṃ vaḥ śurāḥ śastrāṇi gṛhṇata..
kurudhvaṃ vikrame buddhi mā ca kācidvyathāstu vaḥ.. 32.21 ..
1.4.d:
भयं त्यजत भद्रं वः शुराः शस्त्राणि गृह्णत..
कुरुध्वं विक्रमे बुद्धि मा च काचिद्व्यथास्तु वः.. 32.21 ..
1.4.m: "Cast off fear! May it be well with you! Warriors, seize your weapons! / Resolve on valor, and let there be no distress among you!

1.4.s:
eṣa kālānalaprakhyo mayūraṃ samupasthitaḥ..
rakṣitā vo mahāsenaḥ kathaṃ bhītistathāpi vaḥ.. 32.22 ..
1.4.d:
एष कालानलप्रख्यो मयूरं समुपस्थितः..
रक्षिता वो महासेनः कथं भीतिस्तथापि वः.. 32.22 ..
1.4.m: Here is Mahāsena, resplendent as the fire of destruction, mounted upon his peacock! / He is your protector—how then can you still have fear?"

1.4.s:
śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā samāśvastā divokasaḥ..
dānavānpratyayudhyaṃta śakraṃ kṛtvā vyapāśrayam.. 32.23 ..
1.4.d:
शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा समाश्वस्ता दिवोकसः..
दानवान्प्रत्ययुध्यंत शक्रं कृत्वा व्यपाश्रयम्.. 32.23 ..
1.4.m: Hearing Śakra's words, the gods were comforted; / taking Śakra as their refuge, they fought back against the dānavas.

1.4.s:
kālanemirmahendreṇa saṃyuge samayujyata..
sahasrākṣauhiṇīyukto jaṃbhakaḥ śaṃkareṇa ca.. 32.24 ..
1.4.d:
कालनेमिर्महेन्द्रेण संयुगे समयुज्यत..
सहस्राक्षौहिणीयुक्तो जंभकः शंकरेण च.. 32.24 ..
1.4.m: Kālanemi joined battle with Mahendra, / and Jambhaka, accompanied by a thousand akṣauhiṇīs, with Śaṃkara.

1.4.s:
kujaṃbho viṣṇunā caiva tāvatya kṣauhiṇīvṛtaḥ..
anye ca tridaśāḥ sava marutaśca mahābalāḥ.. 32.25 ..
1.4.d:
कुजंभो विष्णुना चैव तावत्य क्षौहिणीवृतः..
अन्ये च त्रिदशाः सव मरुतश्च महाबलाः.. 32.25 ..
1.4.m: Kujambha, surrounded by an equal number of akṣauhiṇīs, [fought] with Viṣṇu, / while the other gods, all the mighty Maruts,

1.4.s:
pratyayudhyaṃtaṃ daityeṃdreḥ sādhyāśca vasubhiḥ saha..
tato bahuvidhaṃ yuddhaṃ kālanemirvidhāyaca.. 32.26 ..
1.4.d:
प्रत्ययुध्यंतं दैत्येंद्रेः साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह..
ततो बहुविधं युद्धं कालनेमिर्विधायच.. 32.26 ..
1.4.m: and the Sādhyas along with the Vasus fought against the daitya chiefs. / Then Kālanemi, having waged various kinds of battle,

1.4.s:
utsṛjya sahasā pārtha airāvaṇaśiraḥsthitaḥ..
sa tu pādaprahāreṇa muṣṭinā caiva taṃ gajam.. 32.27 ..
1.4.d:
उत्सृज्य सहसा पार्थ ऐरावणशिरःस्थितः..
स तु पादप्रहारेण मुष्टिना चैव तं गजम्.. 32.27 ..
1.4.m: suddenly sprang forth, O Pārtha, and stood upon the head of Airāvata; / with a kick of his foot and a blow of his fist, he struck that elephant

1.4.s:
śakraṃ ca caghne vinadanpetatustāvubhau bhuvi..
tataḥ śakraṃ samādāya kālanemirvicetasam.. 32.28 ..
1.4.d:
शक्रं च चघ्ने विनदन्पेततुस्तावुभौ भुवि..
ततः शक्रं समादाय कालनेमिर्विचेतसम्.. 32.28 ..
1.4.m: and Śakra, roaring aloud, so that both of them fell to the ground. / Then Kālanemi, seizing the unconscious Śakra,

1.4.s:
rathamāśritya bhūyopi tārakābhimukho yayau..
atha kruddhaṃ tadā devaiḥ sahasā cāṃtakādibhiḥ.. 32.29 ..
1.4.d:
रथमाश्रित्य भूयोपि तारकाभिमुखो ययौ..
अथ क्रुद्धं तदा देवैः सहसा चांतकादिभिः.. 32.29 ..
