1.4.m: mounted his chariot once more and set off toward Tāraka. / Then, enraged, the gods—led by Antaka and the rest—[cried out] suddenly:

1.4.s:
hriyate hriyate rājā trātā ko'pi na vidyate..
etasminnaṃtare śarvaṃ pinākadhanuṣaścyutaiḥ.. 32.30 ..
1.4.d:
ह्रियते ह्रियते राजा त्राता कोऽपि न विद्यते..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शर्वं पिनाकधनुषश्च्युतैः.. 32.30 ..
1.4.m: "The king is being carried off! He is being carried off! There is no savior!" / In the meantime, Śarva, with arrows shot from his Pināka bow,

1.4.s:
bāṇaiḥ sasainyaṃ kṛtvā ca jaṃbhakaṃ gṛdhramodanam..
kālanemiṃ samāgamya rathastho vākyamabravīt.. 32.31 ..
1.4.d:
बाणैः ससैन्यं कृत्वा च जंभकं गृध्रमोदनम्..
कालनेमिं समागम्य रथस्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 32.31 ..
1.4.m: made Jambhaka together with his army food for vultures, / and approaching Kālanemi while standing upon his chariot, he said:

1.4.s:
kimetena mahendreṇa mayā yudhyasva dānava..
vīraṃmanya sudurbuddhe tato jñāsyasi vīratām.. 32.32 ..
1.4.d:
किमेतेन महेन्द्रेण मया युध्यस्व दानव..
वीरंमन्य सुदुर्बुद्धे ततो ज्ञास्यसि वीरताम्.. 32.32 ..
1.4.m: "What [glory is there] with this Mahendra? Fight with me, dānava! / You who think yourself a hero, fool, you will know heroism then!"

1.4.s:
..kānemiruvāca..
nagnena saha ko yudhyeddhatenāpi ca yena vā..
śaṃsatsu daityavīrāṇāmupahāsaḥ prajāyate.. 32.33 ..
1.4.d:
..कानेमिरुवाच..
नग्नेन सह को युध्येद्धतेनापि च येन वा..
शंसत्सु दैत्यवीराणामुपहासः प्रजायते.. 32.33 ..
1.4.m: Kālanemi said: / "Who would fight with a naked one, or with one who is already slain? / Such praise would become a laughingstock among daitya warriors.

1.4.s:
ātmanastu samaṃ kiṃcidvilokya sudurmate..
tadākarṇya ca sāvajñaṃ vacaḥ śarvo visiṣmiye.. 32.34 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मनस्तु समं किंचिद्विलोक्य सुदुर्मते..
तदाकर्ण्य च सावज्ञं वचः शर्वो विसिष्मिये.. 32.34 ..
1.4.m: Look for someone equal to yourself, utterly foolish one!" / Hearing that contemptuous speech, Śarva was astonished.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kumāraḥ sahasā mayūrastho'bhyadhāvata..
kujaṃbhaṃ sānugaṃ hatvā vāsudevopyadhāvata.. 32.35 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कुमारः सहसा मयूरस्थोऽभ्यधावत..
कुजंभं सानुगं हत्वा वासुदेवोप्यधावत.. 32.35 ..
1.4.m: Then Kumāra swiftly rushed forward, mounted on his peacock; / having slain Kujambha along with his followers, Vāsudeva also rushed forward.

1.4.s:
tato hariḥ skaṃdamāha kimetena tava prabho..
daityādhamena pāpena muhūrtaṃ paśya me balam.. 32.36 ..
1.4.d:
ततो हरिः स्कंदमाह किमेतेन तव प्रभो..
दैत्याधमेन पापेन मुहूर्तं पश्य मे बलम्.. 32.36 ..
1.4.m: Then Hari said to Skanda: "What have you to do with this, O lord? / Watch my strength for a moment against this vile, sinful daitya!"

1.4.s:
evamuktvā nivāryainaṃ keśavo garuḍasthitaḥ..
śārṅgakodaṃḍanirmuktairbāṇairdaityamavākirat.. 32.37 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्त्वा निवार्यैनं केशवो गरुडस्थितः..
शार्ङ्गकोदंडनिर्मुक्तैर्बाणैर्दैत्यमवाकिरत्.. 32.37 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus and restraining him, Keśava, mounted upon Garuḍa, / covered the daitya with arrows discharged from his Śārṅga bow.

1.4.s:
sa tairbāṇaistāḍyamāno vajrairiva mahāsuraḥ..
vimucya vāsavaṃ kruddho bāṇāṃstānvyadhamaccharaiḥ.. 32.38 ..
1.4.d:
स तैर्बाणैस्ताड्यमानो वज्रैरिव महासुरः..
विमुच्य वासवं क्रुद्धो बाणांस्तान्व्यधमच्छरैः.. 32.38 ..
1.4.m: Struck by those arrows as if by thunderbolts, the great asura / released Vāsava in anger and shattered those arrows with his own shafts.

1.4.s:
yānyānbāṇānharirdivyānastrāṇi ca mumoca ha..
nivārayati daityastānprahasam̐llīlayaiva ca.. 32.39 ..
1.4.d:
यान्यान्बाणान्हरिर्दिव्यानस्त्राणि च मुमोच ह..
निवारयति दैत्यस्तान्प्रहसम्̐ल्लीलयैव च.. 32.39 ..
1.4.m: Whatever celestial arrows and missiles Hari unleashed, / the daitya warded them off, laughing as if in sport.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kaumodakīṃ gṛhya kṣiprakārī janārdanaḥ..
mumoca sainyanāthāya sārathiṃ ca vyacūrṇayat.. 32.40 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कौमोदकीं गृह्य क्षिप्रकारी जनार्दनः..
मुमोच सैन्यनाथाय सारथिं च व्यचूर्णयत्.. 32.40 ..
1.4.m: Then Janārdana, acting swiftly, seized the Kaumodakī mace / and hurled it at the army commander, crushing his charioteer.

1.4.s:
tato rathādavaplutya vivṛtya vadanaṃ mahat..
garuḍaṃ caṃcunādāya sa viṣṇuṃ kṣiptavānmukhe.. 32.41 ..
1.4.d:
ततो रथादवप्लुत्य विवृत्य वदनं महत्..
गरुडं चंचुनादाय स विष्णुं क्षिप्तवान्मुखे.. 32.41 ..
1.4.m: Then, leaping down from his chariot and opening his vast mouth, / [the daitya] seized Garuḍa by the beak and threw Viṣṇu into his mouth.

1.4.s:
tato'bhūtsarvadevānāṃ vimoho jagatāmapi..
cacāla vasudhā celuḥ parvatāḥ sapta cārṇavāḥ.. 32.42 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽभूत्सर्वदेवानां विमोहो जगतामपि..
चचाल वसुधा चेलुः पर्वताः सप्त चार्णवाः.. 32.42 ..
1.4.m: Then stupor seized all the gods and the worlds as well; / the earth shook, and the mountains and seven oceans trembled.

1.4.s:
kālanemirnaścaiva prānṛtyata mahāraṇe..
asaṃmūḍhastato viṣṇustvarākāla upasthite.. 32.43 ..
1.4.d:
कालनेमिर्नश्चैव प्रानृत्यत महारणे..
असंमूढस्ततो विष्णुस्त्वराकाल उपस्थिते.. 32.43 ..
1.4.m: Kālanemi began to dance in the great battle. / Then Viṣṇu, undismayed as the moment of urgency arrived,

1.4.s:
kukṣiṃ vidārya cakreṇa bhāskaro'bhādivoditaḥ..
bahirbhūto hariścainaṃ mahoyitvā svanindayā.. 32.44 ..
1.4.d:
कुक्षिं विदार्य चक्रेण भास्करोऽभादिवोदितः..
बहिर्भूतो हरिश्चैनं महोयित्वा स्वनिन्दया.. 32.44 ..
1.4.m: tore open his belly with his discus and shone like the risen sun; / having emerged outside, Hari bewitched him with his own delusion,

1.4.s:
pātālasya talaṃ ninye tatra śiśye sa kāṣṭhavat..
tataścakreṇa daityānāṃ nihatā daśakoṭyaḥ.. 32.45 ..
1.4.d:
पातालस्य तलं निन्ये तत्र शिश्ये स काष्ठवत्..
ततश्चक्रेण दैत्यानां निहता दशकोट्यः.. 32.45 ..
1.4.m: and cast him down to the floor of Pātāla, where he lay like a log of wood. / Then with his discus, ten crores of daityas were slain.

1.4.s:
pramoditāstathā devā vimohāstatkṣaṇādbabhuḥ..
tataḥśarvastamāliṃgya sādhusādhu janārdana.. 32.46 ..
1.4.d:
प्रमोदितास्तथा देवा विमोहास्तत्क्षणाद्बभुः..
ततःशर्वस्तमालिंग्य साधुसाधु जनार्दन.. 32.46 ..
1.4.m: The gods rejoiced and were freed from delusion at that instant. / Then Śarva embraced him, saying: "Well done! Well done, Janārdana!

1.4.s:
tvayā yadvihitaṃ karma tatkartānyo na vidyate..
mahiṣādyāḥ sudurjeyā devyā ye vinipatitāḥ.. 32.47 ..
1.4.d:
त्वया यद्विहितं कर्म तत्कर्तान्यो न विद्यते..
महिषाद्याः सुदुर्जेया देव्या ये विनिपतिताः.. 32.47 ..
1.4.m: The deed that you have done, none other could perform! / The exceedingly invincible ones like Mahiṣa who were struck down by the Devī—

1.4.s:
teṣāmatibalo hyeṣa tvayā viṣṇo vinirjitaḥ..
tārakāmayasaṃgrāme vadhyastesau janārdana.. 32.48 ..
1.4.d:
तेषामतिबलो ह्येष त्वया विष्णो विनिर्जितः..
तारकामयसंग्रामे वध्यस्तेसौ जनार्दन.. 32.48 ..
1.4.m: this one was far mightier than they, yet he was subdued by you, O Viṣṇu! / In the battle of the Tārakāmaya war, he is to be slain by you, Janārdana;

1.4.s:
kaṃsarūpaḥ punaste'yaṃ haṃtavyo'ṣṭamajanmani..
evaṃ praśaṃsamānāste vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum.. 32.49 ..
1.4.d:
कंसरूपः पुनस्तेऽयं हंतव्योऽष्टमजन्मनि..
एवं प्रशंसमानास्ते वासुदेवं जगद्गुरुम्.. 32.49 ..
1.4.m: and again, taking the form of Kaṃsa, he must be killed by you in your eighth birth." / While they were thus praising Vāsudeva, the teacher of the world,

1.4.s:
śastrajālairlabdhasaṃjñāndaityasainyānanāśayat..
tāni daityaśarīrāṇi jarjarāṇi mahāyudhaiḥ.. 32.50 ..
1.4.d:
शस्त्रजालैर्लब्धसंज्ञान्दैत्यसैन्याननाशयत्..
तानि दैत्यशरीराणि जर्जराणि महायुधैः.. 32.50 ..
1.4.m: [the gods] destroyed the daitya troops who had regained consciousness, using volleys of weapons. / Those bodies of the daityas, shattered by mighty weapons,

1.4.s:
apatanbhūtale pārtha cchinnābhrāṇīva sarvaśaḥ..
tatastaddānavaṃ sainyaṃ hatanāthamabhūttadā.. 32.51 ..
1.4.d:
अपतन्भूतले पार्थ च्छिन्नाभ्राणीव सर्वशः..
ततस्तद्दानवं सैन्यं हतनाथमभूत्तदा.. 32.51 ..
1.4.m: fell on the ground, O Pārtha, like torn clouds on every side. / Then that army of dānavas was left without a leader;

1.4.s:
devaiḥ skaṃdānugaiścaiva kṛtaṃ śastraiḥ parāṅmukham..
atho kruṣṭaṃ tadā hṛṣṭaiḥ sarvairdevairmudāyutaiḥ.. 32.52 ..
1.4.d:
देवैः स्कंदानुगैश्चैव कृतं शस्त्रैः पराङ्मुखम्..
अथो क्रुष्टं तदा हृष्टैः सर्वैर्देवैर्मुदायुतैः.. 32.52 ..
1.4.m: put to flight by the weapons of the gods and Skanda's followers, / a joyful cry went up from all the gods filled with delight.

1.4.s:
saṃhatāni ca sarvāṇi tadā tūryāṇyavādayan..
atha bhagnaṃ balaṃ prekṣya hatavīraṃ mahāraṇe.. 32.53 ..
1.4.d:
संहतानि च सर्वाणि तदा तूर्याण्यवादयन्..
अथ भग्नं बलं प्रेक्ष्य हतवीरं महारणे.. 32.53 ..
1.4.m: All united together, they sounded their musical instruments. / Then, seeing his force broken and his warriors slain in the great battle,

1.4.s:
devānāṃ ca mahāmodaṃ tārakaḥ prāha sārathim..
sārathe paśya sainyāni drāvyamāṇāni me suraiḥ.. 32.54 ..
1.4.d:
देवानां च महामोदं तारकः प्राह सारथिम्..
सारथे पश्य सैन्यानि द्राव्यमाणानि मे सुरैः.. 32.54 ..
1.4.m: and the great joy of the gods, Tāraka said to his charioteer: / "Charioteer, behold my troops being routed by the gods,

1.4.s:
yesmābhistṛṇavaddṛṣṭāḥ paśya kālasya citratām..
tanme vāhaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ rathamenaṃ surānprati.. 32.55 ..
1.4.d:
येस्माभिस्तृणवद्दृष्टाः पश्य कालस्य चित्रताम्..
तन्मे वाहय शीघ्रं त्वं रथमेनं सुरान्प्रति.. 32.55 ..
1.4.m: whom we regarded as mere grass! Behold the wonder of Time! / Therefore, drive this chariot quickly toward the gods!

1.4.s:
paśyaṃtu me balaṃ bāhvordravaṃtu ca surādhamāḥ..
bruvannevaṃ sārathiṃ sa vidhunvansumahaddhanuḥ.. 32.56 ..
1.4.d:
पश्यंतु मे बलं बाह्वोर्द्रवंतु च सुराधमाः..
ब्रुवन्नेवं सारथिं स विधुन्वन्सुमहद्धनुः.. 32.56 ..
1.4.m: Let them behold the strength of my arms, and let the vile gods flee!" / Speaking thus to his charioteer and shaking his immense bow,

1.4.s:
krodha raktekṣaṇo rājā devasainyaṃ samāviśat..
āgacchamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā hariḥ skaṃdamathābravīt.. 32.57 ..
1.4.d:
क्रोध रक्तेक्षणो राजा देवसैन्यं समाविशत्..
आगच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा हरिः स्कंदमथाब्रवीत्.. 32.57 ..
1.4.m: the king, his eyes red with rage, plunged into the divine army. / Seeing him approaching, Hari then spoke to Skanda:

1.4.s:
kumāra paśya daityeṃdraṃ kālaṃ yadvadyugātyaye..
ayaṃ sa yena tapasā ghoreṇārādhitaḥ śivaḥ.. 32.58 ..
1.4.d:
कुमार पश्य दैत्येंद्रं कालं यद्वद्युगात्यये..
अयं स येन तपसा घोरेणाराधितः शिवः.. 32.58 ..
1.4.m: "Kumāra, look at the daitya king, who resembles Death at the end of an age! / This is he by whom Śiva was propitiated with fierce austerity;

1.4.s:
ayaṃ sa yena śakrādyāḥ kṛtā markāḥ samārbudam..
ayaṃ sa sarvaśastraigairyo'smābhirna jito raṇe.. 32.59 ..
1.4.d:
अयं स येन शक्राद्याः कृता मर्काः समार्बुदम्..
अयं स सर्वशस्त्रैगैर्योऽस्माभिर्न जितो रणे.. 32.59 ..
1.4.m: this is he by whom Śakra and the rest were turned into monkeys for hundreds of millions of years; / this is he who could not be conquered in battle by us with all hosts of weapons.

1.4.s:
nāvajñayā pradraṣṭavyastārako'yaṃ mahāsuraḥ..
saptamaṃ hi dinaṃ te'dya madhyāhno'yaṃ ca vartate.. 32.60 ..
1.4.d:
नावज्ञया प्रद्रष्टव्यस्तारकोऽयं महासुरः..
सप्तमं हि दिनं तेऽद्य मध्याह्नोऽयं च वर्तते.. 32.60 ..
1.4.m: This great asura Tāraka must not be regarded with contempt. / Today is indeed your seventh day, and it is now midday."

1.4.s:
arvāgastamanādenaṃ jahi vadhyo'nyathā nahi..
evamuktvā sa śakrādīṃstvaritaḥ keśavo'bravīt.. 32.61 ..
1.4.d:
अर्वागस्तमनादेनं जहि वध्योऽन्यथा नहि..
एवमुक्त्वा स शक्रादींस्त्वरितः केशवोऽब्रवीत्.. 32.61 ..
1.4.m:
"Slay him before sunset; otherwise he cannot be killed."
Having spoken thus to Śakra and the others, Keśava swiftly said:

1.4.s:
āyāsayata daityeṃdraṃ sukhavadhyo yathā bhavet..
tataste viṣṇuvacanādvinadanto divaukasaḥ.. 32.62 ..
1.4.d:
आयासयत दैत्येंद्रं सुखवध्यो यथा भवेत्..
ततस्ते विष्णुवचनाद्विनदन्तो दिवौकसः.. 32.62 ..
1.4.m:
"Weary the king of the Daityas so that he may easily be slain."
Then, at Viṣṇu's command, the roaring denizens of heaven,

1.4.s:
tamāsādya śaravrātairmuditāḥ samavākiran..
prahasanniva devāṃstāndrāvayāmāsa tārakaḥ.. 32.63 ..
1.4.d:
तमासाद्य शरव्रातैर्मुदिताः समवाकिरन्..
प्रहसन्निव देवांस्तान्द्रावयामास तारकः.. 32.63 ..
1.4.m:
Approaching him, joyfully showered him with volleys of arrows.
As if laughing, Tāraka put those gods to flight,

1.4.s:
yathā nāstikadurvṛtto nānāśāstropadeśakān..
soḍhuṃ śaktā na te vīraṃ mahati syaṃdane sthitam.. 32.64 ..
1.4.d:
यथा नास्तिकदुर्वृत्तो नानाशास्त्रोपदेशकान्..
सोढुं शक्ता न ते वीरं महति स्यंदने स्थितम्.. 32.64 ..
1.4.m:
Just as an immoral atheist [puts to flight] teachers of various scriptures.
They were unable to withstand that hero standing in his mighty chariot,

1.4.s:
mahāpasmārasaṃkrāṃtaṃ yathaivāpriyavādinam..
vidhūya sakalāndevānkṣaṇamātreṇa tārakaḥ.. 32.65 ..
1.4.d:
महापस्मारसंक्रांतं यथैवाप्रियवादिनम्..
विधूय सकलान्देवान्क्षणमात्रेण तारकः.. 32.65 ..
1.4.m:
Just as [one cannot endure] a speaker of unpleasant words afflicted with severe epilepsy.
Having brushed aside all the gods in a mere moment, Tāraka

1.4.s:
ājagāma kumārāya vidhuvansa mahādhanuḥ..
āgacchamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā skaṃdaḥ pratyudyayau tataḥ.. 32.66 ..
1.4.d:
आजगाम कुमाराय विधुवन्स महाधनुः..
आगच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा स्कंदः प्रत्युद्ययौ ततः.. 32.66 ..
1.4.m:
Came toward Kumāra, brandishing his mighty bow.
Seeing him advancing, Skanda then stepped forth against him.

1.4.s:
tasyārakṣadbhavaḥ pārśvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ caiva taṃ hariḥ..
pṛṣṭhe ca pārṣadāstasya koṭiśo'rbadaśastathā.. 32.67 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यारक्षद्भवः पार्श्वं दक्षिणं चैव तं हरिः..
पृष्ठे च पार्षदास्तस्य कोटिशोऽर्बदशस्तथा.. 32.67 ..
1.4.m:
Bhava protected his side, and Hari protected his right [flank],
and at his back were his attendants in their tens of millions and hundreds of millions.

1.4.s:
tatastau sumahāyuddhe saṃsaktau devadaityayauḥ..
dharmādharmāvivodagrau jagadāścaryakārakau.. 32.68 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तौ सुमहायुद्धे संसक्तौ देवदैत्ययौः..
धर्माधर्माविवोदग्रौ जगदाश्चर्यकारकौ.. 32.68 ..
1.4.m:
Then the two, of the gods and the Daityas, clashed in a stupendous battle,
lofty like righteousness and unrighteousness, causing wonder to the world.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kumāramāsādya līlayā tārako'bravīt..
aho bālātibālastvaṃ yattvaṃ gīrvāṇavākyataḥ.. 32.69 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कुमारमासाद्य लीलया तारकोऽब्रवीत्..
अहो बालातिबालस्त्वं यत्त्वं गीर्वाणवाक्यतः.. 32.69 ..
1.4.m:
Then, having approached Kumāra, Tāraka playfully said:
"Ah, you are a mere child, an utter child, that at the word of the gods

1.4.s:
āsādayasi māṃ yuddhe pataṃga iva pāvakam..
vadhena tava ko lābho mama mukto'si bālaka.. 32.70 ..
1.4.d:
आसादयसि मां युद्धे पतंग इव पावकम्..
वधेन तव को लाभो मम मुक्तोऽसि बालक.. 32.70 ..
1.4.m:
You approach me in battle, like a moth into fire!
What gain is there for me in your death? You are spared, child!

1.4.s:
piṣa kṣīraṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ kaṃdukaṃ krīḍa līlayā..
evamuktaḥ prahasyāha tārakaṃ yogināṃ guruḥ.. 32.71 ..
1.4.d:
पिष क्षीरं गृहाणेमं कंदुकं क्रीड लीलया..
एवमुक्तः प्रहस्याह तारकं योगिनां गुरुः.. 32.71 ..
1.4.m:
Drink milk, take this ball, and play at your ease!"
Spoken to thus, the guru of yogins laughed and said to Tāraka:

1.4.s:
śiśutvaṃ māvamaṃsthā me śiśuḥ kaṣṭo bhujaṃgamaḥ..
duṣprekṣyo bhāskaro bālo duḥsparśo'lpo'pi pāvakaḥ.. 32.72 ..
1.4.d:
शिशुत्वं मावमंस्था मे शिशुः कष्टो भुजंगमः..
दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो भास्करो बालो दुःस्पर्शोऽल्पोऽपि पावकः.. 32.72 ..
1.4.m:
"Do not despise my childhood: a young serpent is dangerous;
the morning sun is hard to gaze upon; even a tiny fire is difficult to touch.

1.4.s:
alpākṣaro na maṃtraḥ kiṃ sasphuro daitya dṛśyate..
evamuktvā daityamuktaṃ gṛhītvā kaṃdukaṃ ca tam.. 32.73 ..
1.4.d:
अल्पाक्षरो न मंत्रः किं सस्फुरो दैत्य दृश्यते..
एवमुक्त्वा दैत्यमुक्तं गृहीत्वा कंदुकं च तम्.. 32.73 ..
1.4.m:
Is not a mantra with few syllables seen to be radiant with power, O Daitya?"
Having spoken thus and caught that ball thrown by the Daitya,

1.4.s:
tasmiñchaktyastramādāya daityāya pramumoca ha..
tasya tena prahārema rathaścūrṇikṛto'bhavat.. 32.74 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिञ्छक्त्यस्त्रमादाय दैत्याय प्रमुमोच ह..
तस्य तेन प्रहारेम रथश्चूर्णिकृतोऽभवत्.. 32.74 ..
1.4.m:
He took up his śakti weapon against it and hurled it at the Daitya.
By its strike, his chariot was reduced to powder—

1.4.s:
caturyojanamātro yo nānāścaryasamanvitaḥ..
garuḍasya sutā ye ca śīryamāṇe rathottame.. 32.75 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्योजनमात्रो यो नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितः..
गरुडस्य सुता ये च शीर्यमाणे रथोत्तमे.. 32.75 ..
1.4.m:
A chariot four yojanas in size, endowed with various wonders.
And the sons of Garuḍa [yoked to it], when that excellent chariot was shattered,

1.4.s:
muktāḥ kathaṃcidutpatya sāgarāṃtaramāviśan..
tataḥ kruddhastārakaśca mudgaraṃ kṣiptavānguhe.. 32.76 ..
1.4.d:
मुक्ताः कथंचिदुत्पत्य सागरांतरमाविशन्..
ततः क्रुद्धस्तारकश्च मुद्गरं क्षिप्तवान्गुहे.. 32.76 ..
1.4.m:
Somehow escaped, flew up, and plunged into the midst of the ocean.
Then the enraged Tāraka hurled a club at Guha.

1.4.s:
viṃdhyādrimiva taṃ skaṃdo gṛhītvā taṃ vyatāḍayat..
sthire tasyorasi vyūḍhe mudgaraḥ śatadhā'gamat.. 32.77 ..
1.4.d:
विंध्याद्रिमिव तं स्कंदो गृहीत्वा तं व्यताडयत्..
स्थिरे तस्योरसि व्यूढे मुद्गरः शतधाऽगमत्.. 32.77 ..
1.4.m:
Skanda, receiving it like the Vindhya mountain, struck it;
on his firm and broad chest the club broke into a hundred pieces.

1.4.s:
mene ca durjayaṃ daityastadā ṣaḍvadanaṃ raṇe..
ciṃtayāmāsa buddhyā ca prāptaṃ tadbrahmaṇo vacaḥ.. 32.78 ..
1.4.d:
मेने च दुर्जयं दैत्यस्तदा षड्वदनं रणे..
चिंतयामास बुद्ध्या च प्राप्तं तद्ब्रह्मणो वचः.. 32.78 ..
1.4.m:
Then the Daitya considered the six-faced god invincible in battle,
and reflected in his mind: "That word of Brahmā has come to pass."

1.4.s:
taṃ bhītamiva cālakṣya daityavīrāśca koṭiśaḥ..
nadaṃto'timahāsenaṃ nānāśastrairavākiran.. 32.79 ..
1.4.d:
तं भीतमिव चालक्ष्य दैत्यवीराश्च कोटिशः..
नदंतोऽतिमहासेनं नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरन्.. 32.79 ..
1.4.m:
Perceiving him to be as if afraid, the Daitya heroes in their millions,
roaring, showered Mahāsena with various weapons.

1.4.s:
kruddhasteṣu tataḥ skaṃdaḥ śaktiṃ ghorāmathādade..
abhyasyamāne śaktyastre skaṃdanāmitatejasā.. 32.80 ..
1.4.d:
क्रुद्धस्तेषु ततः स्कंदः शक्तिं घोरामथाददे..
अभ्यस्यमाने शक्त्यस्त्रे स्कंदनामिततेजसा.. 32.80 ..
1.4.m:
Enraged at them, Skanda then seized his dreadful śakti;
as the śakti weapon was wielded by Skanda of immeasurable splendor,

1.4.s:
ulkājālaṃ mahāghoraṃ papāta vasudhātale..
cālyamānā tathā śaktiḥ sughorā bhavasūnunā.. 32.81 ..
1.4.d:
उल्काजालं महाघोरं पपात वसुधातले..
चाल्यमाना तथा शक्तिः सुघोरा भवसूनुना.. 32.81 ..
1.4.m:
A terrifying shower of meteors fell upon the surface of the earth.
And as that most dreadful śakti was swung by the son of Bhava,

1.4.s:
tataḥ koṭyo viniṣpetuḥ śaktīnāṃ bhartarṣabha..
sa śaktyastreṇa balavānkarasthenāhanatprabhuḥ.. 32.82 ..
1.4.d:
ततः कोट्यो विनिष्पेतुः शक्तीनां भर्तर्षभ..
स शक्त्यस्त्रेण बलवान्करस्थेनाहनत्प्रभुः.. 32.82 ..
1.4.m:
Millions of śaktis burst forth, O best of the Bhāratas!
With the śakti weapon held in his hand, that powerful lord struck down

1.4.s:
aṣṭau padmāni daitvānāṃ daśakoṭiśatāni ca..
tathā niyutasāhasraṃ vāhanaṃ koṭireva ca.. 32.83 ..
1.4.d:
अष्टौ पद्मानि दैत्वानां दशकोटिशतानि च..
तथा नियुतसाहस्रं वाहनं कोटिरेव च.. 32.83 ..
1.4.m:
Eight hundred million Daityas and one hundred million more,
as well as a hundred million thousand mounts and a crore [more],

1.4.s:
hraṃdodaraṃ ca daityeṃdraṃ nikharvairdaśabhirvṛtam..
tatrākurvansutumulaṃ nādaṃ vadhyeṣu śatruṣu.. 32.84 ..
1.4.d:
ह्रंदोदरं च दैत्येंद्रं निखर्वैर्दशभिर्वृतम्..
तत्राकुर्वन्सुतुमुलं नादं वध्येषु शत्रुषु.. 32.84 ..
1.4.m:
And the Daitya lord Hradodara, surrounded by ten nikharvas [of warriors].
There, as the enemies were being slaughtered, a tumultuous roar was raised

1.4.s:
kumārānucarāḥ pārtha pūrayaṃto diśo daśa..
śaktyastrasyārciḥ saṃbhūtaśaktibhiḥ ke'pi sūditāḥ.. 32.85 ..
1.4.d:
कुमारानुचराः पार्थ पूरयंतो दिशो दश..
शक्त्यस्त्रस्यार्चिः संभूतशक्तिभिः केऽपि सूदिताः.. 32.85 ..
1.4.m:
By Kumāra's followers, O Pārtha, filling the ten directions.
Some were slain by the spears born from the radiance of the śakti weapon;

1.4.s:
patākayāvadhūtāśca hatāḥ kecitsahasraśaḥ..
keciddhaṃṭāravatrastāśchinnabhinnahṛdo'patan.. 32.86 ..
1.4.d:
पताकयावधूताश्च हताः केचित्सहस्रशः..
केचिद्धंटारवत्रस्ताश्छिन्नभिन्नहृदोऽपतन्.. 32.86 ..
1.4.m:
Some were struck down by thousands, swept away by his banner;
some, terrified by the sound of his bell, fell with broken and shattered hearts;

1.4.s:
kecinmayūrapakṣābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca sūditāḥ..
koṭiśastāmracūḍena vidāryaiva ca bhakṣitāḥ.. 32.87 ..
1.4.d:
केचिन्मयूरपक्षाभ्यां चरणाभ्यां च सूदिताः..
कोटिशस्ताम्रचूडेन विदार्यैव च भक्षिताः.. 32.87 ..
1.4.m:
Some were destroyed by the peacock's wings and feet;
and by the tens of millions, they were torn apart and devoured by the rooster;

1.4.s:
pārṣadairmātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ padmaśo nihatāḥ pare..
evaṃ nihanyamāneṣu dānaveṣu guhādibhiḥ.. 32.88 ..
1.4.d:
पार्षदैर्मातृभिः सार्धं पद्मशो निहताः परे..
एवं निहन्यमानेषु दानवेषु गुहादिभिः.. 32.88 ..
1.4.m:
Others were slaughtered by the hundreds of millions by his attendants together with the Mothers.
While the Dānavas were thus being destroyed by Guha and the others,

1.4.s:
abhāgyairiva lokeṣu tārakaḥ skaṃdamāyayau..
jagrāha ca gadāṃ divyāṃ lakṣaghaṃṭādurāsadām.. 32.89 ..
1.4.d:
अभाग्यैरिव लोकेषु तारकः स्कंदमाययौ..
जग्राह च गदां दिव्यां लक्षघंटादुरासदाम्.. 32.89 ..
1.4.m:
Tāraka advanced against Skanda, like misfortune falling upon the worlds,
and seized a divine mace, unassailable with its hundred thousand bells.

1.4.s:
tayā mayūramājaghne mayūro vimukho'bhavat..
dṛṣṭvā parāṅmukhaṃ lokeṣu vāsudevo'bravīttvaran.. 32.90 ..
1.4.d:
तया मयूरमाजघ्ने मयूरो विमुखोऽभवत्..
दृष्ट्वा पराङ्मुखं लोकेषु वासुदेवोऽब्रवीत्त्वरन्.. 32.90 ..
1.4.m:
With it he struck the peacock, and the peacock turned away.
Seeing him turned back in the sight of the worlds, Vāsudeva urgently said:

1.4.s:
devasenāpate śīghraṃ śaktiṃ muṃca mahāsure..
pratijñāmātmanaḥ pāhi laṃbate ravimaṃḍalam.. 32.91 ..
1.4.d:
देवसेनापते शीघ्रं शक्तिं मुंच महासुरे..
प्रतिज्ञामात्मनः पाहि लंबते रविमंडलम्.. 32.91 ..
1.4.m:
"O Commander of the Army of the Gods, swiftly unleash your śakti upon the great Asura!
Fulfill your vow: the solar disk is sinking low!"

1.4.s:
..skaṃda uvāca..
tvayaiva rudrabhakto'yaṃ janārdana mameritam..
vadhārthaṃ rudrabhaktasya bāhuḥ śaktiṃ muṃcati.. 32.92 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कंद उवाच..
त्वयैव रुद्रभक्तोऽयं जनार्दन ममेरितम्..
वधार्थं रुद्रभक्तस्य बाहुः शक्तिं मुंचति.. 32.92 ..
1.4.m:
Skanda said:
"It was you yourself, O Janārdana, who told me, 'He is a devotee of Rudra.'
How can my arm release a śakti for the slaying of a devotee of Rudra?

1.4.s:
nārudraḥ pūjayedrudraṃ bhaktarūpasya yo haraḥ..
rudrarūpamamuṃ hatvā kīdṛśaṃ janmano bhavet.. 32.93 ..
1.4.d:
नारुद्रः पूजयेद्रुद्रं भक्तरूपस्य यो हरः..
रुद्ररूपममुं हत्वा कीदृशं जन्मनो भवेत्.. 32.93 ..
1.4.m:
One who is not Rudra cannot worship Rudra; Hara himself takes the form of his devotee.
Having killed him who has the form of Rudra, what would become of my existence?

1.4.s:
tiraskṛtā vipralabdhāḥ śaptāḥ kṣiptāḥ prapīḍitāḥ..
rudrabhaktāḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ nirdahaṃti hatāḥ kimu.. 32.94 ..
1.4.d:
तिरस्कृता विप्रलब्धाः शप्ताः क्षिप्ताः प्रपीडिताः..
रुद्रभक्ताः कुलं सर्वं निर्दहंति हताः किमु.. 32.94 ..
1.4.m:
When insulted, deceived, cursed, repulsed, or tormented,
devotees of Rudra burn down an entire lineage—how much more so if slain?

1.4.s:
eṣa ceddhaṃti tadbhadraṃ hanyatāmeṣa māṃ raṇe..
rudrabhakte punarviṣṇo nāhaṃ śastramupādade.. 32.95 ..
1.4.d:
एष चेद्धंति तद्भद्रं हन्यतामेष मां रणे..
रुद्रभक्ते पुनर्विष्णो नाहं शस्त्रमुपाददे.. 32.95 ..
1.4.m:
If he kills me, let it be so: let him slay me in battle!
Yet against a devotee of Rudra, O Viṣṇu, I will not take up a weapon again."

1.4.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca..
naitattavocitaṃ skaṃda rudrabhakto yathā śrṛṇu..
dve tanū girijābharturvedajñā munayo viduḥ.. 32.96 ..
1.4.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच..
नैतत्तवोचितं स्कंद रुद्रभक्तो यथा श्रृणु..
द्वे तनू गिरिजाभर्तुर्वेदज्ञा मुनयो विदुः.. 32.96 ..
1.4.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
"This is not fitting for you, Skanda; hear who a true devotee of Rudra is:
Seers who know the Veda understand that the husband of Girijā has two forms:

1.4.s:
ekā jīvātmikā tatra pratyakṣā ca tathāparā..
drogdhā bhūteṣu bhaktaśca rudrabhakto na sa smṛtaḥ.. 32.97 ..
1.4.d:
एका जीवात्मिका तत्र प्रत्यक्षा च तथापरा..
द्रोग्धा भूतेषु भक्तश्च रुद्रभक्तो न स स्मृतः.. 32.97 ..
1.4.m:
One consisting of the individual self, and the other directly manifest.
One who injures living beings, even if a devotee, is not considered a devotee of Rudra.

1.4.s:
bhakto rudro kṛpāvāṃśca jaṃtuṣveva haravrataḥ..
tadenaṃ bhūtamartyeṣu drogdhāraṃ tvaṃ pinākinaḥ.. 32.98 ..
1.4.d:
भक्तो रुद्रो कृपावांश्च जंतुष्वेव हरव्रतः..
तदेनं भूतमर्त्येषु द्रोग्धारं त्वं पिनाकिनः.. 32.98 ..
1.4.m:
A devotee of Rudra is compassionate toward living beings, devoted to Hara's vows.
Therefore, slay this hater of the wielder of Pināka toward living beings and mortals;

1.4.s:
jahi naivātra paśyāmi doṣaṃ kaṃcana te prabho..
śrutveti vācaṃ goviṃdātsatyārthāmapi bhārata.. 32.99 ..
1.4.d:
जहि नैवात्र पश्यामि दोषं कंचन ते प्रभो..
श्रुत्वेति वाचं गोविंदात्सत्यार्थामपि भारत.. 32.99 ..
1.4.m:
I see no fault whatsoever in you for this, O Lord."
Having heard these words from Govinda, though they were true, O Bhārata,

1.4.s:
haṃtuṃ na kurute buddhiṃ rudrabhakta iti smaran..
tārakastu tataḥ kruddho yayau vegena keśavam.. 32.100 ..
1.4.d:
हंतुं न कुरुते बुद्धिं रुद्रभक्त इति स्मरन्..
तारकस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो ययौ वेगेन केशवम्.. 32.100 ..
1.4.m:
He did not make up his mind to kill him, remembering, 'He is a devotee of Rudra.'
Then Tāraka, enraged, rushed with speed toward Keśava,

1.4.s:
prāha caivaṃ sudurbuddhe hanmi tvāṃ paśya me balam..
devānāṃ cāpi dharmāṇāṃ mūlaṃ matimatāṃ tathā..
hatvā tvāmadya sarvāṃstāṃśchetsye paśyādya me balam.. 32.101 ..
1.4.d:
प्राह चैवं सुदुर्बुद्धे हन्मि त्वां पश्य मे बलम्..
देवानां चापि धर्माणां मूलं मतिमतां तथा..
हत्वा त्वामद्य सर्वांस्तांश्छेत्स्ये पश्याद्य मे बलम्.. 32.101 ..

1.4.s:
..viṣṇuruvāca..
daityeṃdra tava cāsmābhiḥ kimaho śrṛṇu satyatām.. 32.102 ..
1.4.d:
..विष्णुरुवाच..
दैत्येंद्र तव चास्माभिः किमहो श्रृणु सत्यताम्.. 32.102 ..
1.4.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"O king of the Daityas, what do you have to do with us? Hear the truth!

1.4.s:
rathe ya eṣa śarvo'yaṃ hate'sminsakalaṃ hatam..
śrutveti tārakaḥ kruddhastūrṇaṃ rudrarathaṃ yayau.. 32.103 ..
1.4.d:
रथे य एष शर्वोऽयं हतेऽस्मिन्सकलं हतम्..
श्रुत्वेति तारकः क्रुद्धस्तूर्णं रुद्ररथं ययौ.. 32.103 ..
1.4.m:
It is Śarva who stands here in this chariot; once he is killed, everything is killed."
Hearing this, the enraged Tāraka swiftly rushed toward the chariot of Rudra.

1.4.s:
abhisṛtya sa jagrāha rudrasya rathakūbaram..
yadā sa kūbaraṃ kruddhastārakaḥ sahasā'grahīt.. 32.104 ..
1.4.d:
अभिसृत्य स जग्राह रुद्रस्य रथकूबरम्..
यदा स कूबरं क्रुद्धस्तारकः सहसाऽग्रहीत्.. 32.104 ..
1.4.m: Advancing, he seized the yoke of Rudra's chariot. / When enraged Tāraka suddenly took hold of the yoke,

1.4.s:
resatū rodasī tūrṇaṃ mumuhuśca maharṣayaḥ..
vyanadaṃśca mahākāyā daityā jaladharopamāḥ.. 32.105 ..
1.4.d:
रेसतू रोदसी तूर्णं मुमुहुश्च महर्षयः..
व्यनदंश्च महाकाया दैत्या जलधरोपमाः.. 32.105 ..
1.4.m: the two worlds quickly shrieked, and the great seers were bewildered. / The cloud-like, huge-bodied Daityas roared out,

1.4.s:
āsīcca niścitaṃ teṣāṃ jitamasmābhirityuta..
tāra kasyāpyabhiprāyaṃ bhagavānvīkṣya śaṃkaraḥ.. 32.106 ..
1.4.d:
आसीच्च निश्चितं तेषां जितमस्माभिरित्युत..
तार कस्याप्यभिप्रायं भगवान्वीक्ष्य शंकरः.. 32.106 ..
1.4.m: and their conviction was: “We have won!” / Seeing the intention of Tāraka too, the blessed Śaṃkara,

1.4.s:
umayā saha saṃtyaktvā rathaṃ vṛṣabhamāvahat..
omityatha japanbrahmā ākāśaṃ sahasāśritaḥ.. 32.107 ..
1.4.d:
उमया सह संत्यक्त्वा रथं वृषभमावहत्..
ओमित्यथ जपन्ब्रह्मा आकाशं सहसाश्रितः.. 32.107 ..
1.4.m: abandoning the chariot together with Umā, mounted his bull. / Then Brahmā, chanting “Om,” quickly took to the sky.

1.4.s:
tatastaṃ śatasiṃhaṃ ca rathaṃ rudreṇa nirmitam..
utkṣipya pṛthvyāmāsphoṭya cūrṇayāmāsa tārakaḥ.. 32.108 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तं शतसिंहं च रथं रुद्रेण निर्मितम्..
उत्क्षिप्य पृथ्व्यामास्फोट्य चूर्णयामास तारकः.. 32.108 ..
1.4.m: Then Tāraka, lifting up that chariot fashioned with a hundred lions by Rudra / and dashing it against the earth, smashed it to pieces.

1.4.s:
śūlapāśupatādīni sahasopasthitāni ca..
vārayāmāsa giriśo bhavaḥ sādhya iti bruvan.. 32.109 ..
1.4.d:
शूलपाशुपतादीनि सहसोपस्थितानि च..
वारयामास गिरिशो भवः साध्य इति ब्रुवन्.. 32.109 ..
1.4.m: And when the trident, the Pāśupata, and other [weapons] suddenly approached, / the Mountain-dweller restrained them, saying, “Bhava is to be mastered [by himself alone].”

1.4.s:
tataḥ svavaṃcitaṃ jñātvā rudreṇātmānamīrṣyayā..
vinadansahasā'dhāvadvṛṣabhasthaṃ maheśvaram.. 32.110 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स्ववंचितं ज्ञात्वा रुद्रेणात्मानमीर्ष्यया..
विनदन्सहसाऽधावद्वृषभस्थं महेश्वरम्.. 32.110 ..
1.4.m: Then, realising he had been tricked by Rudra, out of jealousy, / shouting loudly, he suddenly rushed at Maheśvara seated on the bull.

1.4.s:
tato janārdano'dhāvaccakramudyamya vegataḥ..
vajramiṃdrastathodyamya daṃḍaṃ cāpi yamo nadan.. 32.111 ..
1.4.d:
ततो जनार्दनोऽधावच्चक्रमुद्यम्य वेगतः..
वज्रमिंद्रस्तथोद्यम्य दंडं चापि यमो नदन्.. 32.111 ..
1.4.m: Then Janārdana rushed forward, swiftly brandishing his discus, / Indra likewise raising his thunderbolt, and Yama roaring with his rod,

1.4.s:
gadāṃ dhaneśvaraḥ kruddhaḥ pāśaṃ ca varuṇo nadan
vāyurmahāṃkuśaṃ ghoraṃ śaktiṃ vahnirmahāprabhām.. 32.112 ..
1.4.d:
गदां धनेश्वरः क्रुद्धः पाशं च वरुणो नदन्
वायुर्महांकुशं घोरं शक्तिं वह्निर्महाप्रभाम्.. 32.112 ..
1.4.m: the Lord of Wealth enraged with his mace, and Varuṇa roaring with his noose, / Vāyu with a terrible great hook, Agni with his splendid spear,

1.4.s:
nirṛtirniśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rudrāḥ śūlāni kopitāḥ..
dhanūṃṣi sādhyā devāśca parighānvasavastathā.. 32.113 ..
1.4.d:
निरृतिर्निशितं खड्गं रुद्राः शूलानि कोपिताः..
धनूंषि साध्या देवाश्च परिघान्वसवस्तथा.. 32.113 ..
1.4.m: Nirṛti with his sharp sword, the enraged Rudras with their tridents, / the Sādhya gods with bows, and likewise the Vasus with bludgeons,

1.4.s:
viśvedevāśca musalaṃ caṃdrārkau svaprabhāmapi..
oṣadhīścāśvinau devau nāgāśca jvalitaṃ viṣam.. 32.114 ..
1.4.d:
विश्वेदेवाश्च मुसलं चंद्रार्कौ स्वप्रभामपि..
ओषधीश्चाश्विनौ देवौ नागाश्च ज्वलितं विषम्.. 32.114 ..
1.4.m: and the Viśvedevas with a pestle, the sun and moon with their own radiance, / the two divine Aśvins with herbs, and the serpents with blazing poison,

1.4.s:
himādri pramukhāścāpi samudyamya mahīdharān..
bhṛśamunnadato devāndhāvato vīkṣya tārakaḥ.. 32.115 ..
1.4.d:
हिमाद्रि प्रमुखाश्चापि समुद्यम्य महीधरान्..
भृशमुन्नदतो देवान्धावतो वीक्ष्य तारकः.. 32.115 ..
1.4.m: and the mountains headed by Himādri taking up great rocks. / Seeing the gods rushing forward shouting loudly, Tāraka,

1.4.s:
nivṛttaḥ sahasā pārtha mahāgaja ivonnadan..
sa vajramuṣṭi nāhatya bhuje śakramapātayat.. 32.116 ..
1.4.d:
निवृत्तः सहसा पार्थ महागज इवोन्नदन्..
स वज्रमुष्टि नाहत्य भुजे शक्रमपातयत्.. 32.116 ..
1.4.m: turning back suddenly, O son of Pṛthā, like a roaring great elephant, / struck Indra with a fist like a thunderbolt and felled him by his arm.

1.4.s:
daṃḍaṃ yamādupādāya mūrdhnyāhatya nyapātayat..
urasāhatya sagadaṃ dhanadaṃ bhuvyapātayat.. 32.117 ..
1.4.d:
दंडं यमादुपादाय मूर्ध्न्याहत्य न्यपातयत्..
उरसाहत्य सगदं धनदं भुव्यपातयत्.. 32.117 ..
1.4.m: Seizing the rod from Yama, he struck him on the head and struck him down; / striking the Wealth-giver along with his mace on the chest, he threw him to the earth;

1.4.s:
varuṇātpāśamādāya tena baddhā nyapātayat..
mahāṃkuśena vāyuṃ ca ciraṃ mūrdhni jaghāna saḥ.. 32.118 ..
1.4.d:
वरुणात्पाशमादाय तेन बद्धा न्यपातयत्..
महांकुशेन वायुं च चिरं मूर्ध्नि जघान सः.. 32.118 ..
1.4.m: taking the noose from Varuṇa, he bound him with it and threw him down; / and with the great hook he struck Vāyu for a long time on the head.

1.4.s:
phūlkārairuddhataṃ vahniṃ śamayāmāsa tārakaḥ..
nirṛtiṃkhaḍgamādāya hatvā tena nyapātayat.. 32.119 ..
1.4.d:
फूल्कारैरुद्धतं वह्निं शमयामास तारकः..
निरृतिंखड्गमादाय हत्वा तेन न्यपातयत्.. 32.119 ..
1.4.m: With his blowing breaths Tāraka extinguished the fierce fire; / seizing the sword from Nirṛti, he struck and felled him with it.

1.4.s:
śūlaireva tathā rudrāḥ sādhyāśca dhanuṣārditāḥ..
parighaireva vasavo muśalaireva viśvakāḥ.. 32.120 ..
1.4.d:
शूलैरेव तथा रुद्राः साध्याश्च धनुषार्दिताः..
परिघैरेव वसवो मुशलैरेव विश्वकाः.. 32.120 ..
1.4.m: Likewise the Rudras were afflicted by their own tridents, the Sādhyas by their bow, / the Vasus by their very bludgeons, the Viśvas by their pestles.

1.4.s:
reṇunācchādya caṃdrārkau valmīkasthāvivekṣitau..
mahogrāścauṣadhīstālairaśvibhyāṃ so'bhyavartayat.. 32.121 ..
1.4.d:
रेणुनाच्छाद्य चंद्रार्कौ वल्मीकस्थाविवेक्षितौ..
महोग्राश्चौषधीस्तालैरश्विभ्यां सोऽभ्यवर्तयत्.. 32.121 ..
1.4.m: Covering the moon and sun with dust, they were seen as if inside an ant-hill; / with palmyra trees he repelled the terrible herbs of the Aśvins;

1.4.s:
saviṣāśca kṛtā nāgā nirviṣāḥ pādakuṭṭanaiḥ..
parvatāḥ parvataireva nirucchvāsā bhṛśaṃ kṛtāḥ.. 32.122 ..
1.4.d:
सविषाश्च कृता नागा निर्विषाः पादकुट्टनैः..
पर्वताः पर्वतैरेव निरुच्छ्वासा भृशं कृताः.. 32.122 ..
1.4.m: the venomous serpents were rendered venomless by the stomping of his feet; / and the mountains were made thoroughly breathless by the mountains themselves.

1.4.s:
evaṃ taddevasainyaṃ ca hāhābhūtamacetanam..
kṛtvā muhūrtādādhāvaccakrapāṇiṃ tamunnadan.. 32.123 ..
1.4.d:
एवं तद्देवसैन्यं च हाहाभूतमचेतनम्..
कृत्वा मुहूर्तादाधावच्चक्रपाणिं तमुन्नदन्.. 32.123 ..
1.4.m: Having thus thrown that divine army into lamentation and unconsciousness in a moment, / he rushed roaring at that Discus-bearer.

1.4.s:
tataścāṃtardadhe sadyaḥ prahasanniva keśavaḥ..
kuyogina iva svāmī sadā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ.. 32.124 ..
1.4.d:
ततश्चांतर्दधे सद्यः प्रहसन्निव केशवः..
कुयोगिन इव स्वामी सदा बुद्धिमतां वरः.. 32.124 ..
1.4.m: Then Keśava vanished immediately, as if laughing, / just like the master [disappears] from a bad ascetic, he who is ever foremost among the wise.

1.4.s:
apaśyaṃstārako viṣṇuṃ punarvṛṣabhavā hanam..
ādhāvatkupito daityo muṣṭimudyamya vegataḥ.. 32.125 ..
1.4.d:
अपश्यंस्तारको विष्णुं पुनर्वृषभवा हनम्..
आधावत्कुपितो दैत्यो मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वेगतः.. 32.125 ..
1.4.m: Not seeing Viṣṇu, the angry Daitya rushed again / toward the one mounted on the bull, swiftly raising his fist.

1.4.s:
acirāṃśurivālakṣyo lakṣyotha bhagavānhariḥ..
ābabhāṣe tato devānbāhumudyamyacoccakaiḥ.. 32.126 ..
1.4.d:
अचिरांशुरिवालक्ष्यो लक्ष्योथ भगवान्हरिः..
आबभाषे ततो देवान्बाहुमुद्यम्यचोच्चकैः.. 32.126 ..
1.4.m: Hard to perceive like lightning, the blessed Hari then became visible, / and raising his arm high, he spoke to the gods:

1.4.s:
palāyadhvamaho devāḥ śaktiścedvaḥ palāyitum..
vimūḍhā hi vayaṃ sarve ye bālavacasāgatāḥ.. 32.127 ..
1.4.d:
पलायध्वमहो देवाः शक्तिश्चेद्वः पलायितुम्..
विमूढा हि वयं सर्वे ये बालवचसागताः.. 32.127 ..
1.4.m: “Flee, O gods, if you have the power to flee! / For we are all utterly foolish, having come at the word of a child.

1.4.s:
kiṃ na śrutaḥ purā gītaḥ ślokaḥ svāyaṃbhuvena yaḥ..
yathā bāleṣu nikṣiptāḥ strīṣu ṣaṃḍitakeṣu ca..
apasmārīṣu caivāpi sarve te saṃśayaṃ gatāḥ.. 32.128 ..
1.4.d:
किं न श्रुतः पुरा गीतः श्लोकः स्वायंभुवेन यः..
यथा बालेषु निक्षिप्ताः स्त्रीषु षंडितकेषु च..
अपस्मारीषु चैवापि सर्वे ते संशयं गताः.. 32.128 ..
1.4.m: Have you not heard the verse sung long ago by the self-manifest [Manu]? / ‘Whatever is entrusted to children, women, eunuchs, / and those with epilepsy—all of it comes to doubt.’

1.4.s: pratyakṣaṃ tadidaṃ sarvamādhunā cātra dṛsyate.. 32.129 ..
1.4.d: प्रत्यक्षं तदिदं सर्वमाधुना चात्र दृस्यते.. 32.129 ..
1.4.m: All that is directly seen here right now.

1.4.s:
ajñāsiṣma puraivaitadrudrabhaktaṃ na haṃtyasau..
yatpratijñāṃ nākariṣyanna syānnaḥ kadanaṃ mahat.. 32.130 ..
1.4.d:
अज्ञासिष्म पुरैवैतद्रुद्रभक्तं न हंत्यसौ..
यत्प्रतिज्ञां नाकरिष्यन्न स्यान्नः कदनं महत्.. 32.130 ..
1.4.m: We already knew before that he does not kill a devotee of Rudra; / had he not made that vow, there would not be our great slaughter.

1.4.s:
athaiṣa yadi daityeṃdraṃ na nihaṃti kubuddhimān..
mā bhayaṃ vo mahābhāgā nihaniṣyāmi vo ripūn.. 32.131 ..
1.4.d:
अथैष यदि दैत्येंद्रं न निहंति कुबुद्धिमान्..
मा भयं वो महाभागा निहनिष्यामि वो रिपून्.. 32.131 ..
1.4.m: Now, if this foolish one does not slay the lord of Daityas, / do not fear, O fortunate ones; I will slay your enemies.

1.4.s: adya me vipulaṃ bāhvorbalaṃ paśyata daityādhamaṃ nāśayāmi muṣṭinaikena paśyata.. 32.132 ..
1.4.d: अद्य मे विपुलं बाह्वोर्बलं पश्यत दैत्याधमं नाशयामि मुष्टिनैकेन पश्यत.. 32.132 ..
1.4.m: Today behold the vast strength of my arms; behold, / I shall destroy this vilest Daitya with a single fist!

1.4.s:
mayā hi dakṣiṇo bāhurdattaśca bhavatāṃ sadā..
ripūnvā nihaniṣyāmi satyaṃ tatparipālaye.. 32.133 ..
1.4.d:
मया हि दक्षिणो बाहुर्दत्तश्च भवतां सदा..
रिपून्वा निहनिष्यामि सत्यं तत्परिपालये.. 32.133 ..
1.4.m: For my right arm has always been given to you: / I shall kill the enemies—I uphold that truth!

1.4.s:
yeṃ'bare ye ca pātāle bhuvi ye ca mahāsurāḥ..
kṣaṇāttānnāsayiṣyāmi mahāvāto ghanāniva.. 32.134 ..
1.4.d:
येंऽबरे ये च पाताले भुवि ये च महासुराः..
क्षणात्तान्नासयिष्यामि महावातो घनानिव.. 32.134 ..
1.4.m: Those who are in the sky, those in Pātāla, and the great Asuras who are on earth— / I will destroy them in an instant, like a great wind destroys clouds.”

1.4.s:
evamuktā jagannātho muṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam..
nirāyudhastārkṣyapṛṣṭhādavaplutyābhyadhāvata.. 32.135 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्ता जगन्नाथो मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्..
निरायुधस्तार्क्ष्यपृष्ठादवप्लुत्याभ्यधावत.. 32.135 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord of the Universe raised his right fist, / leaped down unarmed from the back of Garuḍa, and rushed forward.

1.4.s:
tasmindhāvati goviṃde cacāla bhuvanatrayam..
vimūrchitamabhūdviśvaṃ devā bhītiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ.. 32.136 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिन्धावति गोविंदे चचाल भुवनत्रयम्..
विमूर्छितमभूद्विश्वं देवा भीतिं परां ययुः.. 32.136 ..
1.4.m: As Govinda ran, the three worlds shook; / the universe swooned, and the gods experienced supreme fear.

1.4.s:
dhāvataścāpi kalpāṃtaṃ rudrakalpasya tasya yāḥ..
mukhātsamudyajurjvālāstābiḥ kharvaśataṃ hatam.. 32.137 ..
1.4.d:
धावतश्चापि कल्पांतं रुद्रकल्पस्य तस्य याः..
मुखात्समुद्यजुर्ज्वालास्ताबिः खर्वशतं हतम्.. 32.137 ..
1.4.m: And as he ran like Rudra's world-destroying fire, the flames / that burst from his mouth slew hundreds of billions [of demons].

1.4.s:
tatoṃ'tarikṣe vācaśca procuḥ siddhāḥ svayaṃ tadā..
jahi kopaṃ vāsudeva tvayi kruddhe kva vai jagat.. 32.138 ..
1.4.d:
ततोंऽतरिक्षे वाचश्च प्रोचुः सिद्धाः स्वयं तदा..
जहि कोपं वासुदेव त्वयि क्रुद्धे क्व वै जगत्.. 32.138 ..
1.4.m: Then in the sky the Siddhas themselves spoke words: / “Restrain your anger, Vāsudeva! When you are angry, where indeed will the world be?”

1.4.s:
anādṛtyeva tadvākyaṃ bruvannānyatkaromyaham..
āhvayaṃśca mahādaityaṃ kruddho hariradhāvata.. 32.139 ..
1.4.d:
अनादृत्येव तद्वाक्यं ब्रुवन्नान्यत्करोम्यहम्..
आह्वयंश्च महादैत्यं क्रुद्धो हरिरधावत.. 32.139 ..
1.4.m: Disregarding that statement as it were, saying “I will do nothing else,” / and challenging the great Daitya, wrathful Hari ran.

1.4.s:
uvāca vācaṃ sādhūṃśca yatnātpālayatāṃ phalam..
duṣṭānvinighnatāṃ caiva tatphalaṃ mama jāyatām.. 32.140 ..
1.4.d:
उवाच वाचं साधूंश्च यत्नात्पालयतां फलम्..
दुष्टान्विनिघ्नतां चैव तत्फलं मम जायताम्.. 32.140 ..
1.4.m: He spoke a word: “The fruit that comes to those who protect the virtuous with effort / and to those who slay the wicked—may that fruit be mine!”

1.4.s:
athāpaśyanmahāseno rudraṃ yāṃtaṃ ca tārakam..
tārakaṃ cānvadhāvantaṃ purāmapuruṣaṃ harim.. 32.141 ..
1.4.d:
अथापश्यन्महासेनो रुद्रं यांतं च तारकम्..
तारकं चान्वधावन्तं पुरामपुरुषं हरिम्.. 32.141 ..
1.4.m: Then Mahāsena saw Rudra, and Tāraka advancing [toward him], / and Hari, the foremost Puruṣa, running after Tāraka;

1.4.s:
jagacca kṣubdhamatyarthaṃ svāṃ pratijñāṃ purā kṛtām..
paścimāṃ pratilaṃbaṃtaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāpi lohitam.. 32.142 ..
1.4.d:
जगच्च क्षुब्धमत्यर्थं स्वां प्रतिज्ञां पुरा कृताम्..
पश्चिमां प्रतिलंबंतं भास्करं चापि लोहितम्.. 32.142 ..
1.4.m: and the world exceedingly agitated; and his own vow made formerly; / and the red sun sinking toward the west;

1.4.s:
ākāśavāṇīṃ śrṛṇvaṃśca kiṃ skanda tvaṃ viṣīdasī..
paścāttāpo yadi bhavetkṛtvā brahmavadhaṃ tvayi.. 32.143 ..
1.4.d:
आकाशवाणीं श्रृण्वंश्च किं स्कन्द त्वं विषीदसी..
पश्चात्तापो यदि भवेत्कृत्वा ब्रह्मवधं त्वयि.. 32.143 ..
1.4.m: and hearing a voice in the sky: “Why do you despair, O Skanda? / If repentance should occur in you upon committing the slaying of a brahmin,

1.4.s:
sthāpayerligamīśasya mokṣo hatyāśatairapi..
āviveśa mahākrodhaṃ didhakṣuriva medinīm.. 32.144 ..
1.4.d:
स्थापयेर्लिगमीशस्य मोक्षो हत्याशतैरपि..
आविवेश महाक्रोधं दिधक्षुरिव मेदिनीम्.. 32.144 ..
1.4.m: you shall establish a liṅga of the Lord; there is liberation even from hundreds of killings!” / Then he was filled with great wrath, as if desiring to burn the earth.

1.4.s:
athotplutya mayūrātsa prahasanniva keśavam..
bāhubhyāmapyupādāya provāca bhavanaṃdanaḥ.. 32.145 ..
1.4.d:
अथोत्प्लुत्य मयूरात्स प्रहसन्निव केशवम्..
बाहुभ्यामप्युपादाय प्रोवाच भवनंदनः.. 32.145 ..
1.4.m: Then leaping down from his peacock, smiling as it were at Keśava / and catching him with his two arms, the son of Bhava said:

1.4.s:
jānāmi tvāmahaṃ viṣṇo mahābuddhiparākramam..
bhūtabhavyaviṣyāṃśca daityānhaṃsyapi hūṃkṛtaiḥ.. 32.146 ..
1.4.d:
जानामि त्वामहं विष्णो महाबुद्धिपराक्रमम्..
भूतभव्यविष्यांश्च दैत्यान्हंस्यपि हूंकृतैः.. 32.146 ..
1.4.m: “I know you, O Viṣṇu, to possess great intellect and valour; / you can kill even past, present, and future Daityas with mere roars.

1.4.s:
tvameva haṃtā daityānāṃ devānāṃ paripālakaḥ..
dharmasaṃsthāpakaśca tvameva te racitoṃ'jaliḥ.. 32.147 ..
1.4.d:
त्वमेव हंता दैत्यानां देवानां परिपालकः..
धर्मसंस्थापकश्च त्वमेव ते रचितोंऽजलिः.. 32.147 ..
1.4.m: You alone are the slayer of Daityas, the protector of the gods, / and the establisher of righteousness; reverent salutation is made to you.

1.4.s:
kṣaṇārdhaṃ paśya me vīryaṃ bhāskaro lohitāyate..
evaṃ praṇamya skandena vāsudevaḥ prasāditaḥ.. 32.148 ..
1.4.d:
क्षणार्धं पश्य मे वीर्यं भास्करो लोहितायते..
एवं प्रणम्य स्कन्देन वासुदेवः प्रसादितः.. 32.148 ..
1.4.m:
"Behold my valor for half a moment; the sun is turning red."
Having bowed thus, Skanda propitiated Vāsudeva.

1.4.s:
viroṣo'bhūttamāliṃgya vacanaṃ keśavo'bravīt..
sanāthastvadya dharmo'yaṃ surāścaiva tvayā guha.. 32.149 ..
1.4.d:
विरोषोऽभूत्तमालिंग्य वचनं केशवोऽब्रवीत्..
सनाथस्त्वद्य धर्मोऽयं सुराश्चैव त्वया गुह.. 32.149 ..
1.4.m:
Free from anger, Keśava embraced him and spoke these words:
"Today, Guha, this dharma and the gods have found a protector in you.

1.4.s:
smarātmānaṃ yadarthaṃ tvamutpanno'si maheśvarāt..
sādhūnāṃ pālanārthāya duṣṭasaṃharaṇāya ca..
suraviprakṛte janma jīvitaṃ ca mahātmanām.. 32.150 ..
1.4.d:
स्मरात्मानं यदर्थं त्वमुत्पन्नोऽसि महेश्वरात्..
साधूनां पालनार्थाय दुष्टसंहरणाय च..
सुरविप्रकृते जन्म जीवितं च महात्मनाम्.. 32.150 ..
1.4.m:
Remember yourself, and the purpose for which you were born from Maheśvara:
for the protection of the virtuous and the destruction of the wicked.
The birth and life of noble souls is for the sake of the gods and brahmins.

1.4.s:
rudrasya devyā gaṃgāyāḥ kṛttikānāṃ ca tejasā..
svāhāvahneśca jātastvaṃ tattejaḥ saphalīkuru..
sādhūnāṃ ca kṛte yasya dhanaṃ vīryaṃ ca saṃpadaḥ.. 32.151 ..
1.4.d:
रुद्रस्य देव्या गंगायाः कृत्तिकानां च तेजसा..
स्वाहावह्नेश्च जातस्त्वं तत्तेजः सफलीकुरु..
साधूनां च कृते यस्य धनं वीर्यं च संपदः.. 32.151 ..
1.4.m:
You were born from the fiery energy of Rudra, of the Goddess, of Gaṅgā, of the Kṛttikās,
and of Svāhā and Agni. Make that fiery energy fruitful!
He whose wealth, valor, and riches are for the sake of the virtuous—

1.4.s: saphalaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ nānyathā rudranaṃdana.. 32.152 ..
1.4.d: सफलं तस्य तत्सर्वं नान्यथा रुद्रनंदन.. 32.152 ..
1.4.m: all of that becomes fruitful for him, not otherwise, O son of Rudra!

1.4.s:
adya dharmaśca devāśca gāvaḥ sādhyāśca brāhmaṇāḥ..
naṃdaṃtu tava vīryeṇa pradarśaya nijaṃ balam.. 32.153 ..
1.4.d:
अद्य धर्मश्च देवाश्च गावः साध्याश्च ब्राह्मणाः..
नंदंतु तव वीर्येण प्रदर्शय निजं बलम्.. 32.153 ..
1.4.m:
Today, let dharma, the gods, cows, the Sādhyas, and the brahmins
rejoice through your valor! Display your own strength!"

1.4.s:
..skanda uvāca..
yā gatiḥ śivatyāgena tvattyāgena ca keśava..
tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyāṃ kṣipraṃ hanmi cenna hi tārakam.. 32.154 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कन्द उवाच..
या गतिः शिवत्यागेन त्वत्त्यागेन च केशव..
तां गतिं प्राप्नुयां क्षिप्रं हन्मि चेन्न हि तारकम्.. 32.154 ..
1.4.m:
Skanda said:
"May I quickly attain that fate which comes from abandoning Śiva
and abandoning you, Keśava, if I do not slay Tāraka!

1.4.s:
yā gatiḥ śrutityāgena sādhvī bhāryātipīḍanāt..
sādhūnāṃ ca parityāgādvṛthā jīvitasādhanāt..
niṣṭhurasya gatiryā ca tāṃ gatiṃ yāmi keśava.. 32.155 ..
1.4.d:
या गतिः श्रुतित्यागेन साध्वी भार्यातिपीडनात्..
साधूनां च परित्यागाद्वृथा जीवितसाधनात्..
निष्ठुरस्य गतिर्या च तां गतिं यामि केशव.. 32.155 ..
1.4.m:
The fate that comes from abandoning the Veda, from tormenting a virtuous wife,
from abandoning the righteous, and from maintaining life in vain—
and the fate that belongs to a cruel person, to that fate let me go, O Keśava!"

1.4.s:
ityukte sumahānnādaḥ saṃprajajñe divaukasām..
praśaśaṃsurguhaṃ kecitkecinnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum.. 32.156 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ते सुमहान्नादः संप्रजज्ञे दिवौकसाम्..
प्रशशंसुर्गुहं केचित्केचिन्नारायणं प्रभुम्.. 32.156 ..
1.4.m:
When this was spoken, a great roar arose among the gods.
Some praised Guha, and some praised Lord Nārāyaṇa.

1.4.s:
tatastārkṣaayaṃ samārudya haristasminmahāraṇe..
tāmracūḍaṃ mahāsena stārakaṃ cāpyadhāvatām.. 32.157 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तार्क्षअयं समारुद्य हरिस्तस्मिन्महारणे..
ताम्रचूडं महासेन स्तारकं चाप्यधावताम्.. 32.157 ..
1.4.m:
Then, mounting Garuḍa, Hari in that great battle,
and Mahāsena, [mounting] his cock-crested bird, both rushed against Tāraka.

1.4.s:
lohitāṃbarasaṃvīto lohitasragvibhūṣaṇaḥ..
lohitākṣo mahābāhurhiraṇyakavacaḥ prabhuḥ.. 32.158 ..
1.4.d:
लोहितांबरसंवीतो लोहितस्रग्विभूषणः..
लोहिताक्षो महाबाहुर्हिरण्यकवचः प्रभुः.. 32.158 ..
1.4.m:
Clad in red garments, adorned with red garlands and ornaments,
red-eyed, mighty-armed, the Lord wore golden armor.

1.4.s:
bhujena tolayañchaktiṃ sarvabhūtāni kampayan..
prāpya taṃ tārakaṃ prāha mahāseno hasanniva.. 32.159 ..
1.4.d:
भुजेन तोलयञ्छक्तिं सर्वभूतानि कम्पयन्..
प्राप्य तं तारकं प्राह महासेनो हसन्निव.. 32.159 ..
1.4.m:
Poising the spear with his arm, making all creatures tremble,
approaching that Tāraka, Mahāsena spoke as if laughing:

1.4.s:
tiṣṭhatiṣṭha sudurbuddhe jīvitaṃ te mayi sthitam..
suhṛṣṭaḥ kriyatāṃ loko durlabhaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ.. 32.160 ..
1.4.d:
तिष्ठतिष्ठ सुदुर्बुद्धे जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम्..
सुहृष्टः क्रियतां लोको दुर्लभः सर्वसिद्धिदः.. 32.160 ..
1.4.m:
"Halt, halt, you evil-minded one! Your life now rests in my hands!
Let the world, hard to attain and the granter of all perfections, be made exceedingly joyful!

1.4.s:
yatte suniṣṭhuratvaṃ ca dharme deveṣu goṣu ca..
tasya te praharāmyadya smara śastraṃ suśikṣitam.. 32.161 ..
1.4.d:
यत्ते सुनिष्ठुरत्वं च धर्मे देवेषु गोषु च..
तस्य ते प्रहराम्यद्य स्मर शस्त्रं सुशिक्षितम्.. 32.161 ..
1.4.m:
For that extreme cruelty of yours toward dharma, the gods, and cows,
I strike you today! Remember your well-practiced weapons!"

1.4.s:
evamukte guhenātha nivṛttasyāsya bhārata..
tārakasya śirodeśātkāpi nārī viniryayau.. 32.162 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्ते गुहेनाथ निवृत्तस्यास्य भारत..
तारकस्य शिरोदेशात्कापि नारी विनिर्ययौ.. 32.162 ..
1.4.m:
When this was said by Guha, O Bhārata, as he turned back,
there emerged from the region of Tāraka's head a certain woman,

1.4.s:
tejasā bhāsayaṃtī tamadha ūrdhvaṃ diśo daśa..
dṛṣṭvā nārīṃ guhaḥ prāha kāsi kasmācca nirgatā.. 32.163 ..
1.4.d:
तेजसा भासयंती तमध ऊर्ध्वं दिशो दश..
दृष्ट्वा नारीं गुहः प्राह कासि कस्माच्च निर्गता.. 32.163 ..
1.4.m:
illuminating him, the lower and upper realms, and the ten directions with her radiance.
Seeing that woman, Guha said: "Who are you, and why have you come forth?"

1.4.s:
..nāryuvāca..
ahaṃ śaktirguhākhyātā bhūtaleṣu sadā sthitā..
anena daityarājena mahatā tapasārjjitā.. 32.164 ..
1.4.d:
..नार्युवाच..
अहं शक्तिर्गुहाख्याता भूतलेषु सदा स्थिता..
अनेन दैत्यराजेन महता तपसार्ज्जिता.. 32.164 ..
1.4.m:
The woman said:
"I am the Power (Śakti), O Guha, celebrated as ever-dwelling on the earth.
I was acquired by this king of daityas through great austerity.

1.4.s:
sureṣu sarveṣu vasāmi cāhaṃ vipreṣu śāstrārtharateṣu cāham..
sādhvīṣu nārīṣu tathā vasāmi vinā guṇānnāsmi vasāmi kutracit.. 32.165 ..
1.4.d:
सुरेषु सर्वेषु वसामि चाहं विप्रेषु शास्त्रार्थरतेषु चाहम्..
साध्वीषु नारीषु तथा वसामि विना गुणान्नास्मि वसामि कुत्रचित्.. 32.165 ..
1.4.m:
I dwell in all the gods, and I dwell in brahmins devoted to the meaning of the scriptures;
I dwell likewise in virtuous women; without good qualities I dwell nowhere.

1.4.s:
tadasya puṇyasaṃghasya saṃprāptodyāvadhirguha..
tadenaṃ tyajya yāsyāmi jahyenaṃ viśvahetave.. 32.166 ..
1.4.d:
तदस्य पुण्यसंघस्य संप्राप्तोद्यावधिर्गुह..
तदेनं त्यज्य यास्यामि जह्येनं विश्वहेतवे.. 32.166 ..
1.4.m:
Now the limit of his heap of merit has arrived, O Guha;
therefore, abandoning him, I depart. Slay him for the sake of the universe!"

1.4.s:
tasyāṃ tato nirgatāyāṃ daityaśīrṣaṃ vyakampayat..
kaṃpitaṃ cāsya taddehaṃ gatavīryo'bhavatkṣaṇāt.. 32.167 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यां ततो निर्गतायां दैत्यशीर्षं व्यकम्पयत्..
कंपितं चास्य तद्देहं गतवीर्योऽभवत्क्षणात्.. 32.167 ..
1.4.m:
When she had thus departed, the daitya's head shook,
and his body trembled; in an instant he was bereft of his valor.

1.4.s:
etasminnaṃtare śaktiṃ so'kṣipadgirijātmajaḥ..
ulkājvālā vimuñcaṃtīmatisūryāgnisaprabhām.. 32.168 ..
1.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शक्तिं सोऽक्षिपद्गिरिजात्मजः..
उल्काज्वाला विमुञ्चंतीमतिसूर्याग्निसप्रभाम्.. 32.168 ..
1.4.m:
At that moment, the son of the mountain's daughter hurled his spear,
which released fiery trails of meteors, blazing brighter than the sun and fire,

1.4.s:
kalpāṃbhodhisamunnādāṃ didhakṣaṃtīṃ jagadyathā..
tārakasyāṃtakālāya abhāgyasya daśāmiva.. 32.169 ..
1.4.d:
कल्पांभोधिसमुन्नादां दिधक्षंतीं जगद्यथा..
तारकस्यांतकालाय अभाग्यस्य दशामिव.. 32.169 ..
1.4.m:
roaring like the ocean of the cosmic dissolution, as if wishing to burn up the universe,
for the time of Tāraka's end, like the state of misfortune [personified],

1.4.s:
dāraṇīṃ parvatānāṃ ca sarvasattvabalādhikām..
utkṣipya tāṃ vinadyoccairamuñcatkupito guhaḥ.. 32.170 ..
1.4.d:
दारणीं पर्वतानां च सर्वसत्त्वबलाधिकाम्..
उत्क्षिप्य तां विनद्योच्चैरमुञ्चत्कुपितो गुहः.. 32.170 ..
1.4.m:
cleaving mountains, surpassing the strength of all living beings;
lifting it and roaring loudly, the enraged Guha released it,

1.4.s:
dharmaścedbalavām̐lloke dharmo jayati cetsadā..
tena satyena daityoyaṃ pralayaṃ yātvitīrayan.. 32.171 ..
1.4.d:
धर्मश्चेद्बलवाम्̐ल्लोके धर्मो जयति चेत्सदा..
तेन सत्येन दैत्योयं प्रलयं यात्वितीरयन्.. 32.171 ..
1.4.m:
declaring: "If dharma is strong in the world, and if dharma always triumphs,
by that truth let this daitya go to destruction!"

1.4.s:
sā kumārabhujotsṛṣṭā durnivāryā durāsadā..
vibheda hṛdayaṃ cāsya bhittvā ca dharaṇiṃ gatā.. 32.172 ..
1.4.d:
सा कुमारभुजोत्सृष्टा दुर्निवार्या दुरासदा..
विभेद हृदयं चास्य भित्त्वा च धरणिं गता.. 32.172 ..
1.4.m:
Hurled from Kumāra's arm, irresistible and unapproachable,
it split his heart and, piercing through, entered the earth.

1.4.s:
niḥsṛtya jalakallolapūrvikā skaṃdamāyayau..
sa ca saṃtāḍitaḥ śaktyā vibhinnahṛdayosuraḥ..
nādayanvasudhāṃ sarvāṃ papātāyomukho mṛtaḥ.. 32.173 ..
1.4.d:
निःसृत्य जलकल्लोलपूर्विका स्कंदमाययौ..
स च संताडितः शक्त्या विभिन्नहृदयोसुरः..
नादयन्वसुधां सर्वां पपातायोमुखो मृतः.. 32.173 ..
1.4.m:
Emerging again preceded by surges of water, it returned to Skanda.
And struck by the spear, his heart split open,
making the whole earth resound, the iron-faced asura fell down dead.

1.4.s:
evaṃ pratāpya trailokyaṃ nirjitya bahuśaḥ surān..
mahāraṇe kumāreṇa nihataḥ pārtha tārakaḥ.. 32.174 ..
1.4.d:
एवं प्रताप्य त्रैलोक्यं निर्जित्य बहुशः सुरान्..
महारणे कुमारेण निहतः पार्थ तारकः.. 32.174 ..
1.4.m:
Having thus tormented the three worlds and repeatedly vanquished the gods,
Tāraka was slain in the great battle by Kumāra, O Pārtha.

1.4.s: etasminnihate daitye praharṣaṃ viśvamāyayau.. 32.175 ..
1.4.d: एतस्मिन्निहते दैत्ये प्रहर्षं विश्वमाययौ.. 32.175 ..
1.4.m: When this daitya was slain, the universe attained great joy.

1.4.s:
vavurvātāstathā puṇyāḥ suprabhobhūddivākaraḥ..
jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtā digjanitasvanāḥ.. 32.176 ..
1.4.d:
ववुर्वातास्तथा पुण्याः सुप्रभोभूद्दिवाकरः..
जज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शांताः शांता दिग्जनितस्वनाः.. 32.176 ..
1.4.m:
Holy breezes blew, the sun became brightly radiant,
the fires burned peacefully, and the sounds born of the quarters grew calm.

1.4.s:
tataḥ punaḥ skaṃdamāha prahṛṣṭaḥ keśavo'rihā..
skaṃdaskaṃda mahābāho bāṇonāma balātmajaḥ.. 32.177 ..
1.4.d:
ततः पुनः स्कंदमाह प्रहृष्टः केशवोऽरिहा..
स्कंदस्कंद महाबाहो बाणोनाम बलात्मजः.. 32.177 ..
1.4.m:
Then Keśava, the slayer of foes, filled with joy, spoke again to Skanda:
"Skanda, Skanda, mighty-armed one! There is a son of Bali named Bāṇa;

1.4.s:
krauṃcaparvatamādāya devasaṃghānprabādhate..
so'dhunā te bhayādvīra palāyitvā nagaṃ gataḥ..
jahi taṃ pāpasaṃkalpaṃ krauṃcasthaṃ śaktivegataḥ.. 32.178 ..
1.4.d:
क्रौंचपर्वतमादाय देवसंघान्प्रबाधते..
सोऽधुना ते भयाद्वीर पलायित्वा नगं गतः..
जहि तं पापसंकल्पं क्रौंचस्थं शक्तिवेगतः.. 32.178 ..
1.4.m:
taking Mount Krauñca, he harasses the hosts of gods.
Now, out of fear of you, O hero, having fled he has gone to that mountain.
Slay that evil-minded one who stays on Krauñca with the speed of your spear!"

1.4.s:
tataḥ krauṃcaṃ mahātejā nānāvyālavināditam..
śaktyā bibheda bahubhirvṛkṣairjīvaiśca saṃkulam.. 32.179 ..
1.4.d:
ततः क्रौंचं महातेजा नानाव्यालविनादितम्..
शक्त्या बिभेद बहुभिर्वृक्षैर्जीवैश्च संकुलम्.. 32.179 ..
1.4.m:
Then he of great fiery energy, with his spear, split Krauñca,
which was echoing with various beasts of prey and crowded with many trees and living creatures.

1.4.s:
tatra vyālasahasrāṇi daityakoṭyayutaṃ tathā..
dadāha bāṇāṃ ca giraṃ bhittvā śaktirmahāravā.. 32.180 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र व्यालसहस्राणि दैत्यकोट्ययुतं तथा..
ददाह बाणां च गिरं भित्त्वा शक्तिर्महारवा.. 32.180 ..
1.4.m:
There, the spear with its mighty sound burned thousands of wild beasts,
tens of millions of daityas, and Bāṇa, splitting the mountain.

1.4.s: adyāpi chidraṃ tatpārtha krauṃcasya parivartate.. 32.181 ..
1.4.d: अद्यापि छिद्रं तत्पार्थ क्रौंचस्य परिवर्तते.. 32.181 ..
1.4.m: Even today, O Pārtha, that cleft in Krauñca remains,

1.4.s:
yena haṃsāśca krauṃcāśca mānasāya prayāṃti ca..
hatvā bāṇaṃ mahāśaktiḥ punaḥ skaṃdaṃ samāgatā..
pratyāyāti manaḥ sādhorāhṛtaṃ prahitaṃ tathā.. 32.182 ..
1.4.d:
येन हंसाश्च क्रौंचाश्च मानसाय प्रयांति च..
हत्वा बाणं महाशक्तिः पुनः स्कंदं समागता..
प्रत्यायाति मनः साधोराहृतं प्रहितं तथा.. 32.182 ..
1.4.m:
through which swans and curlews fly to Mānasa.
Having slain Bāṇa, the mighty spear returned again to Skanda,
just as a virtuous man's mind, sent out and brought back, returns.

1.4.s:
tato harīṃdrapramukhāḥ pratuṣṭuvurnanṛtuśca raṃbhāpramukhā varāṃganāḥ..
vādyāni sarvāṇi ca vādayaṃtastaṃ sādhusādhvityamarā jagurbhuśam.. 32.183 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māhesvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kumārakṛtatārakavadhavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 32 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
ततो हरींद्रप्रमुखाः प्रतुष्टुवुर्ननृतुश्च रंभाप्रमुखा वरांगनाः..
वाद्यानि सर्वाणि च वादयंतस्तं साधुसाध्वित्यमरा जगुर्भुशम्.. 32.183 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेस्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कुमारकृततारकवधवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 32 .. छ ..

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tatastaṃ girivarṣmāṇaṃ patitaṃ vasudhopari..
āliṃgitamiva pṛthvyā guṇinyā guṇinaṃ yathā.. 33.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततस्तं गिरिवर्ष्माणं पतितं वसुधोपरि..
आलिंगितमिव पृथ्व्या गुणिन्या गुणिनं यथा.. 33.1 ..
1.4.m:
Nārada said:
Then, seeing him of mountain-like body fallen upon the earth,
as if embraced by the earth, as a virtuous woman [embraces] a virtuous man,

1.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā devā vismitāste jayaṃ jagustathā muhuḥ..
kecitsamīpamāgaṃtuṃ bibhyati tridivaukasaḥ.. 33.2 ..
1.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवा विस्मितास्ते जयं जगुस्तथा मुहुः..
केचित्समीपमागंतुं बिभ्यति त्रिदिवौकसः.. 33.2 ..
1.4.m:
the gods were astonished, and repeatedly sang of victory;
yet some of the heaven-dwellers were afraid to approach,

1.4.s:
utthāya tārako daityaḥ kadā cinno nihaṃti cet..
taṃ tathā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudhāmaṇḍale guhaḥ.. 33.3 ..
1.4.d:
उत्थाय तारको दैत्यः कदा चिन्नो निहंति चेत्..
तं तथा पतितं दृष्ट्वा वसुधामण्डले गुहः.. 33.3 ..
1.4.m:
[fearing:] "What if the daitya Tāraka should rise and strike us?"
Seeing him thus fallen on the circle of the earth, Guha—

1.4.s:
āsīddīnamanāḥ pārtha śuśoca ca mahāmatiḥ..
stavanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ vārayitvā vaco'bravīt.. 33.4 ..
1.4.d:
आसीद्दीनमनाः पार्थ शुशोच च महामतिः..
स्तवनं चापि देवानां वारयित्वा वचोऽब्रवीत्.. 33.4 ..
1.4.m: O Pārtha, the wise [Skanda] became downcast in mind and grieved. / Checking the praises of the gods, he spoke these words: 33.4

1.4.s:
śocyaṃ pātakinaṃ māṃ ca saṃstuvadhvaṃ kathaṃ surāḥ..
paṃcānāmapi yo bhartā prākṛto'sau na kīrtyate.. 33.5 ..
1.4.d:
शोच्यं पातकिनं मां च संस्तुवध्वं कथं सुराः..
पंचानामपि यो भर्ता प्राकृतोऽसौ न कीर्त्यते.. 33.5 ..
1.4.m: "Why do you gods praise me, a wretched sinner? / He who is the master of even five [elements or beings] is not reckoned ordinary. 33.5

1.4.s:
sa tu rudrāṃśajaḥ proktastasya druhyanna rudram̐vat..
svāyaṃbhuvena gītaśca ślokaḥ saṃśrūyate tathā.. 33.6 ..
1.4.d:
स तु रुद्रांशजः प्रोक्तस्तस्य द्रुह्यन्न रुद्रम्̐वत्..
स्वायंभुवेन गीतश्च श्लोकः संश्रूयते तथा.. 33.6 ..
1.4.m: Moreover, he was proclaimed to be born from a portion of Rudra; harming him is like [harming] Rudra. / And likewise a verse sung by Svāyambhuva [Manu] is heard: 33.6

1.4.s:
vīraṃ hi puruṣaṃ hatvā gosahasreṇa mucyate..
yathākathaṃcitpuruṣo na haṃtavyastato budhaiḥ.. 33.7 ..
1.4.d:
वीरं हि पुरुषं हत्वा गोसहस्रेण मुच्यते..
यथाकथंचित्पुरुषो न हंतव्यस्ततो बुधैः.. 33.7 ..
1.4.m: 'Having killed a heroic man, one is released by a thousand cows; / therefore, a man should never be killed in any way by the wise.' 33.7

1.4.s:
pāpaśīlasya hanane doṣo yadyapi nāsti ca..
tathāpi rudrabhakto'yaṃ saṃsmaranniti śocimi.. 33.8 ..
1.4.d:
पापशीलस्य हनने दोषो यद्यपि नास्ति च..
तथापि रुद्रभक्तोऽयं संस्मरन्निति शोचिमि.. 33.8 ..
1.4.m: Even though there is no fault in slaying an evil-natured person, / still, remembering that he was a devotee of Rudra, I grieve thus. 33.8

1.4.s:
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi prāyāścittaṃ ca kiṃcana..
prāyaścittairapaityeno yatopi mahadarjitam.. 33.9 ..
1.4.d:
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रायाश्चित्तं च किंचन..
प्रायश्चित्तैरपैत्येनो यतोपि महदर्जितम्.. 33.9 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, I wish to hear of some expiation; / for by expiations even great [sin] that has been acquired goes away." 33.9

1.4.s:
iti saṃśocatastasya śivaputrasya dhīmataḥ..
vāsudevo guruḥ puṃsāṃ devamadhye vaco'bravīt.. 33.10 ..
1.4.d:
इति संशोचतस्तस्य शिवपुत्रस्य धीमतः..
वासुदेवो गुरुः पुंसां देवमध्ये वचोऽब्रवीत्.. 33.10 ..
1.4.m: As that wise son of Śiva was thus lamenting, / Vāsudeva, the teacher of men, spoke these words amidst the gods: 33.10

1.4.s:
śrutiḥ smṛtiścetihāsāḥ purāṇaṃ ca śivātmaja..
pramāṇaṃ cettato duṣṭavadhe doṣo na vidyate.. 33.11 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुतिः स्मृतिश्चेतिहासाः पुराणं च शिवात्मज..
प्रमाणं चेत्ततो दुष्टवधे दोषो न विद्यते.. 33.11 ..
1.4.m: "O son of Śiva, if Śruti, Smṛti, the Itihāsas, and the Purāṇa / are authoritative, then there is no fault in slaying the wicked. 33.11

1.4.s:
svaprāṇānyaḥ paraprāṇaiḥ prapuṣṇātyaghṛṇaḥ pumān..
tadvadhastasya hi śreyo yaddoṣādyātyadhaḥ pumān.. 33.12 ..
1.4.d:
स्वप्राणान्यः परप्राणैः प्रपुष्णात्यघृणः पुमान्..
तद्वधस्तस्य हि श्रेयो यद्दोषाद्यात्यधः पुमान्.. 33.12 ..
1.4.m: When a merciless man nourishes his own life with the lives of others, / his slaying is indeed a benefit to him, since because of that sin a man sinks down. 33.12

1.4.s:
annāde bhrūṇahā mārṣṭi patyau bhāryā pacāriṇī..
gurau śiṣyaśca yājyaśca steno rājani kilbiṣam.. 33.13 ..
1.4.d:
अन्नादे भ्रूणहा मार्ष्टि पत्यौ भार्या पचारिणी..
गुरौ शिष्यश्च याज्यश्च स्तेनो राजनि किल्बिषम्.. 33.13 ..
1.4.m: The killer of an embryo wipes off [his sin] on the one who eats his food, the adulterous wife on her husband, / the disciple and the sacrificer on the guru, and the thief wipes off his sin on the king. 33.13

1.4.s:
pāpinaṃ puruṣaṃ yo hi samartho na nihaṃti ca..
tasya tāvaṃti pāpāni tadardhaṃ so'pyavāśrute.. 33.14 ..
1.4.d:
पापिनं पुरुषं यो हि समर्थो न निहंति च..
तस्य तावंति पापानि तदर्धं सोऽप्यवाश्रुते.. 33.14 ..
1.4.m: He who is capable and does not slay a sinful man, / [takes on] as many sins of that man; he attains half of them. 33.14

1.4.s:
pāpino yadi vadhyaṃte naiva pālanasaṃsthitaiḥ..
tato'yamakṣamo lokaḥ kaṃ yāti śaraṇaṃ guha.. 33.15 ..
1.4.d:
पापिनो यदि वध्यंते नैव पालनसंस्थितैः..
ततोऽयमक्षमो लोकः कं याति शरणं गुह.. 33.15 ..
1.4.m: If sinners are not slain by those appointed to protect, / then to whom does this helpless world go for refuge, O Guha? 33.15

1.4.s:
kathaṃ yajñāśca vedāśca vartate viśvadhārakāḥ..
tasmāttvayā puṇyamāptaṃ na ca pāpaṃ kathaṃcana.. 33.16 ..
1.4.d:
कथं यज्ञाश्च वेदाश्च वर्तते विश्वधारकाः..
तस्मात्त्वया पुण्यमाप्तं न च पापं कथंचन.. 33.16 ..
1.4.m: How would the sacrifices and the Vedas, which sustain the universe, continue? / Therefore, merit was obtained by you, and no sin whatsoever. 33.16

1.4.s:
atha cedrudrabhakteṣu bahumānastava prabho..
tatra te kīrtayiṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ mahottamam.. 33.17 ..
1.4.d:
अथ चेद्रुद्रभक्तेषु बहुमानस्तव प्रभो..
तत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तं महोत्तमम्.. 33.17 ..
1.4.m: Yet if you have great regard for the devotees of Rudra, O Lord, / I shall proclaim to you the supreme expiation in that regard, 33.17

1.4.s:
ājanmasaṃbhavaiḥ pāpaiḥ pumānyena vimucyate..
ākalpāṃta ca vā yena rudraloke pramodate.. 33.18 ..
1.4.d:
आजन्मसंभवैः पापैः पुमान्येन विमुच्यते..
आकल्पांत च वा येन रुद्रलोके प्रमोदते.. 33.18 ..
1.4.m: by which a man is freed from the sins born of his whole life, / and by which he rejoices in the world of Rudra until the end of the kalpa. 33.18

1.4.s:
kṛte pāpe'nutāpo vai yasya skanda prajāyate..
rudrārādhanato'nyacca prāyaśtittaṃ paraṃ na hi.. 33.19 ..
1.4.d:
कृते पापेऽनुतापो वै यस्य स्कन्द प्रजायते..
रुद्राराधनतोऽन्यच्च प्रायश्तित्तं परं न हि.. 33.19 ..
1.4.m: O Skanda, when repentance indeed arises in one who has committed a sin, / there is no higher expiation other than the worship of Rudra. 33.19

1.4.s:
na yasyālamapi brahmāmahimānaṃ vivarṇitum..
śrutiśca bhītā yaṃ vakti kiṃ tasmātparamaṃ bhavet.. 33.20 ..
1.4.d:
न यस्यालमपि ब्रह्मामहिमानं विवर्णितुम्..
श्रुतिश्च भीता यं वक्ति किं तस्मात्परमं भवेत्.. 33.20 ..
1.4.m: Even Brahmā is not able to describe his greatness; / who could be higher than him, of whom the Veda speaks in awe? 33.20

1.4.s:
akāṃḍe yacca brahmāṃḍakṣayodyuktaṃ halāhalam..
kaṇṭhe dadhāra śrīkaṇṭhaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet.. 33.21 ..
1.4.d:
अकांडे यच्च ब्रह्मांडक्षयोद्युक्तं हलाहलम्..
कण्ठे दधार श्रीकण्ठः कस्तस्मात्परमो भवेत्.. 33.21 ..
1.4.m: Śrīkaṇṭha held in his throat the halāhala [poison] / that had unexpectedly set out to destroy the universe—who could be higher than him? 33.21

1.4.s:
duḥkhatāṃḍavadīno'bhūdaṇḍasaṃkīrṇamānasaḥ..
māramāraśca yo devaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet.. 33.22 ..
1.4.d:
दुःखतांडवदीनोऽभूदण्डसंकीर्णमानसः..
मारमारश्च यो देवः कस्तस्मात्परमो भवेत्.. 33.22 ..
1.4.m: The god who became distressed in the cosmic dance of suffering, with his mind overwhelmed by the egg [of the universe], / and who is the slayer of Kāma—who could be higher than him? 33.22

1.4.s:
viyadvyāpī surasaritpravāho vipruṣākṛtiḥ..
babhūva yasya śirasi kastasmātparamo bhavet.. 33.23 ..
1.4.d:
वियद्व्यापी सुरसरित्प्रवाहो विप्रुषाकृतिः..
बभूव यस्य शिरसि कस्तस्मात्परमो भवेत्.. 33.23 ..
1.4.m: The stream of the river of the gods, filling the sky, became the form of a drop / on his head—who could be higher than him? 33.23

1.4.s:
yajñādikāśca ye dharmā vinā yasyārcanaṃ vṛthā..
dakṣo'tra satyadṛṣṭāṃtaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet.. 33.24 ..
1.4.d:
यज्ञादिकाश्च ये धर्मा विना यस्यार्चनं वृथा..
दक्षोऽत्र सत्यदृष्टांतः कस्तस्मात्परमो भवेत्.. 33.24 ..
1.4.m: Righteous duties such as sacrifice and the like are futile without his worship; / Dakṣa is a true example in this matter—who could be higher than him? 33.24

1.4.s:
kṣoṇī ratho vidhiryaṃtā śaro'haṃ mandaro dhanuḥ..
rathāṃge cāpi caṃdrārkau yuddhe yasya ca traipure.. 33.25 ..
1.4.d:
क्षोणी रथो विधिर्यंता शरोऽहं मन्दरो धनुः..
रथांगे चापि चंद्रार्कौ युद्धे यस्य च त्रैपुरे.. 33.25 ..
1.4.m: The earth was the chariot, Brahmā the charioteer, I the arrow, Mandara the bow, / and the moon and sun the wheels in his battle against Tripura. 33.25

1.4.s:
ārādhanaṃ tasya kecidyogamārgeṇa kurvate..
duḥkhasādhyaṃ hi tatteṣāṃ nityaṃ śūnyamupāsatām.. 33.26 ..
1.4.d:
आराधनं तस्य केचिद्योगमार्गेण कुर्वते..
दुःखसाध्यं हि तत्तेषां नित्यं शून्यमुपासताम्.. 33.26 ..
1.4.m: Some perform his worship by the path of yoga; / but that is difficult to accomplish for those who constantly meditate on the void. 33.26

1.4.s:
tasmāttasyārcayelliṃgaṃ bhuktimuktī ya icchati..
sṛṣṭyādau liṃgarūpī sa vivādo mama brahmaṇaḥ.. 33.27 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मात्तस्यार्चयेल्लिंगं भुक्तिमुक्ती य इच्छति..
सृष्ट्यादौ लिंगरूपी स विवादो मम ब्रह्मणः.. 33.27 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, he who desires enjoyment and liberation should worship his liṅga. / At the beginning of creation he took the form of a liṅga, and a dispute of mine with Brahmā 33.27

1.4.s:
abhūdyasya paricchede nālamāvāṃ babhūviva..
carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ yato līnaṃ sadātra ca.. 33.28 ..
1.4.d:
अभूद्यस्य परिच्छेदे नालमावां बभूविव..
चराचरं जगत्सर्वं यतो लीनं सदात्र च.. 33.28 ..
1.4.m: arose; the two of us were unable to delimit it. / Because all the moving and unmoving universe is always dissolved (līna) in it, 33.28

1.4.s:
tasmālliṃgamiti proktaṃ devai rudrasya dhīmataḥ..
toyena snāpayelliṃgaṃ śraddhayā śucinā ca yaḥ.. 33.29 ..
1.4.d:
तस्माल्लिंगमिति प्रोक्तं देवै रुद्रस्य धीमतः..
तोयेन स्नापयेल्लिंगं श्रद्धया शुचिना च यः.. 33.29 ..
1.4.m: therefore it is called 'liṅga' by the gods of wise Rudra. / Whosoever bathes the liṅga with pure water and faith, 33.29

1.4.s:
brahmāditṛṇaparyaṃtaṃ tenedaṃ tarpitaṃ jagat..
paṃcāmṛtena talliṃgaṃ snāpayedyaśca buddhimān.. 33.30 ..
1.4.d:
ब्रह्मादितृणपर्यंतं तेनेदं तर्पितं जगत्..
पंचामृतेन तल्लिंगं स्नापयेद्यश्च बुद्धिमान्.. 33.30 ..
1.4.m: by him this universe, from Brahmā down to a blade of grass, is propitiated. / And whichever wise person bathes that liṅga with the five nectars, 33.30

1.4.s:
tarpitaṃ tena viśvaṃ syātsudhayā pitṛbhiḥ samam..
puṣpairabhyarcayelliṃgaṃ yathākālodbhavaiścayaḥ.. 33.31 ..
1.4.d:
तर्पितं तेन विश्वं स्यात्सुधया पितृभिः समम्..
पुष्पैरभ्यर्चयेल्लिंगं यथाकालोद्भवैश्चयः.. 33.31 ..
1.4.m: by him the universe together with the ancestors is propitiated with nectar. / And whosoever worships the liṅga with flowers blooming according to the season, 33.31

1.4.s:
tena saṃpūjitaṃ viśvaṃ sakalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..
naivedyaṃ tatra yo dadyālliṃgasyāgre vicakṣaṇaḥ.. 33.32 ..
1.4.d:
तेन संपूजितं विश्वं सकलं नात्र संशयः..
नैवेद्यं तत्र यो दद्याल्लिंगस्याग्रे विचक्षणः.. 33.32 ..
1.4.m: by him the entire universe is worshipped—there is no doubt in this. / The discerning person who offers food before the liṅga, 33.32

1.4.s:
bhojitaṃ tena viśvaṃ syālliṃgasyaivaṃ phalaṃ mahat..
kimatra bahunoktena svalpaṃ vā yadi va bahu.. 33.33 ..
1.4.d:
भोजितं तेन विश्वं स्याल्लिंगस्यैवं फलं महत्..
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन स्वल्पं वा यदि व बहु.. 33.33 ..
1.4.m: by him the universe has been fed; such is the great fruit of the liṅga. / What is the use of saying much here? Whether little or much, 33.33

1.4.s:
liṃgasya kriyate yacca tatsarvaṃ viśvaprītidam..
tacca ligaṃ sthāpayedyaḥ śucau deśe subhaktitaḥ.. 33.34 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगस्य क्रियते यच्च तत्सर्वं विश्वप्रीतिदम्..
तच्च लिगं स्थापयेद्यः शुचौ देशे सुभक्तितः.. 33.34 ..
1.4.m: whatever is done for the liṅga gives delight to the entire universe. / And he who installs that liṅga in a pure place with great devotion, 33.34

1.4.s:
sa sarvapāpanirmukto rudraloke pramodate..
yannityaṃ yajato yajñaiḥ phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ.. 33.35 ..
1.4.d:
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके प्रमोदते..
यन्नित्यं यजतो यज्ञैः फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः.. 33.35 ..
1.4.m: freed from all sins, rejoices in the world of Rudra. / The fruit that the wise say comes from constantly sacrificing with sacrifices, 33.35

1.4.s:
tacca sthāpayato liṃgaṃ śivasya śubhalakṣaṇam..
yathāgniḥ sarvadevānāṃ mukhaṃ skanda prakīrtyate.. 33.36 ..
1.4.d:
तच्च स्थापयतो लिंगं शिवस्य शुभलक्षणम्..
यथाग्निः सर्वदेवानां मुखं स्कन्द प्रकीर्त्यते.. 33.36 ..
1.4.m: that belongs to the one who installs the auspiciously marked liṅga of Śiva. / Just as fire is proclaimed to be the mouth of all the gods, O Skanda, 33.36

1.4.s:
tathaiva sarvajagatāṃ mukhaṃ liṃgaṃ na saṃśayaḥ..
prāraṃbhānmucyate pāpaiḥ sarvajanmakṛtairapi.. 33.37 ..
1.4.d:
तथैव सर्वजगतां मुखं लिंगं न संशयः..
प्रारंभान्मुच्यते पापैः सर्वजन्मकृतैरपि.. 33.37 ..
1.4.m: so too the liṅga is without doubt the mouth of all the worlds. / From the very beginning [of the work], one is freed even from the sins committed in all births. 33.37

1.4.s:
atītaṃ ca tathāgāmi kulānāṃ tārayecchatam..
mṛnmayaṃ kāṣṭhaniṣpannaṃ pakveṣṭaṃ śailameva ca.. 33.38 ..
1.4.d:
अतीतं च तथागामि कुलानां तारयेच्छतम्..
मृन्मयं काष्ठनिष्पन्नं पक्वेष्टं शैलमेव च.. 33.38 ..
1.4.m: One delivers a hundred past and future families. / A shrine made of clay, constructed of wood, of baked bricks, or of stone, 33.38

1.4.s:
kṛtamāyatanaṃ dadyātkramācchataguṇaṃ phalam..
kalaśaṃ tatra cāropya ekaviṃśatkulairyutaḥ.. 33.39 ..
1.4.d:
कृतमायतनं दद्यात्क्रमाच्छतगुणं फलम्..
कलशं तत्र चारोप्य एकविंशत्कुलैर्युतः.. 33.39 ..
1.4.m: gives progressively a hundredfold fruit. / Having placed the pinnacle-jar upon it, accompanied by twenty-one generations, 33.39

1.4.s:
ākalpāṃtaṃ rudraloke modate rudravatsukhī..
evaṃvidhaphalaṃ liṃgamato bhūyo'pyadho na hi.. 33.40 ..
1.4.d:
आकल्पांतं रुद्रलोके मोदते रुद्रवत्सुखी..
एवंविधफलं लिंगमतो भूयोऽप्यधो न हि.. 33.40 ..
1.4.m: he rejoices happily in the world of Rudra like Rudra until the end of the kalpa. / The liṅga has such fruit; never again does one fall down from there. 33.40

1.4.s:
tasmādatra mahāsena liṃgaṃ sthāpitumarhasi..
yaduktametadaślīlaṃ yadi kiṃcana cātra cet.. 33.41 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मादत्र महासेन लिंगं स्थापितुमर्हसि..
यदुक्तमेतदश्लीलं यदि किंचन चात्र चेत्.. 33.41 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, O Mahāsena, you ought to install a liṅga here. / If anything improper has been spoken here, 33.41

1.4.s:
tadbravītu mahā sena svayaṃ sākṣī maheśvaraḥ..
evaṃ vadati goviṃde sādhuvādo mahānabhūt.. 33.42 ..
1.4.d:
तद्ब्रवीतु महा सेन स्वयं साक्षी महेश्वरः..
एवं वदति गोविंदे साधुवादो महानभूत्.. 33.42 ..
1.4.m: let Maheśvara himself, the witness, declare that, O Mahāsena." / As Govinda spoke thus, there was a great shout of approval. 33.42

1.4.s:
mahādevo hyathāliṃgya skandaṃ vacanabravīt..
yadbhavānmama bhakteṣu prakaroti kṛpāṃ parām.. 33.43 ..
1.4.d:
महादेवो ह्यथालिंग्य स्कन्दं वचनब्रवीत्..
यद्भवान्मम भक्तेषु प्रकरोति कृपां पराम्.. 33.43 ..
1.4.m: Then Mahādeva, embracing Skanda, spoke these words: / "Because you show supreme compassion toward my devotees, 33.43

1.4.s:
tenāpi paramā prītirmama jātā tavopari..
kiṃ tu yadbhagavānāha vāsudevo jagadguruḥ.. 33.44 ..
1.4.d:
तेनापि परमा प्रीतिर्मम जाता तवोपरि..
किं तु यद्भगवानाह वासुदेवो जगद्गुरुः.. 33.44 ..
1.4.m: by that too supreme love for you has arisen in me. / But as to what the Lord Vāsudeva, the teacher of the universe, said: 33.44

1.4.s:
tattthā nānyathā kiṃcidatra proktaṃ hi viṣṇunā..
yo hyahaṃ sa harirjñeyo yo hariḥ so'hamityutā.. 33.45 ..
1.4.d:
तत्त्था नान्यथा किंचिदत्र प्रोक्तं हि विष्णुना..
यो ह्यहं स हरिर्ज्ञेयो यो हरिः सोऽहमित्युता.. 33.45 ..
1.4.m: that is true, nothing spoken here by Viṣṇu is otherwise. / Indeed, whoever is I, that is to be known as Hari; whoever is Hari, that is I. 33.45

1.4.s:
nāvayoraṃtaraṃ kiṃciddīpayoriva suvrata..
enaṃ dveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭiyonvetyenaṃ sa mā'nugaḥ.. 33.46 ..
1.4.d:
नावयोरंतरं किंचिद्दीपयोरिव सुव्रत..
एनं द्वेष्टि स मां द्वेष्टियोन्वेत्येनं स माऽनुगः.. 33.46 ..
1.4.m: There is no difference whatsoever between the two of us, like two lamps, O you of noble vows! / He who hates him hates me; he who follows him is my follower. 33.46

1.4.s: iti skanda vijānāti sa madbhaktonyathā na hi.. 33.47 ..
1.4.d: इति स्कन्द विजानाति स मद्भक्तोन्यथा न हि.. 33.47 ..
1.4.m: O Skanda, he who understands thus is my devotee, not otherwise." 33.47

1.4.s:
..skanda uvāca..
evamevāsmi jānāmi tvāṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca śaṃkara.. 33.48 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कन्द उवाच..
एवमेवास्मि जानामि त्वां च विष्णुं च शंकर.. 33.48 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / Just so do I know you and Viṣṇu [to be one], O Śaṃkara.

1.4.s:
yacca liṃgakṛte prāha harirmāṃ dharmavatsalaḥ..
khe vāṇī tārakavadhe evameva purāha mām.. 33.49 ..
1.4.d:
यच्च लिंगकृते प्राह हरिर्मां धर्मवत्सलः..
खे वाणी तारकवधे एवमेव पुराह माम्.. 33.49 ..
1.4.m: And what Hari, who loves righteousness, told me concerning the liṅga— / that voice in the sky at the slaying of Tāraka—said the very same to me of old.

1.4.s:
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi sarvapāpā pahaṃ tataḥ..
ekaṃ yatra pratijñā me gṛhītāsya vadhāya ca.. 33.50 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगं संस्थापयिष्यामि सर्वपापा पहं ततः..
एकं यत्र प्रतिज्ञा मे गृहीतास्य वधाय च.. 33.50 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, I will establish a liṅga that removes all sins: / the first where my vow was taken for his destruction,

1.4.s:
dvitīyaṃ yatra niḥsattvasatyaktaḥ śaktyā'suro'bhavat..
tṛtīyaṃ yatra nihato hatyā pāpopaśāṃtidam.. 33.51 ..
1.4.d:
द्वितीयं यत्र निःसत्त्वसत्यक्तः शक्त्याऽसुरोऽभवत्..
तृतीयं यत्र निहतो हत्या पापोपशांतिदम्.. 33.51 ..
1.4.m: the second where the Asura was left deprived of strength by the spear, / and the third where he was slain, which pacifies the sin of killing.

1.4.s:
ityuktvā viśvakarmāṇamāhūya prāha pāvakiḥ..
trīṇi liṃgāni śuddhāni śīghraṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi.. 33.52 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा विश्वकर्माणमाहूय प्राह पावकिः..
त्रीणि लिंगानि शुद्धानि शीघ्रं त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि.. 33.52 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, the son of the Fire-god summoned Viśvakarman and said: / "You ought quickly to fashion three flawless liṅgas."

1.4.s:
vacanādbāhuleyasya nirmame devavarddhakiḥ..
trīṇi liṃgāni śuddhāni nyavedayata tāni ca.. 33.53 ..
1.4.d:
वचनाद्बाहुलेयस्य निर्ममे देववर्द्धकिः..
त्रीणि लिंगानि शुद्धानि न्यवेदयत तानि च.. 33.53 ..
1.4.m: At the command of the son of the Kṛttikās, the architect of the gods made / three flawless liṅgas and presented them.

1.4.s:
tato brahmādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca..
pūrvaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa paścimāyāmadūrataḥ.. 33.54 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्मादिभिः सार्धं विष्णुना शंकरेण च..
पूर्वं संस्थापयामास पश्चिमायामदूरतः.. 33.54 ..
1.4.m: Then, together with Brahmā and the others, with Viṣṇu and Śaṃkara, / he first installed [one] not far from the west,

1.4.s:
pratijñeśvaramityeva liṃgaṃ paramaśobhanam..
aṣṭamyāṃ bahule cātra caitre snātvā upoṣya ca.. 33.55 ..
1.4.d:
प्रतिज्ञेश्वरमित्येव लिंगं परमशोभनम्..
अष्टम्यां बहुले चात्र चैत्रे स्नात्वा उपोष्य च.. 33.55 ..
1.4.m: the exceedingly beautiful liṅga named Pratijñeśvara. / Here, having bathed and fasted on the eighth day of the dark fortnight in Caitra,

1.4.s:
pūjāṃ ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā mucyetpāruṣyapāpataḥ..
ityāha skaṃdaprītyarthaṃ svayaṃ tatra maheśvaraḥ.. 33.56 ..
1.4.d:
पूजां च जागरं कृत्वा मुच्येत्पारुष्यपापतः..
इत्याह स्कंदप्रीत्यर्थं स्वयं तत्र महेश्वरः.. 33.56 ..
1.4.m: and having performed worship and a vigil, one is freed from the sin of harshness. / Thus Maheśvara himself spoke there to please Skanda.

1.4.s:
tato dvitīyaṃ liṃgaṃ tu vahnikoṇāśritaṃ tathā..
sthāpayāmāsa saraso yatra śaktirviniryayau.. 33.57 ..
1.4.d:
ततो द्वितीयं लिंगं तु वह्निकोणाश्रितं तथा..
स्थापयामास सरसो यत्र शक्तिर्विनिर्ययौ.. 33.57 ..
1.4.m: Then he installed the second liṅga in the southeast quarter / of the lake, where the spear had emerged,

1.4.s:
kapāleśvaramityeva liṃgaṃ pāpāpahaṃ śubham..
śaktiṃ ca tāmabhiṣṭūya sthāpayāmāsa tatra ca.. 33.58 ..
1.4.d:
कपालेश्वरमित्येव लिंगं पापापहं शुभम्..
शक्तिं च तामभिष्टूय स्थापयामास तत्र च.. 33.58 ..
1.4.m: the auspicious liṅga named Kapāleśvara, which removes sins. / And having praised that spear, he also established there

1.4.s:
kapāleśvarasāṃnidhyaṃ devīṃ kāpālikeśvarīm..
tatra cottaradigbhāge śakticchidraṃ pracakṣate.. 33.59 ..
1.4.d:
कपालेश्वरसांनिध्यं देवीं कापालिकेश्वरीम्..
तत्र चोत्तरदिग्भागे शक्तिच्छिद्रं प्रचक्षते.. 33.59 ..
1.4.m: the goddess Kāpālikeśvarī in the presence of Kapāleśvara. / And there, in the northern direction, they speak of Śakticchidra,

1.4.s:
pātālagaṃgā yatrāstiṃ sarvapāpaharā śivā..
tatra snātvā dadau skaṃdaḥ kṛpayābhipariplutaḥ.. 33.60 ..
1.4.d:
पातालगंगा यत्रास्तिं सर्वपापहरा शिवा..
तत्र स्नात्वा ददौ स्कंदः कृपयाभिपरिप्लुतः.. 33.60 ..
1.4.m: where the auspicious Pātālagaṅgā is, which removes all sins. / Having bathed there, Skanda, overflowing with compassion,

1.4.s: tadā toyaṃ tārakāya sahitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ.. 33.61 ..
1.4.d: तदा तोयं तारकाय सहितः सर्वदैवतैः.. 33.61 ..
1.4.m: then offered water for Tāraka, accompanied by all the deities,

1.4.s:
kāśyapeyāya vajrāṃgatanayāya mahātmane..
rudrabhaktāya satilamakṣayyodakamastviti.. 33.62 ..
1.4.d:
काश्यपेयाय वज्रांगतनयाय महात्मने..
रुद्रभक्ताय सतिलमक्षय्योदकमस्त्विति.. 33.62 ..
1.4.m: saying: "May there be imperishable water with sesamum seeds for the noble son of Kaśyapa, / the offspring of Vajrāṅga, who was devoted to Rudra."

1.4.s:
tato maheśvaraḥ prītaḥ prāha skaṃdasya śrṛṇvataḥ..
caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe madhau caivātra yo naraḥ..
snātvopoṣya samabhyarcya kapāleśvaramīśvarīm.. 33.63 ..
1.4.d:
ततो महेश्वरः प्रीतः प्राह स्कंदस्य श्रृण्वतः..
चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे मधौ चैवात्र यो नरः..
स्नात्वोपोष्य समभ्यर्च्य कपालेश्वरमीश्वरीम्.. 33.63 ..
1.4.m: Then Maheśvara, pleased, spoke while Skanda listened: / "The human who, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in Madhu, / having bathed, fasted, and thoroughly worshipped Kapāleśvara and the goddess,

1.4.s: tejovadhasamudbhūtapātakena sa mucyate.. 33.64 ..
1.4.d: तेजोवधसमुद्भूतपातकेन स मुच्यते.. 33.64 ..
1.4.m: is freed from the sin born of the destruction of splendour.

1.4.s:
asyāmeva tithau somaḥ śivayogaśca taitilam..
ṣaḍyogaḥ śakticchidreyo dinaṃ rudraṃ japanniśi..
snātvātra saśarīro vai rudralokaṃ vrajīṣyati.. 33.65 ..
1.4.d:
अस्यामेव तिथौ सोमः शिवयोगश्च तैतिलम्..
षड्योगः शक्तिच्छिद्रेयो दिनं रुद्रं जपन्निशि..
स्नात्वात्र सशरीरो वै रुद्रलोकं व्रजीष्यति.. 33.65 ..
1.4.m: On this very lunar day, when there is Monday, the Śiva yoga, and the Taitila [karaṇa], / a sixfold conjunction, he who chants Rudra's [mantra] during the night and day at Śakticchidra, / having bathed here, will indeed go in bodily form to the world of Rudra.

1.4.s:
kapāleśasya sāṃnidhye śakticchidraṃ hi kīrtyate..
tasya tulyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ naiva vidyate.. 33.66 ..
1.4.d:
कपालेशस्य सांनिध्ये शक्तिच्छिद्रं हि कीर्त्यते..
तस्य तुल्यं परं तीर्थं पृथिव्यां नैव विद्यते.. 33.66 ..
1.4.m: Śakticchidra is celebrated in the presence of Kapāleśa; / there exists on earth no other sacred ford equal to it."

1.4.s:
iti śrutvā rudravākyaṃ skaṃdaḥ prīto'bhavadbhṛśam..
devāśca muditāḥ sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ.. 33.67 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumārasthāpitajñeśvaraśakticcidreśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo.़dhyāyaḥ.. 33 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा रुद्रवाक्यं स्कंदः प्रीतोऽभवद्भृशम्..
देवाश्च मुदिताः सर्वे साधुसाध्विति ते जगुः.. 33.67 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारस्थापितज्ञेश्वरशक्तिच्चिद्रेश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो.़ध्यायः.. 33 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Hearing these words of Rudra, Skanda was exceedingly pleased, / and all the gods rejoiced and chanted, "Excellent! Excellent!"
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of Jñeśvara and Śakticchidreśvara Installed by Kumāra", in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tatastṛtīyaliṃgasya cikīrṣu sthāpanaṃ guham..
brahmā prāhāsya prītyarthaṃ svayamanyaṃ prakurmahe.. 34.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततस्तृतीयलिंगस्य चिकीर्षु स्थापनं गुहम्..
ब्रह्मा प्राहास्य प्रीत्यर्थं स्वयमन्यं प्रकुर्महे.. 34.1 ..
