1.4.m: Nārada said: / Then, as Guha wished to install the third liṅga, / Brahmā said to him for his pleasure: "We ourselves shall make another.

1.4.s:
yadyapyetacchubhaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam..
tathāpyanyatkariṣye'haṃ sarvaśreṣṭhatamaṃ hi yat.. 34.2 ..
1.4.d:
यद्यप्येतच्छुभं लिंगं सर्वदोषविवर्जितम्..
तथाप्यन्यत्करिष्येऽहं सर्वश्रेष्ठतमं हि यत्.. 34.2 ..
1.4.m: Even though this liṅga is auspicious and free of all flaws, / still I will make another that is the best of all."

1.4.s:
tato brahmā sarvadoṣavimuktaṃ nirmame svayam..
dṛṣṭikāṃtaṃ manaḥkāṃtaṃ phalakāṃtaṃ suliṃgakam.. 34.3 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा सर्वदोषविमुक्तं निर्ममे स्वयम्..
दृष्टिकांतं मनःकांतं फलकांतं सुलिंगकम्.. 34.3 ..
1.4.m: Then Brahmā himself fashioned an excellent liṅga, free from all defects, / pleasing to the eyes, pleasing to the mind, and delightful in its fruits.

1.4.s:
tatra skaṃdasya prītyarthaṃ sarvadevairninirmitam..
saraḥ suramyaṃ tīrthāni tatra te nidadhustathā.. 34.4 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र स्कंदस्य प्रीत्यर्थं सर्वदेवैर्निनिर्मितम्..
सरः सुरम्यं तीर्थानि तत्र ते निदधुस्तथा.. 34.4 ..
1.4.m: There, to please Skanda, a lovely lake was constructed / by all the gods, and they placed the sacred fords within it.

1.4.s:
gaṃgādikāni tīrthāni yāni procurdivaukasaḥ..
idaṃ yāvatsarastāvatsarvairatra samuṣyatām.. 34.5 ..
1.4.d:
गंगादिकानि तीर्थानि यानि प्रोचुर्दिवौकसः..
इदं यावत्सरस्तावत्सर्वैरत्र समुष्यताम्.. 34.5 ..
1.4.m: The denizens of heaven said to the sacred fords beginning with the Gaṅgā: / "For as long as this lake remains, you all must abide here."

1.4.s:
evamastviti tānyūcuḥ prītyarthaṃ śarajanmanaḥ..
tato brahmā svayaṃ tatra raudrairmaṃtrairhutāśanam..
gādhiputrādibhirvipraistarpayāmāsa saṃyutaḥ.. 34.6 ..
1.4.d:
एवमस्त्विति तान्यूचुः प्रीत्यर्थं शरजन्मनः..
ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयं तत्र रौद्रैर्मंत्रैर्हुताशनम्..
गाधिपुत्रादिभिर्विप्रैस्तर्पयामास संयुतः.. 34.6 ..
1.4.m: Saying, "So be it," they agreed for the sake of pleasing the Reed-born one. / Then Brahmā himself, accompanied by brahmins such as the son of Gādhi, / gratified the fire there with mantras dedicated to Rudra.

1.4.s:
tato vaiśākhamāsasya caturddaśyāṃ śubhe dine..
pratiṣṭhāṃ cakrire liṃge ciraṃ vipramukā dvijāḥ.. 34.7 ..
1.4.d:
ततो वैशाखमासस्य चतुर्द्दश्यां शुभे दिने..
प्रतिष्ठां चक्रिरे लिंगे चिरं विप्रमुका द्विजाः.. 34.7 ..
1.4.m: Then, on an auspicious day, the fourteenth of the month of Vaiśākha, / the foremost twice-born brahmins performed the installation of the liṅga for a long time.

1.4.s:
jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ..
tataḥ skaṃdaḥ prītiyuktaḥ snātvā sarasi śobhane.. 34.8 ..
1.4.d:
जगुर्गंधर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः..
ततः स्कंदः प्रीतियुक्तः स्नात्वा सरसि शोभने.. 34.8 ..
1.4.m: The lords of the gandharvas sang, and the hosts of apsarases danced. / Then Skanda, filled with delight, having bathed in that beautiful lake,

1.4.s:
sarvatīrthodakaiḥ snāpya talliṃgaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ..
vividhaiḥ pūjayāmāsa puṣpairmaṃtraiśca paṃcabhiḥ.. 34.9 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वतीर्थोदकैः स्नाप्य तल्लिंगं भक्तिसंयुतः..
विविधैः पूजयामास पुष्पैर्मंत्रैश्च पंचभिः.. 34.9 ..
1.4.m: and having bathed the liṅga with the waters of all the sacred fords, full of devotion, / worshipped it with diverse flowers and with the five mantras.

1.4.s:
pūjākāle svayaṃ tatra liṃgamadhyesthito haraḥ..
jaṃgamā jaṃgamaiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ jagrāha pūjanam.. 34.10 ..
1.4.d:
पूजाकाले स्वयं तत्र लिंगमध्येस्थितो हरः..
जंगमा जंगमैः सार्धं स्वयं जग्राह पूजनम्.. 34.10 ..
1.4.m: At the time of worship, Hara himself, abiding within the liṅga, / in company with all mobile and immobile beings, personally accepted the worship.

1.4.s:
tatastaṃ pūjayanprāha skaṃdo bhaktipariplutaḥ..
kena kenopahāreṇa tvayi dattena kiṃ phalam.. 34.11 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तं पूजयन्प्राह स्कंदो भक्तिपरिप्लुतः..
केन केनोपहारेण त्वयि दत्तेन किं फलम्.. 34.11 ..
1.4.m: Then Skanda, overflowing with devotion, said as he worshipped him: / "By offering which offerings unto you, what fruit is attained?"

1.4.s:
..śrīmahādeva uvāca..
mama yaḥ sthāpayelliṃgaṃ śubhaṃ sadma ca kārayet..
malloke vasate'sau ca vāvaccaṃdradivākarau.. 34.12 ..
1.4.d:
..श्रीमहादेव उवाच..
मम यः स्थापयेल्लिंगं शुभं सद्म च कारयेत्..
मल्लोके वसतेऽसौ च वावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ.. 34.12 ..
1.4.m: The glorious Mahādeva said: / "He who installs my liṅga and causes an auspicious temple to be built / dwells in my world as long as the moon and the sun endure.

1.4.s:
mama sadma sudhāśubhraṃ yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ karoti yaḥ..
tāvaṃtyeva ca janmāni yaśasāsau virājate.. 34.13 ..
1.4.d:
मम सद्म सुधाशुभ्रं यावत्संख्यं करोति यः..
तावंत्येव च जन्मानि यशसासौ विराजते.. 34.13 ..
1.4.m: For as many as are the times a person makes my temple white with lime, / for just that many lives does he shine with glory.

1.4.s:
dhvajabhūto dhvajaṃ dattvā vipāpaḥ syātpatākayā..
vidhāya citravinyāsa gaṃdharvaiḥ saha modate.. 34.14 ..
1.4.d:
ध्वजभूतो ध्वजं दत्त्वा विपापः स्यात्पताकया..
विधाय चित्रविन्यास गंधर्वैः सह मोदते.. 34.14 ..
1.4.m: By giving a flagstaff he becomes pre-eminent, by a banner he becomes free of sin, / and having arranged colourful decorations, he rejoices with the gandharvas.

1.4.s:
rajaḥsaṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā naro rogaiḥ pramucyate..
prāpnoti dehaṃ hārdaṃ ca surasadmānulepanāt.. 34.15 ..
1.4.d:
रजःसंशोधनं कृत्वा नरो रोगैः प्रमुच्यते..
प्राप्नोति देहं हार्दं च सुरसद्मानुलेपनात्.. 34.15 ..
1.4.m: By cleaning away the dust, a man is freed from diseases; / by plastering the temple of the god, he attains a lovely body and deep affection.

1.4.s:
puṣpakṣīrādi bhirdattaistilābho'kṣatadarbhakaiḥ..
śaṃbhoḥ śirasi dattvārghya divi varṣāyutaṃ vaset.. 34.16 ..
1.4.d:
पुष्पक्षीरादि भिर्दत्तैस्तिलाभोऽक्षतदर्भकैः..
शंभोः शिरसि दत्त्वार्घ्य दिवि वर्षायुतं वसेत्.. 34.16 ..
1.4.m: By offering arghya upon Śambhu's head with flowers, milk, / and the like, with sesamum seeds, unbroken grains, and darbha grass, he dwells in heaven for ten thousand years.

1.4.s:
ghṛtena hatapāpaḥ syānmadhunā subhago bhavet..
virogo dadhidugdhābhyāṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsnāpya jāyate.. 34.17 ..
1.4.d:
घृतेन हतपापः स्यान्मधुना सुभगो भवेत्..
विरोगो दधिदुग्धाभ्यां लिंगं संस्नाप्य जायते.. 34.17 ..
1.4.m: By bathing the liṅga with ghee, his sins are destroyed; with honey, he becomes fortunate; / and with curd and milk, he becomes free from disease.

1.4.s:
pānīyadadhidugdhādyaiḥ kramāddaśaguṇaṃ phalam..
māsaṃ saṃsnāpya vai bhaktyā piṣṭādyaiśca virūkṣayet.. 34.18 ..
1.4.d:
पानीयदधिदुग्धाद्यैः क्रमाद्दशगुणं फलम्..
मासं संस्नाप्य वै भक्त्या पिष्टाद्यैश्च विरूक्षयेत्.. 34.18 ..
1.4.m: With water, curd, milk, and so forth, the fruit increases tenfold in order. / Having bathed it with devotion for a month, one should rub it with flours and unguents.

1.4.s:
kapilāpaṃcagavyena surasiṃdhujalena vā..
māṃ ca saṃsnāpya cābhyacca mallokamadhigacchati.. 34.19 ..
1.4.d:
कपिलापंचगव्येन सुरसिंधुजलेन वा..
मां च संस्नाप्य चाभ्यच्च मल्लोकमधिगच्छति.. 34.19 ..
1.4.m: Having bathed and worshipped me with the five products of a tawny cow, / or with the water of the celestial river, he attains my world.

1.4.s:
kuśodakādgaṃdhajalaṃ tasmāttīrthodakaṃ varam..
tīrthebhyaśca jalaṃ darśe mahīsāgarasaṃbhavam.. 34.20 ..
1.4.d:
कुशोदकाद्गंधजलं तस्मात्तीर्थोदकं वरम्..
तीर्थेभ्यश्च जलं दर्शे महीसागरसंभवम्.. 34.20 ..
1.4.m: Scented water is better than water with kuśa grass; better than that is water from a sacred ford; / and superior to water from sacred fords is that from the confluence of the Mahī and the sea on the new moon day.

1.4.s:
kapilāṃ dattvā yadāpnoti tatphalaṃ kalaśe pṛthak..
mṛttāmraraupyasauvarṇaiḥ kramācchataguṇaṃ phalam.. 34.21 ..
1.4.d:
कपिलां दत्त्वा यदाप्नोति तत्फलं कलशे पृथक्..
मृत्ताम्ररौप्यसौवर्णैः क्रमाच्छतगुणं फलम्.. 34.21 ..
1.4.m: The fruit one obtains by giving a tawny cow is obtained separately with each jar; / with jars of clay, copper, silver, and gold, the fruit is progressively a hundred times greater."

1.4.s:
śrīkhaṃḍāgarukāśmīraśaśinaḥ kramaśo'dhikāḥ..
māṃ ca taiśca samālabhya syācchrīmānsubhagaḥ sukhī.. 34.22 ..
1.4.d:
श्रीखंडागरुकाश्मीरशशिनः क्रमशोऽधिकाः..
मां च तैश्च समालभ्य स्याच्छ्रीमान्सुभगः सुखी.. 34.22 ..
1.4.m: Sandalwood, agallochum, saffron, and camphor are progressively superior. / By smearing me with these, one will become prosperous, fortunate, and happy.

1.4.s:
praśasto guglulo dhūpastasmāccaṃdro'garurvaraḥ..
dhūpānetānnaro dattvā sukhaṃ svargamavāpnuyāt.. 34.23 ..
1.4.d:
प्रशस्तो गुग्लुलो धूपस्तस्माच्चंद्रोऽगरुर्वरः..
धूपानेतान्नरो दत्त्वा सुखं स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात्.. 34.23 ..
1.4.m: Guggulu incense is praised, and camphor and agallochum are superior to it. / By offering these incenses, a person easily attains heaven.

1.4.s:
dīpadaḥ kīrtimāpnoti cakṣuruttamameva ca..
naivedyasya pradānena naro mṛṣṭāśano bhavet.. 34.24 ..
1.4.d:
दीपदः कीर्तिमाप्नोति चक्षुरुत्तममेव च..
नैवेद्यस्य प्रदानेन नरो मृष्टाशनो भवेत्.. 34.24 ..
1.4.m: The giver of a lamp attains fame and excellent eyesight, / and by offering food, a person becomes one who eats fine fare.

1.4.s:
puṣpeṇa hemakarṇasya prabaddhena dvisaṃguṇam..
phalamāpnoti puruṣaḥ satyasaṃdhaśca jāyate.. 34.25 ..
1.4.d:
पुष्पेण हेमकर्णस्य प्रबद्धेन द्विसंगुणम्..
फलमाप्नोति पुरुषः सत्यसंधश्च जायते.. 34.25 ..
1.4.m: By offering a flower with gold fastened to its pericarp, / a man attains double the fruit and becomes true to his word.

1.4.s:
akhaṃḍairbilvapatraiśca puṣpairvā vividhairapi..
liṃgaṃ prapūraṇaṃ kṛtvā lakṣmekaṃ vaseddivi.. 34.26 ..
1.4.d:
अखंडैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च पुष्पैर्वा विविधैरपि..
लिंगं प्रपूरणं कृत्वा लक्ष्मेकं वसेद्दिवि.. 34.26 ..
1.4.m: Filling the liṅga completely with unbroken bilva leaves / or various flowers, one dwells in heaven for a hundred thousand [years].

1.4.s:
yastu puṣpagṛhaṃ kuryānnaraḥ śuddhāśayo bhavet..
puṣpakeṇa vimānena divi saṃkrīḍate ciram.. 34.27 ..
1.4.d:
यस्तु पुष्पगृहं कुर्यान्नरः शुद्धाशयो भवेत्..
पुष्पकेण विमानेन दिवि संक्रीडते चिरम्.. 34.27 ..
1.4.m: A person who makes a house of flowers becomes pure in heart; / he sports for a long time in heaven on the Puṣpaka aerial chariot.

1.4.s:
bhūṣaṇāṃbaradānena naro bhavati bhogabhāk..
saccāmarapradānena jāyate pārthivo naraḥ.. 34.28 ..
1.4.d:
भूषणांबरदानेन नरो भवति भोगभाक्..
सच्चामरप्रदानेन जायते पार्थिवो नरः.. 34.28 ..
1.4.m: By the gift of ornaments and garments, a man becomes an enjoyer of pleasures. / By the gift of an excellent chowrie, a man is born as an earthly king.

1.4.s:
ramyaṃ vitānaṃ yo dadyācchatrubhirnābhūyate..
gītaṃ vādyaṃ pranṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā śuddho vrajetsa mām.. 34.29 ..
1.4.d:
रम्यं वितानं यो दद्याच्छत्रुभिर्नाभूयते..
गीतं वाद्यं प्रनृत्यं च कृत्वा शुद्धो व्रजेत्स माम्.. 34.29 ..
1.4.m: He who offers a beautiful canopy is not overcome by enemies; / having offered singing, instrumental music, and dances, pure, he goes to me.

1.4.s:
śaṃkhaghaṃṭāpradānena vidvānbhavati śabdavān..
vidhāya rathayātrāṃ ca ciraṃ śokaiḥ pramucyate.. 34.30 ..
1.4.d:
शंखघंटाप्रदानेन विद्वान्भवति शब्दवान्..
विधाय रथयात्रां च चिरं शोकैः प्रमुच्यते.. 34.30 ..
1.4.m: By the gift of a conch and a bell, one becomes learned and eloquent; / and having performed a chariot procession, he is freed from grief for a long time.

1.4.s:
namaskāraṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvā jāyenmahākule..
vācayaṃścāgrataḥ śāstraṃ mama jñānī prajāyate.. 34.31 ..
1.4.d:
नमस्कारं प्रणामं च कृत्वा जायेन्महाकुले..
वाचयंश्चाग्रतः शास्त्रं मम ज्ञानी प्रजायते.. 34.31 ..
1.4.m: Making salutations and prostrations, he is born in a noble family; / and reciting the scripture before me, he becomes wise.

1.4.s:
vimucyate manomohairbhaktyā stutvā ca māṃ naraḥ..
godānaphalamāpnoti nirmālyaspheṭanānmama.. 34.32 ..
1.4.d:
विमुच्यते मनोमोहैर्भक्त्या स्तुत्वा च मां नरः..
गोदानफलमाप्नोति निर्माल्यस्फेटनान्मम.. 34.32 ..
1.4.m: By praising me with devotion, a man is freed from delusions of the mind; / by removing my withered offerings, he attains the fruit of giving a cow.

1.4.s:
ārārtikaṃ bhrāmayitvā artihīnaḥ prajāyate..
kṛtvā śītalikāṃ tāpairmucyate doṣa saṃbhavaiḥ.. 34.33 ..
1.4.d:
आरार्तिकं भ्रामयित्वा अर्तिहीनः प्रजायते..
कृत्वा शीतलिकां तापैर्मुच्यते दोष संभवैः.. 34.33 ..
1.4.m: Waving the light for the ārārtika, he becomes free from distress; / having offered cooling, he is freed from the torments born of faults.

1.4.s:
natvā dattvātha śaktyā ca dānaṃ liṃgasya saṃnidhau..
phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ prāpya iha cāmutra modate.. 34.34 ..
1.4.d:
नत्वा दत्त्वाथ शक्त्या च दानं लिंगस्य संनिधौ..
फलं शतगुणं प्राप्य इह चामुत्र मोदते.. 34.34 ..
1.4.m: Bowing and then giving according to one's means in the presence of the liṅga, / he attains a hundredfold fruit and rejoices in this world and the next.

1.4.s:
praṇāmātpaṃcadaśa ca snānādviṃśatiṃ pūjayā..
śataṃ yathāproktavidheraparādhānahaṃ kṣame.. 34.35 ..
1.4.d:
प्रणामात्पंचदश च स्नानाद्विंशतिं पूजया..
शतं यथाप्रोक्तविधेरपराधानहं क्षमे.. 34.35 ..
1.4.m: I forgive fifteen transgressions for a prostration, twenty for a bath, / and a hundred for worship performed according to the prescribed rule.

1.4.s:
etatsarvaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ kumārātra bhaviṣyati..
ye māṃ prapūjayiṣyaṃti kumāreśvara saṃsthitam.. 34.36 ..
1.4.d:
एतत्सर्वं यथोद्दिष्टं कुमारात्र भविष्यति..
ये मां प्रपूजयिष्यंति कुमारेश्वर संस्थितम्.. 34.36 ..
1.4.m: All this, as declared, will come to pass here, O Kumāra, / for those who worship me established as Kumāreśvara.

1.4.s: vārāṇasyāṃ yathā vatsa viśvanātho'smi saṃsthitaḥ.. 34.37 ..
1.4.d: वाराणस्यां यथा वत्स विश्वनाथोऽस्मि संस्थितः.. 34.37 ..
1.4.m: Just as, O child, I am established in Vārāṇasī as Viśvanātha,

1.4.s: guptakṣetre tathā sthāsye kumāreśvaramadhyataḥ.. 34.38 ..
1.4.d: गुप्तक्षेत्रे तथा स्थास्ये कुमारेश्वरमध्यतः.. 34.38 ..
1.4.m: so shall I reside in the concealed field in the midst of Kumāreśvara.

1.4.s:
śrutveti vacanaṃ rudrāddevānāṃ śrṛṇvatāṃ guhaḥ..
vismitaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ tuṣṭāva girijāpatim.. 34.39 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुत्वेति वचनं रुद्राद्देवानां श्रृण्वतां गुहः..
विस्मितः प्रणिपत्यैनं तुष्टाव गिरिजापतिम्.. 34.39 ..
1.4.m: Having heard this speech from Rudra while the gods listened, Guha, / astonished, prostrated before the lord of the mountain's daughter and praised him:

1.4.s:
namaḥ śivāyāstu nirāmayāya namaḥ śivāyāstu manomayāya..
namaḥ śivāyāstu surārcitāya tubhyaṃ sadā bhaktakṛpāparāya.. 34.40 ..
1.4.d:
नमः शिवायास्तु निरामयाय नमः शिवायास्तु मनोमयाय..
नमः शिवायास्तु सुरार्चिताय तुभ्यं सदा भक्तकृपापराय.. 34.40 ..
1.4.m: “Homage to Śiva, free from affliction! Homage to Śiva, composed of mind! / Homage to Śiva, worshipped by the gods, to you who are ever devoted to compassion for devotees!

1.4.s:
namo bhavāyāstu bhavodbhavāya namostu te dhvastamanobhavāya..
namo'stu te gūḍhamahāvratāya namo'stu māyagahanāśrayāya.. 34.41 ..
1.4.d:
नमो भवायास्तु भवोद्भवाय नमोस्तु ते ध्वस्तमनोभवाय..
नमोऽस्तु ते गूढमहाव्रताय नमोऽस्तु मायगहनाश्रयाय.. 34.41 ..
1.4.m: Homage to Bhava, source of existence! Homage to you, destroyer of Kāma! / Homage to you of the hidden great vow! Homage to the resort of the thicket of Māyā!

1.4.s:
namostu śarvāya namaḥ śivāya namostu siddhāya purātanāya..
namostu kālāya namaḥ kalāya namo'stu te kālakalātigāya.. 34.42 ..
1.4.d:
नमोस्तु शर्वाय नमः शिवाय नमोस्तु सिद्धाय पुरातनाय..
नमोस्तु कालाय नमः कलाय नमोऽस्तु ते कालकलातिगाय.. 34.42 ..
1.4.m: Homage to Śarva! Homage to Śiva! Homage to the ancient, perfected one! / Homage to Kāla! Homage to the skilled! Homage to you who transcend time and its parts!

1.4.s:
namo nisargātmakabhūtikāya namo'stvameyokṣamaharddhikāya..
namaḥ śaraṇyāya namo'guṇāya namo'stu te bhīmaguṇānugāya .. 34.43 ..
1.4.d:
नमो निसर्गात्मकभूतिकाय नमोऽस्त्वमेयोक्षमहर्द्धिकाय..
नमः शरण्याय नमोऽगुणाय नमोऽस्तु ते भीमगुणानुगाय .. 34.43 ..
1.4.m: Homage to him whose nature is inherent majesty! Homage to him whose immense glory has the bull [as its vehicle]! / Homage to the refuge! Homage to him who is without qualities! Homage to you who are attended by fierce attributes!

1.4.s:
namo'stu nānābhuvanādhikartre namo'stu bhaktābhimatapradātre..
namo'stu karmaprasāvāya dhātre namaḥ sadā te bhagavansukartre.. 34.44 ..
1.4.d:
नमोऽस्तु नानाभुवनाधिकर्त्रे नमोऽस्तु भक्ताभिमतप्रदात्रे..
नमोऽस्तु कर्मप्रसावाय धात्रे नमः सदा ते भगवन्सुकर्त्रे.. 34.44 ..
1.4.m: Homage to the supreme lord of the various worlds! Homage to the granter of devotees’ desires! / Homage to the creator, the procreator of action! Homage ever to you, O Lord, who act beneficently!

1.4.s:
anaṃtarūpāya sadaiva tubhyamasahyakopāya sadaiva tubhyam..
ameyamānāya namostu tubhyaṃ vṛṣeṃdrayānāya namo'stu tubhyam.. 34.45 ..
1.4.d:
अनंतरूपाय सदैव तुभ्यमसह्यकोपाय सदैव तुभ्यम्..
अमेयमानाय नमोस्तु तुभ्यं वृषेंद्रयानाय नमोऽस्तु तुभ्यम्.. 34.45 ..
1.4.m: Homage ever to you of endless forms! Homage ever to you of unbearable anger! / Homage to you of immeasurable honor! Homage to you whose vehicle is the chief of bulls!

1.4.s:
namaḥ prasiddhāya mahauṣadhāya namo'stu te vyādhigaṇāpahāya..
carācarāyātha vicāradāya kumāranāthāya namaḥ śivāya.. 34.46 ..
1.4.d:
नमः प्रसिद्धाय महौषधाय नमोऽस्तु ते व्याधिगणापहाय..
चराचरायाथ विचारदाय कुमारनाथाय नमः शिवाय.. 34.46 ..
1.4.m: Homage to the celebrated, supreme medicine! Homage to you, remover of host of diseases! / Homage to Śiva, the lord of Kumāra, moving and unmoving, the bestower of discernment!

1.4.s:
mameśa bhūteśa maheśvarosi kāmeśa vāgīśa baleśa dhīśa..
krodheśa moheśa parāpareśa namostu mokṣeśa guhaśayeśa.. 34.47 ..
1.4.d:
ममेश भूतेश महेश्वरोसि कामेश वागीश बलेश धीश..
क्रोधेश मोहेश परापरेश नमोस्तु मोक्षेश गुहशयेश.. 34.47 ..
1.4.m: You are my lord, the lord of beings, the great lord, lord of desire, lord of speech, lord of strength, lord of intellect, / lord of anger, lord of delusion, lord of the high and low, homage to the lord of liberation, the lord abiding in the secret cave!”

1.4.s:
iti saṃstūya varadaṃ śūlapāṇimumāpatim..
praṇipatya umāputro namonama uvāca ha.. 34.48 ..
1.4.d:
इति संस्तूय वरदं शूलपाणिमुमापतिम्..
प्रणिपत्य उमापुत्रो नमोनम उवाच ह.. 34.48 ..
1.4.m: Having praised the boon-giver, the wielder of the trident, the husband of Umā, / the son of Umā bowed down and repeatedly said, “Homage, homage!”

1.4.s:
evaṃ bhaktiparākrāṃtamātmayogyaṃ stavaṃ śivaḥ..
abhinandya ciraṃ kālamidaṃ vacanamabravīt.. 34.49 ..
1.4.d:
एवं भक्तिपराक्रांतमात्मयोग्यं स्तवं शिवः..
अभिनन्द्य चिरं कालमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्.. 34.49 ..
1.4.m: Then Śiva, after praising for a long time this hymn / filled with devotion and worthy of himself, spoke these words:

1.4.s:
tvayā duḥkhaṃ na saṃciṃtyaṃ mama bhaktavadhātmakam..
karmaṇānena ślāghyo'si munīnāmapi putraka.. 34.50 ..
1.4.d:
त्वया दुःखं न संचिंत्यं मम भक्तवधात्मकम्..
कर्मणानेन श्लाघ्योऽसि मुनीनामपि पुत्रक.. 34.50 ..
1.4.m: “You should not grieve over the killing of my devotee; / by this deed, O son, you are praiseworthy even among sages.

1.4.s:
ye ca sāyaṃ tathā prātastvatkṛtena stavena mām..
stoṣyaṃti parayā bhaktyā śruṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam.. 34.51 ..
1.4.d:
ये च सायं तथा प्रातस्त्वत्कृतेन स्तवेन माम्..
स्तोष्यंति परया भक्त्या श्रुणु तेषां च यत्फलम्.. 34.51 ..
1.4.m: And those who, at evening and morning, praise me with this hymn / composed by you, with supreme devotion, hear the fruit that is theirs:

1.4.s:
na vyādhirna ca dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam..
bhuktvā bhogāndurlabhāṃśca mama yāsyaṃti sadma te.. 34.52 ..
1.4.d:
न व्याधिर्न च दारिद्र्यं न चैवेष्टवियोजनम्..
भुक्त्वा भोगान्दुर्लभांश्च मम यास्यंति सद्म ते.. 34.52 ..
1.4.m: neither disease nor poverty, nor separation from loved ones [will befall them]; / and having enjoyed pleasures rare to obtain, they will go to my abode.

1.4.s:
tathānyānapi dāsyāmi varānparamadurlabhān..
bhaktyā tavātituṣṭo'haṃ prītyarthaṃ tava putraka.. 34.53 ..
1.4.d:
तथान्यानपि दास्यामि वरान्परमदुर्लभान्..
भक्त्या तवातितुष्टोऽहं प्रीत्यर्थं तव पुत्रक.. 34.53 ..
1.4.m: I shall likewise grant other boons that are exceedingly rare to obtain; / I am exceedingly pleased by your devotion, for your gratification, O son.

1.4.s:
mahīsā garakūle tu ye māṃ stoṣyaṃti pūjayā..
teṣāṃ datakṣayaṃ sarvaṃ vaiśākhyāṃ dānapūjanam.. 34.54 ..
1.4.d:
महीसा गरकूले तु ये मां स्तोष्यंति पूजया..
तेषां दतक्षयं सर्वं वैशाख्यां दानपूजनम्.. 34.54 ..
1.4.m: For those who praise me with worship on the shore of the ocean at the Mahī river, / their gift and worship on the full moon day of Vaiśākha will all be imperishable.

1.4.s:
sarasyatra ca ye snānaṃ prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ..
sarvatīrthaphalā vāptirvaiśākhyāṃ prabhaviṣyati.. 34.55 ..
1.4.d:
सरस्यत्र च ये स्नानं प्रकरिष्यंति मानवाः..
सर्वतीर्थफला वाप्तिर्वैशाख्यां प्रभविष्यति.. 34.55 ..
1.4.m: And whatever people take a bath in this lake / on the full moon day of Vaiśākha will attain the fruit of all sacred fords.

1.4.s:
kumāreśaṃ tu māṃ bhaktyā mahīsāgarasaṃgame..
snātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ tasya jātismṛtirbhavet.. 34.56 ..
1.4.d:
कुमारेशं तु मां भक्त्या महीसागरसंगमे..
स्नात्वा संपूजयेन्नित्यं तस्य जातिस्मृतिर्भवेत्.. 34.56 ..
1.4.m: He who, having bathed at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, / constantly worships me as Kumāreśa with devotion, will attain memory of his past births.

1.4.s:
jātismṛtiriyaṃ putra yasyāṃ jātau prajāyate..
smarate'syāḥ prakartavyaṃ śreyorūpaṃ sudurlabham.. 34.57 ..
1.4.d:
जातिस्मृतिरियं पुत्र यस्यां जातौ प्रजायते..
स्मरतेऽस्याः प्रकर्तव्यं श्रेयोरूपं सुदुर्लभम्.. 34.57 ..
1.4.m: This recollection of past lives, O son, into whatever birth it arises, / makes one remember the duty leading to the highest good, which is exceedingly rare.

1.4.s:
yasminkāle hyanāvṛṣṭirjāyate kṛttikāsuta..
snāpayedvidhivanmāṃ ca kalaśairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ.. 34.58 ..
1.4.d:
यस्मिन्काले ह्यनावृष्टिर्जायते कृत्तिकासुत..
स्नापयेद्विधिवन्मां च कलशैर्विविधैः शुभैः.. 34.58 ..
1.4.m: At whatever time drought occurs, O son of the Kṛttikās, / one should bathe me according to the rule with various auspicious pots.

1.4.s:
ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ ca sapta vā..
snāpayedgaṃdhatoyena kuṃkumena vilepayet.. 34.59 ..
1.4.d:
एकरात्रं त्रिरात्रं वा पञ्चरात्रं च सप्त वा..
स्नापयेद्गंधतोयेन कुंकुमेन विलेपयेत्.. 34.59 ..
1.4.m: For one night, or three nights, or five nights, or seven, / one should bathe me with fragrant water and smear me with saffron.

1.4.s:
karavīrai raktapuṣpairjapāpuṣpaistathaiva ca..
arcayetpuṣpamālābhiḥ paridhāyāruṇavāsasī.. 34.60 ..
1.4.d:
करवीरै रक्तपुष्पैर्जपापुष्पैस्तथैव च..
अर्चयेत्पुष्पमालाभिः परिधायारुणवाससी.. 34.60 ..
1.4.m: One should worship me with oleanders, red flowers, and likewise hibiscus flowers, / with garlands of flowers, having put on two reddish garments.

1.4.s:
bhojayedbrahṇāṃścaiva tāpasāñchaṃsivavratān..
lakṣahomaṃ prakurvīta śivahomaṃ grahādikam.. 34.61 ..
1.4.d:
भोजयेद्ब्रह्णांश्चैव तापसाञ्छंसिवव्रतान्..
लक्षहोमं प्रकुर्वीत शिवहोमं ग्रहादिकम्.. 34.61 ..
1.4.m: One should feed brahmins and ascetics observant of vows, / and perform a hundred thousand oblations, the Śiva homa, the planetary rites, and so forth.

1.4.s:
bhūmidānaṃ tataḥ kuryāttatto dadyādgavāhnikam..
āghoṣayecchivāṃ śāṃtiṃ rudrajāpyaṃ hi kārayet.. 34.62 ..
1.4.d:
भूमिदानं ततः कुर्यात्तत्तो दद्याद्गवाह्निकम्..
आघोषयेच्छिवां शांतिं रुद्रजाप्यं हि कारयेत्.. 34.62 ..
1.4.m: Then one should make a gift of land, and then provide daily fodder for cows; / one should proclaim auspicious peace and have the Rudra recitation performed.

1.4.s:
anenaiva vidhānena kṛtena tu dvijottamaiḥ..
āgarbhitāstadā meghā varṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 34.63 ..
1.4.d:
अनेनैव विधानेन कृतेन तु द्विजोत्तमैः..
आगर्भितास्तदा मेघा वर्षते नात्र संशयः.. 34.63 ..
1.4.m: When this rite is performed by the best of the twice-born, / then the clouds, pregnant with rain, will shower; of this there is no doubt.

1.4.s:
vividhaiḥ pūryate dhānyaḥ śādvalaiśca vasundharā..
ārogyaṃ hi bhaveccaiva jane gopakule tathā.. 34.64 ..
1.4.d:
विविधैः पूर्यते धान्यः शाद्वलैश्च वसुन्धरा..
आरोग्यं हि भवेच्चैव जने गोपकुले तथा.. 34.64 ..
1.4.m: The earth is filled with various grains and lush grasses, / and health indeed will come to the people and to the herds of cattle.”

1.4.s:
dharmayukto bhavedrājā paracakrairna pīḍyate..
gṛtena snāpayenmāṃ ca arkakrāṃtau naro'tra yaḥ.. 34.65 ..
1.4.d:
धर्मयुक्तो भवेद्राजा परचक्रैर्न पीड्यते..
गृतेन स्नापयेन्मां च अर्कक्रांतौ नरोऽत्र यः.. 34.65 ..
1.4.m: The king will be endowed with righteousness and will not be afflicted by hostile armies. / And whichever man here bathes me with ghee at the transit of the sun,

1.4.s:
kanyādāna phalaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..
kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevaṃ tathā paṃcāmṛtena yaḥ.. 34.66 ..
1.4.d:
कन्यादान फलं तस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा..
क्षीरेण स्नापयेद्देवं तथा पंचामृतेन यः.. 34.66 ..
1.4.m: obtains the fruit of the gift of a maiden—of this there should be no doubt. / Whoever bathes the god with milk, as well as with the five nectars,

1.4.s:
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ tasyopajāyate..
kumāreśvaratīrtheyaḥ prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti hi.. 34.67 ..
1.4.d:
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं तस्योपजायते..
कुमारेश्वरतीर्थेयः प्राणत्यागं करोति हि.. 34.67 ..
1.4.m: the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice is produced for him. / Whosoever gives up his life at the sacred ford Kumāreśvara,

1.4.s:
rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam..
ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ.. 34.68 ..
1.4.d:
रुद्रलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्..
अयने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे चंद्रसूर्ययोः.. 34.68 ..
1.4.m: shall dwell in the world of Rudra until the destruction of all elements. / At the solstices and the equinoxes, and during eclipses of the moon and the sun,

1.4.s:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ saṃkrāṃtau vaidhṛte tathā..
kumāreśaṃ naraḥ snātvā mahīsāgarasaṃgame.. 34.69 ..
1.4.d:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां संक्रांतौ वैधृते तथा..
कुमारेशं नरः स्नात्वा महीसागरसंगमे.. 34.69 ..
1.4.m: on the full moon, on the new moon, on the transit of the sun, and on Vaidhṛti, / a man, having bathed at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean,

1.4.s:
bhaktyā yobhyarcayenmāṃ ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śrṛṇu..
yanmahītalatīrtheṣu snāne syāttu mahatphalam..34.70 ..
1.4.d:
भक्त्या योभ्यर्चयेन्मां च तस्य पुण्यफलं श्रृणु..
यन्महीतलतीर्थेषु स्नाने स्यात्तु महत्फलम्..34.70 ..
1.4.m: who worships Kumāreśa, namely me, with devotion—hear the meritorious fruit for him! / Whatever great fruit there may be in bathing at the sacred fords on the earth,

1.4.s:
yaccarciteṣu liṃgeṣu sarveṣu syātphalaṃ ca tat..
ārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dhanalābhaṃ sukhaṃsutam.. 34.71 ..
1.4.d:
यच्चर्चितेषु लिंगेषु सर्वेषु स्यात्फलं च तत्..
आरोग्यं पुत्रलाभं च धनलाभं सुखंसुतम्.. 34.71 ..
1.4.m: and whatever fruit there may be when all liṅgas are worshipped, / health, obtaining a son, acquiring wealth, and happiness with children—

1.4.s:
niścitaṃ labhate martyaḥ kumāreśvarasevayā..
brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā yastiṣṭhedatra tāpasaḥ.. 34.72 ..
1.4.d:
निश्चितं लभते मर्त्यः कुमारेश्वरसेवया..
ब्रह्मचारी शुचिर्भूत्वा यस्तिष्ठेदत्र तापसः.. 34.72 ..
1.4.m: a mortal certainly attains all this through the service of Kumāreśvara. / Whichsoever ascetic, becoming a celibate student and pure, remains here,

1.4.s:
paraṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ prāpya yāti layaṃ mayi..
pāpātmanāṃ ca martyānāṃ sadyo'smi phaladarśakaḥ.. 34.73 ..
1.4.d:
परं पाशुपतं योगं प्राप्य याति लयं मयि..
पापात्मनां च मर्त्यानां सद्योऽस्मि फलदर्शकः.. 34.73 ..
1.4.m: having attained supreme Pāśupata yoga, he merges into me. / And for mortals who are evil-minded, I instantly reveal the fruit.

1.4.s:
divyenāṣṭavidhenātra kośaḥ sādhāraṇo'tra ca..
aghorādyaiḥ paṃcamaṃtraiḥ snāpya liṃgaṃ mahojjavalam.. 34.74 ..
1.4.d:
दिव्येनाष्टविधेनात्र कोशः साधारणोऽत्र च..
अघोराद्यैः पंचमंत्रैः स्नाप्य लिंगं महोज्जवलम्.. 34.74 ..
1.4.m: Here, by means of an eightfold divine ordeal, the oath is customary. / Having bathed the exceedingly radiant liṅga with the five mantras beginning with Aghora,

1.4.s:
aghoreṇaiva tattoyaṃ dadyāddivyasya kāraṇe..
pibedetadudīryā prasṛtitrayameva ca.. 34.75 ..
1.4.d:
अघोरेणैव तत्तोयं दद्याद्दिव्यस्य कारणे..
पिबेदेतदुदीर्या प्रसृतित्रयमेव च.. 34.75 ..
1.4.m: one should offer that water with the Aghora mantra for the sake of the divine ordeal. / Uttering this, one should drink just three handfuls:

1.4.s:
yadi dharmastathā satyamīśvaro'tra jagattraye..
kośapānātphalaṃ sadyo drakṣyāmyasmi śubhā śubham.. 34.76 ..
1.4.d:
यदि धर्मस्तथा सत्यमीश्वरोऽत्र जगत्त्रये..
कोशपानात्फलं सद्यो द्रक्ष्याम्यस्मि शुभा शुभम्.. 34.76 ..
1.4.m: ‘If there is righteousness, truth, and the Lord in the three worlds, / through the drinking of this consecrated water I shall instantly see the auspicious or inauspicious fruit.’

1.4.s:
yāsye ceti kulaṃ hanyādgamane ca kuṭumbakam..
darśane ca śubhaṃ pāne hanyāddehaṃ ca mithyayā.. 34.77 ..
1.4.d:
यास्ये चेति कुलं हन्याद्गमने च कुटुम्बकम्..
दर्शने च शुभं पाने हन्याद्देहं च मिथ्यया.. 34.77 ..
1.4.m: ‘I shall depart’—saying thus, if he walks away [perjured], it destroys his family and relatives; / while in truthful darśana and drinking, it brings auspiciousness; by falsehood, it destroys the body.

1.4.s:
tribhirdinaistribhiḥ pakṣaistribhirmāsaistribhiḥ samaiḥ..
atyugrapuṇyapāpānāṃ mānena phalamaśnute.. 34.78 ..
1.4.d:
त्रिभिर्दिनैस्त्रिभिः पक्षैस्त्रिभिर्मासैस्त्रिभिः समैः..
अत्युग्रपुण्यपापानां मानेन फलमश्नुते.. 34.78 ..
1.4.m: Within three days, three fortnights, three months, or three years, / one reaps the fruit in proportion to one's extremely fierce merits or sins.

1.4.s:
ete varāmayā liṃge dattātraṃ sthāpite tvayā..
tava prītyabhivṛddhyarthaṃ brūhi bhūyo'pyumātmaja.. 34.79 ..
1.4.d:
एते वरामया लिंगे दत्तात्रं स्थापिते त्वया..
तव प्रीत्यभिवृद्ध्यर्थं ब्रूहि भूयोऽप्युमात्मज.. 34.79 ..
1.4.m: These boons have been given by me to the liṅga established here by you. / For the sake of increasing your delight, speak further, O son of Umā.”

1.4.s:
..skanda uvāca..
kṛtakṛtyo varairdattaistvayā caitairmaheśvara..
namonamo namastestu nātra tyājyaṃ tvayā vibho.. 34.80 ..
1.4.d:
..स्कन्द उवाच..
कृतकृत्यो वरैर्दत्तैस्त्वया चैतैर्महेश्वर..
नमोनमो नमस्तेस्तु नात्र त्याज्यं त्वया विभो.. 34.80 ..
1.4.m: Skanda said: / “I have accomplished my purpose through these boons given by you, O Maheśvara! / Salutations, salutations, let there be salutations to you; this place must not be abandoned by you, O Lord!”

1.4.s:
evaṃ praṇamya devaṃ sa mātaraṃ praṇato'bravīt..
tvayāpi mātarnaivātra tyājyaṃ mama priyepsayā.. 34.81 ..
1.4.d:
एवं प्रणम्य देवं स मातरं प्रणतोऽब्रवीत्..
त्वयापि मातर्नैवात्र त्याज्यं मम प्रियेप्सया.. 34.81 ..
1.4.m: Having thus bowed down to the god, he bowed down and spoke to his mother: / “By you too, O mother, desiring to do what is pleasing to me, this place must not be abandoned.

1.4.s: tvāmapyatra sthāpayiṣye varadā bhava parvati.. 34.82 ..
1.4.d: त्वामप्यत्र स्थापयिष्ये वरदा भव पर्वति.. 34.82 ..
1.4.m: I shall establish you here as well; be a bestower of boons, O Pārvatī.”

1.4.s:
..śrīdevyuvāca..
yatra śarvaḥ svabhāvena tatra tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ suta.. 34.83 ..
1.4.d:
..श्रीदेव्युवाच..
यत्र शर्वः स्वभावेन तत्र तिष्ठाम्यहं सुत.. 34.83 ..
1.4.m: The goddess said: / “Where Śarva is naturally present, there I remain, O son.

1.4.s:
tava bhaktyā viśeṣeṇa sthāsye strīṇāṃ varapradā..
yuddheṣu tavakarmāṇi rudrabhakteṣu te kṛpām.. 34.84 ..
1.4.d:
तव भक्त्या विशेषेण स्थास्ये स्त्रीणां वरप्रदा..
युद्धेषु तवकर्माणि रुद्रभक्तेषु ते कृपाम्.. 34.84 ..
1.4.m: Especially out of devotion to you, I will abide here granting boons to women. / Beholding your deeds in battles and your compassion towards the devotees of Rudra,

1.4.s:
paśyaṃti putriṇāṃ mukhyā prīṇitā ca bhṛśaṃ tvayā..
garbhakleśaḥ striyo manye sāphalyaṃ bhajate tadā.. 34.85 ..
1.4.d:
पश्यंति पुत्रिणां मुख्या प्रीणिता च भृशं त्वया..
गर्भक्लेशः स्त्रियो मन्ये साफल्यं भजते तदा.. 34.85 ..
1.4.m: I, the foremost of mothers, am exceedingly pleased by you. / I consider that a woman's pain of pregnancy attains its fruition

1.4.s:
suto yadā rudrabhaktaḥ sānaṃdaṃ sadbhirīryate..
bhava tasmātpriyārthāya tiṣṭhāmyatra ṣaḍānana.. 34.86 ..
1.4.d:
सुतो यदा रुद्रभक्तः सानंदं सद्भिरीर्यते..
भव तस्मात्प्रियार्थाय तिष्ठाम्यत्र षडानन.. 34.86 ..
1.4.m: when a son is a devotee of Rudra, praised joyfully by good men. / Therefore, O six-faced one, for the sake of pleasing you, I will stay here.

1.4.s:
strībhirārādhitā dāsye saubhāgyaṃ supatiṃ sutān..
caitre cāpi tṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā śītena vāriṇā.. 34.87 ..
1.4.d:
स्त्रीभिराराधिता दास्ये सौभाग्यं सुपतिं सुतान्..
चैत्रे चापि तृतीयायां स्नात्वा शीतेन वारिणा.. 34.87 ..
1.4.m: Worshipped by women, I shall bestow good fortune, an excellent husband, and sons. / And on the third day in the month of Caitra, having bathed with cool water,

1.4.s:
arcayiṣyaṃti māṃ yāśca puṣpairdhūpairvilepanaiḥ..
dāsyāmi cāṣṭasaubhāgyaṃ yā nārī bhaktitatparā.. 34.88 ..
1.4.d:
अर्चयिष्यंति मां याश्च पुष्पैर्धूपैर्विलेपनैः..
दास्यामि चाष्टसौभाग्यं या नारी भक्तितत्परा.. 34.88 ..
1.4.m: those women who will worship me with flowers, incenses, and ointments— / to that woman who is intent on devotion, I shall bestow the eightfold good fortune:

1.4.s:
pitarau śvaśurau putrānpatiṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadaḥ..
kuṃkumaṃ puṣpaśrīkhaṃḍaṃ tāṃbūlāṃjanamikṣavaḥ.. 34.89 ..
1.4.d:
पितरौ श्वशुरौ पुत्रान्पतिं सौभाग्यसंपदः..
कुंकुमं पुष्पश्रीखंडं तांबूलांजनमिक्षवः.. 34.89 ..
1.4.m: parents, parents-in-law, sons, a husband, and the treasures of good fortune: / saffron, flowers, sandalwood, betel, collyrium, sugarcane,

1.4.s:
saptamaṃ lavaṇaṃ proktamaṣṭamaṃ ca sujīrakam..
tolayettulayā vāpi sāṃghriśca tulitā bhavet.. 34.90 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तमं लवणं प्रोक्तमष्टमं च सुजीरकम्..
तोलयेत्तुलया वापि सांघ्रिश्च तुलिता भवेत्.. 34.90 ..
1.4.m: salt is declared the seventh, and good cumin the eighth. / Or if she weighs them on a scale, and she too is weighed together with the feet,

1.4.s:
suvarmenātha saugandhyadravyaiḥ śubhaphalairapi..
bhuṃkte vā lavaṇaṃ paścānnāsau vai vidhavā bhavet.. 34.91 ..
1.4.d:
सुवर्मेनाथ सौगन्ध्यद्रव्यैः शुभफलैरपि..
भुंक्ते वा लवणं पश्चान्नासौ वै विधवा भवेत्.. 34.91 ..
1.4.m: with gold, fragrant substances, and auspicious fruits, / or if she eats salt afterwards, she shall never become a widow.

1.4.s:
māghe vā kārtike vāpi caitre snātvārcayet mām..
daurbhāgyaduḥkhadāridryairna sā saṃyogamāpnuyāt.. 34.92 ..
1.4.d:
माघे वा कार्तिके वापि चैत्रे स्नात्वार्चयेत् माम्..
दौर्भाग्यदुःखदारिद्र्यैर्न सा संयोगमाप्नुयात्.. 34.92 ..
1.4.m: Having bathed in Māgha, Kārtika, or Caitra, if she worships me, / she shall never encounter misfortune, sorrow, or poverty.”

1.4.s:
śrutveti girijāvācaṃ sānaṃdaḥ pārvatīsutaḥ..
sthāpayitvā girisutāṃ kapardinamathābravīt.. 34.93 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुत्वेति गिरिजावाचं सानंदः पार्वतीसुतः..
स्थापयित्वा गिरिसुतां कपर्दिनमथाब्रवीत्.. 34.93 ..
1.4.m: Having heard these words of the mountain-born goddess, the son of Pārvatī was delighted. / Having established the daughter of the mountain, he then spoke to Kapardin:

1.4.s:
puṣpairdhūpairmodakaiśca pūrvamabhyarcya tvāṃ prabho..
pujayaṃti kumāreśaṃ teṣāṃ vighnaharo bhava.. 34.94 ..
1.4.d:
पुष्पैर्धूपैर्मोदकैश्च पूर्वमभ्यर्च्य त्वां प्रभो..
पुजयंति कुमारेशं तेषां विघ्नहरो भव.. 34.94 ..
1.4.m: “O Lord, to those who, having first worshipped you with flowers, incenses, and sweet cakes, / worship Kumāreśa, be the remover of obstacles for them.”

1.4.s:
..kapardyuvāca..
bhrātastvayā sthāpite'smim̐lliṃge bhaktāśca ye narāḥ..
na teṣāṃ mama vighnāni mama vāganugāminī.. 34.95 ..
1.4.d:
..कपर्द्युवाच..
भ्रातस्त्वया स्थापितेऽस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे भक्ताश्च ये नराः..
न तेषां मम विघ्नानि मम वागनुगामिनी.. 34.95 ..
1.4.m: Kapardin said: / “O brother, for those men who are devoted to this liṅga established by you, / my obstacles shall not arise; my word will follow [them].”

1.4.s:
evamukte vighnarājñā pratīte'sthāpayacca tam..
tasmādasau sadābhyarcyaścaturthyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ.. 34.96 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्ते विघ्नराज्ञा प्रतीतेऽस्थापयच्च तम्..
तस्मादसौ सदाभ्यर्च्यश्चतुर्थ्यां च विशेषतः.. 34.96 ..
1.4.m: When this was said by the lord of obstacles, who was pleased, he established him. / Therefore, he should always be worshipped, and especially on the fourth day.

1.4.s:
evaṃ sthāpya kumāreśaṃ labdhvā caitānvarāñchivāt..
manasā kṛtakṛtyaṃ cātmānaṃ mene ṣaḍānanaḥ.. 34.97 ..
1.4.d:
एवं स्थाप्य कुमारेशं लब्ध्वा चैतान्वराञ्छिवात्..
मनसा कृतकृत्यं चात्मानं मेने षडाननः.. 34.97 ..
1.4.m: Having thus established Kumāreśa and obtained these boons from Śiva, / the six-faced one considered himself accomplished in purpose.

1.4.s:
tasthāvaṃśena tatraiva kumāreśvarasaṃnidhau..
atra sthitaṃ kumāraṃ ye paśyanti svāmiyātrimaḥ.. 34.98 ..
1.4.d:
तस्थावंशेन तत्रैव कुमारेश्वरसंनिधौ..
अत्र स्थितं कुमारं ये पश्यन्ति स्वामियात्रिमः.. 34.98 ..
1.4.m: By a portion [of himself] he remained right there in the presence of Kumāreśvara. / Those pilgrims of Svāmī who see Kumāra stationed here,

1.4.s:
saphalā svāmiyātrā ca teṣāṃ bhavati bhārata..
kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kārtikeyaṃ samarcayet.. 34.99 ..
1.4.d:
सफला स्वामियात्रा च तेषां भवति भारत..
कार्तिक्यां च विशेषेण कार्तिकेयं समर्चयेत्.. 34.99 ..
1.4.m: their pilgrimage to Svāmī becomes fruitful, O descendant of Bharata. / Especially on the full moon of Kārtika, one should worship Kārtikeya;

1.4.s:
yatphalaṃ svāmiyātrāyāṃ tatphalaṃ samāvāpnuyāt..
evaṃvidhamidaṃ pārtha mahīsāgarasaṃgamam.. 34.100 ..
1.4.d:
यत्फलं स्वामियात्रायां तत्फलं समावाप्नुयात्..
एवंविधमिदं पार्थ महीसागरसंगमम्.. 34.100 ..
1.4.m: whatever fruit there is in the pilgrimage to Svāmī, that very fruit one obtains. / Such is this confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, O son of Pṛthā.

1.4.s:
nimittīkṛtya cātmānaṃ sādhvarthe liṃgamarcitam..
rogābhibhūto rogairvā nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam.. 34.101 ..
1.4.d:
निमित्तीकृत्य चात्मानं साध्वर्थे लिंगमर्चितम्..
रोगाभिभूतो रोगैर्वा नाम्नामष्टोत्तरं शतम्.. 34.101 ..
1.4.m: Making himself the instrument, he worshipped the liṅga for the benefit of the virtuous. / If one afflicted by diseases recites the one hundred and eight names,

1.4.s:
japtvā śucirbrahmacārī māsaṃ mucyeta pātakāt..
etadārādhya saṃjātā rajirāmādayaḥ purā.. 34.102 ..
1.4.d:
जप्त्वा शुचिर्ब्रह्मचारी मासं मुच्येत पातकात्..
एतदाराध्य संजाता रजिरामादयः पुरा.. 34.102 ..
1.4.m: becoming pure and celibate for a month, he will be freed from sin. / Having worshipped this in ancient times, Raji, Rāma, and others arose,

1.4.s:
śatasaṃkhyābalaṃ rājyaṃ rudraloka ca bhejire..
jāmadagnyastvidaṃ liṃgamārādhya ca samāyutam.. 34.103 ..
1.4.d:
शतसंख्याबलं राज्यं रुद्रलोक च भेजिरे..
जामदग्न्यस्त्विदं लिंगमाराध्य च समायुतम्.. 34.103 ..
1.4.m: and attained kingship with the strength of a hundred armies, as well as the world of Rudra. / The descendant of Jamadagni, having worshipped this liṅga for a year,

1.4.s:
lebhe kuṭhāramujjahne yenārjunabhujānyudhi..
agrato devadevasya jñātvā tīrthe mahāguṇān.. 34.104 ..
1.4.d:
लेभे कुठारमुज्जह्ने येनार्जुनभुजान्युधि..
अग्रतो देवदेवस्य ज्ञात्वा तीर्थे महागुणान्.. 34.104 ..
1.4.m: obtained an axe with which he cut off the arms of Arjuna in battle. / Knowing the great virtues at this sacred ford in the presence of the God of gods,

1.4.s:
rāmeśvaramiti khyātaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam..
tacca yo'bhyarcayedbhaktyā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati.. 34.105 ..
1.4.d:
रामेश्वरमिति ख्यातं स्थापितं लिंगमुत्तमम्..
तच्च योऽभ्यर्चयेद्भक्त्या रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति.. 34.105 ..
1.4.m: the excellent liṅga celebrated as Rāmeśvara was established. / And whoever worships it with devotion, he goes to the world of Rudra.

1.4.s:
prītaḥ syāttasya rāmaśca kumāreśaśca phālguna..
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ kumāreśasya varṇanam.. 34.106 ..
1.4.d:
प्रीतः स्यात्तस्य रामश्च कुमारेशश्च फाल्गुन..
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं कुमारेशस्य वर्णनम्.. 34.106 ..
1.4.m: Rāma and Kumāreśa will be pleased with him, O Phālguna. / Thus the description of Kumāreśa has been declared in brief.

1.4.s:
kumāreśasya māhātmyaṃ kīrtayedyastadagrataḥ..
ye ca śrṛṇvaṃtyanudinaṃ rudraloke vasaṃti te.. 34.107 ..
1.4.d:
कुमारेशस्य माहात्म्यं कीर्तयेद्यस्तदग्रतः..
ये च श्रृण्वंत्यनुदिनं रुद्रलोके वसंति ते.. 34.107 ..
1.4.m: Whoever proclaims the māhātmya of Kumāreśa in his presence, / and those who listen to it daily, they dwell in the world of Rudra.

1.4.s:
asya liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ śrāddhakāle tu yaḥ paṭhet..
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 34.108 ..
1.4.d:
अस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्यं श्राद्धकाले तु यः पठेत्..
पितॄणामक्षयं जायते नात्र संशयः.. 34.108 ..
1.4.m: Whoever recites the māhātmya of this liṅga at the time of a śrāddha, / for his ancestors there arises inexhaustible [satisfaction]; of this there is no doubt.

1.4.s:
asya liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ gurviṇīṃ śrāvayedyadi..
guṇavāñjāyate putraḥ kanyā cāpi pativratā.. 34.109 ..
1.4.d:
अस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्यं गुर्विणीं श्रावयेद्यदि..
गुणवाञ्जायते पुत्रः कन्या चापि पतिव्रता.. 34.109 ..
1.4.m: If one causes a pregnant woman to hear the māhātmya of this liṅga, / a virtuous son is born, or a devoted daughter.

1.4.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dharmyaṃ cāhlādakārakam..
paṭhatāṃ cāpi sarvābhīṣṭaphala pradam.. 34.110 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśasthāpanapūrvakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 34 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धर्म्यं चाह्लादकारकम्..
पठतां चापि सर्वाभीष्टफल प्रदम्.. 34.110 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे कुमारेशस्थापनपूर्वकमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 34 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
This is meritorious, sin-destroying, righteous, and brings delight; / and to those who recite it, it grants the fruit of all desired wishes.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya Preceding the Installation of Kumāreśa', in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
kumāreṇa sthāpito'tra kumāreśastataḥ surāḥ..
praṇamya guhamūcuśca prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ.. 35.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
कुमारेण स्थापितोऽत्र कुमारेशस्ततः सुराः..
प्रणम्य गुहमूचुश्च प्रबद्धकरसंपुटाः.. 35.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / When Kumāreśa had thus been installed here by Kumāra, the gods / bowed to Guha and said with folded hands:

1.4.s:
kiṃcidvijñāpayaṣyāmo vayaṃ tvāṃ śrṛṇu tattvataḥ..
pūrvaprasiddha ācāraḥ procyate jayināmayam.. 35.2 ..
1.4.d:
किंचिद्विज्ञापयष्यामो वयं त्वां श्रृणु तत्त्वतः..
पूर्वप्रसिद्ध आचारः प्रोच्यते जयिनामयम्.. 35.2 ..
1.4.m: "We wish to submit something to you; listen in truth: / this ancient, renowned custom of victors is proclaimed:

1.4.s:
jayaṃti ye raṇe śatrūṃstaiḥ kāryaḥ staṃbhacihnakaḥ..
tasmāttava jayoddyotanimittaṃ staṃmamuttamam.. 35.3 ..
1.4.d:
जयंति ये रणे शत्रूंस्तैः कार्यः स्तंभचिह्नकः..
तस्मात्तव जयोद्द्योतनिमित्तं स्तंममुत्तमम्.. 35.3 ..
1.4.m: Those who conquer enemies in battle must erect the token of a pillar. / Therefore, for the sake of celebrating your victory, an excellent pillar

1.4.s:
nakṣipāma vayaṃ yāvattmanujñātumarhasi..
viśvakarmakṛtaṃ yacca tṛtīyaṃ liṃgamuttamam.. 35.4 ..
1.4.d:
नक्षिपाम वयं यावत्त्मनुज्ञातुमर्हसि..
विश्वकर्मकृतं यच्च तृतीयं लिंगमुत्तमम्.. 35.4 ..
1.4.m: let us erect, if you will deign to grant permission. / And this excellent third liṅga fashioned by Viśvakarman—

1.4.s:
tasya staṃbhāgratasataṃ ca saṃsthāpaya śivātmaja..
evamukte suraiḥ skandastatetyāha mahāmanāḥ.. 35.5 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य स्तंभाग्रतसतं च संस्थापय शिवात्मज..
एवमुक्ते सुरैः स्कन्दस्ततेत्याह महामनाः.. 35.5 ..
1.4.m: install it in front of that pillar, O son of Śiva!" / When the gods spoke thus, the magnanimous Skanda said, "So be it."

1.4.s:
tato hṛṣṭāḥ suragaṇāḥ śakrādyāḥ staṃbhamuttamam..
jāṃbūnadamayaṃ śubhraṃ raṇabhūmau vinikṣipuḥ.. 35.6 ..
1.4.d:
ततो हृष्टाः सुरगणाः शक्राद्याः स्तंभमुत्तमम्..
जांबूनदमयं शुभ्रं रणभूमौ विनिक्षिपुः.. 35.6 ..
1.4.m: Then the delighted hosts of gods headed by Śakra erected an excellent pillar / made of Jāmbūnada gold, bright and splendid, upon the battlefield.

1.4.s:
paritaḥ sthaṃḍilaṃ dikṣu sarvaratnamayaṃ tu te..
tatra hṛṣṭāścāpsaraso nanṛturdaśadhā śubhāḥ.. 35.7 ..
1.4.d:
परितः स्थंडिलं दिक्षु सर्वरत्नमयं तु ते..
तत्र हृष्टाश्चाप्सरसो ननृतुर्दशधा शुभाः.. 35.7 ..
1.4.m: All around it in the directions [they made] an altar fashioned of all jewels; / there the delighted, auspicious apsarases danced in ten ways.

1.4.s:
mātaro maṃgalānyasya jaguḥ skandasya naṃditāḥ..
iṃdrādyā nanṛtustatra svayaṃ viṣṇuśca vādakaḥ.. 35.8 ..
1.4.d:
मातरो मंगलान्यस्य जगुः स्कन्दस्य नंदिताः..
इंद्राद्या ननृतुस्तत्र स्वयं विष्णुश्च वादकः.. 35.8 ..
1.4.m: Rejoicing, the Mothers sang auspicious songs for Skanda; / Indra and the others danced there, and Viṣṇu himself was the instrumentalist.

1.4.s:
petuḥ khātpuṣpavarṣāṇi devavādyāni sasvanuḥ..
evaṃ staṃbhaṃ samāropya jayākhyaṃ viśvanaṃdakaḥ.. 35.9 ..
1.4.d:
पेतुः खात्पुष्पवर्षाणि देववाद्यानि सस्वनुः..
एवं स्तंभं समारोप्य जयाख्यं विश्वनंदकः.. 35.9 ..
1.4.m: Showers of flowers fell from the sky, divine musical instruments sounded; / having thus set up the pillar named 'Victory', which gladdens the universe,

1.4.s:
stambheśvarastato devaḥ sthāpitastryakṣasūnunā..
viriṃcipramukhairdevairjātānandaiḥ samaṃ tadā.. 35.10 ..
1.4.d:
स्तम्भेश्वरस्ततो देवः स्थापितस्त्र्यक्षसूनुना..
विरिंचिप्रमुखैर्देवैर्जातानन्दैः समं तदा.. 35.10 ..
1.4.m: the god Stambheśvara was then installed by the three-eyed god's son, / together with the gods headed by Viriñci, who were filled with joy,

1.4.s:
hariharādityuktaistaiḥ sendrairmunigaṇairapi..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge śaktyagreṇa mahātmanā.. 35.11 ..
1.4.d:
हरिहरादित्युक्तैस्तैः सेन्द्रैर्मुनिगणैरपि..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे शक्त्यग्रेण महात्मना.. 35.11 ..
1.4.m: along with Hari, Hara, and the Ādityas, accompanied by Indra and hosts of sages. / On the western side of that very [pillar], with the tip of his lance, the great-souled

1.4.s:
guhena nirmitaḥ kūpo gaṃgā tatra talodbhavā..
māghasya ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ pitṛtarpaṇam.. 35.12 ..
1.4.d:
गुहेन निर्मितः कूपो गंगा तत्र तलोद्भवा..
माघस्य च चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णायां पितृतर्पणम्.. 35.12 ..
1.4.m: Guha fashioned a well; the Gaṅgā arose there from the nether world. / On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, offering libations to the ancestors

1.4.s:
kūpe snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā bhaktyā yaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana..
gayāśrāddhena yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ labhate sphuṭam.. 35.13 ..
1.4.d:
कूपे स्नानं नरः कृत्वा भक्त्या यः पांडुनंदन..
गयाश्राद्धेन यत्पुण्यं तत्फलं लभते स्फुटम्.. 35.13 ..
1.4.m: and bathing in the well with devotion, O son of Pāṇḍu, / a man clearly obtains the fruit of whatever merit comes from a śrāddha at Gayā.

1.4.s:
staṃbheśvaraṃ tato devaṃ gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet..
vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya modate rudrasadmāni.. 35.14 ..
1.4.d:
स्तंभेश्वरं ततो देवं गन्धपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत्..
वाजपेयफलं प्राप्य मोदते रुद्रसद्मानि.. 35.14 ..
1.4.m: He should then worship the god Stambheśvara with fragrant perfumes and flowers; / having attained the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice, he rejoices in the abode of Rudra.

1.4.s:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā ca yo'bhyarcceṃtstaṃbheśvaramakalmaṣaḥ.. 35.15 ..
1.4.d:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां महीसागरसंगमे..
श्राद्धं कृत्वा च योऽभ्यर्च्चेंत्स्तंभेश्वरमकल्मषः.. 35.15 ..
1.4.m: On a full-moon or new-moon day at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, / having performed a śrāddha, whoever, free from sin, worships Stambheśvara,

1.4.s:
pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti tṛptā yacchaṃti cāśiṣaḥ..
sa bhittvā sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate.. 35.16 ..
1.4.d:
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यंति तृप्ता यच्छंति चाशिषः..
स भित्त्वा सर्वपापानि रुद्रलोके महीयते.. 35.16 ..
1.4.m: his ancestors are satisfied, and being satisfied they grant blessings; / he shatters all sins and is glorified in the world of Rudra.

1.4.s:
ityāha bhagavānrudraḥ skandasya prītaye purā..
evameva caturthaṃ ca sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam.. 35.17 ..
1.4.d:
इत्याह भगवान्रुद्रः स्कन्दस्य प्रीतये पुरा..
एवमेव चतुर्थं च स्थापितं लिंगमुत्तमम्.. 35.17 ..
1.4.m: Thus the blessed Rudra spoke of old for the delight of Skanda. / In this very way the excellent fourth liṅga was installed;

1.4.s: praṇemurdevatāḥ sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ.. 35.18 ..
1.4.d: प्रणेमुर्देवताः सर्वे साधुसाध्विति ते जगुः.. 35.18 ..
1.4.m: all the gods bowed down, chanting, "Well done! Well done!"

1.4.s: iti skāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe staṃbheśvaramāhātmyavarṇana nāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 35 .. cha ..
1.4.d: इति स्कांदेमहापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे स्तंभेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णन नाम पंचत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 35 .. छ ..
1.4.m: Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Stambheśvara', in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣitau tāni liṃgāni harasūnunā..
haribrahmeṃdrapramukhā devāḥ procuḥ parasparam.. 36.1 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
एवं दृष्ट्वा क्षितौ तानि लिंगानि हरसूनुना..
हरिब्रह्मेंद्रप्रमुखा देवाः प्रोचुः परस्परम्.. 36.1 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / Seeing those liṅgas thus [established] on earth by the son of Hara, / the gods headed by Hari, Brahmā, and Indra spoke to one another:

1.4.s:
aho dhanyaḥ kumāro'yaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame..
yena catvārī liṃgāni stāpitāni sudurlabhe.. 36.2 ..
1.4.d:
अहो धन्यः कुमारोऽयं महीसागरसंगमे..
येन चत्वारी लिंगानि स्तापितानि सुदुर्लभे.. 36.2 ..
1.4.m: "Oh, blessed is this Kumāra at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, / by whom four liṅgas have been installed in this most rare place!

1.4.s:
vayamapyatra śuddhyarthaṃ toṣārthaṃ skandarudrayoḥ..
sādhvarthe cātmalābhāya kurmo liṃgaparaṃparām.. 36.3 ..
1.4.d:
वयमप्यत्र शुद्ध्यर्थं तोषार्थं स्कन्दरुद्रयोः..
साध्वर्थे चात्मलाभाय कुर्मो लिंगपरंपराम्.. 36.3 ..
1.4.m: We too, here, for purification and for the satisfaction of Skanda and Rudra, / for the sake of the virtuous and for our own spiritual gain, shall make a series of liṅgas.

1.4.s:
athavā koṭiśo devā munayo naiva saṃkhyayā..
sarve cetsthāpayiṣyaṃti liṃgānyatra mahītaṭe.. 36.4 ..
1.4.d:
अथवा कोटिशो देवा मुनयो नैव संख्यया..
सर्वे चेत्स्थापयिष्यंति लिंगान्यत्र महीतटे.. 36.4 ..
1.4.m: Or rather, the gods are in their tens of millions and the sages beyond number; / if all of them should install liṅgas here on the bank of the Mahī,

1.4.s:
pūjā teṣāṃ kataṃ bhāvi bahutvāccātra paṭhyate..
yasya rāṣṭre rudraliṃgaṃ pūjyate naiva śaktitaḥ.. 36.5 ..
1.4.d:
पूजा तेषां कतं भावि बहुत्वाच्चात्र पठ्यते..
यस्य राष्ट्रे रुद्रलिंगं पूज्यते नैव शक्तितः.. 36.5 ..
1.4.m: how will their worship be maintained? And on account of multiplicity it is recited here: / in whose kingdom a liṅga of Rudra is not worshipped according to one's capacity,

1.4.s:
tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ durbhikṣavyādhitaskaraiḥ..
saṃbhūya sthāpayiṣyāmo liṃgamekaṃ tataḥ śubham.. 36.6 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य सीदति तद्राष्ट्रं दुर्भिक्षव्याधितस्करैः..
संभूय स्थापयिष्यामो लिंगमेकं ततः शुभम्.. 36.6 ..
1.4.m: that kingdom of his perishes through famine, diseases, and thieves. / Therefore, uniting together, we shall install a single auspicious liṅga."

1.4.s:
iti kṛtvā matiṃ sarve prāpyānujñāṃ maheśvarāt..
praharṣitā suhaścaiva haribrahmamukhāḥ surāḥ.. 36.7 ..
1.4.d:
इति कृत्वा मतिं सर्वे प्राप्यानुज्ञां महेश्वरात्..
प्रहर्षिता सुहश्चैव हरिब्रह्ममुखाः सुराः.. 36.7 ..
1.4.m: Having thus resolved, all the gods headed by Hari and Brahmā, / having obtained permission from Maheśvara, were deeply delighted and gladdened.

1.4.s:
bhūmibhāgaṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya vijane liṃgamuttamam..
sthāpayāmāsuratha te svayaṃ brahmavinirmitam.. 36.8 ..
1.4.d:
भूमिभागं शुभं वीक्ष्य विजने लिंगमुत्तमम्..
स्थापयामासुरथ ते स्वयं ब्रह्मविनिर्मितम्.. 36.8 ..
1.4.m: Beholding an auspicious plot of land in a secluded place, they then installed / an excellent liṅga fashioned by Brahmā himself.

1.4.s:
siddhārthaiḥ stāpitaṃ yasmā ddevairbrahmādibhiḥ svayam..
siddheśvaramiti prāha nāma liṃgasya vai guhaḥ.. 36.9 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धार्थैः स्तापितं यस्मा द्देवैर्ब्रह्मादिभिः स्वयम्..
सिद्धेश्वरमिति प्राह नाम लिंगस्य वै गुहः.. 36.9 ..
1.4.m: Because it was installed by the gods, Brahmā and the rest, who had attained their purpose, / Guha indeed pronounced the name of the liṅga to be Siddheśvara.

1.4.s:
sarvairdevaistatra liṃge khānitaṃ sara uttamam..
sarvatīrthodakaiḥ śubhraiḥ pūritaṃ ca mahātmabhiḥ.. 36.10 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वैर्देवैस्तत्र लिंगे खानितं सर उत्तमम्..
सर्वतीर्थोदकैः शुभ्रैः पूरितं च महात्मभिः.. 36.10 ..
1.4.m: At that liṅga an excellent lake was excavated by all the gods, / and it was filled with the pure waters of all sacred fords by those great-souled ones.

1.4.s:
etasminnaṃtare pārtha pātālāccheṣanaṃdanaḥ..
kumudonāma āgatya prāha śeṣāhipannagān.. 36.11 ..
1.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे पार्थ पातालाच्छेषनंदनः..
कुमुदोनाम आगत्य प्राह शेषाहिपन्नगान्.. 36.11 ..
1.4.m: In the meantime, O son of Pṛthā, the son of Śeṣa, named Kumuda, / arrived from Pātāla and said to Śeṣa, the serpents, and the pannagas:

1.4.s:
asmiṃstārakayuddhe tu pralaṃbonāma dānavaḥ..
palāyitvā skaṃdabhītyā pāpaḥ pātālamāviśat.. 36.12 ..
1.4.d:
अस्मिंस्तारकयुद्धे तु प्रलंबोनाम दानवः..
पलायित्वा स्कंदभीत्या पापः पातालमाविशत्.. 36.12 ..
1.4.m: "In this battle with Tāraka, a dānava named Pralamba, / fleeing out of fear of Skanda, entered Pātāla, the wicked one.

1.4.s:
sa vo vasūni putrāṃśca bhāryāḥ kanyā gṛhāṇi ca..
vidhvaṃsayati nāgeṃdrāḥ śīghraṃ dhāvatadhāvata.. 36.13 ..
1.4.d:
स वो वसूनि पुत्रांश्च भार्याः कन्या गृहाणि च..
विध्वंसयति नागेंद्राः शीघ्रं धावतधावत.. 36.13 ..
1.4.m: He is destroying your wealth, sons, wives, daughters, and houses, / O lordly serpents! Run quickly, run!"

1.4.s:
śeṣātmajasya tadvākyaṃ kumadasya niśamyate..
autsukyamāpurnāgeṃdrā yāmayāmeti vādinaḥ.. 36.14 ..
1.4.d:
शेषात्मजस्य तद्वाक्यं कुमदस्य निशम्यते..
औत्सुक्यमापुर्नागेंद्रा यामयामेति वादिनः.. 36.14 ..
1.4.m: Hearing that speech of Kumuda, the son of Śeṣa, / the lordly serpents became agitated, crying out, "Let us go! Let us go!"

1.4.s:
tānnivārya tataḥ skaṃdaḥ kruddhaḥ śaktimathādade..
pātālāya mumocātha procya daityo nihanyatām.. 36.15 ..
1.4.d:
तान्निवार्य ततः स्कंदः क्रुद्धः शक्तिमथाददे..
पातालाय मुमोचाथ प्रोच्य दैत्यो निहन्यताम्.. 36.15 ..
1.4.m: Restraining them, Skanda, filled with wrath, then took up his lance / and hurled it toward Pātāla, saying: "Let the daitya be slain!"

1.4.s:
tataḥ skaṃdabhujotsṛṣṭā bhuvaṃ nirbhidya vegataḥ..
praviṣṭā sahasā śaktiryathā daivaṃ naraṃ prati.. 36.16 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स्कंदभुजोत्सृष्टा भुवं निर्भिद्य वेगतः..
प्रविष्टा सहसा शक्तिर्यथा दैवं नरं प्रति.. 36.16 ..
1.4.m: Then, released from Skanda's arm, piercing the earth with great speed, / the lance entered swiftly, just as destiny overtakes a man.

1.4.s:
sā taṃ hatvā pralaṃbaṃ ca koṭibhirdaśabhirvṛtam..
naṃdayitvā gatā nāgāñjalakallopūrvikā.. 36.17 ..
1.4.d:
सा तं हत्वा प्रलंबं च कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतम्..
नंदयित्वा गता नागाञ्जलकल्लोपूर्विका.. 36.17 ..
1.4.m: Having slain that Pralamba and the ten million surrounding him, / and having gladdened the serpents, it returned, preceded by billows of water.

1.4.s:
yāṃtyā śaktyā tayā pārtha yatkṛtaṃ vivaraṃ bhuvi..
pātālagaṃgātoyena pūritaṃ pāpahāriṇā.. 36.18 ..
1.4.d:
यांत्या शक्त्या तया पार्थ यत्कृतं विवरं भुवि..
पातालगंगातोयेन पूरितं पापहारिणा.. 36.18 ..
1.4.m: The cavity made in the earth by that lance as it went, O son of Pṛthā, / was filled with the water of the Pātālagaṅgā, which takes away sin.

1.4.s:
tasya nāma dadau skaṃdaḥ siddhakūpa iti smṛtaḥ..
kṛṣmāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāmupavāsī naraḥ svayam.. 36.19 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य नाम ददौ स्कंदः सिद्धकूप इति स्मृतः..
कृष्माष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यामुपवासी नरः स्वयम्.. 36.19 ..
1.4.m: Skanda gave it a name; it is remembered as Siddhakūpa. / A man who fasts on the eighth or fourteenth day of the dark fortnight,

1.4.s:
snātvā kūpe'rcayedīśaṃ siddheśvaramananyadhīḥ..
prabhūtabhavasaṃbhūtapāpaṃ tasya vilīyate.. 36.20 ..
1.4.d:
स्नात्वा कूपेऽर्चयेदीशं सिद्धेश्वरमनन्यधीः..
प्रभूतभवसंभूतपापं तस्य विलीयते.. 36.20 ..
1.4.m: Bathing in the well, whoever worships the Lord Siddheśvara with undistracted mind, / his abundant sins accumulated through many lives melt away.

1.4.s:
siddhakuṃḍe ca yaḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ..
sarvakalmaṣanirmukto bhaktiyogyo bhavebhave.. 36.21 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धकुंडे च यः स्नात्वा श्राद्धं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः..
सर्वकल्मषनिर्मुक्तो भक्तियोग्यो भवेभवे.. 36.21 ..
1.4.m: And the wise person who, having bathed in the Siddheśvara pool, performs an ancestral offering, / is freed from all impurities and becomes worthy of devotion birth after birth.

1.4.s:
vṛścāpyakṣayastasya tuṣṭo rudro varaṃ dadau..
prayāga vaṭatulyo'yametatsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ.. 36.22 ..
1.4.d:
वृश्चाप्यक्षयस्तस्य तुष्टो रुद्रो वरं ददौ..
प्रयाग वटतुल्योऽयमेतत्सत्यं न संशयः.. 36.22 ..
1.4.m: And the fig tree became imperishable; pleased, Rudra granted a boon: / 'This is equal to the banyan tree of Prayāga; of this there is no doubt.

1.4.s:
atrāgatya mahābhāgaḥ kṣāddhaṃ kuryātsubhaktitaḥ..
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ tacca sarveṣāṃ piṃḍapātanam.. 36.23 ..
1.4.d:
अत्रागत्य महाभागः क्षाद्धं कुर्यात्सुभक्तितः..
पितॄणामक्षयं तच्च सर्वेषां पिंडपातनम्.. 36.23 ..
1.4.m: A fortunate person who comes here and performs a śrāddha with true devotion, / that offering of rice-balls becomes imperishable for all his ancestors.'

1.4.s:
tato brahmādayo devāḥ skaṃdena sahitāstadā..
siddhāṃbikāṃ mahāśaktiṃ prārthayāmāsurīśvarīm.. 36.24 ..
1.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवाः स्कंदेन सहितास्तदा..
सिद्धांबिकां महाशक्तिं प्रार्थयामासुरीश्वरीम्.. 36.24 ..
1.4.m: Then the gods headed by Brahmā, together with Skanda, / prayed to the Great Goddess, the Great Power Siddhāmbikā:

1.4.s:
tvayāviṣṭo hi bhagavānmatsyarūpī janārdanaḥ..
jagaduddhāraṇārthāya cakre karmāmyanekaśaḥ.. 36.25 ..
1.4.d:
त्वयाविष्टो हि भगवान्मत्स्यरूपी जनार्दनः..
जगदुद्धारणार्थाय चक्रे कर्माम्यनेकशः.. 36.25 ..
1.4.m: 'Possessed indeed by you, the Blessed Janārdana took the form of a fish / and performed numerous deeds to save the world.

1.4.s:
iti tāṃ prārthayāmāsuratra tyājyaṃ na te śubhe..
atra sthitāḥ sarva ime kṣetrapālā mahābalāḥ.. 36.26 ..
1.4.d:
इति तां प्रार्थयामासुरत्र त्याज्यं न ते शुभे..
अत्र स्थिताः सर्व इमे क्षेत्रपाला महाबलाः.. 36.26 ..
1.4.m: Thus they petitioned her: 'O auspicious one, you must not abandon this place; / all these exceedingly mighty guardians of the sacred field are stationed here.

1.4.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ balipuṣpaiśca tvāṃ śubhe..
ye pūjayaṃti te pālyāḥ sarvāpatsu ca yā sadā.. 36.27 ..
1.4.d:
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां बलिपुष्पैश्च त्वां शुभे..
ये पूजयंति ते पाल्याः सर्वापत्सु च या सदा.. 36.27 ..
1.4.m: Those who worship you on the eighth or fourteenth lunar day with offerings and flowers, O auspicious one, / are always to be protected by you in all calamities.'

1.4.s:
evamuktā siddhamātā tatheti pratyapadyata..
sthāpayāmāsuratha tāṃ liṃgāduttarabhāgataḥ.. 36.28 ..
1.4.d:
एवमुक्ता सिद्धमाता तथेति प्रत्यपद्यत..
स्थापयामासुरथ तां लिंगादुत्तरभागतः.. 36.28 ..
1.4.m: Addressed thus, the Mother of Accomplishment assented, saying, 'So be it.' / Then they installed her to the north of the liṅga.

1.4.s:
tataḥ kṣetrapatīndevāścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ maheśvaram..
siddheyaṃ nāma kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ nidadhuḥ svayam.. 36.29 ..
1.4.d:
ततः क्षेत्रपतीन्देवाश्चतुःषष्टिं महेश्वरम्..
सिद्धेयं नाम क्षेत्रस्य रक्षार्थं निदधुः स्वयम्.. 36.29 ..
1.4.m: Then the gods themselves installed the sixty-four Lords of the Field / and the Great Lord named Siddheya for the protection of the sacred field:

1.4.s:
tvāṃ ca ye pūjayiṣyaṃti kāryārabheṣu sarvadā..
varṣe varṣe rājamāṣabalinā ca viśeṣataḥ.. 36.30 ..
1.4.d:
त्वां च ये पूजयिष्यंति कार्यारभेषु सर्वदा..
वर्षे वर्षे राजमाषबलिना च विशेषतः.. 36.30 ..
1.4.m: 'And those who will worship you always at the commencement of undertakings, / especially year after year with an offering of royal beans—

1.4.s:
tānasau pālayettuṣṭaḥ pitā lokāniva svakān..
siddhikṛto devāstatra siddhivināyakam.. 36.31 ..
1.4.d:
तानसौ पालयेत्तुष्टः पिता लोकानिव स्वकान्..
सिद्धिकृतो देवास्तत्र सिद्धिविनायकम्.. 36.31 ..
1.4.m: them he shall protect, well-pleased, like a father protects his own children.' / Then the gods, bestowers of accomplishment, there prayed to Siddhivināyaka,

1.4.s:
kaparditanayaṃ prārthya sthāpayācakrire mudā..
taṃ ca ye pūjayaṃtyatra kāryāraṃbheṣu sarvadā.. 36.32 ..
1.4.d:
कपर्दितनयं प्रार्थ्य स्थापयाचक्रिरे मुदा..
तं च ये पूजयंत्यत्र कार्यारंभेषु सर्वदा.. 36.32 ..
1.4.m: the son of the Kapardin (Śiva), and joyfully installed him. / And whoever worships him here at the beginning of undertakings,

1.4.s:
teṣāṃ siddhiṃ dadātyeṣa prabalo vighnarāḍbhavaḥ..
yadyatra pūjayedyastu satataṃ siddhasaptakam.. 36.33 ..
1.4.d:
तेषां सिद्धिं ददात्येष प्रबलो विघ्नराड्भवः..
यद्यत्र पूजयेद्यस्तु सततं सिद्धसप्तकम्.. 36.33 ..
1.4.m: to them this mighty Lord of Obstacles, born of Bhava, grants success. / If anyone always worships the seven sacred accomplished places here,

1.4.s:
paśyedvā smarate vāpi sarvadoṣairvimucyate..
siddheśvaraḥ siddhavaṭaśca sākṣātsiddhāṃbikā siddhavināyakaśca..
siddheyakṣetrādhipatiśca siddhasarastathā siddhakūpaśca sapta.. 36.34 ..
1.4.d:
पश्येद्वा स्मरते वापि सर्वदोषैर्विमुच्यते..
सिद्धेश्वरः सिद्धवटश्च साक्षात्सिद्धांबिका सिद्धविनायकश्च..
सिद्धेयक्षेत्राधिपतिश्च सिद्धसरस्तथा सिद्धकूपश्च सप्त.. 36.34 ..
1.4.m: or sees them or even remembers them, he is freed from all faults: / Siddheśvara, the Siddhavaṭa, Siddhāmbikā in person, Siddhavināyaka, / Siddheya, the Lord of the Field, the lake Siddhasaras, and the well Siddhakūpa—these are the seven.

1.4.s:
atra tuṣṭo dadau rudraḥ surāṇāṃ durlabhānvarān..
vaiśākhamāsasyāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ siddhakūpake.. 36.35 ..
1.4.d:
अत्र तुष्टो ददौ रुद्रः सुराणां दुर्लभान्वरान्..
वैशाखमासस्याष्टम्यां कृष्णायां सिद्धकूपके.. 36.35 ..
1.4.m: Pleased here, Rudra gave boons hard to obtain even for gods: / 'On the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of the month of Vaiśākha, in the Siddhakūpa

1.4.s:
snātvā piṃḍānvaṭe kṛtvā pūjayanmāṃ ca siddhabhāk..
sadā yo'bhyarcayenmāṃ ca brahmacārī jiteṃdriyaḥ.. 36.36 ..
1.4.d:
स्नात्वा पिंडान्वटे कृत्वा पूजयन्मां च सिद्धभाक्..
सदा योऽभ्यर्चयेन्मां च ब्रह्मचारी जितेंद्रियः.. 36.36 ..
1.4.m: having bathed and offered rice-balls at the banyan tree and worshipping me, he attains perfection. / And whoever constantly worships me, celibate and self-controlled,

1.4.s:
aṣṭāviṣṭakarā nityaṃ bhaveyustasya siddhayaḥ..
maṃtrajāpyaṃ baliṃ homamatra yaḥ kurute naraḥ.. 36.37 ..
1.4.d:
अष्टाविष्टकरा नित्यं भवेयुस्तस्य सिद्धयः..
मंत्रजाप्यं बलिं होममत्र यः कुरुते नरः.. 36.37 ..
1.4.m: the eight supernatural perfections will always be in his hand. / A man who performs mantra recitation, offerings, and fire rituals here,

1.4.s:
ekacittaḥ śucirbhūtvā so'bhūṣṭāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt..
samāhitamanāścātha siddheśaṃ yastu paśyati.. 36.38 ..
1.4.d:
एकचित्तः शुचिर्भूत्वा सोऽभूष्टां सिद्धिमाप्नुयात्..
समाहितमनाश्चाथ सिद्धेशं यस्तु पश्यति.. 36.38 ..
1.4.m: becoming purified with focused mind, attains his desired perfection. / And whoever, with composed mind, gazes upon the Lord Siddheśa,

1.4.s:
tasya siddhirbhavatyeva vighnairyadi na hanyate..
siddhāṃbikā mahādevī hyatra saṃnihitāsti yā.. 36.39 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य सिद्धिर्भवत्येव विघ्नैर्यदि न हन्यते..
सिद्धांबिका महादेवी ह्यत्र संनिहितास्ति या.. 36.39 ..
1.4.m: his accomplishment definitely comes about, provided it is not undone by obstacles. / The Great Goddess Siddhāmbikā, who is present here,

1.4.s:
siddhidā sādhakeṃdrāṇāṃ mahāvidyāṃ japaṃti ye..
dhīrebhyo brahmacāribhyaḥ satyacittebhya eva ca.. 36.40 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धिदा साधकेंद्राणां महाविद्यां जपंति ये..
धीरेभ्यो ब्रह्मचारिभ्यः सत्यचित्तेभ्य एव च.. 36.40 ..
1.4.m: bestows perfection on the best of practitioners who chant the Great Mantra, / to the steadfast, to the celibate, and to the true of mind.

1.4.s:
maṃtrajāpyāddadātyeṣā sarvasiddhīryathopsitāḥ..
pātālasya bilaṃ caitadguhaśaktyā kṛtaṃ mahat.. 36.41 ..
1.4.d:
मंत्रजाप्याद्ददात्येषा सर्वसिद्धीर्यथोप्सिताः..
पातालस्य बिलं चैतद्गुहशक्त्या कृतं महत्.. 36.41 ..
1.4.m: From the recitation of mantras she grants all desired accomplishments. / And this great cleft into the netherworld, made by Guha's spear,

1.4.s:
siddhāṃ bikāprasādena vighnakṣetrapayormama..
pratyakṣaṃ bhavitā yatra nānāścaryāṇi bhūriśaḥ.. 36.42 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धां बिकाप्रसादेन विघ्नक्षेत्रपयोर्मम..
प्रत्यक्षं भविता यत्र नानाश्चर्याणि भूरिशः.. 36.42 ..
1.4.m: by the grace of Siddhāmbikā, the remover of obstacles, the guardian of the field, and of me, / will become clearly manifest where many various wonders will occur.

1.4.s:
atra siddhiṃ prayāsyaṃti koṭiśaḥ puruṣāḥ surāḥ..
vidyādharatvaṃ devatvaṃ gaṃdharvatvaṃ ca nāgatā.. 36.43 ..
1.4.d:
अत्र सिद्धिं प्रयास्यंति कोटिशः पुरुषाः सुराः..
विद्याधरत्वं देवत्वं गंधर्वत्वं च नागता.. 36.43 ..
1.4.m: Here, millions of men and gods will attain perfection: / the state of Vidyādharas, the state of gods, the state of Gandharvas, the state of Nāgas,

1.4.s:
yakṣatvaṃ cāmaratvaṃ ca prāpsyaṃtyatra ca sādhakāḥ..
atra vai vijayonāma sthaṃḍilasya prabhāvataḥ.. 36.44 ..
1.4.d:
यक्षत्वं चामरत्वं च प्राप्स्यंत्यत्र च साधकाः..
अत्र वै विजयोनाम स्थंडिलस्य प्रभावतः.. 36.44 ..
1.4.m: and practitioners will attain the state of Yakṣas and immortality here. / Indeed, here by the name of Vijaya, through the power of this sacred altar,

1.4.s:
siddhāṃbikāṃ samārādhya siddhimāpsyati durlabhām..
yo māṃ drakṣyati cātrasthaṃ yaśca māṃ pūjayiṣyati..
vādapracārato vāpi puṇyāvāptirbhaviṣyati.. 36.45 ..
1.4.d:
सिद्धांबिकां समाराध्य सिद्धिमाप्स्यति दुर्लभाम्..
यो मां द्रक्ष्यति चात्रस्थं यश्च मां पूजयिष्यति..
वादप्रचारतो वापि पुण्यावाप्तिर्भविष्यति.. 36.45 ..
1.4.m: having propitiated Siddhāmbikā, one will obtain hard-to-attain perfection. / And whoever sees me residing here, and whoever worships me, / even by spreading discourse about this, the attainment of merit will take place.'

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tryaṃbakeṇa vareṣvevaṃ datteṣvapi surottamāḥ.. 36.46 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
त्र्यंबकेण वरेष्वेवं दत्तेष्वपि सुरोत्तमाः.. 36.46 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / When the boons had thus been granted by Tryambaka, the best of the gods,

1.4.s:
prahṛṣṭāḥ samapadyaṃta gāthāṃ cemāṃ jagustadā..
tena yajñairjapaiḥstotraistapo bhistoṣitā vayam.. 36.47 ..
1.4.d:
प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यंत गाथां चेमां जगुस्तदा..
तेन यज्ञैर्जपैःस्तोत्रैस्तपो भिस्तोषिता वयम्.. 36.47 ..
1.4.m: filled with joy, then sang this song: / 'By him, by sacrifices, recitations, hymns of praise, and austerities, we are pleased.

1.4.s:
sarve devāḥ siddhiliṃgaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayiṣyati..
sarvakāmaphalāvāptirityevaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt.. 36.48 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वे देवाः सिद्धिलिंगं यो नरः पूजयिष्यति..
सर्वकामफलावाप्तिरित्येवं शंकरोऽब्रवीत्.. 36.48 ..
1.4.m: Whatever person worships the Siddhaliṅga, / will obtain the fruit of all desires'—thus Śaṅkara declared.

1.4.s:
ityuktvā te jayaṃ prāptāḥ skaṃdena sahitāḥ surāḥ..
kārāyyaṃ ramyaprāsādānramyaistārakasaṃbhavaiḥ.. 36.49 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा ते जयं प्राप्ताः स्कंदेन सहिताः सुराः..
काराय्यं रम्यप्रासादान्रम्यैस्तारकसंभवैः.. 36.49 ..
1.4.m: Having spoken thus, the gods, having attained victory together with Skanda, / had delightful palaces built with the delightful spoils taken from Tāraka;

1.4.s:
caturvargaphalāvāptiṃ dattvā kṣetrasya saṃyayuḥ..
kecitskaṃdaṃ praśaṃsaṃtastīrthamanye hariṃ pare.. 36.50 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्वर्गफलावाप्तिं दत्त्वा क्षेत्रस्य संययुः..
केचित्स्कंदं प्रशंसंतस्तीर्थमन्ये हरिं परे.. 36.50 ..
1.4.m: having bestowed the attainment of the fruits of the four aims of life upon the sacred field, they departed. / Some departed praising Skanda, others the sacred ford, and others Hari;

1.4.s:
kecilliṃgāni paṃcāpi yuddhaṃ keciddivaṃ yayuḥ..
tatoṃ'tarikṣe cāliṃgya mahāsenaṃ haro'bravīt.. 36.51 ..
1.4.d:
केचिल्लिंगानि पंचापि युद्धं केचिद्दिवं ययुः..
ततोंऽतरिक्षे चालिंग्य महासेनं हरोऽब्रवीत्.. 36.51 ..
1.4.m: some praising the five liṅgas, some the battle, they went to heaven. / Then Hara embraced Mahāsena in the sky and said:

1.4.s:
saptame mārutaskaṃdhe va sa nityaṃ priyātmaja..
kāryeṣvahaṃ tvayā putra saṃpraṣṭavyaḥ sadaiva hi.. 36.52 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तमे मारुतस्कंधे व स नित्यं प्रियात्मज..
कार्येष्वहं त्वया पुत्र संप्रष्टव्यः सदैव हि.. 36.52 ..
1.4.m: 'Dwell always in the seventh wind-course, beloved son! / In your tasks, my son, you must always consult me.

1.4.s:
darśanānmama bhaktyā ca śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi..
staṃbhatīrthe ca vatsye'haṃ na vimokṣyāmi karhicit.. 36.53 ..
1.4.d:
दर्शनान्मम भक्त्या च श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यसि..
स्तंभतीर्थे च वत्स्येऽहं न विमोक्ष्यामि कर्हिचित्.. 36.53 ..
1.4.m: From seeing me and through devotion, you will attain supreme good. / And I shall dwell at Stambhatīrtha; I will never leave it.'

1.4.s:
ityuktvā visasarjainaṃ pariṣvajya maheśvaraḥ..
brahmaviṣṇumukhāṃścaiva bhaktyā tairabhinaṃditaḥ.. 36.54 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा विससर्जैनं परिष्वज्य महेश्वरः..
ब्रह्मविष्णुमुखांश्चैव भक्त्या तैरभिनंदितः.. 36.54 ..
1.4.m: Having said this, embracing him, the Great Lord dismissed him, / as well as the gods headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, being praised by them with devotion.

1.4.s:
visarjitāḥ surājagmuḥ svānisvānyālayāni ca..
śarvo jagāma kailāsaṃ skaṃdhaṃ vai saptamaṃ guhaḥ.. 36.55 ..
1.4.d:
विसर्जिताः सुराजग्मुः स्वानिस्वान्यालयानि च..
शर्वो जगाम कैलासं स्कंधं वै सप्तमं गुहः.. 36.55 ..
1.4.m: Dismissed, the gods went to their respective abodes. / Śarva went to Kailāsa, and Guha went to the seventh wind-course.

1.4.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ pārtha liṃgapaṃcakasaṃbhavam..
yaḥ paṭhetskaṃdasaṃbaddhāṃ kathāṃ martyo mahāmatiḥ.. 36.56 ..
1.4.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं पार्थ लिंगपंचकसंभवम्..
यः पठेत्स्कंदसंबद्धां कथां मर्त्यो महामतिः.. 36.56 ..
1.4.m: Thus this origin of the five liṅgas has been told, O Pārtha. / Whatever wise mortal reads this narrative connected with Skanda,

1.4.s:
śrṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi sa bhavetkīrtimānnaraḥ..
bahvāyuḥ subhagaḥ śrīmānkāṃtimāñchubhadarśanaḥ.. 36.57 ..
1.4.d:
श्रृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्वापि स भवेत्कीर्तिमान्नरः..
बह्वायुः सुभगः श्रीमान्कांतिमाञ्छुभदर्शनः.. 36.57 ..
1.4.m: or hears it, or causes it to be heard, that man will become renowned, / long-lived, fortunate, prosperous, radiant, and fair to behold,

1.4.s:
bhūtebhyo nirbhayaścāpi sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ..
śucirbhūtvā pumānyaśca kumāreśvarasannidhau.. 36.58 ..
1.4.d:
भूतेभ्यो निर्भयश्चापि सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः..
शुचिर्भूत्वा पुमान्यश्च कुमारेश्वरसन्निधौ.. 36.58 ..
1.4.m: fearless of evil spirits, and free from all sorrows. / And whatever man, having become pure in the presence of Kumāreśvara,

1.4.s:
śrṛṇuyātskaṃdacaritaṃ mahādhanapatirbhavet..
bālānāṃ vyādhiduṣṭānāṃ rājadvāropasevinām.. 36.59 ..
1.4.d:
श्रृणुयात्स्कंदचरितं महाधनपतिर्भवेत्..
बालानां व्याधिदुष्टानां राजद्वारोपसेविनाम्.. 36.59 ..
1.4.m: hears the deeds of Skanda, will become a lord of great wealth. / For children, for those afflicted by disease, and for those who serve at the king's gate,

1.4.s:
idaṃ tatparamaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvadoṣaharaṃ sadā..
tanukṣaye ca sāyujyaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya vrajennaraḥ.. 36.60 ..
1.4.d:
इदं तत्परमं धन्यं सर्वदोषहरं सदा..
तनुक्षये च सायुज्यं षण्मुखस्य व्रजेन्नरः.. 36.60 ..
1.4.m: this is supremely auspicious, constantly removing all defects. / And at the destruction of his body, a man will attain union with the Six-faced One.

1.4.s:
varamenaṃ dadurdevāḥ skaṃdasyātha gatā divam.. 36.61 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe paṃcaliṃgopākhyānasamāptivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭ‌triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 36 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
वरमेनं ददुर्देवाः स्कंदस्याथ गता दिवम्.. 36.61 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे पंचलिंगोपाख्यानसमाप्तिवर्णनंनाम षट्‌त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 36 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Then the gods, having granted this boon to Skanda, departed to heaven.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named "The Description of the Conclusion of the Story of the Five Liṅgas," in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.4.s:
..śrīnārada uvāca..
barbarītīrthamāhātmyamatho vakṣyāmi te'rjuna..
yathā barbarikā jātā śataśrṛṃgā nṛpātmajā.. 37.1 ..
1.4.d:
..श्रीनारद उवाच..
बर्बरीतीर्थमाहात्म्यमथो वक्ष्यामि तेऽर्जुन..
यथा बर्बरिका जाता शतश्रृंगा नृपात्मजा.. 37.1 ..
1.4.m: Glorious Nārada said: / Now I shall tell you, O Arjuna, the māhātmya of Barbarītīrtha, / [and] how Barbarikā, the king's daughter [ruling] Śataśṛṅga, was born, 37.1

1.4.s:
kumāriketi vikhyātā tasyā nāmnā prakathyate..
idaṃ kaumārikākhaṃḍaṃ caturvargaphalapradam.. 37.2 ..
1.4.d:
कुमारिकेति विख्याता तस्या नाम्ना प्रकथ्यते..
इदं कौमारिकाखंडं चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदम्.. 37.2 ..
1.4.m: renowned as Kumārikā. By her name, / this Kaumārikākhaṇḍa is proclaimed, which bestows the fruit of the four goals of life; 37.2

1.4.s:
yayā kṛtā pṛthivyāṃ ca nānāgrāmādikalpanā..
idaṃ bharatakhaṃḍaṃ ca yayā samyakprakalpitam.. 37.3 ..
1.4.d:
यया कृता पृथिव्यां च नानाग्रामादिकल्पना..
इदं भरतखंडं च यया सम्यक्प्रकल्पितम्.. 37.3 ..
1.4.m: by whom was made the division of various villages and the like on the earth, / and by whom this Bhāratakhaṇḍa was properly arranged. 37.3

1.4.s:
..dhanaṃjaya uvāca..
mahadetanmamāścaryaṃ śrotavyaṃ paramaṃ mune..
kumārīcaritaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi mahyaṃ savistaram.. 37.4 ..
1.4.d:
..धनंजय उवाच..
महदेतन्ममाश्चर्यं श्रोतव्यं परमं मुने..
कुमारीचरितं सर्वं ब्रूहि मह्यं सविस्तरम्.. 37.4 ..
1.4.m: Dhanañjaya said: / This is a great wonder of mine, supreme to be heard, O sage! / Tell me in full detail the entire life of Kumārī: 37.4

1.4.s:
kathaṃ viśvamidaṃ jātaṃ karmajātiprakalpitam..
kathaṃ vā bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ śuśrūṣeya sadā mama.. 37.5 ..
1.4.d:
कथं विश्वमिदं जातं कर्मजातिप्रकल्पितम्..
कथं वा भारतं खंडं शुश्रूषेय सदा मम.. 37.5 ..
1.4.m: How was this universe born, arranged by actions and classes? / Or how [was] the Bhārata section [divided]? Such is ever my desire to hear. 37.5

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
avyakto'sminnirāloke pradhānapuruṣāvubhau..
ajau samāgatāvekau kevalaṃ śrṛṇumo vayam.. 37.6 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
अव्यक्तोऽस्मिन्निरालोके प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ..
अजौ समागतावेकौ केवलं श्रृणुमो वयम्.. 37.6 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / In this unmanifest [state], devoid of light, both the Pradhāna and the Puruṣa, / unborn, came together as one; [this] only do we hear. 37.6

1.4.s:
tataḥ svabhāvakālābhyāṃ svarūpābhyāṃ samīritam..
īkṣaṇenaiva prakṛtermahattattvamajāyata.. 37.7 ..
1.4.d:
ततः स्वभावकालाभ्यां स्वरूपाभ्यां समीरितम्..
ईक्षणेनैव प्रकृतेर्महत्तत्त्वमजायत.. 37.7 ..
1.4.m: Then, impelled by innate nature and time, through their own natures, / the principle of Mahat was born merely by the glance upon Prakṛti. 37.7

1.4.s:
mahattattvādvikurvāṇādahaṃtattvaṃ vyajāyata..
tridhā tanmunibhiḥ proktaṃ sattvarāsatāmasam.. 37.8 ..
1.4.d:
महत्तत्त्वाद्विकुर्वाणादहंतत्त्वं व्यजायत..
त्रिधा तन्मुनिभिः प्रोक्तं सत्त्वरासतामसम्.. 37.8 ..
1.4.m: From the modifying principle of Mahat, the principle of Ahaṃkāra was born. / That is declared threefold by sages: sāttvika, rājasa, and tāmasa. 37.8

1.4.s:
tāmasātpaṃca jātāni tanmātrāṇi vudurbudhāḥ..
tanmātrebhyaśca bhūtāni veśeṣāḥ paṃca tadbhavāḥ.. 37.9 ..
1.4.d:
तामसात्पंच जातानि तन्मात्राणि वुदुर्बुधाः..
तन्मात्रेभ्यश्च भूतानि वेशेषाः पंच तद्भवाः.. 37.9 ..
1.4.m: From the tāmasa, the five subtle elements were born, as the wise know; / and from the subtle elements, the gross elements, the five specific [principles] that arose from them. 37.9

1.4.s:
sāttvikāccāpyahaṃkārādvidvi karmedriyāṇi ca..
ekādaśaṃ manaścaiva rājasaṃ ca dvayorviduḥ.. 37.10 ..
1.4.d:
सात्त्विकाच्चाप्यहंकाराद्विद्वि कर्मेद्रियाणि च..
एकादशं मनश्चैव राजसं च द्वयोर्विदुः.. 37.10 ..
1.4.m: And from the sāttvika Ahaṃkāra, know the organs of action and [sense], / and the mind as the eleventh; and they know the rājasa to belong to both. 37.10

1.4.s:
caturviśatitattvāni jātānīti purā viduḥ..
sadāśivena vai puṃsā tāni dṛṣṭāni bhārata.. 37.11 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्विशतितत्त्वानि जातानीति पुरा विदुः..
सदाशिवेन वै पुंसा तानि दृष्टानि भारत.. 37.11 ..
1.4.m: The wise know that twenty-four principles were thus born in ancient times. / They were indeed beheld by the person Sadāśiva, O descendant of Bharata. 37.11

1.4.s:
bud‌budākāratāṃ jagmuraṃḍaṃ jātaṃ tataḥ śubham..
śakatoṭipramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍamidamucyate.. 37.12 ..
1.4.d:
बुद्‌बुदाकारतां जग्मुरंडं जातं ततः शुभम्..
शकतोटिप्रमाणं च ब्रह्मांडमिदमुच्यते.. 37.12 ..
1.4.m: They assumed the shape of a bubble; then the auspicious egg was born. / And this cosmic egg of Brahmā is said to measure one hundred million [yojanas]. 37.12

1.4.s:
ātmāsya kathito brahmā vyabhajatsa tridhā tvidam..
ūrdhvaṃ tatra sthitā devā madhye caiva ca mānavāḥ.. 37.13 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मास्य कथितो ब्रह्मा व्यभजत्स त्रिधा त्विदम्..
ऊर्ध्वं तत्र स्थिता देवा मध्ये चैव च मानवाः.. 37.13 ..
1.4.m: Brahmā is declared its self; he divided this into three: / the gods reside in the upper realm, and humans in the middle, 37.13

1.4.s:
nāgā daityāśca pātāle tridhaitatparikalpitam..
aikaikaṃ saptadhābhūya tatastena prakalpitam.. 37.14 ..
1.4.d:
नागा दैत्याश्च पाताले त्रिधैतत्परिकल्पितम्..
ऐकैकं सप्तधाभूय ततस्तेन प्रकल्पितम्.. 37.14 ..
1.4.m: and the Nāgas and Daityas in Pātāla—thus it was designed threefold. / Then, each one becoming sevenfold, was arranged by him: 37.14

1.4.s:
pātālāni ca dvīpāni svarlokāḥ saptasapta ca..
sapta dvīpāni vakṣyāmi śrṛṇu teṣāṃ prakalpanām.. 37.15 ..
1.4.d:
पातालानि च द्वीपानि स्वर्लोकाः सप्तसप्त च..
सप्त द्वीपानि वक्ष्यामि श्रृणु तेषां प्रकल्पनाम्.. 37.15 ..
1.4.m: seven subterranean realms, seven continents, and seven celestial worlds. / I will tell of the seven continents; hear their arrangement. 37.15

1.4.s:
lakṣayojanavistāraṃ jaṃbūdvīpaṃ prakīrtyate..
sūryabiṃbasamākāraṃ tāvatkṣārārṇavāvṛtam.. 37.16 ..
1.4.d:
लक्षयोजनविस्तारं जंबूद्वीपं प्रकीर्त्यते..
सूर्यबिंबसमाकारं तावत्क्षारार्णवावृतम्.. 37.16 ..
1.4.m: Jambūdvīpa is proclaimed to have an extent of one hundred thousand yojanas, / resembling the disc of the sun in shape, surrounded by a salt ocean of the same extent. 37.16

1.4.s:
śākadvīpaṃ dviguṇato jaṃbūdvīpāttataḥ param..
tāvatā kṣīratoyena samudreṇa parīvṛtam.. 37.17 ..
1.4.d:
शाकद्वीपं द्विगुणतो जंबूद्वीपात्ततः परम्..
तावता क्षीरतोयेन समुद्रेण परीवृतम्.. 37.17 ..
1.4.m: Beyond that is Śākadvīpa, twice the size of Jambūdvīpa, / encircled by an ocean of milk-water of equal size. 37.17

1.4.s:
surātoyena daityānāṃ mohakāryarṇavena hi..
puṣkaraṃ tu tato dvīpaṃ dviguṇaṃ tāvatā vṛtam.. 37.18 ..
1.4.d:
सुरातोयेन दैत्यानां मोहकार्यर्णवेन हि..
पुष्करं तु ततो द्वीपं द्विगुणं तावता वृतम्.. 37.18 ..
1.4.m: [Encircled] by an ocean of wine-water that causes delusion to the Daityas, / next is Puṣkaradvīpa, twice [that size], surrounded by [an ocean] of equal measure. 37.18

1.4.s:
kuśadvīpaṃ dviguṇatastatastatparataḥ smṛtam..
dadhitoyena paritastāvadarṇavasaṃvṛtam.. 37.19 ..
1.4.d:
कुशद्वीपं द्विगुणतस्ततस्तत्परतः स्मृतम्..
दधितोयेन परितस्तावदर्णवसंवृतम्.. 37.19 ..
1.4.m: Beyond that, Kuśadvīpa is known to be twice [its size], / surrounded all around by an ocean of curd-water of equal size. 37.19

1.4.s:
tataḥ paraṃ krauñcasaṃjñaṃ dviguṇaṃ hi ghṛtābdhinā..
tataḥ śālmalidvīpaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ tāvataiva ca.. 37.20 ..
1.4.d:
ततः परं क्रौञ्चसंज्ञं द्विगुणं हि घृताब्धिना..
ततः शाल्मलिद्वीपं च द्विगुणं तावतैव च.. 37.20 ..
1.4.m: Beyond that is the one named Krauñca, twice [that size], by an ocean of clarified butter; / next is Śālmalidvīpa, twice [that size], likewise by [an ocean] of equal measure, 37.20

1.4.s:
ikṣusārasvarūpeṇa samudreṇa parivṛtam..
gomedaṃ tasya parito dviguṇaṃ tāvatā vṛtam.. 37.21 ..
1.4.d:
इक्षुसारस्वरूपेण समुद्रेण परिवृतम्..
गोमेदं तस्य परितो द्विगुणं तावता वृतम्.. 37.21 ..
1.4.m: surrounded by an ocean consisting of sugarcane juice. / Around it is Gomeda, twice [that size], surrounded by [an ocean] of equal measure, 37.21

1.4.s:
svādutoyena ramyeṇa samudreṇa samaṃtataḥ..
evaṃ koṭidvayaṃ pārtha lakṣapaṃcāśatatrayam.. 37.22 ..
1.4.d:
स्वादुतोयेन रम्येण समुद्रेण समंततः..
एवं कोटिद्वयं पार्थ लक्षपंचाशतत्रयम्.. 37.22 ..
1.4.m: all around by a delightful ocean of sweet water. / Thus, O son of Pṛthā, twenty-three million, / 37.22

1.4.s:
paṃcāśacca sahasrāṇi saptadvīpāḥ sasāgarāḥ..
daśottarāṇi paṃcaiva aṃgulānāṃ śatāni ca.. 37.23 ..
1.4.d:
पंचाशच्च सहस्राणि सप्तद्वीपाः ससागराः..
दशोत्तराणि पंचैव अंगुलानां शतानि च.. 37.23 ..
1.4.m: and fifty thousand [yojanas] are the seven continents together with the oceans. / Five hundred and ten aṅgulas 37.23

1.4.s:
apāṃ vṛddhikṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ..
tato hemamayī bhūmirdaśakoṭyaḥ kurūdvaha.. 37.24 ..
1.4.d:
अपां वृद्धिक्षयो दृष्टः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः..
ततो हेममयी भूमिर्दशकोट्यः कुरूद्वह.. 37.24 ..
1.4.m: is the increase and decrease of water observed during the bright and dark fortnights. / Beyond that is the golden land of one hundred million [yojanas], O bearer of the Kuru line, 37.24

1.4.s:
devānāṃ krīḍanasthānaṃ lokālokastataḥ param..
parvato valayākāro yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ.. 37.25 ..
1.4.d:
देवानां क्रीडनस्थानं लोकालोकस्ततः परम्..
पर्वतो वलयाकारो योजनायुतविस्तृतः.. 37.25 ..
