1.4.s:
īśāne barkareśasya kūpo'bhūtsvastikābhidhaḥ..
pūrito gaṃgayā pārthasarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ.. 39.100 ..
1.4.d:
ईशाने बर्करेशस्य कूपोऽभूत्स्वस्तिकाभिधः..
पूरितो गंगया पार्थसर्वतीर्थफलप्रदः.. 39.100 ..
1.4.m: northeast of Barkareśa, a well named Svastika came to be, / filled with Gaṅgā water, O Pārtha, granting the fruit of all sacred fords.

1.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā ca sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ śivastuṣṭo varaṃ dadau..
yeṣāṃ mṛtaśarīrāṇāmatra dāhaḥ prajāyate.. 39.101 ..
1.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा च स्थापितं लिंगं शिवस्तुष्टो वरं ददौ..
येषां मृतशरीराणामत्र दाहः प्रजायते.. 39.101 ..
1.4.m: Beholding the liṅga installed, Śiva was pleased and granted a boon: / “Those whose dead bodies are cremated here,

1.4.s:
kṣipyaṃtebdhau tathā sthīni teṣāṃ syādakṣayā gatiḥ..
te svarge suciraṃ kālaṃ vasitvātra samāgatāḥ.. 39.102 ..
1.4.d:
क्षिप्यंतेब्धौ तथा स्थीनि तेषां स्यादक्षया गतिः..
ते स्वर्गे सुचिरं कालं वसित्वात्र समागताः.. 39.102 ..
1.4.m: and whose bones are likewise cast into the ocean, shall attain an imperishable state. / Having dwelled in heaven for a very long time and returning here,

1.4.s:
rājānaḥ sarvasaṃpūrṇāḥ sapratāpā bhavaṃti te..
barkareśaṃ ca yo bhaktyā saṃpūjayati mānavaḥ.. 39.103 ..
1.4.d:
राजानः सर्वसंपूर्णाः सप्रतापा भवंति ते..
बर्करेशं च यो भक्त्या संपूजयति मानवः.. 39.103 ..
1.4.m: they become glorious kings, complete with all prosperity. / And whatever mortal worships Barkareśa with devotion,

1.4.s:
snātvārṇavamahītoye tasya syānmanasepsitam..
kārtike ca caturddeśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ.. 39.104 ..
1.4.d:
स्नात्वार्णवमहीतोये तस्य स्यान्मनसेप्सितम्..
कार्तिके च चतुर्द्देश्यां कृष्णायां श्रद्धयान्वितः.. 39.104 ..
1.4.m: after bathing in the water of the ocean and the Mahī, shall obtain his heart's desire. / Endowed with faith on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in Kārttika,

1.4.s:
kūpe snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā saṃtarpya ca pitṝnnijān..
pūjayedbarkareśaṃ yaḥ sarpapāpaiḥ sa mucyate.. 39.105 ..
1.4.d:
कूपे स्नानं नरः कृत्वा संतर्प्य च पितॄन्निजान्..
पूजयेद्बर्करेशं यः सर्पपापैः स मुच्यते.. 39.105 ..
1.4.m: a man who bathes in the well, offers oblations to his ancestors, / and worships Barkareśa is freed from sins associated with serpents.”

1.4.s:
evaṃ labdhvā varānsarvānsā punaḥ siṃhalaṃ yayau..
śataśrṛṅgāya pitre ca vṛttāṃtaṃ svaṃ nyavedayat.. 39.106 ..
1.4.d:
एवं लब्ध्वा वरान्सर्वान्सा पुनः सिंहलं ययौ..
शतश्रृङ्गाय पित्रे च वृत्तांतं स्वं न्यवेदयत्.. 39.106 ..
1.4.m: Having obtained all these boons in this manner, she returned again to Siṃhala / and related her history to her father, Śataśṛṅga.

1.4.s:
tacchrutvā vismito rājā lokāḥ sarve ca phālguna..
praśaśaṃsurmahītīrthamājagmuśca kṛtādarāḥ.. 39.107 ..
1.4.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मितो राजा लोकाः सर्वे च फाल्गुन..
प्रशशंसुर्महीतीर्थमाजग्मुश्च कृतादराः.. 39.107 ..
1.4.m: Hearing that, the king and all the people, O Phālguna, / were astonished, praised the Mahītīrtha, and went there with deep devotion.

1.4.s:
snātvā dattvā ca dānāni vividhāni ca te tataḥ..
siṃhalaṃ ca yayurbhūyastīrthamāhātmyaharṣitāḥ.. 39.108 ..
1.4.d:
स्नात्वा दत्त्वा च दानानि विविधानि च ते ततः..
सिंहलं च ययुर्भूयस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यहर्षिताः.. 39.108 ..
1.4.m: Having bathed and given various gifts, they then / returned once more to Siṃhala, delighted by the greatness of the sacred ford.

1.4.s:
anicchaṃtyāṃ kumāryāṃ ca varaṃ dravyaṃ ca pārthivaḥ..
tathānyadapi prītyāsau yaddadau nṛpatiḥ śrṛṇu.. 39.109 ..
1.4.d:
अनिच्छंत्यां कुमार्यां च वरं द्रव्यं च पार्थिवः..
तथान्यदपि प्रीत्यासौ यद्ददौ नृपतिः श्रृणु.. 39.109 ..
1.4.m: When the maiden did not desire a boon and wealth, listen, O king, / to what else the king then gave out of affection:

1.4.s:
idaṃ bhāratakhaṃḍaṃ ca navadhaiva vibhajya saḥ..
dadāvaṣṭau svaputrāṇāṃ kumāryai navamaṃ tathā.. 39.110 ..
1.4.d:
इदं भारतखंडं च नवधैव विभज्य सः..
ददावष्टौ स्वपुत्राणां कुमार्यै नवमं तथा.. 39.110 ..
1.4.m: Dividing this Bhāratakhaṇḍa into nine parts, / he gave eight to his sons, and likewise the ninth to the maiden.

1.4.s:
teṣāṃ vibhedānvakṣyāmi parvatairupaśobhitān..
putranāmāni varṣāṇi parvatāṃśca śrṛṇuṣva me.. 39.111 ..
1.4.d:
तेषां विभेदान्वक्ष्यामि पर्वतैरुपशोभितान्..
पुत्रनामानि वर्षाणि पर्वतांश्च श्रृणुष्व मे.. 39.111 ..
1.4.m: I shall describe their divisions adorned with mountains; / listen from me to the realms named after the sons and to the mountains.

1.4.s:
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ..
viṃdhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ.. 39.112 ..
1.4.d:
महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमानृक्षपर्वतः..
विंध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तात्र कुलपर्वताः.. 39.112 ..
1.4.m: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimat, the Ṛkṣa mountain, / Vindhya, and Pāriyātra: these are the seven family-mountains here.

1.4.s:
mahendraparataścaiva indradvīpo nigadyate..
pāriyātrasya caivārvākkhaṇḍaṃ kaumārikaṃ smṛtam.. 39.113 ..
1.4.d:
महेन्द्रपरतश्चैव इन्द्रद्वीपो निगद्यते..
पारियात्रस्य चैवार्वाक्खण्डं कौमारिकं स्मृतम्.. 39.113 ..
1.4.m: Beyond Mahendra, Indradvīpa is spoken of; / and this side of Pāriyātra, the Kaumārīka section is remembered.

1.4.s:
sahasramekamekaṃ ca sarvakhaṇḍānyamūni ca..
nadīnāṃ saṃbhavaṃ cāpi saṃkṣepācchṛṇu phālguna.. 39.114 ..
1.4.d:
सहस्रमेकमेकं च सर्वखण्डान्यमूनि च..
नदीनां संभवं चापि संक्षेपाच्छृणु फाल्गुन.. 39.114 ..
1.4.m: All these sections measure one thousand [yojanas] each. / Hear also in brief, O Phālguna, the origin of the rivers:

1.4.s:
vedasmṛtimukhā nadyaḥ pāriyātrodbhavā matāḥ..
narmadāsarasādyāśca nadyo viṃdhyādvinirgatāḥ.. 39.115 ..
1.4.d:
वेदस्मृतिमुखा नद्यः पारियात्रोद्भवा मताः..
नर्मदासरसाद्याश्च नद्यो विंध्याद्विनिर्गताः.. 39.115 ..
1.4.m: The rivers headed by Vedasmṛti are considered to arise from Pāriyātra; / the rivers beginning with Narmadā and Sarasā have come forth from the Vindhya;

1.4.s:
śatadrūcandrabhāgādyā ṛkṣaparvatasaṃbhavāḥ..
ṛṣikulyākumāryādyāḥ śuktimatpādasaṃbhavāḥ.. 39.116 ..
1.4.d:
शतद्रूचन्द्रभागाद्या ऋक्षपर्वतसंभवाः..
ऋषिकुल्याकुमार्याद्याः शुक्तिमत्पादसंभवाः.. 39.116 ..
1.4.m: those beginning with Śatadrū and Candrabhāgā arise from the Ṛkṣa mountain; / those beginning with Ṛṣikulyā and Kumārī arise from the foothills of Śuktimat;

1.4.s:
tāpī payoṣṇī nirvidhyā kāverī ca mahīnadī..
kṛṣṇā veṇī bhīmarathī sahyapādodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ.. 39.117 ..
1.4.d:
तापी पयोष्णी निर्विध्या कावेरी च महीनदी..
कृष्णा वेणी भीमरथी सह्यपादोद्भवाः स्मृताः.. 39.117 ..
1.4.m: Tāpī, Payoṣṇī, Nirvindhyā, Kāverī, and the Mahī river, / Kṛṣṇā, Veṇī, and Bhīmarathī are remembered as originating at the foothills of the Sahya;

1.4.s:
kṛtamālātāmraparṇīpramukhā malayodbhavāḥ..
trisāmaṛṣyakulyādyā mahendraprabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ.. 39.118 ..
1.4.d:
कृतमालाताम्रपर्णीप्रमुखा मलयोद्भवाः..
त्रिसामऋष्यकुल्याद्या महेन्द्रप्रभवाः स्मृताः.. 39.118 ..
1.4.m: those headed by Kṛtamālā and Tāmraparṇī arise from Malaya; / those beginning with Trisāmā and Ṛṣyakulyā are remembered as originating from Mahendra.

1.4.s:
evaṃ vibhajya putrebhyaḥ kumāryai ca mahīpatiḥ..
śataśṛṃgo giraṃ gatvā udīcyāṃ taptavāṃstapaḥ.. 39.119 ..
1.4.d:
एवं विभज्य पुत्रेभ्यः कुमार्यै च महीपतिः..
शतशृंगो गिरं गत्वा उदीच्यां तप्तवांस्तपः.. 39.119 ..
1.4.m: Having thus distributed [the realms] to his sons and to the maiden, the lord of the earth, / Śataśṛṅga, went to the mountain in the north and performed austerity.

1.4.s:
tatra taptvā tapo ghoraṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ..
śataśrṛṃgo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ śataśrṛṃge nagottame.. 39.120 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र तप्त्वा तपो घोरं ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम सः..
शतश्रृंगो नृपश्रेष्ठः शतश्रृंगे नगोत्तमे.. 39.120 ..
1.4.m: Having performed fierce austerity there, on the best of mountains, Śataśṛṅga, / that best of kings, Śataśṛṅga, went to the world of Brahmā—

1.4.s:
yatra jāto'si kauteya pāṃḍostvaṃ sodaraiḥ saha..
kumārī ca mahābhāgā staṃbhatīrthasthitā satī.. 39.121 ..
1.4.d:
यत्र जातोऽसि कौतेय पांडोस्त्वं सोदरैः सह..
कुमारी च महाभागा स्तंभतीर्थस्थिता सती.. 39.121 ..
1.4.m: where you were born, O son of Kuntī, of Pāṇḍu together with your brothers. / And the noble maiden, the virtuous woman residing at Stambhatīrtha,

1.4.s:
khaṃḍodbhavena dravyeṇa tepe dānāni yacchatī..
tataḥ kenāpi kālena bhrātṛbhyo'ṣṭabhya eva ca.. 39.122 ..
1.4.d:
खंडोद्भवेन द्रव्येण तेपे दानानि यच्छती..
ततः केनापि कालेन भ्रातृभ्योऽष्टभ्य एव च.. 39.122 ..
1.4.m: performed austerity giving gifts with the wealth produced from her section. / Then, in the course of time, from the eight brothers

1.4.s:
mahāvīryabalotsāhā jātā nava navātmajāḥ..
te sametya samāgamya kumārīṃ procire tataḥ.. 39.123 ..
1.4.d:
महावीर्यबलोत्साहा जाता नव नवात्मजाः..
ते समेत्य समागम्य कुमारीं प्रोचिरे ततः.. 39.123 ..
1.4.m: nine sons each were born, possessing great prowess, strength, and vigour. / Gathering together, they approached the maiden and said:

1.4.s:
kuladevī tvamasmākaṃ prasādaṃ kuru naḥ śubhe..
aṣṭau khaṇḍāni cāsmākaṃ vibhajya svayameva ca..
dehī dvāsaptatīnāṃ no vibhedaḥ syādyathā na naḥ.. 39.124 ..
1.4.d:
कुलदेवी त्वमस्माकं प्रसादं कुरु नः शुभे..
अष्टौ खण्डानि चास्माकं विभज्य स्वयमेव च..
देही द्वासप्ततीनां नो विभेदः स्याद्यथा न नः.. 39.124 ..
1.4.m: “You are our family goddess; show us favour, O auspicious one. / Divide our eight sections yourself / and give them to us seventy-two, so that there will be no division among us.”

1.4.s:
ityuktā sarvadharmajñā vijñāne brahmaṇā samā..
dvāsaptativibhedaiḥ sā nava khaṃḍānyacīkarat.. 39.125 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ता सर्वधर्मज्ञा विज्ञाने ब्रह्मणा समा..
द्वासप्ततिविभेदैः सा नव खंडान्यचीकरत्.. 39.125 ..
1.4.m: Addressed thus, she who knew all duties and was equal to Brahmā in knowledge / made the nine sections into seventy-two divisions.

1.4.s:
teṣāṃ nāmāni grāmāṃśca pattanāni ca phālguna..
velākūlāni saṃkhyāṃ ca vakṣyāmi tava tattvataḥ.. 39.126 ..
1.4.d:
तेषां नामानि ग्रामांश्च पत्तनानि च फाल्गुन..
वेलाकूलानि संख्यां च वक्ष्यामि तव तत्त्वतः.. 39.126 ..
1.4.m: Their names, villages, cities, O Phālguna, / seacoasts, and their counts I shall describe to you in truth:

1.4.s:
koṭiścatasro grāmāṇāṃ nīvṛdāsīcca maṃḍale..
sārdhakoṭidvayagrāmairdeśo bālāka jacyate.. 39.127 ..
1.4.d:
कोटिश्चतस्रो ग्रामाणां नीवृदासीच्च मंडले..
सार्धकोटिद्वयग्रामैर्देशो बालाक जच्यते.. 39.127 ..
1.4.m: There were forty million villages in the province [of ...]; / the country called Bālāka [consists of] twenty-five million villages.

1.4.s:
sapādakoṭirgrāmāṇāṃ purasāhaṇake viduḥ..
lakṣāścatvāra evāpi grāmāṇāmaṃdhake smṛtāḥ.. 39.128 ..
1.4.d:
सपादकोटिर्ग्रामाणां पुरसाहणके विदुः..
लक्षाश्चत्वार एवापि ग्रामाणामंधके स्मृताः.. 39.128 ..
1.4.m: They know twelve and a half million villages in Purasāhaṇaka; / and four hundred thousand villages are remembered in Andhaka.

1.4.s:
eko lakṣaśca nepāle grāmāṇāṃ parikīrtitaḥ..
ṣaṭ‌trīṃśallakṣamānaṃ tu kānyakubje prakīrtitam.. 39.129 ..
1.4.d:
एको लक्षश्च नेपाले ग्रामाणां परिकीर्तितः..
षट्‌त्रींशल्लक्षमानं तु कान्यकुब्जे प्रकीर्तितम्.. 39.129 ..
1.4.m: One hundred thousand villages is proclaimed in Nepāla; / the measure of thirty-six hundred thousand is proclaimed in Kānyakubja.

1.4.s:
dvāsaptatistathā lakṣā grāmā gājaṇake smṛtāḥ..
aṣṭādaśa tathā lakṣā grāmāṇāṃ gauḍadeśake.. 39.130 ..
1.4.d:
द्वासप्ततिस्तथा लक्षा ग्रामा गाजणके स्मृताः..
अष्टादश तथा लक्षा ग्रामाणां गौडदेशके.. 39.130 ..
1.4.m: Seventy-two hundred thousand villages are remembered in Gājaṇaka; / likewise eighteen hundred thousand villages in the Gauḍa country.

1.4.s:
kāmarūpe ca grāmāṇāṃ navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ..
ḍāhale vedasaṃjñe tu grāmāṇāṃ navalakṣakam.. 39.131 ..
1.4.d:
कामरूपे च ग्रामाणां नवलक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः..
डाहले वेदसंज्ञे तु ग्रामाणां नवलक्षकम्.. 39.131 ..
1.4.m: In Kāmarūpa nine hundred thousand villages are proclaimed; / in Ḍāhala, named Veda, there are nine hundred thousand villages.

1.4.s:
navaiva lakṣā grāmāṇāṃ kāṃtipure prakīrtitāḥ..
navalakṣāstathā caiva mācipure prakīrtitāḥ.. 39.132 ..
1.4.d:
नवैव लक्षा ग्रामाणां कांतिपुरे प्रकीर्तिताः..
नवलक्षास्तथा चैव माचिपुरे प्रकीर्तिताः.. 39.132 ..
1.4.m: Just nine hundred thousand villages are proclaimed in Kāntipura; / and likewise nine hundred thousand are proclaimed in Mācipura.

1.4.s:
oḍḍiyāṇe tathā deśe navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ..
jālaṃdhare tathā deśe navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ.. 39.133 ..
1.4.d:
ओड्डियाणे तथा देशे नवलक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः..
जालंधरे तथा देशे नवलक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः.. 39.133 ..
1.4.m: So also in the Oḍḍiyāṇa country nine hundred thousand are proclaimed; / in the Jālandhara country nine hundred thousand are proclaimed.

1.4.s:
lohapūre tathā deśe lakṣāḥ proktā navaiva ca..
grāmāṇāṃ saptalakṣaṃ ca pāṃbīpure prakīrtitam.. 39.134 ..
1.4.d:
लोहपूरे तथा देशे लक्षाः प्रोक्ता नवैव च..
ग्रामाणां सप्तलक्षं च पांबीपुरे प्रकीर्तितम्.. 39.134 ..
1.4.m: In the Lohapūra country nine hundred thousand are declared; / and seven hundred thousand villages are proclaimed in Pāmbīpura.

1.4.s:
grāmāṇāṃ saptalakṣaṃ ca raṭarāje prakīrtitam..
harīāle ca grāmāṇāṃ lakṣapaṃcakasaṃmitam.. 39.135 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रामाणां सप्तलक्षं च रटराजे प्रकीर्तितम्..
हरीआले च ग्रामाणां लक्षपंचकसंमितम्.. 39.135 ..
1.4.m: Seven hundred thousand villages are proclaimed in Raṭarāja; / and Harīāla is measured as five hundred thousand villages.

1.4.s:
sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ draḍasya viṣaye tathā..
sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ tathāvaṃbhaṇavāhake.. 39.136 ..
1.4.d:
सार्धलक्षत्रयं प्रोक्तं द्रडस्य विषये तथा..
सार्धलक्षत्रयं प्रोक्तं तथावंभणवाहके.. 39.136 ..
1.4.m: Three hundred and fifty thousand are declared in the realm of Draḍa; / three hundred and fifty thousand are likewise declared in Vambhaṇavāhaka.

1.4.s:
ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ grāmaṇāṃ nīlapūrake..
tathāmalaviṣaye pārtha grāmamāṇāmekalakṣakam.. 39.137 ..
1.4.d:
एकविंशतिसाहस्रं ग्रामणां नीलपूरके..
तथामलविषये पार्थ ग्राममाणामेकलक्षकम्.. 39.137 ..
1.4.m: Twenty-one thousand villages are in Nīlapūraka; / likewise in the Amala realm, O son of Pṛthā, [there is] one hundred thousand villages.

1.4.s:
nareṃdunāmadeśe tu lakṣamekaṃ sapādakam..
atilāṃgaladeśe ca lakṣaḥ proktaḥ sapādakaḥ.. 39.138 ..
1.4.d:
नरेंदुनामदेशे तु लक्षमेकं सपादकम्..
अतिलांगलदेशे च लक्षः प्रोक्तः सपादकः.. 39.138 ..
1.4.m: In the country named Narendu [there is] one hundred and twenty-five thousand; / and in the Atilāṅgala country one hundred and twenty-five thousand is declared.

1.4.s:
lakṣāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ navatī dve ca mālave..
sayaṃbhare tathā deśe lakṣaḥ proktaḥ sapādakaḥ.. 39.139 ..
1.4.d:
लक्षाष्टादशसाहस्रं नवती द्वे च मालवे..
सयंभरे तथा देशे लक्षः प्रोक्तः सपादकः.. 39.139 ..
1.4.m: One million eight hundred and ninety-two thousand [villages are] in Mālava; / in the country Sayambhara one hundred and twenty-five thousand is declared.

1.4.s:
mevāḍe ca tathā prokto lakṣaścaikaḥsapādakaḥ..
aśītiśca sahasrāṇi vāguriḥ parikīrtitaḥ.. 39.140 ..
1.4.d:
मेवाडे च तथा प्रोक्तो लक्षश्चैकःसपादकः..
अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि वागुरिः परिकीर्तितः.. 39.140 ..
1.4.m: And in Mevāḍa one hundred and twenty-five thousand is declared; / and Vāguri is proclaimed as eighty thousand.

1.4.s:
grāmasaptatisāhasro gurjarātraḥ prakīrtitaḥ..
tathā saptatisāhasraḥ pāṃḍarviṣaya eva ca.. 39.141 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रामसप्ततिसाहस्रो गुर्जरात्रः प्रकीर्तितः..
तथा सप्ततिसाहस्रः पांडर्विषय एव च.. 39.141 ..
1.4.m: Gurjarātra is proclaimed as having seventy thousand villages; / and likewise the Pāṇḍar realm has seventy thousand.

1.4.s:
jahāhutisahasrāṇi dvācatvāriṃśadeva ca..
aṣṭaṣāṣṭasahasrāṇi proktaṃ kāśmīramaṃḍalam.. 39.142 ..
1.4.d:
जहाहुतिसहस्राणि द्वाचत्वारिंशदेव च..
अष्टषाष्टसहस्राणि प्रोक्तं काश्मीरमंडलम्.. 39.142 ..
1.4.m: Jahāhuti [has] forty-two thousand; / the region of Kāśmīra is declared as sixty-eight thousand.

1.4.s:
ṣaṣṭitriṃśatsahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ kauṃkaṇe viduḥ..
caturdaśaśataṃ dve ca viṃśatīlaghukauṃkaṇam.. 39.143 ..
1.4.d:
षष्टित्रिंशत्सहस्राणि ग्रामाणां कौंकणे विदुः..
चतुर्दशशतं द्वे च विंशतीलघुकौंकणम्.. 39.143 ..
1.4.m: They know thirty-six thousand villages in Kauṅkaṇa; / Minor Kauṅkaṇa has one thousand four hundred and twenty.

1.4.s: siṃdhuḥ sahasradaśake grāmāṇāṃ parikīrtitaḥ.. 39.144 ..
1.4.d: सिंधुः सहस्रदशके ग्रामाणां परिकीर्तितः.. 39.144 ..
1.4.m: Sindhu is proclaimed as having ten thousand villages.

1.4.s:
caturdaśaśate dve ca viṃśatiḥ kacchamaṃḍalam..
paṃcapaṃcāśatsahasraṃ grāmāḥ saurāṣṭramucyate.. 39.145 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्दशशते द्वे च विंशतिः कच्छमंडलम्..
पंचपंचाशत्सहस्रं ग्रामाः सौराष्ट्रमुच्यते.. 39.145 ..
1.4.m: The Kaccha region has one thousand four hundred and twenty; / Saurāṣṭra is said to have fifty-five thousand villages.

1.4.s:
ekaviṃśatisahasro lāḍadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..
atisiṃdhuśca grāmāṇāṃ daśasahasra ucyate..
tathā cāśvamukhaṃ pārtha daśasāhasramucyate.. 39.146 ..
1.4.d:
एकविंशतिसहस्रो लाडदेशः प्रकीर्तितः..
अतिसिंधुश्च ग्रामाणां दशसहस्र उच्यते..
तथा चाश्वमुखं पार्थ दशसाहस्रमुच्यते.. 39.146 ..
1.4.m: The Lāḍa country is proclaimed as having twenty-one thousand; / Atisindhu is said to have ten thousand villages; / and Aśvamukha, O son of Pṛthā, is said to have ten thousand.

1.4.s: sahasradaśakaṃ cāpi ekapādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ.. 39.147 ..
1.4.d: सहस्रदशकं चापि एकपादः प्रकीर्तितः.. 39.147 ..
1.4.m: Ekapāda is proclaimed as having ten thousand.

1.4.s:
tathaiva daśasāhasro deśaḥ sūryamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ..
ekabāhustathā deśo daśasāhasramucyate.. 39.148 ..
1.4.d:
तथैव दशसाहस्रो देशः सूर्यमुखः स्मृतः..
एकबाहुस्तथा देशो दशसाहस्रमुच्यते.. 39.148 ..
1.4.m: Likewise, the Sūryamukha country is remembered as having ten thousand; / the Ekabāhu country is said to have ten thousand.

1.4.s:
sahasradaśakaṃ caiva saṃjāyuriti deśakaḥ..
śivanāmā tathā deśaḥ sahasradaśakaḥ smṛtaḥ..
sahasrāṇi daśa khyātaṃ tathā kālahayaṃjayaḥ.. 39.149 ..
1.4.d:
सहस्रदशकं चैव संजायुरिति देशकः..
शिवनामा तथा देशः सहस्रदशकः स्मृतः..
सहस्राणि दश ख्यातं तथा कालहयंजयः.. 39.149 ..
1.4.m: The country named Sañjāyu [has] ten thousand; / the country named Śiva is remembered as having ten thousand; / likewise Kālahayañjaya is known to have ten thousand.

1.4.s:
liṃgodbhavastathā deśaḥ sahasrāṇi daśaiva ca..
bhadraśca devabhadraśca pratyekaṃ daśakau smṛtau.. 39.150 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगोद्भवस्तथा देशः सहस्राणि दशैव च..
भद्रश्च देवभद्रश्च प्रत्येकं दशकौ स्मृतौ.. 39.150 ..
1.4.m: The Liṅgodbhava country has ten thousand; / and Bhadra and Devabhadra are remembered as having ten [thousand] each.

1.4.s:
ṣaṭ‌triṃśacca sahasrāṇi smṛtau caṭavirāṭakau..
ṣaṭ‌triṃśacca sahasrāṇi yamakoṭiḥ prakīrtitā.. 39.151 ..
1.4.d:
षट्‌त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि स्मृतौ चटविराटकौ..
षट्‌त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि यमकोटिः प्रकीर्तिता.. 39.151 ..
1.4.m: Caṭa and Virāṭaka are remembered as having thirty-six thousand; / Yamakoṭi is proclaimed as having thirty-six thousand.

1.4.s:
aṣṭādaśa tathā koṭyo rāmako deśa ucyate..
tomaraścāpi karṇāṭo yugalaśca trayastvime.. 39.152 ..
1.4.d:
अष्टादश तथा कोट्यो रामको देश उच्यते..
तोमरश्चापि कर्णाटो युगलश्च त्रयस्त्विमे.. 39.152 ..
1.4.m: The Rāmaka country is said to have one hundred and eighty million; / and these three—Tomara, Karṇāṭa, and Yugala—

1.4.s:
sapādalakṣagrāmāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ parikīrtitaḥ..
paṃcalakṣāśca grāmāṇāṃ strīrājyaṃ parikīrtitam.. 39.153 ..
1.4.d:
सपादलक्षग्रामाणां प्रत्येकं परिकीर्तितः..
पंचलक्षाश्च ग्रामाणां स्त्रीराज्यं परिकीर्तितम्.. 39.153 ..
1.4.m: each is declared to have one and a quarter lakh villages. / Strīrājya is proclaimed to have five lakh villages. // 39.153

1.4.s:
pulastyaviṣayaścāpi daśalakṣaka ucyate..
pratyekaṃ lakṣadaśakau deśau kāṃbojakośalau.. 39.154 ..
1.4.d:
पुलस्त्यविषयश्चापि दशलक्षक उच्यते..
प्रत्येकं लक्षदशकौ देशौ कांबोजकोशलौ.. 39.154 ..
1.4.m: The realm of Pulastya is said to have ten lakhs. / The two lands of Kāmboja and Kośala each have ten lakhs. // 39.154

1.4.s:
grāmāṇāṃ ca caturlakṣo bālhikaḥ parikīrtyate..
ṣaṭ‌triṃśacca sahasrāṇi laṃkādeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ.. 39.155 ..
1.4.d:
ग्रामाणां च चतुर्लक्षो बाल्हिकः परिकीर्त्यते..
षट्‌त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि लंकादेशः प्रकीर्तितः.. 39.155 ..
1.4.m: Bālhika is proclaimed to have four lakh villages. / The land of Laṅkā is proclaimed to have thirty-six thousand. // 39.155

1.4.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi kurudeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..
sārdhalakṣastathā proktaḥ kirātavijayo jayaḥ.. 39.156 ..
1.4.d:
चतुःषष्टिसहस्राणि कुरुदेशः प्रकीर्तितः..
सार्धलक्षस्तथा प्रोक्तः किरातविजयो जयः.. 39.156 ..
1.4.m: The land of Kuru is proclaimed to have sixty-four thousand. / Kirātavijaya, [also called] Jaya, is said to have one and a half lakhs. // 39.156

1.4.s:
paṃca prāhustathā lakṣānvidarbhāyāṃ ca grāmakān..
caturdaśasahasrāṇi vardhamānaṃ prakīrtitam.. 39.157 ..
1.4.d:
पंच प्राहुस्तथा लक्षान्विदर्भायां च ग्रामकान्..
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि वर्धमानं प्रकीर्तितम्.. 39.157 ..
1.4.m: They declare five lakh villages in Vidarbhā. / Vardhamāna is proclaimed to have fourteen thousand. // 39.157

1.4.s:
sahasradaśakaṃ cāpi siṃhaladvīpamucyate..
ṣaṭ‌triṃśacca sahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ pāṃḍudeśakaḥ.. 39.158 ..
1.4.d:
सहस्रदशकं चापि सिंहलद्वीपमुच्यते..
षट्‌त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि ग्रामाणां पांडुदेशकः.. 39.158 ..
1.4.m: The island of Siṃhala is said to have ten thousand. / The land of Pāṇḍu has thirty-six thousand villages. // 39.158

1.4.s:
lakṣaikaṃ ca tathā proktaṃ grāmāṇāṃ tu bhayāṇakam..
ṣaṭ‌ṣaṣṭiṃ ca sahasrāṇi deśo māgadha ucyate.. 39.159 ..
1.4.d:
लक्षैकं च तथा प्रोक्तं ग्रामाणां तु भयाणकम्..
षट्‌षष्टिं च सहस्राणि देशो मागध उच्यते.. 39.159 ..
1.4.m: Bhayāṇaka is declared to have one lakh of villages. / The land of Māgadha is said to have sixty-six thousand. // 39.159

1.4.s:
ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tathā grāmāṇāṃ pāṃgudeśakaḥ..
triṃśatsāhasra uktaśca grāmāṇāṃ ca vareṃdukaḥ.. 39.160 ..
1.4.d:
षष्टिसहस्राणि तथा ग्रामाणां पांगुदेशकः..
त्रिंशत्साहस्र उक्तश्च ग्रामाणां च वरेंदुकः.. 39.160 ..
1.4.m: The land of Pāṅgu has sixty thousand villages. / Varenduka is said to have thirty thousand villages. // 39.160

1.4.s:
paṃcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ mūlasthānaṃ prakīrtitam..
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ yāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ.. 39.161 ..
1.4.d:
पंचविंशतिसाहस्रं मूलस्थानं प्रकीर्तितम्..
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि ग्रामाणां यावनः स्मृतः.. 39.161 ..
1.4.m: Mūlasthāna is proclaimed to have twenty-five thousand. / Yāvana is remembered as having forty thousand villages. // 39.161

1.4.s:
catvāryeva sahasrāṇi pakṣabāhurudīryate..
dvāsaptatiramī deśāḥ grāmasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ.. 39.162 ..
1.4.d:
चत्वार्येव सहस्राणि पक्षबाहुरुदीर्यते..
द्वासप्ततिरमी देशाः ग्रामसंख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः.. 39.162 ..
1.4.m: Pakṣabāhu is declared to have just four thousand. / These seventy-two lands have been proclaimed with their numbers of villages. // 39.162

1.4.s:
evaṃ bharatakhaṃḍe'sminṣaṇṇavatyeva koṭayaḥ..
dvāsaptatistathā lakṣāḥ pattanānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ.. 39.163 ..
1.4.d:
एवं भरतखंडेऽस्मिन्षण्णवत्येव कोटयः..
द्वासप्ततिस्तथा लक्षाः पत्तनानां प्रकीर्तिताः.. 39.163 ..
1.4.m: Thus, in this Bhāratakhaṇḍa, ninety-six crores / and seventy-two lakhs of cities are proclaimed, // 39.163

1.4.s:
ṣaṭ‌triṃśacca sahasrāṇi velākūlāni bhārata..
evaṃ vibhajya khaṃḍāni bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ dadau nava.. 39.164 ..
1.4.d:
षट्‌त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि वेलाकूलानि भारत..
एवं विभज्य खंडानि भ्रातृव्याणां ददौ नव.. 39.164 ..
1.4.m: along with thirty-six thousand coastal shores, O descendant of Bharata. / Having thus divided the sections, she gave nine to her brothers' sons, // 39.164

1.4.s:
ātmīyamapi sā devī anicchuṣvapi teṣu ca..
yato mānyeti bhaginī prati krudhyaṃti bhrātaraḥ.. 39.165 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मीयमपि सा देवी अनिच्छुष्वपि तेषु च..
यतो मान्येति भगिनी प्रति क्रुध्यंति भ्रातरः.. 39.165 ..
1.4.m: and her own [portion] as well, even though they were unwilling; / for brothers become angry, [saying] that a sister should be respected. // 39.165

1.4.s:
bhrātṝnprati bhaginī ca vicāryaiva dadau śubhā..
tatkṛtvā sānumānyaitānstaṃbhatīrthamupāgatā.. 39.166 ..
1.4.d:
भ्रातॄन्प्रति भगिनी च विचार्यैव ददौ शुभा..
तत्कृत्वा सानुमान्यैतान्स्तंभतीर्थमुपागता.. 39.166 ..
1.4.m: Reflecting thus toward her brothers, the auspicious lady gave [it to them]. / Having done that and gained their consent, she went to Stambhatīrtha. // 39.166

1.4.s:
tadā teṣu ca deśeṣu caturvargasya sādhanam..
sarveṣāṃ pravaraṃ proktaṃ kumārīśvarameva ca.. 39.167 ..
1.4.d:
तदा तेषु च देशेषु चतुर्वर्गस्य साधनम्..
सर्वेषां प्रवरं प्रोक्तं कुमारीश्वरमेव च.. 39.167 ..
1.4.m: Then, among those lands, Kumārīśvara was declared / the best of all means for attaining the four aims of life. // 39.167

1.4.s:
tatrāpi guptakṣetraṃ ca vedaitatsā kumārikā..
guptakṣetre kumāreśaṃ pūjayaṃti mahāvratā.. 39.168 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रापि गुप्तक्षेत्रं च वेदैतत्सा कुमारिका..
गुप्तक्षेत्रे कुमारेशं पूजयंति महाव्रता.. 39.168 ..
1.4.m: There too, that Kumārikā knew this secret field. / In the secret field, she, observing great vows, worshipped Kumāreśa. // 39.168

1.4.s:
tasthau snāyaṃtī ṣaṭ‌su caivāpi saṃgame..
tataḥ kālaprakarṣāc prāsāde skaṃdanirmite.. 39.169 ..
1.4.d:
तस्थौ स्नायंती षट्‌सु चैवापि संगमे..
ततः कालप्रकर्षाच् प्रासादे स्कंदनिर्मिते.. 39.169 ..
1.4.m: Bathing at the confluence of the six [rivers], she remained there. / Then, with the passage of time, the temple built by Skanda // 39.169

1.4.s:
jīrṇe navyaṃ svarṇamayaṃ prāsādaṃ sāpyakārayat..
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasyā bhaktyātitoṣitaḥ.. 39.170 ..
1.4.d:
जीर्णे नव्यं स्वर्णमयं प्रासादं साप्यकारयत्..
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्या भक्त्यातितोषितः.. 39.170 ..
1.4.m: having decayed, she had a new one made of gold. / Thereupon Mahādeva, pleased, highly gratified by her devotion, // 39.170

1.4.s:
kumāraliṃgādutthāya pratyakṣastāmavocata..
bhadre tavāhaṃ bhaktyā ca vijñānena ca toṣitaḥ.. 39.171 ..
1.4.d:
कुमारलिंगादुत्थाय प्रत्यक्षस्तामवोचत..
भद्रे तवाहं भक्त्या च विज्ञानेन च तोषितः.. 39.171 ..
1.4.m: arose visibly from the liṅga of Kumāra and spoke to her: / ‘O fortunate lady, I am pleased with your devotion and your wisdom. // 39.171

1.4.s:
jīrṇaḥ punaruddhṛto'yaṃ prāsādastena toṣitaḥ..
tava nāmnā ca vikhyāto bhaviṣyāmi kumārike.. 39.172 ..
1.4.d:
जीर्णः पुनरुद्धृतोऽयं प्रासादस्तेन तोषितः..
तव नाम्ना च विख्यातो भविष्यामि कुमारिके.. 39.172 ..
1.4.m: This decayed temple has been restored; I am pleased by that. / O Kumārikā, I shall become famous by your name. // 39.172

1.4.s:
kartā cāpi tathoddhartā dvau vai samaphalau smṛtau..
kumāreśaḥ kumārīśa iti vakṣyaṃti māṃ tataḥ.. 39.173 ..
1.4.d:
कर्ता चापि तथोद्धर्ता द्वौ वै समफलौ स्मृतौ..
कुमारेशः कुमारीश इति वक्ष्यंति मां ततः.. 39.173 ..
1.4.m: The maker and the restorer are both considered equal in merit. / Therefore, people will call me Kumāreśa [and] Kumārīśa. // 39.173

1.4.s:
barkareśe ca ye datta varā dattāḥ sadaiva te..
tavāpi prāptaḥ kālaśca samīpe varavarṇini.. 39.174 ..
1.4.d:
बर्करेशे च ये दत्त वरा दत्ताः सदैव ते..
तवापि प्राप्तः कालश्च समीपे वरवर्णिनि.. 39.174 ..
1.4.m: Whatever boons were given at Barkareśa, they are granted forever. / Your time too has arrived near, O fair-complexioned lady. // 39.174

1.4.s:
abhartṛkāyā nāryāśca na svargo mokṣa eva ca..
yathaiva vṛddhakanyāyāḥ sarasvatyāstaṭe śubhe.. 39.175 ..
1.4.d:
अभर्तृकाया नार्याश्च न स्वर्गो मोक्ष एव च..
यथैव वृद्धकन्यायाः सरस्वत्यास्तटे शुभे.. 39.175 ..
1.4.m: For a woman without a husband there is neither heaven nor liberation, / just as [it happened] to the aged maiden on the auspicious bank of the Sarasvatī. // 39.175

1.4.s:
tasmāttvamatra tīrthe ca mahākālamiti smṛtam..
siddhiṃ gataṃ vṛṇu bhadre patitve varavarṇini.. 39.176 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मात्त्वमत्र तीर्थे च महाकालमिति स्मृतम्..
सिद्धिं गतं वृणु भद्रे पतित्वे वरवर्णिनि.. 39.176 ..
1.4.m: Therefore, here at this sacred ford, choose as your husband the one known as Mahākāla, / who has attained perfection, O auspicious, fair-complexioned lady.’ // 39.176

1.4.s:
tataḥ sā rudravākyena varayāmāsa taṃ patim..
rudralokaṃ yayau cāpi mahākālasanvitā.. 39.177 ..
1.4.d:
ततः सा रुद्रवाक्येन वरयामास तं पतिम्..
रुद्रलोकं ययौ चापि महाकालसन्विता.. 39.177 ..
1.4.m: Then, at the word of Rudra, she chose him as her husband / and went to Rudra's world together with Mahākāla. // 39.177

1.4.s:
tatra tāṃ pārvatī prāha samāliṃgya praharṣitā..
yasmāttvayā citravacca likhitā pṛthivī śubhe.. 39.178 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र तां पार्वती प्राह समालिंग्य प्रहर्षिता..
यस्मात्त्वया चित्रवच्च लिखिता पृथिवी शुभे.. 39.178 ..
1.4.m: There Pārvatī embraced her and, delighted, said to her: / ‘Because, O auspicious lady, you drew the earth like a picture, // 39.178

1.4.s:
citralekhetināmnā tvaṃ tasmādbhava sakhī mama..
tataḥ sakhī samabhavaccitralekheti sā śubhā.. 39.179 ..
1.4.d:
चित्रलेखेतिनाम्ना त्वं तस्माद्भव सखी मम..
ततः सखी समभवच्चित्रलेखेति सा शुभा.. 39.179 ..
1.4.m: therefore become my friend under the name Citralekhā.’ / Then that auspicious lady became her friend named Citralekhā, // 39.179

1.4.s:
yayāniruddhaḥ kathita uṣāyāḥ patiruttamaḥ..
yoginīnāṃ variṣṭhā yā mahākālasya vallabhā.. 39.180 ..
1.4.d:
ययानिरुद्धः कथित उषायाः पतिरुत्तमः..
योगिनीनां वरिष्ठा या महाकालस्य वल्लभा.. 39.180 ..
1.4.m: by whom Aniruddha was described as an excellent husband for Uṣā, / she who was the foremost of yoginīs and the beloved of Mahākāla. // 39.180

1.4.s:
apsusā vārṣikaṃ biṃduṃ pūrṇe varṣaśate papau..
tapaścaraṃtī tasmātsā procyate cāpsarā divi.. 39.181 ..
1.4.d:
अप्सुसा वार्षिकं बिंदुं पूर्णे वर्षशते पपौ..
तपश्चरंती तस्मात्सा प्रोच्यते चाप्सरा दिवि.. 39.181 ..
1.4.m: In the waters she drank a droplet of rain when a hundred years were complete; / performing austerity, she is therefore called an apsaras in heaven. // 39.181

1.4.s:
evaṃvidhā kumārī sā liṃgametaddhi phālguna..
sthāpayāmāsa śivadaṃ barkareśvarasaṃjñitam.. 39.182 ..
1.4.d:
एवंविधा कुमारी सा लिंगमेतद्धि फाल्गुन..
स्थापयामास शिवदं बर्करेश्वरसंज्ञितम्.. 39.182 ..
1.4.m: Such was the maiden, O Phālguna, who established this liṅga / that bestows auspiciousness, known as Barkareśvara. // 39.182

1.4.s:
tasmādatra nṛṇāṃ dāhaścāsthikṣepaśca bhārata..
prayāgādadhikau proktau maheśasya vaco yathā.. 39.183 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe barkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 39 .. cha ..
1.4.d:
तस्मादत्र नृणां दाहश्चास्थिक्षेपश्च भारत..
प्रयागादधिकौ प्रोक्तौ महेशस्य वचो यथा.. 39.183 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कौमारिकाखण्डे बर्करेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः.. 39 .. छ ..
1.4.m:
Therefore, the cremation of men and the casting of bones here / are declared superior to Prayāga, according to the word of Maheśa.” // 39.183
Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Barkareśvara,” in the Kaumārikākhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. // 39

1.4.s:
..arjuna uvāca..
mahākālastvasau kaśca kathaṃ siddhimupāgataḥ..
asmiṃstīrthe muniśreṣṭha mahadāścarya matra me.. 40.1 ..
1.4.d:
..अर्जुन उवाच..
महाकालस्त्वसौ कश्च कथं सिद्धिमुपागतः..
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे मुनिश्रेष्ठ महदाश्चर्य मत्र मे.. 40.1 ..
1.4.m: Arjuna said: / “Who is this Mahākāla, and how did he attain perfection / at this sacred ford, O best of sages? There is great wonder in me concerning this. // 40.1

1.4.s: sarvametatsamākhyāhi śraddadhānāya pṛcchate.. 40.2 ..
1.4.d: सर्वमेतत्समाख्याहि श्रद्दधानाय पृच्छते.. 40.2 ..
1.4.m: Explain all this to me who inquire with faith.” // 40.2

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
namaskṛtya mahākālaṃ varadaṃ sthāṇumavyayam..
śaktitaścaritaṃ tasya vakṣye pāṃḍukulodvaha.. 40.3 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
नमस्कृत्य महाकालं वरदं स्थाणुमव्ययम्..
शक्तितश्चरितं तस्य वक्ष्ये पांडुकुलोद्वह.. 40.3 ..
1.4.m: Nārada said: / “Having bowed to Mahākāla, the boon-granting, immutable Sthāṇu, / I shall tell of his deeds according to my ability, O bearer of the Pāṇḍu family! // 40.3

1.4.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ puri purā babhūva japatāṃ varaḥ..
rudrajāpī mahābhāgo māṃṭirnāma mahāyaśāḥ.. 40.4 ..
1.4.d:
वाराणस्यां पुरि पुरा बभूव जपतां वरः..
रुद्रजापी महाभागो मांटिर्नाम महायशाः.. 40.4 ..
1.4.m: Long ago, in the city of Vārāṇasī, there was a foremost chanter of prayers, / a repeater of the Rudra [hymn], fortunate and of great renown, named Māṇṭi. // 40.4

1.4.s:
tasyāputrasya putrārthe rudrānsaṃjapataḥ kila..
gataṃ varṣaśataṃ tuṣṭastatastaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ.. 40.5 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यापुत्रस्य पुत्रार्थे रुद्रान्संजपतः किल..
गतं वर्षशतं तुष्टस्ततस्तं प्राह शंकरः.. 40.5 ..
1.4.m: As he, being sonless, continually chanted prayers to the Rudras for the sake of a son, / indeed a hundred years passed. Then Śaṃkara, pleased, said to him: // 40.5

1.4.s:
māṃṭe tava suto dhīmānmatprabhāvaparākramaḥ..
vaṃśasya tava sarvasya samuddhartā bhaviṣyati.. 40.6 ..
1.4.d:
मांटे तव सुतो धीमान्मत्प्रभावपराक्रमः..
वंशस्य तव सर्वस्य समुद्धर्ता भविष्यति.. 40.6 ..
1.4.m: ‘O Māṇṭi, you shall have an intelligent son with might and valor like mine, / who will deliver your entire lineage.’ // 40.6

1.4.s:
iti śrutvā rudravaco māṃṭirharṣaṃ paraṃ gataḥ..
tataḥ kāle kiyanmātre patnī māṃṭermahātmanaḥ.. 40.7 ..
1.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा रुद्रवचो मांटिर्हर्षं परं गतः..
ततः काले कियन्मात्रे पत्नी मांटेर्महात्मनः.. 40.7 ..
1.4.m: Hearing this word of Rudra, Māṇṭi felt supreme joy. / Then, after a short time, the wife of high-souled Māṇṭi, // 40.7

1.4.s:
dadhāra garbhaṃ caṭikā tapomūrtidharā yathā..
tasya garbhasya varṣāṇi catvāri kila saṃyayuḥ.. 40.8 ..
1.4.d:
दधार गर्भं चटिका तपोमूर्तिधरा यथा..
तस्य गर्भस्य वर्षाणि चत्वारि किल संययुः.. 40.8 ..
1.4.m: Caṭikā, conceived a child like an embodied form of austerity. / Indeed, four years passed for that fetus, // 40.8

1.4.s:
na punarmāturudaraṃtyaktvā nirgacchate bahiḥ..
tato māṃṭirupāmaṃtrya sāmabhistamavocata.. 40.9 ..
1.4.d:
न पुनर्मातुरुदरंत्यक्त्वा निर्गच्छते बहिः..
ततो मांटिरुपामंत्र्य सामभिस्तमवोचत.. 40.9 ..
1.4.m: yet it would not leave its mother's womb and come outside. / Then Māṇṭi addressed him and spoke to him with soothing words: // 40.9

1.4.s:
vatsa sāmānyaputro'pi pitroḥ sukhakaraḥ sadā..
śuddhāyāṃ mātari bhavo mattaḥ kiṃ pīḍayasyalam.. 40.10 ..
1.4.d:
वत्स सामान्यपुत्रोऽपि पित्रोः सुखकरः सदा..
शुद्धायां मातरि भवो मत्तः किं पीडयस्यलम्.. 40.10 ..
1.4.m: ‘Child, even an ordinary son always brings joy to his parents. / Being born of a pure mother, why do you cause me such distress? // 40.10

1.4.s:
vatsa mānuṣyavāsasya spṛhā tubhyaṃ kathaṃ na hi..
yatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasyāpi ca saṃtatiḥ.. 40.11 ..
1.4.d:
वत्स मानुष्यवासस्य स्पृहा तुभ्यं कथं न हि..
यत्र धर्मार्थकामानां मोक्षस्यापि च संततिः.. 40.11 ..
1.4.m: Child, why do you have no desire to dwell in human life, / where there is the succession of virtue, wealth, pleasure, and even liberation?’ // 40.11

1.4.s:
kadā manuṣyā jāyema pūjā yatra mahāphalā..
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca nānādharmāśca yatra hi.. 40.12 ..
1.4.d:
कदा मनुष्या जायेम पूजा यत्र महाफला..
पितॄणां देवतानां च नानाधर्माश्च यत्र हि.. 40.12 ..
1.4.m: "When will we be born as human beings, where worship yields great fruit, / and where there are [offerings] to ancestors and deities, and manifold righteous duties?"

1.4.s:
iti bhūtāni śocaṃti nānāyonigatānyapi..
tattvaṃ mānuṣyamatulaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ divaukasām..
anādṛtya kathaṃ brūhi sthitaścodara eva ca.. 40.13 ..
1.4.d:
इति भूतानि शोचंति नानायोनिगतान्यपि..
तत्त्वं मानुष्यमतुलं स्पृहणीयं दिवौकसाम्..
अनादृत्य कथं ब्रूहि स्थितश्चोदर एव च.. 40.13 ..
1.4.m: Thus do beings grieve, though dwelling in various wombs. / Disregarding that matchless human state desired by the gods, / why, speak, do you remain in the womb alone?

1.4.s:
..garbha uvāca..
tāta jānāmyahaṃ sarvametatparama durlabham..
kiṃ tu bibhemi cātimātraṃ kālamārgasya nityaśaḥ.. 40.14 ..
1.4.d:
..गर्भ उवाच..
तात जानाम्यहं सर्वमेतत्परम दुर्लभम्..
किं तु बिभेमि चातिमात्रं कालमार्गस्य नित्यशः.. 40.14 ..
1.4.m: The child in the womb said: / "O father, I know all this is exceedingly rare; / yet I am incessantly and exceedingly afraid of the path of time.

1.4.s:
dvau mārgau kila vedeṣu proktau kālo'rcireva ca..
arciṣā mokṣamāyāṃti kālamārgeṇa karmaṇi.. 40.15 ..
1.4.d:
द्वौ मार्गौ किल वेदेषु प्रोक्तौ कालोऽर्चिरेव च..
अर्चिषा मोक्षमायांति कालमार्गेण कर्मणि.. 40.15 ..
1.4.m: Two paths indeed are taught in the Vedas: the path of time and that of light. / By light they attain liberation; by the path of time, they go to action.

1.4.s:
svarge vā narake vāpi kālamārgagato hyayam..
na śarma labhate kvāpi vyādhaviddhamṛgo yathā.. 40.16 ..
1.4.d:
स्वर्गे वा नरके वापि कालमार्गगतो ह्ययम्..
न शर्म लभते क्वापि व्याधविद्धमृगो यथा.. 40.16 ..
1.4.m: Whether in heaven or in hell, he who has gone by the path of time / finds no peace anywhere, like a deer pierced by a hunter.

1.4.s:
tasyaiva hetoḥ prayatetkovido yanna duḥkhavit..
kālena ghorarūpeṇa gaṃbhīreṇa samāhitaḥ.. 40.17 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यैव हेतोः प्रयतेत्कोविदो यन्न दुःखवित्..
कालेन घोररूपेण गंभीरेण समाहितः.. 40.17 ..
1.4.m: For that very reason a wise man should strive that he know no suffering, / when seized by time of terrible form and profound nature.

1.4.s:
taccenmama manastāta nānādoṣairna mohyate..
tato'haṃ durlabhaṃ janma mānuṣyaṃ śīghramāpnuyām.. 40.18 ..
1.4.d:
तच्चेन्मम मनस्तात नानादोषैर्न मोह्यते..
ततोऽहं दुर्लभं जन्म मानुष्यं शीघ्रमाप्नुयाम्.. 40.18 ..
1.4.m: If my mind, O father, will not be deluded by various faults, / then I shall quickly take this rare human birth."

1.4.s:
tatastasya pitā pārtha kāṃdiśīko maheśvaram..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ trāhitrāhi maheśvara.. 40.19 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तस्य पिता पार्थ कांदिशीको महेश्वरम्..
जगाम शरणं देवं त्राहित्राहि महेश्वर.. 40.19 ..
1.4.m: Thereupon his father, O Pārtha, fleeing in distress, / went for refuge to the god Maheśvara, [praying:] "Save me, save me, O Maheśvara!

1.4.s:
tvāṃ vinā ko'paro deva putrasyābhīṣṭado'sti me..
tvayaiva dattastvaṃ cāmuṃ janma prāpaya me sutam.. 40.20 ..
1.4.d:
त्वां विना कोऽपरो देव पुत्रस्याभीष्टदोऽस्ति मे..
त्वयैव दत्तस्त्वं चामुं जन्म प्रापय मे सुतम्.. 40.20 ..
1.4.m: Except for you, O God, who else can grant what is desired for my son? / He was given by you alone; bring this son of mine to birth."

1.4.s:
tatastasyātibhaktyāsau prāha tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ..
vibhūtīḥ svā dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryameva ca.. 40.21 ..
1.4.d:
ततस्तस्यातिभक्त्यासौ प्राह तुष्टो महेश्वरः..
विभूतीः स्वा धर्मज्ञानवैराग्यैश्वर्यमेव च.. 40.21 ..
1.4.m: Then Maheśvara, pleased by his great devotion, said to him: / "His own powers are indeed righteousness, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereign lordship.

1.4.s:
viparītaśca śīghraṃ bho māṃṭiputraḥ prabodhyatām..
tatastā dyotayaṃtyaśca vibhūtyo garbhamūciṃre.. 40.22 ..
1.4.d:
विपरीतश्च शीघ्रं भो मांटिपुत्रः प्रबोध्यताम्..
ततस्ता द्योतयंत्यश्च विभूत्यो गर्भमूचिंरे.. 40.22 ..
1.4.m: Let the converse also be awakened quickly, O son of Māṃṭi!" / Thereupon those luminous powers spoke to the child in the womb:

1.4.s:
mahāmate māṃṭiputra na dhāryaṃ te bhayaṃ hṛdi..
catvārastvāṃ hi dharmādyā manastyakṣyāmahe na te.. 40.23 ..
1.4.d:
महामते मांटिपुत्र न धार्यं ते भयं हृदि..
चत्वारस्त्वां हि धर्माद्या मनस्त्यक्ष्यामहे न ते.. 40.23 ..
1.4.m: "O wise son of Māṃṭi, you must not hold fear in your heart; / for we four, righteousness and the rest, will not forsake your mind."

1.4.s:
tato'parāstvadharmādyāḥ procurnaiva tathā vayam..
bhaviṣyāmo manastubhyamasmattava bhayaṃ na hi.. 40.24 ..
1.4.d:
ततोऽपरास्त्वधर्माद्याः प्रोचुर्नैव तथा वयम्..
भविष्यामो मनस्तुभ्यमस्मत्तव भयं न हि.. 40.24 ..
1.4.m: Then the others, unrighteousness and the rest, said: "We shall never / be in your mind; you have no fear from us."

1.4.s:
ityukte sa vibhūtībhiḥ śīghrameva kumārakaḥ..
niḥsasāra bahirjātaścakaṃpeti ruroda ca.. 40.25 ..
1.4.d:
इत्युक्ते स विभूतीभिः शीघ्रमेव कुमारकः..
निःससार बहिर्जातश्चकंपेति रुरोद च.. 40.25 ..
1.4.m: When addressed thus by the powers, the child at once / came out, and being born, he trembled and wept.

1.4.s:
tato vibhūtayaḥ prāhurmāṃṭe tava sutastvasau..
adyāpi kālamārgasya bhītaḥ kampati roditi.. 40.26 ..
1.4.d:
ततो विभूतयः प्राहुर्मांटे तव सुतस्त्वसौ..
अद्यापि कालमार्गस्य भीतः कम्पति रोदिति.. 40.26 ..
1.4.m: Then the powers said: "O Māṃṭi, this son of yours / trembles and weeps even now, afraid of the path of time.

1.4.s:
kālabhītiriti khyātastasmādeṣa bhaviṣyati..
iti dattvā varaṃ tāśca mahādevāṃtikaṃ yayuḥ.. 40.27 ..
1.4.d:
कालभीतिरिति ख्यातस्तस्मादेष भविष्यति..
इति दत्त्वा वरं ताश्च महादेवांतिकं ययुः.. 40.27 ..
1.4.m: Therefore he shall be known by the name Kālabhīti." / Having thus bestowed the boon, they went to Mahādeva's presence.

1.4.s:
so'pi bālaḥ pravavṛdhe śuklapakṣa ivoḍupaḥ..
saṃskṛtaḥ sa ca saṃskārairdhīmānpaśupativratī.. 40.28 ..
1.4.d:
सोऽपि बालः प्रववृधे शुक्लपक्ष इवोडुपः..
संस्कृतः स च संस्कारैर्धीमान्पशुपतिव्रती.. 40.28 ..
1.4.m: The boy also grew up like the moon in the bright fortnight; / consecrated with the sacraments, the wise boy observed the vow of Paśupati.

1.4.s:
paṃcamaṃtrāñjapañchuddhastīrthayātrāparo'bhavat..
rudrakṣetreṣu sasnau sa japanmantrāṃśca bhārata.. 40.29 ..
1.4.d:
पंचमंत्राञ्जपञ्छुद्धस्तीर्थयात्रापरोऽभवत्..
रुद्रक्षेत्रेषु सस्नौ स जपन्मन्त्रांश्च भारत.. 40.29 ..
1.4.m: Chanting the five mantras, purified, he became devoted to going on pilgrimage; / he bathed in the sacred fields of Rudra, chanting mantras, O Bhārata.

1.4.s:
kālabhītiguptakṣetraguṇāñchrutvābhyupāyayau..
snātvā tato mahītoye japtvā mantrāṃśca koṭiśaḥ.. 40.30 ..
1.4.d:
कालभीतिगुप्तक्षेत्रगुणाञ्छ्रुत्वाभ्युपाययौ..
स्नात्वा ततो महीतोये जप्त्वा मन्त्रांश्च कोटिशः.. 40.30 ..
1.4.m: Having heard the virtues of the secret sacred field of Kālabhīti, he went there; / having bathed there in the waters of the Mahī, and chanted mantras crores of times,

1.4.s:
nivṛtto nātidūretha bilvavṛkṣaṃ dadarśa saḥ..
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tasya cādhastallakṣamekaṃ jajāpa saḥ.. 40.31 ..
1.4.d:
निवृत्तो नातिदूरेथ बिल्ववृक्षं ददर्श सः..
दृष्ट्वा तं तस्य चाधस्तल्लक्षमेकं जजाप सः.. 40.31 ..
1.4.m: upon turning back, not very far away, he beheld a bilva tree. / Having seen it, he chanted [the mantra] one hundred thousand times beneath it.

1.4.s:
japatastasya viprasya iṃdriyāṇi layaṃ yayuḥ..
kevalaṃ paramānaṃdasvarūpo'sāvabhūtkṣaṇāt.. 40.32 ..
1.4.d:
जपतस्तस्य विप्रस्य इंद्रियाणि लयं ययुः..
केवलं परमानंदस्वरूपोऽसावभूत्क्षणात्.. 40.32 ..
1.4.m: As that brahmin was chanting, his sense-faculties dissolved; / in an instant he became purely of the nature of supreme bliss.

1.4.s:
tasyānaṃdasya naupamyaṃ svargādīnāṃ bhavetkvacit..
gaṃgodakasyeva mānaṃ kevalaṃ so'pyasāvapi.. 40.33 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यानंदस्य नौपम्यं स्वर्गादीनां भवेत्क्वचित्..
गंगोदकस्येव मानं केवलं सोऽप्यसावपि.. 40.33 ..
1.4.m: There is no comparison anywhere to that bliss, [even] of heaven and the like; / like the measurement of the Gaṅgā’s water, he was alone that, and that alone.

1.4.s:
tatra līno muhurtena punaścābhūdyathā purā..
tato visiṣmiye pārtha kālabhītiruvāca ha.. 40.34 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र लीनो मुहुर्तेन पुनश्चाभूद्यथा पुरा..
ततो विसिष्मिये पार्थ कालभीतिरुवाच ह.. 40.34 ..
1.4.m: Dissolved in it for a muhūrta, he again became as before. / Thereupon Kālabhīti was astonished, O Pārtha, and said:

1.4.s:
nāyaṃ mama mahānando vārāṇasyāṃ na namiṣe..
na prabhāse na kedāre na cāpyamarakaṇṭake.. 40.35 ..
1.4.d:
नायं मम महानन्दो वाराणस्यां न नमिषे..
न प्रभासे न केदारे न चाप्यमरकण्टके.. 40.35 ..
1.4.m: "This great bliss of mine was not in Vārāṇasī, nor in Naimiṣa, / nor in Prabhāsa, nor in Kedāra, nor in Amarakaṇṭaka,

1.4.s:
śrīparvate na cānyatra yādṛśodyapravarttate..
nirvikārāṇi svacchāni gaṃgāṃbāṃsīvakhāni me.. 40.36 ..
1.4.d:
श्रीपर्वते न चान्यत्र यादृशोद्यप्रवर्त्तते..
निर्विकाराणि स्वच्छानि गंगांबांसीवखानि मे.. 40.36 ..
1.4.m: nor on Śrīparvata, nor anywhere else, such as has arisen today! / My sense-faculties are free from modification and clear, like the waters of the Gaṅgā.

1.4.s:
bhūteṣu paramā prītistrijagaddyotate sphuṭam..
dharmamekaṃ paraṃ mahyaṃ cetaścāpyavagacchati.. 40.37 ..
1.4.d:
भूतेषु परमा प्रीतिस्त्रिजगद्द्योतते स्फुटम्..
धर्ममेकं परं मह्यं चेतश्चाप्यवगच्छति.. 40.37 ..
1.4.m: Supreme love for all beings and the threefold world clearly shines; / and my mind understands the one supreme righteousness.

1.4.s:
aho sthānaprabhāvo'yaṃ sphuṭaṃ cāpyatra procyate..
nirdoṣaṃ yacchuci stāna sarvopadravavarjitam.. 40.38 ..
1.4.d:
अहो स्थानप्रभावोऽयं स्फुटं चाप्यत्र प्रोच्यते..
निर्दोषं यच्छुचि स्तान सर्वोपद्रववर्जितम्.. 40.38 ..
1.4.m: Ah, the power of this place! And it is clearly said here: / a place which is faultless, pure, and free from all afflictions—

1.4.s:
tatra sthitasya dharmārthastadvadbhūyātsahasradhā..
tadasmācca prabhāvāddhi jānāmītaḥ svacetasi.. 40.39 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र स्थितस्य धर्मार्थस्तद्वद्भूयात्सहस्रधा..
तदस्माच्च प्रभावाद्धि जानामीतः स्वचेतसि.. 40.39 ..
1.4.m: for one residing there, the purpose of righteousness increases a thousandfold. / Therefore, from this very power, I know this in my heart:

1.4.s:
viśiṣṭaṃ kāśimukhyebhyastīrthebhyaḥ sthānakaṃ tvidam..
tasmādatraiva saṃsthohaṃ tapastapsyāmi puṣkalam.. 40.40 ..
1.4.d:
विशिष्टं काशिमुख्येभ्यस्तीर्थेभ्यः स्थानकं त्विदम्..
तस्मादत्रैव संस्थोहं तपस्तप्स्यामि पुष्कलम्.. 40.40 ..
1.4.m: this place is superior even to the sacred fords headed by Kāśī. / Therefore, staying right here, I shall perform abundant austerity.

1.4.s:
idaṃ cedaṃ tīrthamiti sadā yastṛṣitaścaret..
na sa siddhimavāpnoti kleśenaiva mriyeta saḥ.. 40.41 ..
1.4.d:
इदं चेदं तीर्थमिति सदा यस्तृषितश्चरेत्..
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति क्लेशेनैव म्रियेत सः.. 40.41 ..
1.4.m: He who, ever thirsty, wanders about thinking, 'This sacred ford and that,' / does not attain perfection; he merely dies in weariness."

1.4.s:
iti saṃciṃtya bilvasya vṛkṣasyādho vyavasthitaḥ..
jajāpa mantrānrudrasya aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa dhiṣṭhitaḥ.. 40.42 ..
1.4.d:
इति संचिंत्य बिल्वस्य वृक्षस्याधो व्यवस्थितः..
जजाप मन्त्रान्रुद्रस्य अंगुष्ठाग्रेण धिष्ठितः.. 40.42 ..
1.4.m: Having reflected thus, he stood beneath the bilva tree, / perched on the tip of his big toe, and chanted the mantras of Rudra.

1.4.s:
gṛhītvā niyamaṃ toyabiṃduṃ varṣaśate'gnivat..
tato varṣaśate yāte japatastasya bhārata.. 40.43 ..
1.4.d:
गृहीत्वा नियमं तोयबिंदुं वर्षशतेऽग्निवत्..
ततो वर्षशते याते जपतस्तस्य भारत.. 40.43 ..
1.4.m: Having undertaken the resolve [to take only] a drop of water in a hundred years, [burning] like fire; / then, when a hundred years had passed as he was chanting, O Bhārata,

1.4.s:
kaścittoyabhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ gṛhītvā nara āvrajat..
sataṃ praṇamya prāhedaṃ kālabhītiṃ praharṣataḥ.. 40.44 ..
1.4.d:
कश्चित्तोयभृतं कुम्भं गृहीत्वा नर आव्रजत्..
सतं प्रणम्य प्राहेदं कालभीतिं प्रहर्षतः.. 40.44 ..
1.4.m: a certain man arrived holding a pot filled with water. / Bowing to Kālabhīti, he said this with great joy:

1.4.s:
adya te niyamaḥ pūrṇastoyametanmahāmate..
gṛhāṇa saphalaṃ mahyaṃ śramaṃ kartumihārhasi.. 40.45 ..
1.4.d:
अद्य ते नियमः पूर्णस्तोयमेतन्महामते..
गृहाण सफलं मह्यं श्रमं कर्तुमिहार्हसि.. 40.45 ..
1.4.m: "Today your observance is complete. Take this water, O noble-minded one; / you should make my toil fruitful here."

1.4.s:
..kālabhītiruvāca..
ko bhavānvarṇato brūhi kimācāraśca tattvataḥ..
janmācārau viditvā te grahīṣyāmyanyathā na hi.. 40.46 ..
1.4.d:
..कालभीतिरुवाच..
को भवान्वर्णतो ब्रूहि किमाचारश्च तत्त्वतः..
जन्माचारौ विदित्वा ते ग्रहीष्याम्यन्यथा न हि.. 40.46 ..
1.4.m: Kālabhīti said: / "Speak, who are you by caste, and what is your conduct in truth? / Having known your birth and conduct I shall take it, not otherwise."

1.4.s:
..nara uvāca..
na jāne pitarau svīyau naṣṭau vā sarvathā na hi..
evamevāpi paśyāmi sarvadā'haṃ sa eva ca.. 40.47 ..
1.4.d:
..नर उवाच..
न जाने पितरौ स्वीयौ नष्टौ वा सर्वथा न हि..
एवमेवापि पश्यामि सर्वदाऽहं स एव च.. 40.47 ..
1.4.m: The man said: / "I do not know my parents, whether they are dead or not at all; / I just see in this way, always, that he is indeed that [same].

1.4.s:
ācāraiścāpi dharmaiśca na kāryaṃ mama kiṃcana..
tasmādvakṣyāmi nāpyetanna cāpyasmi samācare.. 40.48 ..
1.4.d:
आचारैश्चापि धर्मैश्च न कार्यं मम किंचन..
तस्माद्वक्ष्यामि नाप्येतन्न चाप्यस्मि समाचरे.. 40.48 ..
1.4.m: I have no concern with conduct or righteous duties; / therefore I will not speak of this, nor am I one who practices it."

1.4.s:
..kālabhītiruvāca..
yadyevaṃ nodakaṃ tubhyaṃ grahīṣyāmyasmi karhicit..
śrṛṇuṣvātra vaco yanme gururāha śrutīritam.. 40.49 ..
1.4.d:
..कालभीतिरुवाच..
यद्येवं नोदकं तुभ्यं ग्रहीष्याम्यस्मि कर्हिचित्..
श्रृणुष्वात्र वचो यन्मे गुरुराह श्रुतीरितम्.. 40.49 ..
1.4.m: Kālabhīti said: / "If so, I will never accept water from you. / Hear on this matter the word that my teacher told me, declared in the scriptures:

1.4.s:
na jñāyate kulaṃ yasya bījaśuddhiṃ vinā tataḥ..
tasya khādanpibanvāpi sādhuḥ sīdati tatkṣaṇāt.. 40.50 ..
1.4.d:
न ज्ञायते कुलं यस्य बीजशुद्धिं विना ततः..
तस्य खादन्पिबन्वापि साधुः सीदति तत्क्षणात्.. 40.50 ..
1.4.m: 'One whose family is not known, without purity of seed— / eating or drinking from him, a virtuous person falls instantly.

1.4.s:
yaśca rudraṃ na jānāti rudrabhaktaśca yo nahi..
annodakaṃ tasya bhuñjanpātakī syānna saṃśayaḥ.. 40.51 ..
1.4.d:
यश्च रुद्रं न जानाति रुद्रभक्तश्च यो नहि..
अन्नोदकं तस्य भुञ्जन्पातकी स्यान्न संशयः.. 40.51 ..
1.4.m: And he who does not know Rudra, and who is not a devotee of Rudra— / consuming his food and water, one becomes a sinner, without doubt.

1.4.s:
ajñātvā yaḥ śivaṃ bhuṃkte kathyate so'tra brahmahā..
mārṣṭi ca brahmahānnāde tasmāttasya na bhakṣayet.. 40.52 ..
1.4.d:
अज्ञात्वा यः शिवं भुंक्ते कथ्यते सोऽत्र ब्रह्महा..
मार्ष्टि च ब्रह्महान्नादे तस्मात्तस्य न भक्षयेत्.. 40.52 ..
1.4.m: He who eats without knowing Śiva is called a slayer of a brahmin here; / and a slayer of a brahmin wipes off [his sin] on the eater of his food; therefore one should not eat his [food].

1.4.s:
gaṃgodakumbhaḥ syādyadvattanmadhye madyabiṃdunā..
aśivajñasya yo bhuṃkte śivajño'pi tathaiva saḥ.. 40.53 ..
1.4.d:
गंगोदकुम्भः स्याद्यद्वत्तन्मध्ये मद्यबिंदुना..
अशिवज्ञस्य यो भुंक्ते शिवज्ञोऽपि तथैव सः.. 40.53 ..
1.4.m: Just as a pot of Gaṅgā water becomes [polluted] by a drop of liquor within it, / so is he who eats [food] from one who knows not Śiva, even though he himself knows Śiva.'"

1.4.s:
hīnavarṇaśca yaḥ syāddhi śivabhakto'pi naiva saḥ..
pratigṛhyau guṇau tasmādvilokyau dvau pratigrahe.. 40.54 ..
1.4.d:
हीनवर्णश्च यः स्याद्धि शिवभक्तोऽपि नैव सः..
प्रतिगृह्यौ गुणौ तस्माद्विलोक्यौ द्वौ प्रतिग्रहे.. 40.54 ..
1.4.m:
And he who is of low caste is not indeed a devotee of Śiva.
Therefore, in accepting a gift, two qualities are to be examined in the acceptance:

1.4.s:
..nara uvāca..
etena tava vākyena hāsyaṃ saṃjāyate mama..
aho mugdho'si mithyā tvamapasmārī jaḍo'pi ca.. 40.55 ..
1.4.d:
..नर उवाच..
एतेन तव वाक्येन हास्यं संजायते मम..
अहो मुग्धोऽसि मिथ्या त्वमपस्मारी जडोऽपि च.. 40.55 ..
1.4.m:
The man said:
At these words of yours, laughter arises in me.
Ah, you are foolish, false, epileptic, and also dull-witted!

1.4.s:
sadā sarveṣu bhūteṣu śivo vasati nityaśaḥ..
sādhvasādhu tato vākyaṃ naiva nindā śivasya sā.. 40.56 ..
1.4.d:
सदा सर्वेषु भूतेषु शिवो वसति नित्यशः..
साध्वसाधु ततो वाक्यं नैव निन्दा शिवस्य सा.. 40.56 ..
1.4.m:
Śiva ever abides constantly in all beings.
Therefore, words good or bad are not slander of Śiva.

1.4.s:
ātmanaśca parasyāpi yaḥ karotyaṃtaro haram..
tasya bhinnadṛśo mṛtyurvidadhe bhayamulbaṇam.. 40.57 ..
1.4.d:
आत्मनश्च परस्यापि यः करोत्यंतरो हरम्..
तस्य भिन्नदृशो मृत्युर्विदधे भयमुल्बणम्.. 40.57 ..
1.4.m:
He who makes a distinction between himself and another with regard to Hara—
for him who sees difference, Death creates terrible fear.

1.4.s:
athavā kā hi pānīye bhavedaśucitā vada..
mṛttikodbhavakumbho'yaṃ pāvakenāpi pācitaḥ.. 40.58 ..
1.4.d:
अथवा का हि पानीये भवेदशुचिता वद..
मृत्तिकोद्भवकुम्भोऽयं पावकेनापि पाचितः.. 40.58 ..
1.4.m:
Or tell me, what impurity could there be in water?
This pot is born of clay and baked by fire;

1.4.s: pūrṇaśca payasā kasminneṣāmaśucitā kutaḥ.. 40.59 ..
1.4.d: पूर्णश्च पयसा कस्मिन्नेषामशुचिता कुतः.. 40.59 ..
1.4.m: and it is filled with water. In which of these is impurity, and whence?

1.4.s:
atha cenmama saṃsargādaśucitvaṃ ca mīyate..
tadasyāṃ saṃsthitaḥ pṛthvyāmahaṃtvaṃ ca kuto vada.. 40.60 ..
1.4.d:
अथ चेन्मम संसर्गादशुचित्वं च मीयते..
तदस्यां संस्थितः पृथ्व्यामहंत्वं च कुतो वद.. 40.60 ..
1.4.m:
Now, if impurity is inferred from contact with me,
then, tell me, where does ‘I-ness’ and ‘you-ness’ come from when residing on this earth?

1.4.s:
kutaḥ pṛthivyāṃ carasi khe tvaṃ naiva carasyuta..
evaṃ vicāryamāṇe te bhāṣitaṃ mugdhavadbhavet.. 40.61 ..
1.4.d:
कुतः पृथिव्यां चरसि खे त्वं नैव चरस्युत..
एवं विचार्यमाणे ते भाषितं मुग्धवद्भवेत्.. 40.61 ..
1.4.m:
Why do you walk on the earth and not walk in the sky?
When considered in this way, your speech becomes like that of a fool.

1.4.s:
..kālabhītiruvāca..
sarvabhūteṣu cedevaṃ śiva eveti cocyate..
nāstikāṃ mṛttikā kasmādbhakṣayaṃti nabhasyake.. 40.62 ..
1.4.d:
..कालभीतिरुवाच..
सर्वभूतेषु चेदेवं शिव एवेति चोच्यते..
नास्तिकां मृत्तिका कस्माद्भक्षयंति नभस्यके.. 40.62 ..
1.4.m:
Kālabhīti said:
If indeed it is said that Śiva alone is in all beings,
then why do the godless eat clay in Bhādrapada?

1.4.s:
śuddhyarthaṃ tena viśvasya sthāpitā saṃsthitiryathā..
phalena pālitā sā ca nānyathā tāṃ śrṛṇuṣva ca.. 40.63 ..
1.4.d:
शुद्ध्यर्थं तेन विश्वस्य स्थापिता संस्थितिर्यथा..
फलेन पालिता सा च नान्यथा तां श्रृणुष्व च.. 40.63 ..
1.4.m:
For the sake of the purification of the universe, an established order was instituted by him in that manner,
and it is maintained by its fruits and not otherwise; listen to that!

1.4.s:
sasarjeti purā dhātā rūpātmakamidaṃ jagat..
tacca nāmaprapañcena baddhaṃ dāmnā ca gauryathā.. 40.64 ..
1.4.d:
ससर्जेति पुरा धाता रूपात्मकमिदं जगत्..
तच्च नामप्रपञ्चेन बद्धं दाम्ना च गौर्यथा.. 40.64 ..
1.4.m:
Formerly the Creator fashioned this world consisting of form;
and it is bound by the expanse of names, as a cow with a rope.

1.4.s:
sa ca nāmaprapañcastu caturddhā bhidyate kila..
dhvanirvarṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityāspadacatuṣṭayam.. 40.65 ..
1.4.d:
स च नामप्रपञ्चस्तु चतुर्द्धा भिद्यते किल..
ध्वनिर्वर्णाः पदं वाक्यमित्यास्पदचतुष्टयम्.. 40.65 ..
1.4.m:
And that expanse of names is divided in four ways indeed:
sound, phonemes, word, and sentence—such is the tetrad of domains.

1.4.s:
tatra dhvanirnādamayo varṇāścākārapūrvakāḥ..
padaṃ `śa vami' ti proktaṃ vākyaṃ ceti śivaṃ' bhajet.. 40.66 ..
1.4.d:
तत्र ध्वनिर्नादमयो वर्णाश्चाकारपूर्वकाः..
पदं `श वमि' ति प्रोक्तं वाक्यं चेति शिवं' भजेत्.. 40.66 ..
1.4.m:
There, sound consists of tone, and the phonemes begin with ‘a’;
the word is declared to be ‘Śiva’, and the sentence is ‘one should worship Śiva.’

1.4.s:
taccāpi vākyaṃ trividhaṃ bhavediti śrutermatam..
prabhusammatamekaṃ ca suhṛtsaṃmatameva ca.. 40.67 ..
1.4.d:
तच्चापि वाक्यं त्रिविधं भवेदिति श्रुतेर्मतम्..
प्रभुसम्मतमेकं च सुहृत्संमतमेव च.. 40.67 ..
1.4.m:
And that sentence is of three kinds according to the view of the Veda:
one commanding like a master, one advising like a friend,

1.4.s:
kāṃtāsaṃmatamevāpi vākyaṃ hi trividhaṃ viduḥ..
prabhuḥ svāmī yathā bhṛtyamādiśatyetadācara.. 40.68 ..
1.4.d:
कांतासंमतमेवापि वाक्यं हि त्रिविधं विदुः..
प्रभुः स्वामी यथा भृत्यमादिशत्येतदाचर.. 40.68 ..
1.4.m:
and one enticing like a beloved woman; thus they know sentence to be threefold.
Just as a master, a lord, commands a servant: ‘Do this!’

1.4.s:
tathā śrutismṛtī cobhe prāhatuḥ prabhusaṃmatam..
itihāsapurāṇādi suhṛtsaṃmatamucyate.. 40.69 ..
1.4.d:
तथा श्रुतिस्मृती चोभे प्राहतुः प्रभुसंमतम्..
इतिहासपुराणादि सुहृत्संमतमुच्यते.. 40.69 ..
1.4.m:
So both Śruti and Smṛti speak with the authority of a master;
Itihāsa, Purāṇa, and the like are said to advise like a friend.

1.4.s:
suhṛdvatpratibodhyainaṃ pravartayati tattvataḥ..
kāvyālāpādikaṃ yacca kāṃtāsaṃmatamucyate.. 40.70 ..
1.4.d:
सुहृद्वत्प्रतिबोध्यैनं प्रवर्तयति तत्त्वतः..
काव्यालापादिकं यच्च कांतासंमतमुच्यते.. 40.70 ..
1.4.m:
Enlightening him like a friend, it directs him to the truth;
and poetry, conversation, and the like are said to entice like a beloved.

1.4.s:
prabhuvākyaṃ smṛtaṃ yacca sabāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ śuci..
suhṛdvākyaṃ tathā śaucaṃ pālayetsvargakāṃkṣayā.. 40.71 ..
1.4.d:
प्रभुवाक्यं स्मृतं यच्च सबाह्याभ्यंतरं शुचि..
सुहृद्वाक्यं तथा शौचं पालयेत्स्वर्गकांक्षया.. 40.71 ..
1.4.m:
The command of a master is remembered as externally and internally pure;
and likewise, desiring heaven, one should observe purity according to the word of a friend.

1.4.s:
tadetatpālanīyaṃ syādbhūmijānāṃ śrutirvadet..
tvayā nāstikyavākyena cedetadabhidhīyate.. 40.72 ..
1.4.d:
तदेतत्पालनीयं स्याद्भूमिजानां श्रुतिर्वदेत्..
त्वया नास्तिक्यवाक्येन चेदेतदभिधीयते.. 40.72 ..
1.4.m:
That very thing is to be observed by those born on earth, as the Śruti declares.
If this is spoken by you with the words of a non-believer,

1.4.s:
etena śrutiśāstrāṇi purāṇaṃ ca vṛtaiva kim..
agre saptarṣipūrvā ye brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā bhavan.. 40.73 ..
1.4.d:
एतेन श्रुतिशास्त्राणि पुराणं च वृतैव किम्..
अग्रे सप्तर्षिपूर्वा ये ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया भवन्.. 40.73 ..
1.4.m:
are the Śrutis, the Śāstras, and the Purāṇa completely in vain?
Were those brahmins and kṣatriyas of old, headed by the Seven Seers,

1.4.s:
mugdhāḥ sarve'bhavandakṣā ye hi vedaṃ gatā hyanu..
tathā vedāṃtavacanaṃ sattvasthā hyūrdhvagāminaḥ.. 40.74 ..
1.4.d:
मुग्धाः सर्वेऽभवन्दक्षा ये हि वेदं गता ह्यनु..
तथा वेदांतवचनं सत्त्वस्था ह्यूर्ध्वगामिनः.. 40.74 ..
1.4.m:
all deluded, while those who followed the Veda were clever?
Likewise, the teaching of Vedānta says: those established in sattva go upward;

1.4.s:
tiṣṭhaṃti rājasā madhye hyadho gacchaṃti tāmasāḥ..
sattvāhāraiḥ sattvavṛttyā svargagāmī bhavettataḥ.. 40.75 ..
1.4.d:
तिष्ठंति राजसा मध्ये ह्यधो गच्छंति तामसाः..
सत्त्वाहारैः सत्त्ववृत्त्या स्वर्गगामी भवेत्ततः.. 40.75 ..
1.4.m:
the rājasic remain in the middle; and the tāmasic go downward.
Therefore, through sattva foods and a sattvic livelihood, one becomes a goer to heaven.

1.4.s:
na caitadapya sūyāmo yadbhūteṣu śivo na hi..
astyeva sarvabhūteṣu śrṛṇvatrāpyupamānakam.. 40.76 ..
1.4.d:
न चैतदप्य सूयामो यद्भूतेषु शिवो न हि..
अस्त्येव सर्वभूतेषु श्रृण्वत्राप्युपमानकम्.. 40.76 ..
1.4.m:
Nor do we envy this: that Śiva is not in beings;
he is indeed present in all beings. Hear also a comparison on this point:

1.4.s:
yathā suvarṇajātāni bhūṣaṇāni bahūni ca..
kānicicchuddharūpāṇi hīnarūpāṇi kānicit.. 40.77 ..
1.4.d:
यथा सुवर्णजातानि भूषणानि बहूनि च..
कानिचिच्छुद्धरूपाणि हीनरूपाणि कानिचित्.. 40.77 ..
1.4.m:
Just as there are many ornaments made of gold,
some of pure form and some of inferior form,

1.4.s:
svarṇaṃ sarveṣu cāstyeva tathaiva sa sadāśivaḥ..
hīnarūpaṃ śodhitaṃ sacchuddhimeti na caikatām.. 40.78 ..
1.4.d:
स्वर्णं सर्वेषु चास्त्येव तथैव स सदाशिवः..
हीनरूपं शोधितं सच्छुद्धिमेति न चैकताम्.. 40.78 ..
1.4.m:
yet gold is present in all of them—in the same way is Sadāśiva.
The inferior form, when purified, attains purity, but not identity [with the pure].

1.4.s:
tathedaṃ śodhitaṃ dehaṃ śuddhaṃ divi vrajetsphuṭam..
tasmātsarvātmanā hīnānna grāhyaṃ bata dhīmatā.. 40.79 ..
1.4.d:
तथेदं शोधितं देहं शुद्धं दिवि व्रजेत्स्फुटम्..
तस्मात्सर्वात्मना हीनान्न ग्राह्यं बत धीमता.. 40.79 ..
1.4.m:
Likewise this body, when purified and made clean, clearly goes to heaven.
Therefore, a wise man should by no means accept [anything] from an inferior person.

1.4.s:
cedidaṃ śodhayeddehaṃ naiva grāhyaṃ samaṃtataḥ..
sarvato yaḥ pratigrāhī nihārāhārayorna ca.. 40.80 ..
1.4.d:
चेदिदं शोधयेद्देहं नैव ग्राह्यं समंततः..
सर्वतो यः प्रतिग्राही निहाराहारयोर्न च.. 40.80 ..
1.4.m:
If one would purify this body, it should not be accepted from every side.
He who accepts gifts from everywhere, and is not [circumspect] in evacuation and food,

1.4.s:
śuciḥ syādalpadivasātpāṣāṇo'sau bhavetsphuṭam..
tasmātsarvātmanā naiva grahīṣyehaṃ jalaṃ sphuṭam.. 40.81 ..
1.4.d:
शुचिः स्यादल्पदिवसात्पाषाणोऽसौ भवेत्स्फुटम्..
तस्मात्सर्वात्मना नैव ग्रहीष्येहं जलं स्फुटम्.. 40.81 ..
1.4.m:
could not be pure; in a few days he clearly becomes a stone.
Therefore, by no means will I clearly accept the water.

1.4.s:
sādhuvāpyathavā'sādhu pramāṇaṃ naḥ śrutiḥ parā..
evamukte sa ca naraḥ prahasandakṣiṇena ca.. 40.82 ..
1.4.d:
साधुवाप्यथवाऽसाधु प्रमाणं नः श्रुतिः परा..
एवमुक्ते स च नरः प्रहसन्दक्षिणेन च.. 40.82 ..
1.4.m:
Whether good or bad, the supreme Śruti is our authority.
When this was said, that man, laughing, and with his right

1.4.s:
aṃguṣṭhena likhanbhūmiṃ cakre gartaṃ mahottamam..
tatra cikṣepa tattoyaṃ tena gartaḥ sma pūritaḥ.. 40.83 ..
1.4.d:
अंगुष्ठेन लिखन्भूमिं चक्रे गर्तं महोत्तमम्..
तत्र चिक्षेप तत्तोयं तेन गर्तः स्म पूरितः.. 40.83 ..
1.4.m:
big toe scratching the ground, made an excellent pit;
into it he poured that water, and by it the pit was filled.

1.4.s:
atyaricyata toyaṃ ca cakre pādena saṃlikhan..
cakre saraḥ pūritaṃ cāpyatiriktajalena tat.. 40.84 ..
1.4.d:
अत्यरिच्यत तोयं च चक्रे पादेन संलिखन्..
चक्रे सरः पूरितं चाप्यतिरिक्तजलेन तत्.. 40.84 ..
1.4.m:
And water remained in excess; scratching with his foot,
he made a lake, and it was filled with that overflowing water.

1.4.s:
tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā naiva vipro visiṣmiye..
yato bahuvidhaṃ citraṃ bhavedbhūtādyupāsiṣu.. 40.85 ..
1.4.d:
तदद्भुतं महद्दृष्ट्वा नैव विप्रो विसिष्मिये..
यतो बहुविधं चित्रं भवेद्भूताद्युपासिषु.. 40.85 ..
1.4.m:
Seeing that great wonder, the brahmin was not astonished at all,
because manifold wonders occur among worshippers of spirits and the like.

1.4.s: taccitreṇa na jahyācca śrutimārgaṃ sanātanam.. 40.86 ..
1.4.d: तच्चित्रेण न जह्याच्च श्रुतिमार्गं सनातनम्.. 40.86 ..
1.4.m: Because of that wonder, one must not abandon the eternal path of the Śruti.

1.4.s:
..nara uvāca..
atimūrkhosi vipra tvaṃ prajñāvādāṃśca bhāṣase..
kiṃ na śrutastvayā ślokaḥ purāvidbhirudīritaḥ..
kūponyasya ghaṭo'nyasya rajjuranyasya bhārata.. 40.87 ..
1.4.d:
..नर उवाच..
अतिमूर्खोसि विप्र त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे..
किं न श्रुतस्त्वया श्लोकः पुराविद्भिरुदीरितः..
कूपोन्यस्य घटोऽन्यस्य रज्जुरन्यस्य भारत.. 40.87 ..
1.4.m:
The man said:
You are extremely foolish, O brahmin, yet you speak words of wisdom!
Have you not heard the verse uttered by those who know the past:
‘The well belongs to one, the pot to another, the rope to another, O descendant of Bharata;

1.4.s:
pāyaṃtyanye pibaṃtyanye sarve te samabhāginaḥ..
tajjalaṃ mama kasmāttvaṃ dharmajño na pibasyasi.. 40.88 ..
1.4.d:
पायंत्यन्ये पिबंत्यन्ये सर्वे ते समभागिनः..
तज्जलं मम कस्मात्त्वं धर्मज्ञो न पिबस्यसि.. 40.88 ..
1.4.m:
others give drink, and others drink: they all share equally [in the merit].’
Why do you, who know dharma, not drink that water of mine?

1.4.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tato vimamṛśe śloko bahudhā samabhāginām..
aniścayādvicāryāsau ghaṭādyaiḥ samabhāgitā.. 40.89 ..
1.4.d:
..नारद उवाच..
ततो विममृशे श्लोको बहुधा समभागिनाम्..
अनिश्चयाद्विचार्यासौ घटाद्यैः समभागिता.. 40.89 ..
1.4.m:
Nārada said:
Then the verse concerning equal partners was reflected upon in various ways,
considering, due to uncertainty, the equal partnership through pots and the like.

1.4.s:
bahupotadravyakṣepaḥ sarvaiḥ sā samabhāgitā..
evaṃ kartuḥ phalaiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ syācca punaḥpunaḥ.. 40.90 ..
1.4.d:
बहुपोतद्रव्यक्षेपः सर्वैः सा समभागिता..
एवं कर्तुः फलैः सर्वैः समं स्याच्च पुनःपुनः.. 40.90 ..
1.4.m:
Like the loading of goods onto many boats, that is equal partnership by all;
thus, the agent’s results would repeatedly be equal for all.

1.4.s:
yaḥ śuciśca śivaṃ dhyāyanprāsādakūpakartari..
jalapratigrahābhāvātpibato'sya samaṃ phalam.. 40.91 ..
1.4.d:
यः शुचिश्च शिवं ध्यायन्प्रासादकूपकर्तरि..
जलप्रतिग्रहाभावात्पिबतोऽस्य समं फलम्.. 40.91 ..
1.4.m:
He who is pure and meditates on Śiva in the maker of temples and wells,
due to the absence of receiving water as a formal gift, has equal fruit upon drinking it.

1.4.s:
iti niścitya provāca kālabhītirnaraṃ ca tam..
satyametkiṃ tu kuṃbhapayasā gartapūraṇe.. 40.92 ..
1.4.d:
इति निश्चित्य प्रोवाच कालभीतिर्नरं च तम्..
सत्यमेत्किं तु कुंभपयसा गर्तपूरणे.. 40.92 ..
1.4.m:
Having decided thus, Kālabhīti said to that man:
‘This is true; yet in the filling of a pit with water from a jar,

1.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣato mādṛkkathaṃ pibati bho vada..
sādhu vāpyathavā'sādhu na pibeyaṃ kathaṃcana.. 40.93 ..
1.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यक्षतो मादृक्कथं पिबति भो वद..
साधु वाप्यथवाऽसाधु न पिबेयं कथंचन.. 40.93 ..
1.4.m:
tell me, sir, having witnessed it directly, how could one like me drink?
Whether good or bad, I will not drink under any circumstances.’

1.4.s:
evaṃ viniścayaṃ dṛṣṭvāsya sthiraṃ kurunaṃdana..
puruṣo'sau prahasyaiva kṣaṇādaṃtardadhe tataḥ.. 40.94 ..
1.4.d:
एवं विनिश्चयं दृष्ट्वास्य स्थिरं कुरुनंदन..
पुरुषोऽसौ प्रहस्यैव क्षणादंतर्दधे ततः.. 40.94 ..
1.4.m:
Seeing his firm resolve thus, O joy of the Kurus,
that man simply laughed and disappeared in an instant.

1.4.s:
kālabhītiśca paramaṃ vismayaṃ samupāgataḥ..
vṛttāṃtaḥ koyamityeva ciṃtayāmāsa bhūyasā.. 40.95 ..
1.4.d:
कालभीतिश्च परमं विस्मयं समुपागतः..
वृत्तांतः कोयमित्येव चिंतयामास भूयसा.. 40.95 ..
1.4.m:
And Kālabhīti arrived at supreme amazement,
and pondered intensely: ‘What is this incident?’

1.4.s:
tataściṃtayatastasya bilvādhastātsuśobhanam..
ucchritaṃ sumahāliṃgaṃ pṛthivyā dyotayaddiśaḥ.. 40.96 ..
1.4.d:
ततश्चिंतयतस्तस्य बिल्वाधस्तात्सुशोभनम्..
उच्छ्रितं सुमहालिंगं पृथिव्या द्योतयद्दिशः.. 40.96 ..
1.4.m:
Then, as he was pondering, beneath a bilva tree arose a very beautiful,
exalted, very great liṅga, illuminating the quarters of the earth.

1.4.s:
prādurbhāve tatastasya mahāliṃgasya bhārata..
nanarta khepsarovṛṃdaṃ gadharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ.. 40.97 ..
1.4.d:
प्रादुर्भावे ततस्तस्य महालिंगस्य भारत..
ननर्त खेप्सरोवृंदं गधर्वा ललितं जगुः.. 40.97 ..
1.4.m: Upon the manifestation of that great liṅga, O descendant of Bharata, / a host of apsarases danced in the sky, and gandharvas sang gracefully.

1.4.s:
pārijātamayīṃ puṣpavṛṣṭimiṃdro mumoca ha..
jayeti devā munayastuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ.. 40.98 ..
1.4.d:
पारिजातमयीं पुष्पवृष्टिमिंद्रो मुमोच ह..
जयेति देवा मुनयस्तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तवैः.. 40.98 ..
1.4.m: Indra showered down a rain of pārijāta flowers; / the gods and sages praised him with various hymns, crying, "Be victorious!"

1.4.s:
tasminmahati kauravya vartamāne mahotsave..
kālabhītiḥ pramuditaḥ praṇamya stotramairayat.. 40.99 ..
1.4.d:
तस्मिन्महति कौरव्य वर्तमाने महोत्सवे..
कालभीतिः प्रमुदितः प्रणम्य स्तोत्रमैरयत्.. 40.99 ..
1.4.m: While that great festival was taking place, O Kauravya, / Kālabhīti, overjoyed, bowed down and recited a hymn:

1.4.s:
pāpasya kālaṃ bhavapaṃkakālaṃ kalākalaṃ kālamārgasya kālam..
devaṃ mahākālamahaṃ prapadye śrīkālakaṃṭhaṃ bhavakālarūpam.. 40.100 ..
1.4.d:
पापस्य कालं भवपंककालं कलाकलं कालमार्गस्य कालम्..
देवं महाकालमहं प्रपद्ये श्रीकालकंठं भवकालरूपम्.. 40.100 ..
1.4.m: "To the death of sin, the destruction of the mire of worldly existence, the lord of arts, the vanquisher of the path of death, / to the god Mahākāla, the glorious Blue-throated One, the form of death to worldly existence, I fly for refuge.

1.4.s:
īśānavaktraṃ praṇamāmi tvāhaṃ stauti śrutiḥ sarvavidyeśvarastvam..
bhūteśvarastvaṃ prapitāmahastvaṃ tasmai namastestu maheśvarāya.. 40.101 ..
1.4.d:
ईशानवक्त्रं प्रणमामि त्वाहं स्तौति श्रुतिः सर्वविद्येश्वरस्त्वम्..
भूतेश्वरस्त्वं प्रपितामहस्त्वं तस्मै नमस्तेस्तु महेश्वराय.. 40.101 ..
1.4.m: I bow to your Īśāna-face; the revealed scripture praises you: 'You are the lord of all knowledge, / you are the lord of beings, you are the great-grandfather'; homage be to that Maheśvara.

1.4.s:
yaṃ stauti vedastamahaṃ prapadye tatpuruṣasaṃjñaṃ śaraṇaṃ dvitīyam..
tvāṃ vidmahe tac nastvaṃ pradehi śrīrudra deveśa namonamaste.. 40.102 ..
1.4.d:
यं स्तौति वेदस्तमहं प्रपद्ये तत्पुरुषसंज्ञं शरणं द्वितीयम्..
त्वां विद्महे तच् नस्त्वं प्रदेहि श्रीरुद्र देवेश नमोनमस्ते.. 40.102 ..
1.4.m: To him whom the Veda praises, the second [face] named Tatpuruṣa, I go for refuge; / 'May we know you, grant us that,' O glorious Rudra, lord of the gods, homage, homage to you.

1.4.s:
aghoravaktraṃ tritayaṃ prapadye atharvajuṣṭaṃ tava rūpakāṇi..
aghoraghorāṇi ca ghoraghorāṇyahaṃ sadānaumi bhūtāni tubhyam.. 40.103 ..
1.4.d:
अघोरवक्त्रं त्रितयं प्रपद्ये अथर्वजुष्टं तव रूपकाणि..
अघोरघोराणि च घोरघोराण्यहं सदानौमि भूतानि तुभ्यम्.. 40.103 ..
1.4.m: I seek refuge in the Aghora face, the third, favored by the Atharvan [Veda]; to your forms, / both non-terrific and terrific, and extremely terrific, and to your beings, I always bow.

1.4.s:
caturthavaktraṃ ca sadā prapadye sadyobhijātāya namonamaste..
bhavebhavenādibhavo bhavasva bhavodbhavo māṃ śiva tatratatra.. 40.104 ..
1.4.d:
चतुर्थवक्त्रं च सदा प्रपद्ये सद्योभिजाताय नमोनमस्ते..
भवेभवेनादिभवो भवस्व भवोद्भवो मां शिव तत्रतत्र.. 40.104 ..
1.4.m: And I ever seek refuge in the fourth face; homage, homage to Sadyojāta! / In existence after existence, be my primordial existence; you who transcend worldly existence, [protect] me everywhere, O Śiva.

1.4.s:
namostu te vāmadevāya jyeṣṭharudrāya kālāya kalāvikāriṇe..
balaṃkarāyāpi balapramāthine bhūtāni haṃtre ca manonmanāya.. 40.105 ..
1.4.d:
नमोस्तु ते वामदेवाय ज्येष्ठरुद्राय कालाय कलाविकारिणे..
बलंकरायापि बलप्रमाथिने भूतानि हंत्रे च मनोन्मनाय.. 40.105 ..
1.4.m: Homage be to you, Vāmadeva, the eldest Rudra, Time, the disturber of parts, / the strengthener, the crusher of strength, the destroyer of creatures, and Manonmana.

1.4.s:
triyaṃbakaṃ tvāṃ ca yajāmahe vayaṃ supuṇyagaṃdhaiḥ śivapuṣṭivardhanam..
urvārukaṃ pakvamivograbaṃdhanādrakṣasva māṃ tryaṃbaka mṛtyumārgāt.. 40.106 ..
1.4.d:
त्रियंबकं त्वां च यजामहे वयं सुपुण्यगंधैः शिवपुष्टिवर्धनम्..
उर्वारुकं पक्वमिवोग्रबंधनाद्रक्षस्व मां त्र्यंबक मृत्युमार्गात्.. 40.106 ..
1.4.m: We worship you, the three-eyed Lord, who increases auspicious prosperity with fragrant scents; / as a ripe cucumber from its stalk, protect me, O Three-eyed One, from the path of death.

1.4.s:
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ maṃtravaraṃ taveśa japaṃti ye munayo vītarāgāḥ..
teṣāṃ prasanno'si japāmahetaṃ tvoṃkārapūrvaṃ ca namaḥ śivāya.. 40.107 ..
1.4.d:
षडक्षरं मंत्रवरं तवेश जपंति ये मुनयो वीतरागाः..
तेषां प्रसन्नोऽसि जपामहेतं त्वोंकारपूर्वं च नमः शिवाय.. 40.107 ..
1.4.m: The six-syllabled supreme mantra of yours, O Lord, which sages free from passion mutter— / you are pleased with them; we mutter that preceded by the syllable Oṃ: 'Homage to Śiva.'"

1.4.s:
evaṃ stuto mahādevo liṃgānniḥsṛtya bhārata..
trijagaddyotayanmabhāsā pratyakṣaḥ prāha ca dvijam.. 40.108 ..
1.4.d:
एवं स्तुतो महादेवो लिंगान्निःसृत्य भारत..
त्रिजगद्द्योतयन्मभासा प्रत्यक्षः प्राह च द्विजम्.. 40.108 ..
1.4.m: Praised in this way, Mahādeva emerged from the liṅga, O descendant of Bharata, / illuminating the three worlds with his splendor, and, appearing visibly, spoke to the twice-born:

1.4.s:
yattvayātra mahātīrthe bhṛśamārādhito dvija..
tenāti tuṣṭaste vatsa neśaḥ kālaḥ kathaṃcana.. 40.109 ..
1.4.d:
यत्त्वयात्र महातीर्थे भृशमाराधितो द्विज..
तेनाति तुष्टस्ते वत्स नेशः कालः कथंचन.. 40.109 ..
1.4.m: "Since you have worshiped me intensely here in this great sacred ford, O twice-born, / I am very pleased with you, child; Death has no power over you in any way.

1.4.s:
ahaṃ ca nararūpī yo dṛṣṭvā te dharmasaṃsthitim..
dhanyastaddharmamārgo'yaṃ pālyate yadbhavadvidhaiḥ.. 40.110 ..
1.4.d:
अहं च नररूपी यो दृष्ट्वा ते धर्मसंस्थितिम्..
धन्यस्तद्धर्ममार्गोऽयं पाल्यते यद्भवद्विधैः.. 40.110 ..
1.4.m: And having seen your adherence to dharma in human form, / blessed is this path of dharma, since it is protected by men like you.

1.4.s:
sarvatīrthodakairgarataḥ pūrito me sarastathā..
jalametanmahāpuṇyaṃ tvadarthaṃ me samāhṛtam.. 40.111 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वतीर्थोदकैर्गरतः पूरितो मे सरस्तथा..
जलमेतन्महापुण्यं त्वदर्थं मे समाहृतम्.. 40.111 ..
1.4.m: The pit was filled by me with water from all sacred fords, and likewise the lake; / this highly sacred water has been brought together by me for your sake.

1.4.s:
saptamaṃtrarahasyaṃ ca yatkṛtaṃ stavanaṃ mama..
anena paṭhyamānena saptamaṃtraphalaṃ bhavet.. 40.112 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तमंत्ररहस्यं च यत्कृतं स्तवनं मम..
अनेन पठ्यमानेन सप्तमंत्रफलं भवेत्.. 40.112 ..
1.4.m: And this praise of me that was composed by you, containing the secret of the seven mantras— / by reciting this, the fruit of the seven mantras will be attained.

1.4.s:
abhīṣṭaṃ ca varaṃ matto vṛṇīṣva manasepsitam..
tvayātitoṣito hyasminādeyaṃ vidyate tava.. 40.113 ..
1.4.d:
अभीष्टं च वरं मत्तो वृणीष्व मनसेप्सितम्..
त्वयातितोषितो ह्यस्मिनादेयं विद्यते तव.. 40.113 ..
1.4.m: Choose from me a desired boon, whatever your mind wishes; / I am exceedingly pleased with you, and there is nothing here that cannot be given to you."

1.4.s:
..kālabhītiruvāca..
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yattvaṃ tuṣṭo'si śaṃkara..
tvattoṣātsaphalā dharmāḥ śramāyaivānyatāmatāḥ.. 40.114 ..
1.4.d:
..कालभीतिरुवाच..
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यत्त्वं तुष्टोऽसि शंकर..
त्वत्तोषात्सफला धर्माः श्रमायैवान्यतामताः.. 40.114 ..
1.4.m: Kālabhīti said: / "I am blessed, I am favored, since you are pleased, O Śaṃkara; / through your satisfaction dharmas bear fruit; otherwise, they are considered mere labor.

1.4.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si sāṃnidyaṃ liṃge'tra kriyatāṃ sadā..
akṣayaṃ tatkṛtaṃ cāstu yalliṃge kriyate'tra ca.. 40.115 ..
1.4.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि सांनिद्यं लिंगेऽत्र क्रियतां सदा..
अक्षयं तत्कृतं चास्तु यल्लिंगे क्रियतेऽत्र च.. 40.115 ..
1.4.m: If you are pleased, let your presence be established forever in this liṅga, / and whatever is performed here at this liṅga, let that become imperishable.

1.4.s:
japato yatphalaṃ devapaṃcamaṃtrāyutena ca..
tatphalaṃ jāyatāṃ naṇāmasya liṃgasya darśane.. 40.116 ..
1.4.d:
जपतो यत्फलं देवपंचमंत्रायुतेन च..
तत्फलं जायतां नणामस्य लिंगस्य दर्शने.. 40.116 ..
1.4.m: The fruit that is obtained, O God, from reciting ten thousand of the five mantras, / let that fruit arise for men upon seeing this liṅga.

1.4.s:
kālamārgādahaṃ yasmānmocito'haṃ maheśvara..
mahākālamiti khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ tasmādbhavatvidam.. 40.117 ..
1.4.d:
कालमार्गादहं यस्मान्मोचितोऽहं महेश्वर..
महाकालमिति ख्यातं लिंगं तस्माद्भवत्विदम्.. 40.117 ..
1.4.m: Because I have been liberated from the path of death, O Maheśvara, / therefore let this liṅga be known as Mahākāla.

1.4.s:
asmiṃśca kūpe yo martyaḥ snātvā tarpayate pitṝn..
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ cāstu pitṝṇāmakṣayā gatiḥ.. 40.118 ..
1.4.d:
अस्मिंश्च कूपे यो मर्त्यः स्नात्वा तर्पयते पितॄन्..
सर्वतीर्थफलं चास्तु पितॄणामक्षया गतिः.. 40.118 ..
1.4.m: And whatever mortal bathes in this well and offers libations to the ancestors, / let him attain the fruit of all sacred fords, and let the ancestors have an imperishable destiny."

1.4.s:
iti tasyavacaḥ śrutvā prītastaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt..
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ yatra liṃgaṃ tatra nityaṃ vasāmyaham.. 40.119 ..
1.4.d:
इति तस्यवचः श्रुत्वा प्रीतस्तं शंकरोऽब्रवीत्..
स्वायंभुवं यत्र लिंगं तत्र नित्यं वसाम्यहम्.. 40.119 ..
1.4.m: Having heard his words, Śaṃkara, well-pleased, said to him: / "Wherever there is a self-manifest liṅga, there I dwell eternally.

1.4.s:
svayaṃbhubāṇaratnotthadātupāṣāṇalohajam..
liṃgaṃ krameṇa phaladamaṃtyātpūrvaṃ daśottaram.. 40.120 ..
1.4.d:
स्वयंभुबाणरत्नोत्थदातुपाषाणलोहजम्..
लिंगं क्रमेण फलदमंत्यात्पूर्वं दशोत्तरम्.. 40.120 ..
1.4.m: A liṅga that is self-manifest, made of a bāṇa-stone, of gems, of minerals, of stone, or of iron / yields fruit in order, each preceding one tenfold greater than the subsequent.

1.4.s:
ākāśe tārakāliṃgaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram..
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dhārapṛṣṭhe tadetattritayaṃ samam.. 40.121 ..
1.4.d:
आकाशे तारकालिंगं पाताले हाटकेश्वरम्..
स्वायंभुवं धारपृष्ठे तदेतत्त्रितयं समम्.. 40.121 ..
1.4.m: The Tārakaliṅga in the sky, Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla, / and the self-manifest [liṅga] on the surface of the earth—these three are equal.

1.4.s:
viśeṣātprārthitaṃ yacca tacca bhaviṣyati..
atra puṣpaṃ phalaṃ pūjā naivedyaṃ stavanakriyā.. 40.122 ..
1.4.d:
विशेषात्प्रार्थितं यच्च तच्च भविष्यति..
अत्र पुष्पं फलं पूजा नैवेद्यं स्तवनक्रिया.. 40.122 ..
1.4.m: And what was specially requested [by you], that too shall be so; / here, a flower, fruit, worship, food offering, an act of praise,

1.4.s:
dānaṃ vānyaśca yatkiṃcidakṣayaṃ tadbhaviṣyati..
māghāsitacaturdaśyāṃ śivayoge ca putraka.. 40.123 ..
1.4.d:
दानं वान्यश्च यत्किंचिदक्षयं तद्भविष्यति..
माघासितचतुर्दश्यां शिवयोगे च पुत्रक.. 40.123 ..
1.4.m: or a gift, or whatever else [is offered], that will become imperishable. / On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, and during an auspicious conjunction with Śiva, O son,

1.4.s:
liṃgācca pūrvataḥ kūpesnātvā yastarpayetpitṝn..
sarvatīrthaphalāvāptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā gatiḥ.. 40.124 ..
1.4.d:
लिंगाच्च पूर्वतः कूपेस्नात्वा यस्तर्पयेत्पितॄन्..
सर्वतीर्थफलावाप्तिः पितॄणां चाक्षया गतिः.. 40.124 ..
1.4.m: whoever bathes in the well to the east of the liṅga and offers libations to the ancestors / obtains the fruit of all sacred fords, and an imperishable destiny for his ancestors.

1.4.s:
tasyāṃ rātrau mahākālaṃ yāmeyāme prapūjayet..
yaḥ kṣipetsarvaliṃgeṣu sa jāgaraphalaṃ labhet.. 40.125 ..
1.4.d:
तस्यां रात्रौ महाकालं यामेयामे प्रपूजयेत्..
यः क्षिपेत्सर्वलिंगेषु स जागरफलं लभेत्.. 40.125 ..
1.4.m: On that night, one should worship Mahākāla during each three-hour watch; / he who applies [offerings] to all the liṅgas obtains the fruit of keeping vigil.

1.4.s:
jiteṃdriyaśca yo nityaṃ māṃ liṃgetra prapūjayet..
bhuktimuktī na dūrasthe tasya nityaṃ dvijottama.. 40.126 ..
1.4.d:
जितेंद्रियश्च यो नित्यं मां लिंगेत्र प्रपूजयेत्..
भुक्तिमुक्ती न दूरस्थे तस्य नित्यं द्विजोत्तम.. 40.126 ..
1.4.m: And whoever, with senses controlled, constantly worships me here in this liṅga, / enjoyment and liberation are not far from him, O best of the twice-born.

1.4.s:
māghe caturdaśyaṣṭamyāṃ somavāre ca parvaṇi..
snātvā sarasi yo'bhyarcya liṃgametacchivaṃ vrajet.. 40.127 ..
1.4.d:
माघे चतुर्दश्यष्टम्यां सोमवारे च पर्वणि..
स्नात्वा सरसि योऽभ्यर्च्य लिंगमेतच्छिवं व्रजेत्.. 40.127 ..
1.4.m: In the month of Māgha, on the fourteenth, the eighth, on a Monday, and on an auspicious day, / he who bathes in the lake, worships this liṅga, and goes to Śiva,

1.4.s:
dānaṃ tapo rudrajāpaḥ sarvamakṣayameva ca..
tvaṃ ca nandī dvitīyo me pratīhāro bhaviṣyasi.. 40.128 ..
1.4.d:
दानं तपो रुद्रजापः सर्वमक्षयमेव च..
त्वं च नन्दी द्वितीयो मे प्रतीहारो भविष्यसि.. 40.128 ..
1.4.m: his gift, austerity, and muttering of the Rudra [hymn] are entirely imperishable. / And you shall become Nandī, my second gatekeeper.

1.4.s:
kālamārgajayādvatsa mahākālā bhidhaściram..
karaṃdhamo'tra rājarṣiracirādāgamiṣyati.. 40.129 ..
1.4.d:
कालमार्गजयाद्वत्स महाकाला भिधश्चिरम्..
करंधमोऽत्र राजर्षिरचिरादागमिष्यति.. 40.129 ..
1.4.m: Because of conquering the path of death, O child, you shall be named Mahākāla for a long time. / The royal seer Karaṃdhama will come here before long;

1.4.s:
tasya procya bhavāndharmāṃstato mallokamāvraja..
ityuktvā bhagavānrudro liṃgamadhye nyalīyata.. 40.130 ..
1.4.d:
तस्य प्रोच्य भवान्धर्मांस्ततो मल्लोकमाव्रज..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्रुद्रो लिंगमध्ये न्यलीयत.. 40.130 ..
1.4.m: having explained to him the dharmas, then go to my realm." / Having spoken thus, the Lord Rudra merged into the center of the liṅga.

1.4.s: mahākālo'pi muditastatra tepe mahattapaḥ.. 40.131 ..
1.4.d: महाकालोऽपि मुदितस्तत्र तेपे महत्तपः.. 40.131 ..
1.4.m: Mahākāla, too, full of joy, performed severe austerity there.

1.4.s:
..iti mahākālaprādurbhāvaḥ..
..nārada uvāca..
atha kenāpi kālena pārtha rājā karaṃdhamaḥ..
viśeṣamicchurdharmeṣu śrutvā tīrthamahāguṇān.. 40.132 ..
1.4.d:
..इति महाकालप्रादुर्भावः..
..नारद उवाच..
अथ केनापि कालेन पार्थ राजा करंधमः..
विशेषमिच्छुर्धर्मेषु श्रुत्वा तीर्थमहागुणान्.. 40.132 ..
1.4.m: Thus ends the manifestation of Mahākāla. / Nārada said: / Then after some time, O son of Pṛthā, King Karaṃdhama, / desiring excellence in dharmas and having heard the great qualities of the sacred ford

1.4.s:
mahākālacaritraṃ ca tatraiva samupāyayau..
mahīsāgara toye'sau snātvā liṃgānyathārcayat.. 40.133 ..
1.4.d:
महाकालचरित्रं च तत्रैव समुपाययौ..
महीसागर तोयेऽसौ स्नात्वा लिंगान्यथार्चयत्.. 40.133 ..
1.4.m: and the history of Mahākāla, arrived at that very place; / having bathed in the water of Mahīsāgara, he worshiped the liṅgas in accordance with rule.

1.4.s:
mahākālamanuprāpya paramāṃ prītimāgataḥ..
sa paśyansumahāliṃgaṃ nātṛpyata janeśvaraḥ.. 40.134 ..
1.4.d:
महाकालमनुप्राप्य परमां प्रीतिमागतः..
स पश्यन्सुमहालिंगं नातृप्यत जनेश्वरः.. 40.134 ..
1.4.m: Having reached Mahākāla, he experienced the highest delight; / beholding that great liṅga, the lord of men was not satiated.

1.4.s:
yathā daridraḥ kṛpaṇo nidhikumbhamavāpya ca..
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mene mahākālaṃ nirīkṣya saḥ.. 40.135 ..
1.4.d:
यथा दरिद्रः कृपणो निधिकुम्भमवाप्य च..
सफलं जीवितं मेने महाकालं निरीक्ष्य सः.. 40.135 ..
1.4.m: Just as a poor and wretched man, upon obtaining a jar of treasure, / so he considered his life fruitful upon seeing Mahākāla,

1.4.s:
paṃcamaṃtrāyutajapaphalaṃ yasyeha darśanāt..
tataḥ saparyayākṣyarcya mahatyāsau praṇamya ca.. 40.136 ..
1.4.d:
पंचमंत्रायुतजपफलं यस्येह दर्शनात्..
ततः सपर्ययाक्ष्यर्च्य महत्यासौ प्रणम्य च.. 40.136 ..
1.4.m: by whose darśana here one gains the fruit of muttering ten thousand of the five mantras; / then, having worshiped it with elaborate service and having bowed down,

1.4.s:
śrutvā ca liṃgapravaraṃ mahākālamupāsadat..
tato rudravacaḥ smṛtvā mahākālaḥ smayanniva.. 40.137 ..
1.4.d:
श्रुत्वा च लिंगप्रवरं महाकालमुपासदत्..
ततो रुद्रवचः स्मृत्वा महाकालः स्मयन्निव.. 40.137 ..
