43 महीसागरसंगमे नारदस्थापितभट्टादित्यसूर्यमूर्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, तत्प्रसंगेन सूर्यपूजा-
विधिवर्णनम्. ............., 170 2
1.4.m: 43 The account of the image of the sun god Bhaṭṭāditya installed by Nārada at the confluence of the Mahī and the sea; in connection with that, a description of the procedure for worshiping the sun... 170 2

1.4.s: 44 bhaṭṭādityasya purataḥ sadyaḥpratyayakārakāṣṭavidhaśapathādidivyaprakārakathanam... 172.2
1.4.d: 44 भट्टादित्यस्य पुरतः सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकाष्टविधशपथादिदिव्यप्रकारकथनम्... 172.2
1.4.m: 44 An exposition before Bhaṭṭāditya of the eight kinds of oaths and other divine ordeals that immediately produce conviction... 172.2

1.4.s: 45 kapilasthāpitakapileśvarasya naṃdabhadravaṇijā trikālamarcākaraṇam,saṃsārāsāravicāra pūrvakaṃ naṃdabhadravaiśyasya śuddhasadācārapravṛttivaṇarnam, saddharmācaraṇaniṣṭhasya naṃdabhadrasya daivavaśādbhāryāputranāśena duḥkhitasya tatsamīpavartinā satyavratākhyena nāstikaśūdreṇa buddhibhedārthaṃ viruddha upadeśe kriyamāṇe nandabhadreṇa tadviruddhavādakhaṇḍanapūrvakaṃ devatāstitvasthāpanapūrvakaṃ saddharmācaraṇāya bhaṭṭārkasthale bahūdakakuṃḍaṃ pratyāgamanam..... 174 1
1.4.d: 45 कपिलस्थापितकपिलेश्वरस्य नंदभद्रवणिजा त्रिकालमर्चाकरणम्,संसारासारविचार पूर्वकं नंदभद्रवैश्यस्य शुद्धसदाचारप्रवृत्तिवणर्नम्, सद्धर्माचरणनिष्ठस्य नंदभद्रस्य दैववशाद्भार्यापुत्रनाशेन दुःखितस्य तत्समीपवर्तिना सत्यव्रताख्येन नास्तिकशूद्रेण बुद्धिभेदार्थं विरुद्ध उपदेशे क्रियमाणे नन्दभद्रेण तद्विरुद्धवादखण्डनपूर्वकं देवतास्तित्वस्थापनपूर्वकं सद्धर्माचरणाय भट्टार्कस्थले बहूदककुंडं प्रत्यागमनम्..... 174 1
1.4.m: 45 Description of the merchant Nandabhadra's threefold daily worship of Kapileśvara installed by Kapila, description of the vaiśya Nandabhadra's pursuit of pure virtuous conduct preceded by reflection on the unsubstantial nature of saṃsāra; when Nandabhadra, intent on practicing true dharma, was grieved by the loss of his wife and son through the power of destiny, and contrary counsel was given to confound his intellect by a nihilist śūdra nearby named Satyavrata, Nandabhadra refuted his contrary thesis, established the existence of the deity, and came to the Bahūdaka pool at the site of Bhaṭṭārka to practice true dharma... 174 1

1.4.s: 46 bahūdakakuṃḍasamīpavartikapileśvaramabhyarcya svatanutyāgārthamudyatasya naṃdabhadravaiśyasya samīpe kuṣṭharogārtena kenacidbrāhmaṇaputreṇāgatya naṃdabhadrāya jñānopadeśakaraṇam, atha naṃdabhadrapṛṣṭena brāhmaṇabālakena nijacaritravṛttāṃtakathanam, tasmādbrāhmaṇabālakādupadeśaśravaṇena suprasannena naṃdabhadreṇa gurudakṣiṇārthaṃ gurūpadeśena gurunāmnā bālādityasthāpanavṛttāṃtavarṇanam
1.4.d: 46 बहूदककुंडसमीपवर्तिकपिलेश्वरमभ्यर्च्य स्वतनुत्यागार्थमुद्यतस्य नंदभद्रवैश्यस्य समीपे कुष्ठरोगार्तेन केनचिद्ब्राह्मणपुत्रेणागत्य नंदभद्राय ज्ञानोपदेशकरणम्, अथ नंदभद्रपृष्टेन ब्राह्मणबालकेन निजचरित्रवृत्तांतकथनम्, तस्माद्ब्राह्मणबालकादुपदेशश्रवणेन सुप्रसन्नेन नंदभद्रेण गुरुदक्षिणार्थं गुरूपदेशेन गुरुनाम्ना बालादित्यस्थापनवृत्तांतवर्णनम्
1.4.m: 46 Description of a certain brahmin's son afflicted with leprosy coming to the vaiśya Nandabhadra—who was prepared to abandon his body after worshipping Kapileśvara situated near the Bahūdaka pool—and imparting spiritual instruction to Nandabhadra; then the brahmin boy, questioned by Nandabhadra, relating the story of his own life; and Nandabhadra, delighted by hearing the instruction from that brahmin boy, installing Bālāditya in the name of his guru according to his guru's instruction as guru-dakṣiṇā.

1.4.s: 47 nāradena bahūdakartārtharakṣārthaṃ siddhāṃbikādicaturdaśamahāśaktīnāṃ saparivārāṇāṃ sthāpanavarṇanam tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ mahāśaktīnāṃ māhātmyavarṇanam. 180
1.4.d: 47 नारदेन बहूदकर्तार्थरक्षार्थं सिद्धांबिकादिचतुर्दशमहाशक्तीनां सपरिवाराणां स्थापनवर्णनम् तासां सर्वासां महाशक्तीनां माहात्म्यवर्णनम्. 180
1.4.m: 47 Description of the installation by Nārada of the fourteen Great Powers headed by Siddhāmbikā, together with their retinues, to protect the Bahūdaka tīrtha; description of the greatness of all those Great Powers. 180

1.4.s: 48 somanāthamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra cauḍadeśīyayorjayaṃtaprāleyanāmakaviprayorvṛttāṃtavarṇanam, somanāthadarśanārthaṃ prabhāsakṣetragamanodyatayostayormārge'tiśrāṃtatayā madhyemārgaṃ luṇṭhamānayoranugrahārthaṃ somanāthaprādurbhāvaḥ, mahīsāgarasaṃgamavartisomakuṇḍasnānasomanāthadarśana-māhātmyavarṇanam, hāṭakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. ... 183 1
1.4.d: 48 सोमनाथमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र चौडदेशीययोर्जयंतप्रालेयनामकविप्रयोर्वृत्तांतवर्णनम्, सोमनाथदर्शनार्थं प्रभासक्षेत्रगमनोद्यतयोस्तयोर्मार्गेऽतिश्रांततया मध्येमार्गं लुण्ठमानयोरनुग्रहार्थं सोमनाथप्रादुर्भावः, महीसागरसंगमवर्तिसोमकुण्डस्नानसोमनाथदर्शन-माहात्म्यवर्णनम्, हाटकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. ... 183 1
1.4.m: 48 Description of the greatness of Somanātha; therein, narration of the account of two brahmins named Jayanta and Prāleya from the Cola country; when the two, setting out for Prabhāsa-kṣetra to see Somanātha, were exhausted on the way and rolling on the path, the manifestation of Somanātha took place to show them grace; description of the greatness of bathing in the Soma-kuṇḍa and seeing Somanātha at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; description of the greatness of the Hāṭakeśvara liṅga... 183 1

1.4.s: 49 nāradasthāpitamahīnagarasthitavividhatīrthamāhātmyaprasaṃge jayādityamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra nāradena sūryadarśanārthaṃ sūryalokaṃ prati gatena nijasthāpitamahīnagarasthabrāhmaṇapraśaṃsāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ sūryanārāyaṇena tatratyabrāhmaṇānāṃ darśanārthaṃ vṛddhātithirūpeṇāgamanam, tatra jñānacarcārūpaparamabhojanamākāṅkṣato bhāskarasya hārītaputreṇāṣṭavarṣavayasā kmaṭhākhyena sarvaśāstrīyasiddhāntasiddhajīvagatyādiviṣayakapraśnānāṃ suspaṣṭatayottarapradānena sūryabhagavato'tyantasaṃtoṣaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanam..... 183 2
1.4.d: 49 नारदस्थापितमहीनगरस्थितविविधतीर्थमाहात्म्यप्रसंगे जयादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र नारदेन सूर्यदर्शनार्थं सूर्यलोकं प्रति गतेन निजस्थापितमहीनगरस्थब्राह्मणप्रशंसायां कृतायां सूर्यनारायणेन तत्रत्यब्राह्मणानां दर्शनार्थं वृद्धातिथिरूपेणागमनम्, तत्र ज्ञानचर्चारूपपरमभोजनमाकाङ्क्षतो भास्करस्य हारीतपुत्रेणाष्टवर्षवयसा क्मठाख्येन सर्वशास्त्रीयसिद्धान्तसिद्धजीवगत्यादिविषयकप्रश्नानां सुस्पष्टतयोत्तरप्रदानेन सूर्यभगवतोऽत्यन्तसंतोषप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्..... 183 2
1.4.m: 49 In the context of the greatness of various tīrthas situated in Mahīnagara founded by Nārada, description of the greatness of Jayāditya; therein, when Nārada went to the realm of the Sun to see the Sun and praised the brahmins living in Mahīnagara founded by himself, Sūryanārāyaṇa arrived in the form of an elderly guest to see the brahmins there; therein, as the Sun-god desired the supreme meal in the form of philosophical discussion, an eight-year-old son of Hārīta named Kamaṭha gave lucid answers to questions regarding the state of the soul after death and other topics established by the doctrines of all the śāstras, and the Sun Lord attained extreme satisfaction... 183 2

1.4.s: 50 atha bhāskarakṛtaśarīralakṣaṇaviṣayakapraśnasya kamaṭhabālakena saśāstrapramāṇasiddhaśa-rīralakṣaṇakathanena samyaguttarapradānam, tatprasaṃgena jīvasya pāralaukikagativarṇanam. -- -. .. ---... 185 1
1.4.d: 50 अथ भास्करकृतशरीरलक्षणविषयकप्रश्नस्य कमठबालकेन सशास्त्रप्रमाणसिद्धश-रीरलक्षणकथनेन सम्यगुत्तरप्रदानम्, तत्प्रसंगेन जीवस्य पारलौकिकगतिवर्णनम्. -- -. .. ---... 185 1
1.4.m: 50 Then, to the question regarding bodily characteristics asked by the Sun-god, the boy Kamaṭha gave proper answers by stating bodily characteristics proven by the authorities of the śāstras; in that context, description of the soul's destiny in the other world... 185 1

1.4.s: 51 atha bhāskarakṛtavividhakarmaphalaviṣayakapraśnasya kamaṭhabālakena saśāstrapramāṇa-siddhasakalaprāṇikarmavipākavarṇanena samyaguttarapradānam, tatprasaṃgena dharmapraśaṃsāvarṇanam, kamaṭhaproktasamyakpraśnottaraśravaṇasaṃtuṣṭena bhagavatā bhāskareṇa tatputraprabhṛti-hārītāditannagarasthabrāhmaṇapraśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ nijanāmakathanam, atha brāhmaṇānāṃ prārthanayā bhagavatā bhāskareṇa jayādityanāmnā tasminmahīnagare mūrtāvavasthitikaraṇam, kamaṭhakṛtā'ṣṭakastotreṇa jayādityastutiḥ, bhagavatā bhāskareṇa kamaṭhākhyāya hārītabrāhmaṇabālakāya varapradānam, jayādityamāhātmyavarṇanam.... 187 1
1.4.d: 51 अथ भास्करकृतविविधकर्मफलविषयकप्रश्नस्य कमठबालकेन सशास्त्रप्रमाण-सिद्धसकलप्राणिकर्मविपाकवर्णनेन सम्यगुत्तरप्रदानम्, तत्प्रसंगेन धर्मप्रशंसावर्णनम्, कमठप्रोक्तसम्यक्प्रश्नोत्तरश्रवणसंतुष्टेन भगवता भास्करेण तत्पुत्रप्रभृति-हारीतादितन्नगरस्थब्राह्मणप्रशंसापूर्वकं निजनामकथनम्, अथ ब्राह्मणानां प्रार्थनया भगवता भास्करेण जयादित्यनाम्ना तस्मिन्महीनगरे मूर्ताववस्थितिकरणम्, कमठकृताऽष्टकस्तोत्रेण जयादित्यस्तुतिः, भगवता भास्करेण कमठाख्याय हारीतब्राह्मणबालकाय वरप्रदानम्, जयादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 187 1
1.4.m: 51 Then, to the question regarding the various fruits of actions asked by the Sun-god, the boy Kamaṭha gave proper answers by describing the ripening of actions of all living beings established by the authority of the śāstras; in that context, praise of dharma is described; the Lord Sun, pleased by hearing the excellent answers given by Kamaṭha, praised the brahmins residing in that city such as his father Hārīta, and declared his own name; then, at the request of the brahmins, the Lord Sun took up residence in an icon in that Mahīnagara under the name Jayāditya; hymn of praise to Jayāditya through an eight-verse hymn composed by Kamaṭha; granting of a boon by the Lord Sun to the brahmin boy named Kamaṭha, son of Hārīta; description of the greatness of Jayāditya... 187 1

1.4.s: 52 atha mahīsāgarasaṃgame brahmadevasthāpitakoṭitīrthamāhātmyavṛttāntavarṇanam,koṭitīrtha-samīpasthātrīśvarabharadvājeśvaragautameśvarāhilyāsaromāhātmyam, ahilyāsarovarṇanaprasaṃgena śakrakṛtāhilyādharṣaṇādivṛttāntavarṇanaḥ.. ... 189 1
1.4.d: 52 अथ महीसागरसंगमे ब्रह्मदेवस्थापितकोटितीर्थमाहात्म्यवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्,कोटितीर्थ-समीपस्थात्रीश्वरभरद्वाजेश्वरगौतमेश्वराहिल्यासरोमाहात्म्यम्, अहिल्यासरोवर्णनप्रसंगेन शक्रकृताहिल्याधर्षणादिवृत्तान्तवर्णनः.. ... 189 1
1.4.m: 52 Then description of the account of the greatness of Koṭitīrtha installed by Brahmā at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; the greatness of Atrīśvara, Bharadvājeśvara, Gautameśvara, and the Ahilyā lake situated near Koṭitīrtha; in the context of describing the Ahilyā lake, narration of Indra's violation of Ahilyā and other events... 189 1

1.4.s: 53 atha mahīsāgarasaṃgame nāradasthāpitasthānarakṣārthakatripuruṣaśālāvyavasthāpanādivṛttāntapūrvakaśālāmāhātmyama, atha nāradīyasarovaranāgeśvaramāhātmyam, aparadvārakottaradvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanam ..... .... 190 1
1.4.d: 53 अथ महीसागरसंगमे नारदस्थापितस्थानरक्षार्थकत्रिपुरुषशालाव्यवस्थापनादिवृत्तान्तपूर्वकशालामाहात्म्यम, अथ नारदीयसरोवरनागेश्वरमाहात्म्यम्, अपरद्वारकोत्तरद्वारकामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ..... .... 190 1
1.4.m: 53 Then, at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean, the greatness of the hall preceded by the account of establishing the Tripuruṣa hall to protect the site founded by Nārada; then the greatness of the lake of Nārada and of Nāgeśvara; description of the greatness of the western and northern Dvārakā... 190 1

1.4.s: 54 atha mahīsāgarasaṃgamavartināradamūrtisthāpanavṛttāntaḥ, tatprasaṃgena bābhravyārjunasaṃvādaḥ, bābhravyeṇārjunāya nāradamūrtisthāpanaprasaṃgenograsenaśrīkṛṣṇasaṃvādakathanapūrvakaṃ śrīkṛṣṇenograsenaśaṃkāpanodanāya nāradapraśaṃsākathanapūrvaka nāradāṣṭakastutikaraṇakathanam, śrīkṛṣṇakṛtanāradapūjādikathanam, nāradamāhātmyavarṇanama......... 190 2
1.4.d: 54 अथ महीसागरसंगमवर्तिनारदमूर्तिस्थापनवृत्तान्तः, तत्प्रसंगेन बाभ्रव्यार्जुनसंवादः, बाभ्रव्येणार्जुनाय नारदमूर्तिस्थापनप्रसंगेनोग्रसेनश्रीकृष्णसंवादकथनपूर्वकं श्रीकृष्णेनोग्रसेनशंकापनोदनाय नारदप्रशंसाकथनपूर्वक नारदाष्टकस्तुतिकरणकथनम्, श्रीकृष्णकृतनारदपूजादिकथनम्, नारदमाहात्म्यवर्णनम......... 190 2
1.4.m: 54 Then the account of the installation of the image of Nārada situated at the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean; in that context, the dialogue between Bābhravya and Arjuna; Bābhravya reciting to Arjuna the dialogue between Ugrasena and Śrī Kṛṣṇa in connection with the installation of the image of Nārada, wherein Śrī Kṛṣṇa praised Nārada and recited an eight-verse hymn to Nārada to remove Ugrasena's doubts; the worship of Nārada performed by Śrī Kṛṣṇa; description of the greatness of Nārada... 190 2

1.4.s: 55 bābhravyamukhādarjunena nāradamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā praśaṃsākaraṇapūrvakaṃ guptakṣetramāhātmyaśravaṇecchayā praśnakaraṇam , nāradenārjunāya guptakṣetrasthitagautameśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaprasaṃgena savistarayogatattvasvarūpalakṣaṇavarṇanam ......... 190 1
1.4.d: 55 बाभ्रव्यमुखादर्जुनेन नारदमाहात्म्यं श्रुत्वा प्रशंसाकरणपूर्वकं गुप्तक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यश्रवणेच्छया प्रश्नकरणम् , नारदेनार्जुनाय गुप्तक्षेत्रस्थितगौतमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनप्रसंगेन सविस्तरयोगतत्त्वस्वरूपलक्षणवर्णनम् ......... 190 1
1.4.m: 55 Arjuna, having heard the greatness of Nārada from the mouth of Bābhravya, praised [him] and asked a question wishing to hear the greatness of the hidden field (Guptakṣetra); in the context of Nārada describing to Arjuna the greatness of the Gautameśvara liṅga situated in Guptakṣetra, a detailed description of the nature and characteristics of the reality of yoga... 190 1

1.4.s:
56 atha mahīnagarakātpūrvadiksthitabrahmasarobrahmeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, nāradasthāpita-
jayādityakūpagarbheśvarāparaparyāyamokṣeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam - ..... 195 1
1.4.d:
56 अथ महीनगरकात्पूर्वदिक्स्थितब्रह्मसरोब्रह्मेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, नारदस्थापित-
जयादित्यकूपगर्भेश्वरापरपर्यायमोक्षेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - ..... 195 1
1.4.m: 56 Then description of the greatness of the Brahmasaras and the Brahmeśvara liṅga situated to the east of Mahīnagara; description of the greatness of the Jayāditya well installed by Nārada, and of Garbheśvara, also known as Mokṣeśvara liṅga... 195 1

1.4.s: 57 atha kedāreśvaranīlakaṇṭhamāhātmyam...... -..... 195
1.4.d: 57 अथ केदारेश्वरनीलकण्ठमाहात्म्यम्...... -..... 195
1.4.m: 57 Then the greatness of Kedāreśvara and Nīlakaṇṭha... 195

1.4.s:
58 atha tasya mahīsāgarasaṃgamakṣetrasya guptakṣetretināmaprasiddhau kāraṇavarṇanam, tatprasaṃgena brahmaloke madhuparkasamaye tīrthakṣetrāṇāṃ mahattvavarṇanaprastāve mahīsāgarasaṃgamena svamukhena svaprakhyātau kriyamāṇāyāṃ brahmaṇo jyeṣṭhaputreṇa dharmeṇa tasmā aprakhyātirūpa-. śāpapradānam, atha tacchāpavacanaśravaṇottaraṃ guhasya tatrāgatya taduktasvaprakhyātisamarthanam, atha dharmeṇa guhasyāgre stutipṛrvakaṃ svāparādhakṣamāpaṇam, mahīsāgarasaṃgamakṣetrasya garvarūpastaṃbhavaśena stambhatīrthākhyayā prasiddhivṛttāntavarṇanapuraḥsaraṃ stambhatīrthāparaparyāyamahīsāgarasaṃgamamāhātmyakathanam, arjunasya tīrthayātrāparisamāptivṛttānta-
varṇanama.... ... ............ ... 195 2
1.4.d:
58 अथ तस्य महीसागरसंगमक्षेत्रस्य गुप्तक्षेत्रेतिनामप्रसिद्धौ कारणवर्णनम्, तत्प्रसंगेन ब्रह्मलोके मधुपर्कसमये तीर्थक्षेत्राणां महत्त्ववर्णनप्रस्तावे महीसागरसंगमेन स्वमुखेन स्वप्रख्यातौ क्रियमाणायां ब्रह्मणो ज्येष्ठपुत्रेण धर्मेण तस्मा अप्रख्यातिरूप-. शापप्रदानम्, अथ तच्छापवचनश्रवणोत्तरं गुहस्य तत्रागत्य तदुक्तस्वप्रख्यातिसमर्थनम्, अथ धर्मेण गुहस्याग्रे स्तुतिपृर्वकं स्वापराधक्षमापणम्, महीसागरसंगमक्षेत्रस्य गर्वरूपस्तंभवशेन स्तम्भतीर्थाख्यया प्रसिद्धिवृत्तान्तवर्णनपुरःसरं स्तम्भतीर्थापरपर्यायमहीसागरसंगममाहात्म्यकथनम्, अर्जुनस्य तीर्थयात्रापरिसमाप्तिवृत्तान्त-
वर्णनम.... ... ............ ... 195 2
1.4.m: 58. Now, description of the reason for that Mahīsāgarasaṃgama sacred field's renown under the name Guptakṣetra; in that connection, in the world of Brahmā at the time of the honey-offering, in the context of describing the greatness of sacred fords and fields, as Mahīsāgarasaṃgama proclaims its own renown with its own mouth, Brahmā's eldest son Dharma pronounces a curse upon it that it become unrenowned; then, after hearing the words of that curse, Guha arrives there and vindicates its statement of its own renown; then Dharma, preceded by praise, begs forgiveness of Guha for his offence; description of the account of its renown under the name Stambhatīrtha on account of the pillar-like stupor of pride in the Mahīsāgarasaṃgama sacred field, followed by the narration of the māhātmya of Mahīsāgarasaṃgama, whose other name is Stambhatīrtha; description of the account of Arjuna's completion of his pilgrimage to sacred fords... 195 2

1.4.s: 59 atha siddheśvaraliṃgasiddhāmbikāmāhātmyam, tatprasaṃgena pāṇḍavatīrthayātrāyāṃ ghaṭotkacākhyasya bhīmaputrasya pāṇḍavaiḥ saha samāgamaḥ, atha śrīkṛṣṇena saha pāṇḍavānāṃ vivāhamaṃgalaviṣaye mantrakaraṇam, atha śrīkṛpṇena kāmakaṭaṃkaṭākhyāyā vṛttāntaṃ saṃvarṇya tasyā vijayapūrvakaṃ varaṇārthaṃ ghaṭotkacasya prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati preṣaṇam, śrīkṛṣṇādīnāmanujñayā ghaṭotkacasya prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati gamanam.......... 197 1
1.4.d: 59 अथ सिद्धेश्वरलिंगसिद्धाम्बिकामाहात्म्यम्, तत्प्रसंगेन पाण्डवतीर्थयात्रायां घटोत्कचाख्यस्य भीमपुत्रस्य पाण्डवैः सह समागमः, अथ श्रीकृष्णेन सह पाण्डवानां विवाहमंगलविषये मन्त्रकरणम्, अथ श्रीकृप्णेन कामकटंकटाख्याया वृत्तान्तं संवर्ण्य तस्या विजयपूर्वकं वरणार्थं घटोत्कचस्य प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं प्रति प्रेषणम्, श्रीकृष्णादीनामनुज्ञया घटोत्कचस्य प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं प्रति गमनम्.......... 197 1
1.4.m: 59. Now, the māhātmya of the Siddhīśvara liṅga and Siddhāmbikā; in that connection, during the Pāṇḍavas' pilgrimage to sacred fords, the meeting of Bhīma's son named Ghaṭotkaca with the Pāṇḍavas; then, consultation of the Pāṇḍavas with Lord Kṛṣṇa regarding an auspicious marriage; then, Lord Kṛṣṇa, describing the story of the maiden named Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā, dispatches Ghaṭotkaca to the city of Prāgjyotiṣa to marry her after conquering her; Ghaṭotkaca's departure for the city of Prāgjyotiṣa by permission of Lord Kṛṣṇa and the others... 197 1

1.4.s: 60 atha ghaṭotkacasya kāmakaṭaṃkaṭāyāḥ prāsāde praveśaḥ atha kāmakaṭaṃkaṭāyā ghaṭotkacena śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇapūrvakamapūrvakathākathanena praśnadvārā niruttarīkaraṇam, atha yuddhopāyena tāṃ kāmakaṭaṃkaṭāṃ parājitya tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhimāruhya śrīkṛṣṇapāṇḍavasamīpaṃ prati ghaṭotkacasyāgamanam, atha ghaṭotkacakāmakaṭaṃkaṭayorvivāhaḥ, tato hiḍimbavane ghaṭotkacena rākṣasarājyakaraṇam, ghaṭotkacasya kāmakaṭaṃkaṭāyāṃ barbarīkākhyasutotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam... 199 1
1.4.d: 60 अथ घटोत्कचस्य कामकटंकटायाः प्रासादे प्रवेशः अथ कामकटंकटाया घटोत्कचेन श्रीकृष्णस्मरणपूर्वकमपूर्वकथाकथनेन प्रश्नद्वारा निरुत्तरीकरणम्, अथ युद्धोपायेन तां कामकटंकटां पराजित्य तस्याः पृष्ठिमारुह्य श्रीकृष्णपाण्डवसमीपं प्रति घटोत्कचस्यागमनम्, अथ घटोत्कचकामकटंकटयोर्विवाहः, ततो हिडिम्बवने घटोत्कचेन राक्षसराज्यकरणम्, घटोत्कचस्य कामकटंकटायां बर्बरीकाख्यसुतोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्... 199 1
1.4.m: 60. Now, Ghaṭotkaca's entrance into the palace of Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā; then, Ghaṭotkaca, having remembered Lord Kṛṣṇa, renders Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā answerless by means of a riddle through the telling of an unprecedented tale; then, having conquered that Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā by means of combat and mounted upon her back, Ghaṭotkaca's return into the presence of Lord Kṛṣṇa and the Pāṇḍavas; then, the marriage of Ghaṭotkaca and Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā; thereafter, the exercise of rakshasa sovereignty by Ghaṭotkaca in the Hiḍimba forest; description of the account of the birth of a son named Barbarīka to Ghaṭotkaca through Kāmakaṭaṅkaṭā... 199 1

1.4.s: 61 atha ghaṭotkacasya barbarīkaṃ putramādāya śrīkṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ dvārakāpurīṃ prati gamanam tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇena barbarīkāya saṃkṣepataścānurvarṇyadharmavarṇanapūrvakaṃ kṣāttradharmānusāreṇa laukikabalaprāptyai devyārādhanārthamupadeśapūrvakaṃ suhṛdayeti nāmakaraṇama, śrīkṛṣṇopadeśena tena suhṛdayena guptakṣetre dagdhasthalīmāgatya devīnāmārādhanam, suprasannānāṃ devīnāmanujñayā tena suhṛdayena tatraiva sthitvā vijayanāmakamāgadhabrāhmaṇasya tatra siddhāmbikāyāḥ purata āgatya mahāvidyāṃ sādhayituṃ pravṛttasya suhṛdayena vighnanivāraṇārthaṃ sāhāyyakaraṇam, vijayavrāhmaṇena mahāvidyāsādhanārthamādau gāṇeśvarakalpopāsanākaraṇavarṇanam 200 2
1.4.d: 61 अथ घटोत्कचस्य बर्बरीकं पुत्रमादाय श्रीकृष्णदर्शनार्थं द्वारकापुरीं प्रति गमनम् ततः श्रीकृष्णेन बर्बरीकाय संक्षेपतश्चानुर्वर्ण्यधर्मवर्णनपूर्वकं क्षात्त्रधर्मानुसारेण लौकिकबलप्राप्त्यै देव्याराधनार्थमुपदेशपूर्वकं सुहृदयेति नामकरणम, श्रीकृष्णोपदेशेन तेन सुहृदयेन गुप्तक्षेत्रे दग्धस्थलीमागत्य देवीनामाराधनम्, सुप्रसन्नानां देवीनामनुज्ञया तेन सुहृदयेन तत्रैव स्थित्वा विजयनामकमागधब्राह्मणस्य तत्र सिद्धाम्बिकायाः पुरत आगत्य महाविद्यां साधयितुं प्रवृत्तस्य सुहृदयेन विघ्ननिवारणार्थं साहाय्यकरणम्, विजयव्राह्मणेन महाविद्यासाधनार्थमादौ गाणेश्वरकल्पोपासनाकरणवर्णनम् 200 2
1.4.m: 61. Now, Ghaṭotkaca, taking along his son Barbarīka, goes to the city of Dvārakā to have darśana of Lord Kṛṣṇa; then Lord Kṛṣṇa, having briefly described the duty of the four castes to Barbarīka, instructs him to worship the Goddess in accordance with the duty of the warrior class to attain worldly strength, and names him Suhṛdaya; at the instruction of Lord Kṛṣṇa, that Suhṛdaya comes to Dagdhasthalī in Guptakṣetra and worships the goddesses; by permission of the highly pleased goddesses, that Suhṛdaya stays right there and provides assistance to avert obstacles for a Magadhan brahmin named Vijaya, who has come there before Siddhāmbikā and set out to master a Mahāvidyā; description of the practice of the ritual rite of Gaṇeśvara undertaken at first by the brahmin Vijaya to master the Mahāvidyā... 200 2

1.4.s: 62 atha gaṇeśvarakṣetrapālotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam, kṣetrapālapūjanādividhānavarṇanam, tato vijayabrāhmaṇena vaṭayakṣiṇīvidyāsādhanam, tataścāparājitāmahāvidyāsādhanam 202 1
1.4.d: 62 अथ गणेश्वरक्षेत्रपालोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, क्षेत्रपालपूजनादिविधानवर्णनम्, ततो विजयब्राह्मणेन वटयक्षिणीविद्यासाधनम्, ततश्चापराजितामहाविद्यासाधनम् 202 1
1.4.m: 62. Now, description of the story of the origin of Gaṇeśvara, the Guardian of the sacred field; description of the rules for the worship of the Guardian of the sacred field, and so forth; then, the mastering of the Vaṭayakṣiṇī vidyā by the brahmin Vijaya; and then, the mastering of the Aparājitā Mahāvidyā... 202 1

1.4.s:
63 atha prathamayāmānte vighnakaraṇārthaṃ samāgatāyā mahājihvārākṣasyāḥ suhṛdayena ghaṭotkacaputreṇa damanam, tato madhyarātrasamaye vighnakaraṇārthaṃ samāgatasya repalendrasya ghaṭotkacaputreṇa suhṛdayena damanam, tatastṛtīyayāmānte vighnakaraṇārthaṃ samāgatāyā duhadruhākhyāśvataryāḥ suhṛdayena hanane kṛte sati tatprakṣepasthale duhadruhākhyagrāmaprasiddhivarṇanam, atha caturthayāme vighnakaraṇārthaṃ samāgatasya kṣapaṇakaveṣadhāriṇaḥ palāśināmno daityasya navakoṭidaityasenāsamanvitasya bhaimiputreṇa suhṛdayena pātālaguhāṃ tamanu gatvā hananam, tataśca tatkṛtena daityavadhena saṃtuṣṭairnāgalokaiḥ suhṛdayāya varapradānam, atha pātālavivarastharatnaliṅgapūjakanāgakanyābhiḥ pravarṇitena mārgeṇa suhṛdayasya -bhūtale siddhāmbikāpuraḥsthale vijayākhyabrāhmaṇasamīpaṃ pratyāgamanam, tataḥ sarvamahāvidyāsiddhisaṃpannatayā
suprasannena vijayabrāhmaṇena suhṛdayāyāśīḥpradānam, tato bhaviṣyatsaṃgrāme pāṇḍavasaṃrakṣaṇahetunā devānāṃ devīnāṃ cānujñayā vijayabrāhmaṇadattasindūrasadṛśahomabhasmagrahaṇapūrvaka sarvadevīdevaiḥ suhadayasya siddhasenetināmakaraṇavarṇanam..... 203
1.4.d:
63 अथ प्रथमयामान्ते विघ्नकरणार्थं समागताया महाजिह्वाराक्षस्याः सुहृदयेन घटोत्कचपुत्रेण दमनम्, ततो मध्यरात्रसमये विघ्नकरणार्थं समागतस्य रेपलेन्द्रस्य घटोत्कचपुत्रेण सुहृदयेन दमनम्, ततस्तृतीययामान्ते विघ्नकरणार्थं समागताया दुहद्रुहाख्याश्वतर्याः सुहृदयेन हनने कृते सति तत्प्रक्षेपस्थले दुहद्रुहाख्यग्रामप्रसिद्धिवर्णनम्, अथ चतुर्थयामे विघ्नकरणार्थं समागतस्य क्षपणकवेषधारिणः पलाशिनाम्नो दैत्यस्य नवकोटिदैत्यसेनासमन्वितस्य भैमिपुत्रेण सुहृदयेन पातालगुहां तमनु गत्वा हननम्, ततश्च तत्कृतेन दैत्यवधेन संतुष्टैर्नागलोकैः सुहृदयाय वरप्रदानम्, अथ पातालविवरस्थरत्नलिङ्गपूजकनागकन्याभिः प्रवर्णितेन मार्गेण सुहृदयस्य -भूतले सिद्धाम्बिकापुरःस्थले विजयाख्यब्राह्मणसमीपं प्रत्यागमनम्, ततः सर्वमहाविद्यासिद्धिसंपन्नतया
सुप्रसन्नेन विजयब्राह्मणेन सुहृदयायाशीःप्रदानम्, ततो भविष्यत्संग्रामे पाण्डवसंरक्षणहेतुना देवानां देवीनां चानुज्ञया विजयब्राह्मणदत्तसिन्दूरसदृशहोमभस्मग्रहणपूर्वक सर्वदेवीदेवैः सुहदयस्य सिद्धसेनेतिनामकरणवर्णनम्..... 203
1.4.m: 63. Now, the subduing by Suhṛdaya, son of Ghaṭotkaca, of the rakshasa woman Mahājihvā who came at the end of the first watch of the night to create obstacles; then, at midnight, the subduing by Suhṛdaya, son of Ghaṭotkaca, of Repalendra who came to create obstacles; then, at the end of the third watch of the night, when the female mule named Duhadruhā, who came to create obstacles, is slain by Suhṛdaya, description of the renown of the village named Duhadruhā at the spot where she was thrown; then, in the fourth watch, the son of Bhīma's son, Suhṛdaya, follows into a cavern of Pātāla and slays the Daitya named Palāśin, who wears the guise of a wandering mendicant and is accompanied by an army of ninety million Daityas, who has come to create obstacles; and then, granting of boons to Suhṛdaya by the folk of the world of the Nāgas, who were satisfied by the slaying of the Daitya performed by him; then, Suhṛdaya's return to the surface of the earth, before Siddhāmbikā, to the presence of the brahmin named Vijaya, along the path described by the serpent maidens who worship the jewel liṅga situated in the cavern of Pātāla; then, bestowing of blessings upon Suhṛdaya by the brahmin Vijaya, who is well-pleased because of having attained the mastery of all the Mahāvidyās; then, for the sake of protecting the Pāṇḍavas in the future war, by permission of the gods and goddesses, taking sacrificial ash resembling vermilion given by the brahmin Vijaya, description of the bestowing of the name Siddhasena upon Suhṛdaya by all the goddesses and gods... 203

1.4.s:
64 atha devyārādhanatatparatayā siddhāmbikāsaṃnidhau siddhasene sthite vanavāsaprasaṃgenāgatānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ madhye'titṛṣārtena bhīmena devīpurataḥ sthite kuṇḍe praveśe kṛte satyatikruddhena siddhasenena bhīmena saha yuddhaṃ kṛtvā bhīmasenasya jarjarīkaraṇam, tato bhīmasenaṃ gṛhītvā sāgare prakṣeptuṃ pracalitasya siddhasenasya samīpe viyati bhagavatā rudradevena samabhyetya siddhasenāya bhīmasenasya pitāmahatvavarṇanam, tadrudravacaḥ śrutvā siddhasenasya śokakaraṇapūrvaka bhomasenāgre'parādhakṣamāpaṇam, bhīmasenena svapautrasyāliṃganam, atha pitāmahāparādhadoṣaviṣaṇṇasya siddhasenasya samudraṃ prati nijaprāṇatyāgārthaṃ gamanam, tannivāraṇārthaṃ bhīmasenasyāpi tatpaścādgamanam, tato rudrasahitābhiḥ siddhāmbikādidevībhiḥ siddhasenasya sāṃtvanapūrvakaṃ caṇḍiletināmakaraṇama, bhīmena caṇḍilena saha
yudhiṣṭhirādipāṇḍavasamīpaṃ gatvā sarvavṛttanivedanama, bhīmasthāpitabhīmeśvararudraliṃṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam. -....... ... .. 205
1.4.d:
64 अथ देव्याराधनतत्परतया सिद्धाम्बिकासंनिधौ सिद्धसेने स्थिते वनवासप्रसंगेनागतानां पाण्डवानां मध्येऽतितृषार्तेन भीमेन देवीपुरतः स्थिते कुण्डे प्रवेशे कृते सत्यतिक्रुद्धेन सिद्धसेनेन भीमेन सह युद्धं कृत्वा भीमसेनस्य जर्जरीकरणम्, ततो भीमसेनं गृहीत्वा सागरे प्रक्षेप्तुं प्रचलितस्य सिद्धसेनस्य समीपे वियति भगवता रुद्रदेवेन समभ्येत्य सिद्धसेनाय भीमसेनस्य पितामहत्ववर्णनम्, तद्रुद्रवचः श्रुत्वा सिद्धसेनस्य शोककरणपूर्वक भोमसेनाग्रेऽपराधक्षमापणम्, भीमसेनेन स्वपौत्रस्यालिंगनम्, अथ पितामहापराधदोषविषण्णस्य सिद्धसेनस्य समुद्रं प्रति निजप्राणत्यागार्थं गमनम्, तन्निवारणार्थं भीमसेनस्यापि तत्पश्चाद्गमनम्, ततो रुद्रसहिताभिः सिद्धाम्बिकादिदेवीभिः सिद्धसेनस्य सांत्वनपूर्वकं चण्डिलेतिनामकरणम, भीमेन चण्डिलेन सह
युधिष्ठिरादिपाण्डवसमीपं गत्वा सर्ववृत्तनिवेदनम, भीमस्थापितभीमेश्वररुद्रलिंङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. -....... ... .. 205
1.4.m: 64. Now, while Siddhasena, intent on worshipping the Goddess, is stationed in the presence of Siddhāmbikā, when Bhīma, extremely afflicted by thirst among the Pāṇḍavas who had arrived in the course of their forest exile, enters the pond situated before the Goddess, the furious Siddhasena fights with Bhīma and severely bruises Bhīmasena; then, as Siddhasena sets out holding Bhīmasena to throw him into the ocean, the Blessed Lord Rudradeva approaches in the sky near Siddhasena and explains that Bhīmasena is his grandfather; having heard those words of Rudra, Siddhasena grieves and begs forgiveness for his offence before Bhīmasena; Bhīmasena embraces his grandson; then Siddhasena, dejected by the fault of offending his grandfather, goes towards the ocean to surrender his own life; in order to prevent him, Bhīmasena also goes after him; then the goddesses headed by Siddhāmbikā, together with Rudra, console Siddhasena and give him the name Caṇḍila; Bhīma goes with Caṇḍila to Yudhiṣṭhira and the other Pāṇḍavas and reports the whole story; description of the māhātmya of the Bhīmeśvara Rudraliṅga installed by Bhīma... 205

1.4.s: 65 atha yudhiṣṭhirakṛtāṃ siddhāmbikāstutiṃ niśamya bhīmasenena yudhiṣṭhirasya strīstutikaratvaṃ matvā nirbhartsanam, tato devyavajñānādbhīmasenasyāṅgavaikalyaprāptau bhīmena svāparādhakṣamāpaṇāya siddhāmbikājagadambikāstutikaraṇama, tato jagadambikayā tasmai varapradānam, atha devyā svasyā nimittāntareṇa lohāṇāsthakeleśvarīdurgāvatseśvarīgayatrāḍetyādināmabhedasthānabhedena tatra kṣetre'vasthitivarṇanapūrvakaṃ sarvapāṇḍavānāmabhayapradānam pāṇḍavairbarbarīkasya tatraiva sthāne saṃsthāpanapūrvakaṃ tīrthayātrākaraṇam... .. 207
1.4.d: 65 अथ युधिष्ठिरकृतां सिद्धाम्बिकास्तुतिं निशम्य भीमसेनेन युधिष्ठिरस्य स्त्रीस्तुतिकरत्वं मत्वा निर्भर्त्सनम्, ततो देव्यवज्ञानाद्भीमसेनस्याङ्गवैकल्यप्राप्तौ भीमेन स्वापराधक्षमापणाय सिद्धाम्बिकाजगदम्बिकास्तुतिकरणम, ततो जगदम्बिकया तस्मै वरप्रदानम्, अथ देव्या स्वस्या निमित्तान्तरेण लोहाणास्थकेलेश्वरीदुर्गावत्सेश्वरीगयत्राडेत्यादिनामभेदस्थानभेदेन तत्र क्षेत्रेऽवस्थितिवर्णनपूर्वकं सर्वपाण्डवानामभयप्रदानम् पाण्डवैर्बर्बरीकस्य तत्रैव स्थाने संस्थापनपूर्वकं तीर्थयात्राकरणम्... .. 207
1.4.m: 65 Next, hearing the praise of Siddhāmbikā uttered by Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīmasena rebukes Yudhiṣṭhira, considering that he is merely praising a woman; then, due to his contempt for the Goddess, Bhīmasena suffers a mutilation of his limbs, whereupon Bhīma utters a praise of Siddhāmbikā, Mother of the Universe, to ask forgiveness for his fault; then the Mother of the Universe grants him a boon; next, the Goddess, residing in that sacred field under different names and at different places for various reasons—such as Keleśvarī, Durgā, Vatseśvarī, and Gayatrāḍā in Lohāṇā—grants safety to all the Pāṇḍavas; the Pāṇḍavas establish Barbarīka in that very place and depart on their pilgrimage... 207

1.4.s:
66 atha trayodaśavarṣānantaraṃ vanavāsānnivṛtya svakīyarājyaṃprāptaye saṃgrāmāṃgaṇaṃ samupasthiteṣu sasainyeṣu pāṇḍavakauraveṣu madhye sarvaśatrusainyavadhasamarthavīraparigaṇanāyāṃ prakrāntāyāṃ ghaṭotkacaputreṇa caṇḍilena sarvātiśāyisvasāmarthyaprakaṭanaprauḍhyā parīkṣāpradānārthaṃ purā dèvyagrataḥ kṛtahomena vijayanāmakasiddhabrāhmaṇena pradattasya sindūrābhabhasmanaḥ svaśarāgre saṃyojanapūrvaka bāṇaprakṣepeṇa sarvaśatrusainyasya mṛtyumarmanidarśanakaraṇama, atha taddṛṣṭvā sarveṣāṃ yudhiṣṭhirādīnāṃ tatpraśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ sumahati sādhuvāde saṃpravṛte satyakasmādeva kṛṣṇena tasya ghaṭotkacaputrasya svacakreṇa śiraścheddrakaraṇam, atha kṛṣṇena tacichra3chedaṃ kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā śeīkākulānpāṃḍavādònghaṭotkacaṃ ca prati tasminsaṃprāmāṃgaṇe siddhūtaḥ. bikadicaturdaśadevīnāmāgamanama, tābhiśca caṇḍilasya prāgjanmajātasuvaconāmakayakṣasya vṛttāntakathanapūrvakaṃ sarveṣāṃ sāntvanam , atha śrīkṛṣṇena tacchiraśchedakaraṇam , atha kṛṣṇena tacchiraśchedaṃ kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokākulānpāṃḍavādīnghaṭotkacaṃ ca prati tasminsaṃgrāmāṃgaṇe siddhāmbikādicaturdaśadevīnāmāgamanam, tābhiśca caṇḍilasya prāgjanmajātasuvarconāmakayakṣasya vṛttāntakathanapūrvakaṃ sarveṣāṃ sāntvanam, atha śrīkṛṣṇena tacchiraśchedakāraṇakathanam, tato devyāmṛtasiñcanena tacchirasomṛtīkaraṇam, atha śrīkṛṣṇena śirorūpasya caṇḍilasya varapradānam, atha śrīkṛṣṇājñayā yuddhabhūmisamīpavartigiriśrṛṃgamadhiruhya tena barbarīkeṇa pāṇḍavakauravāṇāṃ yuddhanirīkṣaṇam, atha bhāratamahāyuddhanivṛtyanantaraṃ garvānvitasya bhīmasya śrīkṛṣṇena barbarīkamukhata: paramapuruṣeṇa hariharābhinnarūpeṇa kenacitparamapuruṣeṇa sarvaṃ sainyaṃ nirdalitamiti satyāpayitvāpi laṃkādvā:sthitakumbhakarṇaśiraḥkaroṭikādarśanena garvapariharaṇavṛttāntavarṇanam, atha raṇājiraṃ pratyetya ghaṭotkacaputrāya barbarīkāya śrīkṛṣṇena varapradānam, atha barbarīkastavaḥ, barbarīkapūjanamāhātmyam, atha mahīnagarasthakedāreśvarātrīśvaranīlakaṇṭheśvarajayādityamāhātmyama, evaṃ saptakrośātmakaguptakṣetrāparaparyāyamahīsāgarasaṃgamakṣetramāhātmyaśravaṇapaṭhanā

1.4.d:
66 अथ त्रयोदशवर्षानन्तरं वनवासान्निवृत्य स्वकीयराज्यंप्राप्तये संग्रामांगणं समुपस्थितेषु ससैन्येषु पाण्डवकौरवेषु मध्ये सर्वशत्रुसैन्यवधसमर्थवीरपरिगणनायां प्रक्रान्तायां घटोत्कचपुत्रेण चण्डिलेन सर्वातिशायिस्वसामर्थ्यप्रकटनप्रौढ्या परीक्षाप्रदानार्थं पुरा द्èव्यग्रतः कृतहोमेन विजयनामकसिद्धब्राह्मणेन प्रदत्तस्य सिन्दूराभभस्मनः स्वशराग्रे संयोजनपूर्वक बाणप्रक्षेपेण सर्वशत्रुसैन्यस्य मृत्युमर्मनिदर्शनकरणम, अथ तद्दृष्ट्वा सर्वेषां युधिष्ठिरादीनां तत्प्रशंसापूर्वकं सुमहति साधुवादे संप्रवृते सत्यकस्मादेव कृष्णेन तस्य घटोत्कचपुत्रस्य स्वचक्रेण शिरश्छेद्द्रकरणम्, अथ कृष्णेन तचिछ्र3छेदं कृतं दृष्ट्वा शेईकाकुलान्पांडवाद्òन्घटोत्कचं च प्रति तस्मिन्संप्रामांगणे सिद्धूतः. बिकदिचतुर्दशदेवीनामागमनम, ताभिश्च चण्डिलस्य प्राग्जन्मजातसुवचोनामकयक्षस्य वृत्तान्तकथनपूर्वकं सर्वेषां सान्त्वनम् , अथ श्रीकृष्णेन तच्छिरश्छेदकरणम् , अथ कृष्णेन तच्छिरश्छेदं कृतं दृष्ट्वा शोकाकुलान्पांडवादीन्घटोत्कचं च प्रति तस्मिन्संग्रामांगणे सिद्धाम्बिकादिचतुर्दशदेवीनामागमनम्, ताभिश्च चण्डिलस्य प्राग्जन्मजातसुवर्चोनामकयक्षस्य वृत्तान्तकथनपूर्वकं सर्वेषां सान्त्वनम्, अथ श्रीकृष्णेन तच्छिरश्छेदकारणकथनम्, ततो देव्यामृतसिञ्चनेन तच्छिरसोमृतीकरणम्, अथ श्रीकृष्णेन शिरोरूपस्य चण्डिलस्य वरप्रदानम्, अथ श्रीकृष्णाज्ञया युद्धभूमिसमीपवर्तिगिरिश्रृंगमधिरुह्य तेन बर्बरीकेण पाण्डवकौरवाणां युद्धनिरीक्षणम्, अथ भारतमहायुद्धनिवृत्यनन्तरं गर्वान्वितस्य भीमस्य श्रीकृष्णेन बर्बरीकमुखत: परमपुरुषेण हरिहराभिन्नरूपेण केनचित्परमपुरुषेण सर्वं सैन्यं निर्दलितमिति सत्यापयित्वापि लंकाद्वा:स्थितकुम्भकर्णशिरःकरोटिकादर्शनेन गर्वपरिहरणवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, अथ रणाजिरं प्रत्येत्य घटोत्कचपुत्राय बर्बरीकाय श्रीकृष्णेन वरप्रदानम्, अथ बर्बरीकस्तवः, बर्बरीकपूजनमाहात्म्यम्, अथ महीनगरस्थकेदारेश्वरात्रीश्वरनीलकण्ठेश्वरजयादित्यमाहात्म्यम, एवं सप्तक्रोशात्मकगुप्तक्षेत्रापरपर्यायमहीसागरसंगमक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यश्रवणपठना
